Meanwhile, in a small bowl, add the remaining tamari, rice vinegar, coconut sugar, ginger, and water and whisk well. Pour into a medium-sized pot and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce the heat and simmer for about 15 minutes, until thickened, whisking occasionally.

Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the cauliflower, beet, broccoli, and squash to the baking sheet. Drizzle with coconut oil and season with parsley, garlic powder, and salt.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until browned and tender. Season with additional salt if needed. Enjoy!

name: Caribbean Okra & Cornmeal
ingredients:
1 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1 1/4 cups
Water
1/2 cup
Okra (trimmed, sliced)
1 cup
Cornmeal (fine)
1 tbsp
Butter (unsalted)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
recipe:
Bring the coconut milk and water to a boil in a medium pot.
Lower the heat to a simmer and add the okra. Cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the cornmeal, butter, and salt. Reduce the heat to low and cover with a lid. Cook for five minutes.
Scoop and pack the cornmeal into a bowl. Invert it onto a plate to create a dome. Serve and enjoy!

name: Boiled Okra with Tamari
ingredients:
2 cups
Okra
1 tsp
Tamari
recipe:
Bring a pot of a water to a boil. Boil the okra until fork tender, about three minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water.
Serve with the tamari and enjoy!

name: Pecan Chia Granola
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Coconut Oil (melted)
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 1/2 cups
Oats (rolled)
1/2 cup
Pecans (chopped)
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 300ºF (150ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a mixing bowl, combine the melted coconut oil and maple syrup. Stir in the oats then add the pecans and chia seeds. Mix well.
Transfer the granola mixture to the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, stirring halfway through, or until the oats are golden brown.
Allow the granola to cool completely on the baking sheet before transferring to an airtight container. Enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
recipe: Place in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Pear & Pistachio Sorghum Porridge
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Sorghum Flour
1 3/4 cups
Water (divided)
2 tbsps
Honey (plus extra for drizzling)
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1
Pear (cored, sliced)
2 tbsps
Pistachios (shelled, chopped)
recipe:
In a reusable container, mix the sorghum flour with 1/7th of the amount of water to form a paste. Seal and leave out at room temperature overnight.
In the morning, bring the remaining water to a boil in a pot. Whisk in sorghum mixture. Cook for five to seven minutes until the mixture thickens and warms through.
Stir in the honey, cinnamon, and salt.
Portion into bowls, top with pear slices, chopped pistachios, and an extra drizzle of honey. Serve immediately and enjoy!

name: Berbere Spiced Roasted Okra
ingredients:
2 cups
Okra (halved lengthwise)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Berbere Spice (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat your oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the sliced okra in the oil and berbere spice. Roast for 20 minutes, tossing halfway, or until browned and crispy. Enjoy!

name: Three Bean Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2 cup
Red Kidney Beans (cooked)
1/2 cup
Cannellini Beans (cooked)
1
Tomato (medium, diced)
1/2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
2 tbsps
Red Onion (diced)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Lime Juice (to taste)
recipe: Add all the ingredients to a mixing bowl and combine well. Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Ethiopian Chickpea Stew
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Ghee
2
Yellow Onion (chopped)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
3 tbsps
Berbere Spice
1
Tomato (diced)
3
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1/2 cup
Chickpea Flour
2 1/2 cups
Water
recipe:
Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat. Cook the onions with salt until translucent and slightly browned, about five minutes.
Add the berbere spice and cook until fragrant, about one minute. Add the tomatoes and garlic. Cook until softened, about two minutes.
Whisk in the chickpea flour and water. Puree the mixture with an immersion handheld blender until smooth, or your desired consistency is reached.
Season with more salt, if needed. Let simmer for five more minutes, then serve. Enjoy!

name: Pomelo
ingredients:
1 cup
Pomelo (peeled, pink or white)
recipe: Peel and serve on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Kenyan Beans & Corn
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
White Onion (diced)
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1 1/2 tsps
Smoked Paprika
1/2 tsp
Curry Powder
2
Tomato (medium, diced)
2 cups
Red Kidney Beans (cooked)
1 cup
Frozen Corn (or canned)
1/4 cup
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
3/4 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the onion until translucent, about five minutes. Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, and curry powder until fragrant, about one minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook until soft, about two minutes.
Add the red kidney beans, corn, broth, and salt. Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Fruit & Nut Popcorn Snack Mix
ingredients:
1 cup
Popcorn
1/4 cup
Blueberries
2 tbsps
Pecans
1 tbsp
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Enjoy!

name: Turmeric & Pepper Yuca Fries
ingredients:
4 cups
Yuca (cut into strips)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Turmeric
1 tsp
Black Pepper
3/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and bring a large pot of water to boil. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Use a sharp knife to remove the skin from the yuca and cut it into approximately one-inch strips. Discard any yuca that contains grey or brown streaks.
Place the strips into the pot of boiling water and simmer for 10 minutes. Once parboiled, remove the yuca from the water and pat completely dry.
Place the yuca pieces on the prepared baking sheet. Add the oil, turmeric, black pepper and salt and mix well to coat. Spread the fries into a single layer, using two baking sheets if needed to avoid overcrowding.
Bake the fries for 25 to 30 minutes flipping halfway, until golden and crispy. Enjoy!

name: Blueberry Chia Baked Oatmeal
ingredients:
3 cups
Water
2 cups
Steel Cut Oats
1/2 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
3 tbsps
Ground Flax Seed
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1 tsp
Stevia Powder
1/2 cup
Frozen Blueberries (or fresh)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC) and line a baking dish with parchment paper.
In a mixing bowl, gently combine all the ingredients, folding in the blueberries last.
Transfer to the baking dish and bake until a toothpick comes out clean, about 40 to 45 minutes. Let cool before serving. Enjoy!

name: Pecan Trail Mix
ingredients:
1 cup
Pecans
1/4 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
1/4 cup
Dried Unsweetened Cranberries
2 ozs
Dark Chocolate (at least 70%, chopped)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients into a jar. Shake well until mixed together. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Potatoes with Tahini Dressing & Herbs
ingredients:
6
Yellow Potato (small, washed and cubed)
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Dried Rosemary

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Tahini
1 tsp
Lemon Juice
1 tbsp
Water
1 1/3 ozs
Pickled Red Onions (homemade or store-bought)
1/2 cup
Parsley (washed and dried)
1/2 cup
Fresh Dill (washed and dried)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Place the potatoes on the tray. Toss with olive oil, dried rosemary, salt, and pepper. Place the tray in the middle rack of the oven and cook for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.
In the meantime, in a small bowl whisk together the tahini, lemon juice, and water until smooth. Season with salt.
Once the potatoes are cooked, place them on a serving platter. Drizzle with the tahini dressing. Add the pickled onions and spread parsley and dill on top. Enjoy!

name: Pineapple Fried Rice
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Brown Rice (dry, uncooked)
2 tsps
Coconut Oil
1 cup
Pineapple (chopped)
1/2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, chopped)
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
2 tbsps
Soy Sauce
1 tsp
Fish Sauce
1 tsp
Lime Juice
1 stalk
Green Onion (optional, sliced)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions and set aside to cool.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the pineapple, red bell pepper, and garlic and saute until soft, about four minutes.
Add the cooked rice, soy sauce, fish sauce, and lime juice. Stir fry for an additional three to four minutes, until heated through.
Divide into bowls and top with the green onions, if using. Enjoy!

name: Rice Cereal with Peaches
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Rice Puffs Cereal
2/3 cup
Oat Milk
1/2 cup
Frozen Peaches (thawed and chopped)
recipe: Place the cereal in a bowl and add the milk and peaches. Enjoy!

name: Cauliflower Alfredo Spaghetti
ingredients:
1 cup
Brown Rice Spaghetti
1 head
Cauliflower (small, cut into florets)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Sweet Onion (diced)
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
3/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1
Lemon (juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and rinse the pasta under cold water to prevent it from over-cooking.
Meanwhile, bring a second pot of water to a boil. Add the cauliflower florets and cook for five to six minutes (or until tender when pierced with a fork). Drain and set aside.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Saute onion for five minutes or until translucent. Add the garlic and stir for another minute. Remove from heat and set aside.
To make the alfredo sauce, place the onion and garlic mix and cooked cauliflower in a blender. Add the almond milk and lemon juice and season generously with salt and pepper to taste. Blend until the sauce becomes smooth and a creamy consistency forms. (This may take some time. Add additional almond milk and continue to blend if the sauce is too thick.)
To serve, divide the cooked pasta between plates and top with the desired amount of the cauliflower alfredo sauce. Drizzle with a lemon wedge and season with a pinch of salt and pepper to taste. Enjoy!

name: Watermelon Fruit Salad
ingredients:
1/4
Seedless Watermelon (small, cut into cubes)
1
Mango (cut into cubes)
1/2 cup
Blueberries
recipe: Add the watermelon, mango, and blueberries to a bowl and stir to combine. Enjoy!

name: Peach Chia Pudding
ingredients:
1 cup
Oat Milk
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/4 cup
Chia Seeds
1/2 cup
Frozen Peaches (thawed and chopped)
recipe:
In a mixing bowl combine the oat milk, maple syrup, and vanilla. Stir in the chia seeds. Refrigerate for at least three hours or until chilled and chia seeds have set.
Divide between jars or bowls, top with the chopped peach, and enjoy!

name: Sauteed Ackee & Red Bell Pepper
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil
1
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
1/2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
1
Tomato (medium, diced)
1 tbsp
Thyme (fresh)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
1 1/4 lbs
Ackee
recipe:
Heat the coconut oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the onions until soft, about three minutes.
Add the bell pepper, tomato, thyme, and salt. Cook for two more minutes, stirring occassionally.
Gently fold in the ackee until well combined and warmed through, about one minute. Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Jackfruit
ingredients:
1 cup
Jackfruit (ripe, fresh or frozen)
recipe: Serve the jackfruit on a plate and enjoy!

name: Smashed Chickpea Toast
ingredients:
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked, rinsed)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 tsp
Black Pepper
1/4 tsp
Oregano
1 tsp
Fresh Dill (chopped)
1 3/4 ozs
Sourdough Bread (toasted)
recipe:
In a small bowl, add the chickpeas, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, pepper and oregano. Lightly smash with a fork.
Add the dill and mix. Taste and add more flavor if desired.
Pour the smashed chickpeas onto the toasted bread and spread it out with a fork.
Cut the toast in half and enjoy!

name: Banana Protein Oats
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Oats
1 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (unsweetened from the carton)
1/2
Banana (sliced, plus extra for garnish)
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon (plus extra for garnish)
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1/4 cup
Blueberries
1 tbsp
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
1 tbsp
Pumpkin Seeds
1 1/2 tsps
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
recipe:
Add the oats, coconut milk, banana, maple syrup, vanilla, and sea salt to a pot over medium heat. Stir to combine. Cook for five to seven minutes or until the oats thicken.
Turn off the heat and stir in the cinnamon and protein powder.
Transfer to a bowl and garnish with blueberries, coconut yogurt, pumpkin seeds, shredded coconut, sliced banana, and cinnamon. Enjoy!

name: Mango Rocket Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Oat Milk (plain, unsweetened)
1 cup
Frozen Mango
1 cup
Arugula
1/2
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1 tbsp
Sunflower Seed Butter
recipe: Add all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Tahini Toast with Blueberries
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Tahini
1 slice
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
1/3 cup
Blueberries
recipe: Spread tahini over the bread and top with blueberries. Enjoy!

name: Jackfruit Carrot Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Jackfruit (ripe, fresh or frozen)
1
Carrot (medium, chopped)
1 1/4 cups
Oat Milk (plain, unsweetened)
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
recipe: Add all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Drizzled Cookie Dough Bites
ingredients:
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/4 cup
Almond Flour
1/4 cup
Oats
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky, divided)
6 ozs
Dark Chocolate (divided)
recipe:
In a food processor, combine chickpeas, almond flour, oats, maple syrup, vanilla, and half of the sea salt. Process until smooth, stopping every thirty seconds to push down the batter with a spatula.
Transfer the mixture to a large bowl.
Chop 1/3 of the dark chocolate and add to the bowl. Stir the batter to combine.
Using a one-inch scoop or a tablespoon, portion out the batter into balls. Melt the remaining chocolate and drizzle it onto the balls. Set in the fridge for five minutes. Top with the remaining flaky sea salt. Enjoy!

name: Carrot Tahini Oatmeal
ingredients:
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
1 1/4 cups
Plain Coconut Milk (from the box)
1 1/2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1/2
Carrot (shredded)
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
2 tbsps
Tahini
2 tsps
Sesame Seeds
recipe:
In a saucepan, combine the oats with the coconut milk and chia seeds. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and let it simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the shredded carrot and maple syrup. Divide into bowls and top with tahini and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: White Bean Purée & Sautéed Mushrooms on Toast
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
White Navy Beans (cooked, rinsed)
1 tsp
Lemon Juice
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
8
White Button Mushrooms (sliced)
3 1/2 ozs
Sourdough Bread (toasted)
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
In a food processor, purée the white beans, lemon juice, and half of the olive oil until smooth. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
In a medium pan over high heat, add the remaining olive oil. Once the oil is hot, sauté the sliced mushrooms for two to three minutes or until cooked and golden brown. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Spread the white bean purée evenly on top of the toasted bread.
Top with sautéed mushrooms and chopped parsley. Enjoy.

name: Peanut Maple Tempeh
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Soy Sauce
3 tbsps
All Natural Peanut Butter
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Sesame Oil
1 tsp
Lime Juice
2 tbsps
Water
1 1/8 lbs
Tempeh (sliced)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
recipe:
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, peanut butter, maple syrup, sesame oil, lime juice, and water.
Add in tempeh and toss to coat. Marinate for fiften minutes.
In a pan, heat the olive oil on medium heat. Add in the tempeh and cook for three minutes per side, until golden. Add in the remaining marinade and cook to warm through, about one to two minutes. Serve immediately and enjoy!

name: Peach Blueberry Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Oat Milk
1/2 cup
Frozen Blueberries
3/4 cup
Frozen Peaches
2 tbsps
Ground Flax Seed
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
recipe: Add all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Popcorn & Olive Snack Box
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Popcorn
1/2
Apple (medium, chopped)
1 cup
Snap Peas (trimmed)
1/3 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives
recipe: Arrange the popcorn, apples, snap peas, and olives into a container. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Enjoy!

name: Slow Cooker Enchilada Beans & Quinoa
ingredients:
3 cups
Black Beans (cooked)
2 cups
Frozen Corn (or fresh)
3 1/2 cups
Diced Tomatoes
2 cups
Enchilada Sauce
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry)
1/2 cup
Water
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
8 ozs
Mozzarella Cheese (shredded)
recipe:
Add the black beans, corn, tomatoes, enchilada sauce, quinoa, water, and salt to the slow cooker. Stir until combined.
Cook on high for two to four hours, or on low for four to six hours.
Divide into bowls and top with cheese. Enjoy!

name: Cucumber, Mango & Banana Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2 cup
Frozen Banana
1/2 cup
Frozen Mango
1/4
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1 cup
Baby Spinach
2 tbsps
Almond Butter
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
recipe: Add all of the ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Tahini & Honey Popcorn
ingredients:
2 cups
Popcorn
1 1/2 tsps
Tahini
1 1/2 tsps
Honey
1 tbsp
Sunflower Seeds
recipe: Place popcorn in a bowl. Drizzle with tahini and honey. Add sunflower seeds and enjoy!

name: Layered Ratatouille
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 1/2 tsps
Italian Seasoning
1 1/2 cups
Tomato Sauce

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Eggplant (medium, sliced to 1/8-inch thickness)
2
Zucchini (medium, sliced to 1/8-inch thickness)
3
Tomato (small, sliced to 1/8-inch thickness)
1/2 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped or torn for serving)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC).
Heat half of the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for about five minutes or until softened. Add the garlic and Italian seasoning and cook for another minute. Stir in the tomato sauce and season generously with salt and pepper to taste. Continue to cook until the tomato sauce has warmed through. Transfer the tomato sauce mixture to the bottom of a baking dish.
Arrange the eggplant, zucchini, and tomato slices in the baking dish in an alternating pattern standing on their sides. (Cut the eggplant slices in halve or thirds to better fit in the baking dish). Brush the top of the vegetables with the remaining oil.
Cover the baking dish with foil or a lid and bake for 30 minutes then remove the cover and continue to bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Top with the basil leaves. Divide between plates and enjoy!

name: Lemon, Garlic & Herb Pasta with Chickpeas
ingredients:
2 cups
Brown Rice Penne (uncooked)
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, drained)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1/2 tsp
Oregano

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves (chopped)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)
recipe:
Cook pasta according to the package.
While the pasta is cooking, in a bowl, add the chickpeas, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper. Mix to combine and set aside to marinate.
Add the pasta to a serving bowl followed by the chickpea mix (including the liquid). Toss to combine.
Add the parsley, basil, dill and toss again. Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Peanut Maple Tempeh Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry)
2 tbsps
Soy Sauce
1 1/2 tbsps
All Natural Peanut Butter
1 1/2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Sesame Oil
1/2 tsp
Lime Juice
1 tbsp
Water
8 3/4 ozs
Tempeh (sliced)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 cups
Frozen Vegetable Mix (cooked)
1 tbsp
Raw Peanuts (chopped)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the directions on the package and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, peanut butter, maple syrup, sesame oil, lime juice, and water. Add in tempeh and toss to coat. Marinate for fifteen minutes.
In a pan, heat the olive oil on medium heat. Add in the tempeh and cook for three minutes per side, until golden. Add in the remaining marinade and cook to warm through, about one to two minutes. To serve, portion the rice into bowls. Top with the vegetable mix, tempeh, chopped peanuts, and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Banana Pudding
ingredients:
2
Banana (mashed)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1 1/4 cups
Oat Milk (divided)
1 tbsp
Arrowroot Powder
1/8 tsp
Turmeric
1 tbsp
Coconut Butter
1/4 tsp
Vanilla Extract
recipe:
In a small saucepan, over medium heat combine the mashed banana, maple syrup, 3/4 of the milk and whisk well. Cook for three to four minutes, stirring occasionally. In a small bowl, whisk the remaining milk with the arrowroot powder.
Stir the arrowroot/milk mixture into the saucepan and reduce the heat to medium-low. Add the turmeric and coconut butter and stir. Cook until thickened, another three to five minutes.
Remove from the heat and stir in the vanilla. Divide into jars and place in the fridge for two hours to thicken. Enjoy!

name: Spaghetti with Lentil Mushroom Tomato Sauce
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Rice Spaghetti (dry)
1/4 cup
Water (reserved starchy cooking water)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 cups
Oyster Mushrooms
1/2 tsp
Oregano

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Tomato Paste
2
Tomato (medium, diced)
1/2 cup
Lentils (cooked, rinsed well)
1/2 cup
Basil Leaves (loosely packed, chopped)
recipe:
Cook the spaghetti according to the package directions. Reserve some of the starchy cooking water from the pot then drain and rinse the pasta under water to remove the excess starch from the noodles.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the mushrooms and cook for about five minutes or until browned and softened. Season with the oregano and generously with salt and pepper. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for another minute.
Add the tomatoes to the pan and stir to combine. Cook for six to eight minutes until the tomatoes have broken down and become sauce-like in consistency. Stir in the lentils and basil and cook for another one to two minutes until the lentils are warmed through. Stir in the reserved cooking water. Season with additional salt and pepper to taste.
To serve, divide the spaghetti noodles between plates and top with the sauce. Enjoy!

name: Tikka Masala Paste
ingredients:
1
White Onion (chopped)
4
Garlic (cloves, roughly chopped)
1
Red Hot Chili Pepper (chopped)
2 tsps
Ginger (chopped)
2 tbsps
Garam Masala
1 tsp
Paprika
1 tsp
Coriander
1 tsp
Cumin
1/4 tsp
Cayenne Pepper
2 tbsps
Tomato Paste
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
1 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
In a food processor or blender, combine all ingredients and process until completely smooth. Add water as needed to blend if the mixture is too thick.
Store in a glass container in the fridge or freeze for longer. Enjoy!

name: Green Pea & Edamame Soup
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Water
1
Sweet Onion (medium, chopped)
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tsp
Dried Thyme
1 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
2 cups
Frozen Peas
1 cup
Frozen Edamame
4 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1/3 cup
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
Heat the water in a pot over medium-high heat. Add the onions and garlic and cook for about five minutes until the onions have softened. Add the thyme and the salt and stir to combine and cook for another minute.
Add the peas, edamame, and vegetable broth to the pot. Bring to a gentle boil and continue to cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until the peas and edamame are very tender. Remove the pot from the heat.
Transfer the soup to a blender (do this in batches if necessary) and add the hemp seeds. Blend until smooth. Season with additional salt if needed.
Divide between bowls and enjoy!

name: Sunflower & Blueberry Overnight Oats
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Sunflower Seed Butter (divided)
1 1/2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 1/4 cups
Oat Milk
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1 1/2 cups
Frozen Blueberries
recipe:
In a medium-sized bowl, combine half the sunflower seed butter with the maple syrup and oat milk and whisk well. Stir in the oats, chia seeds, and blueberries. Cover and let sit for at least three hours or overnight.
When ready to eat, divide into bowls or jars and top with remaining sunflower seed butter. Enjoy!

name: Citrus Fruit Salad
ingredients:
1
Navel Orange (peeled and diced)
1
Grapefruit (peeled and diced)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
recipe:
Add the orange, grapefruit, and maple syrup to a bowl. Toss to combine. Sprinkle cinnamon all over and toss again.
Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Carrot Cake Bites
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Coconut Flour
1/2 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 tsp
Nutmeg
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract (alcohol-free)
1/4 cup
Coconut Oil (melted)
3/4 cup
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut (divided)
1 cup
Grated Carrot
recipe:
In a bowl, add the coconut flour, protein powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. Stir to combine.
Add the maple syrup, vanilla, and melted coconut and stir again.
Fold in a quarter of the shredded coconut and all of the grated carrot.
Form into even balls with your hands, approximately one inch in diameter. Add the remaining shredded coconut to a plate for rolling. If the batter is too sticky, add some more coconut flour.
Place in a sealed container in the fridge for about 20 minutes to slightly harden. Enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Spice N'Oatmeal
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Pureed Pumpkin
1
Banana (ripe, mashed)
1/3 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut (plus extra for topping)
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 cup
Blueberries
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
recipe:
In a medium pot, stir together pureed pumpkin, banana, coconut milk, shredded coconut, and cinnamon. Cook on medium heat for five minutes, until cooked through and thickened.
Serve in bowls and top with blueberries, maple syrup, and shredded coconut. Enjoy!

name: Marinara Sauce
ingredients:
3 cups
Canned Whole Tomatoes
1
White Onion (medium, halved)
3
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Dried Parsley (optional)
recipe:
In a heavy bottom medium pot, combine tomatoes, white onion, garlic, and olive oil.
Bring the sauce to simmer over high heat, then turn the heat down to low and let it simmer for 45 minutes. Stir occasionally.
Remove the pot from heat. Use a slotted spoon to scoop out the onion and discard. Use an immersion blender to blend the sauce until smooth. Add salt and dried parsley if using.
Serve warm and Enjoy.

name: Guacamole & Plantain Chips
ingredients:
1
Avocado (medium, ripe)
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Plantain Chips (store-bought or homemade)
recipe:
In a bowl, mash together the avocado, nutritional yeast, lemon juice, and sea salt with a fork.
Place the guacamole in a bowl and serve with plantain chips. Enjoy!

name: Pickled Red Onions
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
1 cup
Water
2/3 cup
White Wine Vinegar
1 tbsp
Cane Sugar
1 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tsp
Black Peppercorns
recipe:
Place the sliced red onions in a jar, packing them down tightly.
Heat the water, vinegar, sugar, salt, and peppercorns in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Stir until the sugar and salt dissolve, about one minute. Let cool and pour into the jar over the onions.
Set aside to cool to room temperature, then close the lid and store the onions in the fridge.
The pickled red onions will be ready after about two hours. Enjoy.

name: Sun Dried Tomato Hummus
ingredients:
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, rinsed)
2 tbsps
Tahini
1/3 cup
Sun Dried Tomatoes (plus extra for optional garnish)
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1
Garlic (clove)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 tsp
Sesame Seeds (optional for garnish)
recipe:
In a food processor, process together the chickpeas, tahini, sun dried tomatoes, lemon juice, garlic, sea salt, and half of the olive oil until smooth, about two to three minutes.
Spoon the hummus into your serving plate. Top it with the remaining olive oil. Garnish with optional chopped sun dried tomatoes and sesame seeds. Enjoy.

name: Strawberry Basil Sorbet
ingredients:
3 cups
Frozen Strawberries
1/4 cup
Water (warm)
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves
recipe:
Thaw the frozen strawberries for ten minutes before blending.
In a food processor, blend the strawberries with water until smooth. Add in the maple syrup, lemon juice, and basil and blend to combine.
Scoop into bowls and serve immediately, or store in a resealable container in the freezer for one hour for a firmer texture. Enjoy!

name: Spiced Chickpea Flatbread
ingredients:
1 cup
Chickpea Flour
1 cup
Water
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil (divided)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tsp
Garam Masala
1/2 tsp
Coriander
1/4 tsp
Turmeric
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
In a mixing bowl whisk the chickpea flour, water, half of the oil, salt, garam masala, coriander, and turmeric together until smooth. Let the batter sit for one hour.
About 10 minutes before the batter is done resting, preheat the oven to 450ºF (230ºC) and place a 10-inch cast-iron pan inside the warming oven.
Remove the pan from the oven and turn the broiler to high. Add the remaining oil into the pan and swirl to coat. Pour the batter into the pan and place under the broiler for five to seven minutes or until the edges have browned and the top of the flatbread is firm.
Carefully remove the flatbread from the pan and slice. Top with cilantro and serve immediately. Enjoy!

name: Muhammara
ingredients:
10 ozs
Roasted Red Peppers
3 tbsps
Pomegranate Juice
1/3 cup
Walnuts (chopped, plus extra for garnish)
1 1/2 tbsps
Bread Crumbs
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (plus extra for garnish)
1/2 tsp
Cumin
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Place all the ingredients in a food processor. Pulse until it reaches the desired consistency.
Transfer it to the serving bowl. Top with olive oil and chopped walnuts. Enjoy.

name: Rosemary & Garlic Marinated Olives
ingredients:
1 cup
Green Olives
1 cup
Black Olives
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1 1/2 tsps
Rosemary (fresh, chopped)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/8 tsp
Red Pepper Flakes
recipe: In a pot, toss together all the ingredients. Heat on medium-high heat for three to five minutes, until warmed through. Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Halloumi & Pesto Toast
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
4 ozs
Halloumi (cut into large pieces)
2 slices
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
2 tbsps
Pesto
1/2
Tomato (small, sliced)
1 tsp
Basil Leaves
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
In a pan, add the olive oil and heat on medium-high heat. Add halloumi and sear on both sides for one to two minutes until golden. Remove from heat.
Onto each slice of toast, add pesto, tomato slices, halloumi, basil, and sea salt. Enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Hummus Toast
ingredients:
2 slices
Rye Bread (toasted)
1
Garlic (clove, peeled)
1/4 cup
Hummus
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/3 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives (halved)
1/2 tsp
Oregano
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
1/2 tsp
Ground Sumac
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)
recipe:
Rub garlic on both pieces of the toasted bread.
To assemble, place the bread on plates and top evenly with the hummus, tomatoes, olives, oregano, chili flakes, sumac, sea salt, and dill. Enjoy!

name: Honey Roasted Plums with Ricotta
ingredients:
1 tsp
Coconut Oil
4
Plum (halved)
1 tbsp
Honey
2 cups
Ricotta Cheese
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400℉ (205℃) and grease an 8 x 8-inch baking dish with coconut oil.
Place the plums into the dish face down and drizzle with honey.
Bake for 15 minutes or until the plums have softened. Serve over ricotta and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Almond Bars
ingredients:
1 3/4 cups
Almond Flour
2 tbsps
Cocoa Powder
1/4 cup
Coconut Sugar
2 tsps
Vanilla Extract
1 cup
Almond Butter (smooth and drippy, divided)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2 cup
Maple Syrup
1/3 cup
Coconut Oil
2 1/4 cups
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Line an 8 x 8-inch pan with parchment paper going both directions.
In a food processor, pour in the almond flour, cocoa powder, coconut sugar, vanilla, half the almond butter, and salt. Process until the mixture comes together. Add the milk and pulse to combine. The mixture should hold together when pressed between your fingers.
Pour the mixture into the lined pan and press down firmly to create a smooth surface. Place in the freezer while you make the filling.
In a medium-sized microwave-safe bowl, combine the remaining almond butter, maple syrup, and coconut oil. Microwave on high for 30 to 45 seconds until the mixture is smooth. Whisk well to combine. Remove the pan from the freezer and pour the caramel mixture over top. Place in the freezer for six hours (or overnight) to harden.
In a large bowl, add the chocolate chips and microwave on high for 30 to 45-second intervals until melted. Stir with a spoon to fully combine.
Remove the pan from the freezer and slice into even bars. Carefully dip each bar into the chocolate and place on a parchment-lined plate. Place in the fridge for 30 minutes to harden. When ready to eat, remove from the fridge and enjoy!

name: Blueberry Protein Oats
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Quick Oats
1 cup
Oat Milk (plain, unsweetened)
1/2 tsp
Cardamom (ground)
1 tbsp
Sunflower Seed Butter
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1/2 cup
Frozen Blueberries (or fresh)
recipe:
Add the oats, oat milk, and cardamom to a pot over medium heat. Cook for two to three minutes or until the oats thicken.
Turn off the heat and stir in the sunflower seed butter, honey, and protein powder.
Transfer to a bowl and top with the blueberries. Enjoy!

name: Plantain Stew
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
1
Yellow Onion (chopped)
3
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1
Tomato (chopped)
1/2 cup
Tomato Paste
4
Plantain (unripe, chopped)
2
Carrot (chopped)
2 tbsps
Coconut Aminos
3 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Cook the onions until soft, about three minutes. Add the garlic and tomatoes, cooking for another two minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the tomato paste. Then, add the plantain, carrots, coconut aminos, and broth. Bring to a boil then lower to a simmer for 20 to 30 minutes, or until the plantain is fork-tender.
Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Plantain Porridge
ingredients:
2
Plantain (green, unripe, chopped)
4 cups
Water (divided)
1 1/2 cups
Canned Coconut Milk
1/2 tsp
Nutmeg
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon
2 tsps
Vanilla Extract
3/4 cup
Sweetened Condensed Milk, Low Fat
recipe:
Add the plantain and half the water to a blender and blend until smooth. Set aside.
In a pot over medium-high heat, add the remaining water, coconut milk, nutmeg, and cinnamon. Cover and bring to a boil.
Lower the heat to low and whisk in the plantain mixture, vanilla, and condensed milk until warmed through.
Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Lentil Chickpea Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Green Lentils (cooked, drained)
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, drained)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (small, diced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
1
Tomato (large, diced)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
White Wine Vinegar
1/2 tsp
Oregano
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Add all ingredients to a large bowl. Mix well. Taste and adjust flavor if desired.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Apple & Cashew Oats Kheer
ingredients:
1 tsp
Ghee
1/4 cup
Quick Oats
1 1/4 cups
Oat Milk (plain, unsweetened)
1/2 tsp
Coconut Sugar (optional)
1/8 tsp
Cardamom (ground)
1/2
Apple (small, grated)
1 tbsp
Cashews (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the ghee in a small pot over low-medium heat. Add the oats and sauté for two minutes.
Add the milk, coconut sugar (optional), cardamom, and grated apple. Bring to a simmer and cook for three to four minutes, stirring occasionally, or until your desired thickness is reached.
Serve warm or chilled. Top with cashews and enjoy!

name: Chaat Masala
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Cumin Seed
2 tbsps
Mango Powder
1 tbsp
Dried Pomegranate Seeds
1 1/4 tsps
Black Salt
1/4 tsp
Chili Powder (to taste)
recipe:
Heat a skillet over low-medium heat. Toast the cumin seeds for two to three minutes. Set aside and let cool.
Once cooled, combine the cumin seeds with the remaining ingredients in a spice grinder. Grind into a fine powder. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Chip Oat Bites
ingredients:
1 cup
Pitted Dates
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
1/4 cup
Sliced Almonds
3 tbsps
Cashew Butter
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips (mini)
recipe:
In a food processor, add the dates and oats. Blend until there are small crumbly pieces.
Add the almonds, cashew butter, maple syrup, and sea salt. Blend again.
Fold in the chocolate chips. Form the dough into one inch balls and refrigerate for 15 minutes to firm up. Enjoy!

name: Vanilla Date Smoothie
ingredients:
4 2/3 ozs
Tofu (soft)
1
Banana (medium)
2/3 cup
Oat Milk
1/4 cup
Pitted Dates
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
3
Ice Cubes
recipe: In a blender, combine all ingredients and blend until smooth. Serve immediately and enjoy!

name: Chickpea Patties
ingredients:
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, rinsed)
1
Orange Bell Pepper
4
Garlic (clove)
1/2 cup
Oats
1/2 cup
Parsley
1 tbsp
Nutritional Yeast
1/2 tsp
Cumin
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375℉ (190℃) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a food processor, combine all the ingredients. Pulse until evenly mixed, but not smooth.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the mixture directly onto the baking sheet into patties. Press down and shape edges with your fingers.
Bake patties for 35 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes on the baking sheet. Enjoy!

name: Portobello Mushroom Fajitas
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Water (divided)
3 cups
Portobello Mushroom (sliced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (medium, sliced)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (medium, sliced)
1 1/2 tsps
Taco Seasoning
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
4
Corn Tortilla
1
Avocado (mashed)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
1/4
Lemon (cut into wedges)
recipe:
Heat up a large pan over medium-high heat. Add half of the water to the pan along with mushroom, bell pepper, and red onion. Stir and cook for two to three minutes until water evaporates. Then add the taco seasoning, salt, and the remaining water.
Cook and stir occasionally for another three to four minutes or until veggies are tender and browned (if the pan seems too dry, add a splash of water). Take the pan off the heat.
Top each tortilla with the mushroom mixture, smashed avocado, and chopped cilantro. Drizzle with lemon juice. Enjoy.

name: Raisin Oats Kheer
ingredients:
1 tsp
Ghee
1/4 cup
Quick Oats
1 cup
Oat Milk (plain, unsweetened)
1/2 tsp
Coconut Sugar (optional)
1/8 tsp
Cardamom (ground)
1 tbsp
Raisins (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the ghee in a small pot over low-medium heat. Add the oats and sauté for two minutes.
Add the milk, coconut sugar (optional), cardamom, and raisins. Bring to a simmer and cook for three to four minutes, stirring occasionally, or until your desired thickness is reached.
Serve warm or chilled. Enjoy!

name: Pickled Beets
ingredients:
4
Beet (cooked, peeled and chopped)
1 cup
Water
1 cup
White Wine Vinegar
1 tbsp
Cane Sugar
1 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tsp
Black Peppercorns
recipe:
Place the beets in a jar, packing them down tightly.
Heat the water, vinegar, sugar, salt, and peppercorns in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Stir until the sugar and salt dissolve, about one minute. Let cool and pour into the jar over the beets.
Set aside to cool to room temperature, then close the lid and store in the fridge for at least three hours before using. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Blueberry Smoothie
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Frozen Blueberries (wild)
1/2 cup
Strawberries (stems removed)
1 1/4 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
recipe: Add all of the ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Strawberry Oats Kheer
ingredients:
1 tsp
Ghee
1/4 cup
Quick Oats
1 cup
Oat Milk (plain, unsweetened)
1/2 tsp
Coconut Sugar (optional)
1/8 tsp
Cardamom (ground)
1/4 cup
Strawberries (chopped)
1 tbsp
Almonds (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the ghee in a small pot over low-medium heat. Add the oats and sauté for two minutes.
Add the milk, coconut sugar (optional), cardamom, and strawberries. Bring to a simmer and cook for three to four minutes, stirring occasionally, or until your desired thickness is reached.
Serve warm or chilled. Top with almonds and enjoy!

name: Dates & Pistachio Oats Kheer
ingredients:
1 tsp
Ghee
1/4 cup
Quick Oats
1 cup
Oat Milk (plain, unsweetened)
1/2 tsp
Coconut Sugar (optional)
1/8 tsp
Cardamom (ground)
1 tbsp
Pitted Dates (chopped)
1 tbsp
Pistachios (removed from shell, chopped)
recipe:
Heat the ghee in a small pot over low-medium heat. Add the oats and sauté for two minutes.
Add the milk, coconut sugar (optional), cardamom, and dates. Bring to a simmer and cook for three to four minutes, stirring occasionally, or until your desired thickness is reached.
Serve warm or chilled. Top with pistachios and enjoy!

name: Citrus & Date Salad
ingredients:
1
Navel Orange (large)
1
Blood Orange (large)
1/4 cup
Pitted Dates
1 tbsp
Slivered Almonds
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
recipe:
Supreme the navel and blood orange by using a sharp knife to slice the rind and peel off each fruit. Then cut the segments out from in between the membranes, and organize them on a serving plate. Set the leftovers from the oranges aside.
Slice the dates and place them between the citrus segments. Top with slivered almonds and flakey salt.
Squeeze the juice from the set-aside leftover oranges into a small bowl. Mix in the maple syrup. Pour the mixture over the salad and enjoy.

name: Chickpea, Walnut & Raisin Salad Sandwich
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Tahini
1 1/2 tbsps
Lemon Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, rinsed)
1/2 stalk
Celery (finely chopped)
1/3 cup
Walnuts (chopped)
1/3 cup
Raisins
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
8 slices
Gluten-Free Bread (toasted)
1/4 head
Iceberg Lettuce (leaves pulled apart)
recipe:
In a small bowl whisk together the tahini, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
In a large bowl, lightly smash the chickpeas with the back of a fork. Mix in the celery, walnut, raisins, and parsley. Add the tahini mixture and mix well.
Assemble the sandwich by placing a lettuce leaf on toasted bread, spoon the chickpea salad on top, and place another toasted bread on top.
Slice the sandwich in half and enjoy.

name: Fruit Chaat
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Grapes (halved)
2
Apple (small, chopped)
1
Banana (medium, sliced)
1/4
Lemon (juiced)
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves (chopped)
1/2 tsp
Chaat Masala
1/4 tsp
Cumin (ground)
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Add all the ingredients into a large mixing bowl. Toss until well combined. Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Peri Peri Seasoning Blend
ingredients:
1 1/3 tbsps
Garlic Powder
2 tsps
Onion Powder
2 tsps
Paprika
1 tsp
Cayenne Pepper
2 tsps
Dried Parsley
2 tsps
Oregano (dried)
2 tsps
Chili Flakes
1/4 oz
Sweetened Dried Lemon Peel (grated)
2 tsps
Sea Salt (flaky)
1 tsp
Coconut Sugar
recipe: Combine all of the ingredients in a jar or bowl and mix well. Seal and store in the pantry. Enjoy!

name: Oil-Free Roasted Chickpeas
ingredients:
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, rinsed)
1 tbsp
Water
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
1 1/2 tsps
Paprika
1 tsp
Chili Powder
1 tsp
Cumin
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat oven to 400℉ (205℃) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place chickpeas on the baking sheet and pat dry. Bake for 25 minutes.
In a bowl, add the remaining ingredients. Add the cooked chickpeas and toss to coat. Spread the chickpeas back on the baking sheet. Bake for an additional 20 minutes or until golden. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea Pasta with Pesto
ingredients:
8 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (uncooked)
2 1/2 cups
Basil Leaves (packed)
1/4 cup
Pine Nuts
1/4 cup
Nutritional Yeast
2
Garlic (clove)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1/4 cup
Water
recipe:
Cook chickpea pasta according to the package.
While the pasta is cooking, add the basil, pine nuts, nutritional yeast, garlic, and sea salt to a food processor.
With the food processor running, slowly add the lemon juice followed by the water. Continue to blend for 20 to 30 seconds until pesto is smooth and emulsified to your liking. Taste and season with additional salt if needed.
Once the pasta is cooked, add the pesto to the pot and mix to combine.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Maple Baked Beans
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Water
1
Yellow Onion (small, diced)
2 cups
White Navy Beans (cooked, rinsed)
1/3 cup
Crushed Tomatoes
1 1/2 tbsps
Fancy Molasses
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Dijon Mustard
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
2 tsps
Apple Cider Vinegar
1/2 tsp
Paprika
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
In a medium pot, add water and bring to a boil. Add in the onion and simmer for five minutes.
Stir in remaining ingredients and simmer for 15 minutes. Serve and enjoy!

name: Buffalo Tofu Wings
ingredients:
12 1/3 ozs
Tofu (extra firm)
1/4 cup
Arrowroot Powder
1/4 cup
Oat Milk
3/4 cup
Bread Crumbs
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
3/4 cup
Hot Sauce (vinegar-based)
recipe:
Drain the tofu, wrap in a paper towel and place on a plate. Lay a cutting board and something heavy (like a can of beans) over top to press out excess moisture. Press for 25 minutes.
Preheat oven to 425℉ (220℃) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut tofu into 0.5-inch x 3-inch sticks. In one bowl add the arrowroot powder. In a second bowl add the oat milk. In a third bowl add the breadcrumbs, garlic powder, and sea salt.
Dredge the tofu by dipping the sticks first in the arrowroot, then the oat milk, and finally the breadcrumb mixture. Lay dredged tofu onto the baking sheet. Bake for 25 minutes.
Toss the tofu in hot sauce, and bake for an additional 10 minutes. Serve immediately and enjoy!

name: Buffalo Chickpea Wraps
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, drained)
1/4 cup
Hot Sauce (divided)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 head
Iceberg Lettuce (small, chopped)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (small, sliced)
3 tbsps
Vegan Ranch Dressing
3
Whole Wheat Tortilla (small)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, add the chickpeas and half of the hot sauce. Mix to combine. Spread the chickpeas out on the baking sheet and bake for 13 to 15 minutes.
While the chickpeas are in the oven, in a bowl, combine the lettuce, onions, and ranch dressing.
Remove the chickpeas from the oven and place them back into the first bowl that was used for mixing. Add the remaining hot sauce and sea salt and mix to combine.
To assemble, place the tortillas on plates and top evenly with the lettuce mix and chickpeas. Wrap and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Baked Sweet Potato
ingredients:
2
Sweet Potato (medium)
2 tbsps
Butter

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Pierce the sweet potatoes with a fork on all sides. Place the sweet potatoes in the air fryer and bake at 375ºF (190ºC) for 35 to 40 minutes, until cooked through.
Remove the sweet potatoes and top with butter. Season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Vegan Jalapeño Poppers
ingredients:
4 ozs
Vegan Cream Cheese
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
6
Jalapeno Pepper
1/4 cup
Bread Crumbs
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 375ºF (190ºC).
In a small bowl, mix together the cream cheese and nutritional yeast.
Cut the jalapenos in half lengthwise and remove the seeds. Stuff each half with the cheese mixture, about one tablespoon per half. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Place the poppers in the air fryer and spray with avocado oil. Bake for eight to ten minutes, until browned and crispy. Serve and enjoy!

name: Naan
ingredients:
1 cup
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour (plus more for dusting)
1 cup
Plain Cow's Yogurt, Whole Milk
1 tsp
Baking Powder
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Water
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
recipe:
In a mixing bowl, add the flour, yogurt, baking powder, and sea salt and start mixing with a spatula. As the dough begins to form, add the water and keep mixing.
Once the dough is ready (it will be a little bit sticky but mostly smooth), lightly flour your work surface and shape the dough into a ball. Cut the dough into the according number of recipe servings.
Heat a large non-stick pan over medium heat. While it is heating, roll out each ball of dough as thin as you can, approximately 1/8-inch thickness, into an oval shape.
Place one rolled naan onto the pan and cook until you start to see air bubbles on the top and the bottom is golden, about one to two minutes. Flip over and cook for another one to two minutes or until the bottom is golden. Repeat with the other pieces of naan.
Brush the oil on each piece of naan before serving. Enjoy!

name: Cardamom & Lime Rice Pudding
ingredients:
2 cups
Canned Coconut Milk
1/2 cup
Water
1/2 cup
Basmati Rice
1/2
Lime (juiced and zested)
3/4 tsp
Cardamom
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
2 tbsps
Pistachios (shelled, chopped)
recipe:
In a medium pot, add the coconut milk, water, rice, lime juice, lime zest, cardamom, cinnamon, and vanilla extract. Bring to a boil, stirring frequently. Simmer on low heat, stirring occasionally, for twenty minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is cooked through.
Add the coconut sugar, stir to combine, and remove from heat. Allow it to sit for five minutes. Divide evenly between bowls, top with chopped pistachios and enjoy!

name: Coconut Chocolate Bars
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
1/4 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
3 tbsps
Coconut Oil (divided)
3 1/2 ozs
Dark Chocolate
recipe:
Line a small baking sheet or plate with parchment paper.
Add the shredded coconut, coconut milk, maple syrup, and 2/3 of the coconut oil to a food processor. Blend until a wet, coarse sand-like texture forms.
Form the coconut mixture into small bars approximately two inches long. Place the bars on the prepared baking sheet or plate and freeze for at least 30 minutes or until the logs are chilled and firm.
Meanwhile, melt the chocolate and the remaining coconut oil in a small bowl in 30-second increments in the microwave or by using a double boiler over the stove.
Using forks, carefully dip the coconut bars into the melted chocolate until completely covered. Allow any excess chocolate to drip off before placing the chocolate-covered coconut bar back on the baking sheet. Use a spoon to drizzle any remaining melted chocolate over the top of each bar, if desired. Place the bars back in the freezer for at least 15 minutes or until the chocolate has set.
Store the bars in an airtight container in the fridge or freezer until ready to enjoy.

name: Lentil Salad Lettuce Wraps
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Lentils (cooked, rinsed well)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (finely chopped)
1
Tomato (medium, diced)
1/4
Cucumber (diced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 tsp
Oregano (dried)
1/8 tsp
Garlic Powder
3 tbsps
Red Wine Vinegar
6 leaves
Romaine (large)
recipe:
Add the lentils to a mixing bowl and combine with the red onion, tomato, cucumber, salt, pepper, oregano, garlic powder, and red wine vinegar. Mix to combine and season with additional salt and pepper to taste.
To serve, divide the lettuce leaves between plates and top with the lentil salad. Enjoy!

name: Balsamic Lentil Salad
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Lentils (cooked, rinsed well)
2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinegar
1/2 cup
Parsley (finely chopped)
1/4
Cucumber (diced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Add the lentils to a bowl and stir in the balsamic vinegar, parsley, and cucumber. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Divide between bowls and enjoy!

name: Curried Cauliflower Soup
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tbsps
Ginger (fresh, minced)
1 head
Cauliflower (sliced into florets)
2 tsps
Curry Powder
1 1/2 tsps
Garam Masala
1 tsp
Turmeric
1 tsp
Coriander
3 cups
Vegetable Broth
1 3/4 cups
Canned Coconut Milk (plus more for garnish)
1 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Cilantro (optional, garnish)
1/2 tsp
Red Pepper Flakes (optional, garnish)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion, garlic, and ginger and cook until the onions are translucent about five minutes.
Add the cauliflower and spices and stir to combine. Add the vegetable broth and bring it to a boil. Simmer for 30 minutes or until the cauliflower is fork-tender.
Using a blender, food processor, or immersion blender, blend until smooth.
Transfer back to the pot and add the coconut milk and sea salt. Warm through and divide between bowls. Garnish with cilantro, red pepper flakes, and additional coconut milk (if using). Enjoy!

name: Masala Chai Overnight Oats
ingredients:
1 cup
Oats
1 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (unsweetened from the carton)
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/2 tsp
Masala Chai Spice
1/2
Banana (sliced, for garnish)
2 tbsps
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt (for garnish)
1/8 tsp
Cinnamon (for garnish)
recipe:
In a bowl, add all of the ingredients, except those used as a garnish, and mix well to combine. Taste and add more masala chai spice if desired.
Divide evenly between jars and refrigerate overnight. When ready to eat, top with banana slices, coconut yogurt, and cinnamon, if using. Enjoy!

name: Marinated Feta
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
1/4
Lime (peel only)
1 tsp
Basil Leaves (chopped)
1 tsp
Mint Leaves (chopped)
3
Garlic (clove)
1 1/2 cups
Feta Cheese (cubed)
recipe:
In a medium saucepan, add all the ingredients except for the feta. Heat on medium-high heat for four to five minutes, until warmed through.
Place the feta cubes in a jar. Pour the oil mixture over the feta and close the lid. Let it marinate for at least two hours. Take the feta cubes out of the marinade before serving and enjoy.

name: Chana Biryani
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Basmati Rice
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
2 tbsps
Biryani Masala (divided)
2 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1
Tomato (medium, chopped)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, drained)
1/2 cup
Mint Leaves (chopped)
1/2 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Soak the basmati rice in water and set it aside.
In a large pot or dutch oven, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Add the onions and half of the sea salt. Cook until the onions begin to soften, about two to three minutes.
Add the garlic, half of the biryani masala, and a splash of vegetable broth. Continuously stir for two to three minutes to combine the spices.
Add the tomatoes and the rest of the biryani masala. Stir until the tomatoes soften, about two to three minutes. Add some more broth if things start to stick.
Add the chickpeas and stir to combine. Drain the rice then add it to the pot along with the mint, cilantro, and remaining salt. Stir and then add the rest of the vegetable broth. Ensure the rice is fully covered, adding water if needed.
Bring to a boil, then lower to a simmer and cover. Cook for 20 minutes or until the rice is cooked. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Palak Tofu
ingredients:
12 1/3 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, cut into 1-inch cubes)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
5
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Ginger (fresh, minced)
1 1/2 tsps
Garam Masala
1 tsp
Cumin
1 tsp
Coriander
1/2 tsp
Chili Powder
1
Tomato (medium, diced)
5 cups
Baby Spinach
1/2 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1 1/2 tsps
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400℉ (205℃) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the tofu with 1/3 of the oil. Spread it out evenly onto the baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes. Once it's done, set it aside.
In a large pot, add the remaining oil and heat on medium-low. Add the onion, garlic, and ginger and cook for five minutes. Add the spices and tomatoes and stir to combine. Cook until softened, about five minutes. Add the spinach and cook until just wilted.
Using a food processor, blender, or immersion blender, process until smooth. Transfer the mixture back to the pot and add the coconut milk, salt, and tofu. Heat to warm through. Portion into bowls and enjoy!

name: Cookie Caramel Chocolate Cups
ingredients:
1 cup
Almond Flour
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/4 cup
Coconut Oil (divided)
3/4 cup
Pitted Dates (soaked in hot water for at least 10 minutes)
2 tbsps
All Natural Peanut Butter
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Water (reserved from soaking the dates; plus more if needed)
4 1/3 ozs
Dark Chocolate
recipe:
Line a muffin tray with paper baking cups and set aside.
Add the almond flour, maple syrup, and 3/4 of the coconut oil to a food processor. Blend until a soft, cookie dough-like texture forms. Divide the dough evenly between baking cups and press it into an even layer at the bottom of each baking cup. (Use damp fingers if the dough is too sticky.) Transfer to the freezer for at least 15 minutes or until firm.
Meanwhile, rinse out the bowl of the food processor. Add the soaked dates, peanut butter, salt, and reserved date water and blend until mostly smooth, scraping down the sides of the food processor when needed. Add one to two additional tablespoons of the date water if needed. The consistency of the date caramel sauce should be thick, mostly smooth, and not liquidy.
Using a spoon or damp fingers, add the date caramel sauce in an even layer to the top of the almond cookie layer. Place in the freezer for at least 15 minutes or until chilled.
Meanwhile, melt the chocolate and the remaining coconut oil in a small bowl in 30-second increments in the microwave or by using a double boiler over the stove.
Spoon the melted chocolate over the top of the caramel layer. Place in the freezer for at least 15 minutes or until the chocolate has set then transfer to an airtight container in the fridge or freezer until ready to enjoy.

name: Mixed Fruit Crumble
ingredients:
2 cups
Frozen Fruit Mix
1 1/2 tbsps
Monk Fruit Sweetener (divided)
1 1/2 tbsps
Butter (melted)
3 tbsps
Almond Flour
1 1/2 tbsps
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Mint Leaves (for garnish, optional)
recipe:
In a medium saucepan, mix together the fruit and 1/3 of the sweetener. Heat the saucepan over medium-high heat. Once the mixture starts simmering, turn the heat to low and let it simmer for about 10 minutes or until thickened. Stir occasionally.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC). In a small bowl mix together melted butter, almond flour, coconut, sea salt, and the remaining sweetener. Stir and press with a fork until a loose crumble forms.
Transfer the fruit mixture into an oven-safe baking dish. Top with the crumble and bake in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until the crumble starts browning.
Remove and let cool for 10 minutes. Top with mint leaves if using. Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Bison Taco Bowl
ingredients:
1
Lime (medium, juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/3 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 lb
Ground Bison
2 tbsps
Taco Seasoning
1 head
Romaine Hearts (chopped)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1
Avocado (cubed)
2 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)
recipe:
In a small bowl, add the lime juice, salt, pepper, and 4/5 of the oil. Whisk well and set aside.
Heat the remaining oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the bison, breaking it up as it cooks. Add the taco seasoning and continue to break up the bison. Cook for seven to eight minutes or until the bison is cooked through.
To assemble, divide all ingredients evenly between bowls. Top each bowl with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Bombay Potatoes
ingredients:
2 1/2 cups
Mini Potatoes (halved)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (medium, sliced)
1 tsp
Cumin
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1/2 tsp
Garam Masala
1 tsp
Sea Salt
3
Tomato (large, diced)
1 tbsp
Ginger (fresh, minced)
4
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
In a medium pot, add the potatoes and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil and cook for ten minutes or until fork-tender. Drain and set aside.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the onions and cook until translucent, about five minutes. Stir in the spices.
Add in the tomatoes, ginger, and garlic, and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes or until the mixture reduces. Add in the potatoes and warm through. Divide evenly between bowls, top with cilantro, and enjoy!

name: Carrot Halwa
ingredients:
1 tsp
Ghee
3
Carrot (large, grated)
2 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 1/2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar (to taste)
1/2 tsp
Cardamom (ground)
1/4 cup
Pistachios (removed from shell, chopped)
recipe:
Heat the ghee in a pan over medium heat. Cook the grated carrots for five minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in the milk and bring to a simmer. Turn down the heat to medium-low and cook until the liquid is asorbed, about 35 minutes.
Stir in the coconut sugar and cardamom. Cook until dissolved, about one minute. Divide into bowls and top with pistachios. Enjoy!

name: Jeera Basmati Rice
ingredients:
1 cup
Basmati Rice (soaked for 10 to 15 minutes)
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Cumin Seed
2 cups
Water
recipe:
Rinse the soaked rice well using a fine mesh strainer under cold water until the water runs clear.
Heat the coconut oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds and cook for about a minute, or until fragrant. Carefully add the rinsed rice and a splash of the water and stir to combine.
Add the rest of the water and increase the heat to high. Bring to a boil then cover and reduce the heat to low and cook for about 12 minutes or until the liquid has absorbed and the rice is tender. Remove from the heat and allow the rice to sit covered for three to five minutes before fluffing with a fork. Enjoy!

name: Masala Chai Spice Blend
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Cinnamon
1 tbsp
Cardamom
1 tbsp
Ginger
1/2 tsp
Nutmeg
1/2 tsp
Ground Cloves
1/2 tsp
Ground Allspice
recipe: Add all of the ingredients into a bowl or a jar and mix well. Seal and store in the pantry. Enjoy!

name: Palak Paratha
ingredients:
1 cup
Whole Wheat Flour (plus more for dusting)
2 cups
Baby Spinach (finely chopped)
1/2
Green Chili Pepper (seeds removed, finely chopped)
1/2 tsp
Cumin
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
2 tbsps
Water
recipe:
In a large bowl, mix together the whole wheat flour, chopped spinach, green chili pepper, cumin, salt, and half of the oil. Set aside (uncovered) for 10 minutes. The spinach will release some water during this time.
Add water little by little and knead to make a slightly soft, smooth dough. Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 15 minutes.
Cut the dough into the according number of recipe servings. Roll into balls. Dust each ball and working surface with flour. Use a rolling pin and roll each ball flat to about 1/8- to 1/4-inch thick.
In a large skillet over medium heat, add a small amount of the remaining oil with a brush or paper towel. Cook each paratha for about two to three minutes per side. Brush the skillet with the remaining oil as needed.
Transfer to a basket covered with a dish towel until ready to serve. Enjoy!

name: Tandoori Paneer Skewers
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
2 tbsps
Tandoori Masala
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
12 ozs
Paneer Cheese (cubed)
1
Orange Bell Pepper (medium, chopped)
4
Barbecue Skewers
recipe:
Preheat the grill to medium-low heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, tandoori masala, oil, and salt. Add the paneer and toss until well coated.
Thread the paneer and bell peppers evenly onto the skewers.
Cook the skewers for four to five minutes per side, until browned. Enjoy!

name: Green Tea Shortbread Cookies
ingredients:
1 cup
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
2 tsps
Green Tea Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Butter (room temperature)
1/4 cup
Cane Sugar
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
3/4 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
In a medium-sized bowl, whisk together the flour, green tea powder, and salt. Set aside.
In a stand mixer, cream together the butter and sugar until very well combined, about four to five minutes. Add the vanilla and beat to incorporate.
With the stand mixer running on low, slowly add the flour mixture and beat until just combined.
Remove the dough. Place it on a cutting board and divide it in half. Place each half on plastic wrap and shape into 1 1/2-inch thick logs. Wrap and place in the fridge for at least one hour.
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC) and line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
Remove the dough from the fridge and slice it into 1/4-inch thick cookies. Place the cookies on the baking sheets, keeping about two inches of space from each other. Bake for eight to nine minutes, until the edges are just barely set. Let cool on the baking sheet before moving to a wire rack. Let them cool completely.
In a large bowl, add the chocolate chips and microwave on high for 30 to 45-second intervals until melted. Stir with a spoon to fully combine.
Carefully dip the cookies in the melted chocolate and set them on parchment-lined baking sheets until set. To speed up the process, transfer to the fridge to firm up. Enjoy!

name: Smashed Parmesan Brussels Sprouts
ingredients:
4 cups
Brussels Sprouts (trimmed)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Apple Cider Vinegar
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Red Pepper Flakes
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 450℉ (230℃) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the Brussels sprouts to a pot of water and bring to a boil. Boil for eight to ten minutes. Drain the water.
In a bowl, toss together the Brussels sprouts, oil, apple cider vinegar, sea salt, and red pepper flakes.
Transfer the sprouts to the baking sheet and use a measuring cup to smash down the sprouts until lightly crushed. Top with grated cheese and bake for ten minutes. Serve immediately and enjoy!

name: Chickpea & Cranberry Rice
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Basmati Rice (dry)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 cup
Red Onion (chopped)
1 tsp
Cumin (ground, to taste)
1/4 tsp
Cardamom (ground, to taste)
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1
Carrot (cut into matchsticks)
1 cup
Dried Unsweetened Cranberries (soaked)
1 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to package directions.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the red onion and cook with cumin and cardamom for two minutes.
Stir in the chickpeas, carrots, cranberries, and salt. Cook for five minutes. Stir in the cooked rice and serve. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Tahini Puffed Quinoa Bars
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Pitted Dates (softened in hot water and drained)
1/2 cup
Tahini (well stirred)
1/2 cup
Oat Milk
1 tbsp
Cocoa Powder
1/4 cup
Chocolate Protein Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
3 cups
Puffed Quinoa
recipe:
Line a pan with parchment paper.
Add the softened dates to a food processor with the tahini. Mix on high until well blended. Add the milk, cocoa powder, protein powder, and salt and blend again until smooth.
Pour the puffed quinoa into a large bowl. Add the tahini mixture into the bowl and use a spatula to mix until well combined.
Transfer into the prepared pan and use damp hands to press the mixture into the pan. Place in the freezer to set for about 30 minutes. Remove the bars from the pan and slice. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Okra & Onions
ingredients:
4 cups
Okra (halved lengthwise)
1 1/2 cups
Red Onion (sliced)
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
1 tsp
Paprika
1/2 tsp
Cumin
1/4 tsp
Turmeric

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the grill over medium-high heat.
Toss the okra and red onions in the oil, paprika, cumin, turmeric, salt and pepper. Place the veggies in a grilling basket and grill for eight to 10 minutes, until the edges are charred. Remove from grill and enjoy!

name: Tofu Tikka Masala
ingredients:
1 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry)
1/3 cup
Tikka Masala Paste
12 1/3 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, cut into 1-inch cubes)
1 cup
Tomato Purée
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
3/4 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large dutch oven or pot over medium heat, add the tikka masala paste and cook, stirring often for two minutes. Add the tofu, tomato purée, coconut yogurt, coconut milk, and salt. Cover and reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook for 15 minutes.
Divide the rice and tofu evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Protein Baked Oatmeal
ingredients:
2 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/3 cup
Almond Butter
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
2 cups
Quick Oats
1/4 cup
Chocolate Protein Powder
1 tsp
Baking Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC). Line a pan with parchment paper.
In a mixing bowl, whisk together the milk, almond butter, and maple syrup. Stir in the remaining ingredients.
Transfer the mixture to the loaf pan and bake for 30 to 40 minutes, or until cooked through to your liking. Cut into slices and enjoy!

name: Jollof Quinoa
ingredients:
2
Tomato (medium, roughly chopped)
2
Garlic (cloves)
1
Yellow Onion (chopped, divided)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Curry Powder
1/2 tsp
Dried Thyme (leaves)
2 cups
Quinoa (dry)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
2 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
recipe:
In a food processor, blend the tomatoes, garlic, and half the onions until smooth. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Cook the remaining onions until golden, about two minutes. Stir in the curry powder, thyme, and tomato mixture. Cook for one minute.
Add the quinoa, salt, and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then turn the heat to low. Cover and cook for 20 minutes or until the quinoa is cooked. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Blueberry Coconut Chia Pudding
ingredients:
1 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1 cup
Blueberries (plus extra for garnish)
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/4 cup
Chia Seeds
2 tbsps
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut (plus extra for garnish)
recipe:
Add the coconut milk, blueberries, and vanilla to a blender and blend well until combined.
Pour the blueberry mixture into a medium-sized bowl and add the chia seeds. Stir well to combine. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight to thicken.
Divide evenly between bowls or in to-go containers. Top with extra blueberries and shredded coconut, if using. Enjoy!

name: No Bake Chocolate Almond Protein Bars
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Almond Butter (smooth and drippy)
3 tbsps
Coconut Oil
1/3 cup
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/2 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 cup
Oats
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
3 tbsps
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Line the pan with parchment paper.
Add the almond butter, coconut oil, and maple syrup to a small saucepan. Heat over low, stirring with a spatula until smooth and well combined. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla. Transfer to a large bowl.
To the same bowl, add the protein powder, oats, chia seeds, shredded coconut, and salt. Stir well to combine. Transfer the mixture to the prepared pan.
In a small bowl, add the chocolate chips and microwave on high for 30 to 45-second intervals until melted. Stir with a spoon to fully combine.
Drizzle the melted chocolate over the top of the bars and place them in the fridge to set for one hour. Remove the bars from the pan and slice. Enjoy!

name: Lemon Rice
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Basmati Rice (soaked for at least 10 minutes)
1 cup
Water
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil
1/2
Green Chili Pepper (small, seeds removed and finely chopped)
1/4 cup
Raw Peanuts (roughly chopped)
1 tbsp
Ginger (freshly grated)
1 tsp
Coriander (ground)
3/4 tsp
Turmeric
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
recipe:
Rinse the soaked rice well using a fine mesh strainer under cold water until the water runs clear.
Add the rice and water to a pot over high heat. Bring to a boil then reduce the heat to low and cover with a lid. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes or until the water has been absorbed. Fluff with a fork and set aside.
Heat the coconut oil in a pan over medium heat. When the oil is hot, add the chili pepper and cook, stirring often, for a minute. Add the peanuts and continue to cook for another minute or until peanuts start to brown. Stir in the ginger, coriander, turmeric, and salt and cook for another minute or until very fragrant.
Add the cooked rice and lemon juice and stir until well combined. Season with additional salt or lemon juice if needed. Enjoy!

name: Steel Cut Oats with Jammy Blueberries
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Steel Cut Oats (uncooked)
1 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (unsweetened from the carton)
1 cup
Water
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 cup
Frozen Blueberries
recipe:
Add the oats, coconut milk, water, and sea salt to a saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 13 to 15 minutes, depending on how crunchy you like your oats. When everything starts to thicken, add the maple syrup. While the oats are cooking, add the blueberries to a small saucepan and cook over medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes.
To serve, divide the oats and blueberry compote evenly between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Broccolini & Quinoa Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (uncooked)
2 tbsps
Water
1 tbsp
Tahini
3
Garlic (cloves, minced, divided)
1 tbsp
Chives (finely chopped)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
1/4 tsp
Black Pepper (divided)
2 tbsps
Butter
8 ozs
Broccolini (trimmed, chopped)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions.
Using an immersion blender, blend the water, tahini, half the garlic, chives, half of the sea salt, and half of the black pepper. Blend until smooth and set aside.
In a frying pan, heat the butter over medium heat. Add the broccolini and toss with tongs. Add the rest of the sea salt and black pepper. Sauté for two to three minutes.
Add the rest of the garlic and toss again. Sauté for three to four minutes or until cooked to your liking.
To assemble, add the quinoa, broccolini, onions, and dressing. Toss to combine. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Garlicky Cauliflower Potato Mash
ingredients:
4
Yellow Potato (medium, peeled and chopped)
1 head
Cauliflower (large, sliced into florets)
2 tbsps
Butter
1/2
Yellow Onion (small, diced)
4
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/3 cup
Oat Milk

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (season to taste)
recipe:
Bring water to a boil in a large pot. Add the potatoes and cook for 12 minutes. Add the cauliflower and cook everything for another 15 minutes, until both the potatoes and cauliflower are fork-tender. Drain.
Meanwhile, heat a pan on medium-high heat. Add the butter, onion, and garlic to the pan, and cook until the onions soften, about three to five minutes. Add everything to the pot of potatoes and cauliflower.
Add the oat milk and mash everything to combine. Season with salt and pepper and enjoy!

name: Cantaloupe Popsicles
ingredients:
1/2
Cantaloupe (medium, peeled, deseeded and chopped)
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2 tbsps
Canned Coconut Milk (full fat)
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
recipe:
In a blender, combine all the ingredients and blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into popsicle molds or small paper cups. Add popsicle sticks, and transfer them to the freezer. Allow them to set overnight. Enjoy!

name: Oat Pancakes
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Ground Flax Seed
2 1/2 tbsps
Water
1 1/2 cups
Oat Flour
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Baking Powder
1 1/4 cups
Oat Milk
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil
1/3 cup
Maple Syrup (for drizzling)
recipe:
In a small bowl, whisk together the ground flax and water. Set aside to thicken for five minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the oat flour, sea salt, and baking powder. Add the oat milk and flax seed mixture. Allow it to sit for five minutes to thicken.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add some of the coconut oil, enough to coat the pan. Scoop 1/4 cup of batter at a time into the pan, and cook until bubbles start to form. Flip and cook for another one to two minutes. Repeat with the remaining batter.
Serve the pancakes with a drizzle of maple syrup, if using, and enjoy!

name: Roasted Apples & Blueberries
ingredients:
2
Apple (peeled and sliced)
1 cup
Frozen Blueberries
2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
2 tbsps
Coconut Cream (optional, for garnish)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400℉ (205℃).
In a baking dish, combine the apple slices, blueberries, and coconut sugar. Bake in the oven for 35 minutes or until the apples are fork-tender. Serve with coconut cream, if using, and enjoy!

name: Carrot Cake Baked Oatmeal
ingredients:
2 cups
Oats
2 tbsps
Ground Flax Seed
1/2 tsp
Ground Ginger
2
Carrot (small, peeled and grated)
1 1/2 cups
Oat Milk
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup (plus extra for drizzling)
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Applesauce
1/4 cup
Coconut Cream (optional, to garnish)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350℉ (175℃).
In a bowl, mix together the oats, flax seed, and ground ginger. Stir in the grated carrot, oat milk, maple syrup, and applesauce. Pour the mixture into a baking dish.
Bake for 30 minutes or until cooked through. Allow it to cool for ten minutes. Serve onto plates, top with coconut cream and maple syrup, if using, and enjoy!

name: Hummus Kraut & Crackers
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Hummus
1/4 cup
Sauerkraut
3 slices
Light Rye Crisp Bread
1/2
Cucumber (medium, sliced)
recipe: In a bowl, combine the hummus and sauerkraut. Spread onto the crisp bread and top with cucumber slices. Enjoy!

name: Masala Lassi
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Plain Cow's Yogurt, Whole Milk
1/4 cup
Water
2 tsps
Cashews (plus more for garnish)
1 tsp
Coconut Sugar
1/4 tsp
Cardamom (ground)
1/8 tsp
Nutmeg (ground)
recipe: Combine all the ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Top with crushed cashews and enjoy!

name: Salted Lassi
ingredients:

Cumin (ground)

name: Whipped Ricotta & Avocado Toast
ingredients:

Ricotta Cheese

Sourdough Bread (toasted)
1/2
Avocado (sliced)
1/2 tsp
Mint Leaves (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
In a food processor, whip together the ricotta cheese, lemon juice, and zest until smooth.
Spread the whipped ricotta over the toasted bread. Slice the avocado and place it on top. Sprinkle with chopped mint, sea salt, and black pepper. Enjoy!

name: Peach Cherry Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1
Peach (medium, pitted)
1/2 cup
Cherries (pitted)
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
recipe: Add all of the ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Watermelon Gazpacho

Seedless Watermelon (medium, diced into cubes)

Red Bell Pepper (chopped)

Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill
1 tsp
Apple Cider Vinegar
1 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: In a food processor or blender, add all the ingredients and process until mostly smooth. Serve into bowls and enjoy!

name: Radicchio & White Bean Salad
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Red Wine Vinegar
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
3 cups
Radicchio (thinly sliced)
3 stalks
Celery (sliced)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1 cup
Cannellini Beans (drained, rinsed)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
recipe:
Whisk the oil, vinegar, and garlic in a small bowl to combine. Set aside.
In a large bowl, add the radicchio, celery, onion, beans, parsley, salt, and pepper. Pour the dressing on top and toss to combine. Pour the lemon juice all over and toss again.
To serve, divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Cucumber & Cantaloupe Salad
ingredients:
1/3
Cantaloupe (medium, peeled, deseeded and chopped)
1
Cucumber (medium, diced)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves (chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp

Lemon Juice
recipe: Mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Mango Slices with Cumin
ingredients:
1/4 tsp
Cumin (ground)
