Sea Salt (to taste)
1
Mango (peeled, sliced)
recipe: Sprinkle cumin and salt over the mango slices. Enjoy!

name: Pineapple Kiwi Smoothie

Kiwi (peeled)
1/16 head
Green Lettuce (separated into leaves and washed)
1 cup

Plain Greek Yogurt
recipe: Add all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Divide into glasses and enjoy!

name: Honey Mustard Lentil Salad
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Whole Grain Mustard
1 tbsp

Honey

Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Shallot (thinly sliced)

Baby Spinach
recipe:
In a mixing bowl, whisk together the mustard, lemon juice, honey, and salt.
Gently toss in the shallots, lentils, and spinach until well incorporated. Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Strawberry Lime Popsicles
ingredients:
3 cups
Strawberries (stems removed)
1
Lime (large, juiced)
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour into popsicle molds and freeze for five to six hours or until completely frozen. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Covered Peanut Caramel Bars
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Almond Flour
1 tbsp
Cocoa Powder
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk (divided)
3/4 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
1 cup
Pitted Dates (soaked until soft then drained)
1/4 cup
All Natural Peanut Butter
1/2 cup
Raw Peanuts (roughly chopped)
5 1/4 ozs
Dark Chocolate
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil
recipe:
Line a baking pan with parchment paper.
In a mixing bowl combine the almond flour, cocoa powder, maple syrup, 2/3 of the almond milk, and a pinch of the salt. Stir until a wet dough forms. Press the dough into an even layer in the bottom of the baking dish and place in the freezer.
Add the drained dates, peanut butter, the remaining almond milk, and the remaining salt to a food processor and blend until smooth. A caramel sauce will form and it should be thick but smooth. Add additional almond milk if necessary to help with blending.
Spoon the date caramel sauce on top of the chocolate almond layer and use a spoon or damp fingers to spread the caramel into an even layer. Top with the peanuts. Place in the freezer for two to three hours, or up to overnight, until the caramel layer is firm, but not solid.
Melt the chocolate and coconut oil in a small bowl in 30-second increments in the microwave or by using a double boiler over the stove. Line a baking sheet or plate with parchment paper.
Remove the pan from the freezer and carefully cut the caramel and cookie layers into bars, approximately one inch by two inches.
Using forks, carefully dip the bars into the melted chocolate until completely covered. Allow any excess chocolate to drip off before placing the chocolate-covered bar on the baking sheet. Use a spoon to drizzle any remaining melted chocolate over the top of each bar, if desired. Place the bars back in the freezer for at least 15 minutes or until the chocolate has set.
Store the bars in an airtight container in the fridge or freezer until ready to enjoy.

name: Cilantro Mint Chutney
ingredients:
1 cup
Cilantro (leaves only, roughly chopped)
1/2 cup
Mint Leaves (roughly chopped)
1 tsp
Ginger (fresh, minced or grated)
1/2
Green Chili Pepper (small, seeds removed)
2 tsps
Lemon Juice
2 tbsps
Water (plus more if needed)
1/2 tsp
Cumin

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a small blender or mini-food processor and blend. Scrape down the sides as needed and continue to blend until a thick sauce forms. Season with additional salt, pepper, or lemon juice if needed. Enjoy!

name: Za'atar Roasted Haddock
ingredients:
2
Haddock Fillet

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Za'atar Spice
1 tbsp
Ground Sumac (divided)
1/3
Cucumber (large, diced)
1
Tomato (large, diced)
1 cup
Radishes (diced)
1 1/2 tsps
Lemon Juice
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Season the haddock with salt and pepper. Mix together the za'atar spice and half of the sumac and add it to the fish fillet.
Bake for eight to 10 minutes or until the haddock fillets are cooked through and flake easily with a fork.
As your fish cooks, mix together the cucumber, tomato, and radishes. Add lemon juice and remaining of the sumac. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide the salad evenly between plates, top with the haddock and enjoy!

name: Grilled Scallops & Asparagus on Greens
ingredients:
8 ozs
Scallops
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1
Lemon (juiced)
3
Garlic (cloves, minced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Asparagus (trimmed)
4 cups
Mixed Greens (divided)
recipe:
Pat the scallops dry with a paper towel.
In a bowl, whisk half of the oil, half of the lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper. Add the scallops and marinate for 15 minutes.
Coat the asparagus with the remaining oil and season with salt and pepper.
Preheat the grill to medium heat. Place the scallops on one side of the grill and the asparagus on the other side.
Grill the scallops on each side for three to four minutes or until cooked through and slightly charred. Roll the asparagus when you turn the scallops. Remove the scallops from the heat and grill the asparagus for a few minutes longer.
To serve, divide the mixed greens, asparagus, and scallops evenly between plates. Drizzle the remaining lemon juice onto both plates. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Overnight Oats
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Oats
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2 cup
Strawberries (chopped, plus extra to garnish)
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
recipe:
Add all the ingredients to a resealable bowl or container and stir well to combine. Seal and place in the fridge overnight, or for at least eight hours.
Remove the oats from the fridge. Divide into containers and top with additional strawberries, if using. Enjoy!

name: Nicoise Salad
ingredients:
2 1/2 cups
Mini Potatoes (halved)
3 cups
Asparagus (trimmed)
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Fresh Dill (chopped, plus extra for optional garnish)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 can
Tuna (drained)
1 1/2 cups
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1 cup
Radishes (quartered)
1
Avocado (sliced)
1/3
Cucumber (medium, sliced)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
recipe:
In a medium pot, add the potatoes and cover them with cold water. Bring to a boil and cook for ten minutes or until fork-tender. Drain the potatoes and transfer them immediately to an ice bath to cool down.
Set the asparagus in a steaming basket over boiling water and cover. Steam for about three to five minutes or until fork tender. Transfer them immediately to an ice bath to cool down.
In a small bowl, combine the lemon juice, oil, and dill. Season with salt and pepper.
Arrange the tuna, cherry tomatoes, radishes, avocado, cucumber, cooked potatoes, and asparagus on a serving platter. Top with red onion and garnish with extra dill if using. Spoon the dressing on top and enjoy!

name: One Pot Spinach & Artichoke Pasta
ingredients:
2 cups
Artichoke Hearts (from the can, drained)
1 1/2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
8 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (dry)
2 tbsps
Cashew Butter
3 3/4 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
4 cups
Baby Spinach
recipe:
In a pot over medium-high heat, add the artichoke hearts and cook for two minutes. Stir in the nutritional yeast and salt.
Add the pasta, cashew butter, and broth. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat to a simmer. Cover and cook for eight to 10 minutes, or until the pasta is cooked through. Stir occasionally.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Tomato & Feta Couscous Salad
ingredients:
2 1/4 cups
Water
1 1/2 cups
Israeli Couscous (dry)
1/8
Lemon (juiced, zested)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/3 cup
Parsley (chopped)
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves (chopped, divided)
1 1/2 cups
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Bring the water to a boil in a medium-sized pot. Once boiling, add the couscous. Reduce the heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes or until most of the liquid is gone and the couscous is cooked through. Drain any excess water if needed.
Transfer the couscous to a bowl and add the lemon juice, lemon zest, oil, parsley, mint, tomatoes, and feta cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Broccoli & Radish Side Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
Broccoli (cut into small florets)
1 cup
Radishes (thinly sliced)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (finely chopped)
1/4 cup
Italian Dressing

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Add broccoli, radishes, red onion, and the dressing into a medium bowl and mix well. Add salt and pepper and adjust the seasoning to your taste. Cover the bowl and let it sit in the fridge for at least 15 minutes so the flavors blend together.
Divide the salad between plates and enjoy!

name: Lemon & Mint Edamame Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1/4
Cucumber (quartered, sliced)

Parmigiano Reggiano
1 tbsp
Hemp Seeds
1 tbsp
Mint Leaves

1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Add all ingredients to a bowl and toss to combine. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Vegetable Sandwich
ingredients:
1
Zucchini (sliced length-wise)
1
Eggplant (Chinese, sliced length-wise)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Green Goddess Salad Dressing
7 1/16 ozs
Sourdough Bread (toasted)
1 cup
Baby Spinach
4 ozs
Roasted Red Peppers
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Arrange the sliced zucchini and eggplant onto the baking sheet and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until soft and cooked through.
Spread the dressing on the toasted bread. Top with spinach, zucchini, eggplant, and roasted red peppers. Close the sandwich and enjoy!

name: Garlic & Parmesan Roasted Edamame
ingredients:

2 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano

Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400℉ (205℃) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, toss together the edamame, oil, parmesan cheese, garlic, salt, and pepper. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
Add the hemp seeds, toss to combine, and enjoy!

name: Yerba Mate Latte
ingredients:
2 tsps
Yerba Mate (loose leaf)
1 cup
Water (hot)
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon (plus more for garnish)
recipe:
Steep the yerba mate in the water for four to five minutes, or until your desired strength.
In a small saucepan, add the almond milk, maple syrup, vanilla, and cinnamon. Bring to a simmer and use a frother to create some foam. Alternatively, blend the warmed milk mixture in a blender until frothy. Pour into the brewed tea and top with cinnamon. Enjoy!

name: Cilantro Lime Rice
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Basmati Rice
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
1
Lime (medium, juiced)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Once the rice is cooked, stir in the cilantro and lime juice. Serve and enjoy!

name: Celery Sticks
ingredients:
2 stalks
Celery
recipe: Cut the celery into sticks. Enjoy!

name: Sea Salt & Lemon Cabbage Slaw
ingredients:
4 cups
Purple Cabbage (thinly sliced)
1
Lemon (large, juiced)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (flakey)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a bowl and massage the lemon juice and salt into the cabbage to soften it. Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Lentil Tacos
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
3 cups
Water
1/2 cup
Tomato Sauce (plain)
1 1/2 tbsps
Taco Seasoning
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
8
Corn Tortilla
1 head
Romaine Hearts (finely chopped)
1
Tomato (large, diced)
1 cup
Salsa
recipe:
Combine the lentils, water, tomato sauce, taco seasoning, and salt in the pot of the pressure cooker.
Close the lid. Set to “sealing”, then press manual/pressure cooker and cook for 12 minutes on high pressure. Once it is done, release the pressure manually. Remove the lid carefully.
Stir the lentils well and season with additional salt if needed.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the lentils onto the tortillas and topping with the lettuce, tomato, and salsa. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Taco Spiced Lentils
ingredients:

Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)

Sea Salt
recipe:
Combine all ingredients in the pot of the pressure cooker.
Close the lid. Set to “sealing”, then press manual/pressure cooker and cook for 12 minutes on high pressure. Once it is done, release the pressure manually. Remove the lid carefully.
Stir the lentils well and season with additional salt if needed. Enjoy!

name: Salsa Verde & Crackers
ingredients:
1 1/4 lbs
Tomatillo
1
Jalapeno Pepper
1/2
White Onion (small, chopped)
1/4 cup
Cilantro
1
Garlic (clove)
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
6 1/3 ozs
Whole Grain Crackers
recipe:
Set your oven to broil and move the rack to the top rung. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Place the tomatillos and jalapeno on the baking sheet and broil for six to seven minutes. Be sure to monitor closely as broilers vary greatly between ovens. Remove the seeds from the jalapeno once they are cool enough to touch.
Add the tomatillo, jalapeno, onion, cilantro, garlic, lime juice, and salt to a food processor. Pulse several times to purée. Adjust the salt and lime juice to your taste.
Pour the mixture into a serving bowl. Serve with crackers and enjoy.

name: One Pan Chickpea Fajitas
ingredients:
1
Red Bell Pepper (sliced)
1
Yellow Bell Pepper (sliced)
1
Green Bell Pepper (sliced)
1
Yellow Onion (medium, sliced)
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, drained)
3 tbsps
Avocado Oil
2 tbsps
Taco Seasoning
8
Corn Tortilla (small)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425° F (220° F).
To a large baking sheet, add bell peppers, onion, and chickpeas. Add the oil and taco seasoning and toss to combine. Spread everything out into an even layer.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until the vegetables are cooked to your liking. Toss halfway through for even cooking.
To assemble, divide the chickpeas and vegetables onto the tortillas. Enjoy!

name: Cucumber & Hummus Open Face Sandwich
ingredients:
1 3/4 ozs
Sourdough Bread
2 tsps
Hummus
1/4
Cucumber (medium, sliced)
1 stalk
Green Onion (thinly sliced)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)

name: Hummus & Naan Plate

Cucumber (large, sliced)
1
Tomato (medium, chopped)
1 piece
Naan
1/4 cup
Hummus
1/4 cup
Black Olives
recipe: Arrange all the ingredients onto a plate and enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Lentil Taco Bowl
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
3 cups
Water
1/2 cup
Tomato Sauce (plain)
1 1/2 tbsps
Taco Seasoning
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
2 heads
Romaine Hearts (finely chopped)
2
Tomato (large, diced)
1
Jalapeno Pepper (large, finely chopped)
1/2
Yellow Onion (finely chopped)
2
Lime (cut into wedges)
recipe:
Combine the lentils, water, tomato sauce, taco seasoning, and salt in the pot of the pressure cooker.
Close the lid. Set to “sealing”, then press manual/pressure cooker and cook for 12 minutes on high pressure. Once it is done, release the pressure manually. Remove the lid carefully.
Stir the lentils well and season with additional salt if needed.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl combine the tomato, jalapeno, and onion.
When ready to serve, divide the lettuce and lentils evenly between bowls and top with the tomato-jalapeno mixture. Squeeze fresh lime juice over top and enjoy!

name: Carrot & Mixed Bean Salad with Tahini Dressing
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Tahini
1 1/3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
3 tbsps
Apple Cider Vinegar (to taste)
1/4 cup
Water
2 cups
Mixed Beans (cooked)
2 stalks
Celery (sliced)
4
Tomato (small, chopped)
1
Carrot (large, shredded)
1
Avocado (chopped)
1/3 cup
Chives (chopped, flowers optional)
recipe:
In a jar, whisk together the tahini, maple syrup, vinegar, and water. Set aside.
Arrange the beans, celery, tomato, carrot, and avocado in a large salad bowl. Drizzle with the dressing and top with chives. Toss the salad before serving and enjoy!

name: Horchata
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Basmati Rice (uncooked)
1/4 cup
Almonds
1 serving
Cinnamon Stick (small)
2 cups
Water (cold, divided)
2 tbsps
Honey
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 cup
Cow's Milk, Reduced Fat
12
Ice Cubes
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon (for optional garnish)
recipe:
Add the rice, almonds, and cinnamon stick to a high-speed blender. Blend for about 30 to 60 seconds on high speed or until finely pulverized.
Pour in 1/2 of the water, honey, and vanilla. Blend an additional 30 seconds.
Pour the mixture into a large pitcher or container. Add the milk and remaining water into the mixture. Cover with a lid or plastic wrap and let it chill in the fridge for at least eight hours or over night.
Strain the mixture through a fine-mesh sieve and serve over ice. Divide between glasses and top with cinnamon, if using, and enjoy!

name: Raspberry Iced Tea
ingredients:
1 cup
Raspberry Leaf Tea (brewed)
1 tbsp
Mint Leaves (stems removed)
1 tsp
Lime Juice
1/16 tsp
Stevia Powder (to taste)
4
Ice Cubes
recipe: Stir together the raspberry leaf tea, mint leaves, lime juice, and stevia. Let cool before serving with ice. Enjoy!

name: Lentil Potato Fritter Wrap
ingredients:
2
Russet Potato (medium, peeled and cut into large cubes)
1/2 cup
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed well)
2 1/2
Garlic (clove, smashed, divided)
1 1/2 tsps
Curry Powder
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
2 tsps
Lemon Juice
3
Whole Wheat Tortilla (large)
3 cups
Baby Spinach
recipe:
Add the potatoes, lentils, and 3/4 of the garlic to a pot of salted water. Bring to a boil and cook for about 15 minutes or until the potatoes are soft and the lentils are just tender. Drain the potatoes and lentils then place them back in the same pot while warm. Add the curry powder and salt to the pot then mash with a vegetable masher until mostly smooth (some lentils may remain whole). Let the mixture rest until cool enough to handle.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Form the potato lentil mixture into thin patties, using approximately two tablespoons of the mixture per patty. Place on the baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes then flip and continue to bake for 10 minutes or until both sides of the fritters are brown and the outside is crispy.
Meanwhile, mince the remaining garlic and add it to a small mixing bowl. Add the coconut yogurt and lemon juice and stir to combine. Season with additional salt if needed.
Lay the tortilla flat and top with the yogurt sauce, baby spinach, and lentil potato fritters. Roll the tortilla tightly and enjoy!

name: Basic Protein Porridge
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Water
1/3 cup
Quick Oats
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon (optional)
recipe:
Bring the water to a boil in a small saucepan. Add the quick oats and cook for one minute, or until cooked to your liking.
Stir in the protein powder and cinnamon until well combined. Enjoy!

name: Mint & Lime Iced Tea
ingredients:
1 cup
Water (hot)
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves (stems removed)
1 tsp
Lime Juice
1 tsp
Raw Honey (optional)
4
Ice Cubes
recipe:
Steep the mint leaves in the hot water for three to five minutes. Stir in the lime juice and honey, if using.
Let cool before serving with ice. Enjoy!

name: Lentil & Potato Fritters
ingredients:
2
Russet Potato (medium, peeled and cut into large cubes)
1/2 cup
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed well)
2
Garlic (large clove, smashed)
1 1/2 tsps
Curry Powder
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Add the potatoes, lentils, and the garlic to a pot of salted water. Bring to a boil and cook for about 15 minutes or until the potatoes are soft and the lentils are just tender. Drain the potatoes and lentils then place them back in the same pot while warm. Add the curry powder and salt to the pot then mash with a vegetable masher until mostly smooth (some lentils may remain whole). Let the mixture rest until cool enough to handle.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Form the potato lentil mixture into thin patties, using approximately two tablespoons of the mixture per patty. Place on the baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes then flip and continue to bake for 10 minutes or until both sides of the fritters are brown and the outside is crispy. Divide between plates and enjoy!

name: Ginger Iced Tea
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Water
1 1/2 tbsps
Ginger (peeled, sliced)
1 tsp
Raw Honey (to taste)
1/4
Lemon (small, juiced, to taste)
recipe:
Add the water and ginger slices to a small pot and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and let simmer for about five to 10 minutes, or to your desired strength.
Remove from heat and stir in the honey and lemon juice. Let cool before serving with ice. Enjoy!

name: Cuban-Style Chickpea Picadillo
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (small, chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tsp
Cumin
3/4 tsp
Oregano (dried)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1
Tomato (medium, diced)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, rinsed well)
1/4 cup
Green Olives (chopped)
1/4 cup
Water
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for three to five minutes or until softened.
Add the garlic, cumin, oregano, and salt and stir to combine then add the tomato. Cook for about one minute then stir in the chickpeas. Continue to cook for two to three minutes until the tomatoes start to break down and the chickpeas warm through.
Add the olives and the water and continue to cook for three to five minutes or until the sauce thickens. Season with additional salt if needed. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Shredded Romaine Salad
ingredients:
2 heads
Romaine Hearts (shredded)
2 stalks
Green Onion (thinly sliced)
3 tbsps
Fresh Dill (finely chopped)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a bowl and toss to combine. Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Lemon Earl Grey Iced Tea
ingredients:
1 cup
Earl Grey Tea (brewed)
1 1/16 ozs
Dried Lavender Flowers (optional)
1 tsp
Raw Honey (to taste)
1/4
Lemon (small, juiced)
4
Ice Cubes
recipe:
Brew the earl grey tea with dried lavender (optional) and strain into a mug.
Stir in the honey and lemon juice. Let cool before serving with ice. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea Picadillo with Rice
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Rice
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (small, chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tsp
Cumin
3/4 tsp
Oregano (dried)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1
Tomato (medium, diced)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, rinsed well)
1/4 cup
Green Olives (chopped)
1/4 cup
Water
recipe:
Cook the rice according to package directions.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for three to five minutes or until softened.
Add the garlic, cumin, oregano, and salt and stir to combine then add the tomato. Cook for about one minute then stir in the chickpeas. Continue to cook for two to three minutes until the tomatoes start to break down and the chickpeas warm through.
Add the olives and the water and continue to cook for three to five minutes or until the sauce thickens. Season with additional salt if needed.
Divide the rice and chickpeas evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Lemon Blueberry Baked Oats
ingredients:
2 cups
Oats
2 cups
Cow's Milk, Reduced Fat
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
1
Lemon (large, juiced)
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1 tsp
Baking Powder
1 cup
Blueberries (plus extra for garnish)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a baking pan, or line it with parchment paper.
Add the oats, milk, maple syrup, lemon juice, vanilla, chia seeds, and baking powder to the pan. Mix to combine. Fold in the blueberries.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until cooked through. Remove from the oven and let it cool for ten minutes. Divide between plates and enjoy!

name: Almond Flour Churros
ingredients:
1 cup
Water
2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar (plus more for dusting)
3 tbsps
Butter
2 cups
Almond Flour
2/3 cup
Tapioca Flour
2 tsps
Cinnamon
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the water, coconut sugar, and butter to a pot and bring to a boil. Remove from heat.
Stir in the almond flour and tapioca flour until a sticky dough forms. Set aside to cool for five minutes.
Transfer the dough to a piping bag fitted with a large star tip and pipe the dough onto the baking sheet into four-inch (10 cm) lines. Bake for 20 to 22 minutes, until golden on top.
Meanwhile, whisk together a generous amount of coconut sugar with the cinnamon in a shallow baking dish. Toss the churros in the cinnamon sugar while they're still warm. Enjoy!

name: Cucumber & Lime Chia Fresca
ingredients:
1/2
Cucumber (chopped)
3 cups
Water
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
8
Ice Cubes
recipe:
Blend the cucumber, water, lime juice, and maple syrup in a blender until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a pitcher. Optional: use a fine mesh strainer to strain the mixture. Stir in the chia seeds and allow them to sit for 10 minutes.
Add ice to glasses and pour the chia fresca over top. Enjoy!

name: Lentil Potato Fritter Bowl
ingredients:
2
Russet Potato (medium, peeled and cut into large cubes)
1/2 cup
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed well)
2 1/2
Garlic (clove, smashed, divided)
1 1/2 tsps
Curry Powder
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1 head
Romaine Hearts (chopped)
1
Carrot (small, cut into matchsticks)
1/4
Cucumber (chopped)
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
2 tsps
Lemon Juice
recipe:
Add the potatoes, lentils, and 3/4 of the garlic to a pot of salted water. Bring to a boil and cook for about 15 minutes or until the potatoes are soft and the lentils are just tender. Drain the potatoes and lentils then place them back in the same pot while warm. Add the curry powder and salt to the pot then mash with a vegetable masher until mostly smooth (some lentils may remain whole). Let the mixture rest until cool enough to handle.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Form the potato lentil mixture into thin patties, using approximately two tablespoons of the mixture per patty. Place on the baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes then flip and continue to bake for 10 minutes or until both sides of the fritters are brown and the outside is crispy.
Meanwhile, divide the lettuce, carrots, and cucumber between bowls. Mince the remaining garlic and add it to a small mixing bowl. Add the coconut yogurt and lemon juice and stir to combine. Season with additional salt if needed.
Divide the potato fritters between bowls and serve with the coconut yogurt sauce. Enjoy!

name: Easy Vegan Gravy
ingredients:
2 cups
Vegetable Broth
1 tbsp
Tamari
1/4 cup
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
1/2 tsp
Onion Powder
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/4 tsp
Dried Thyme

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Combine all ingredients into a saucepan over medium heat and whisk well. Bring to a boil, and then reduce the heat and simmer on low for five minutes, until thickened, whisking often.
Transfer to a dish and enjoy!

name: Mackerel Salad Open Face Sandwich
ingredients:
2 ozs
Canned Mackerel (skinless, boneless)
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1/2 tsp
Dijon Mustard
1 stalk
Celery (chopped)
1 stalk
Green Onion (thinly sliced)
1 tbsp
Fresh Dill (finely chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 slices
Gluten-Free Bread
1/8
Tomato (sliced)
recipe:
Add the mackerel, yogurt, lemon juice, mustard, celery, onion, dill, salt, and black pepper to a bowl. Mash and stir until well combined.
Divide the mackerel salad onto the bread and add a tomato slice to each piece. Enjoy!

name: Carnitas-Style Jackfruit
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
4 cups
Canned Jackfruit (young, drained, rinsed, cored)
1/2 cup
Water
1 tbsp
Tomato Paste
2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
2 tsps
Cumin
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1/4 cup
Orange Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 450℉ (230℃) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for three to five minutes until softened. Add the jackfruit and water and simmer for ten minutes.
Add the remaining ingredients and simmer on low for ten minutes. Pull apart the jackfruit with a fork.
Spread the jackfruit onto the prepared baking sheet and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until crispy. Enjoy!

name: Mango & Black Bean Quinoa Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (uncooked)
2 cups
Black Beans (cooked)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (diced)
1
Mango (peeled, diced)
2 cups
Baby Spinach (chopped)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 tsp
Cumin

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Set aside to cool.
Combine the cooled quinoa and all remaining ingredients in a large bowl and mix until well combined. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato Poutine
ingredients:
2
Sweet Potato (large, sliced into 1/4-inch strips)
1 1/2 tbsps
Tapioca Flour

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 1/2 tbsps
Avocado Oil
1 cup
Vegetable Broth
1 1/2 tsps
Tamari
2 tbsps
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1 tbsp
Nutritional Yeast
1/4 tsp
Onion Powder
1/4 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/8 tsp
Dried Thyme
5 1/4 ozs
Cheese Curds
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (215ºC) and line the baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the sweet potato strips in a large bowl with tapioca flour, salt, and pepper and toss until well coated. Pour in the oil and toss again to combine.
Arrange the sweet potato onto your baking sheet, being careful not to crowd the pan. Use multiple baking sheets if needed. Bake for 28 to 30 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Meanwhile combine the vegetable broth, tamari, all purpose gluten-free flour, nutritional yeast, onion powder, garlic powder, thyme, salt, and pepper into a saucepan over medium heat and whisk well. Bring to a boil, and then reduce the heat and simmer on low for five minutes, until thickened, whisking often. Cover and keep on low heat until the fries are ready.
Remove the fries from the oven and transfer to a plate. Add the cheese curds on top and immediately pour the hot gravy on top. Season with salt and/or pepper if needed. Enjoy!

name: Apple & Beet Quinoa Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (uncooked)
1
Apple (julienned)
2
Beet (small, peeled, grated)
2
Carrot (small, peeled, grated)
1 cup
Kale Leaves (chopped)
1/3 cup
Dried Unsweetened Cranberries
1/4 cup
Orange Juice
2 tbsps
Apple Cider Vinegar
1 tbsp
Dijon Mustard
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Once it has finished cooking, set it aside to cool.
Combine the cooled quinoa and all remaining ingredients in a large bowl and mix until well combined. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Jackfruit Carnitas Tacos
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
4 cups
Canned Jackfruit (young, drained, rinsed, cored)
1/2 cup
Water
1 tbsp
Tomato Paste
2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
2 tsps
Cumin
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1/4 cup
Orange Juice
1/4 cup
Guacamole
8
Corn Tortilla
1/4 cup
Red Onion (diced)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 450℉ (230℃) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for three to five minutes until softened. Add the jackfruit and water, and simmer for ten minutes.
Add the tomato paste, coconut sugar, cumin, smoked paprika, and orange juice and simmer on low for ten minutes. Pull apart the jackfruit with a fork.
Spread the jackfruit onto the prepared baking sheet and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until crispy. Spread the guacamole over the tortillas, and top with the jackfruit, red onion, and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Brazilian Tapioca Flour Crepe
ingredients:
1
Apple (small, diced)
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1/3 cup
Water (divided)
1/2 cup
Tapioca Flour
1 tbsp
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
recipe:
In a small saucepan, add the diced apple, cinnamon, maple syrup, and 1/3 of the water. Place the pan over medium heat and cook for 15 to 17 minutes or until apples are soft. Stir occasionally and add more water if necessary. Meanwhile, in a large bowl add the tapioca flour. Then add the rest of the water a little bit at a time and use your hands to wet the flour with the water.
After adding all the water you should have a wet powdery dough (if the dough looks sticky, add more flour). Use a fine-mesh sieve and slowly press the dough through it. You should have a very fine powder.
Heat up a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Sprinkle about two tablespoons of the powder onto the pan evenly to form a circle.
Cook the crepe for about a minute, then slowly flip it with a spatula and cook the other side for another minute. Repeat the process to make all the crepes.
Roll the pancakes and top them with cooked apple. Sprinkle with coconut and enjoy!

name: Chilean-Style Salad
ingredients:
3
Tomato (cut into wedges)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Lime (juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a bowl and toss to combine. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Basil Agua Fresca
ingredients:
2 cups
Strawberries (stems removed, plus more for garnish)
2 cups
Water
1
Lime (juiced)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves
12
Ice Cubes
recipe:
Add the strawberries, water, lime juice, maple syrup, and basil to a blender and blend until smooth.
Divide the ice cubes into cups. Pour the blended beverage into cups and enjoy!

name: Portobello & Red Pepper Naan Pizza
ingredients:
1 piece
Naan
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 ozs
Portobello Mushroom Caps (chopped)
1/4
Red Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
1 tbsp
Tomato Sauce
2 ozs
Vegan Cheese Shreds (divided)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Once preheated, put the naan on the baking sheet and bake for five minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the mushrooms and bell peppers until soft, about five minutes.
Spread the tomato sauce evenly over the naan. Top with half the cheese shreds, the cooked mushrooms and bell peppers, and then the remaining cheese shreds.
Return to the oven and bake for six to eight more minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the crust is crispy. Cut into slices and enjoy!

name: Mulberry Chia Jam
ingredients:
2 cups
Mulberries
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
recipe:
Add the mulberries, honey, and chia seeds to a saucepan over medium heat. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes or until the jam begins to thicken. Crush the mulberries with a spatula or fork.
Remove from heat and pour into a jar. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Salsa
ingredients:
2 1/4 cups
Strawberries (stems removed, finely diced)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (finely diced)
1/2
Jalapeno Pepper (seeds removed, finely diced)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (finely chopped)
1
Lime (juiced)
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a bowl and mix to combine. Enjoy!

name: California Naan Pizza
ingredients:
1 piece
Naan
2 tbsps
Water
2 cups
Baby Spinach
1 tbsp
Tomato Sauce
1 oz
Mozzarella Cheese (shredded)
3 tbsps
Sun Dried Tomatoes (sliced)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Once preheated, put the naan on the baking sheet and bake for five minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the water in a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the spinach until wilted, about one to two minutes. Pat dry and set aside.
Spread the tomato sauce evenly over the naan. Top with mozzarella, sautéed spinach, sun dried tomatoes, and feta cheese. Return to the oven and bake for six to eight more minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the crust is crispy.
Cut into slices and enjoy!

name: Blended Sweet Potato & Roasted Red Peppers
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (large, peeled, chopped)
5 1/2 ozs
Roasted Red Peppers
1/4 cup
White Navy Beans (cooked, rinsed well)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1/2
Lime (juiced)
recipe:
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the sweet potatoes and boil until fork tender, about seven to 10 minutes. Drain the water and leave to cool for about 10 minutes.
Add all the ingredients to the food processor. Process everything together until smooth.
Serve either hot or cold and enjoy!

name: Brazilian-Style Fudge Balls
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Cacao Powder (for rolling)
1 tbsp
Ghee
2/3 cup
Coconut Cream
2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
2/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Add the cacao powder to a plate and set it aside.
Add the ghee to a small saucepan over medium-low heat. Once it melts, add the coconut cream and coconut sugar. Stir to combine.
Reduce the heat and add the chocolate chips. Continuously stir until smooth and the chocolate has melted.
Transfer to a heatproof shallow bowl and let it cool for ten to fifteen minutes at room temperature. Then move to the fridge to cool for an hour to an hour and a half.
Use a spoon to make approximately one-inch sized balls. Roll the balls in your hands to make them smooth, then roll them into the cacao powder and place them on a plate. Serve right away or refrigerate. Enjoy!

name: Mushroom & Leek Soup
ingredients:
1/2 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
1
Leeks (medium, trimmed and chopped)
10
Cremini Mushrooms (sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Canned Coconut Milk (plus more for garnish)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion and sauté for four to five minutes or until soft and translucent.
Add the leeks and mushrooms. Continue cooking for another five minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the coconut milk, stir and cover the pot with a lid. Turn the heat down to simmer and cook for 20 to 25 minutes.
Use a hand blender or carefully transfer to your blender and blend the soup until smooth. Divide evenly between bowls and garnish with coconut milk and dill. Enjoy!

name: Naan Bruschetta
ingredients:
1 piece
Naan
1
Tomato (small, diced)
1 tbsp
Red Onion (minced)
1 tbsp
Basil Leaves (chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Once preheated, put the naan on the baking sheet and bake for five minutes.
Meanwhile, combine the remaining ingredients in a bowl. Drain any excess liquid.
Top the naan with the bruschetta mix and return to the oven. Bake for six to eight more minutes, or until the crust is crispy. Cut into slices and enjoy!

name: Greek Style Fries Supreme
ingredients:
4 ozs
Frozen French Fries
1/3
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1/2
Tomato (medium, diced)
2 tbsps
Black Olives (pitted, sliced)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
2 tbsps
Plain Greek Yogurt
1 tbsp
Water
recipe:
Cook the fries according to package directions.
Top the fries with cucumbers, tomatoes, black olives, and feta cheese.
Whisk the Greek yogurt and water in a bowl. Drizzle over the fries and enjoy!

name: Ricotta & Strawberry Puree
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Ricotta Cheese
2 tbsps
Plain Greek Yogurt
2 tbsps
Strawberries
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon
recipe: Add all the ingredients to a blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Serve and enjoy!

name: Diced Tomatoes & Tofu
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 cup
Red Onion (diced)
1 tsp
Italian Seasoning
1/2 cup
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, drained)
10 1/2 ozs
Tofu (medium, crumbled)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper
recipe:
Heat the oil in a non-stick skillet. Add the onion and cook until softened, about five minutes.
Add the Italian seasoning, tomatoes, and tofu. Cook for two to three minutes until warmed through. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Navy Bean Tomato Soup
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
4
Garlic (clove, minced)
3 1/2 cups
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with juices)
2 cups
White Navy Beans (cooked)
1 tsp
Italian Seasoning
1/2 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a non-stick skillet. Add the garlic and cook for one minute. Add the diced tomatoes, beans, and Italian seasoning. Cook on a low simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove from the heat and add the Greek yogurt. Use an immersion blender or a high-powered blender to blend the soup until it is smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Baked Spinach & Ricotta Florentine
ingredients:
1 cup
Ricotta Cheese
2 ozs
Mozzarella Cheese (divided)
1/3 cup
Frozen Spinach (thawed, drained)
1/4 cup
Sun Dried Tomatoes (drained, chopped)
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves (chopped)
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1/2 tsp
Nutmeg

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). In a bowl, mix together the ricotta cheese, 2/3 of the mozzarella, spinach, sun dried tomatoes, basil, and garlic.
Add nutmeg and season with salt and pepper. Adjust the seasoning to your taste. Transfer the mixture into an oven-safe dish or ramekin. Top with the remaining mozzarella cheese.
Bake in the oven for about 15 minutes or until the cheese on top is slightly browned. Enjoy!

name: Blackberry Protein Popsicles
ingredients:
2 cups
Blackberries
1 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour into popsicle molds and freeze for five to six hours or until completely frozen. Enjoy!

name: Tofu Caesar Dressing
ingredients:
14 ozs
Tofu (soft, crumbled)
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
2 tbsps
Dijon Mustard
2 tbsps
Apple Cider Vinegar
2 tbsps
Water
1 tbsp
Tamari
3
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a food processor and blend until smooth. Taste and adjust flavors if needed. If the dressing is too thick, add water, one tablespoon at a time until desired consistency is reached.
Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate until ready to use. Enjoy!

name: Potato, Green Pea & Mint Soup
ingredients:
1/2
Yellow Onion (small, chopped)
1
Yellow Potato (medium, peeled and chopped)
2
Garlic (clove)
2 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
2/3 cup
Frozen Peas (thawed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Mint Leaves (plus extra for garnish)
2 tbsps
Plain Greek Yogurt (for garnish)
recipe:
In a pot over medium heat, add the onion, potato, garlic, and vegetable broth. Bring it to a boil, and then turn down the heat to simmer. Cover the pot with a lid and cook for 15 minutes or until the potatoes are soft.
Add the peas, salt, and pepper and cook for another 10 minutes. Add the mint leaves. Use an immersion blender or blender and blend the soup until it is smooth. Divide the soup between serving bowls. Top with Greek yogurt and additional mint leaves, if using. Enjoy!

name: Potato & Asparagus Soup
ingredients:
1 tsp
Butter
1 1/2 cups
Asparagus (trimmed, cut into bite-sized pieces)
1
Yellow Potato (medium, chopped)
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
1 tsp
Curry Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1 tbsp
Chives (chopped, for garnish)
1/2
Lime (cut into wedges)
recipe:
Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Once melted, add the asparagus and sauté for about two minutes. Take out a few of them for garnish, if using, and set them aside.
Add the potato, onion, curry powder, salt, pepper, and broth to the pot. Bring it to a boil, then turn the heat down to a simmer. Cover the pot and cook for 20 minutes or until the potatoes are soft.
Using an immersion blender or blender, blend the soup until smooth. Divide between serving bowls, top with chives and sautéed asparagus. Serve with lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Mushroom & Orzo Soup
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
8
White Button Mushrooms (sliced)
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1/4 tsp
Nutmeg (ground)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2/3 cup
Orzo
3 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1/2 cup
Frozen Peas (thawed)
1 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1 stalk
Green Onion (thinly sliced)
recipe:
In a pot, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Sauté the mushrooms for three to four minutes or until soft. Add the onion and sauté for another two minutes.
Add the garlic, nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Stir and cook for another minute. Add the orzo and vegetable broth. Turn down the heat to low and let it simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the peas and coconut milk. Continue to simmer for another 10 minutes or until everything is cooked through. Add a splash of water if necessary.
Divide the soup between serving bowls and top with green onion. Enjoy!

name: Fried Halloumi Salad
ingredients:
5 ozs
Halloumi (sliced)
4 cups
Mixed Greens
2
Tomato (small, sliced)
1/4 cup
Pesto
recipe:
Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the halloumi slices until golden brown, about one to two minutes per side.
Divide the greens, tomato slices, and halloumi onto plates. Top with pesto and enjoy!

name: Za'atar Bocconcini Wraps
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Za'atar Spice
3 1/2 ozs
Small Bocconcini (halved)
1/4 cup
Hummus
1 1/16 ozs
White Pita Bread (toasted)
3 cups
Mixed Greens
1
Tomato (medium, chopped)
recipe:
Heat a pan over medium heat. Add the za'atar spice and toast until fragrant, about one minute.
Add the bocconcini and toss until well coated. Remove from heat.
Spread the hummus evenly over each pita. Top with mixed greens, tomato, and bocconcini. Enjoy!

name: Pesto & Asparagus Linguine
ingredients:
4 1/2 ozs
Whole Wheat Linguine (uncooked)
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
2 cups
Asparagus (woody ends trimmed, chopped)
2 cups
Fresh Peas (or frozen)
1/4 cup
Pesto
1 tsp
Red Pepper Flakes (optional)
recipe:
Cook the linguine according to the package directions.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the asparagus until fork tender, about five minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the peas and pesto. Cook until warmed through, about one to two more minutes.
Divide the linguine onto plates and top with the peas and asparagus. Top with red pepper flakes (optional) and enjoy!

name: Romaine with Tofu Caesar Dressing
ingredients:
7 ozs
Tofu (soft, crumbled)
1 tbsp
Nutritional Yeast
1 tbsp
Dijon Mustard
1 tbsp
Apple Cider Vinegar
1 tbsp
Water
1 1/2 tsps
Tamari
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
12 leaves
Romaine (large, chopped)
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients, except for the romaine, to a food processor and blend until smooth. Taste and adjust flavors if needed. If the dressing is too thick, add water, one tablespoon at a time until desired consistency is reached.
In a large bowl, toss the chopped romaine with the dressing until well coated. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Banana Popsicles
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/2 cup
Chocolate Protein Powder
1 tbsp
Cacao Powder
1
Banana
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour into popsicle molds and freeze for five to six hours or until completely frozen. Enjoy!

name: Pineapple Coconut Overnight Oats
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Oats
1 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1/2 cup
Frozen Pineapple
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
recipe: Whisk all of the ingredients together in a bowl. Cover and place in the fridge overnight, or for at least eight hours. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Pineapple Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 1/2 cups
Strawberries (chopped)
1 cup
Frozen Pineapple
1/3 cup
Protein Powder
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and enjoy!

name: Lentil Goulash
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (diced)
6
Garlic (cloves, minced)
2
Red Bell Pepper (diced)
3
Yellow Potato (medium, peeled, diced)
2 cups
Lentils (cooked)
1 1/8 tbsps
Paprika
1 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
2 cups
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with juices)
1 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion softens, about five minutes.
Add the peppers, potatoes, lentils, paprika, vegetable broth, and diced tomatoes. Bring to a boil and simmer for 25 to 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are fork tender. Season with salt, serve, and enjoy!

name: Balsamic Tofu with Rice
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Jasmine Rice (dry)
1/3 cup
Balsamic Vinegar
1 tbsp
Tamari
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
2 tsps
Rosemary (fresh, chopped)
1 tsp
Italian Seasoning

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
16 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, and cubed)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to package directions.
Whisk together the balsamic vinegar, tamari, maple syrup, rosemary, and Italian seasoning. Set aside.
Gently toss the tofu in a large bowl with salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Cook the tofu in the pan until golden, about eight to ten minutes, flipping and tossing every couple of minutes. Reduce the heat to low and add the balsamic mixture. Cook for one minute, tossing to coat until thickened. Divide the rice onto plates and top with tofu. Garnish with extra rosemary if desired. Enjoy!

name: Cumin Mango Dressing
ingredients:
2
Mango (small, chopped)
1/2 tsp
Cumin (ground)
3 tbsps
Apple Cider Vinegar
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
recipe:
Add all ingredients to a food processor and blend until smooth.
Transfer to an airtight container or jar and keep refrigerated until ready to use.

name: Ground Bison & Raisins with Rapini
ingredients:
8 ozs
Rapini (large, chopped)
1 1/4 lbs
Ground Bison
1 tsp
Oregano (dried)
1/2 tsp
Dried Thyme
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
1/3 cup
Raisins
recipe:
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Cook the rapini for two minutes or until tender crisp. Drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, heat a pan over medium heat. Add the bison, oregano, thyme, salt, and raisins. Cook for five to eight minutes, breaking it up as it cooks. Drain extra fat if needed.
Divide the rapini and bison onto plates and enjoy!

name: Greek Seasoned Parsnip Fries
ingredients:
4
Parsnip (large, peeled, sliced into fries)
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
2 tbsps
Greek Seasoning
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the parsnips to a large bowl. Add the oil, lemon juice, and Greek seasoning. Toss to combine.
Spread them out onto the baking sheet and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, turning them halfway through. Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Pineapple Chia Pudding
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
4 fl ozs
Pineapple Juice
1/4 cup
Chia Seeds
1/2
Lime (zested)
1/3 cup
Pineapple (chopped)
1 tbsp
Mint Leaves (chopped, optional garnish)
recipe:
Combine the coconut milk, pineapple juice, chia seeds, and lime zest in a bowl. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or until chilled and the chia seeds have set.
Stir well then divide between bowls or jars. Top with pineapple and mint, if using. Enjoy!

name: Pineapple Lime Smoothie
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
2/3 cup
Pineapple
1 tsp
Honey
3
Ice Cubes
1/2
Lime (juiced, zested)
recipe:
Combine all ingredients in a blender except for the lime juice and zest. Blend until smooth.
Add the lime juice and zest and pulse two to three times more. Serve immediately and enjoy!

name: Slow Cooker Turnip & Apple Casserole
ingredients:
3
Turnip (medium, peeled, diced)
3
Apple (medium, peeled, diced)
1/4 cup
Coconut Sugar (divided)
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Almond Flour
2 tbsps
Coconut Oil (melted)
recipe:
Add the turnips, apples, half the coconut sugar, cinnamon, and sea salt to the slow cooker. Stir to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk the almond flour, coconut oil, and remaining coconut sugar together. Spread evenly on top of the apple turnip mixture.
Cook on high for three to four hours, or until the turnips are fork tender. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Beet & Dill Soup
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (diced)
3
Garlic (cloves, minced)
3
Beet (medium, peeled, chopped)
2 cups
White Navy Beans (cooked)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1/4 cup
Fresh Dill (chopped)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion softens, about five minutes.
Add in the beets, beans, and vegetable broth. Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes or until the beets are fork tender. Remove from heat.
Add the dill and the salt. Blend the soup with an immersion blender until smooth. Serve and enjoy!

name: Black Bean & Roasted Red Pepper Patties
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Black Beans (cooked)
5 ozs
Roasted Red Peppers (drained, chopped)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped, tough stems removed)
1/4 cup
Bread Crumbs
2 tbsps
Feta Cheese
2 tsps
Smoked Paprika
1 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mash all the ingredients until a mixture forms, adding a few tablespoons of water one at a time if needed.
Form the mixture into patties, about three inches wide and one inch thick. Transfer to the baking sheet and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, flipping halfway, or until browned and crisp.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Paprika Garlic Roasted Potatoes
ingredients:
4
Yellow Potato (medium, washed and cut into 1-inch pieces)
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil
2 tsps
Smoked Paprika
1 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 450ºF (230ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In the bottom of a large mixing bowl combine the oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Add the potatoes to the bowl and mix until well coated.
Transfer to the baking sheet and bake for 25 to 28 minutes, flipping halfway, or until the potatoes are tender and golden brown.
Divide between plates and enjoy!

name: Marinated Chickpea & Farro Bowls
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinegar
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup (to taste)
1/2 cup
Chives (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Farro (rinsed)
1/4 cup
Pesto
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
recipe:
Combine the chickpeas, balsamic vinegar, maple syrup, chives, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Set aside.
Meanwhile, cook the farro according to the package directions. Stir in the pesto. Set aside.
Toss the tomatoes in oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Broil for six to eight minutes on the middle rack.
Divide the farro, chickpeas, and tomatoes evenly between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Bison, Rapini & Rice
ingredients:
1 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry)
8 ozs
Rapini (chopped)
1 lb
Ground Bison
1 tsp
Oregano (dried)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to package directions.
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Cook the rapini for two minutes or until tender crisp. Drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, heat a pan over medium heat. Add the bison, oregano, and salt. Cook for five to eight minutes, breaking it up as it cooks. Drain extra fat if needed.
Divide the rice, rapini, and bison onto plates. Enjoy!

name: Spiced Apple Oatmeal
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Coconut Oil
2
Apple (cored, chopped)
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup (divided)
1 tsp
Cinnamon (divided)
1/2 tsp
Nutmeg (divided)
1 1/2 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 cup
Oats
recipe:
Add the coconut oil, apples, vanilla, maple syrup, cinnamon, and nutmeg to a saucepan over medium heat. Cook the apples for four to five minutes or until they have softened, stirring continuously so they don't stick.
Add the milk and oats. Stir to combine. Lower the heat and cook for five to seven minutes or until the oats thicken, stirring as needed.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Miso Dressing
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Tahini
1 tbsp
Honey
1 1/2 tsps
Tamari
1/4 cup
Water
1 tsp
Sesame Oil
1 tsp
Miso Paste
2 tbsps
Rice Vinegar
recipe: Add all the ingredients into a mini food processor and blend until smooth. Alternatively, use an immersion blender, shake vigorously in a jar, or whisk all of the ingredients in a bowl. Adjust any flavors to your preference as needed. Enjoy!

name: Wild Rice & Nori Bowl
ingredients:
1 cup
Wild Rice (dry)
1/3 cup
Tahini
1/4 cup
Water
2 tbsps
Rice Vinegar
1 tbsp
Honey
1 tsp
Miso Paste
1
Cucumber (chopped)
2 cups
Matchstick Carrots
2 cups
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
4
Nori Sheets (small, thinly sliced)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to package directions.
Add the tahini, water, vinegar, honey, and miso to a jar or bowl. Whisk, blend, or shake until smooth. Adjust any flavors to your preference as needed.
Divide the rice, cucumbers, carrots, and edamame into bowls. Top with the miso dressing and nori. Enjoy!

name: Tropical Fruit Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Papaya
1
Kiwi (peeled, chopped)
1 cup
Pineapple
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 tsp
Cardamom
recipe:
Add the papaya, kiwi, pineapple, and maple syrup to a bowl. Toss to combine. Sprinkle the cinnamon and cardamom on top and mix again.
Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Blended Red Lentil Soup
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
1
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
2
Carrot (chopped)
3
Garlic (cloves, chopped)
1 tbsp
Tomato Paste
1 1/2 tsps
Moroccan Spice Blend
4 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
3/4 cup
Dry Red Lentils (rinsed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and carrot and sauté for eight to ten minutes, or until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the tomato paste and Moroccan spice blend and cook for one minute, stirring often. Deglaze with a splash of the vegetable broth and scrape the bottom of the pot with a wooden spoon.
Add the remaining broth, lentils, and season with salt and pepper. Bring to a boil and then reduce the heat. Cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until everything is softened and cooked through.
Remove from the heat and blend with an immersion blender until smooth. Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Blackberry & Pear Oat Smoothie
ingredients:
1
Pear (cored and chopped)
1/2 cup
Blackberries (fresh or frozen)
3/4 cup
Oat Milk
1/4 cup
Oats (rolled)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and enjoy!

name: Cucumber & Peanut Salad
ingredients:
1
Cucumber (thinly sliced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Apple Cider Vinegar
2 tsps
Tamari
2 tsps
Sesame Oil
1 tsp
Coconut Sugar
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/4 cup
Raw Peanuts (finely chopped)
1/2 tsp
Red Pepper Flakes
recipe:
In a medium bowl toss the cucumber slices with the sea salt and allow them to sit for 15 minutes. Drain the excess water.
Whisk together the apple cider vinegar, tamari, sesame oil, coconut sugar, and minced garlic in a small bowl. Pour over the cucumbers.
Top with peanuts and red pepper flakes. Serve and enjoy!

name: Roasted Potato, Zucchini & Quinoa Bowl
ingredients:
1
Zucchini (sliced)
1/2
Orange Bell Pepper (medium, chopped)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (cut into chunks)
1 cup
Mini Potatoes (quartered)
1 tsp
Coconut Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Quinoa
1/3
Cucumber (large, diced)
1 stalk
Green Onion (thinly sliced)
3 tbsps
Tahini
2 tbsps
Water
1 tsp
Honey
1 tbsp
Cilantro (for garnish, optional)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400℉ (205℃) and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Arrange the zucchini, bell pepper, red onion, and potatoes on the tray. Toss with coconut oil and season with salt and pepper. Cook in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Meanwhile, cook the quinoa according to the package directions. Once cooked, fluff with a fork and let it cool. Mix the quinoa with cucumber and green onion.
Whisk together the tahini, water, and honey to make a dressing. Season it with salt and pepper.
Divide all of the ingredients evenly between bowls. Top with cilantro, if using. Serve with the dressing and enjoy!

name: Cherry Raspberry Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Cow's Milk, Reduced Fat
1/2 cup
Frozen Raspberries
1/2
Banana (frozen)
1/2 cup
Frozen Cherries
1/4 cup
Oats
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tbsp
Coconut Butter
recipe: Add all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Simple Vanilla Protein Shake
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
6
Ice Cubes (large)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Strawberry Vanilla Pineapple Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 1/2 cups
Strawberries (chopped)
1 cup
Frozen Pineapple
1/3 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Blueberry Basil Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Blueberries (fresh or frozen)
2/3 cup
Oat Milk
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves
recipe: Add all of the ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Sweet Chili Edamame
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Rice Vinegar
1/2 cup
Water
2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tsps
Tamari
1 1/2 tsps
Sriracha
1 tsp
Arrowroot Powder
4 cups
Edamame Pods
recipe:
In a small saucepan, combine the vinegar, water, sugar, garlic, tamari, and sriracha. Bring to a low boil over medium-high heat and then reduce the heat and simmer for seven to eight minutes.
Remove about 1/4 of the sauce and place in a small bowl. Whisk in the arrowroot powder to create a slurry and then add the slurry to the saucepan. Cook for 30 seconds or so, until thickened. Remove from the heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Place the edamame pods in the boiling water and cook for five minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain and rinse with cold water and then add the edamame back to the large pot.
Add the sauce and toss to combine until the edamame is well coated. Enjoy!

name: Tricolor Quinoa & Cardamom Porridge
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (tricolor, rinsed and drained)
1 1/2 cups
Canned Coconut Milk (divided)
1/2 cup
Water
1/4 tsp
Cardamom (ground)
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1
Peach (medium, pitted, chopped)
1/4 cup
Pumpkin Seeds (toasted)
recipe:
In a small pot, bring the quinoa, 2/3 of the milk, water, cardamom, and salt to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer covered until the liquid has been absorbed and the quinoa is tender but still chewy, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand for five minutes. Fluff with a fork.
Divide evenly between bowls and serve topped with the remaining milk, peach(es), and pumpkin seeds. Enjoy!

name: Parsnip & Tofu Puree
ingredients:
3
Parsnip (medium, peeled, diced)
2
Yellow Potato (medium, peeled, diced)
5 1/4 ozs
Tofu (soft)
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Add the parsnips and potatoes to a pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil, and cook for 15 to 17 minutes, or until the parsnips are fork tender. Drain.
In a food processor add the boiled parsnips and potatoes, tofu, garlic powder, and salt. Blend until smooth. Serve and enjoy!

name: Parmesan & Parsley Popcorn
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil
1/2 cup
Popcorn Kernels
3 tbsps
Butter (unsalted, melted)
1/2 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
1/2 cup
Parsley (chopped finely)
1/4 cup
Pine Nuts (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
In a large, heavy-bottomed saucepan with a capacity of at least six quarts, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Add the kernels, cover, and wait a few seconds for the kernels to start popping. Continuously shake the pan until the kernels stop popping. Remove from heat.
Toss the freshly made popcorn with the melted butter until evenly coated. Then add the parmesan, parsley, pine nuts, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat completely. Enjoy!

name: Baked Green Tomatoes
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3
Green Tomato (large, sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1 cup
Buttermilk
2 tsps
Cajun Seasoning
1 1/2 cups
Bread Crumbs
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Add the oil directly to a baking sheet and spread it around to coat evenly and then set aside.
Season the tomato slices with salt and pepper. Add the flour to one bowl. Whisk the buttermilk, cajun seasoning, salt, and pepper in a second bowl. Place the bread crumbs in a third bowl.
Dip each tomato slice into the flour, tap off any excess and then coat it in buttermilk. Transfer from the buttermilk into the bread crumbs, coating all sides.
Place on the baking sheet, pressing into the oil, flip, and coat the other side. Repeat with all remaining slices.
Bake for 24 minutes, flipping once, until crispy and lightly browned. Serve and enjoy!

name: Mashed Sweet Potatoes
ingredients:
4
Sweet Potato (medium, peeled, cubed)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
1 tbsp
Butter
recipe:
In a large pot, add the cubed sweet potato, half of the sea salt and enough water to cover the sweet potatoes.
Bring the potatoes to a simmer over medium-high heat. Reduce the heat and cook the potatoes for eight to ten minutes or until they are fork tender.
Drain the potatoes and then place them back into the pot. Add the butter and the remaining salt. Mash the potatoes to your desired consistency.
Transfer the mashed potatoes to a serving bowl then divide onto plates. Enjoy!

name: Orange Matcha Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
1
Navel Orange (peeled)
1/2 cup
Frozen Banana
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tsp
Green Tea Powder
recipe: Add all of the ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Carrot & Lentil Pureed Soup
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, peeled, chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
4
Carrot (medium, chopped)
3/4 cup
Dry Red Lentils (rinsed)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1/2 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
1 tbsp
Italian Seasoning

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for three to four minutes. Add the garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add a splash of broth or water if needed so the onions and garlic don't burn.
Add the carrots, lentils, broth, coconut milk, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until the lentils are cooked.
Remove from the heat and use an immersion blender or a high-powered blender to blend the soup until it is smooth. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Carrot Fries
ingredients:
4
Carrot (large, cut into 3-inch fries)
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil (melted)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 350ºF (180ºC).
Toss the carrots and oil together in a bowl until well coated.
Transfer the fries to the air fryer and cook for 25 minutes, flipping halfway through. Sprinkle with salt while still hot. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry & Apple Quinoa Puree
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (tricolor, rinsed and drained)
1
Apple (peeled, chopped)
1 cup
Frozen Strawberries
1 cup
Water
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
recipe:
Add all the ingredients to a pot and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer and cook for 12 to 15 minutes or until the quinoa is cooked through.
Add the mixture to a food processor and blend until smooth. Serve and enjoy!

name: Tahini Carrot Oat Cookies
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Ground Flax Seed
2 tbsps
Water
1 cup
Tahini
1/2 cup
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 cup
Grated Carrot
1 1/2 cups
Quick Oats
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
1/2 tsp
Baking Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix the ground flax seed and water together in a small bowl and set aside for five minutes.
Mix the tahini, maple syrup, and vanilla extract together in a large bowl.
Add the flax mixture, grated carrot, quick oats, shredded coconut, baking powder, and salt to the tahini mixture and mix well.
Use a 1/4 cup measuring cup to scoop the cookie dough onto the baking sheet. Gently press down the cookie mounds.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes. Set the cookies on a cooling rack for 10 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Blended Chickpea Tomato Soup
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Crushed Tomatoes (from the can)
1/4
White Onion (small, chopped)
2
Garlic (clove)
2/3 cup
Chickpeas (cooked, rinsed)
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1/2 tsp
Cumin (ground)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Add the crushed tomatoes, onion, and garlic to a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to simmer and let it simmer uncovered for about 10 minutes.
Add chickpeas, paprika, and cumin. Stir well, cover with a lid, and let simmer for another 15 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper. Use an immersion blender and blend the soup until it is smooth. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Parmesan Pea Puree
ingredients:
1 cup
Frozen Peas (thawed)
1/4
White Onion (small, chopped)
1
Garlic (clove)
1 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Add the peas, onion, garlic, and broth to a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan with a lid and let simmer for 15 to 17 minutes or until everything is cooked through.
Drain the broth into a bowl and set it aside. Transfer the cooked peas, onion, and garlic along with a large splash of the broth to a food processor. Add the parmesan cheese, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Blend until everything is mixed together and smooth. Add more broth as needed until your desired consistency is reached. Serve and enjoy!

name: Nut & Seed Keto Granola
ingredients:
1 cup
Almonds
1 cup
Sunflower Seeds
1 cup
Walnuts
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1 1/2 tbsps
Coconut Oil (melted)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
1/3 cup
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, mix together the almonds, sunflower seeds, walnuts, cinnamon, coconut oil, and salt. Spread the mixture onto the baking sheet.
Bake the granola for eight minutes, stirring halfway. Be sure to watch the granola closely so that it does not burn.
Remove from the oven and pour it into a large bowl. Add the shredded coconut and hemp seeds and mix well. Enjoy!

name: Dill Pickle Popcorn
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil
1/2 cup
Popcorn Kernels
1 tbsp
Pickle Brine
3 tbsps
Butter (unsalted, melted)
2 tsps
Dried Dill
1 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
In a large, heavy-bottomed saucepan with a capacity of at least six quarts, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Add the kernels, cover, and wait a few seconds for the kernels to start popping. Continuously shake the pan until the kernels stop popping. Remove from heat.
Add the pickle brine to the melted butter. Toss the freshly made popcorn with the melted butter until evenly coated. Add the dill and salt. Toss to coat completely. Enjoy!

name: Carrot & Pineapple Smoothie
ingredients:
1
Carrot (medium, chopped)
1 cup
Frozen Pineapple
1 cup
Oat Milk (unsweetened)
recipe: Add all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Edamame Broccoli Soup
ingredients:
2 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
1 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1/2
White Onion (chopped)
3
Garlic (clove)
1 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
In a small pot, add broccoli, edamame, onion, garlic, and broth. Bring to a boil. Turn down the heat to simmer, cover the pot with a lid, and let simmer for about 25 minutes or until everything is cooked.
Remove the pot from the heat and add basil and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper.
Use an immersion blender and blend the soup until it is smooth. Divide between serving plates and enjoy!

name: Date & Chocolate Pudding
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Pitted Dates
3 ozs
Dark Chocolate (plus more for optional garnish)
2/3 cup
Oat Milk
1/4 cup
Raspberries (optional, for garnish)
recipe:
Add the dates, chocolate, and milk to a saucepan. Bring to a boil then reduce the heat down to simmer. Simmer for two to three minutes or just until the chocolate has melted and the dates are soft. Stir well.
Remove the pan from the heat. Let it cool down for about five minutes then transfer the mixture to a food processor. Process until smooth. Pour the mixture into a serving bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and transfer it to the fridge. Chill for at least one hour before serving. Top with raspberries and dark chocolate if using. Enjoy!

name: Harissa Paste
ingredients:
3 ozs
Dried Guajillo Chilis
4 ozs
Roasted Red Peppers
1 tbsp
Tomato Paste
3
Garlic (clove)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1 tsp
Cumin
1 tsp
Coriander
1 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
recipe:
Place the Guajillo chilis in a bowl and cover them with boiling water. Let sit for 30 minutes or until the chilis are tender and rehydrated. Drain and remove the seeds and stems.
Add the rehydrated chilis along with the remaining ingredients to a food processor. Process until smooth and adjust the seasoning to your taste.
Pour into an airtight jar or container. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato Wedges & Mint Gremolata
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (large, cut into wedges)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves (chopped)
1/2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Red Wine Vinegar
1/2 tsp
Capers (minced)
1/4
Lime (juiced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the sweet potato wedges with 1/3 of the oil and salt to taste. Spread the wedges out on the baking sheet and roast for 25 to 30 minutes, flipping the wedges halfway through.
Mix the remaining oil with the remaining ingredients in a bowl to make the mint gremolata. Add salt to taste.
Serve the sweet potatoes with the gremolata. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry & Watermelon Drink
ingredients:
1/4
Seedless Watermelon (medium, diced into cubes)
1 cup
Frozen Strawberries
1 cup
Coconut Water
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves (plus extra for garnish)
recipe: Combine all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Serve into glasses and enjoy!

name: Pistachio & Coconut Date Roll
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Pistachios (shells removed, roughly chopped)
1/3 cup
Almonds (chopped)
2 tbsps
Sesame Seeds
1 tbsp
Butter
1 1/3 cups
Pitted Dates
1/4 cup
Water
2 tbsps
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
recipe:
Add the pistachios, almonds, and sesame seeds to a pan. Toast them over low heat for about 10 minutes and stir occasionally.
Add the butter and dates to the pan and mix everything together. Add the water and simmer for five to seven minutes or until the dates are soft. Stir and use the back of a fork to smash the dates and make a paste. Remove from the heat.
Let the mixture get cool enough to handle. Transfer the date mixture to plastic wrap and roll it into an approximately two-inch thick log. Refrigerate overnight. Unwrap the log and cover in shredded coconut.
Cut into about half-inch thick slices and enjoy!

name: Pomegranate Pineapple Smoothie
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Frozen Pineapple
1/3 cup
Pomegranate Juice
1/2 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Raspberry Thumbprint Cookies
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Almond Flour
1/4 cup
Coconut Oil
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
3 tbsps
Raspberry Jam
recipe:
Preheat oven to 350ºF (175ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, add the almond flour, coconut oil, maple syrup, and salt and stir until well combined. Roll the dough into balls roughly one tablespoon in size and place on the baking sheet. Use a 1/2 teaspoon to press down the center of the cookies. Fill the center with jam. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until golden. Enjoy!

name: Coconut Banana Oat Cookies
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Unsweetened Coconut Flakes
1/2 cup
Oats
2
Banana (roughly chopped)
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a food processor, blend the coconut flakes and oats until they resemble bread crumbs. Add the bananas, cinnamon, and salt and blend again until mostly smooth. It's ok if there are small pieces of banana.
Scoop about two tablespoons of batter per cookie onto the baking sheet. Shape them into round cookies.
Bake for 16 to 18 minutes or until they are golden brown at the bottom. Let them cool for 10 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Crab, Grapefruit & Avocado Salad
ingredients:
1
Grapefruit (large)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped finely)
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1
Avocado (medium, sliced)
8 ozs
Fresh Lump Crab Meat, Cooked
2 cups
Mixed Greens
recipe:
Supreme the grapefruit by using a sharp knife to slice the rind and peel off each fruit. Then cut the segments out from in between the membranes, and set them aside. Squeeze the juice from the grapefruit membranes into a bowl and then discard the membranes. Add the oil and the green onion and whisk until combined. Season with salt.
Divide the avocado and grapefruit segments between plates. Top with the crab meat and greens and top with the grapefruit dressing. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Chip Coconut Cookies
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1 tsp
Baking Powder
3 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
1/4 cup
Coconut Oil (melted)
1/4 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large mixing bowl combine the flour, baking powder, and coconut sugar. Add coconut oil, coconut milk, vanilla, and salt and mix until a dough forms. Add an extra splash of coconut milk if needed. Fold in the chocolate chips. Scoop about two tablespoons of dough per cookie and form into a ball. Place on the baking sheet and slightly flatten, leaving space between cookies.
Bake for eight to nine minutes. Let the cookies cool for five minutes before transferring them to a cooling rack for another five minutes. Enjoy!

name: Blueberry Pineapple Popsicles
ingredients:
1 cup
Frozen Blueberries (wild)
1 cup
Frozen Pineapple
1 cup
Plain Cow's Yogurt, Whole Milk
1/4 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour into popsicle molds and freeze for five to six hours or until completely frozen. Enjoy!

name: Coconut Pesto
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Basil Leaves (packed)
3/4 cup
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
3
Garlic (large cloves, crushed)
1/4 cup
Nutritional Yeast
1/3 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
recipe: Add all ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth and creamy. If needed, add one tablespoon of water at a time and process to your desired consistency. Enjoy!

name: Carrot Cake Smoothie
ingredients:
1
Carrot (medium, chopped)
2/3 cup
Frozen Banana
1/2 cup
Oat Milk
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Banana Cookies
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Coconut Sugar
3 tbsps
Butter (melted, cooled)
1
Banana (ripe, roughly chopped)
1/4 cup
Cocoa Powder
1 oz
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
1 tsp
Baking Powder
1 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
In a large bowl, whisk together the coconut sugar and butter until light and fluffy.
Add the banana, cocoa powder, flour, and baking powder. Mix everything together until well combined. Cover the dough and refrigerate for about one hour.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Scoop about 1 1/2 tablespoons of dough per cookie into the baking sheet and leave space between cookies.
Bake for 12 to 13 minutes. Sprinkle the salt on top right after coming out of the oven. Let the cookies cool down and enjoy!

name: Grilled Plantain & Zucchini with Coconut Pesto
ingredients:
2
Plantain (large, halved and sliced lengthwise)
2
Zucchini (medium, halved and sliced lengthwise)
1/3 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 cup
Basil Leaves (packed)
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
3 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
2
Garlic (large cloves, crushed)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (divided, to taste)
recipe:
