Preheat the grill to medium heat. Brush both sides of the plantains and zucchini with 1/5 of the oil and transfer them to the grill. Cook for approximately 20 minutes, flipping halfway through. Add basil, coconut, nutritional yeast, lemon juice, garlic, half of the salt, and the remaining oil to a food processor. Process until smooth and creamy. If needed, add one tablespoon of water at a time and process to your desired consistency.
Remove the plantain and zucchini from the grill and season with the remaining salt to taste. Divide evenly between plates and top with pesto. Enjoy!

name: Cornmeal Biscuits with Strawberry Jam
ingredients:
2 cups
Strawberries (trimmed, quartered)
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Lemon Juice
1 1/2 cups
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1/2 cup
Cornmeal
2 tsps
Baking Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Butter (cold, grated)
2/3 cup
Buttermilk
recipe:
Add the strawberries and maple syrup to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir until it begins to bubble. Reduce the heat to low and let simmer for 10 to 15 minutes or until the jam begins to thicken. Remove from the heat, add in the lemon juice and let cool down.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix together the flour, cornmeal, baking powder, and salt in a bowl. Add the grated butter and mix everything together with a fork. Add the buttermilk and keep mixing just until the dough forms.
Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface. Roll out the dough gently to half-inch thickness. Use a 2 1/2 inch round cutter and cut the dough into biscuits.
Place the biscuits onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes or until lightly golden brown. Serve with cooled strawberry jam and enjoy!

name: Ginger Orange Iced Tea
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Earl Grey Tea (brewed, cold)
1/4 cup
Orange Juice
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1 tbsp
Honey
1 1/2 tsps
Ginger (fresh, minced)
5
Ice Cubes
1/8
Navel Orange (thinly sliced, for garnish)
recipe:
Add all the ingredients except for ice cubes and orange slice(s) to a cocktail shaker. Shake well for one minute or until everything is mixed together.
Place the orange slice(s) in a glass if using. Add ice and pour the mixture into the glass. Enjoy!

name: Beet Masala Soup
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (diced)
1 tbsp
Ginger (fresh, minced)
1 1/2 tsps
Garam Masala
1 tsp
Curry Powder
4
Beet (medium, peeled, chopped)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1/2 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and ginger and cook until the onion softens, about five minutes.
Add the garam masala, curry powder, beets, and broth, and bring to a boil. Simmer for 25 minutes or until the beets are fork tender. Remove from heat.
Blend the soup with an immersion blender until smooth. Stir in the yogurt and season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Classic Iced Tea
ingredients:
4 cups
Black Tea (brewed)
1/4 cup
Cane Sugar
1/2
Lemon (cut into wedges)
recipe:
Pour the brewed tea into a heatproof pitcher and stir in the sugar until it dissolves. Let it cool before refrigerating.
Chill for 30 to 60 minutes. Pour into glasses with ice and garnish with lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Haddock, Broccoli & Quinoa
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (uncooked)
2
Haddock Fillet
2 cups
Frozen Broccoli
2 tbsps
Coconut Oil
1/2 tsp
Onion Powder
1/2 tsp
Paprika
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 450ºF (230ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cook the quinoa according to package directions.
Place the haddock fillets and broccoli onto the parchment paper. In a small bowl, whisk together the coconut oil, onion powder, paprika, and sea salt. Brush the mixture onto the haddock and broccoli.
Bake the haddock and broccoli for 20 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through. Serve with the quinoa and enjoy!

name: Cornmeal Biscuits
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1/2 cup
Cornmeal
2 tsps
Baking Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Butter (cold, grated)
2/3 cup
Buttermilk
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix together the flour, cornmeal, baking powder, and salt. Add the grated butter and mix everything together with a fork. Add the buttermilk and keep mixing just until the dough forms.
Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface. Roll out the dough gently to half-inch thickness. Use a 2 1/2-inch round cutter to cut the dough into biscuits. Place the biscuits onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes or until lightly golden brown. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Mint Iced Tea
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Strawberries
1 tbsp
Cane Sugar
1 tbsp
Mint Leaves (plus extra for optional garnish)
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
2/3 cup
Earl Grey Tea (brewed, cold)
5
Ice Cubes
recipe:
Muddle the strawberries, sugar, and mint in a glass. Add the lemon juice and stir well.
Top with brewed tea and ice cubes. Garnish with mint leaves if using and enjoy!

name: Collard Green Slaw
ingredients:
3 cups
Collard Greens (stems removed, shredded)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lime (juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Add the collard greens, oil, and lime juice to a large bowl. Massage the collard greens until they become tender and soft. Season with salt and pepper. Divide evenly between plates. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Balsamic Tofu & Broccoli
ingredients:
16 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, and sliced into triangles)
2 tbsps
Tamari (divided)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
4 cups
Broccoli (florets, chopped)
2 cups
Radishes (halved)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/3 cup
Balsamic Vinegar
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Italian Seasoning
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet(s) with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, toss the tofu with half the tamari, and 1/3 of the oil. Place on the baking sheet, spacing out the tofu from one another.
In the same bowl, toss the broccoli and radishes with the remaining oil, salt, and pepper. Transfer to the baking sheet alongside the tofu, leaving enough space between everything. Line another baking sheet if needed. Bake for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Meanwhile, in a bowl or jar, mix together the balsamic vinegar, maple syrup, Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, and remaining tamari.
Remove the baking sheet(s) from the oven and drizzle the balsamic mixture over everything. Place back in the oven for five minutes. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Mixed Legume Salad with Tahini Dressing
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Tahini
3 tbsps
Water (warm)
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Lentils (cooked, rinsed well)
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, drained)
2 tsps
Za'atar Spice
recipe:
In a bowl or jar, combine the tahini, water, lemon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Mix well to combine until smooth.
Add the lentils and chickpeas to a bowl. Season with za'atar.
Divide evenly between bowls and top with the tahini dressing. Season with more salt and pepper if needed. Enjoy!

name: Peach Oatmeal
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Butter
1
Peach (pitted, chopped)
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 cups
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
1 cup
Oats
2 tsps
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
Add the butter, peach, maple syrup, and salt to a saucepan over medium-low heat. Stir to combine.
Cook the peaches for four to five minutes or until they have softened, stirring continuously so they don't stick.
Add the coconut milk and oats. Stir to combine. Lower the heat and cook for five to seven minutes or until the oats thicken, stirring as needed.
Divide evenly between bowls, top with hemp seeds, and enjoy!

name: Matcha Mousse
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
2/3 cup
Pitted Dates (pitted, divided)
2 tbsps
Coconut Oil (divided)
2
Avocado (small, pitted)
2 tsps
Green Tea Powder
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
2 tbsps
Canned Coconut Milk
recipe:
Pulse the shredded coconut, half of the dates, and half the coconut oil in a food processor to make a crust. The crust should hold together when you squeeze it. Divide the crust mixture evenly between small jars and press it into the bottom of the jars firmly. Wipe the food processor clean.
Add the avocado, green tea powder, maple syrup, coconut milk, the remaining oil, and the remaining dates to a clean food processor and blend until smooth. Divide the mixture between the jars. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving. Enjoy!

name: Tomato, Mango, & Basil Salad
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Balsamic Vinegar
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1 1/2
Mango (large, peeled, diced, and divided)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
3 cups
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1
Avocado (large, peeled and diced)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (finely diced)
1/2 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped and tightly packed)
recipe:
Combine the balsamic vinegar, oil, honey, 1/4 of the mango, and salt in a blender and blend until smooth.
Combine the tomatoes, avocado, red onion, basil, and remaining mango together in a large bowl. Toss with the dressing until well coated. Serve and enjoy!

name: Garlicky Green Beans
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
4 cups
Green Beans (trimmed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the beans, salt, and pepper and sauté for three to five minutes.
Add the garlic and sauté for another one to three minutes until the beans are tender-crisp or cooked to your liking. Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Chickpea, Couscous & Spinach Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Couscous (uncooked)
2 cups
Baby Spinach
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2
Orange Bell Pepper (medium, seeds removed, diced)
2 tbsps
Slivered Almonds
2 tbsps
Cilantro Lime Dressing
recipe:
Cook the couscous according to the package directions and let cool.
Mix all the ingredients together except for the dressing.
Divide all of the ingredients evenly between bowls. Top with the dressing and enjoy!

name: Balsamic & Honey Roasted Carrots
ingredients:
3
Carrot (large, peeled and cut on the bias)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 3/4 tbsps
Balsamic Vinegar
1 tsp
Honey

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking dish with parchment paper.
In a bowl toss the carrots with the oil, balsamic and honey. Add sea salt and pepper to taste. Spread the carrots out in the baking dish and roast for 25 to 30 minutes.
Divide the carrots evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Crispy Baked Okra
ingredients:
1/2 cup
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1/4 cup
Cornmeal
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2/3 cup
Buttermilk
2 cups
Okra (trimmed, chopped)
1 1/16 ozs
Avocado Oil Spray
1/8
Lemon (cut into wedges)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix the flour, cornmeal, paprika, salt, and pepper in one bowl. Add the buttermilk to another bowl.
Dip the okra first in buttermilk, then transfer to cornmeal mixture, coating all sides. Transfer on to the prepared baking sheet and spray with oil.
Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Squeeze lemon on top and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Sweet Potato Hashbrowns
ingredients:
1/2
Sweet Potato (large, cubed)
2 tsps
Avocado Oil
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat your air fryer to 400°F (205°C). Toss the sweet potato with the oil until well coated. Add to the air fryer and cook for 12 to 15 minutes, or until desired crispiness, tossing halfway through.
Top with salt. Serve and enjoy!

name: Roasted Sweet Potato & Peaches with Rosemary
ingredients:
1/2
Sweet Potato (large, cubed)
1
Peach (large, pitted, chopped)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (diced)
1 1/2 tbsps
Rosemary (chopped)
1 1/2 tsps
Avocado Oil
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Balsamic Vinegar (optional)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Add the sweet potatoes, peaches, onion, and rosemary to the baking sheet. Toss with the oil to coat. Add salt and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove from the oven and top with balsamic vinegar. Enjoy!

name: Maple Roasted Parsnips
ingredients:
4
Parsnip (large, peeled, cubed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the parsnips to the baking sheet and toss with the oil, maple syrup, and salt. Spread into an even layer. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until they are browned on the outside and fork tender.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Pecan Chocolate Chip Energy Balls
ingredients:
1 cup
Oats
1 cup
Pecans
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
1/2 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1/2 cup
Almond Butter (smooth, runny)
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
1/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Add the oats, pecans, and hemp seeds to a food processor. Blend until the mixture resembles bread crumbs. Add the protein powder and blend until combined.
Add the almond butter, maple syrup, and coconut milk, and mix until a slightly sticky dough forms. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Roll the dough into approximately two-inch balls. You can eat them as is or refrigerate them for 15 minutes to firm up. Enjoy!

name: Mackerel & Baby Spinach Balsamic Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
Baby Spinach
1 tbsp
Red Onion (sliced)
2 tbsps
Pecans
1 tbsp
Goat Cheese
4 ozs
Canned Mackerel
2 tsps
Balsamic Vinaigrette
recipe:
In a bowl, toss together the baby spinach, onion, pecans, and goat cheese. Gently flake the mackerel on top.
Top with balsamic vinaigrette and enjoy!

name: Tomato, Cucumber & Olive Grain Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Farro (uncooked, rinsed)
1 can
Tuna (drained, flaked with a fork)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4
Cucumber (chopped)
3/4 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/4 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives
1/4 cup
Parsley (finely chopped)
recipe:
Cook the farro according to package directions and set aside to let cool slightly.
In a large bowl combine the cooled farro and tuna. Add half of the oil and half of the lemon juice and season with salt and pepper. Divide the farro and tuna mixture evenly between bowls. Top with cucumbers, tomatoes, and olives. Add the remaining oil and lemon juice to each bowl. Top with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Cauliflower with Parmesan
ingredients:
1 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (218ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, toss the cauliflower with the oil, cheese, salt, and pepper.
Transfer to the baking sheet, making sure to space them out. Bake for 15 minutes, remove, flip and bake for ten minutes more.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Tempeh, Brown Rice & Tzatziki Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Rice (uncooked)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
6 ozs
Tempeh (sliced)
1 tbsp
Balsamic Vinaigrette
1/4 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/8
Cucumber (medium, quarted and sliced)
2 tbsps
Pitted Kalamata Olives
2 tbsps
Tzatziki
recipe:
Cook the rice according to package instructions.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the tempeh and cook until golden, about four minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Divide the rice evenly between bowls. Top with balsamic vinaigrette. Evenly divide the tempeh, tomatoes, cucumber, olives, and tzatziki on top of the rice. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Spiced Carrots
ingredients:
5
Heirloom Carrots (medium, sliced into rounds)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1/2 tsp
Cumin

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 400ºF (205ºC).
In a large bowl combine the carrots, oil, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper. Toss well to coat.
Transfer the carrots to the basket of the air fryer. Arrange in an even layer and bake for ten minutes. Remove, shake the basket and bake for six to eight minutes longer, until cooked through.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Parmesan Snap Peas
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 cups
Snap Peas
2 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sauté the snap peas for four to five minutes or until nicely charred.
Transfer to a serving plate. Top with parmesan cheese and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Squash
ingredients:
2 cups
Butternut Squash (peeled, seeds removed, cubed)
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 390ºF (200ºC).
In a large bowl combine the squash, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Toss well to coat.
Add the squash to the basket of the air fryer in an even layer and spray with oil. Bake for ten minutes. Remove, shake the basket and bake for eight to ten minutes longer, until cooked through.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Mackerel & Cucumber Rice Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Rice (dry)
1/4 cup
Coconut Aminos
1 tsp
Ginger (fresh, minced)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
8 ozs
Canned Mackerel
1
Avocado (sliced)
1/2
Cucumber (sliced)
2 tsps
Sesame Seeds
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Make the dressing by mixing together the coconut aminos, ginger, and oil.
Divide the rice evenly between bowls and top with the mackerel, avocado, cucumber, and sesame seeds. Top with the dressing and enjoy!

name: Olive Hummus
ingredients:
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/3 cup
Green Olives (pitted, plus extra for optional garnish)
2 tbsps
Tahini
2 tbsps
Water
1
Garlic (clove)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (plus extra for optional garnish)
1 tsp
Lemon Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Add all ingredients together in a food processor. Blend until a creamy consistency forms.
Top with extra olives and olive oil if using. Enjoy!

name: Sauteed Lentils with Hummus
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Red Bell Pepper (medium, cut into sticks)
2
Garlic (cloves, chopped finely)
2 tsps
Ground Sumac
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1 cup
Green Lentils (cooked, drained)
1 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
1 cup
Hummus
recipe:
Heat a skillet over medium heat and add the oil. Add the peppers and cook for two to four minutes or until softened.
Add the garlic, sumac, and salt and continue cooking for one minute, stirring frequently.
Stir in the cooked lentils and continue to cook for one more minute. Turn off the heat and stir in the cilantro.
To serve, divide the hummus evenly between plates and top with the lentil mixture. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean, Tofu & Cilantro Lime Salad
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Millet (dry)
16 ozs
Tofu (firm)
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
1/4 cup
Water
2 tsps
Taco Seasoning
4 cups
Mixed Greens
2 cups
Microgreens
1/2 cup
Black Beans (cooked and rinsed)
1/4 cup
Cilantro Lime Dressing
recipe:
Cook the millet according to package instructions. Set aside.
Press the tofu with paper towels to remove excess moisture.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the tofu, breaking it up as it cooks, stirring frequently, for four to six minutes or until golden. Add the water and the taco seasoning and continue cooking for two minutes. Set aside to cool.
Divide the greens, microgreens, beans, cooked millet, and tofu evenly between bowls and top with the dressing. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Honey Mustard Cabbage Wedges
ingredients:
6 cups
Green Cabbage (sliced thick)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Honey Mustard

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the cabbage slices on the baking sheet.
In a small bowl, mix together the oil, honey mustard, salt, and pepper.
Using a brush or your hands, coat the cabbage slices in the honey mustard mixture. Add to both sides making sure they are well coated.
Bake in the oven for 35 to 40 minutes, rotating the pan halfway through until browned around the edges and crispy. Serve and enjoy!

name: Halibut & Couscous Bowl
ingredients:
1 cup
Israeli Couscous (dry)
10 ozs
Halibut Fillet
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1
Lemon (juiced, divided)
2 tbsps
Greek Seasoning
1/3 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)
1/4
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
recipe:
Cook the couscous according to the package directions.
In a bowl, combine the fish, half of the oil, half of the lemon juice, and Greek seasoning. Ensure the fish is well coated.
Heat the remaining oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Once hot, place the halibut in the pan and cook for three to five minutes per side (depending on the thickness).
Add the remaining lemon juice, feta cheese, and dill to the cooked couscous. Mix to combine.
Divide the couscous, halibut, and cucumbers evenly between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Peach Salsa
ingredients:
1
Peach (large, finely chopped)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (finely diced)
1/2
Jalapeno Pepper (finely chopped)
3 tbsps
Cilantro (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Serve, and enjoy!

name: Coconut Crusted Haddock
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Garlic (clove, small, minced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Haddock Fillet
1 tbsp
Parsley (finely chopped)
1/4
Lemon (juiced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine the shredded coconut with the oil and garlic. Season with salt and pepper.
Place the haddock on the baking sheet and scoop the coconut mixture on top of the haddock, gently packing it down. Bake the haddock for 10 minutes.
Add parsley and lemon juice on top of the hadock. Serve and enjoy!

name: Spicy Tempeh Caesar Salad
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Hot Sauce
8 3/4 ozs
Tempeh (sliced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 heads
Romaine Hearts (chopped)
1/4 cup
Vegan Caesar Dressing
3 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
In a shallow bowl, combine the hot sauce and tempeh and gently toss well to coat each piece.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the tempeh. Cook for four to five minutes per side or until golden. Once cooked, cut each piece into approximately one inch cubes.
In a large bowl, combine the romaine hearts, caesar dressing, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper. Divide the salad evenly between bowls and top each with tempeh. Enjoy!

name: Harissa Chickpea Couscous Salad
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Couscous (uncooked)
1/2 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 1/2 tsps
Harissa
2/3 cup
Arugula
2 tbsps
Hummus
1 1/2 tbsps
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
1 1/2 tbsps
Cilantro Lime Dressing
recipe:
Cook the couscous according to the package directions and let cool.
Meanwhile, heat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
In bowl combine together the chickpeas and harissa. Place chickpeas on the baking sheet and bake in the oven for 15 minutes.
Arrange the couscous, arugula, chickpeas, hummus, and red onion in your serving bowl. Top with dressing and enjoy!

name: Tempeh & Guacamole Wrap
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
8 3/4 ozs
Tempeh (sliced)
3
Whole Wheat Tortilla (small)
3 tbsps
Guacamole
1 1/2 cups
Mixed Greens
1
Red Bell Pepper (medium, sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the tempeh. Cook for four to five minutes per side or until golden.
To assemble, place the tortillas on plates and top evenly with guacamole, mixed greens, peppers, and tempeh. Season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: One Pan Halibut, Green Beans & Tomatoes
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Shallot (thinly sliced)
1 cup
Frozen Green Beans (thawed)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes
1/2 cup
White Cooking Wine
1/2 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives (chopped)
5 1/3 ozs
Halibut Fillet

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat oven to 350ºF (175ºC).
Heat the oil in an oven-safe pan over medium-high heat. Add in the shallots and cook until translucent, about two to three minutes.
Add the green beans and tomatoes, and cook for five minutes. Deglaze the pan with the white wine and cook for two to three minutes, until it begins to thicken. Stir in the olives.
Make a well in the center of the pan and add the halibut fillet and season with salt and pepper. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through. Serve and enjoy!

name: Honey & Balsamic Roasted Beets
ingredients:
4
Beet (medium, cubed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinegar
1 tbsp
Honey

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the beets in the oil and bake for 35 minutes, or until the beets are slightly tender but not cooked through.
Toss the partially roasted beets in the balsamic vinegar and honey, and cook in the oven for an additional 15 minutes, or until the beets are fork tender. Season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Peanut Sauce
ingredients:
1/2 cup
All Natural Peanut Butter (smooth)
1/4 cup
Apple Cider Vinegar
3 tbsps
Coconut Aminos
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
2 tsps
Raw Honey
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Water
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a bowl or a liquid measuring cup and whisk until well combined and smooth. Add more water if needed to thin it out. Transfer to a sealable jar. Enjoy!

name: Sardine & Cherry Tomato Pasta
ingredients:
1 cup
Brown Rice Spaghetti
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Shallot (thinly sliced)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes
6 ozs
Sardines (in oil, drained)
1/4 cup
Lemon Juice
1/2 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated, plus more for garnish)
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Reserve pasta water and drain.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the shallots and tomatoes, and cook until the shallots are translucent, about three to five minutes.
Add the sardines to the pan, and cook until warmed through, about two minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice. Add the pasta and parmesan to the pan, and toss to combine. Add some of the reserved pasta water, a little at a time, to reach the desired consistency. Serve into bowls, garnish with extra parmesan and enjoy!

name: Pan Fried Haddock with Sun Dried Tomatoes & Capers
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (small, peeled, cubed)
1/2 head
Cauliflower (cut into florets)
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper
2
Haddock Fillet
1/4 cup
Sun Dried Tomatoes (drained, chopped)
2 tbsps
Capers (drained, chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Lined a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, toss together the sweet potato, cauliflower and 2/3 of the oil. Season with salt and pepper. Roast for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are browned.
Meanwhile, pan fry the haddock fillets with the remaining oil in a large pan over medium heat. Cook the haddock for about two to three minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Mix the sun dried tomatoes and capers together in a small bowl.
Divide the roasted vegetables evenly between bowls. Place the haddock fillets on top. Top with the sun dried tomato and caper mixture. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Tofu & Cauliflower Soup
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Leeks (small, trimmed, sliced)
1 head
Cauliflower (medium, roughly chopped)
1 1/2 tbsps
Cajun Seasoning
4 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
7 1/16 ozs
Tofu (soft, cut into chunks)
2 cups
Lima Beans (cooked)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the leeks and the cauliflower and cook, stirring, for five to eight minutes or until softened.
Stir in the seasoning and the broth, then add the tofu and lima beans. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer on low until it thickens for about 10 minutes.
Remove from heat. Add the cilantro and blend the soup with an immersion blender until smooth. Serve and enjoy!

name: Pesto Potatoes
ingredients:
4
Red Potato (medium, cubed)
1/4 cup
Pesto
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Toss the potatoes with the pesto until well coated and add them to the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until crispy and tender. Serve and enjoy!

name: Spicy Tempeh Caesar Wrap
ingredients:
1 head
Romaine Hearts (shredded)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
2 tbsps
Vegan Caesar Dressing
1/3 cup
Hot Sauce
8 3/4 ozs
Tempeh (sliced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3
Whole Wheat Tortilla (small)
recipe:
In a bowl, combine the romaine hearts, onion, and dressing. Set aside.
In a shallow bowl, combine the hot sauce and tempeh and gently toss well to coat each piece.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the tempeh. Cook for four to five minutes per side or until golden.
To assemble, place the tortillas on plates and top evenly with the salad mix and tempeh. Wrap and enjoy!

name: One Pan Smoky & Sweet Roasted Broccoli
ingredients:
2 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Chili Flakes
2 tsps
Honey
1/4 tsp
Liquid Smoke

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add all of the ingredients to a large bowl and toss to combine. Spread the broccoli out on the baking sheet and roast for 15 minutes, or until lightly charred. Serve and enjoy!

name: Sardine Spaghetti
ingredients:
4 1/2 ozs
Whole Wheat Spaghetti
5 2/3 ozs
Sardines (packed in oil, drained, chopped)
1/4 cup
Sun Dried Tomatoes (chopped)
1
Lemon (small, juice and zest)
1/4 cup
Black Olives (pitted, sliced)
1/4 cup
Parsley (finely chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the spaghetti according to package directions, reserving roughly one cup of cooking water.
In a bowl, combine the sardines, sun dried tomatoes, lemon zest, juice, olives, and parsley.
Toss the hot pasta with the sardine mixture. Add some of the reserved pasta water, a little at a time, as necessary. Toss to coat and season with salt and pepper to taste. Enjoy!

name: Vegan TVP Tacos
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Textured Vegetable Protein (crumbs)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Taco Seasoning
3 tbsps
Guacamole
4
Corn Tortilla
2/3 cup
Green Cabbage (finely sliced)
2 tbsps
Cilantro
2 tbsps
Cilantro Lime Dressing
recipe:
Rehydrate the textured vegetable protein by placing it in a bowl and covering it with boiling water. Cover the bowl and let sit for 10 minutes.
In a pan over medium heat add the oil. Add the textured vegetable protein and taco seasoning and cook for 12 to 15 minutes.
Spread the guacamole over the tortillas. Top with texture vegetable protein, cabbage, and cilantro. Top with the dressing and enjoy!

name: Roasted Beets & Feta
ingredients:
4
Beet (medium, cubed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the beets in the oil, salt, and pepper, and bake for 45 minutes, or until the beets are fork tender.
Garnish with feta cheese. Serve and enjoy!

name: White Pasta Sauce
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Arrowroot Powder
2 cups
Cow's Milk, Whole (plus more as needed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (optional)
recipe: Add the arrowroot powder to a saucepan with the heat turned off. Slowly add the milk, whisking continuously. Turn the heat to high and bring it to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, whisking constantly, for about five minutes or until thickened. Season with salt and pepper, if desired. Add more milk if needed to reach the desired consistency. Enjoy over your favorite pasta.

name: Rosemary & Garlic Mushrooms
ingredients:
14
Cremini Mushrooms
2 tbsps
Butter (melted)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Rosemary (fresh, chopped)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
In a large bowl, toss together the mushrooms, butter, garlic, rosemary, and salt. Arrange on the baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Moroccan Carrot, Chickpea & Halloumi Salad
ingredients:
5 ozs
Halloumi (sliced)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, drained)
2
Carrot (small, julienned)
1/3 cup
Raisins
2 tsps
Cumin
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Cook the halloumi slices until golden brown, about one to two minutes per side.
Mix the rest of the ingredients together. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide the salad and halloumi between bowls and enjoy!

name: Italian Dressing
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Red Wine Vinegar
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Dijon Mustard
1 tsp
Raw Honey
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
2 tbsps
Italian Seasoning
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a bowl or a liquid measuring cup and whisk until well combined and smooth. Transfer to a sealable jar. Enjoy!

name: Mashed Turnip
ingredients:
4
Turnip (medium, peeled, diced)
2 tbsps
Butter
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Add the turnips to a pot and cover them with water. Bring them to a boil. Cook for eight to 10 minutes or until fork tender, and drain.
Add the butter and garlic powder to the turnips. Mash thoroughly to combine. Season with salt and pepper, and enjoy!

name: Halloumi Mushroom Tacos with Pineapple Salsa
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
6
Cremini Mushrooms (sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
5 ozs
Halloumi (sliced)
1/2 cup
Pineapple (chopped)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
4
Corn Tortilla
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms and cook for three to five minutes or until golden brown. Season with salt and pepper. Remove and set them aside.
In the same pan, cook the halloumi slices until golden brown, about one to two minutes per side.
In a small bowl, mix together the pineapple, cilantro, and lime juice.
Divide the mushrooms and halloumi between the tortillas. Top with pineapple salsa, season with additional salt and pepper if needed, and enjoy!

name: Pesto Asparagus
ingredients:
2 cups
Asparagus (ends trimmed)
1/4 cup
Pesto
2 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the asparagus with the pesto and evenly spread the spears out onto the baking sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until the asparagus is fork tender.
Top with grated parmesan, and enjoy!

name: Mashed Celery Root
ingredients:
2 1/2 cups
Celery Root (peeled, cubed)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Boil the celery root in a large pot of water for 15 minutes or until tender.
Mash the celery root. Add the oil, salt, and pepper to taste. Garnish with the parsley and enjoy!

name: Lentil & Halloumi Salad
ingredients:
5 ozs
Halloumi (sliced)
1 cup
Lentils (cooked, rinsed well)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1 cup
Arugula
3 tbsps
Cilantro Lime Dressing
recipe:
Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the halloumi slices until golden brown, about one to two minutes per side.
Mix together the lentils, tomatoes, and arugula together in a bowl.
Divide the salad and halloumi evenly between plates. Top with the dressing and enjoy!

name: Spicy Persian Tamarind & Cilantro Mackerel
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/3
Yellow Onion (medium, finely chopped)
4
Garlic (clove, finely chopped)
1/3 cup
Cilantro (finely chopped, plus extra for optional garnish)
1/4 cup
Tamarind Paste
2/3 cup
Water (boiled)
2 tsps
Chili Flakes
12 2/3 ozs
King Mackerel Steak

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for five to six minutes or until soft and translucent. Add the garlic and cilantro, and cook for another 10 minutes. Stir occasionally.
In a small bowl mix together the tamarind paste and water. Add the mixture to the pan along with chili flakes. Cover the pan with a lid, turn the heat down to simmer, and let simmer for about 20 minutes.
Season the fish with salt and pepper. Add the fish to the pan, cover with a lid again and simmer for another 30 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Adjust the seasoning to your taste. Garnish with cilantro if desired and enjoy!

name: Cauliflower & Mushroom Casserole
ingredients:
1/2 head
Cauliflower (cut into florets)
1 tsp
Butter
6
Cremini Mushrooms (sliced)
1 1/2 tbsps
Arrowroot Powder
1 1/2 cups
Cow's Milk, Whole

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Bread Crumbs
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Add the cauliflower to a pot of salted boiling water. Boil for five to seven minutes or until cooked half way. Drain and set aside.
Melt the butter in a pan. Add the mushrooms and sauté over high heat for five to six minutes or until golden brown.
In a medium bowl, add the arrowroot powder. Slowly add the milk, whisking continuously. Pour the mixture over the mushrooms. Whisk and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, whisking constantly, for about five minutes or until thickened.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper. Add the cauliflower to an oven-safe dish. Pour the sauce into the dish and top with bread crumbs.
Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Top with parsley and enjoy!

name: White Bean & Tomatillo Soup
ingredients:
1 lb
Tomatillo (brown shells removed, halved lengthwise)
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
3 1/4 cups
Vegetable Broth
3
Garlic (cloves, minced)
3/4 cup
Red Onion (diced)
2 1/2 cups
Cannellini Beans (drained & rinsed)
1/4 tsp
Red Pepper Flakes (optional)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Turn the oven to broil. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat.
Add the tomatillo halves to the baking sheet, skin side facing up. Drizzle with the lime juice and transfer to the oven. Broil for 12 minutes, but watch closely as oven temperatures vary. They are done when the skin is blistered and the tomatillos are soft.
Heat a pot over medium heat and add a splash of the broth. Add the garlic and stir for a minute, then add the onion and continue to stir for a couple of minutes.
Add the broiled tomatillos to the pot, then add the cannellini beans and stir for one minute. Add the remaining broth, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and allow to simmer for five minutes.
Turn off the heat and let the soup cool for five minutes. Blend with an immersion blender, or carefully transfer to a blender and blend for one minute or until a smooth and creamy texture is achieved. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Strawberry Orange Smoothie
ingredients:
1
Navel Orange (peeled and sectioned)
1/2 cup
Frozen Strawberries
1 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Enjoy!

name: White Bean, Sweet Potato & Kale Soup
ingredients:
5 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium (divided)
1/2
White Onion (large, chopped)
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
2 tsps
Herbes De Provence
2
Sweet Potato (large, cut into cubes)
1 3/4 cups
Cannellini Beans (drained, rinsed)
4 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat a large pot over medium heat and add a splash of vegetable broth. Once hot add the onion and sauté for about five minutes, until softened. Add the garlic and herbes de provence and cook for one minute, until fragrant.
Add the sweet potato, beans, and remaining vegetable broth and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for about 15 minutes, until the potato is softened. Add the kale and cook for an additional five minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Divide evenly between bowls, and enjoy!

name: Cranberry Orange Mint Tea
ingredients:
3 cups
Water
1 1/2 cups
Frozen Cranberries
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves
1 tbsp
Monk Fruit Sweetener
1 cup
Orange Juice
recipe:
Add water, cranberries, and mint to a pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Remove from the heat. Let it steep covered for about 20 minutes.
Strain the cranberry mixture through a fine sieve. Return to the pot. Stir in the sweetener and orange juice, and heat through. Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Spinach, Cauliflower & White Bean Soup
ingredients:
6 cups
Vegetable Broth
1
White Onion (small, chopped)
4
Garlic (clove, finely chopped)
1 head
Cauliflower (small, roughly chopped)
2 cups
White Navy Beans (cooked)
6 cups
Baby Spinach

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2
Lemon (small, juice and zest)
recipe:
In a large saucepan, add the broth, onion, garlic, and cauliflower. Cook on medium-high for five to eight minutes or until the cauliflower is tender.
Add the beans and the spinach. Season with salt and pepper, stirring until combined. Continue cooking for two minutes, or until the spinach is slightly wilted. Remove from heat.
Use an immersion blender or carefully transfer to a blender. Puree the soup until it is smooth.
Stir in the lemon zest and juice. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Apple Pecan Millet Porridge
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Millet (dry)
3/4 cup
Water
3/4 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (divided)
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon
1/2
Apple (chopped)
2 tbsps
Pecans
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
recipe:
Combine the millet, water, 3/4 of the coconut milk, vanilla, and cinnamon in a pot on the stove. Mix well, then bring it to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and cover the pot with a lid. Cook for 20 minutes.
Remove the porridge from the stove. Add it to a bowl and top with the remaining coconut milk, chopped apple, pecans, and maple syrup. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Cranberry Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
1/2 cup
Frozen Strawberries
1/2 cup
Frozen Cranberries
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Enjoy!

name: Cranberry Sage Sausage Patties & Brussels Sprouts
ingredients:
4 cups
Brussels Sprouts (trimmed and halved)
1
Pear (large, chopped)
1/4 cup
Walnuts
1 1/3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
1 lb
Extra Lean Ground Turkey
1/3 cup
Dried Unsweetened Cranberries
2 tbsps
Fresh Sage (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the Brussels sprouts, pear, and walnuts to the baking sheet. Toss with half of the oil and half of the salt. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes or until cooked through.
While the Brussels sprouts are baking, combine the ground turkey, cranberries, sage, and remaining salt in a bowl. Mix everything together with your hands and form four even-sized patties.
Heat the remaining oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the patties and cook for seven to eight minutes per side, or until cooked through. Serve the patties with the Brussels sprouts mixture and enjoy!

name: Lentil, Onion & Parsley Salad
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Red Wine Vinegar
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Dijon Mustard

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
2 1/2 cups
Water
1/3 cup
Red Onion (finely chopped)
1/4 cup
Parsley (fresh, finely chopped)
recipe:
In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar, maple syrup, dijon mustard, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
In a pot, add the lentils and water. Bring to a boil then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the lentils for 20 to 25 minutes or until they are tender. Add more water if needed.
Once the lentils are cooked, drain any excess water then run them under cold water. Drain again then place them in a large bowl.
Add the onion, parsley, and dressing. Toss to combine and season with additional salt and pepper if needed. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Smoky Tofu & Corn Chowder
ingredients:
2 ears
Corn On The Cob
2
Red Potato (medium, chopped)
8 ozs
Tofu (medium, chopped)
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
3
Garlic (cloves, large, with skin on)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth
1 tsp
Liquid Smoke

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Chives (chopped, flowers optional)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the corn, potatoes, tofu, onion, and unpeeled garlic cloves to a baking sheet. Sprinkle some water (or broth) over everything and season with salt and pepper to taste. Bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the kernels of corn from the cob by slicing vertically down the cob. Remove the skin from the garlic cloves.
Heat a large pot over medium heat and add the baked ingredients to the pot. Add the broth and liquid smoke and stir. Bring everything to a boil then turn off the heat and allow it to cool for a couple of minutes.
Blend with an immersion blender, or carefully transfer the soup to a blender and blend until smooth. Season with additional salt and pepper if desired. Divide into bowls, top with chives, and enjoy!

name: Roasted Red Pepper & Tomato Pasta
ingredients:
1
Red Bell Pepper (large, chopped)
3
Tomato (medium, whole)
3
Garlic (cloves, large, left in the skin)
1 tbsp
Water

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
6 ozs
Chickpea Pasta
1/2 tsp
Red Pepper Flakes
1/4 cup
Parsley
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Prepare a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper (optional).
Add the red pepper, tomatoes, and garlic cloves to a baking sheet. Add water and season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes.
Cook the pasta according to package directions.
Once the vegetables have finished baking, remove the garlic cloves from their skins and transfer everything to a blender. Add red pepper flakes and blend until smooth and creamy. Combine the pasta with the sauce and mix until well coated. Top with parsley, serve, and enjoy!

name: Maple Sage Roasted Beets & Squash
ingredients:
1/2
Acorn Squash (medium, cubed)
4
Beet (medium, cubed)
3/4 cup
Pecans
2 tbsps
Fresh Sage (chopped)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine the squash, beets, pecans, and sage onto the baking sheet. Toss the ingredients with oil and maple syrup to coat. Season with salt. Bake in the oven for 40 minutes or until fork-tender. Enjoy!

name: Quinoa Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients:
8 ozs
Portobello Mushroom Caps

Sea Salt & Black Pepper
1 tsp
Paprika
1/3 cup
Quinoa (uncooked)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (diced)
1/3 cup
Artichoke Hearts (from the can, drained, chopped)
1 tbsp
Parsley (finely chopped)
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the mushroom caps on the baking sheet. Season with salt, pepper and paprika. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes or until cooked and soft.
Meanwhile, cook the quinoa according to the package directions.
Mix the quinoa with onion, artichoke, parsley, and lime juice. Top the mushroom caps with the quinoa mixture. Season with additional salt and pepper if needed. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Pear & Walnuts
ingredients:
4 cups
Brussels Sprouts (trimmed and halved)
1
Pear (large, chopped)
1/4 cup
Walnuts
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the Brussels sprouts, pear, and walnuts to the baking sheet. Toss with oil and season with salt. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes or until cooked through. Enjoy!

name: Mushroom & Chickpea Polenta
ingredients:
6 cups
Mushrooms (coarsely chopped)
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, drained and patted dry)
6
Garlic (clove, chopped finely)
1/4 oz
Thyme Sprigs (whole)
1/2 cup
Water

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided, plus extra if needed)
1 cup
Cornmeal
4 cups
Baby Kale
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC). Place the rack in the middle of the oven.
On a rimmed baking sheet, combine the mushrooms, chickpeas, garlic, thyme, and water. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring halfway through. Meanwhile, in a heavy-bottomed saucepan, bring the broth to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium and add the cornmeal, stirring constantly for two minutes, until thickened.
Stir in the kale until it becomes wilted, about two minutes. If the polenta thickens too much, thin with additional broth or water.
Divide the polenta evenly between plates. Top with the mushrooms and chickpeas and enjoy!

name: Cranberry Sage Sausage Patties
ingredients:
1 lb
Extra Lean Ground Turkey
1/3 cup
Dried Unsweetened Cranberries
2 tbsps
Fresh Sage (chopped)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
recipe:
Combine the ground turkey, cranberries, sage, and salt in a bowl. Mix everything together with your hands and form four even-sized patties.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the patties and cook for seven to eight minutes per side, or until cooked through. Enjoy!

name: Squash, Black Bean & Couscous Bowl
ingredients:
2 tsps
Honey
3 tbsps
Water (divided)
2 cups
Butternut Squash (peeled, seeds removed, cubed)
1/2 cup
Couscous (uncooked)
2 tbsps
Tahini
1 tsp
Lime Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Black Beans (cooked)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix together the honey and 1/3 of the water. Add the butternut squash and mix well. Place the mixture on the prepared baking sheet and roast in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until cooked and golden brown.
Meanwhile, cook the couscous according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together the tahini, lime juice, and remaining water. Season the sauce with salt and pepper.
Divide the couscous, butternut squash, and black beans evenly between bowls. Top with the tahini sauce and enjoy!

name: Maple Cinnamon Chickpea Snack Box
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, rinsed)
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1 cup
Strawberries
1 cup
Blackberries
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the chickpeas onto the baking sheet and pat them dry. Bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the chickpeas from the oven and carefully transfer them to a mixing bowl. Add the maple syrup, cinnamon, and sea salt and toss to combine. Spread the chickpeas back onto the baking sheet and and bake for an additional 10 to 15 minutes or until golden.
Arrange the roasted chickpeas, strawberries, and blackberries into containers. Enjoy!

name: Cranberry Pineapple Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Frozen Pineapple
1/2 cup
Oat Milk
1/2 cup
Frozen Cranberries
1 tbsp
Pitted Dates
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and enjoy!

name: Baked Sole Tapenade with Broccoli & Beans
ingredients:
12 ozs
Sole Fillet
1/4 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives (chopped)
1 tbsp
Capers (chopped)
1 tbsp
Parsley (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 tsp
Chili Flakes
2 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
2 cups
Green Beans (trimmed)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (180ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
Arrange the sole fillets onto the baking sheet and bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until the fish is opaque.
Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the olives, capers, parsley, oil and chili flakes. Set aside.
Place the broccoli and the green beans in a steamer basket over boiling water and cover. Steam for three to five minutes.
Divide the fish and vegetables evenly between plates. Top with the olive mixture and enjoy!

name: Rutabaga & Carrot Mash
ingredients:
4 cups
Rutabaga (cubed)
4
Carrot (medium, chopped)
1/4 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
3 tbsps
Fresh Dill (optional)
recipe:
Bring a pot of shallow water to a boil. Add the rutabaga and carrots to a steaming basket over the boiling water. Cover with a lid. Steam for 15 minutes or until fork-tender.
Add the rutabaga and carrots to a bowl. Add the coconut milk and salt and mash with a potato masher. For a smoother consistency, add to a blender and blend until desired texture.
Garnish with dill, serve, and enjoy!

name: Squash & Black Bean Enchiladas
ingredients:
3 cups
Butternut Squash (peeled, seeds removed, cubed)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1 3/4 cups
Black Beans (cooked, rinsed)
1 1/3 cups
Enchilada Sauce (divided)
4
Whole Wheat Tortilla (large)
4 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Add the butternut squash to the baking sheet and toss with oil, salt, pepper, and smoked paprika. Roast for 20 to 25 minutes or until browned and fork-tender.
Add the cooked squash to a large bowl along with the black beans. Toss to combine.
Pour 1/3 of the enchilada sauce on the bottom of the baking dish.
Place a tortilla on a flat surface and scoop out the squash and bean mixture into the tortilla in a line down the center. Roll tightly and transfer to the prepared baking dish, seam side down. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and filling.
Pour the remaining enchilada sauce on top of the tortillas. Top with cheese. Place in the oven and bake for 15 minutes, covered. Remove the cover and bake for an additional five minutes. Let cool slightly before serving. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Pomegranate & Tahini Dressing
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Brussels Sprouts (trimmed and halved)
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
2 tsps
Tahini
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
2 tbsps
Water
1 tbsp
Parsley (minced)
1/4 cup
Pomegranate Seeds
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the Brussels sprouts with 2/3 of the oil and half of the salt. Spread them out on the baking sheet and roast for 15 to 20 minutes, flipping them halfway through until crispy and browned.
Make the dressing by mixing the tahini, lemon juice, water, and remaining salt together. Drizzle it over the Brussels sprouts and garnish with the parsley and pomegranate seeds. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Salsa
ingredients:
2
Tomato (medium, diced)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (diced)
1/2
Jalapeno Pepper (seeds removed, finely chopped)
1 1/2 tbsps
Lime Juice
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Serve, and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Orange Ginger Truffles
ingredients:
1 cup
Pitted Dates
1/2 cup
Candied Ginger
2 tbsps
Coconut Oil
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
1 tsp
Orange Extract
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Cacao Powder (divided)
1/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Add the dates, ginger, coconut oil, shredded coconut, orange extract, salt, and 1/4 of the cacao powder to the bowl of a food processor. Process until a smooth consistency is achieved.
Fold in the chocolate chips and roll the batter into 1 1/2-inch balls. Add the remaining cacao powder to a small bowl. Roll each ball in it until well coated.
Transfer the balls to a plate or container and refrigerate for two hours, or until firm. Enjoy now or freeze for later!

name: Blueberry Coconut Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Coconut Water
1 cup
Frozen Blueberries
1/4 cup
Frozen Banana
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Enjoy!

name: Blended Cauliflower Zucchini Soup
ingredients:
1/2 head
Cauliflower (small, roughly chopped)
1
Zucchini (roughly chopped)
3 cups
Vegetable Broth
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves (chopped, plus extra for garnish)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
recipe:
Add the cauliflower, zucchini, broth, and mint leaves to a pot.
Bring to boil and reduce the heat down to simmer. Cover the pot with a lid and let it simmer for 20 to 25 minutes or until everything is cooked.
Use an immersion blender or carefully transfer to a blender. Purée the soup until it is smooth and season with salt and pepper. Garnish with parmesan cheese and enjoy!

name: Roasted Cauliflower with Dates & Tahini Sauce
ingredients:
1 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tsp
Cumin Seed
3/4 cup
Pitted Dates (halved)
1/4 cup
Pine Nuts
1 tbsp
Tahini
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1 tbsp
Parsley (finely chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, toss the cauliflower with half of the oil, salt, pepper, and cumin seed.
Transfer to the baking sheet, making sure to space everything out. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove, flip the florets and add the dates. Bake for ten minutes more.
Meanwhile, in a small skillet over medium-low heat, toast the pine nuts until browned and fragrant, shaking the skillet often, about five minutes total. Remove and set aside. In a small jar, combine the remaining oil, tahini, and lemon juice. Shake well to incorporate.
Layer the cauliflower and dates on a platter. Drizzle the tahini all over and garnish with pine nuts and parsley. Season with additional salt and pepper if needed. Enjoy!

name: Cranberry Pecan Oatmeal
ingredients:
1 cup
Water
1/2 cup
Oats
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 cup
Cranberry Sauce
2 tbsps
Pecans (chopped)
recipe:
Bring the water to a boil in a small saucepan. Add the oats. Reduce to a simmer and cook for three to five minutes, until the oats are soft.
Stir in the maple syrup, cinnamon, and cranberry sauce until warmed through.
Top with the chopped pecans. Enjoy!

name: Charred Broccolini with Lemon & Garlic
ingredients:
16 ozs
Broccolini
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2
Lemon (juiced, zested)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Nutritional Yeast
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (215ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the broccolini on the baking sheet and toss with half of the oil, salt, and pepper. Mix well with your hands. Transfer the baking sheet to the oven and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until charred and crispy.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix together the remaining oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, garlic, nutritional yeast, and chili flakes.
Plate the broccolini and drizzle the oil and lemon mixture on top. Serve and enjoy!

name: Braised Cranberry Cabbage
ingredients:
4 cups
Purple Cabbage (shredded)
1 cup
Cranberry Sauce
1/2
Yellow Onion (diced)
1/4 cup
Apple Cider Vinegar
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a large pot. Stir to combine. Cook over medium-high heat for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally until the cabbage is cooked through and tender.
Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Lentil Stuffed Peppers
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Brown Rice (dry)
3/4 cup
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
2 cups
Water
1/2
Yellow Onion (chopped)
1 tsp
Taco Seasoning
1/2 cup
Salsa
4
Red Bell Pepper (medium, tops, seeds, and ribs removed)
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
2 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
In a pot, add the lentils and water. Bring to a boil then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the lentils for 20 to 25 minutes or until they are tender. Add more water if needed. Once the lentils are cooked, drain any excess water then run them under cold water and set them aside.
Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about five to seven minutes, stirring often. Stir in the taco seasoning and reduce the heat to low. Add the salsa, cooked rice, and lentils and stir to combine everything.
Preheat the air fryer to 320ºF (160ºC).
Spray the peppers with oil and place them in the air fryer for five minutes. Remove the peppers and stuff them with the rice mixture until about 3/4 of the way full. Increase the temperature on the air fryer to 350ºF (177ºC). Place the peppers back in the air fryer and bake for eight minutes. Remove, top with cheese and bake for one to two minutes, until the cheese has melted. Serve and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Pumpkin Breakfast Cookie
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Oats
1/4 cup
Pureed Pumpkin (blotted with paper towel to remove excess liquid)
2 tbsps
Oat Flour
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil (melted)
2 tsps
All Natural Peanut Butter
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Baking Powder
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 360ºF (180ºC).
In a medium-sized bowl, combine the oats, pumpkin, flour, coconut oil, peanut butter, maple syrup, baking powder, and salt. Mix well with a spoon and fold in the chocolate chips. Form the dough into a ball.
Line the air fryer with an air fryer parchment sheet. Place the cookie dough ball in the air fryer and use your hands to flatten it into a large circle about 1/2-inch (1.2 cm) thick. Bake for 10 minutes, until cooked through. Carefully remove and enjoy!

name: Cranberry Orange Mocktail
ingredients:
4
Ice Cubes (large)
4 fl ozs
Cranberry Juice
1/4 cup
Orange Juice (freshly squeezed)
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1 cup
Sparkling Water
1/2 cup
Frozen Cranberries
1/4
Navel Orange (cut into wedges)
recipe: Divide the ice cubes, cranberry juice, orange juice, and maple syrup into glasses. Stir to combine. Top each with sparkling water and cranberries. Garnish with orange slices. Enjoy!

name: Lentil Pot Pie
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Cassava Flour
1/3 cup
Arrowroot Powder
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Butter
2/3 cup
Water
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 cups
Frozen Vegetable Mix
2 1/2 cups
Lentils (cooked, rinsed)
3/4 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1 tbsp
Cornstarch
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). In a bowl, mix the cassava flour, arrowroot powder, and salt. Cut in the butter until crumbly. Add the water and mix until a dough forms. Knead the dough with your hands until smooth. If the dough is too dry, add more water one tablespoon at a time.
Between two pieces of parchment paper, roll out 2/3 of the dough with a rolling pin until it is one to two inches larger than your pie plate. Transfer it to the pie plate and bake for seven minutes.
Roll out the remaining dough until it is about the same diameter as your pie plate. Set it aside.
Warm the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the frozen vegetable mix and cook until it has thawed completely. Add the lentils and continue to cook for another five minutes. Add the coconut milk, stir, and let simmer for a couple of minutes. Add the cornstarch and garlic powder. Continue to stir until it has thickened. Season with additional salt, if needed.
Add the lentil mixture to the pie crust. Top it with the remaining rolled-out dough and press the edges of the crust together with your hands. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes or until the edges turn golden and cooked through. Slice, serve, and enjoy!

name: Spiced Granola Stuffed Apples
ingredients:
5
Apple (medium)
1/2 cup
Oats (rolled)
1/4 cup
Pecans (chopped)
2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
1 tsp
Pumpkin Pie Spice
1 tbsp
Arrowroot Powder
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2 tbsps
Coconut Oil (melted)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut off the top of each apple and remove the core. Scoop out the flesh with a spoon, leaving approximately 1/2-inch of flesh on the apples. Finely chop up half of the apple flesh and discard the rest.
Add the chopped apple, oats, pecans, coconut sugar, pumpkin pie spice, and arrowroot powder in a bowl. Stir to combine. Add the vanilla extract and melted coconut oil, and stir until crumbly.
Divide the crumble mixture evenly between the apples. Transfer them to the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 30 minutes or until the apples are soft to the touch. Serve and enjoy!

name: Mulled Cider
ingredients:
3 quarts
Apple Cider
2 tbsps
Star Anise (whole)
5 servings
Cinnamon Stick
1/2 cup
Frozen Cranberries
1/2
Navel Orange (sliced)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients into a large pot and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Drop the heat to low once the pot is simmering and continue to simmer for 30 minutes. Pour into glasses or mugs and enjoy!

name: Miso Mustard Roasted Brussels Sprouts
ingredients:
3 cups
Brussels Sprouts (trimmed and halved)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Miso Paste
2 tsps
Dijon Mustard

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Parsley (minced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Lined a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss all of the ingredients together in a large bowl except for the parsley. Spread everything out evenly on the baking sheet. Cook for 20 minutes, tossing halfway through.
Garnish with parsley before serving and enjoy!

name: Citrus & Olive Side Salad
ingredients:
2
Navel Orange
1/2 cup
Red Onion (chopped)
1/2 cup
Black Olives (pitted)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Using a sharp knife, cut off both ends of the oranges. Remove the peel and as much of the white membrane as possible, cutting as close to the flesh as possible. Cut the oranges into 1/2-inch slices.
Add the orange slices to a serving dish. Place the onions and olives on top. Drizzle with oil and season with salt, and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Chickpeas, Cauliflower & Brussels Sprouts
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas
1/2 cup
Dried Unsweetened Cranberries
2 cups
Brussels Sprouts (trimmed and halved)
1/2 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1 tbsp
Fresh Dill (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, toss all of the ingredients together except for the dill. Spread them out on the baking sheet. Cook for 20 minutes or until nicely browned, tossing halfway through.
Top the cooked mixture with lemon juice and dill. Enjoy!

name: Mint Pea Couscous
ingredients:
1 cup
Couscous
2 cups
Frozen Peas (thawed)
1/4 cup
Shallot (thinly chopped)
1 cup
Mint Leaves (thinly chopped)
2 tbsps
Pine Nuts (toasted)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the couscous according to package directions.
With a fork, fluff the couscous and stir in the peas, shallots, mint, and pine nuts.
Season to taste and serve. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Moroccan Lentil Stew
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (large, chopped)
1/4 cup
Tomato Paste
2 tsps
Moroccan Spice Blend

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 cups
Vegetable Broth
1 1/2 cups
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
3 cups
Baby Spinach
recipe:
Turn your pressure cooker to sauté mode and add the oil. Once hot, add the onion and cook, stirring often for three to four minutes, until softened. Add the tomato paste and cook for one minute. Add the Moroccan seasoning, salt, and pepper and cook for two to three more minutes. Deglaze the pot with a splash of broth or water and scrape up any bits. Turn the sauté mode off.
Add the broth and lentils and stir. Put the lid on and set to “sealing” then press manual/pressure cooker and cook for 16 minutes on high pressure. Once finished, let the pressure release naturally for ten minutes, then do a quick release.
Carefully remove the lid and stir in the spinach until wilted. Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Pomegranate Thyme Mocktail
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Pomegranate Juice
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
4
Ice Cubes (large)
2 cups
Sparkling Water
1/4 cup
Pomegranate Seeds
1/2 oz
Thyme Sprigs
recipe: Divide the pomegranate juice and maple syrup into glasses. Stir to combine. Add the ice then top each with sparkling water and pomegranate seeds. Garnish with thyme. Enjoy!

name: Cranberry Orange Popsicles
ingredients:
1 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
1 cup
Frozen Cranberries
1/2
Navel Orange (peeled)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour into popsicle molds and freeze for five to six hours or until completely frozen. Enjoy!

name: Maple Miso Parsnips
ingredients:
4
Parsnip (medium, chopped)
3 tbsps
Miso Paste
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the parsnips to a mixing bowl. In a small bowl, whisk together the miso paste, oil, and maple syrup until well combined.
Pour the miso mixture over the parsnips and mix or toss until they are well coated. Spread the parsnips onto a baking sheet. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes or until caramelized and browned, flipping halfway through.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Spice Buckwheat Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Buckwheat Groats
2/3 cup
Pureed Pumpkin
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 tsp
Pumpkin Pie Spice
2 tbsps
Pitted Dates (chopped)
1 tbsp
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
recipe:
In a pot, bring the buckwheat, pumpkin, and almond milk to a boil. Cover and reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook for 15 minutes or until the buckwheat is tender.
Add the pumpkin spice, dates, and shredded coconut. Enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Snickerdoodle Cookies
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Butter
1 1/2 cups
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1 tsp
Baking Powder
1/4 tsp
Baking Soda
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tsp
Pumpkin Pie Spice
3/4 cup
Brown Sugar (light)
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/3 cup
Pureed Pumpkin (blot with paper towel to absorb excess moisture)
1 tbsp
Cinnamon
2 tbsps
Cane Sugar
recipe:
Heat a small saucepan over medium and add the butter. Let it melt, stirring constantly with a spatula, until bubbling and browned, about five to eight minutes total. Adjust the heat as needed to medium-low to avoid burning. Remove from the heat and add to a medium bowl to cool. Transfer to the fridge for five to ten minutes while you prepare the rest.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and pumpkin pie spice.
Add the brown sugar, vanilla, and pumpkin to the bowl with the cooled butter. Mix very well with a spatula until smooth. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir with a spatula until just combined and no flour remains. Cover and transfer to the fridge for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a small bowl mix together the cinnamon and cane sugar.
Remove the cookie dough from the fridge and scoop approximately two tablespoons of batter into your hands and roll it into a ball. Roll the ball in the cinnamon sugar mixture until completely coated.
Transfer the dough balls to the baking sheet and lightly press down on each with the palm of your hand or the back of a measuring cup until the cookie is approximately 2 1/2-inches (6 cm) in diameter.
Bake for 11 to 12 minutes. Remove from the oven and allow them to cool for at least 10 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Shredded Brussels Sprouts & Pomegranate Salad
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Hazelnuts (raw)
4 cups
Brussels Sprouts (trimmed and shredded)
1/3 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tbsps
Dijon Mustard
1 1/2 tbsps
White Wine Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)
1/2 cup
Pomegranate Seeds
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (180ºC). Add the hazelnuts to a baking tray and bake for ten to 15 minutes, until toasted and fragrant. Remove from the oven and place in a clean kitchen towel. Rub to remove the skins. Let cool and then roughly chop and set aside.
Add the Brussels sprouts to a large salad bowl. In a small jar or bowl, combine the oil, mustard, vinegar, salt, and pepper and shake or whisk until well combined.
Add the dressing to the Brussels sprouts and toss well to combine. Top with the hazelnuts and garnish with the parmesan cheese and pomegranate seeds. Enjoy!

name: Cranberry Chia Popsicle
ingredients:
2 cups
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
2 fl ozs
Cranberry Juice
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/4 cup
Chia Seeds
1/3 cup
Frozen Cranberries
recipe:
In a bowl, mix together the coconut milk, cranberry juice, maple syrup, and chia seeds. Cover the bowl and place in the fridge for about 30 minutes.
Divide the frozen cranberries between popsicle molds. Pour the coconut milk mixture into popsicle molds and freeze for eight hours or overnight until completely frozen. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Covered Frozen Blueberries
ingredients:
3 ozs
Dark Chocolate
2 cups
Blueberries
1/3 cup
Sliced Almonds (plus extra for topping)
recipe:
Line a small baking sheet or plate with parchment paper.
Melt the chocolate in a small bowl in 30-second increments in the microwave or by using a double boiler over the stove.
Add the blueberries and almonds to the chocolate and stir well.
Spread the blueberry mixture over the parchment paper in a single layer. Sprinkle extra almonds on top.
Place in the freezer for at least six hours or overnight. Slice or break apart into pieces. Enjoy!

name: Dried Figs
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Dried Fig
recipe: Place figs in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Roasted Jerusalem Artichokes with Pomegranate & Sage
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Jerusalem Artichokes (trimmed and halved)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Dried Rosemary

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Pomegranate Seeds
1 tbsp
Fresh Sage (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC).
Toss the Jerusalem artichokes with the oil, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Add them to a cast iron pan or oven safe dish. Roast in the oven for 20 minutes, tossing halfway. They should be tender and slightly browned.
Top with the pomegranate seeds and fresh sage. Enjoy!

name: Gingerbread Coconut Clusters
ingredients:
3 cups
Unsweetened Coconut Flakes
1/2 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
3 tbsps
Coconut Oil (melted)
2 tbsps
Blackstrap Molasses
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 tsp
Ground Ginger
1/4 tsp
Ground Allspice
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 325°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add all of the ingredients to a large bowl and mix to combine. Pour onto the baking sheet and flatten with a spatula to make an even tight layer.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the coconut flakes have browned.
Let it cool for 10 to 15 minutes. Break it apart to make clusters. Enjoy!

name: Orange Ginger Chickpea Stir Fry
ingredients:
4 cups
Frozen Vegetable Mix
1/2 cup
Orange Juice
2 tbsps
Tamari
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Ginger (fresh, grated)
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1 tbsp
Arrowroot Powder
3 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, drained, rinsed)
recipe:
Heat a large pan over medium heat. Add the frozen vegetable mix and cook for 10 to 15 minutes, or until completely thawed.
In a bowl, combine the orange juice, tamari, maple syrup, ginger, garlic powder, and arrowroot powder. Whisk until well combined.
Add the chickpeas to the vegetables. Add the sauce and stir until everything is coated. Cook for another five minutes and allow the sauce to thicken. Enjoy!

name: Pretzels
ingredients:
2 ozs
Pretzels
recipe: Add the pretzels to a plate and enjoy!

name: Brown Rice & Peas
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Rice (dry, rinsed)
1 cup
Water
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Frozen Peas (thawed)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
To a pot add the rinsed rice, water, and salt. Bring the rice to a boil over high heat, then cover and reduce the heat to low. Cook for about 15 minutes, then add peas and parsley. Continue cooking for the 10 to 15 minutes or until the liquid has just been absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and enjoy!

name: Maple Lentil Breakfast Sausages
ingredients:
3 cups
Lentils (cooked, drained, rinsed)
3 tbsps
Ground Flax Seed
1 1/2 tbsps
Arrowroot Powder
3/4 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Combine the lentils, ground flax seed, arrowroot powder, garlic powder, maple syrup, and 2/3 of the oil in a food processor. Process until a smooth, thick batter has formed. If the batter is too crumbly, add a little bit of water one teaspoon at a time, and continue to process until you have a thick batter.
Form the patties by scooping 3/4 cup of the lentil mixture into your hands, roll it into a ball, then flatten it with the palm of your hand. Each patty should be approximately three inches in diameter.
Heat the remaining oil in a large pan over medium heat. Fry the lentil patties for three to four minutes on each side, until browned. Remove from the heat. Enjoy!

name: Clementines & Almonds
ingredients:
2
Clementines
1/4 cup
Almonds
recipe: Divide the clementines and almonds onto plates. Enjoy!

name: Honey Garlic Roasted Rutabaga
ingredients:
4 cups
Rutabaga (cubed)
2 tbsps
Raw Honey
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine all of the ingredients in a large bowl. Mix until the rutabaga is well-coated. Transfer to the baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes, or until fork-tender, flipping halfway through.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Dates
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Pitted Dates
recipe: Place pitted dates on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Dipped Pear with Pistachios
ingredients:
2
Pear (sliced)
1 3/4 ozs
Dark Chocolate (at least 70% cacao)
2 tsps
Pistachios (chopped, optional)
recipe:
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and pat dry the pear slices with a paper towel.
Place the chocolate in a bowl and melt in the microwave in 30-second intervals or over a double boiler. Dip each pear slice into the chocolate and place on the baking sheet. Sprinkle with pistachios, if using.
Transfer the chocolate dipped pears to the fridge for 20 minutes or until the chocolate is completely set. Remove from parchment paper and enjoy!

name: Snap Peas & Hummus
ingredients:
1 cup
Snap Peas (trimmed)
1/3 cup
Hummus
recipe: Serve the snap peas with the hummus. Enjoy!

name: Smashed Edamame & Mushroom Sandwich
ingredients:
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
2/3 cup
Mushrooms (sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1 tsp
Lemon Juice
1/3 cup
Arugula
3 1/2 ozs
Sourdough Bread (toasted)
recipe:
In a pan over medium-high heat, add half of the oil and mushrooms. Sauté until golden brown and season with salt and pepper.
In a bowl, add the edamame, lemon juice, and the remaining oil. Lightly smash with a fork and season with salt and pepper.
Spread the smashed edamame on the toasted bread. Top with mushrooms and arugula. Close the sandwich and enjoy!

name: Cajun Kale Chips
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Cajun Seasoning
4 cups
Kale Leaves (packed, torn into pieces)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix together the oil and Cajun seasoning. Add the kale and massage lightly to coat the leaves.
Add the kale to the baking sheet, leaving space between the leaves. Bake in the oven for 15 to 17 minutes or until crispy. Serve and enjoy!

name: Grapefruit & Honey
ingredients:
1
Grapefruit
2 tsps
Honey
recipe:
Cut the grapefruit in half and place in separate bowls. Use a sharp knife to cut around the circumference and in between the segments.
Drizzle with honey and use a spoon to scoop out individual sections. Enjoy!

name: Avocado & Crackers with Balsamic Dressing
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinaigrette
1
Avocado (halved)
1 1/3 ozs
Seed Crackers
recipe:
Pour the balsamic vinegar into the empty space in the avocado where the pit was.
Serve alongside crackers and enjoy!

name: Spicy Beans on Toast
ingredients:
1 1/3 cups
White Navy Beans (cooked)
1/4 cup
Tomato Paste
1/4 cup
Vegetable Broth
1 1/2 tsps
Hot Sauce
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Cumin
2 slices
Whole Grain Bread (lightly toasted)
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
recipe:
In a small pan over medium heat, add the beans, tomato paste, broth, hot sauce, maple syrup, and cumin. Cook for five minutes, or until heated through.
Spoon the beans over the toast and serve with a dollop of yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Maple Lentil Breakfast Sausage with Turnip Hashbrowns
ingredients:
2 cups
Lentils (cooked, drained, rinsed)
2 tbsps
Ground Flax Seed
1 tbsp
Arrowroot Powder
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3
Turnip (medium, cubed)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C).
