Combine the lentils, ground flax seed, arrowroot powder, garlic powder, maple syrup, and 2/3 of the oil in a food processor. Process until a smooth, thick batter has formed. If the batter is too crumbly, add a little bit of water one teaspoon at a time, and continue to process until you have a thick batter.
Form the patties by scooping 3/4 cup of the lentil mixture into your hands, roll it into a ball, then flatten it with the palm of your hand. Each patty should be approximately three inches in diameter.
Heat half of the remaining oil in a large pan over medium heat. Fry the lentil patties for three to four minutes on each side, until browned. Remove from the heat. Toss the turnip in the remaining oil. Transfer them to a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes, or until fork-tender and golden brown.
Serve the lentil patties with the turnip hashbrowns and enjoy!

name: Savory Chickpea Muffins
ingredients:
2 cups
Chickpea Flour
1 tsp
Baking Powder
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/8 cups
Water
1 cup
Mushrooms (chopped)
1 cup
Arugula (chopped, tightly packed)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a muffin tray with liners or use a silicone muffin tray.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the chickpea flour, baking powder, garlic powder, and salt. Mix well to combine. Add the oil and water, and mix with a fork until a thick, pancake-like batter forms.
Stir in the mushrooms and arugula until well combined. Scoop 1/3 cup into each muffin cup. Transfer to the oven and bake for 35 minutes, or until starting to brown.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Cranberry Orange Sorbet
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Frozen Cranberries
1/2 cup
Orange Juice
1 1/2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
recipe:
In a food processor, blend together the cranberries, orange juice, and maple syrup until smooth.
Transfer the mixture into a container and freeze for at least 30 minutes. Scoop into serving bowls and enjoy!

name: Easy Tomato Baked Risotto
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Arborio Rice
1 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth
2
Tomato (medium, grated)
1/4 oz
Thyme Sprigs
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated, plus extra for optional garnish)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC).
In an oven safe dish, add the rice, broth, grated tomato, and thyme springs. Stir well, cover the dish tightly with a lid or foil. Bake in the oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until the rice is cooked through.
Stir in the parmesan and salt. Adjust the seasoning to your taste. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Frozen Grapes
ingredients:
2 cups
Grapes (washed and dried)
recipe:
Place the grapes in a freezer bag or an airtight container, seal, and place in the freezer for at least six hours.
When ready to snack, remove some from the freezer and eat them straight away. Enjoy!

name: Taco Spiced Quinoa
ingredients:
2 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium (divided)
1
Yellow Onion (medium, finely diced)
1
Green Bell Pepper (medium, finely diced)
1 cup
Quinoa (rinsed and drained)
1 1/2 tbsps
Tomato Paste
1 tbsp
Taco Seasoning
2/3 cup
Black Beans (cooked, rinsed)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Heat a splash of the broth in a pot over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and the bell pepper and cook for five minutes or until the broth is absorbed. Add the quinoa and cook for another five minutes, stirring frequently, until the quinoa begins to toast and turn lightly golden.
Add the remaining broth, tomato paste, and taco seasoning. Stir well and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes.
Remove the lid and fluff with a fork. Add the beans and let stand for five minutes to absorb the remaining liquid, if necessary.
Divide evenly between plates, garnish with the cilantro and enjoy!

name: Bagel & Hummus
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Hummus
1
Bagel (plain, sliced in half, toasted)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
recipe: Spread the hummus onto the bagel and top it with oil. Enjoy!

name: Pecans
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Pecans
recipe: Place the pecans in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Clementines & Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients:
2
Clementines (peeled, sectioned)
1/4 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
recipe: Add the clementines and pumpkin seeds to a plate. Enjoy!

name: Tempeh & Arugula Benedict
ingredients:
8 ozs
Tempeh (cut into 2 x 2-inch squares)
1
Sweet Potato (large, cut into rounds)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/4 cup
Cashews (raw, soaked for at least 6 hours, drained & rinsed)
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1/4 tsp
Turmeric
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Water
1 cup
Arugula
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Brush both sides of the tempeh and sweet potato rounds with half of the oil. Place them on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 30 minutes, or until the sweet potato is fork-tender.
Add the remaining oil, cashews, lemon juice, turmeric, salt, and water to a blender. Blend for approximately one minute, or until smooth and creamy. Add a little more water if necessary to achieve your desired consistency.
Stack the sweet potato rounds, arugula, and tempeh, then drizzle on the cashew hollandaise. Enjoy!

name: Apple Chips & Hazelnuts
ingredients:
2/3 oz
Apple Chips
1/4 cup
Hazelnuts
recipe: Place apple chips and hazelnuts on a plate or in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Carrots, Crackers & Hummus Snack Box
ingredients:
1
Carrot (medium, peeled, cut into sticks)
1 1/2 ozs
Rice Crackers
1/4 cup
Hummus
recipe: Arrange the carrot sticks, crackers, and hummus into a container. Enjoy!

name: Tomato Chips
ingredients:
8
Tomato (large, firm, thinly sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 210°F (100°C). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the tomatoes on the baking sheet. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer to the oven and bake for three hours, or until completely dry. Allow the tomato slices to cool for 15 minutes before removing them from the parchment paper. Enjoy!

name: Edamame Ricotta Toast
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Ricotta Cheese
1 tsp
Lemon Juice
3/4 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed, divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 1/2 ozs
Sourdough Bread (toasted)
recipe:
Add ricotta, lemon juice, and 2/3 of the edamame to the bowl of a food processor. Process until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.
Spread the ricotta mixture onto the toast. Top with the remaining edamame. Enjoy!

name: Blueberry Tofu Pudding
ingredients:
8 ozs
Silken Tofu
1 cup
Blueberries (plus more for garnish)
1 1/2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
2 1/2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
2 tsps
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
recipe:
Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend for at least one minute, until a very smooth texture is achieved.
Scoop into a container. Top with additional blueberries if desired. Seal the container and transfer it to the fridge to set for at least two hours or overnight. Enjoy!

name: One Pan Sweet Potatoes & Chickpeas
ingredients:
1 3/4 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, rinsed, pat dry with paper towel)
1
Sweet Potato (large, cubed)
2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, sliced)
1
Yellow Onion (large, sliced)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Cajun Seasoning

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet(s) with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine the chickpeas, sweet potato, bell peppers, and onions. Add the oil and Cajun seasoning. Toss to combine and make sure everything is well coated.
Bake in the oven for 20 minutes. Remove the tray and shake and then bake for an additional 20 to 25 minutes longer, until the chickpeas are crispy and the sweet potato is cooked through. Season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Loaded Tostadas
ingredients:
2
Corn Tortilla
1/4 can
Refried Beans
2 tbsps
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
2 tbsps
Salsa
2 tbsps
Guacamole
2 tbsps
Plain Greek Yogurt
1 stalk
Green Onion (sliced)
1/2 cup
Microgreens
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Lay the tortillas on the prepared baking sheet. Divide the beans equally among the tortillas.
Top each tortilla with equal parts of the crumbled feta cheese and bake for 10 minutes.
Remove from the oven. Top with the salsa, guacamole, and yogurt. Add green onions and microgreens. Enjoy!

name: Kimchi Tofu Soup
ingredients:
2 cups
Kimchi (with juice)
3 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
12 1/3 ozs
Tofu (soft, cut into 1-inch cubes)
2 cups
Bean Sprouts
2 stalks
Green Onion (sliced)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Add the kimchi and the broth to a pot. Bring to a boil and cook over medium-high heat for five minutes.
Reduce the heat to medium-low. Add the tofu and continue cooking for two minutes or just enough to warm the tofu.
Divide into bowls and top with the bean sprouts, green onions, and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Cucumber, Blackberries & Hummus Snack Box
ingredients:
1/4
Cucumber (medium, sliced)
1/2 cup
Blackberries
1/4 cup
Hummus
recipe: Arrange the cucumber, blackberries and hummus into a container. Enjoy!

name: Edamame Avocado Toast
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Frozen Edamame
1
Avocado (medium, mashed)
3 1/2 ozs
Sourdough Bread (toasted)
1/2 oz
Pickled Red Onions
1 tsp
Sesame Seeds (black)
recipe:
Cook the edamame in salted boiling water for three to four minutes. Set aside.
Spread the avocado on the toast and top with the edamame, red onions, and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Smoked Oysters, Apple & Brazil Nuts
ingredients:
1
Apple
2 ozs
Smoked Oysters (drained)
2 tbsps
Brazil Nuts
recipe: Place all ingredients on a plate. Enjoy!

name: One Pan Spaghetti Squash Ratatouille
ingredients:
1
Spaghetti Squash (medium, halved lengthwise, seeds removed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper
1
Eggplant (large, coarsely chopped)
1
Orange Bell Pepper (large, coarsely chopped)
1
Yellow Onion (large, coarsely chopped)
2 tsps
Herbes De Provence
3 cups
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with juices)
4
Garlic (cloves, roughly chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Line rimmed baking sheets with parchment paper.
Season the flesh of the squash with salt and pepper and arrange cut side down on the prepared baking sheet. Cook in the oven for 20 minutes.
Arrange the eggplant, bell peppers, and onions around the partially cooked squash. Season with herbes de provence. Continue cooking for 20 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and garlic. Continue cooking for 10 minutes.
Using a fork, scrape the squash into a serving platter. Spoon the roasted veggies on top and enjoy!

name: Spiced Quince Puree
ingredients:
4
Quince (cored & chopped)
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Pumpkin Pie Spice
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a medium saucepan over medium heat. Cover with a lid and allow to cook for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until very soft.
Let it cool for five minutes before transferring to a food processor. Process until smooth. Enjoy!

name: Squash & Lentil Chili
ingredients:
1 cup
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1
White Onion (small, diced)
2 cups
Butternut Squash (peeled, chopped)
3
Tomato (large, chopped)
1
Green Bell Pepper (diced)
1/4 cup
Tomato Paste
1 cup
Dry Lentils
2 tsps
Chili Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat a large pot over medium heat and add a splash of the vegetable broth. Add the onion, stir, and let it cook for a couple of minutes.
Add the butternut squash and cook for another five minutes. Then, add the tomatoes, green pepper, tomato paste, lentils, chili powder, salt, pepper, and remaining broth. Stir, reduce the heat to low, and cover with a lid.
Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until it has thickened and absorbed most of the liquid. Enjoy!

name: Strawberries & Walnuts
ingredients:
1 cup
Strawberries
1/4 cup
Walnuts
recipe: Add the strawberries and walnuts to a plate and. Enjoy!

name: Kalamata Olives
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives
recipe: Place the olives in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Chickpea Crepes with Smashed Avocado
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Chickpea Flour
1/4 cup
Water
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
1/2
Avocado (medium)
1 tbsp
Hemp Seeds
1 tsp
Nutritional Yeast
1/2 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
recipe:
In a medium-sized bowl, whisk together the flour, water, and half the salt until well combined. Let sit for 20 minutes.
In a small bowl, mash the avocado. Add the hemp seeds, nutritional yeast, and the remaining salt. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Once hot, add the chickpea batter and swirl the pan to create an even layer. Cook for three to four minutes, until set. The sides will pull away from the pan and you will be able to flip the crepe over with a spatula. Once flipped, cook for three minutes longer.
Remove the crepe and transfer to a plate. Add the avocado mixture to half the crepe and fold the other half over. Enjoy!

name: Sweet & Spicy Tofu with Rice
ingredients:
1 cup
Basmati Rice (uncooked)
2 tbsps
Soy Sauce
1/2 cup
Water (plus more if needed)
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
2 tsps
Paprika
2 tsps
Garlic Powder
1/4 tsp
Cayenne Pepper
1 1/2 tsps
Arrowroot Powder
1 1/16 lbs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, and cubed)
1/4 cup
Chives (chopped, plus more for garnish)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Whisk together the soy sauce, water, maple syrup, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and arrowroot powder. Set aside.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Cook the tofu in the pan until golden, about six to eight minutes, flipping and tossing every couple of minutes.
Reduce the heat to low and add the soy sauce mixture. Cook for another minute, stirring to coat and adding a little water at a time, if necessary, to achieve desired sauce consistency.
Add the chives to the rice and stir to combine.
Divide the rice evenly between plates. Top with the tofu and garnish with extra chives, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Cucumber & Smoked Oyster Spread
ingredients:
3/4 tsp
Cream Cheese, Regular (room temperature)
2 1/3 ozs
Smoked Oysters (drained)
1 1/2 tsps
Worcestershire Sauce
1
Cucumber (large, sliced)
recipe:
Place the cream cheese, smoked oysters, and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl. Mix and mash with a fork or blend with a hand blender if you prefer a smoother texture.
Serve with the cucumber and enjoy!

name: Artichoke, Olive & Sun Dried Tomato Pesto Pizza
ingredients:
1 piece
Naan
1 tbsp
Sun Dried Tomato Pesto
1 1/2 ozs
Mozzarella Cheese (shredded, divided)
1/4 cup
Artichoke Hearts (from the can, drained, sliced)
2 tbsps
Black Olives (pitted, sliced)
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Once preheated, put the naan on the baking sheet and bake for five minutes.
Spread the pesto evenly over the naan. Top with half the mozzarella, artichokes, and olives. Then add the remaining mozzarella.
Return to the oven and bake for six to eight minutes, or until the cheese has melted and the crust is crispy. Cut into slices, sprinkle with parsley, and enjoy!

name: Curried Potato & Pea Stew
ingredients:
6 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1
White Onion (small, diced)
3
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1 cup
Dried Green Peas
2 cups
Mini Potatoes (chopped)
1 tsp
Madras Curry Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (optional, chopped)
recipe:
Add a splash of the vegetable broth to a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, stir, and cook for a couple of minutes. Then add the garlic and cook for another couple of minutes.
Add the dried green peas and remaining broth. Bring to a rolling boil for 10 minutes, then reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the potatoes, curry powder, salt, and pepper. Continue to simmer for another 20 minutes, or until it has thickened and most of the liquid has reduced.
Divide evenly between bowls. Top with cilantro and enjoy!

name: Roasted Red Pepper, Olive & Onion Flatbread
ingredients:
1
Sweet Onion (large, chopped)
2
Garlic (cloves, roughly chopped)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Thyme (fresh, plus more for garnish)
1 tsp
Anchovy Paste
4 1/4 ozs
Roasted Red Peppers (sliced)
2 pieces
Naan
1/4 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives (halved)
recipe:
With the rack in the middle of the oven, preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large skillet over medium-low heat, brown the onions and the garlic in the oil. Stir frequently, until cooked through, for about six to eight minutes.
Add the thyme, anchovy paste, and the roasted peppers. Continue cooking for two minutes, stirring constantly. Set aside.
Place the naan on the prepared baking sheet. Spread with the onion mixture and top with the olives.
Bake for about eight to 10 minutes or until golden and crisp. Top with more thyme, if desired. Cut into slices and enjoy!

name: Halloumi Tzatziki Wrap
ingredients:
5 ozs
Halloumi (sliced)
2
Whole Wheat Tortilla (medium)
1/4 cup
Tzatziki
1 cup
Mixed Greens
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (cut in half)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1 tsp
Oregano
recipe:
Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the halloumi slices until golden brown, about one to two minutes per side.
To assemble, place the tortillas on plates and top evenly with tzatziki, mixed greens, tomato, onion, halloumi and oregano. Enjoy!

name: Garlic Potato Naan Pizza
ingredients:
2
Yellow Potato (medium, peeled and cubed)
4
Garlic (cloves, peeled)
2 pieces
Naan
4 1/4 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (old, shredded)
1 tbsp
Rosemary (finely chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
With the rack in the middle of the oven, preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the potatoes and garlic in a pot. Cover with cold water. Bring to a boil. Simmer for 15 minutes or until the potatoes are tender. Drain and spread out on a cutting board and let cool.
Once cooled to touch, coarsely chop the potatoes and the garlic cloves together.
Place the naan on the prepared baking sheet. Top with the cheese, potatoes, and rosemary.
Bake for eight to ten minutes or until golden and crisp. Cut into slices and enjoy!

name: Apple & Cheddar Quesadilla
ingredients:
1 oz
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)
1
Spelt Tortilla
1/2
Apple (medium, sliced)
recipe:
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Add the cheese on one half of the tortilla and layer the apple slices on top of the cheese. Fold the tortilla in half and place it in the pan. Cook for three to five minutes or until browned. Flip and cook on the other side until browned and the cheese is melted.
Cut into quarters and enjoy!

name: Savory Chickpea & Spinach Muffins
ingredients:
1 3/4 cups
Chickpea Flour
1/4 cup
Nutritional Yeast
1 tsp
Baking Powder
1 1/4 tsps
Sea Salt
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika
2 cups
Water
1
Orange Bell Pepper (chopped)
2 cups
Baby Spinach (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a muffin tray with liners or use a silicone muffin tray.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, nutritional yeast, baking powder, salt, and smoked paprika.
Add the water and whisk to combine until smooth. Fold in the peppers and spinach. Let the batter sit at room temperature for 15 to 20 minutes. Divide the batter evenly between muffin cups, approximately 1/3 cup per muffin. Transfer to the oven and bake for 35 to 45 minutes, or until the muffins are cooked through and golden brown. Let them cool in the tray for ten minutes before removing. Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Maple Parsnip & Tofu Bowl
ingredients:
4
Parsnip (medium, cubed)
8 1/4 ozs
Tofu (firm, cubed)
1 tsp
Avocado Oil
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Mixed Greens
1/2 cup
Radishes (thinly sliced)
2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinaigrette
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the parsnips and tofu to the prepared baking sheet. Top with oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes, or until the parsnips are fork tender and starting to brown.
Place the mixed greens, radishes, parsnips, and tofu in a bowl. Top with balsamic vinaigrette. Enjoy!

name: Figs
ingredients:
2
Fig (cut in half)
recipe: Add the figs to a bowl and enjoy!

name: Black Eyed Peas & Mushrooms on Toast
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Shiitake Mushrooms (stem removed, chopped)
1/4 cup
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1 cup
Black Eyed Peas (cooked, drained and rinsed)
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 1/2 ozs
Sourdough Bread (toasted)
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
recipe:
Warm the skillet over medium heat. Add the mushrooms to the pan along with a splash of broth. Cook and stir occasionally for about three minutes or until mushrooms are cooked.
Add the black eyed peas, paprika, and the remaining broth to the pan. Bring to boil then reduce the heat down to simmer. Let simmer for about five minutes, then use a fork and smash some of the peas into the pan.
Season with salt and pepper and pour the beans over the toast.
Top with parsley and squeeze some lemon juice on top. Enjoy!

name: Maple Balsamic Roasted Beets & Pears
ingredients:
2
Pear (medium, chopped)
3
Beet (medium, chopped)
2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinegar
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, toss the pears and beets with the balsamic vinegar, maple syrup, and salt, until well coated. Transfer to the baking sheet. Bake in the oven for 40 minutes, or until fork tender. Enjoy!

name: Carrot Salad
ingredients:
2
Carrot (medium, shredded)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Apple Cider Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a bowl. Toss to combine. Enjoy!

name: Feta & Radishes
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Radishes (thinly sliced)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe: Mix the radishes and feta cheese together in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Clam, Tomato & Parsley Pasta
ingredients:
8 ozs
Whole Wheat Linguine (uncooked)
4 3/4 ozs
Canned Clams (reserve liquid)
2 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
3
Garlic (cloves, chopped)
1 tsp
Red Pepper Flakes
1
Tomato (large, diced)
2 tbsps
Parsley (finely chopped, plus more for garnish)
1 tsp
Lemon Zest

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the linguine to al dente according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, drain the clams and keep the juice from the can. Set both aside separately.
Heat 1/4 of the broth in a large pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and red pepper flakes and cook for two minutes.
Add the remaining broth and the clam juice to the pan. Increase the heat to medium-high and let it boil to reduce the sauce for about five to seven minutes.
Add the clams and return to a simmer. Then stir in the tomatoes, parsley, and lemon zest. Remove from the heat.
Add the pasta to the pan and toss to combine. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately and enjoy!

name: Macadamia Nuts & Pear
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Macadamia Nuts
1
Pear
recipe: Place all ingredients on a plate and enjoy!

name: Farro & Beet Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Farro (uncooked, rinsed)
4
Beet (medium, cubed small)
2
Garlic (cloves, unpeeled)
1 cup
Vegetable Broth (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2
Lemon (small, juiced and zested)
1/4 cup
Fresh Dill (chopped)
1 cup
Microgreens
recipe:
Cook the farro according to the package directions. Set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the beets and unpeeled garlic on the baking sheet. Drizzle with 3/4 of the broth and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread into a single layer. Bake in the oven, flipping once, until tender for about 15 to 18 minutes. Set aside to cool.
Remove the garlic from the peels and mash with the remaining broth, lemon zest, and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Add the garlic mixture, beets, dill, and microgreens to the farro. Stir until combined. Divide between plates and enjoy!

name: Tahini & Blueberry Jam Sandwich
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Tahini
2 slices
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
2 tbsps
Blueberry Jam
recipe: Spread tahini on one slice of toast and jam on the other slice. Close the sandwich and enjoy!

name: Brie & Plum
ingredients:
2 ozs
Brie Cheese
1
Plum
recipe: Place all ingredients on a plate and enjoy!

name: Tempeh Patties
ingredients:
8 ozs
Tempeh (cut into cubes)
1
Yellow Onion (small, diced)
2
Garlic (cloves)
1 tsp
Chili Powder
1/2 tsp
Dried Parsley
1/2 tsp
Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper
1 tbsp
Coconut Aminos
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
recipe:
Add the tempeh, onion, garlic, chili powder, parsley, paprika, salt, pepper, coconut aminos, and half of the oil to the bowl of a food processor. Pulse until everything is combined and resembles a sausage like texture.
Form the mixture into equal balls then flatten to approximately one inch thickness. Heat the remaining oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the patties and cook for three to five minutes per side or until they are golden brown. Enjoy!

name: Zucchini & Artichoke Pizza
ingredients:
1 1/3 lbs
Pizza Dough (store bought)
1/2 oz
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2
Garlic (clove, chopped)
1 tsp
Oregano
1/2 cup
Artichoke Hearts (from the can, drained, sliced)
1 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
1/2
Zucchini (thinly sliced)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Place the dough in a large bowl and cover it with a tea towel. Leave it on counter for at least 30 minutes to rise and come to room temperature.
Preheat the oven to 500°F (260°C).
Lightly dust a clean surface on the counter with flour. Roll the dough out to approximately one inch in thickness. Transfer it to a baking sheet or pizza pan.
Drizzle the oil all over the dough and then use a brush (or your hands) to spread it all over. Next, spread the garlic all over followed by the oregano.
Add the artichoke hearts, parmesan cheese, zucchini, and feta cheese. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the cheese has melted and the dough is browned and cooked through.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Tofu Breakfast Quesadilla
ingredients:
1/2 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
1/4 tsp
Turmeric (ground, divided)
1/4 tsp
Cumin (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
8 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, pressed, crumbled)
2
Whole Wheat Tortilla (large)
4 ozs
Vegan Cheese Shreds (divided)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large nonstick pan over medium heat. Once warm, add the onion along with half of the turmeric, half the cumin, salt, and pepper. Cook until softened, about five minutes. Remove the onion and set aside.
Add the tofu to the pan. Season with the remaining turmeric, cumin, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring often, until slightly browned, about seven to eight minutes. Remove the tofu and set aside with the onions. Mix to combine. Place the tortilla on the skillet and cover half of it with half of the cheese. Add tofu mixture on top of the cheese followed by the remaining cheese. Fold the tortilla in half and gently press down. Cook for two to three minutes per side or until browned and crispy. Let the quesadilla cool slightly and then cut into wedges. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
ingredients:
3
Red Bell Pepper (quartered)
5
Garlic (cloves, skin left on)
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Chickpeas (drained, rinsed)
3 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Place the red bell pepper and garlic on a baking sheet and spray with the avocado oil. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the garlic cloves from their peel. Add them along with the roasted red peppers, chickpeas, lemon juice, and smoked paprika to the bowl of a food processor. Process until smooth and creamy.
Season with additional salt and pepper, if needed. Serve and enjoy!

name: Blueberry Buckwheat Blender Muffins
ingredients:
1/2
Banana (mashed)
1 cup
Frozen Blueberries
1 cup
Buckwheat Flour
1 tbsp
Ground Flax Seed
1/4 cup
Water
1 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1/3 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 cup
Quick Oats
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC). Line a muffin tray with liners or use a silicone muffin tray.
Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until mixed well. Evenly divide the batter between muffin cups. Bake for 35 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let the muffins thoroughly cool in the muffin tray. Enjoy!

name: Tempeh Bacon Wrap
ingredients:
8 ozs
Tempeh (thinly sliced)
1/4 cup
Coconut Aminos
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
1/2 tsp
Paprika
3
Whole Wheat Tortilla
1 tbsp
Vegan Mayonnaise
1/2
Tomato (sliced)
1/4
White Onion (sliced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the tempeh in a shallow bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together the coconut aminos, maple syrup, oil, and paprika. Pour the marinade over the tempeh and let it sit for five minutes.
Spread the tempeh onto the baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes. Flip the tempeh over and brush some of the remaining marinade over each piece. Bake for another 10 to 15 minutes or until crispy.
To assemble, place the tortillas on plates and top evenly with vegan mayonnaise, tomato, onion, and tempeh. Enjoy!

name: Carrot & Date Muffins
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Ground Flax Seed
1/4 cup
Water
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Coconut Sugar
1 cup
Grated Carrot
1 cup
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1 tsp
Baking Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Pitted Dates (chopped, divided)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC). Line a muffin tray with liners or use a silicone muffin tray.
In a large bowl mix the flax seed with water and let it sit for five minutes to congeal. Then, add the oil and sugar and whisk well. Mix in the carrots.
In a separate bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, and salt together. Add the dry ingredients to the wet and mix well. The mixture will be thick. Fold in the dates, reserving a few to top the muffins with if desired.
Evenly divide the muffin batter between the muffin cups. Top the batter with the reserved dates.
Bake in the oven for 20 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus & Crackers
ingredients:
3
Red Bell Pepper (quartered)
5
Garlic (cloves, skin left on)
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
3 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika
4 ozs
Seed Crackers
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Place the red bell pepper and garlic on a baking sheet and spray with the avocado oil. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Bake for 30 minutes in the oven.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes. Once cool enough to handle, remove the garlic cloves from their peel. Add them along with the roasted red peppers, cooked chickpeas, lemon juice, and smoked paprika to the bowl of a food processor. Process until smooth and creamy.
Transfer the hummus to a bowl. Serve with crackers and enjoy!

name: Tempeh Bacon, Potatoes & Blackberries
ingredients:
8 ozs
Tempeh (thinly sliced)
1/4 cup
Coconut Aminos
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil (divided)
1/2 tsp
Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper
2
Yellow Potato (medium, cubed)
3 slices
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
1 1/2 cups
Blackberries
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the tempeh in a shallow bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together the coconut aminos, maple syrup, half the oil, and paprika. Pour the marinade over the tempeh and let it sit for five minutes.
Arrange the tempeh into a single layer on one side of the baking sheet. Add the potatoes to the other side and toss them with the remaining oil, salt, and pepper.
Bake for 15 minutes. Flip the tempeh, then brush some of the remaining marinade onto each piece. Place back into the oven for another 10 to 15 minutes. Remove the tempeh and set aside. Return the potatoes to the oven as needed until they are crispy and cooked through. Divide the tempeh, potatoes, toast, and blackberries onto plates. Enjoy!

name: Pretzels & Brie
ingredients:
1 1/2 ozs
Brie Cheese
1 1/2 ozs
Pretzels
recipe: Place all ingredients on a plate and enjoy!

1

1/4 cup
Sauerkraut
recipe: Stack the apple pieces with the brie and sauerkraut. Enjoy!

name: No-Bake Hazelnut Date Brownies
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Pitted Dates
3/4 cup
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
1/4 cup
Hemp Seeds
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1/3 cup
Coconut Oil (divided)
2/3 cup
Cacao Powder (divided)
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup (divided)
3 tbsps
Hazelnuts (roasted, crushed)
2 tbsps
Cacao Nibs
2 tbsps
Goji Berries
recipe:
Add the dates, coconut, hemp seeds, and chia seeds to the bowl of a food processor. Add 1/3 of the coconut oil, 3/4 of the cacao powder, and 1/2 of the maple syrup. Process until a sticky dough is formed, about five minutes.
Line a loaf pan with parchment paper. Scoop the brownie dough into the pan and flatten with your hands or a spatula, until evenly spread. Transfer to the freezer to set for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, combine the remaining coconut oil, cacao powder, and maple syrup. Heat on the stove over low until the coconut oil has melted. Whisk to combine and remove from the heat. Allow to cool for 10 minutes.
Pour the melted chocolate over top of the cold brownies. Sprinkle on the crushed hazelnuts, cacao nibs, and goji berries. Transfer to the fridge to set for 10 minutes. Slice, serve, and enjoy!

name: Edamame Potato Soup
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
2
Yellow Potato (peeled, diced)
1/4 oz
Thyme Sprigs
1 cup

Sea Salt & Black Pepper
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
recipe:
Add the vegetable broth, onion, potato, and thyme springs to a pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat down to simmer. Cover the pot with a lid and let simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes are soft.
Add the edamame to the pot and let simmer covered for another five minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Remove the thyme springs from the pot. Use an immersion blender or carefully transfer to a blender. Purée the soup until it is smooth.
Stir in the lemon juice. Divide evenly between bowls. If desired, top with more edamame and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Dipped Pretzels

Transfer the baking sheet to the fridge for 20 minutes or until the chocolate is completely set. Remove from parchment paper and enjoy!

Butter
2
Garlic (cloves, finely grated)
1/4
Lemon (juiced)
1 tsp
Parsley (finely chopped)
recipe:
Rub half of the oil all over the mushrooms and season well with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and add the remaining oil. Once hot, add the mushrooms in an even layer and sear on one side until browned, about two minutes. Flip and sear the other side for two minutes. Remove the mushrooms and set aside on a serving dish or plate. Remove the skillet from the heat and add the butter and the garlic. Cook, stirring frequently for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the lemon juice.
Pour the butter mixture over the mushrooms and top with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Hazelnuts & Dried Figs

Bake until golden and crisp, about eight to ten minutes. Serve while still warm or cold and enjoy!

Add the spinach and cook for another minute. Add salt and pepper and adjust the seasoning to your taste.
Divide the pasta between serving plates. Top with basil and parmesan. Enjoy!

Add the tomato sauce to the skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and let the sauce simmer for five minutes.
Top the zucchini noodles with the sauce and enjoy!

Warm the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for three to four minutes or until translucent. Add garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the broth to the pan and bring to simmer. Transfer mussels to the simmering liquid and cover with a lid. Let them steam for six to eight minutes or until the mussels have opened.
Add the drained pasta to the pan along with a splash of the pasta water. Stir and let simmer for about three minutes. Season with salt and pepper and add more pasta water as needed.
Evenly divide the pasta and mussels onto plates. Top with lemon juice and parsley. Enjoy!

Add the curry paste and garlic and cook for one minute longer. Add the coconut milk, sugar, tamari, chickpeas, and broccoli. Bring to a simmer and then reduce the heat to low. Cover and simmer for six to eight minutes or until the broccoli is fork-tender.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

Tzatziki

name: Kiwi & Apple Chips
ingredients:
1
Kiwi (halved)
1 oz
Apple Chips
recipe: Place the kiwi and apple chips on a plate. Enjoy!

Avocado (ripe)

Line a loaf pan with parchment paper, leaving an overhang on both sides.
Place the avocado, maple syrup, and almond butter in a food processor. Process until completely smooth, about one minute.
Add the vanilla, cocoa powder, salt, and water and pulse until incorporated. Add the melted chocolate and pulse again to combine.
Transfer the fudge to the prepared pan, smoothing the top with a spatula. Top with walnuts. Place in the freezer to set for at least eight hours.
Remove the fudge and slice into squares. Keep them stored in the freezer for best results. Enjoy!

2 tbsps
Butter (divide)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Add the carrots to a pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until the carrots are fork tender.
Drain the water and then place the carrots back into the pot. Lower the heat and add half of the butter. Mash the carrots to your desired consistency.
Season with salt and pepper. Transfer the mashed carrots to a serving plate. Top with remaining butter and enjoy!

Pesto

2
Avocado (small, halved and pitted)

Chickpeas (drained, rinsed)

Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC) and lightly grease a muffin tray or use a silicone muffin tray.
In a small saucepan, whisk together the cream, dried thyme, and the garlic powder.
Bring to a slow simmer and remove from the heat. Do not let it boil.
Season the potato slices with salt and pepper and stack them in the prepared muffin cups, filling each one to the top and not beyond.
Pour the cream evenly over each pile of potatoes, filling them almost to the top. Top each stack with cheese and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until the potatoes are just tender and golden on top.
Remove the muffin tray from the oven and let stand for five minutes. Run a knife around the edges to loosen the stacks and carefully place them on a serving plate. Enjoy!

name: Buckwheat Pineapple Pancakes
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Ground Flax Seed
1/4 cup
Water
2 cups
Buckwheat Flour
1/2 tsp
Baking Powder
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1
Banana (mashed)
2 cups
Lite Coconut Milk
1/2 cup
Pineapple (chopped)
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
recipe:
Mix the flax seed and water together in a large bowl and set aside for five minutes.
In the meantime, mix the flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon together.
Add the banana and coconut milk to the flax mixture and mix well. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined. Add the pineapple and stir until evenly mixed in.
Heat a large pan over medium heat and grease with oil. Scoop 1/3 cup of batter at a time into the pan. Flip the pancakes when they bubble on top and continue cooking until they are lightly browned. Repeat with the remaining batter.
Serve the pancakes with maple syrup and enjoy!

name: Nectarine & Walnuts
ingredients:
1
Nectarine (chopped or sliced)
1/4 cup
Walnuts
recipe: Serve the nectarine with walnuts and enjoy!

name: Oven Roasted Chestnuts
ingredients:
12 ozs
Chestnuts, In Shell (raw)
recipe:
Use a sharp knife and carefully cut a slit or an "x" into the round side of each chestnut.
Place the chestnuts in a bowl and cover them with water. Let soak for at least one hour. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Place the chestnuts cut side up, on a baking tray. Roast in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, check them regularly to make sure they are not burning.
Transfer quickly to a kitchen towel. Close the towel and squeeze the chestnuts firmly. Let sit in the towel for about 10 minutes to steam.
Peel the chestnuts as soon as they are cool enough to handle and enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Sausage, Fennel & Squash
ingredients:
2 cups
Butternut Squash (peeled, seeds removed, cubed)
1 bulb
Fennel (medium, cut into wedges)
1 cup
Red Onion (cut into wedges)
1
Beet (medium, peeled, cut into chunks)
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
2 tsps
Dried Rosemary
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
8 ozs
Lamb Sausage (casing removed, cut into chunks)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the squash, fennel, red onion, and beet on the prepared baking sheet. Add the oil, rosemary, and salt and mix until well coated. Arrange into a single layer.
Spread the crumbled sausage overtop of the vegetables.
Cook for 40 minutes or until the vegetables are golden and tender, and the meat is cooked through. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Lemon & Garlic Seafood Fettuccine
ingredients:
8 ozs
Brown Rice Fettuccine
2 tbsps
Butter
4
Garlic (cloves, large, minced)
1 lb
Scallops (frozen)
9 ozs
Shrimp (frozen)
1
Lemon (juiced and zested)
2
Orange Bell Pepper (large, sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tsp
Red Pepper Flakes
recipe:
Cook the fettuccine according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, warm the butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for one minute. Add the scallops and shrimp and cook for 10 minutes, flipping as needed to thaw.
Add the lemon juice and bell pepper to the pan and continue to cook for another five to 10 minutes, until softened. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Divide the pasta, scallops, shrimp, and peppers evenly between bowls. Top with the pan sauce. Top with lemon zest and pepper flakes. Enjoy!

name: Tzatziki & Peppers
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Tzatziki
1/2
Red Bell Pepper (sliced)
recipe: Add the tzatziki to a bowl and the sliced pepper to a plate. Enjoy!

name: Spinach & Potato Tofu Frittata
ingredients:
15 1/2 ozs
Tofu (firm)
1 1/4 cups
Unsweetened Cashew Milk
1/3 cup
Nutritional Yeast
1 tbsp
Arrowroot Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3
Red Potato (cubed)
1/2
Yellow Onion (diced)
3 cups
Baby Spinach
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Line a springform pan, baking dish, or loaf pan with parchment paper.
To a blender or food processor, add the tofu, cashew milk, nutritional yeast, arrowroot powder, salt, and pepper. Blend or process on high until a smooth consistency is achieved, at least one minute.
Add the tofu mixture to a large bowl, then add the potato, onion, and spinach. Mix well to combine. Pour into the baking dish or loaf pan and bake in the oven for 60 minutes, or until it is browning on top and cooked in the middle. Slice, serve, and enjoy!

name: Chestnut Hummus
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Chestnuts (roasted, deshelled)
1 1/2 tbsps
Tahini
1
Garlic (clove)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (plus extra for garnish)
1/3 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1/4 cup
Water (cold)
1 tsp
Sesame Seeds (for garnish, optional)
recipe:
Add all the ingredients except for water and sesame seeds to a food processor. Blend until pureed. Turn the food processor on high and slowly stream in the cold water. Continue to blend until really smooth and creamy. Season with additional salt or lemon juice, if needed.
Transfer the mixture to a serving bowl. Top with sesame seeds and additional oil, if using. Enjoy!

name: Mushroom & Chestnut Soup
ingredients:
1 1/2 tsps
Butter
1/4
Yellow Onion (chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 cups
Mushrooms (sliced)
1/2 cup
Chestnuts (roasted, deshelled)
1 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Cream, Half & Half
recipe:
Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for two minutes.
Add the garlic and mushrooms. Cook for about five minutes or until softened. Add the chestnuts and vegetable broth to the pot. Cover the pot with a lid and let simmer for 15 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper. Use an immersion blender or carefully transfer to a blender. Purée the soup until it is smooth.
Add the cream and let simmer for couple more minutes. Divide between bowls and enjoy!

name: Chestnut Hummus with Cucumber & Pita Chips
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Chestnuts (roasted, deshelled)
1 1/2 tbsps
Tahini
1
Garlic (clove)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (plus extra for garnish)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1/4 cup
Water (cold)
1 tsp
Sesame Seeds (for garnish, optional)
1/2
Cucumber (medium, sliced)
1 2/3 ozs
Pita Chips
recipe:
Add the chestnuts, tahini, garlic, oil, salt, and lemon juice to a food processor. Blend until pureed.
Turn the food processor on high and slowly stream in the cold water. Continue to blend until really smooth and creamy. Season with additional salt and lemon juice, if needed.
Transfer the mixture to a serving bowl. Top with sesame seeds and additional oil, if using. Serve with cucumber slices and pita chips. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Vegetable Broth
ingredients:
2 stalks
Celery (roughly chopped)
2
Carrot (skin on, roughly chopped)
1
Yellow Onion (skin on, cut in half)
1/2 cup
Mushrooms
3
Garlic (cloves, skin on, cut in half)
1 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Black Pepper
1/2 cup
Parsley (fresh, roughly chopped)
12 cups
Water
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to the pressure cooker. Close the lid and set to “sealing”, then press manual/pressure cooker and cook for 30 minutes on high pressure. Once it is done, allow the pressure to release naturally.
Remove the lid carefully and strain the liquid through a fine mesh strainer. Discard the vegetables. Divide the broth into jars. Enjoy!

name: Parmesan Roasted Savoy Cabbage
ingredients:
1 tsp
Honey
1/4 cup
Red Wine Vinegar
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 cups
Savoy Cabbage (cut into wedges)
2 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Mix the honey, red wine vinegar, oil, and sea salt together in a large bowl. Add the savoy cabbage and toss to coat. Place the cabbage in a casserole dish and roast for 25 to 30 minutes or until the cabbage is crispy and browned.
Top the cabbage with parmesan cheese. Enjoy!

name: Snap Pea, Olive & Feta Salad
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 cups
Mixed Greens
1 cup
Snap Peas (trimmed, chopped)
1/3 cup
Dried Unsweetened Cranberries
1/4 cup
Green Olives (pitted, halved)
1/4 cup
Pecans
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
In a small bowl, whisk together the oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Add the mixed greens, snap peas, cranberries, olives, pecans, and feta cheese to a bowl. Pour the dressing all over and toss.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Pomegranate Avocado Toast
ingredients:
1/2
Avocado (medium)
1/4
Lime (juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 3/4 ozs
Sourdough Bread (toasted)
2 tbsps
Pomegranate Seeds
1 tbsp
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes (optional)
recipe:
In a bowl, add the avocado and lime juice. Mash the avocado with a fork and season with salt and pepper.
Spread the avocado on top of the toast. Top with pomegranate seeds and feta cheese. Sprinkle chili flakes on top, if using, and enjoy!

name: Moose Roast with Mushroom Miso Gravy
ingredients:
6 cups
Mushrooms (sliced)
2 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
3
Garlic (cloves, minced)
2 lbs
Moose Roast (top sirloin)
1 tsp
Onion Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
6
Carrot (large, cut into sticks)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Miso Paste
1 tbsp
Tapioca Flour
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C).
Add the mushrooms, half of the broth, and garlic to a casserole or baking dish with a lid. Place the roast on top of the mushrooms and season with onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Cover the dish with a lid and bake in the oven for 15 minutes. Remove the lid and turn the heat down to 325°F (165°C) and continue to cook for one hour, or until the internal temperature of the roast is at least 135°F (60°C). Baste the roast a few times while it is cooking.
Meanwhile, add the carrots to a baking sheet. Toss them with the oil, salt and pepper. Bake in the oven with the roast for the last 30 minutes.
When the roast is done cooking, remove it from the oven. Set aside the juices and half of the mushrooms and cover the roast with a lid. Let it sit for 15 minutes while you make the gravy.
Add the juices and mushrooms, remaining broth, miso paste, and tapioca flour to a blender. Blend on high for one minute, or until a smooth consistency is achieved. Warm up the gravy in a saucepan over medium heat, whisking regularly until it has thickened, about five minutes.
Slice the roast and serve with the remaining mushrooms, gravy, and carrots. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato Nacho Fries
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (large, cut into fries)
2 1/2 tsps
Tapioca Flour
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil
2 tbsps
Taco Seasoning
4 1/4 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)
1/2
Yellow Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
1/2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
1
Tomato (small, diced)
2/3 cup
Black Beans (rinsed, drained)
1 stalk
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, add the sweet potato and tapioca flour. Toss to evenly coat each fry. Add the oil and taco seasoning and toss again.
Spread the sweet potato fries onto the baking sheet in an even layer. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, flipping halfway through. With about five minutes left, push the fries together and sprinkle the cheese over the fries. Put back in the oven until the cheese melts. Broil on high for one to two minutes to brown the cheese, if desired.
Remove from the oven and top with the bell peppers, tomatoes, beans, and onions. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Covered Chestnuts
ingredients:
2 tsps
Coconut Oil
1/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
1 cup
Chestnuts (roasted, deshelled)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a small saucepan over low heat, add the coconut oil and chocolate chips. Stir continuously until the chocolate is melted and smooth.
Transfer the melted chocolate to a bowl. Using a spoon or fork, roll each chestnut in the chocolate until coated. Place the chestnuts onto the baking sheet and sprinkle sea salt over them.
Freeze for 10 to 15 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Asparagus Avocado Toast
ingredients:
1/4 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3/4 cup
Asparagus (chopped, woody ends trimmed)
1/2
Avocado (medium)
1/4
Lime (juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 3/4 ozs
Sourdough Bread (toasted)
1 tbsp
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes (optional)
recipe:
Warm the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the asparagus and sauté for four to five minutes or until the asparagus is fork tender.
In a bowl, add the avocado and lime juice. Mash the avocado with a fork and season with salt and pepper.
Spread the avocado on top of the toast. Top with sautéed asparagus, feta cheese, and chili flakes, if using. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Lava Cakes with Raspberries
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Coconut Oil (melted and cooled)
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2 tsp
Apple Cider Vinegar
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/2 cup
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1/4 cup
Coconut Sugar
2 tbsps
Cocoa Powder
1/2 tsp
Baking Powder
1/8 tsp
Baking Soda
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 ozs
Dark Chocolate (squares)
1/3 cup
Raspberries
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC). Grease the ramekins with oil.
In a large bowl, whisk the coconut oil, milk, vinegar, and vanilla. Add the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Whisk until just combined.
Add half of the batter into each ramekin. Place the chocolate into the center and then fill the ramekins with the remaining batter.
Place the ramekins on a baking sheet and transfer to the oven. Bake for 14 to 15 minutes, until the sides are cooked through and the top is mostly firm to the touch.
Let cool a few minutes to continue cooking. Top with raspberries and serve. Enjoy!

name: Applesauce & Kiwi
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Applesauce
2
Kiwi (sliced)
recipe: Add the applesauce and kiwi to a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Mushroom & Feta Chickpea Omelette
ingredients:
1/8 oz
Avocado Oil Spray (divided)
2
Cremini Mushrooms (sliced)
1/2 cup
Chickpea Flour
1/2 cup
Water
1/4 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Heat half of the avocado oil spray in a large pan over medium heat. Add the mushrooms and sauté for three to four minutes. Remove from the pan and set aside.
Meanwhile, mix the chickpea flour, water, garlic powder, and sea salt together. Spray the pan with the remaining oil spray and add the chickpea mixture. Cook for three minutes.
Fold the omelette in half and remove it from the pan. Top the omelette with mushrooms and feta. Enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Spice Mix
ingredients:
1 tsp
Dried Parsley
2 tsps
Dried Basil
2 tsps
Oregano (dried)
1/2 tsp
Dried Dill
1/2 tsp
Dried Mint
1/2 tsp
Onion Powder
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/4 tsp
Black Pepper
recipe: Combine all ingredients together in a small bowl or jar. Enjoy!

name: Kiwi & Strawberries
ingredients:
2
Kiwi (sliced)
1 cup
Strawberries
recipe: Serve the kiwi with the strawberries. Enjoy!

name: Blueberries & Almonds
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Almonds
1 cup
Blueberries
recipe: Serve the almonds with the blueberries and enjoy!

name: Roasted Beet Hummus with Crackers
ingredients:
1
Beet (small, peeled, cut into small cubes)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 3/4 cups
Chickpeas (drained, rinsed)
1/2 cup
Tahini
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
3/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Water (cold)
1/4 tsp
Cumin
1/2 tsp
Za'atar Spice
12 ozs
Whole Grain Crackers
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Cut a large piece of foil.
Place the beet in the center of the foil and toss with 1/4 of the oil. Wrap tightly and transfer to a baking sheet. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until the beets are tender and cooked through. Let cool.
In a food processor, combine the beets, chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, salt, water, and cumin. Blend on high until very smooth, about one to two minutes.
With the food processor still running, slowly add the remaining oil and continue blending until smooth and incorporated.
Transfer the hummus to a bowl and top with za'atar spice. Serve with crackers and enjoy!

name: Whipped Ricotta & Strawberry Toast
ingredients:
1 cup
Ricotta Cheese
2 slices
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
1 cup
Strawberries (sliced)
2 tsps
Raw Honey
1 1/2 tsps
Mint Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
In a food processor, whip the ricotta until it is creamy, fluffy, and smooth, about one to two minutes.
Spread the whipped ricotta onto the toast. Top with the strawberries, honey, and fresh mint. Enjoy!

name: Raspberry & Date Crumble Bars
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Pitted Dates (soaked for at least 30 minutes)
1 cup
Oats (rolled, divided)
1/2 cup
Almond Flour
1 tbsp
Butter
1 1/2 cups
Raspberries
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Arrowroot Powder
1 1/2 tsps
Lemon Juice
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°F) and line a baking dish with parchment paper.
In a food processor, add the dates and half of the oats. Process until a paste forms. Add the almond flour and butter and pulse a few more times. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in the remaining oats.
Transfer 2/3 of the date mixture to the prepared baking dish. Press the mixture down firmly to create a crust and bake in the oven for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, add the raspberries and maple syrup to a saucepan. Bring the mixture to a simmer and smash the raspberries as they cook. Let simmer for about five to six minutes. Remove from heat. In a small bowl, whisk together the arrowroot powder and lemon juice to create a slurry. Add the slurry to the raspberries and stir until well combined and thickened.
Pour the raspberry mixture over the base in the baking dish and crumble the remaining oat mixture over top. Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Chill in the fridge for about an hour or until set. Slice and enjoy!

name: Quinoa Green Smoothie Bowl
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Quinoa (dry)
1 cup
Water
1 cup
Kale Leaves (destemmed and chopped)
1/2
Banana (sliced)
1/2
Lime (juiced)
1/2
Avocado (medium)
2 tbsps
Vanilla Protein Powder
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package instructions. Let cool.
While the quinoa is cooling, add the remaining ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth.
Add the quinoa to a bowl and pour the smoothie over top. Enjoy!

name: Pink Energy Bites
ingredients:
1 1/3 ozs
Freeze Dried Strawberries
1/2 cup
Pitted Dates
1 cup
Cashews (raw)
1/4 cup
Cashew Butter
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Add the dried strawberries to a food processor and blend until the mixture is powdery. Remove and set aside on a plate. Add the dates, cashews, cashew butter, and salt to the bowl of a food processor. Blend until a smooth consistency is achieved and the mixture holds together.
Remove the mixture and form into small balls with your hands, using about one tablespoon of dough. Roll into the strawberry powder. Repeat until the mixture is used up. Enjoy!

name: Salsa & Avocado Chickpea Omelette
ingredients:
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
1/2 cup
Chickpea Flour
1/2 cup
Water
1/4 tsp
Garlic Powder
2 tbsps
Salsa
1/2
Avocado (medium, sliced)
1 tbsp
Cilantro (chopped)
1/4
Lime (juiced)
recipe:
Heat a cast iron skillet over medium heat. Spray it with avocado oil.
Mix the chickpea flour, water, and garlic powder in a bowl. Pour the mixture into the skillet and cook for three minutes. Fold the omelette in half and remove it from the pan.
Top the chickpea omelette with salsa, avocado, and cilantro. Squeeze the lime over top. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato Fries with Feta
ingredients:
2
Sweet Potato (large, cut into fries)
1 1/2 tbsps
Tapioca Flour
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Oregano (dried, plus more for garnish)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, add the sweet potato and tapioca flour. Toss to evenly coat each fry. Add the oil, salt, and oregano and toss again.
Spread the sweet potatoes onto the baking sheet in an even layer. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, flipping halfway through. Put the fries in a serving bowl and top with feta cheese. Garnish with oregano, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Vegan Crab Cakes
ingredients:
1 2/3 cups
Hearts Of Palm (canned, drained, cut in half)
1/2 cup
Vegan Mayonnaise
2 tsps
Dijon Mustard
2 tsps
Lemon Juice (plus extra for garnish)
2 tsps
Old Bay Seasoning

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4
Nori Sheets (snack size, finely chopped)
4 stalks
Green Onion (finely sliced, plus more for garnish)
1 cup
Bread Crumbs (divided)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Transfer the hearts of palm to a bowl. Using your fingers, gently press and break apart into shreds.
In another bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, Old Bay seasoning, salt, and pepper. Reserve half of this sauce for dipping.
Stir the hearts of palm, nori, and green onions into half of the mayonnaise mixture. Add half of the breadcrumbs and mix in thoroughly but do not mash. Form into equal patties approximately three-inches in diameter.
Spread the remaining breadcrumbs in a small dish. Coat the patties in the breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Place the patties on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them evenly. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until light golden brown.
Serve with the remaining sauce. Top with lemon juice and additional green onions, if using. Enjoy!

name: Mushroom & Walnut Chopped Salad
ingredients:
3
Tomato (diced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (small, diced)
1 stalk
Celery (diced)
4 stalks
Green Onion (sliced, plus more for garnish)
1
Zucchini (small, diced)
1/2 cup
Cilantro (plus more for garnish)
1 tbsp
Taco Seasoning (divided)
1 cup
Walnuts (roughly chopped)
1 cup
Mushrooms
1 tbsp
Coconut Aminos
recipe:
Add the tomatoes, bell peppers, celery, green onions, zucchini, cilantro, and 1/2 of the taco seasoning to a large bowl. Mix well to combine.
Add half of the vegetable mixture into a food processor or blender. Blend until pureed. Return the purée to the original bowl and toss well to combine with the remaining vegetables.
Place the remaining taco seasoning, walnuts, mushrooms, and coconut aminos into the food processor or blender and pulse until crumbly. Don’t over-blend. Remove the mixture from the food processor and stir it into the vegetable mixture.
Divide evenly between plates or bowls and top with extra green onions and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Smashed Chickpea Spinach Salad
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, rinsed)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1
Lemon (large, juiced, divided)
1/2 tsp
Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
4 cups
Baby Spinach
1/2 cup
Microgreens
recipe:
In a bowl, add the chickpeas, half of the oil, half of the lemon juice, paprika, salt, and pepper. Mix to combine. With the back of a fork, lightly mash the chickpeas, leaving some whole.
Heat a pan over medium-low heat and add the chickpeas into the pan with the remaining liquid from the bowl. Stir in the minced garlic. Sauté for four to five minutes. Add a splash of water if needed.
To assemble, evenly divide the spinach, chickpeas, and microgreens into bowls. Drizzle the remaining oil and lemon juice on top. Season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Halloumi Avocado Toast
ingredients:
4 ozs
Halloumi (cut into large pieces)
2 slices
Gluten-Free Bread (toasted)
1/2
Avocado (large, mashed)
3/4 tsp
Raw Honey

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
Warm a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the halloumi slices until golden brown, about one to two minutes per side.
Top the toast with mashed avocado, halloumi, honey, salt, pepper, and chili flakes. Enjoy!

name: Almond, Broccoli & Cabbage Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
1 cup
Purple Cabbage (thinly sliced)
1/4 cup
Raisins
1/4 cup
Slivered Almonds
1/4 cup
Shallot (chopped, divided)
1/3 cup
Orange Juice
1 tbsp
Miso Paste
1 tbsp
Almond Butter
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
recipe:
Add the broccoli, cabbage, raisins, almonds, and half of the shallots together in a bowl.
In a separate bowl or cup, with an immersion blender, blend the orange juice, miso, almond butter, remaining shallots, and oil until smooth. You can also use a mini food processor or small blender.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss to combine. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Shirataki Noodle Tofu Stir Fry
ingredients:
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
12 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, pressed, cubed)
1
Yellow Onion (chopped)
2
Garlic (cloves, large, sliced)
2 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
1 cup
Snap Peas (trimmed)
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
1 tbsp
Sesame Oil
8 ozs
Shirataki Noodles
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the tofu to the pan and brown the tofu on all sides. Remove from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the onion and garlic and sauté for two minutes. Then, add the broccoli, snap peas, rice vinegar, and sesame oil. Sauté for three to four minutes or until tender-crisp.
Add the tofu, noodles, and chili flakes to the pan. Toss well to coat the noodles. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Raw Chocolate Walnut Bars
ingredients:
1 cup
Walnuts
1 cup
Pitted Dates (soaked in warm water for ten minutes)
1 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1/2 cup
Cashews (raw, soaked for at least one hour, rinsed)
2 tbsps
Cacao Powder
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Line a baking dish with parchment paper.
In a food processor or high-powered blender, add the walnuts and dates. Blend until everything is combined into small crumbly pieces.
Add the mixture to the baking dish to make the crust. Use your hands to press down and make an even layer.
In a blender, add the coconut milk, cashews, cacao powder, maple syrup. vanilla, and salt. Blend until smooth.
Pour the chocolate mix onto the crust and use the back of a spoon to spread it out into an even layer. Freeze for at least two hours to set or until the filling is frozen.
Once set, let it thaw for a few minutes before cutting into bars. Serve cold and enjoy!

name: Banana Fritters
ingredients:
3
Banana (medium, ripe)
1 1/4 cups
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1/2 cup
Coconut Sugar
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Coconut Oil
recipe:
Add the bananas, flour, coconut sugar, and sea salt to a blend or food processor. Blend on high for two to three minutes, tampering as needed, until a smooth consistency is achieved.
Add the coconut oil to a pan over medium heat. Once melted, scoop 1/3 cup of batter into the hot coconut oil. Flatten out with a spatula until an even, three-inch patty is formed. Cook for two to three minutes on each side, or until browned and crispy. Set aside on a paper towel.
Repeat until all of the batter is used up. Enjoy!

name: Cabbage & Bell Pepper Noodle Salad
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Tahini (runny)
1 tbsp
Sesame Oil
1
Garlic (clove, small, minced)
1 tsp
Ginger (minced)
1/2
Lime (juiced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2
Yellow Bell Pepper (sliced)
8 ozs
Shirataki Noodles
1 cup
Savoy Cabbage (shredded)
2
Thai Chili (chopped, optional)
recipe:
In a small bowl, mix together the tahini, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, lime juice, and sea salt. Set aside.
In a large bowl, toss the bell pepper, noodles, cabbage, and chili peppers, reserving some chilli peppers for garnish.
Pour the tahini dressing all over the noodle salad and toss to coat well. Garnish with the remaining chili peppers. Enjoy!

name: Vegan Po' Boy
ingredients:
2 1/3 ozs
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
1 1/2 tsps
Cajun Seasoning (divided)
2/3 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 cup
Bread Crumbs
1 2/3 cups
Hearts Of Palm (drained, sliced 1/2 inch thick)
3/4 cup
Vegan Mayonnaise
1 tbsp
Dijon Mustard
9 1/3 ozs
Whole Wheat Bun
1 head
Iceberg Lettuce (small, chopped)
2
Tomato (medium, sliced)
recipe:
Preheat oven to 450ºF (230ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Set up a dredging station. Combine the flour with 2/3 of the Cajun seasoning on a shallow plate. Place the milk in a second shallow plate, and the bread crumbs in a third one.
Drop a hearts of palm piece into the flour mixture, then into the milk, and then into the bread crumbs to coat completely. Place on the prepared baking sheet. Repeat for each piece.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until browned and crispy.
Meanwhile, mix the mayonnaise, mustard, and remaining Cajun seasoning in a small bowl. Set aside.
Spread the Cajun mayonnaise onto the bread. Top with lettuce, tomatoes, and crispy hearts of palm. Enjoy!

name: One Pot Snap Pea & Mackerel Orzo
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Orzo
3 cups
Water
1 cup
Cream, Half & Half
1
Lemon (juiced)
1 1/2 cups
Snap Peas (chopped)
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (reserve some for garnish)
8 ozs
Canned Mackerel (drained and flaked)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)
recipe:
In a large skillet over medium heat, add the orzo, water, cream, and lemon juice. Cook for 15 minutes until the orzo is al dente, being sure to stir often to avoid having the orzo stick to the skillet.
Add the remaining ingredients and cook for two to three minutes or until the peas are slightly softened.
Divide the orzo evenly between plates and garnish with the remaining parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Harissa Roasted Chickpeas & Squash
ingredients:
5 cups
Butternut Squash (cut into wedges)
2 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (drained, rinsed)
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil
1 tbsp
Harissa
3/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
1 tbsp
Cilantro (finely chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet(s) with parchment paper.
Toss the squash and chickpeas on the baking sheet with the oil, harissa, and salt until well coated. Spread out evenly on the baking sheet(s).
Transfer to the oven and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, flipping the squash and shaking the pan halfway through.
In a small bowl, mix together the yogurt and cilantro.
Spread the yogurt mixture onto plates and top with squash and chickpeas. Enjoy!

name: Seafood & Cabbage Miso Soup
ingredients:
7 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
3 tbsps
Sesame Oil
3 tbsps
Coconut Aminos
3 tbsps
Miso Paste
2 tbsps
Ginger (finely chopped)
2 cups
Shiitake Mushrooms (sliced)
4 cups
Napa Cabbage (thinly sliced)
4 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
8 ozs
Shrimp (peeled, deveined, and rinsed)
10 1/2 ozs
Salmon Fillet (skinless, cubed)
recipe:
In a large pot, bring the broth, sesame oil, coconut aminos, miso, and ginger to a boil. Simmer over low heat for five minutes.
Add the mushrooms, cabbage, green onions, shrimp, and salmon to the broth and cook for four to five minutes or until cooked through.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Seafood Jerk Pasta
ingredients:
2 tsps
Avocado Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
4
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1
Yellow Bell Pepper (large, chopped)
1 lb
Shrimp
2 cups
Fire Roasted Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with juices)
1 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1 tbsp
Jerk Seasoning
1/4 cup
Coconut Sugar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
8 ozs
Brown Rice Fettuccine (dry)
1/2 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)
recipe:
Warm the oil in a large high-rimmed pan or pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for one minute. Add the garlic and cook for another minute, then add the bell pepper and continue to cook for five minutes, stirring a few times.
Add the shrimp, tomatoes, coconut milk, jerk seasoning, coconut sugar, salt, and pepper. Simmer, stirring frequently, for 30 minutes or until reduced.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to the package directions.
Once the pasta is done cooking, drain well and add it to the pan with the rest of the ingredients. Stir in the parmesan cheese and mix until well coated. Enjoy!

name: Lemon Tahini Chopped Salad
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Tahini
1
Lemon (small, juiced)
1 tbsp
Water
1
Tomato (large, diced)
1/2
Cucumber (large, diced)
3 tbsps
Parsley (finely chopped)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
In a large bowl, add the tahini, lemon juice, and water. Whisk until smooth.
Add the tomato, cucumber, parsley, and salt to the same bowl. Mix to combine with the dressing. Divide evenly between bowls or onto plates and enjoy!

name: Vanilla Cauliflower Shake
ingredients:
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 cup
Frozen Cauliflower
1
Banana (frozen)
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tbsp
Almond Butter
1 1/2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Protein Overnight Oats
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Oats
3/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/4 cup
Chocolate Protein Powder
1 1/2 tbsps
Cocoa Powder
1 tbsp
Almond Butter
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
1/2 cup
Raspberries (plus extra to garnish)
recipe:
Add all the ingredients to a resealable bowl or container and stir well to combine. Seal and place in the fridge overnight, or for at least eight hours.
Remove the oats from the fridge. Divide evenly between containers and top with additional raspberries, if using. Enjoy!

name: Tamarind Glazed Carrots
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Tamarind Paste
1 1/2 tsps
Water
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1/2 tsp
Cumin
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4
Carrot (medium, cut in half lengthwise)
1 tbsp
Cilantro
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, mix together the tamarind, water, honey, cumin, and chili flakes. Season the mixture with salt and pepper.
Place the carrots on the prepared baking sheet. Brush the carrots all over with the tamarind mixture. Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until the carrots are tender. Top with cilantro and enjoy!

name: Harissa Mushroom Skewers & Hummus
ingredients:
2 cups
Oyster Mushrooms
4
Barbecue Skewers
2 tsps
Harissa
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1 cup
Hummus
2 tbsps
Parsley
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Thread the mushrooms onto the skewers. Brush the harissa all over the mushrooms and sprinkle with salt. Bake in the oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until cooked through. Spread the hummus on a serving plate. Top with mushroom skewers and parsley. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea Pasta Salad
ingredients:
8 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (uncooked)
1/2
Cucumber (small, chopped)
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Lemon (juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Once cooked, set aside to cool for about 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, add the cucumber, tomatoes, onion, feta cheese, and dill. Add in the cooled pasta and mix to combine. Drizzle the oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper on top and mix again.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Harissa Mushroom Shawarma
ingredients:
2 cups
Oyster Mushrooms
4
Barbecue Skewers
2 tsps
Harissa
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Tzatziki
1/2 oz
Pickled Red Onions
2 tbsps
Parsley
2 tbsps
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
2
Whole Wheat Pita (warmed)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Thread the mushrooms onto the skewers. Brush the harissa all over the mushrooms and season with salt. Bake in the oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until cooked through.
Divide the mushrooms, tzatziki, pickled onion, parsley, and feta cheese between the pita bread and enjoy!

name: Baklava-Style Overnight Oats
ingredients:
1 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
2 tsps
Chia Seeds
2 tsps
Raw Honey
2 tsps
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1 cup
Oats
1/4 cup
Pistachios (chopped)
1/4 cup
Walnuts (chopped)
recipe:
In a bowl, combine the coconut milk, chia seeds, honey, lemon juice, cinnamon, and salt. Stir in the oats.
Divide evenly between jars. Refrigerate overnight or for at least eight hours. When ready to serve, top with pistachios and walnuts. Enjoy!

name: Watermelon Paletas
ingredients:
1/3
Seedless Watermelon (chopped)
1/3 cup
Water
1
Lime (juiced)
1 tsp
Cane Sugar
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour into popsicle molds and freeze for five to six hours or until completely frozen. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean & Plantain Rice Bowls
ingredients:
2
Plantain (large, green, sliced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (sliced)
1 cup
Red Onion (diced)
4
Garlic (cloves, minced, divided)
1/4 cup
Avocado Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry)
1
Lime (juice and zest)
1/3 cup
Cilantro
2 tbsps
Raw Honey
3 cups
Black Beans (drained, rinsed)
1
Avocado (medium, diced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Add the plantain, red pepper, red onion, half of the garlic, half of the oil, salt, and pepper to a bowl. Toss to combine and spread everything out on a baking sheet. Cook in the oven for 30 minutes, or until the plantain slices are fork-tender.
Meanwhile, cook the rice according to package directions.
Using an immersion blender, blend the remaining oil, garlic, lime juice, lime zest, cilantro, and honey together. You can also add to a blender. Blend until a smooth consistency is achieved. Set aside.
Divide everything evenly between bowls. Top with the avocado and dressing. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Kiwi Paletas
ingredients:
2 cups
Strawberries (stems removed)
2
Kiwi (peeled, roughly chopped)
1/2 cup
Water
2 tsps
Cane Sugar
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth.
Use popsicle molds or pour into paper cups and insert each popsicle stick into a small piece of strawberry to anchor it into each cup.
Freeze for five to six hours or until completely frozen. Enjoy!

name: Mango Coconut Bites
ingredients:
1
Mango (large, peeled and diced)
2/3 cup
Coconut Flour
1/2 tsp
Cardamom
1/4 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1/4 cup
Raw Honey
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil
1 1/3 cups
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut (divided)
recipe:
Add the mango, coconut flour, cardamom, coconut milk, honey, coconut oil, and 3/4 of the shredded coconut to a food processor. Process until a slightly sticky dough has formed. Add the remaining shredded coconut to a small bowl.
Roll the dough into balls, roughly two inches in diameter, then roll each of them in the shredded coconut until completely coated. Set on a plate or baking sheet.
Enjoy immediately or transfer to the fridge or freezer.

name: Roasted Vegetable & Chickpea Salad with Cilantro Chimichurri
ingredients:
3
Carrot (medium, chopped)
1 cup
Red Onion (chopped)
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/3 cups
Chickpeas (drained, rinsed)
5 ozs
Roasted Red Peppers (sliced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the carrot and red onion on the baking sheet. Spray with avocado oil and season with salt and pepper. Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until the vegetables are cooked.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix together the cilantro, lemon juice, garlic, chili flakes, and olive oil. Season with salt and set aside.
Place the chickpeas, roasted red pepper, carrot, and red onion on a plate. Top with the cilantro chimichurri and enjoy!

name: Turkish Simit
ingredients:
16 ozs
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
2 tbsps
Cane Sugar
1 1/2 tsps
Instant Yeast
1 cup
Water (warm, divided)
1 tsp
Sea Salt
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
2 tbsps
Fancy Molasses
1/4 cup
Sesame Seeds
recipe:
In a mixing bowl, combine the flour, sugar, and yeast. Add 3/4 of the warm water. Mix with a fork, then add the salt. Transfer the dough to a working surface. Knead with your hands for about 10 minutes to form a ball. Spray a bowl with avocado oil. Place the dough in the bowl and cover it with a damp towel. Let sit at room temperature for 60 minutes or until doubled in size.
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Punch down the dough and form it into a log. Divide into even pieces, one piece per serving. Roll each dough ball into a long thin strand, about 24 inches long. Flip in half so the ends meet. Twist the dough onto itself to form a spiraled rope. Pinch the ends together and repeat till all the dough is formed.
Combine the molasses and the remaining water in a bowl and add the sesame seeds to another bowl. Dip the dough circles into the molasses and coat both sides. Then place the dough in the sesame seeds and coat both sides again. Place them on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from the oven and allow to cool for five minutes before serving. Enjoy!

name: Halloumi & Olive Spaghetti
ingredients:
4 1/2 ozs
Whole Wheat Spaghetti
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
5 ozs
Halloumi (sliced)
1 cup
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with juices)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Green Olives (pitted, halved)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Reserve pasta water and drain.
Warm a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the halloumi slices until golden brown, about one to two minutes per side. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add the tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Let simmer on low heat for about five minutes. Add the olives, cooked pasta, and pasta water. Stir and toss to combine.
Divide the pasta evenly between plates. Top with parsley and halloumi. Enjoy!

name: Mango Thai Pasta Salad
ingredients:
8 ozs
Whole Wheat Spaghetti
3 tbsps
Sesame Oil
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
2 tbsps
Coconut Aminos
2 tbsps
Tahini
1
Garlic (clove, large, minced)
2 tsps
Ginger (freshly grated)
1
Mango (large, peeled & diced)
2 cups
Purple Cabbage (thinly sliced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (sliced)
1 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to package directions. Once the pasta is done cooking, run it under cold water for a minute and drain well.
Meanwhile, prepare the sauce by whisking together the sesame oil, lime juice, coconut aminos, tahini, garlic, and ginger in a bowl.
Combine the pasta, mango, cabbage, red pepper, and basil in a large bowl. Mix well. Add the sauce and toss to completely coat. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Black Bean & Avocado Dip
ingredients:
1
