Avocado (medium)
1 cup
Black Beans (drained, rinsed)
1
Lime (juiced)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
1
Jalapeno Pepper (seeds removed, finely diced)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (finely diced)
recipe:
Add the avocado, black beans, lime juice, and salt to a blender. Blend until smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a serving bowl. Add in the cilantro, jalapeño, and red onion. Mix well and enjoy!

name: Halloumi & Tahini on Toast
ingredients:
2 ozs
Halloumi (sliced)
1 tbsp
Tahini
1 3/4 ozs
Sourdough Bread (toasted)
1 1/2 tsps
Raw Honey
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
Warm a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the halloumi slices until golden brown, about one to two minutes per side.
Spread the tahini over the sourdough bread. Top with halloumi, honey, and chili flakes. Enjoy!

name: Samosa-Style Baked Potatoes
ingredients:
2
Russet Potato (medium)
1/2 cup
Frozen Peas (thawed)
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil (melted)
1 1/2 tsps
Cumin Seed
2 tsps
Curry Powder
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2
Lime (juiced)
1 tbsp
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat your oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Pierce the potatoes all over with a fork. Place on a pan and bake for 45 to 50 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the potatoes from the oven. Once cool enough to handle, cut them down the middle and spoon out inside of the potatoes into a medium bowl.
Add the peas, coconut oil, cumin, curry powder, and smoked paprika to the bowl. Mix everything together and season with salt and pepper.
Add the mixture back to the hollowed-out potatoes. Place back into the oven and cook for another 10 minutes. Top with lime juice and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Cardamom Tea
ingredients:
2 cups
Cow's Milk, Reduced Fat
1 cup
Water
1/4 oz
Black Tea Leaves
1 tbsp
Cardamom Seeds
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a saucepan. Bring to simmer and let it simmer for up to 10 minutes on low heat. Strain and serve, enjoy!

name: Garlic & Thyme Yuca Mash
ingredients:
4 cups
Yuca (peeled and cubed)
3
Garlic (cloves, large, in peel)
1/2 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Butter
1/4 cup
Cow's Milk, Whole
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Thyme (fresh, removed from sprigs)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Bring a pot of water to boil and add the yuca. Cook for 20 minutes, or until fork-tender.
Meanwhile, coat the garlic cloves in oil and place on a baking sheet. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes, then peel.
Once the yuca is done, drain well and remove the inner stringy cores. Transfer to a food processor along with the roasted garlic, butter, milk, and salt. Process until smooth, adding more milk as needed until desired consistency, one tablespoon at a time.
Stir in the thyme. Enjoy!

name: Garam Masala Fries
ingredients:
2
Russet Potato (large, cut into fries)
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil
2 tsps
Garam Masala
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the fries onto the baking sheet and toss them with the oil, garam masala, and salt.
Spread them out into an even later and bake for 15 minutes. Flip and continue to bake for another 10 to 15 minutes or until golden and crispy.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Aloo Bhindi
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
3
Yellow Potato (peeled, diced)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
2
Garlic (cloves, large, minced)
1
Yellow Onion (diced)
1 cup
Okra (trimmed and chopped)
1 tbsp
Ginger (freshly grated)
1 1/2 cups
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with the juices)
1 tbsp
Garam Masala
2 tsps
Turmeric
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Heat half of the oil in a large skillet. Add the potatoes and half of the salt and cook, covered over medium heat. Cook the potato until it is crispy and tender, about 10 minutes. If the potato sticks to the pan, you can add some water to loosen and steam the potato as it continues to cook. Remove the potato from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining oil to the same skillet. Add the garlic, onion, okra, and ginger. Cook until the okra softens, about five to seven minutes. Then, add the tomatoes to deglaze the pan, being sure to scrape up the browned bits.
Add the remaining salt and spices. Mix well. Add the potatoes back to the skillet, and stir to coat them in the tomato mixture. Garnish with parsley and enjoy!

name: Spinach & Mango Protein Chia Pudding
ingredients:
1 3/4 cups
Canned Coconut Milk
1/4 cup
Chia Seeds
1 cup
Baby Spinach (packed)
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1
Mango (medium, peed and diced)
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients except the mango and hemp seeds to a blender. Blend on high for at least one minute or until a very smooth consistency is achieved.
Scoop the pudding into bowls or containers and secure with a lid. Transfer to the fridge to set for at least one hour.
Top with mango and hemp seeds. Enjoy!

name: Yuca Con Mojo
ingredients:
4 cups
Yuca (peeled, chopped)
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil
1/2
White Onion (diced)
6
Garlic (cloves, large, minced)
1/3 cup
Orange Juice
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
1 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Parsley (fresh, chopped, optional)
recipe:
Bring a pot of water to a boil and add the yuca. Boil for 30 minutes, or until fork-tender. Drain well, then remove the inner stringy cores.
Meanwhile, warm the oil in a pan over medium-low heat. Add the onion, cook for one minute, then add the garlic. Stir and cook for another minute, then add the orange juice and lime juice. Simmer on low for 15 minutes, covered. Season with salt.
Add the yuca to a bowl and pour the citrus sauce over top. Cover, and steam for 10 minutes.
Top with parsley if desired, serve, and enjoy!

name: Farro & Roasted Vegetable Salad
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (large, peeled, diced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
2 tbsps
Butter (melted)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Farro (uncooked, rinsed)
2 tbsps
Tahini
1/4 cup
Water (warm)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped, plus more for garnish)
2 cups
Mixed Greens
2 tbsps
Pecans (toasted, chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Add the sweet potato, bell pepper, melted butter, and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat. Cook for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the farro, according to the package directions.
Add the tahini to a small bowl and whisk in the water, until smooth. Add the cilantro and season with salt and pepper.
Place the mixed greens, roasted vegetables, farro, and pecans in a bowl. Drizzle with the tahini dressing. Top with more cilantro if desired. Enjoy!

name: Tahini Date Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1
Banana (frozen)
3 tbsps
Pitted Dates
2 tbsps
Tahini
1/4 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon
1/8 tsp
Cardamom (optional)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Chimichurri Corn Crostini
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
1 cup
Corn
2 ozs
Sourdough Baguette (sliced, toasted)
recipe:
In a bowl, mix together the parsley, oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and chili flakes. Add the corn and stir well to combine.
Top the sliced baguettes with the corn mixture. Enjoy!

name: Foul Mudammas
ingredients:
2 1/4 cups
Fava Beans (from the can, drained and rinsed)
1/2 cup
Water
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (diced)
1/4
Jalapeno Pepper (minced)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Parsley (curly, chopped)
1
Whole Wheat Pita
recipe:
Add the fava beans, water, and salt to a pot and heat over medium heat. Use a potato masher to gently mash about half of the beans, leaving some chunky pieces. Scoop into a shallow serving bowl.
In a small bowl mix the garlic, tomatoes, jalapeño, and lemon juice. Add to the top of the fava beans. Drizzle the oil on top and garnish with parsley. Serve with pita and enjoy!

name: Chili Lime Corn Chips
ingredients:
5
Corn Tortilla (6-inch)
3 tbsps
Avocado Oil
1
Lime (medium, juiced)
2 tsps
Chili Powder
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C).
Stack the tortillas and cut them into triangle shaped chips.
In a small bowl combine the oil, lime juice, and chili powder.
Arrange the tortilla chips onto a large baking sheet in a single layer and lightly brush each side of the chips with the chili lime mix.
Bake for four to five minutes per side. Take them out of the oven and sprinkle the salt all over. Transfer them to a wire rack and let them cool for 10 minutes. They will crisp up as they cool. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker White Bean & Potato Soup
ingredients:
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
4
Garlic (cloves, minced)
3 tbsps
Tomato Paste
2 tsps
Italian Seasoning

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Cannellini Beans (drained, rinsed)
3
Russet Potato (medium, cut into large chunks)
3 cups
Vegetable Broth
2 cups
Crushed Tomatoes (from the can)
recipe:
Turn your pressure cooker to "sauté" and add a splash of broth or water. Once hot, add the onion and cook, stirring often for three to four minutes, until softened.
Add the garlic, tomato paste, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper, and cook for one to two minutes. Add the cannellini beans and potatoes and stir. Add the broth to deglaze the pot and scrape up any bits. Turn "sauté" off.
Add the tomatoes on top and do not stir. Put the lid on and set to “sealing” then press manual/pressure cooker and cook for five minutes on high pressure. Once finished, let the pressure release naturally for ten minutes, then do a quick release.
Carefully remove the lid. Stir and then divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Avocado Toast with Chickpeas & Tomatoes
ingredients:
1/2
Avocado (large, peeled, and diced)
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 slices
Gluten-Free Bread (toasted)
1 cup
Chickpeas (drained, rinsed)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
Combine the avocado, yogurt, salt, and pepper to taste in a bowl and mash with a fork until smooth.
Evenly spread the avocado and yogurt mash over the toast. Top with chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, and hemp seeds. Enjoy!

name: Harissa Roasted Cauliflower
ingredients:
1 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
1/4 cup
Harissa
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Fresh Dill
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 420ºF (215ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, toss the cauliflower with harissa and salt.
Transfer to the baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes, remove, flip, and bake for ten minutes more.
Divide evenly between bowl, top with dill, and enjoy!

name: Smoked Oyster & Spinach Rice
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry)
1 tbsp
Butter
3
Garlic (cloves, minced)
3 ozs
Smoked Oysters (from the can, drained)
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
3 cups
Baby Spinach (packed)
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to package directions.
Meanwhile, warm the butter in a pan over medium heat. Add the garlic, stir for one minute, then add the smoked oysters. Cook for two to three minutes, then add the lemon juice and cook for another two minutes. Add the spinach and continue to cook, stirring, for five minutes, until wilted. Add the smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
When the rice is done, combine with the oyster and spinach mixture and stir until incorporated. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Garam Masala Popcorn
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Popcorn Kernels
2 tbsps
Coconut Oil
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Garam Masala
recipe:
In a large deep pot, add the popcorn kernels, coconut oil, and sea salt. Cover with a lid and turn the stove on low heat.
Let the kernels pop. Hold the lid on tightly and give the pot a little shake occasionally. Once the popping slows to one pop per every few seconds, turn off the heat.
Pour the popcorn into a bowl right away and sprinkle on the garam masala. Toss to combine. Serve and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Crispy Chickpeas
ingredients:
2 cups
Chickpeas (drained, rinsed)
1 1/2 tsps
Avocado Oil
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 tsp
Garlic Powder
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 390ºF (200ºC).
In a bowl, mix together the chickpeas, oil, smoked paprika, salt, and garlic powder.
Transfer the chickpeas to the air fryer and bake for 12 to 14 minutes, shaking the tray halfway through, until crispy and browned. Enjoy!

name: No Bake Frosted Carrot Cake Bars
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Almond Flour
3/4 cup
Coconut Flour
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
1/2 cup
Pureed Pumpkin
3/4 cup
Cashew Butter (divided)
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk (divided)
1 cup
Grated Carrot (finely grated)
3/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
recipe:
Line a square baking dish with parchment paper. In a large bowl, combine the almond flour, coconut flour, cinnamon, and half of the salt. Mix well.
In another bowl, combine the pumpkin purée, 2/3 of the cashew butter, maple syrup, and 1/4 of the almond milk. Mix until well combined, then add to the dry ingredients and continue to mix until a batter has formed.
Add the grated carrot into the dough and kneed with your hands until fully incorporated.
Add the dough to the prepared baking dish and spread it evenly across the pan with your hands.
In a bowl, add the protein powder, remaining salt, remaining cashew butter, and remaining almond milk. Mix well until smooth. If needed, add more milk until desired frosting consistency, one tablespoon at a time.
Spread the frosting evenly over top of the dough with a spatula. Transfer to the fridge to set for at least 30 minutes. Slice, serve, and enjoy!

name: Harissa Roasted Cauliflower Pitas
ingredients:
1 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
1/4 cup
Harissa

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tsps
Tahini
2 tbsps
Water
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
4 1/3 ozs
Mini Whole Wheat Pita
2 1/16 ozs
Pickled Red Onions
1
Cucumber (medium, sliced)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, toss the cauliflower with harissa and season with salt.
Transfer to the baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes, remove, flip, and bake for ten minutes more.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk together the tahini, water, and lemon juice until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.
Cut the pitas in half and stuff them with roasted cauliflower, pickled onion, cucumber, and dill. Top with tahini sauce and enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Cauliflower Soup
ingredients:
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
4
Garlic (cloves, minced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth
2 cups
Cannellini Beans (drained, rinsed)
1 cup
Cashews (raw)
1 head
Cauliflower (small, chopped into florets)
1/3 cup
Nutritional Yeast
1/4 oz
Thyme Sprigs
recipe:
Turn your pressure cooker to "sauté" and add a splash of broth or water. Once hot, add the onion and cook, stirring often for four to five minutes, until softened.
Add the garlic and season with salt and pepper and cook for one minute more. Turn "sauté" off. Add the broth, cannellini beans, cashews, cauliflower, nutritional yeast, and thyme. Stir to combine. Put the lid on and set to “sealing”. Press manual/pressure cooker and cook for seven minutes on high pressure. Once finished, let the pressure release naturally for five minutes, then do a quick release.
Carefully remove the lid and remove the thyme sprigs. Purée with an immersion blender or carefully transfer to a blender and blend until completely smooth and creamy. Divide into bowls, top with thyme and season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Muhammarra Chickpea Skillet
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (chopped)
4
Garlic (cloves, minced)
4 1/2 ozs
Roasted Red Peppers (drained and chopped)
1/2 cup
Walnuts (chopped, divided)
2 tsps
Chili Flakes (divided)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Tomato Paste
1 3/4 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
2 tbsps
Parsley (curly, chopped)
1
Whole Wheat Pita (toasted)
recipe:
In a large skillet over medium heat, add the oil, onion, garlic, red peppers, half of the walnuts, half of the chili flakes, sea salt, and tomato paste. Cook until the onion has softened and everything is fragrant, about five minutes.
Transfer everything to a high-powered blender or food processor. Pulse until the mixture is somewhat smooth but still textured. Return the mixture to the skillet.
Add the chickpeas to the skillet to warm, stirring to combine. Once warmed through, transfer to a shallow serving plate. Garnish with the remaining walnuts, chili flakes, and parsley. Serve with pita bread. Enjoy!

name: Millet, Corn & Zucchini Fritters
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Millet (dry)
2 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth
1/2
Yellow Onion (small, diced)
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1/3 cup
Corn
1
Zucchini (medium, shredded)
1 tsp
Cumin
3 tbsps
Arrowroot Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Coconut Oil
recipe:
Bring the millet and vegetable broth to a boil on the stove. Cover, reduce the heat to low, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Combine the cooked millet with the remaining ingredients, except for the coconut oil, into a large bowl. Mix well to combine.
Melt the coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat. Use a 1/2 cup measuring cup to scoop the millet mixture into your hands. Form a patty that is approximately three inches in diameter. Fry the fritters for 20 to 30 minutes, until browned and crispy, flipping a few times as needed.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Elk Enchilada Bowl
ingredients:
1 cup
Brown Rice (dry)
8 ozs
Ground Elk
2 tbsps
Taco Seasoning
1 1/2 cups
Enchilada Sauce
3 1/2 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)
3 stalks
Green Onion (chopped thinly)
1
Avocado (medium, sliced)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped, plus more for garnish)
1/2 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt (optional)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Grease a large oven proof skillet or pan.
Cook the rice according to package directions.
In a bowl, combine the ground meat and taco seasoning. Mix well using your hands. Roll into balls roughly the size of a golf ball and place in the prepared skillet. Bake for 20 minutes in the oven.
Remove from the oven and pour the enchilada sauce over the meatballs and top with cheese and green onions. Continue to bake for 10 to 15 minutes until bubbling hot.
Serve with rice, sliced avocado, cilantro, and yogurt if desired. Enjoy!

name: Savory Amaranth Pancakes
ingredients:
1 cup
Amaranth
2 tbsps
Ground Flax Seed
1 tsp
Baking Powder
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1 tsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 cups
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
3/4 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
3 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Add the amaranth to blender or food processor and blend until a flour consistency is achieved. Transfer to a mixing bowl and add the ground flax, baking powder, garlic powder, and sea salt. Mix well to combine.
Add the coconut milk and half of the oil. Stir until a thick but slightly runny batter is formed. Let it sit for five minutes.
Meanwhile, warm the remaining oil in a non-stick frying pan or skillet. Scoop 1/3 cup of batter per pancake onto the pan and cook for approximately five minutes on each side, until browned and cooked through.
Serve with the coconut yogurt, tomatoes, and parsley. Enjoy!

name: Mango, Hemp & Chia Overnight Parfait
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Chia Seeds
1/2 cup
Oats (rolled)
1 1/4 cups
Cow's Milk, Whole
1/4 cup
Frozen Mango
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
In a large bowl, mix the chia seeds, oats, and milk together. Let sit for five minutes.
Alternate layers of the oat mixture, mango, and hemp seeds in glass jars until all ingredients are used. Cover and refrigerate overnight or for at least eight hours. Enjoy!

name: Brie & Tomato Pie with Mixed Greens
ingredients:
1/4 oz
Unbleached All Purpose Flour (for dusting)
8 ozs
Puff Pastry (thawed)
2
Tomato (sliced)
3 1/2 ozs
Brie Cheese (sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tsp
Herbes De Provence
6 cups
Mixed Greens
2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinaigrette
recipe:
With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Use the flour to lightly dust onto a flat surface. Roll out the puff pastry into a rectangle, about 1/2 inch thick.
Lay the sliced tomatoes on top, then the brie, and season with salt, pepper, and Herbes de Provence.
Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown.
Divide onto plates. Serve with the mixed greens topped with balsamic vinaigrette and enjoy!

name: Matzo Granola
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Pecans (roughly chopped)
1/2 cup
Walnuts (roughly chopped)
1/2 cup
Almonds (roughly chopped)
1 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Flakes
1 oz
Matzo (unsalted)
1/4 cup
Coconut Oil (melted, slightly cooled)
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
2 tsps
Vanilla Extract
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, add the pecans, walnuts, almonds, coconut flakes, and matzo. Mix to combine.
Add the coconut oil, maple syrup, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and salt. Stir to combine.
Add the granola to the baking sheet and spread it out into an even layer. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until everything is golden brown. Check on it every five minutes and toss it around. Remove from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes. It will crisp up as it cools. Enjoy!

name: Elk, Mushroom & Brie Burger
ingredients:
1 lb
Ground Elk
1 tbsp
Steak Spice Seasoning
1 tbsp
Worcestershire Sauce
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
2 cups
Mushrooms (finely sliced)
3 1/2 ozs
Brie Cheese
2 tbsps
Dijon Mustard
8 ozs
Whole Wheat Bun (toasted)
2 cups
Mixed Greens
recipe:
In a bowl combine the meat, steak seasoning, and Worcestershire sauce. Form the meat into equal patties, approximately four inches in diameter. Set aside.
Heat half of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for five minutes or until mostly golden brown on all sides. Set aside.
Add the remaining oil to the same skillet and cook the patties for three to four minutes per side. Top each patty with cheese. Continue cooking until the cheese is melted and the meat is cooked to your preferred doneness.
Spread the mustard on the insides of the buns. Top with a patty, mushrooms, and mixed greens. Enjoy!

name: Lebanese Musabaha
ingredients:
2 cups
Chickpeas (from the can, drained, divided)
1/2 cup
Water
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2
Garlic (clove, small, minced)
3 tbsps
Tahini (runny)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Parsley (minced)
1/2 tsp
Cumin
2
Whole Wheat Pita
recipe:
Add the chickpeas to a pot with water and salt. Bring to a simmer and cook for two minutes. This step is meant to heat the chickpeas and soften them.
Add 3/4 of the chickpeas to a food processor along with the water they were warmed in, garlic, tahini, lemon juice, and half of the oil. Pulse until you get a chunky mixture. The texture should be runnier than hummus.
Add the chickpea mixture to a serving dish. Garnish with the reserved chickpeas, the remaining oil, parsley, and cumin. Serve with pita. Enjoy!

name: Banana & Pecan Chia Overnight Parfait
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Cow's Milk, Whole
1/4 cup
Chia Seeds
1/2 cup
Oats (rolled)
1
Banana (medium, sliced)
1/4 cup
Pecans
recipe:
In a large bowl mix the milk, chia seeds, and oats together and let sit for five minutes.
Alternate layers of the oat mixture, banana, and pecans in glass jars until all ingredients are used. Cover and refrigerate overnight or for at least eight hours. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Steamed Artichokes
ingredients:
2
Artichoke (washed)
1 cup
Water
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Dijon Mustard
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Prepare your artichokes by trimming the tips and excess stem. Snip the spiky ends of the leaves. Cut the base of the stem off so that the artichokes rest flat, bloom side up.
Place the rack insert into the pressure cooker so that the artichokes can sit above the water.
Add the water and then place the artichokes, stem side up on top of the rack in a single layer.
Close the lid and set to "sealing". Press manual/pressure cooker and cook for 15 minutes on high pressure. Once finished, manually release the pressure. Carefully remove the artichokes from the pressure cooker.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl or jar, mix the oil, mustard, lemon juice, honey, and salt.
Enjoy by peeling the artichoke leaves and dipping the fleshy end into the dressing. Use your teeth to scrape the flesh and discard the remaining of the leaf. Repeat until you reach the fuzzy choke. Scrape out and discard this part. Find the artichoke heart underneath, dip, and enjoy!

name: Sole, Collard Greens & Brown Rice
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Brown Rice (dry)
1 tbsp
Butter (divided)
8 ozs
Sole Fillet
2 cups
Collard Greens (chopped)
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to package directions.
Heat half of the butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add the sole fillets and cook until lightly browned and cooked through, about five minutes, flipping halfway. Set aside.
Heat the remaining butter in the skillet. Add the collard greens and sauté for about three to five minutes or until cooked down.
Evenly divide the rice, sole, and collard greens between plates. Garnish with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Matzo Ricotta Pizza
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Ricotta Cheese
1 tbsp
Basil Leaves (chopped, plus extra for garnish)
1/4
Lemon (juiced and zested)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/16 ozs
Matzo
1/3 cup
Marinara Sauce
1 tbsp
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, combine together the ricotta, basil, lemon juice, and zest. Season with salt and pepper.
Place matzo on the baking sheet. Spread the marinara evenly over the matzo. Spoon the ricotta mixture on top and sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Bake in the oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Garnish with basil leaves and enjoy!

name: Bagel with Ghee
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Ghee
1
Bagel (plain, sliced in half, toasted)
recipe: Spread the ghee onto each side of the bagel and enjoy!

name: Sole, Mashed Potatoes & Green Beans
ingredients:
4
Yellow Potato (peeled and chopped)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Butter (divided)
2 cups
Green Beans (trimmed)
8 ozs
Sole Fillet
2 tsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Add the potatoes to a pot and cover with water. Boil for ten minutes or until the potatoes fall off of a fork when pierced. Drain.
Add salt and half of the butter. Mash the potatoes until they are your desired texture.
Place the green beans in a steamer basket over boiling water and cover. Steam for three to five minutes.
In a large skillet, heat the remaining butter over medium heat. Add the sole fillets and cook until lightly browned and cooked through, about five minutes, flipping halfway.
Plate the sole, mashed potatoes, and green beans. Garnish with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Lettuce & Tomato Bagel Sandwich
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Cream Cheese, Regular
1
Bagel (plain, toasted)
1/2
Tomato (medium, sliced)
1/8 head
Iceberg Lettuce (small, leaves pulled apart)
recipe: Spread the cream cheese onto the bagel. Top with tomato slices and iceberg lettuce. Enjoy!

name: One Pan Trout, Green Beans & Radishes
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Red Onion (minced)
1 tbsp
Coconut Aminos
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Rainbow Trout Fillet
1 cup
Frozen Green Beans (trimmed)
1/2 cup
Radishes (quartered)
1 tbsp
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix the onion, coconut aminos, and oil in a bowl. Add the trout, green beans, and radishes onto the baking sheet. Add the marinade to evenly coat all of the ingredients. Bake for 15 minutes, or until everything is cooked through.
Divide evenly between plates. Garnish with the cilantro and enjoy!

name: Chermoula Trout
ingredients:
1 cup
Parsley (chopped)
1 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
2
Garlic (cloves)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Lemon (juiced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Cumin
3
Rainbow Trout Fillet
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add all of the ingredients except for the trout to a food processor and blend until you get a somewhat smooth yet still textured mixture.
Place the trout fillets on the baking sheet. Set aside some of the chermoula for serving and spoon the rest on the fillets. Bake for 15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve the trout with the reserved chermoula and enjoy!

name: Broccoli, Carrot & Quinoa Skillet
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (uncooked)
1/2 tsp
Sesame Oil
2 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
1
Carrot (medium, diced)
1/2
Yellow Bell Pepper (medium, sliced)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (diced)
2 tsps
Smoked Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to package directions.
Meanwhile, heat the sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the broccoli, carrots, bell pepper, and red onion. Sauté for seven to eight minutes. Add the paprika and cooked quinoa. Season with salt and pepper and cook for another three to four minutes.
Before serving, stir in the green onion. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Chermoula Trout & Quinoa
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Quinoa (dry)
1 cup
Parsley (chopped)
1 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
2
Garlic (cloves)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Lemon (juiced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Cumin
3
Rainbow Trout Fillet
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to package directions.
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the parsley, cilantro, garlic, oil, lemon juice, salt, and cumin to a food processor. Blend until you get a somewhat smooth yet still textured mixture.
Place the trout fillets on the baking sheet. Set aside some of the chermoula for serving and spoon the rest on the fillets. Bake for 15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve the trout with the reserved chermoula and quinoa. Enjoy!

name: Mango Banana Overnight Millet Porridge
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Millet (dry)
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1
Banana (medium, peeled and sliced, divided)
1
Mango (medium, peeled and chopped, divided)
3/4 cup
Cow's Milk, Whole
1/2 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
recipe:
Cook the millet according to package directions. Allow to cool for five minutes.
In a mixing bowl, combine the cooked millet, chia seeds, salt, maple syrup, half of the banana, half of the mango, and the milk. Stir until fully mixed.
Divide into sealable jars or containers and refrigerate for at least one hour, or overnight.
Top with yogurt and the remaining fruit. Enjoy!

name: Broccoli with Nutritional Yeast
ingredients:
2 cups
Frozen Broccoli
1 tbsp
Nutritional Yeast
recipe:
Bring a 1/2-inch of salted water to boil in a large pan. Add the broccoli, cover, and cook for about three to five minutes or until the broccoli is bright green.
Drain, top with nutritional yeast, and enjoy!

name: Salty Roasted Fennel
ingredients:
2 bulbs
Fennel (medium, sliced into wedges)
1 1/2 tbsps
Tamari
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the fennel on the baking sheet and brush it all over with tamari. Bake in the oven for about 20 to 25 minutes or until golden and tender. Enjoy!

name: Broccoli with Parmesan
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Butter
3 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
1/3 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (shredded)
recipe:
Heat the butter in a pan over medium heat. Add the broccoli and mix around to coat them in the butter. Cook for four to five minutes or until tender-crisp.
Add the broccoli to a serving bowl and sprinkle the cheese on top. Toss to combine. Enjoy!

name: Mashed Chickpea & Sauerkraut Sandwich
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Chickpeas (drained, rinsed)
3 tbsps
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Parsley (finely chopped)
2 slices
Rye Bread
1 tbsp
Sauerkraut
1/8 head
Iceberg Lettuce (torn into pieces)
recipe:
Add the chickpeas, yogurt, salt, and parsley to a bowl. Mash with a fork or potato masher until desired consistency.
Scoop the chickpea mixture onto one slice of bread and spread evenly. Top with sauerkraut, lettuce, and the remaining piece of bread. Slice in half if desired. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Sumac Carrots
ingredients:
6
Carrot (medium, cut in half lengthwise)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Ground Sumac
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the carrots onto the baking sheet. Toss the carrots with oil and sumac until evenly coated.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, flipping halfway through, or until the carrots are cooked to your liking. Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Sole, Cilantro Rice & Cabbage
ingredients:
1 cup
Basmati Rice (dry)
1 tbsp
Butter
8 cups
Green Cabbage (chopped)
2 tbsps
Lime Juice (divided)
2 tsps
Garlic Powder (divided)
1 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
1 1/4 lbs
Sole Fillet
1/3 cup
Cilantro (finely chopped)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions. Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C).
Melt the butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add the cabbage and cook for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Add half of the lime juice, half of the garlic powder, and half of the sea salt. Continue to cook for another five to 10 minutes, until the cabbage is completely cooked through.
Meanwhile, add the sole to a baking sheet and poke it several times with a fork. Pour the remaining lime juice over top. Season with the remaining garlic powder and salt. Bake in the oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Stir the cilantro into the rice. Divide the rice, cabbage, and fish fillets evenly between plates. Enjoy!

name: Asparagus with Coconut Aminos
ingredients:
1 cup
Asparagus (trimmed)
2 tbsps
Coconut Aminos
recipe:
Fill a non-stick pan with an inch or two of water. Bring the water to a boil and blanch the asparagus for one to two minutes or until tender-crisp.
Reduce the heat to medium. Drain the water and add the coconut aminos to the pan. Keep the asparagus moving in the pan and cook for one to two minutes, or until well coated. Enjoy!

name: Seared Scallops with Spring Pea Purée
ingredients:
2 cups
Fresh Peas (or frozen)
1/4 cup
Vegetable Broth
1 tbsp
Mint Leaves (plus extra for garnish)
3 tbsps
Butter (divided)
1
Lemon (juiced, divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
10 ozs
Scallops
recipe:
In a saucepan, add the peas, vegetable broth, mint leaves, and 1/3 of the butter. Let simmer for about five minutes or until the peas are soft.
Transfer to a food processor and blend until smooth. Stir in half of the lemon juice and season with salt and pepper. Set aside.
Place the scallops on a paper towel-lined plate and pat them very dry. Season with salt and pepper. Heat a cast-iron skillet over medium heat and add half of the remaining butter. Add the scallops and cook for three to four minutes on one side. Flip and cook for one to two more minutes. During the last 30 seconds, add the remaining butter and spoon it over top of the scallops.
Divide the pea purée and scallops evenly between plates. Top with lemon juice and extra mint leaves, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea & Lentil Brussels Sprouts Salad
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
White Wine Vinegar
1/2 tsp
Dijon Mustard
1/2 tsp
Raw Honey
1/4 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/4 tsp
Onion Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Brussels Sprouts (shaved)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, rinsed)
1/2 cup
Green Lentils (cooked, rinsed in cold water)
recipe:
In a large bowl, whisk together the oil, vinegar, mustard, honey, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
To the same bowl, add the Brussels sprouts, chickpeas, and lentils. Mix well to combine with the dressing. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Fruit Cocktail Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Grapes
1
Banana (sliced)
1/4
Cantaloupe (small, chopped)
1 cup
Strawberries (chopped)
1/2 cup
Blueberries
recipe: Add all of the fruit to a bowl and mix to combine. Divide into bowls or onto plates. Enjoy!

name: Salt & Vinegar Roasted Edamame
ingredients:
2 cups
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
White Distilled Vinegar
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, add the edamame, oil, vinegar, and salt. Toss to combine. Let the edamame marinate for 10 to 15 minutes.
Drain the edamame of any excess liquid and spread it out evenly onto the baking sheet.
Place in the oven and cook for 30 to 40 minutes, or until golden brown, stirring halfway through. Cool for 10 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Lentil & Chickpea Salad
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
2 1/2 cups
Water
1/3 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1 1/4 tsps
Za'atar Spice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (from the can, drained and rinsed)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (diced)
1/2 cup
Sun Dried Tomatoes (drained and chopped)
1/4 cup
Parsley (finely chopped)
recipe:
In a pot, add the lentils and water. Bring to a boil then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 20 to 22 minutes or until they are tender. Once the lentils are cooked, drain any excess water and rinse under cold water. Transfer them to a large bowl.
In a small jar, combine the oil, lemon juice, za'atar spice, salt, and pepper. Shake well to combine.
In the large bowl with the lentils, add the chickpeas, onion, sun dried tomatoes, and dressing. Toss well to combine. Top with parsley. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Caprese Skewers
ingredients:
6
Barbecue Skewers (small)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes
1/3 cup
Basil Leaves
4 ozs
Small Bocconcini
2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Take a barbecue skewer and thread a tomato, a piece of basil, bocconcini, another piece of basil, and another tomato onto it one at a time. Repeat with each barbecue skewer. Top with balsamic vinegar, sea salt, and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Garlic & Chili Edamame
ingredients:
2 cups
Water
1 cup
Frozen Edamame
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Shallot (minced)
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Soy Sauce
1 tsp
Red Pepper Flakes
recipe:
Bring the water to a boil in a large pot. Add the edamame and cook until tender, about three to five minutes and then drain.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the garlic and shallots and sauté until fragrant. Add the maple syrup, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes. Cook for one minute or until the sauce gets sticky. Add the edamame to the pan and coat it in the sauce. Enjoy!

name: Mixed Berry Fruit Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Strawberries (chopped)
1/2 cup
Blackberries
1/2 cup
Blueberries
1/2 cup
Raspberries
recipe: Add the fruit to a bowl and mix to combine. Divide into bowls or onto plates. Enjoy!

name: Peanut Tofu & Edamame Quinoa Bowl
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Quinoa (dry)
12 ozs
Tofu (cut into triangles)
1 1/2 tsps
Coconut Aminos
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Rice Vinegar
2 cups
Frozen Edamame (defrosted)
3 tbsps
Peanut Sauce
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to package directions.
Preheat oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the tofu on the baking sheet.
Mix the coconut aminos, oil, and rice vinegar together. Pour the mixture on the tofu, turning the tofu a few times in it to make sure it is coated. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the tofu starts to brown at the edges.
Divide the quinoa evenly between the bowls and top with the edamame and tofu. Serve with the peanut sauce. Enjoy!

name: Falafel Patties
ingredients:
3 cups
Chickpeas (drained and rinsed)
1/2
Yellow Onion (chopped)
2
Garlic (cloves)
1/2 cup
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1/4 cup
Parsley
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves
1 tsp
Cumin
1/2 tsp
Baking Powder
1 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients except the oil to a food processor. Blend on high until a batter is created.
Form the batter into four to five-inch diameter patties, approximately 3/4-inch thick. There should be one patty per serving.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the patties and cook for five to seven minutes on each side, until browned and starting to crisp. Enjoy!

name: Vegan TVP Chili
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Textured Vegetable Protein (crumbs)
3 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
1/2
Yellow Bell Pepper (diced)
1 1/2 tsps
Taco Seasoning
1/2 cup
Black Beans (rinsed, drained)
1 cup
Tomato Purée

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Cilantro
recipe:
Place the textured vegetable protein in a bowl. Bring 1/3 of the vegetable broth to boil and pour over the textured vegetable protein. Cover and let it sit for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile add the onion to a pot with splash of water. Cook and stir over medium heat for about five minutes or until soft.
Add the rehydrated textured vegetable protein to the pot with bell pepper. Cook and stir occasionally for five minutes. Add the taco seasoning, black beans, tomato purée and the remaining vegetable broth to the pot. Season with salt and pepper.
Stir and cover the pot with a lid. Let simmer for about 20 minutes. Divide evenly between bowls, top with cilantro, and enjoy!

name: Pot Pie Chickpea Pasta
ingredients:
8 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (dry)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1
Carrot (large, chopped)
3/4 cup
Frozen Corn
3/4 cup
Frozen Peas
6 1/4 ozs
Cashew Cream Cheese

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Nutritional Yeast (divided)
3 tbsps
Almond Flour
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C).
Cook the chickpea pasta according to package directions.
Heat the oil in an oven-safe pan over medium heat. Add the onion, cook for two minutes, then add the garlic and cook for another two minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the carrots and cook for five minutes, continuing to stir. Add the corn and peas and cook for another five minutes. Add the cashew cheese and half of the nutritional yeast. Stir to allow the cashew cheese to melt. Add the salt and pepper to taste.
Once the pasta is finished cooking, add it to the pan and stir to combine. Remove from heat and sprinkle the almond flour and remaining nutritional yeast on top. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes, or until just starting to brown. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea, Tofu & Broccoli Quinoa Bowl
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Quinoa (dry)
3 cups
Frozen Broccoli
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
12 ozs
Tofu (cut into triangles)
1 1/3 tbsps
Coconut Aminos (divided)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
1 tbsp
Sriracha
1 tsp
Sesame Oil
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to package directions.
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the broccoli, chickpeas, and tofu on the baking sheet.
Mix together 3/4 of the coconut aminos, olive oil, and vinegar. Brush the tofu with the marinade and pour the rest onto the broccoli and chickpeas, being sure to coat them well with your hands. Bake for 20 minutes or until the tofu edges brown.
Meanwhile mix the remaining coconut aminos, sriracha, and sesame oil together to create a sauce.
Divide the quinoa evenly between bowls and top with the broccoli, tofu, and chickpeas. Serve with the sriracha sauce. Enjoy!

name: Citrus Sole with Cauliflower, Turnip & Rice
ingredients:
1 cup
Basmati Rice (dry)
1/4 cup
Orange Juice
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1 tbsp
Tamari
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/4 lbs
Sole Fillet
1/2 head
Cauliflower (chopped into florets)
2
Turnip (medium, cubed)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C).
Cook the rice according to package directions.
Meanwhile, whisk together the orange juice, smoked paprika, garlic powder, tamari, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to taste in a small bowl.
Place the sole in a shallow dish or bowl and poke it several times with a fork. Pour 1/3 of the sauce onto it and set aside.
Add the cauliflower and turnip to a baking sheet and drizzle with half of the remaining sauce. Bake in the oven for 18 to 20 minutes. Remove the pan from the oven and add the sole. Cook for another 10 to 12 minutes or until the fish is cooked through. Mix the remaining sauce into the rice. Serve it with the sole and vegetables. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea, Tofu & Sweet Potato Quinoa Salad
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Quinoa (dry)
14 ozs
Tofu (cut into triangles)
2 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1
Sweet Potato (cubed)
1 tbsp
Coconut Aminos
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
2 cups
Mixed Greens
2 tbsps
Italian Dressing
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to package directions.
Preheat oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the tofu, chickpeas and sweet potato on the baking sheet.
Mix together the coconut aminos, oil, and rice vinegar. Brush this marinade onto the tofu and pour the rest onto the sweet potato and chickpeas, mixing well with your hands. Bake for 20 minutes or until the tofu edges brown.
Divide the mixed greens evenly between bowls. Top with the quinoa, sweet potatoes, chickpeas, tofu, and Italian dressing. Enjoy!

name: Cantaloupe Agua Fresca
ingredients:
1/2
Cantaloupe (medium, peeled, deseeded, and chopped)
1
Lime (medium, juiced)
1/4 cup
Water
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
recipe: Combine all of the ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and enjoy!

name: Lemony White Bean & Quinoa Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
Quinoa (dry)
1
Sweet Potato (larged, cubed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
1
Lemon (juiced)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (minced)
2 cups
White Navy Beans (from the can, rinsed)
3 cups
Mixed Greens
1/2
Cucumber (chopped)
3 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions.
Toss the sweet potato with half the oil and half the sea salt. Add evenly to the baking sheet and cook for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, or until the sweet potato is turning crispy on the edges.
Mix the remaining oil, salt, lemon juice, and cilantro with the beans.
Divide the quinoa evenly between the bowls and top with the sweet potato, mixed greens, beans, cucumber, and hemp seeds. Drizzle any remaining lemon juice mixture over each serving. Enjoy!

name: Peanut & Edamame Chickpea Pasta
ingredients:
5 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (dry)
1 cup
Frozen Edamame
1/4 cup
Peanut Sauce
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. In the final two minutes of cooking the pasta, add the frozen edamame and cook. Drain everything together and then add everything back to the pot.
Add the peanut sauce to the pasta and edamame and stir well. Serve and enjoy!

name: Coconut Cherry Shake
ingredients:
1 3/4 cups
Plain Coconut Milk
1 cup
Frozen Cherries
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
9
Ice Cubes
recipe: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Tofu, Edamame & Broccoli with Quinoa
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Quinoa (dry)
3 cups
Frozen Broccoli
2 cups
Frozen Edamame
14 ozs
Tofu (cut into triangles)
1 1/3 tbsps
Coconut Aminos (divided)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
1 tbsp
Sriracha
1 tsp
Sesame Oil
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to package directions.
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the broccoli, edamame, and tofu on the baking sheet. Mix together 3/4 of the coconut aminos, oil, and rice vinegar. Brush the tofu with the marinade and pour the remaining marinade onto the broccoli and edamame. Mix well with your hands. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the tofu browns around the edges.
Meanwhile, mix the sriracha, sesame oil, and remaining coconut aminos together to create a sauce.
Divide the quinoa evenly between bowls and add the tofu, broccoli, and edamame on top. Serve with the sriracha sauce and enjoy!

name: Lemony Asparagus Spaghetti
ingredients:
4 1/2 ozs
Whole Wheat Spaghetti
2 cups
Asparagus
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
1
Lemon (juiced, zested)
2/3 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)
2 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions, adding the asparagus to the last two minutes of cooking. Reserve pasta water and drain.
In a serving bowl, mix the lemon zest, lemon juice, parmesan, and oil.
Transfer the pasta and the asparagus to the bowl and stir, adding a little cooking water if necessary to coat the pasta.
Top with basil and season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Shake
ingredients:
1 3/4 cups
Cow's Milk, Whole
2 tbsps
Cacao Powder
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
9
Ice Cubes
recipe: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Enjoy!

name: Beet & Snap Pea Salad with Strawberry Balsamic Dressing
ingredients:
8 cups
Mixed Greens
1
Beet (medium, shredded)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
1 cup
Snap Peas (halved)
2 cups
Strawberries (chopped, divided)
1 cup
Walnuts
2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinegar
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Combine the mixed greens, beets, red onion, snap peas, half of the strawberries, and walnuts in a large bowl.
Add the remaining strawberries, vinegar, oil, honey, and salt to a blender and blend on high until a smooth consistency is achieved.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and enjoy!

name: Banana & Pecans
ingredients:
1
Banana
1/4 cup
Pecans
recipe: Slice the banana if desired and add to a plate with the pecans. Enjoy!

name: Lentil & Spinach Soup
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
4
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1 1/3 cups
Dry Green Lentils
7 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1 tsp
Cumin
2 cups
Baby Spinach (chopped)
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1/2 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes (optional)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and the garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant and translucent, about three minutes.
Add the lentils, vegetable broth, cumin, and spinach to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and let simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the lemon juice and the cilantro and top with chili flakes, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea & Tofu Quinoa Bowl with Peanut Sauce
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Quinoa (dry)
2 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
14 ozs
Tofu (cut into triangles)
1 tbsp
Coconut Aminos
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
2 tbsps
Peanut Sauce
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to package directions.
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Add the chickpeas and tofu to the baking sheet.
Mix the coconut aminos, oil, and rice vinegar and brush on the tofu. Pour the remaining marinade on the chickpeas and mix well with your hands. Bake for 20 minutes or until the edges of the tofu brown and the chickpeas are crispy.
Divide the quinoa evenly between bowls and top with the tofu and chickpeas. Serve with the peanut sauce. Enjoy!

name: Lentil & Chickpea Pasta Salad
ingredients:
4 ozs
Chickpea Pasta
2 cups
Lentils (from the can, drained and rinsed)
2 tbsps
Red Onion (finely chopped)
1
Red Bell Pepper (diced)
1/2
Cucumber (diced)
1/4 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives (finely chopped)
2 cups
Baby Kale
2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinaigrette

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the directions on the package and set aside. Drain, rinse well, and set aside to cool.
In a large bowl, mix the pasta, lentils, red onion, bell pepper, cucumber, olives, and baby kale. Add the dressing and mix well. Enjoy!

name: Chopped Tomatoes with Parsley
ingredients:
3
Tomato (chopped)
1/2 cup
Parsley (chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
White Wine Vinegar
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 tsp
Black Pepper
recipe: Add all of the ingredients into a bowl and toss to combine. Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Chickpea & Tofu Curry
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
2
Garlic (cloves, chopped)
9 ozs
Tofu (firm, drained, cubed)
2 2/3 cups
Chickpeas (from the can, drained and rinsed)
2 cups
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with the juices)
1/2 cup
Water
1 tbsp
Curry Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
In a large pot, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant and translucent, about three minutes.
Add the tofu, chickpeas, tomatoes, water, and curry powder. Season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and let simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Stir in the cilantro. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Raspberry Dressing
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Raspberries
1/2 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 1/2 tbsps
Red Wine Vinegar
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Dijon Mustard
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Add all ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Transfer to an airtight container or jar and keep refrigerated until ready to use. Enjoy!

name: Tofu & Edamame Noodles with Peanut Sauce
ingredients:
15 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, and cubed)
1 tbsp
Tamari
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
1 tbsp
Arrowroot Powder
12 ozs
Udon Noodles (dried)
2 cups
Frozen Edamame
1 cup
Grated Carrot
1/2 cup
Peanut Sauce
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the tofu cubes to a bowl and gently toss with the tamari and oil. Then add the arrowroot powder and gently toss until the tofu cubes are well coated. Arrange the coated tofu cubes on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 28 to 30 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Meanwhile, cook the udon noodles and edamame according to package directions and set aside in a large bowl with the carrots. Drizzle the peanut sauce over the noodles and toss well. Top with the tofu. Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Spicy Black Bean & Lentil Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Black Beans (cooked)
1 cup
Lentils (cooked)
1
Red Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
1
Jalapeno Pepper (diced)
1 cup
Baby Spinach
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
1/2
Lime (medium, juiced)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Cumin

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
In a large mixing bowl, combine the black beans, lentils, red bell pepper, jalapeño pepper, spinach, and cilantro.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice, oil, and cumin. Season with salt and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss until well combined. Enjoy!

name: Blackberry Smash Mocktail
ingredients:
1 cup
Blackberries
2 tbsps
Water
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
2 tsps
Lime Juice
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves (plus extra for garnish)
10
Ice Cubes
1 cup
Sparkling Water
recipe:
In a shaker glass, muddle the blackberries with the water, maple syrup, lime juice, and mint, until smashed. Remove the mint.
Divide the ice cubes evenly between glasses.
Pour the blackberry mixture into the glasses and top with sparkling water. Garnish with mint. Enjoy!

name: Radicchio & Arugula Salad with Raspberry Dressing
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Raspberries
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/4 tbsps
Red Wine Vinegar
1/2 tsp
Maple Syrup
1/4 tsp
Dijon Mustard
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
2 cups
Radicchio (thinly chopped)
2 cups
Arugula
1 cup
Radishes (thinly sliced)
3/4 cup
Walnuts (roughly chopped)
2/3 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Add raspberries, olive oil, vinegar, maple syrup, dijon mustard and salt to a blender and blend until smooth. Set aside. In a salad bowl, combine the radicchio, arugula, radishes and walnuts. Drizzle with the dressing and top with feta cheese.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Black Bean Tacos
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 cups
Black Beans (cooked)
2 tsps
Taco Seasoning
6
Corn Tortilla (small)
3 tbsps
Sour Cream
3 tbsps
Salsa
1 1/2 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)
1
Avocado (sliced)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the black beans and taco seasoning. Mix well until the beans are coated. Heat for three to five minutes, stirring often.
Divide the beans evenly between the tortillas and top with the sour cream, salsa, cheese, and avocado. Enjoy!

name: Mushroom, Black Bean & Quinoa Chili
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (small, chopped)
10
Cremini Mushrooms (sliced)
2 tsps
Taco Seasoning
1 cup
Tomato Purée
2 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1 cup
Black Beans (rinsed, drained)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the yellow onion and sauté for about five minutes or until soft. Add the mushrooms and cook for another five minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the taco seasoning along with tomato purée, broth, and black beans. Stir, cover the pot with a lid, and let it simmer for about five minutes.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper. Add the quinoa to the pot and stir. Cover with lid again and let simmer on low heat for about 15 minutes or until quinoa is cooked through. Stir the chili occasionally.
Divide the chili evenly between bowls. Top with green onion and enjoy!

name: Green Bean & Feta Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Green Beans (stems removed, chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (cut in half)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)
1/2 tsp
Oregano
recipe:
In a large pan, bring one inch of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the beans and cover and cook for about three to four minutes or until tender-crisp. Transfer the beans to a bowl of iced water for two to three minutes.
Drain the beans and add them to a large bowl along with the salt, pepper, tomatoes, onion, feta, oil, lemon juice, dill, and oregano. Toss to combine.
Divide evenly between plates or into bowls and enjoy!

name: Tempeh Quesadillas
ingredients:
8 3/4 ozs
Tempeh (crumbled)
2 tbsps
Coconut Aminos
2 tsps
Taco Seasoning
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
4 ozs
Vegan Cheese Shreds
4
Corn Tortilla (small)
recipe:
In a bowl, combine the crumbled tempeh, coconut aminos, and taco seasoning. Marinate for 10 to 15 minutes.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onions and sauté for two to three minutes or until softened.
Add the marinated tempeh along with any liquid from the bowl. Cook for four to five minutes or until the tempeh has browned.
Heat another large pan over medium heat and add a tortilla. Working in batches, on one side of the tortilla, add some cheese, the tempeh mixture, and then more cheese. Fold the other side of the tortilla over the filling and press down with a spatula. Cook for two to three minutes then carefully turn over and cook for another two to three minutes until crispy. Continue until all tortillas are used up.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Mini Fruit Pizzas
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
2 ozs
English Muffin (cut in half, toasted)
1/4 cup
Strawberries (sliced)
1/4 cup
Blueberries
2 tsps
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
In a small bowl, mix the yogurt and maple syrup until smooth.
Divide the yogurt mixture between the English muffin halves and top with strawberries, blueberries, and hemp seeds. Enjoy!

name: Lentil Bolognese with Chickpea Pasta
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (small, finely chopped)
2
Garlic (cloves, minced)
2
Carrot (peeled, finely chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Crushed Tomatoes (from the can)
2 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1 cup
Lentils (rinsed, drained)
2 tbsps
Italian Seasoning
10 ozs
Chickpea Pasta
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onions and sauté for two to three minutes or until they have softened. Add the garlic and sauté for 30 to 60 seconds.
Add the carrots, salt, and pepper. Sauté for five to six minutes or until the carrots have softened.
Add the crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth, lentils, and Italian seasoning. Bring to a boil then reduce the heat to a simmer. Simmer for 30 to 35 minutes or until the lentils are tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir occasionally.
While the bolognese is cooking, cook the chickpea pasta according to the package directions.
Divide the pasta and bolognese evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Black Bean Lettuce Wraps
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Water
2 tsps
Taco Seasoning
2 cups
Black Beans (cooked)
1 head
Boston Lettuce (washed with leaves eparated)
1/4 cup
Sour Cream
1/4 cup
Salsa
recipe:
Heat a cast-iron or non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the water and taco seasoning and mix together.
Add the black beans to the pan and coat in the taco seasoning well. Heat for three to five minutes, stirring often. Remove from the heat.
Divide the black beans evenly between the lettuce leaves and top with the sour cream and salsa. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Sweet Potato & Asparagus with Chimichurri
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (large, cut into wedges)
2 cups
Asparagus (trimmed)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
1 1/2 tsps
Lime Juice
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
Turn the grill to medium-low heat. Toss the sweet potato and asparagus with 1/3 of the oil. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the sweet potato to the grill and cook for approximately 15 minutes, flipping halfway through. Add the asparagus to the grill and cook for another five minutes or until everything is cooked through.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, add the parsley, remaining oil, lime juice, garlic, and chili flakes. Season with salt.
Place the grilled asparagus and sweet potato on a serving plate. Drizzle with the chimichurri and enjoy!

name: Lentil, Chickpea & Green Pea Curry with Rice
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Basmati Rice (dry)
1/2
White Onion (small, diced)
4
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1 1/2 tbsps
Curry Powder
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 cup
Frozen Peas (thawed)
3 cups
Vegetable Broth
1 1/2 cups
Lentils (cooked)
1/3 cup
Canned Coconut Milk

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a separate pot, add the onion with a splash of water. Cook and stir over medium heat for about five minutes or until soft. Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the curry powder, cook, and stir for another minute. Add the chickpeas, green peas, and vegetable broth to the pot. Cover with a lid and let it simmer on low heat for about 10 minutes.
Add the lentils and coconut milk, stir, and season with salt and pepper. Cover with a lid and let it simmer for another 10 minutes.
Divide the rice and curry evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Tempeh, Quinoa & Edamame Stuffed Peppers
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
8 ozs
Tempeh (smoked, finely crumbled)
1/2 cup
Frozen Edamame (shelled, thawed)
2 ozs
Cashew Cream Cheese
1 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
2
Orange Bell Pepper (large, tops and seeds removed)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Cook the quinoa according to package directions.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the crumbled tempeh and cook for five to seven minutes, until starting to brown.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, tempeh, edamame, cashew cream cheese, garlic powder, sea salt, black pepper, and parsley. Mix well to combine.
Scoop the mixture into the peppers, packing them tightly until all of it is used up. Place on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 25 minutes, or until the peppers have softened. Enjoy!

name: TVP Chili Sweet Potato Fries
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Textured Vegetable Protein (crumbs)
3 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
2
Sweet Potato (large, cut into fries)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
1/2
Yellow Bell Pepper (diced)
1/2
Jalapeno Pepper (finely chopped, plus extra for garnish)
1 1/2 tsps
Taco Seasoning
1/2 cup
Black Beans
1 cup
Tomato Purée
recipe:
Place the textured vegetable protein in a bowl. Bring 1/3 of the vegetable broth to a boil and pour over the textured vegetable protein. Cover and let it sit for 10 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Arrange the sweet potato onto the baking sheet in an even layer. Season with salt and pepper. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, tossing halfway.
Add the onion to a pot with a splash of water. Cook and stir over medium heat for about five minutes or until soft.
Add the rehydrated textured vegetable protein to the pot with bell pepper and jalapeño. Cook and stir occasionally for five minutes. Add the taco seasoning, black beans, tomato purée, and the remaining vegetable broth to the pot. Season with salt and pepper.
Stir and cover the pot with a lid. Let simmer for about 20 minutes. Arrange the sweet potato fries on a serving platter. Top with chili and garnish with extra jalapeño. Enjoy!

name: Mimosa Mocktail
ingredients:
1 cup
Orange Juice
1 cup
Sparkling Water
1/4
Navel Orange (cut into wedges)
recipe: Pour orange juice in a glass and top with sparkling water. Garnish with an orange slice. Enjoy!

name: Tofu Broccoli Pasta
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Whole Wheat Penne (dry)
2 cups
Broccoli (chopped into florets)
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
2 tbsps
Tamari
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
6 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, cubed)
1 tbsp
Nutritional Yeast
1/2 tsp
Herbes De Provence
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions, adding the broccoli to the last two minutes of cooking. Reserve pasta water and drain.
In a small bowl, mix the tamari and the garlic powder to combine.
Meanwhile, heat half of the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the tofu and the tamari mixture. Cook, stirring, until the tofu has browned on all sides, about five to seven minutes. Remove from the heat.
Add the cooked pasta and broccoli to the pan along with the remaining oil, nutritional yeast, and Herbes de Provence. Stir to combine then stir in the reserved pasta water one tablespoon at a time until your desired consistency is reached.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Pecans & Blueberries
ingredients:
1 cup
Blueberries
1/4 cup
Pecans
recipe: Serve the blueberries with pecans and enjoy!

name: Whole Grilled Branzino with Capers
ingredients:
1 lb
Whole Sea Bass (gutted, scaled)
1/2
Lemon (thinly sliced, plus extra for garnish)
2 tbsps
Fresh Oregano (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
2 tbsps
Capers (pat dry with paper towel)
1
Garlic (clove, smashed)
recipe:
Place the fish on a cutting board and stuff with the lemon slices and half of the oregano. Season inside with salt and pepper. Rub the outside of the fish with 1/3 of the oil and season with salt and pepper. Set aside for about 15 minutes.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Once the grill is very hot, place the fish on the grate and close the lid. Cook for seven to nine minutes, until the skin is crispy and puffed up and the fish releases easily. Flip and cook for another seven to nine minutes with the lid closed. Remove and set aside.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a small saucepan over medium-low heat. Once hot, add the capers and cook for two minutes, until the capers get crispy. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the remaining oregano and cook for 30 seconds. Remove from the heat and set aside.
Serve the fish and spoon the caper mixture over top. Garnish with extra lemon slices. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Tofu & Broccoli on Rice
ingredients:
1 cup
Brown Rice (dry)
2 tbsps
Tamari
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast (divided)
15 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, pressed, crumbled)
5 cups
Broccoli (florets, chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and lightly grease one sheet pan with oil. Line the second sheet pan with parchment paper. Cook the rice according to the package directions.
In a large bowl, whisk together the tamari, half of the oil, garlic powder, and half of the nutritional yeast. Add the crumbled tofu and toss well. Transfer to the sheet pan and bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until crispy.
Meanwhile, in the same bowl, combine the broccoli with the remaining oil, remaining nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper.
Transfer the broccoli to the second sheet pan, spreading out evenly. Place in the oven and bake for 15 to 17 minutes, until fork tender and browned. Divide the rice, broccoli, and tofu evenly between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Hemp Caesar Dressing
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Lemon Juice
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 cup
Hemp Seeds
2
Garlic (cloves)
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Water
recipe: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth and creamy. Enjoy!

name: Lentil, Chickpea & Green Pea Curry
ingredients:
1/2
White Onion (small, diced)
4
Garlic (cloves, minced)
1 1/2 tbsps
Curry Powder
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 cup
Frozen Peas (thawed)
3 cups
Vegetable Broth
1 1/2 cups
Lentils (cooked)
1/3 cup
Canned Coconut Milk

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
In a pot, add the onion with a splash of water. Cook and stir over medium heat for about five minutes or until soft. Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the curry powder, cook, and stir for another minute. Add the chickpeas, green peas, and vegetable broth to the pot. Cover with a lid and let it simmer on low heat for about 10 minutes.
Add the lentils and coconut milk, stir, and season with salt and pepper. Cover with a lid and let it simmer for another 10 minutes.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Avocado & Hummus Cucumber Sandwich
ingredients:
1 cup
Hummus
1/2
Avocado
2 tbsps
Parsley (finely chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 slices
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
1 cup
Baby Spinach
1/2
Cucumber (small, sliced)
recipe:
In a large bowl, add the hummus and avocado. Mash well until everything is combined. Add the parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste. Mix well once more.
Spread the hummus and avocado mixture on one slice of toast, top with spinach, cucumber, and the second slice of toast. Repeat for each sandwich.
Slice the sandwich in half and enjoy!

name: Lemony Hummus Pasta
ingredients:
2 1/2 cups
Whole Wheat Penne (dry)
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/4 tsp
Chili Powder (optional, or to taste)
1/2 cup
Hummus
1 1/2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1/4 cup
Parsley (finely chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Reserve pasta water and drain.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for two to three minutes. Add the garlic and chili powder, if using, and cook for a minute more until fragrant.
Remove the pan from the heat and add the hummus and lemon juice. Stir to combine then stir in the reserved pasta water one tablespoon at a time until the sauce has loosened a bit.
Add the cooked pasta and the parsley to the pan. Toss until evenly coated. Add more pasta water one tablespoon at a time until your desired consistency is reached. Season with salt and pepper. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Protein Cinnamon & Apple Oats
ingredients:
1 cup
Water
1/2 cup
Oats
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tbsp
Ground Flax Seed
1/8 tsp
Cinnamon
1
Apple (diced)
recipe:
Bring water to a boil in a small saucepan. Add the oats. Reduce to a steady simmer and cook, stirring occasionally for about seven to eight minutes or until oats are tender and most of the water is absorbed. Stir in the protein powder, ground flax seed, and cinnamon.
Transfer the cooked oats to a bowl and top with the apple. Enjoy!

name: Curried Fried Zucchini
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
2
Zucchini (medium, thinly sliced lengthwise, halved)
1 tsp
Curry Powder (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Warm the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the zucchini and season with half of the curry powder, salt, and pepper. Cook for five minutes, then flip, and season with the remaining curry powder. Cook for another five minutes, or until cooked through. Enjoy!

name: Pecan Raisin Oat Muffins
ingredients:
1 cup
Oats
1/4 cup
All Natural Peanut Butter
1/3 cup
Maple Syrup
3/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 1/2 tsps
Baking Powder
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Raisins
1/4 cup
Pecans
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC) and line a muffin tray with baking cups or use a silicone muffin tray.
Add the oats to a high-powered blender or food processor and blend until a fine oat flour is created.
In a mixing bowl combine the peanut butter and maple syrup then stir in the almond milk.
Add the oat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt to the bowl and stir until combined. Fold in the raisins and pecans.
Divide the batter evenly between the baking cups and bake for 16 to 18 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the muffin comes out with just a few moist crumbs.
Transfer the muffins to a cooling rack to cool completely. Enjoy!

name: Maple Roasted Lentil & Sweet Potato Salad
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (medium, cubed)
1 cup
Lentils (cooked)
1/2 cup
Pecans
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Cinnamon

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
4 cups
Baby Spinach
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C).
Add the sweet potato, lentils, and pecans to a baking sheet. Toss with half of the oil and maple syrup to combine. Season with cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes, or until fork-tender.
Combine the remaining oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a small dish. Whisk with a fork.
Divide the spinach evenly between bowls and add the lentil and sweet potato mixture. Drizzle with the lemon and oil dressing. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea & Cucumber Avocado Sandwich
ingredients:
1 3/4 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, rinsed)
1
Avocado (medium)
1 tsp
Lemon Juice
1/4 cup
Parsley (finely chopped)
1
Garlic (small clove, minced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
6 slices
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
1 cup
Baby Spinach
1/2
Cucumber (large, sliced)
recipe:
In a large bowl, add the chickpeas and avocado. Mash well until everything is combined. Add the lemon juice, parsley, garlic, sea salt, and pepper. Mix well once more.
On one slice of the toast, add the spinach and cucumber. Top with the mashed chickpea mixture and the other slice of toast. Slice and enjoy!

name: White Chocolate & Strawberry Mousse
ingredients:
1/3 cup
White Chocolate Chips
1 1/2 cups
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/2 cup
Strawberries (chopped)
1 1/2 tsps
Lime Juice
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves
recipe:
Gently melt the white chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave for 30-second intervals.
Using a hand mixer, whip the yogurt in a bowl on medium speed for one to two minutes or until light and smooth. Gradually add the white chocolate until the mixture is creamy and well combined.
Divide between small glass jars, cover, and refrigerate for two hours or overnight.
Just before serving, mix the chopped strawberries with the lime juice and let it sit for five minutes. Add to the top of each serving and garnish with mint leaves. Enjoy!

name: Rhubarb & Mint Mocktail
ingredients:
1 cup
Rhubarb (diced)
1 tbsp
Cane Sugar
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves (plus extra for garnish)
2 tbsps
Water
10
Ice Cubes
1
Lemon (juiced)
1 cup
Sparkling Water
recipe:
Place rhubarb, sugar, mint, and water in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir occasionally for about 10 to 15 minutes or until rhubarb starts to break down. Turn off the heat and use a fork to mash the rhubarb. Let the mixture cool down for about five minutes. Use a strainer and pass the mixture through it.
Divide the rhubarb syrup evenly between glasses. Add the ice and lemon juice. Stir and top with sparkling water. Garnish with extra mint leaves, if using, and enjoy!

name: Tandoori Tofu & Mixed Greens Salad
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Plain Goat Milk Yogurt
1 tbsp
Tandoori Masala
11 ozs
Tofu (cut into squares)
2 cups
Mixed Greens
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/4
Cucumber (sliced)
2 tbsps
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
recipe:
Preheat the grill to medium heat.
In a large shallow bowl, mix the yogurt with the tandoori masala. Add the tofu and coat well.
Gently shake off the excess marinade from the tofu and place the tofu on the grill. Save the marinade. Grill the tofu for three to four minutes on each side or until there are crispy grill marks.
Meanwhile, in a large salad bowl, add the mixed greens, tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
Top the salad with the grilled tofu and drizzle the remaining marinade on top. Enjoy!

name: Snap Pea & Radish Arugula Salad
ingredients:
4 cups
Arugula
1/2 cup
Snap Peas (chopped)
1/2 cup
Radishes (thinly sliced)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 tsp
Black Pepper
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a bowl and mix to combine. Divide evenly between bowls or onto plates and enjoy!

name: Lemony Lentil & Spinach Pasta
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Whole Wheat Penne
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
3
Garlic (cloves, minced)
6 cups
Baby Spinach
1 cup
Lentils (cooked)
1/4 cup
Lemon Juice
3 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, warm 1/4 of the oil in a large pan. Add the garlic and sauté for one to two minutes, then add the spinach and cook for three to five minutes, or until wilted.
Add the pasta and lentils to the pan. Add the remaining oil, lemon juice, and nutritional yeast and stir to combine. Season with salt and pepper. Stir for a minute, then remove from heat. Enjoy!

name: Blueberry Banana Protein Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Blueberries
1
Banana (small, frozen)
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 1/2 tbsps
All Natural Peanut Butter
1 tbsp
Ground Flax Seed
1 1/4 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
recipe: Place all ingredients in your blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Scallops, Green Beans & Mashed Sweet Potato
ingredients:
2
Sweet Potato (medium, cubed)
1 tbsp
Butter (divided)
2 cups
Green Beans (ends trimmed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
11 ozs
Scallops
2 tbsps
Cow's Milk, Whole
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
recipe:
Add the sweet potato to a steaming pot of water over high heat. Cover, and steam for 10 to 15 minutes, until fork tender.
Meanwhile, melt 1/3 of the butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add the green beans and sauté for 10 to 15 minutes, until tender and starting to brown. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Once the beans are done, remove from the heat and add half of the remaining butter to the same pan. Add the scallops and cook for six to 10 minutes, flipping halfway through, until browned.
Add the sweet potato, milk, remaining butter, garlic powder, salt, and pepper to a large bowl and mash with a potato masher. Divide the ingredients evenly between plates. Enjoy!

name: Tandoori Tofu Wrap
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Plain Goat Milk Yogurt
1 tbsp
Tandoori Masala
11 ozs
Tofu (cut into squares)
1
Whole Wheat Tortilla
1 cup
Baby Spinach
1/4 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
2 tbsps
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
recipe:
Preheat the grill to medium heat.
In a large shallow bowl, mix the yogurt with the tandoori masala. Add the tofu to marinate.
Gently remove the excess marinade and place the tofu on the grill. Save the leftover marinade. Grill the tofu on each side for three to four minutes or until crispy grill marks appear.
Meanwhile, add the spinach, tomatoes, and red onion to the tortilla. Place the tofu on top and drizzle the leftover marinade on top. Roll up the tortilla and enjoy!

name: Broad Beans & Asparagus on Whipped Ricotta
ingredients:
1 cup
Frozen Broad Beans
1 cup
Frozen Peas
2 cups
Asparagus (shaved)
1
Lemon (juiced, zested, divided)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
