1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Ricotta Cheese
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves
recipe:
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the broad beans and peas to the pot and boil for about five minutes or until soft. Strain and run cold water over the top to stop the cooking process.
In a bowl, add the cooked broad beans, peas, asparagus, half of the lemon juice and zest, oil, and chili flakes. Toss everything together, season with salt and pepper, and set aside.
In a food processor, add the ricotta, remaining lemon juice and zest, salt, and pepper. Blend until smooth.
Spread the whipped ricotta onto a serving plate. Top with broad beans mixture and garnish with mint leaves. Enjoy!

name: Spinach Chickpea Pasta Salad
ingredients:
4 ozs
Chickpea Pasta
1/4 cup
Green Olives (pitted, quartered)
1/4 cup
Shallot (chopped)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1
Green Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
2 ozs
Mozzarella Ball (pearls)
2 tbsps
Italian Dressing
2 cups
Baby Spinach
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves
recipe:
Cook the pasta al dente according to the package directions. Drain and rinse under cold water.
In a bowl, add the olives, shallot, tomatoes, peppers, mozzarella balls, and dressing. Mix to combine. Add the spinach and the basil and toss to combine.
Refrigerate until ready to serve. Enjoy!

name: Sparkling Salty Lime Mocktail
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Coconut Water
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
1/16 tsp
Sea Salt
5
Ice Cubes
1/2 cup
Sparkling Water
recipe: Add the coconut water, lime juice, salt, and ice to a glass. Top with sparkling water and stir. Enjoy!

name: Couscous & Raisin Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Couscous (uncooked)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/3 cup
Raisins
1/4 cup
Red Onion (diced)
2 tbsps
Pine Nuts (toasted)
1 stalk
Green Onion (thinly sliced)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the couscous according to package directions.
With a fork, fluff the couscous and stir in the rest of the ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Zucchini Dip
ingredients:
1/2
Zucchini (medium, sliced)
2 tbsps
Red Onion (sliced)
1/2
Lemon
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/3 cup
Plain Goat Milk Yogurt
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1
Garlic (clove)
2 tbsps
Tahini
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a small baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the zucchini, red onion, and lemon with half the oil. Spread out on a baking sheet and cook in the oven for 20 minutes or until browned.
Remove the lemon and set aside. Add the zucchini, red onion, yogurt, salt, garlic, and tahini to a food processor. Squeeze the juice of the roasted lemon into the food processor. Blend the mixture until smooth.
Transfer the dip to a serving bowl and drizzle the remaining oil on top. Enjoy!

name: Peanut Sesame Potatoes
ingredients:
3 cups
Mini Potatoes (halved)
1/3 cup
Raw Peanuts (unsalted)
1 1/2 tbsps
Sesame Seeds
1 tbsp
Turmeric
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1
Garlic (clove)
1 tbsp
Ginger (peeled, roughly chopped)
1 tsp
Cumin
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (quartered)
recipe:
Boil the potatoes in water until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, pulse the peanuts, sesame seeds, turmeric, salt, garlic, ginger, and cumin in a food processor until you get a coarse mixture.
Heat the oil in a large skillet until it shimmers. Add the peanut and sesame mixture and heat until fragrant, about two minutes. Add the potatoes to the skillet and stir to coat the potatoes well.
Divide the potatoes evenly between plates. Squeeze the lemon overtop of the potatoes and enjoy!

name: Tandoori Corn on the Cob
ingredients:
1 1/2 tbsps
Butter (melted)
1 tbsp
Tandoori Masala

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 ears
Corn On The Cob (husk removed)
1/2
Lime (cut into wedges, juiced)
1 tbsp
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, mix together the butter, tandoori masala, salt and pepper. Brush the butter mixture all over the corn.
Bake in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until cooked through. Top with lime juice and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Vegetable & Halloumi Wrap
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/2
Zucchini (medium, sliced lengthwise)
1/2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 ozs
Halloumi (sliced)
3 tbsps
Hummus
1
Whole Wheat Tortilla (large)
recipe:
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Brush the oil onto the zucchini and bell pepper. Season with salt and pepper.
Place the zucchini, bell pepper, and halloumi on the grill. Cook for four to five minutes per side, until charred.
Spread the hummus onto the tortilla. Add the zucchini, bell pepper, and halloumi. Roll tightly into a wrap, tucking in the sides, and enjoy!

name: Salty Orange Mocktail
ingredients:
5
Ice Cubes
1/2 cup
Orange Juice (freshly squeezed)
1/2 cup
Coconut Water
1/16 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a glass and stir to combine. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Skewers with Chocolate
ingredients:
2 cups
Strawberries (tops removed)
3
Barbecue Skewers
1/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Thread the strawberries onto the skewers.
Add the chocolate chips to a small bowl and microwave on high for 30 to 45-second intervals until melted. Stir with a spoon to fully combine.
Drizzle the melted chocolate on the strawberry skewers. Enjoy!

name: Fried Halloumi Israeli Couscous Salad
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Israeli Couscous (dry)
6 ozs
Halloumi (cut into large pieces)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1 tbsp
Balsamic Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Arugula
1 1/2 cups
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1 1/4 cups
Strawberries (quartered)
1/2 cup
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the couscous according to the package directions.
Warm a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the halloumi slices until golden brown, about one to two minutes per side.
In a small bowl or jar, combine the oil, lemon, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Pour the couscous into a large bowl and add the arugula, tomatoes, and strawberries. Drizzle the dressing over top and mix well. Top with parsley and halloumi. Enjoy!

name: Vindaloo Spice Blend
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Coriander
1 tbsp
Smoked Paprika
1 tbsp
Cumin
1 tbsp
Turmeric
1 tsp
Cayenne Pepper
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1 tsp
Cardamom
1 tsp
Ground Cloves
1 tsp
Black Pepper
recipe: Add all the ingredients into a bowl or a jar and mix well. Seal and store in the pantry. Enjoy!

name: Blended Salty Watermelon Mocktail
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Coconut Water
1/4
Seedless Watermelon (small, chopped)
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
1/16 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Halloumi, Chickpea & Arugula Salad
ingredients:
6 ozs
Halloumi (cut into large pieces)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves (chopped, divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 cups
Arugula
1 3/4 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1
Avocado (medium, cubed)
recipe:
Warm a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the halloumi slices until golden brown, about one to two minutes per side.
In a small bowl, whisk together the oil, lemon juice, half the mint, salt, and pepper.
Layer the arugula on a plate and top with chickpeas, halloumi, avocado, and the remaining mint. Drizzle the dressing on top, season with salt and pepper if needed. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry, Tomato & Mozzarella Salad
ingredients:
1
Tomato (large, sliced)
1 1/3 cups
Strawberries (chopped)
2 1/16 ozs
Mozzarella Ball (torn into pieces)
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinegar
recipe:
Arrange the tomato slices, strawberries, mozzarella cheese, and basil leaves onto a serving plate.
Season with salt. Drizzle with oil and balsamic vinegar. Enjoy!

name: Lebanese Spicy Potatoes
ingredients:
5 cups
Water (cold)
6
Ice Cubes
1 tbsp
White Distilled Vinegar
3 cups
Mini Potatoes (quartered)
1/4 cup
Avocado Oil (divided)
3
Garlic (cloves, minced)
2 tsps
Harissa
1/4 cup
Cilantro (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Add the water, ice cubes, and vinegar to a large bowl. Add the potatoes and let sit for 30 minutes. Drain the potatoes and pat dry with a paper towel.
Heat 3/4 of the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the potatoes and cook for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring frequently, until browned and crispy. Place the potatoes in a paper towel-lined bowl to absorb any excess oil.
Add the remaining oil to the pan. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds to one minute. Add the harissa and cilantro, stir, and then add the potatoes back into the pan. Toss to coat, then turn off the heat and add the lemon juice and salt. Toss again and allow to sit for five minutes. Enjoy!

name: Green Pea & Mint Sunflower Dip with Crackers
ingredients:
2 cups
Frozen Peas (thawed)
2
Garlic (cloves, skin removed)
1/4 cup
Sunflower Seeds
1/2 cup
Mint Leaves
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
2 2/3 ozs
Seed Crackers
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients except for the crackers to a food processor. Blend for two to five minutes, or until desired consistency.
Serve the dip with the crackers and enjoy!

name: Kachumber Salad
ingredients:
1 1/2
Cucumber (medium, diced)
3
Tomato (medium, diced)
3/4 cup
Red Onion (chopped)
1
Green Chili Pepper (finely chopped)
1/2 cup
Cilantro (finely chopped)
1 tsp
Cumin
1 tsp
Chili Powder
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well to combine. Enjoy!

name: Caprese Sandwich
ingredients:
1
Tomato (large, sliced)
2 1/8 ozs
Mozzarella Ball (sliced)
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves
4 ozs
Whole Wheat Bun (cut in half to open, toasted)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinegar
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
recipe: Place the tomato, mozzarella, and basil leaves between the buns. Season with salt. Drizzle with balsamic vinegar and oil. Enjoy!

name: Fennel, Quinoa & Toasted Chickpea Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Almonds (coarsely chopped)
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/4 tsp
Smoked Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 bulb
Fennel (medium, thinly sliced)
2 cups
Mixed Greens
3 tbsps
Green Goddess Salad Dressing
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to package directions.
Meanwhile, add the oil to a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Once warm, add the almonds and lightly toast them, about one minute.
Add the chickpeas and cook until golden and crispy, about three to five minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the smoked paprika. Season with salt and pepper and cook for one more minute while stirring. Remove from the heat.
In a large bowl, combine the quinoa, fennel, and mixed greens.
Divide the salad evenly between plates. Top with the chickpea mixture, dressing, and almonds. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Lemon Parmesan Asparagus
ingredients:
2 cups
Asparagus (trimmed)
1/2 tsp
Avocado Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)
1/4 tsp
Lemon Zest
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 400ºF (205ºC).
In a bowl, combine the asparagus, oil, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Place the asparagus in the air fryer basket. Arrange in an even layer and bake for six to seven minutes or until fork tender and cooked through.
Transfer the asparagus to a plate and top with parmesan and lemon zest. Enjoy!

name: Vanilla Pineapple Chia Fresca
ingredients:
2 cups
Pineapple (chopped)
1 1/2 cups
Coconut Water
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
2 tsps
Raw Honey
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
recipe: Combine all ingredients except the chia seeds in a blender. Blend on high for one minute, then transfer to a sealable jar. Add the chia seeds, top with a lid, and shake. Transfer to the fridge for 15 to 20 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Chip Spelt Zucchini Bread
ingredients:
1
Zucchini (medium, grated)
1 1/2 cups
Spelt Flour
1 tsp
Baking Powder
1 tsp
Baking Soda
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tsp
Cinnamon
3/4 cup
Coconut Sugar
3/4 cup
Unsweetened Applesauce
1/3 cup
Coconut Oil (melted)
1 1/2 tsps
Vanilla Extract
1/2 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC). Line a loaf pan with parchment paper.
Use a cheesecloth or clean kitchen towel to squeeze the zucchini of excess water very well. Set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the spelt flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon.
In a medium bowl, combine the sugar, applesauce, oil, and vanilla.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix with a spatula until just combined. Add the zucchini and chocolate chips and stir until just combined.
Transfer the batter to the prepared loaf pan and bake in the oven for 60 to 70 minutes or until cooked through. Let cool on a wire rack completely before removing. Slice and enjoy!

name: Tofu, Tomato & Zucchini Skewers
ingredients:
11 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, drained, pressed and cubed)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes
1
Zucchini (chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Herbes De Provence
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
recipe:
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Place the tofu, tomatoes, and zucchini on skewers. Mix the garlic, oil, Herbes de Provence, salt, and lemon juice in a small bowl. Brush the marinade onto the skewers.
Grill the skewers for three to five minutes on each side until you get noticeable grill marks and the zucchini and tomatoes start to brown. Serve and enjoy!

name: Green Pea & Mint Sunflower Dip
ingredients:
2 cups
Frozen Peas (thawed)
2
Garlic (cloves, skin removed)
1/4 cup
Sunflower Seeds
1/2 cup
Mint Leaves
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Add all ingredients to a food processor and blend for two to five minutes, or until desired consistency. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Parmesan Radishes
ingredients:
2 1/2 cups
Radishes (halved)
1 1/2 tsps
Avocado Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Oregano
2 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 400ºF (205ºC).
In a bowl, combine the radishes with oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and oregano. Toss to combine.
Place the radishes in the air fryer basket. Arrange in an even layer and bake for nine minutes.
Remove the basket and transfer the radishes to the same bowl used to season them. Sprinkle the parmesan on top and transfer back to the air fryer. Bake for four to five minutes, until cooked through.
Divide evenly between plates. Enjoy!

name: Orange Tahini Salad Dressing
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Tahini
1/2
Navel Orange (medium, zested, juiced)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1 1/2 tsps
Honey
1
Garlic (clove, minced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Whisk all of the ingredients together until well combined. Adjust the seasoning to your taste and enjoy!

name: Mashed Pinto Beans & Tortillas
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4
Yellow Onion (chopped)
1/2
Jalapeno Pepper (minced, seeds optional)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 cup
Pinto Beans (cooked)
1/4 cup
Water
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
3
Corn Tortilla (warmed)
recipe:
Warm the oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the onions, jalapeno pepper, and garlic and cook for two to three minutes or until fragrant.
Add the pinto beans, water, and salt. Simmer for three to four minutes to heat the beans. Gently mash half of the beans in the pan and stir to create a cohesive mixture. Alternatively, you can leave the beans whole.
Serve the beans with the tortillas and enjoy!

name: Grilled Tofu, Tomato & Zucchini Pasta Salad
ingredients:
4 1/2 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (dry)
11 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, drained, pressed and cubed)
1
Zucchini (cubed)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Herbes De Provence
1 1/2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano (shaved)
recipe:
Cook the chickpea pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Add the tofu, zucchini, and tomatoes to a grill basket or foil packet. Mix the oil, Herbes de Provence, lemon juice, garlic, and salt together. Brush the marinade onto the tofu mixture. Reserve the leftover marinade.
Grill for five to seven minutes, tossing gently, or until you see grill marks and the tomatoes and zucchini have softened.
Add the veggies to a bowl with the pasta. Add the reserved marinade and toss well to combine. Top with parmesan cheese. Enjoy!

name: Grapefruit Ginger Chia Fresca
ingredients:
2 cups
Grapefruit Juice
1 cup
Water
2 tsps
Ginger (freshly grated)
2 tsps
Raw Honey
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
recipe: Combine all ingredients in a sealable jar and top with a lid. Shake well to combine, then transfer to the fridge for 15 to 20 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Pecan Chocolate Chunk Cookies
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Butter (melted)
2/3 cup
Coconut Sugar
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 3/4 cups
Spelt Flour
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Baking Soda
5 ozs
Dark Chocolate (chopped)
1/2 cup
Pecans (chopped)
recipe:
In a large bowl combine the melted butter with the coconut sugar. Whisk until very well incorporated and fairly smooth.
Add the milk and vanilla and whisk again until blended. Add the flour, salt, and baking soda and use a spatula to combine just until no flour streaks remain.
Fold in the chocolate and pecans. Cover and refrigerate for 20 to 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Scoop about two tablespoons of dough per cookie and form into a ball. Place on the baking sheet and slightly flatten, leaving space between cookies (use another baking sheet or bake in batches if needed).
Bake for 11 minutes. Let the cookies cool for five minutes before transferring them to a cooling rack for another five minutes. Enjoy!

name: Oil-Free Blueberry Dressing
ingredients:
1 cup
Blueberries
3 tbsps
Balsamic Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
recipe: Add all of the ingredients together in a blender and blend until combined. Adjust it to your taste and enjoy!

name: Kombucha Chia Fresca
ingredients:
1 1/2 pints
Kombucha
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
recipe: Combine the kombucha and chia seeds in a sealable jar and top with a lid. Gently rotate the jar to mix the seeds in (do not shake). Transfer to the fridge for 15 to 20 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Caprese Pita Pizza
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
3 1/16 ozs
White Pita Bread
1/2
Tomato (large, sliced)
3 ozs
Mozzarella Cheese (sliced)
1/3 cup
Basil Leaves
1/2 tsp
Oregano
recipe:
Preheat half of the grill to medium heat.
Add half of the oil onto the pita and rub it all over with your hands or a brush. Add the tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil.
Brush the remaining oil onto the grill. Place the pizza onto the direct heat and cook with the lid open for two to three minutes. Move the pizza to the other side of the grill (indirect heat) and close the lid. Cook for four to five minutes or until the cheese has melted. Check on it occasionally so it doesn’t burn.
Top the pizza with oregano. Cut it into equal pieces and enjoy!

name: Pinto Bean Quesadillas
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Pinto Beans (cooked)
2 tbsps
Salsa (drained of excess liquid)
2
Corn Tortilla (small)
1 1/2 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)
1 tbsp
Sour Cream
recipe:
Preheat a cast-iron pan over medium heat.
Mix the beans with the salsa. Divide the beans evenly between the tortillas being sure to cover half of each tortilla. Sprinkle the cheese over the beans. Fold the tortillas in half and gently transfer them to the pan.
Heat the quesadillas for three to five minutes on each side until the tortillas are lightly browned and the cheese has melted.
Cut the quesadillas in half, if desired, and top with sour cream. Enjoy!

name: Pesto Pasta with Scallops
ingredients:
7 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (dry)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 lb
Scallops (defrosted)
8 cups
Baby Spinach
1/2 cup
Pesto
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan. Once hot, add the scallops and cook for three to five minutes on each side, until starting to brown.
Remove the scallops from the pan. Add the spinach with a splash of water and sauté for two minutes, or until wilted.
Combine the pasta, spinach, and pesto, and mix until well-coated. Serve with scallops, and enjoy!

name: Chickpea & Tofu Taco Scramble
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Shallot (minced)
1/4 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (chopped)
11 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, drained, pressed and crumbled)
1/2 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2 tsp
Taco Seasoning
1/2
Lime (juiced)
recipe:
Warm the oil in a pan over medium heat. Sauté the shallot and tomatoes until softened, about two to three minutes.
Add the tofu, chickpeas, and taco seasoning and mix well. Cook for three minutes to heat through.
Divide the scramble evenly between plates and squeeze the lime over top. Enjoy!

name: Smashed Avocado & Lima Bean Toast
ingredients:
1
Avocado (medium)
1 cup
Lima Beans (cooked)
1/2
Lime (medium, juiced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
3 1/2 ozs
Sourdough Bread (sliced, toasted)
1 cup
Alfalfa Sprouts
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
In a bowl, smash the avocado until smooth. Add the lima beans to the bowl, lightly smash the beans and mix with avocado. Add the lime juice and sea salt, adjusting the seasoning to your taste.
Add the bean mixture to the toast. Top with alfalfa sprouts and chili flakes. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Zucchini & Chickpea Pasta Salad
ingredients:
4 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (dry)
1/3 cup
Frozen Peas
1
Zucchini (chopped)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the chickpea pasta according to the package directions. In the final five minutes of cooking, add the frozen peas to the pot to cook. Drain everything and set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat the grill to medium heat. Toss the zucchini and onion with half of the oil. Add to a grill basket and grill until the veggies are slightly charred, about five to seven minutes.
Mix the lemon juice, garlic, sea salt, pepper, and remaining oil. Toss this mixture together with the pasta, peas, and veggies, and garnish with the dill. Enjoy!

name: Nightshade-Free Curry Powder
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Turmeric
2 tsps
Coriander
2 tsps
Cumin
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 tsp
Ground Ginger
1/4 tsp
Cardamom
1/8 tsp
Nutmeg
recipe: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and mix well with a fork. Enjoy!

name: Oil-Free Thousand Island Dressing
ingredients:
5 1/4 ozs
Tofu (extra soft)
1 tsp
Yellow Mustard
2 tbsps
Sugar Free Ketchup
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
2 tbsps
Orange Juice
1/4 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 oz
Relish
1/4 tsp
Paprika
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until a smooth consistency is achieved. Enjoy!

name: Jamaican Rice & Peas
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1
Yellow Onion (small, chopped)
1 1/2 cups
Basmati Rice (dry, rinsed)
1 2/3 cups
Canned Coconut Milk
2/3 cup
Water
1/2 tsp
Ground Allspice
1 1/2 tsps
Thyme
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1
Bay Leaf
2 cups
Red Kidney Beans (cooked)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté the garlic and onion until fragrant, about two to three minutes.
Add the rice, coconut milk, water, allspice, thyme, salt, bay leaf, and kidney beans. Bring everything to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer, cover, and cook on low for 15 minutes.
Take the pot off the heat leaving the lid on and allow it to steam for another 10 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork and divide evenly between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spinach & Feta Stuffed Pita
ingredients:
1 cup
Frozen Spinach (thawed, drained)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
1/2
Lemon (juiced, zested)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 1/3 ozs
Mini Whole Wheat Pita
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, add the spinach, feta, parsley, lemon juice, lemon zest, garlic, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Cut the pitas open and stuff them with the spinach mixture. Spray both sides of the pitas with oil and place on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the oven for eight to 10 minutes or until crispy and golden brown, flipping halfway through. Cut the pitas in half and enjoy!

name: Sumac Pita Chips
ingredients:
7 ozs
White Pita Bread
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Ground Sumac
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC).
Use a knife or scissors to cut the pita bread into triangles. Place the cut pita pieces into a bowl and add the oil. Mix with your hands to coat each piece of pita. Add the sumac and salt, and mix again.
Spread the pita chips onto a baking sheet in a single layer. Bake for 10 to 11 minutes, or until crispy and browned, flipping halfway through.
Let the chips cool for a few minutes before serving. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Salt & Vinegar Kale Chips
ingredients:
7 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped)
1/4 cup
White Distilled Vinegar
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 375°F (190°C).
Add all ingredients to a bowl. Massage the kale with your hands until all of the liquid is absorbed.
Add the kale leaves to the air fryer. Cook for seven to 10 minutes, tossing regularly, until completely dried and crispy. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Falafel
ingredients:
3 1/3 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2
Yellow Onion (chopped)
3
Garlic (clove)
1/4 cup
Parsley
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves
1/2 cup
Chickpea Flour
1 tsp
Cumin
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 375°F (190°C).
Add the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, mint, flour, cumin, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and half of the oil to a food processor. Blend until a smooth consistency is achieved.
Form the batter into two to three-inch balls with your hands. Place into the air fryer and coat with the remaining oil.
Cook for 15 minutes, flipping halfway through, until crispy and cooked through. Enjoy!

name: Mango, Avocado & Black Bean Salad
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Lime (juiced)
1
Garlic (clove, whole)
1 tsp
Raw Honey

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Tomato (large, chopped)
1
Mango (small, peeled, chopped)
1
Avocado (cubed)
1 cup
Black Beans (cooked, rinsed)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
In a jar, add the oil, lime juice, garlic, honey, salt, and pepper. Add a splash of water and close the jar. Shake it until smooth and emulsified. Let the garlic infuse in the dressing for five to ten minutes. Discard the garlic before adding the dressing to the salad.
In a large bowl, combine the tomato, mango, avocado, beans, onion, and feta cheese.
Pour the dressing onto the salad and toss to combine. Divide evenly onto plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Strawberry Rhubarb Popsicles
ingredients:
2 cups
Strawberries
2 cups
Rhubarb
2 tbsps
Raw Honey
1 1/2 cups
Coconut Water
recipe:
Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth.
Add to popsicle molds and freeze for at least four to five hours, until completely frozen. Enjoy!

name: Green Pea & Edamame Dip
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Frozen Edamame
1/3 cup
Frozen Peas
2 tbsps
Tahini

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
2 tbsps
Water
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
recipe:
Add the edamame and peas to boiling water for three minutes or until tender. Drain and add to a food processor.
Add all of the remaining ingredients except for the oil to the food processor. Blend until smooth, scraping down the sides as needed.
Add the dip into a serving bowl and drizzle the oil on top. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea & Spinach Salad with Strawberry Rhubarb Dressing
ingredients:
1 cup
Strawberries (sliced, divided)
1 cup
Rhubarb (finely chopped, divided)
2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinegar
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Raw Honey
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
4 cups
Baby Spinach
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
1/2 cup
Pecans
recipe:
Add half of the strawberries, half of the rhubarb, balsamic vinegar, oil, honey, and salt to a small blender and blend until smooth.
Divide the spinach, remaining strawberries, remaining rhubarb, chickpeas, red onion, and pecans evenly between bowls. Add the dressing on top and enjoy!

name: Grilled Potato Wedges
ingredients:
2
Russet Potato (large, cut into wedges)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (plus more for greasing the grill)
1 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Black Pepper
recipe:
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and carefully add the potato wedges. Boil for four to six minutes or until they are slightly soft. Don't overcook. Drain and add oil, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat and grease the grill with oil. Grill the potatoes for five to six minutes on each side or until they are charred and fork-tender. Season with more salt if needed. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Grilled Halloumi & Watermelon Salad
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (plus more for greasing grill)
8 3/4 ozs
Halloumi (sliced)
1/4
Seedless Watermelon (medium, chopped)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the grill to medium heat and grease it with oil. Place the halloumi on the grill and cook for two to three minutes per side or until browned.
Cut the halloumi into smaller pieces (approximately two inches/five cm). Add the halloumi pieces, watermelon, tomatoes, mint, honey, oil, and salt to a large bowl. Mix to combine. Divide evenly between plates or into bowls and enjoy!

name: Citrus, Edamame & Kale Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
Frozen Edamame
4 cups
Kale Leaves (finely chopped)
1
Carrot (large, grated)
1
Grapefruit (peeled, seeded, chopped)
1/2 cup
Pecans
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the edamame and cook for five minutes. Drain, rinse under cold water, and set aside.
Add the kale to a large bowl and massage until broken down. Add the carrot, edamame, grapefruit, and pecans. Mix to combine. Add the lemon juice and oil, toss, and season with salt and pepper. Toss once more until well coated. Enjoy!

name: Blackberry Basil Mocktail
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Blackberries (plus more for garnish)
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves
1 tsp
Cane Sugar
12
Ice Cubes
1 cup
Sparkling Water
recipe:
In a glass or cocktail shaker, add the blackberries, basil, and sugar. Muddle until mashed.
Use a small sieve to pour the blackberry mixture into a measuring cup. Use a spoon to get the liquid through the sieve, then discard the mashed blackberry and basil pieces. Divide the juice between glasses.
Divide the ice cubes into the glasses and top each with sparkling water. Garnish with more blackberries. Enjoy!

name: Artichoke & Chickpea Salad
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2 cup
Artichoke Hearts (from the can, drained, chopped)
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1/4 cup
Parsley (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
White Wine Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a large bowl and mix to combine. Divide evenly between bowls or onto plates and enjoy!

name: Sumac & Parsley Carrot Salad
ingredients:
8
Carrot (large, peeled, cut into 1 inch rounds)
1 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1/2 cup
Parsley (chopped)
1 tbsp
Ground Sumac
recipe:
In a large pot, add the carrots and enough water to cover about two inches above the carrots. Add half of the salt and bring to a boil then lower the heat. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes or until the carrots are just fork-tender.
Drain the carrots well and place them into a large bowl. Add the oil, lemon juice, parsley, sumac, and the remaining sea salt. Toss to combine. Serve warm or refrigerate overnight for a cold salad. Enjoy!

name: Tofu Scramble with Lentils & Spinach
ingredients:
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
14 ozs
Tofu (crumbled)
1 tbsp
Nutritional Yeast
1 tsp
Turmeric
1/2 tsp
Cumin

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Lentils (cooked)
2 cups
Baby Spinach (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and sauté for one minute.
Add the tofu, nutritional yeast, turmeric, and cumin to the skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Cook for five minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the lentils and spinach to the skillet. Cook for another three to four minutes or until the spinach wilts. Enjoy!

name: Za'atar Pita Chips
ingredients:
7 ozs
White Pita Bread
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Za'atar Spice
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC).
Use a knife or scissors to cut the pita bread into triangles. Place the cut pita bread into a bowl and add the oil. Mix with your hands to coat each piece of pita. Add the za'atar spice and salt and mix again.
Spread the pita chips onto a baking sheet in a single layer. Bake for 10 to 11 minutes, or until crispy and browned, flipping halfway through.
Let the chips cool for a few minutes before serving. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Falafel Salad
ingredients:
3 1/3 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2
Yellow Onion (chopped)
3
Garlic (clove)
1/4 cup
Parsley
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves
1/2 cup
Chickpea Flour
1 tsp
Cumin
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
8 cups
Mixed Greens
1 cup
Tzatziki
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 375°F (190°C).
Add the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, mint, flour, cumin, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and half of the oil to a food processor. Blend until a smooth consistency is achieved.
Form the batter into two to three-inch balls with your hands. Place into the air fryer and coat with the remaining oil.
Cook for 15 minutes, flipping halfway through, until crispy and cooked through.
Divide the mixed greens evenly between bowls. Top with falafels and tzatziki. Enjoy!

name: Vanilla Berry Protein Smoothie
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Soy Milk
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
1/2 cup
Blueberries (fresh or frozen)
1/2 cup
Raspberries (fresh or frozen)
1 tbsp
Almond Butter
recipe: Add all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Divide into glasses and enjoy!

name: Charred Corn & Tomato Salad
ingredients:
3 ears
Corn On The Cob (husk removed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tbsps
Red Wine Vinegar
3 cups
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (shaved)
1/3 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Heat a cast-iron skillet over medium heat. Cook the corn over medium-high heat for about one to two minutes per side until lightly charred on all sides. Once it is cooked, remove and let it cool before slicing the kernels off the cob. Season with salt and pepper and transfer to a large bowl.
In a small jar, combine the oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper and shake to combine.
Add the tomatoes and red onion to the bowl with the corn. Add the dressing and toss to combine. Top with parmesan cheese and basil. Season if needed and enjoy!

name: Bok Choy, Mushroom & Lima Bean Bowls
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Basmati Rice (dry, rinsed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 cup
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
3 cups
Mushrooms (sliced)
1 tbsp
Tamari
1 1/2 cups
Lima Beans (cooked)
3 cups
Bok Choy (chopped)
1/4 cup
Vegetable Broth

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook rice according to the package directions.
Heat the oil in a pan and add the onion. Cook for two minutes or until softened. Add the garlic and cook for another minute. Add the mushrooms and tamari and continue to cook for five to seven minutes or until the mushrooms have softened. Add the beans and cook for another minute, then remove the mushroom and bean mixture from the pan and set aside.
Add the bok choy and broth to the pan and cook for three minutes or until the bok choy is wilted and fork-tender. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide the rice, bok choy, and mushroom mixture evenly between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Mediterranean Pita Pizza
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
3 ozs
White Pita Bread
1
Garlic (clove, smashed)
1/2 cup
Artichoke Hearts (from the can, drained, sliced)
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1/4 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives (chopped)
1/2 tsp
Oregano (dried)
recipe:
Preheat half of the grill to medium heat.
Add half of the oil onto the pita and rub it all over with your hands or a brush. Rub the smashed garlic all over the pita, then discard. Add the artichoke hearts, tomatoes, onion, feta cheese, and olives. Brush the remaining oil onto the grill. Place the pizza onto the direct heat and cook with the lid open for two to three minutes. Move the pizza to the other side of the grill (indirect heat) and close the lid. Cook for four to five minutes or until the cheese has melted. Check on it occasionally so it doesn’t burn.
Top the pizza with oregano. Cut it into equal pieces and enjoy!

name: Moroccan Pancakes
ingredients:
1 cup
Semolina
2 1/2 ozs
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
1 tsp
Instant Yeast
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 tsps
Brown Sugar
1 2/3 cups
Water (lukewarm)
1 1/2 cups
Strawberries (chopped)
1/4 cup
Honey
recipe:
In a blender, add the semolina, flour, yeast, salt, sugar, and water. Blend until mixed well.
Add the batter to a bowl. Cover and let sit for about 15 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add approximately 1/4 cup of batter to the pan. Bubbles will start to form immediately. Once the pancake looks completely cooked on the top, remove it from the heat. Repeat with any remaining batter, adjusting the heat as needed to keep it at medium and no higher.
Serve warm with strawberries and honey. Enjoy!

name: Cucumber & Radish Sandwich
ingredients:
2 1/2 tbsps
Cream Cheese, Regular
2 slices
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
1/4
Cucumber (small, sliced)
1/4 cup
Radishes (trimmed, thinly sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Spread cream cheese on each slice of bread.
Top with cucumbers and radishes and season with salt and pepper. Slice in half and enjoy!

name: Mexican Street Corn Salad
ingredients:
2 ears
Corn On The Cob (husk removed)
1
Lime (juiced and zested)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
3 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
1/2
Jalapeno Pepper (seeds removed, finely diced)
1/4 cup
Cotija Cheese
recipe:
Heat a cast-iron pan or grill over medium-high heat. Cook the corn for one to two minutes per side until lightly charred on all sides. Once it is cooked, remove it and let it cool for about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a bowl, mix together the lime juice, lime zest, oil, salt, cilantro, jalapeño, and cotija cheese.
Slice the kernels off the cob and transfer them into the bowl. Mix everything together until combined and enjoy!

name: Almond Raspberry Warm Chia Pudding
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Chia Seeds
3/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2 cup
Raspberries
1 tbsp
Slivered Almonds
1 tbsp
Almond Butter
recipe:
Whisk together the chia seeds and almond milk in a small pot over medium-low heat.
Stir until heated through and the mixture has thickened up, about five minutes.
Remove from heat and add to a bowl. Top with raspberries, slivered almonds, and almond butter. Enjoy!

name: Vegan Cauliflower Risotto
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Garlic (clove, chopped)
1/2
Yellow Onion (large, chopped)
2 tsps
Arrowroot Powder
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2 cup
Vegetable Broth
2 cups
Baby Spinach
1 1/2 cups
Cauliflower Rice
1 tbsp
Chives (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and the onions. Stir and cook for approximately two minutes or until tender.
Add the arrowroot and stir to coat. Add the milk and stir then add the broth, stirring slowly to combine. Add the spinach, stirring constantly. Cook for two minutes or until wilted.
Stir in the cauliflower rice and allow to cook for three to five minutes or until warmed through.
Divide evenly between bowls, top with chives, and enjoy!

name: Slow Cooker Black Bean & Barley Chili
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Pearl Barley (uncooked, rinsed and drained)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (medium, finely chopped)
2 stalks
Celery (chopped)
2 tsps
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Chili Powder
2
Bay Leaf
2 cups
Black Beans (cooked)
1 cup
Kale Leaves (chopped)
4 cups
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with the juices)
3 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
recipe:
Place all the ingredients in the slow cooker and stir to combine. Cover and cook for four hours on high or six hours on low setting.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Edamame & Barley Spinach Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Pearl Barley (uncooked, rinsed and drained)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (finely chopped)
2 1/2 tbsps
Lemon Juice (divided)
1/2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
1/2 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
2 cups
Baby Spinach
recipe:
Cook the barley according to the package directions.
In a large bowl, mix the onions in 2/3 of the lemon juice and set aside.
Once cooked, add the barley to the bowl of onions and set aside to cool to room temperature.
Once the barley has cooled, add the remaining ingredients and stir to coat. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Cucumber & Tzatziki Sandwich
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Tzatziki
2 slices
Whole Grain Bread
1/4
Cucumber (large, sliced)
recipe: Divide the tzatziki onto each slice of bread. Add the cucumbers to one slide of bread. Close the sandwich and cut it in half. Enjoy!

name: Cold Orzo, Zucchini & Corn Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Orzo (dry)
2 ears
Corn On The Cob (husk removed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (plus extra for cooking)
2
Zucchini (sliced)
2 tbsps
White Wine Vinegar
3/4 cup
Goat Cheese (crumbled)
1/2 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the orzo according to the package directions. Drain and add to a large bowl.
Meanwhile, using a cast-iron pan or grill, cook the corn over medium-high heat for about one to two minutes per side or until lightly charred on all sides. Once it is cooked, remove and let it cool before slicing the kernels off the cob. Season with salt and pepper and transfer to the bowl with the orzo. In the same skillet over medium heat, add a small drizzle of oil. Once hot, add the zucchini and cook for about two to three minutes per side, until browned and just cooked through. Remove and season with salt and pepper. Transfer to the bowl with the orzo.
In a small jar, combine the oil with the vinegar and season with salt and pepper. Shake to combine.
Pour the dressing over the orzo salad and top with goat cheese and basil. Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Peach Sorbet
ingredients:
3 cups
Frozen Peaches
1/3 cup
Water
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
recipe:
Let the peaches thaw for five minutes before placing them into a food processor with the water and maple syrup. Blend until smooth. Transfer to a bowl and freeze for 30 to 35 minutes or longer for a firmer texture.
Scoop into bowls and enjoy!

name: Irio
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (thinly sliced)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
2 1/2 cups
Mini Potatoes (halved)
1 cup
Frozen Peas (defrosted)
1 cup
Frozen Corn (defrosted)
1/2 tsp
Paprika
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion and half of the salt, and cook for 20 minutes, stirring frequently, until browned and starting to crisp. Set aside.
Meanwhile, bring a pot of water to a boil and add the potatoes. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes, until fork tender. Remove the potatoes and reserve the water.
Add the peas and corn to the pan and cook for two to three minutes. Add the potato and continue to cook for another two to three minutes.
Add the remaining salt and paprika. Add everything to the bowl of a food processor and blend until mostly smooth. Add a splash of the reserved water as needed. You can also skip the food processor and mash the potato, corn, and peas with a masher until desired consistency.
Serve with onions on top and enjoy!

name: Whipped Ricotta & Tomato Toast
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Ricotta Cheese
1 slice
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
1/4
Tomato (large, sliced)
1 tbsp
Basil Leaves

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
In a food processor, whip the ricotta until it is creamy, fluffy, and smooth, about one to two minutes.
Spread the whipped ricotta onto the toast. Top with the tomato and basil. Season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Halloumi Fries
ingredients:
1/2 oz
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
1/2 tsp
Paprika
1/2 tsp
Dried Thyme
5 1/2 ozs
Halloumi (sliced, patted dry)
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
1/4 tsp
Black Pepper
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 375°F (190°C).
In a bowl, mix together the flour, paprika, and thyme. Add the halloumi and toss to coat well.
Transfer the halloumi slices to the air fryer. Spray with oil and bake for eight to ten minutes, shaking halfway through, until cooked.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk together the yogurt, lime juice, and black pepper. Serve alongside the halloumi fries and enjoy!

name: Cabbage & Green Bean Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
Green Beans (stems removed)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Lemon (juiced)
2 cups
Purple Cabbage (shredded)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Slivered Almonds
recipe:
Bring salted water to boil in a large pan. Add green beans, cover, and cook for five to seven minutes or until tender-crisp. Drain and transfer the green beans to an ice bath.
In a large bowl, whisk together the oil and lemon juice. Add the green beans, cabbage, and feta cheese. Toss to combine and season with salt and pepper.
Transfer the salad to a serving plate and top with slivered almonds. Enjoy!

name: Spiced Cauliflower Rice & Beans
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Shallot (chopped)
1 cup
Purple Cabbage (thinly sliced)
2 cups
Cauliflower Rice
1 tsp
Cumin
1/4 tsp
Turmeric
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Oregano

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Red Kidney Beans (cooked)
recipe:
Preheat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the shallots and cabbage. Cook stirring regularly for three to five minutes or until the shallot has softened.
Add the cauliflower rice, cumin, turmeric, garlic powder, and oregano. Season with salt and pepper. Cook for three minutes then add the kidney beans and cook for three more minutes or until warmed through.
Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Raspberry & Pecan Oatmeal
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Oats (rolled)
1 cup
Water
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 cup
Raspberries
2 tbsps
Pecans (chopped)
recipe:
Add the oats and water to a small saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring often until gently boiling. Reduce the heat and simmer until cooked through, about five to seven minutes. Mix the cinnamon into the oats once they have cooked.
Top with the raspberries and pecans and enjoy!

name: Toasted Cucumber & Tomato Sandwich
ingredients:
2 1/2 tbsps
Cream Cheese, Regular
2 slices
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
1/4
Tomato (medium, sliced)
1/4
Cucumber (small, sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Spread cream cheese on each slice of toast.
Top with tomato and cucumber and season with salt and pepper. Slice in half and enjoy!

name: Slow Cooker Kidney Bean & Barley Chili
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Pearl Barley (uncooked, rinsed and drained)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (medium, finely chopped)
2 stalks
Celery (chopped)
2 tsps
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Chili Powder
2
Bay Leaf
2 cups
Red Kidney Beans (cooked)
1 cup
Kale Leaves (stems removed and leaves chopped)
4 cups
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with the juices)
3 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
recipe:
Place all the ingredients in the slow cooker and stir the mixture. Cover and cook for four hours on high or six hours on low.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Green Goddess Mason Jar Salad
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Brown Basmati Rice (dry, rinsed)
2 tbsps
Green Goddess Salad Dressing
1 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1/4 cup
Broccoli (cut into florets)
1/4
Cucumber (medium, diced)
2 cups
Mixed Greens
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions. Let it cool to room temperature.
Layer the ingredients in a mason jar in the following order: Green Goddess dressing, edamame, broccoli, rice, cucumber, mixed greens, and hemp seeds
Seal the jar and refrigerate until ready to serve.
When ready to eat, shake well and dump into a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Greek Salad Sandwich
ingredients:
1/4
Tomato (sliced)
1/4
Cucumber (small, sliced)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Lemon Juice
1/2 tsp
Oregano (dried)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 slices
Whole Grain Bread
1/3 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
In a bowl, combine the tomato, cucumber, onion, oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
On one piece of bread, add the feta cheese and mash it with a fork. Add the marinated veggies on top of the feta cheese and close the sandwich. Cut in half and enjoy!

name: Campfire Stuffed Bananas
ingredients:
2
Banana
1/4 cup
All Natural Peanut Butter
1/4 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
For each banana, slice the banana peel and banana down the middle and gently open it up to create an opening for stuffing.
Divide the peanut butter and chocolate chips evenly between the bananas. Wrap them in foil and place them on the heated grill for five to seven minutes or until the chocolate has melted. Carefully remove from the heat and unwrap. Use a fork to eat the stuffed banana out of the peel and enjoy!

name: Campfire Dessert Quesadillas
ingredients:
1
Brown Rice Tortilla
1/4 cup
All Natural Peanut Butter
1/4 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
1/2 oz
Graham Crackers (crumbled)
recipe:
Heat the grill to medium heat.
While it is heating, place the tortilla on a plate. Spread the peanut butter onto one-half of the tortilla. Add the chocolate chips and crushed graham crackers on the same side. Fold the tortilla in half to close it and gently press down.
Place the quesadilla on the grill and cook on each side for two to three minutes or until you see grill marks and the chocolate has melted.
Remove from the heat, cut in half, and enjoy!

name: Tempeh & Sweet Potato Hash
ingredients:
8 ozs
Tempeh (cubed)
1/4 cup
Coconut Aminos
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Paprika
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
2
Sweet Potato (medium, cubed)
1/2
Yellow Bell Pepper (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
Blackberries
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the tempeh in a shallow bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together the coconut aminos, maple syrup, paprika, and half of the oil. Pour the marinade over the tempeh and let it sit for five minutes.
Arrange the tempeh into a single layer on one side of the baking sheet. Reserve the marinade for later. Add the potatoes and bell pepper to the other side and toss them with the remaining oil, salt, and pepper.
Bake for 15 minutes. Flip the tempeh, then pour the remaining marinade onto the tempeh. Place back into the oven for another 10 to 15 minutes. Remove the tempeh and set aside. Return the potatoes and bell pepper to the oven as needed until they are crispy and cooked through.
Divide the tempeh, potatoes, bell pepper, and blackberries between plates. Enjoy!

name: Vanilla Matcha Protein Balls
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Cashews
1/2 cup
Walnuts
1/2 cup
Pitted Dates
2/3 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tsp
Coconut Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Green Tea Powder
1/3 cup
Water
recipe:
Add the cashews and walnuts to a food processor and pulse until you get a coarse crumble. Add the dates, protein powder, oil, and green tea powder and pulse again until the mixture starts to come together.
Add the water one tablespoon at a time and pulse until the mixture becomes sticky and holds together when you squeeze it between your hands. You may not need all of the water. The type of protein powder used will affect this.
Use a one-inch cookie scoop or use a regular teaspoon to scoop out the batter and roll it in your hands to create a ball. Continue until you have used up all of the batter. Enjoy!

name: Beet & Dill Gazpacho
ingredients:
2
Beet (medium, chopped)
1/2
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (diced)
3
Garlic (cloves, crushed)
1/4 cup
Fresh Dill
1 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Combine all of the ingredients in a blender and blend on high for one minute or until smooth and creamy. Enjoy!

name: Tomato Peach Gazpacho
ingredients:
4
Peach (medium, pits removed)
2
Tomato (medium, chopped, plus additional for garnish)
1/2
Zucchini (medium, chopped)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (chopped, plus additional for garnish)
1/2 cup
Basil Leaves (plus additional for garnish)
1 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt (plus additional for garnish)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Apple Cider Vinegar
1 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend for at least one minute, until smooth and creamy. Enjoy!

name: Charred Broccolini with Tahini Dressing
ingredients:
8 ozs
Broccolini
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Tahini
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1 tbsp
Water
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Sesame Seeds
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (215ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the broccolini on the baking sheet and toss with the oil, salt, and pepper. Mix well with your hands. Transfer the baking sheet to the oven and cook for 20 to 25 minutes, until charred and crispy.
Meanwhile, in a bowl, whisk together the tahini, lemon juice, water, and garlic. Season the sauce with salt and pepper.
Transfer the broccolini to a serving dish. Top with the tahini sauce and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Lemon & Herb Potato Wedges
ingredients:
4
Red Potato (medium, cut into wedges)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Lemon (juiced)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
recipe:
Preheat the grill to medium-low heat. In a bowl, toss together the potato wedges, half of the oil, salt, and pepper.
Grill the potatoes for 10 to 12 minutes on each side or until they are charred and fork-tender.
Meanwhile in a bowl, mix together the remaining oil, lemon juice, dill, parsley, and red onion. Once the potatoes are cooked, transfer them to a plate and let them cool down for about five minutes. Add the potatoes to the bowl and toss to combine. Adjust the seasoning to your taste and enjoy!

name: Arugula, Kale & Pinto Bean Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 cup
Arugula
1 1/2 cups
Pinto Beans (cooked, rinsed and drained)
1
Beet (large, peeled, chopped)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
In a large bowl, add the chopped kale and drizzle some of the oil on top. Massage with your hands until the kale softens.
Add the remaining ingredients and toss to combine. Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Halloumi & Vegetable Skewers
ingredients:
6 ozs
Halloumi (cut into cubes)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes
1
Yellow Bell Pepper (medium, cut into cubes)
1
Zucchini (medium, cut into half-moon slices)
1 tbsp
Mint Leaves (chopped)
1
Lemon (juiced, divided)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
8
Barbecue Skewers (wood, soaked)
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients, except the barbecue skewers, to a bowl and toss to combine.
Preheat the grill to medium heat.
Thread and divide the halloumi cubes, cherry tomatoes, bell peppers, and zucchini pieces evenly between the skewers. Set the leftover marinade aside.
Grill for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the cheese is golden and the vegetables are soft, turning halfway through.
Divide evenly between plates, drizzle with the remaining marinade, and enjoy!

name: Cherry Salsa
ingredients:
1 cup
Cherries (pitted, finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Red Onion (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
1/2
Lime (juiced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2
Jalapeno Pepper (seeds removed, finely diced)
recipe: In a bowl, add all the ingredients and mix well. Adjust the seasoning to your taste and enjoy!

name: Easy Dill Pickles
ingredients:
1/2 cup
White Wine Vinegar
3/4 cup
Water
1 1/2 tsps
Sea Salt
1 tsp
Black Peppercorns
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
1/2 cup
Fresh Dill
2
Garlic (clove, quartered)
1
Cucumber (large, sliced lengthwise)
recipe:
In a small saucepan over medium heat, bring the vinegar, water, and salt to a boil. Stir the mixture until the salt is fully dissolved, for about three minutes. Remove from the heat.
Meanwhile, place the peppercorns, chili flakes, dill, and garlic in a glass jar. Pack the cucumbers tightly into the jar.
Carefully pour the vinegar mixture over the cucumbers, ensuring that they are completely submerged in the liquid.
Allow the jar to cool uncovered at room temperature for approximately one hour. Then cover the jar and place it in the refrigerator, leaving it for at least 24 hours. Enjoy!

name: Beet, Grapefruit & Mint Salad
ingredients:
1
Beet (medium, cubed)
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
1
Grapefruit (divided)
4 cups
Arugula
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves (chopped)
3 tbsps
Sunflower Seeds
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking with parchment paper or foil. Add the beets to the baking sheet and toss in half of the oil and half of the salt. Cook in the oven for 30 minutes, until fork-tender.
Meanwhile, create the dressing by juicing 1/4 of the grapefruit and whisking the juice with the remaining oil and salt. Remove the peel of the remaining grapefruit and chop it into small pieces.
Divide the arugula, mint, chopped grapefruit, sunflower seeds, and beets evenly between bowls. Top with the dressing and enjoy!

name: Garlic & Caper Green Beans
ingredients:
4 cups
Green Beans (trimmed)
3
Garlic (clove)
2 tbsps
Capers (rinsed)
1
Lemon (zest and juice, divided)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Place the green beans in a steamer basket over boiling water and cover. Steam for three to five minutes.
Finely chop the garlic, capers, and lemon zest together on a cutting board to make a coarse paste.
Preheat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic mixture and cook, stirring constantly for one minute. Add the lemon juice and bring to a boil. Add the beans and toss until coated, for about two minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and enjoy!

name: Spicy Mango Gazpacho
ingredients:
2
Mango (medium, peeled, sliced)
1/2
Avocado (medium, peel removed, sliced)
1
Garlic (clove, crushed)
2 tsps
Ginger (fresh, grated)
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
1/2 tsp
Red Pepper Flakes (plus more for garnish)
1 tbsp
Tamari
1 cup
Water
recipe: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend for at least one minute, until smooth and creamy. Garnish as desired and enjoy!

name: Watermelon & Strawberry Salad
ingredients:
1/2
Seedless Watermelon (small, cut into cubes)
1 1/2 cups
Strawberries (chopped)
1/3
Cucumber (medium, sliced in half moons)
3 tbsps
Mint Leaves (chopped, divided)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
3/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
In a large bowl combine the watermelon, strawberries, cucumber, and half of the mint.
In a small bowl or jar, combine the oil, honey, salt, and remaining mint.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine. Top with feta. Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Garlic Scape Pesto
ingredients:
2 1/2 cups
Garlic Scapes (chopped)
2/3 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 cups
Basil Leaves (packed)
1/2 cup
Sunflower Seeds
1/2 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (freshly grated)
1/4 cup
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Add the garlic scapes to a baking sheet and drizzle with a little bit of the oil. Toss until well coated. Bake for 15 minutes or until fork-tender and starting to brown.
Combine the roasted garlic scapes with the remaining ingredients in a food processor and blend until desired consistency. Enjoy!

name: Raspberry Pecan Warm Chia Pudding
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Chia Seeds
3/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2 cup
Raspberries
1 tbsp
Pecans
1 tbsp
Almond Butter
recipe:
Whisk together the chia seeds and almond milk in a small pot over medium-low heat. Stir until heated through and the mixture has thickened up, about five minutes.
Remove from heat and add to a bowl. Top with raspberries, pecans, and almond butter. Enjoy!

name: Buckwheat Noodles with Raw Puttanesca
ingredients:
3 1/2 ozs
Buckwheat Soba Noodles (dry)
1/4 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/2 cup
Artichoke Hearts (marinated, chopped)
1/4 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives
2 tbsps
Capers
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the noodles according to the package directions. Drain the noodles but save the pasta water.
In a large bowl, mix the remaining ingredients together. Add the noodles to the bowl with the reserved water, adding one to two tablespoons at one time. Toss everything together with tongs and divide evenly between servings. Enjoy!

name: Grapefruit & Fennel Quinoa Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinegar
1 tbsp
Dijon Mustard

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 cups
Baby Kale
1 bulb
Fennel (medium, thinly sliced)
1
Grapefruit (peeled and chopped)
1/2
Avocado (medium, diced)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Meanwhile, make the dressing by whisking together the oil, balsamic vinegar, dijon, salt, and pepper.
Once the quinoa is done, fluff with a fork and transfer to a large bowl to cool for five minutes.
Add the remaining ingredients to the bowl along with the dressing. Mix well to combine. Enjoy!

name: Tofu & Summer Vegetable Red Curry
ingredients:
1 cup
Basmati Rice (dry)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2
Carrot (medium, chopped)
1
Zucchini (medium, chopped)
1
Yellow Bell Pepper (medium, chopped)
16 ozs
Tofu (chopped)
1/4 cup
Thai Red Curry Paste
1 3/4 cups
Canned Coconut Milk

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the carrot and cook for five minutes. Add the zucchini and bell peppers and continue to cook for another one to two minutes. Add the tofu and red curry paste, mix to coat, and cook for another one to two minutes.
Add the coconut milk and season with salt and pepper. Cover with a lid, reduce the heat to low, and simmer for approximately 15 minutes, or until the vegetables are fork-tender.
Divide the rice and curry between bowls and enjoy!

name: Buckwheat & Ricotta Zucchini Boats
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Buckwheat Groats
2 tbsps
Ricotta Cheese
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped, divided)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
2
Zucchini (halved and hollowed out)
recipe:
Cook the buckwheat according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC).
Add the ricotta, half of the parsley, lemon juice, oil, and salt to the cooked buckwheat.
Add the buckwheat ricotta mixture to the zucchini and bake for 20 minutes. The zucchini should be soft but still sturdy.
Garnish the zucchini with the remaining parsley and enjoy!

name: Whipped Ricotta & Cherry Toast
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Ricotta Cheese
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced, zested)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 1/2 ozs
Sourdough Bread (sliced, toasted)
1 cup
Cherries (pits removed, halved)
1 tbsp
Sesame Seeds
recipe:
In a food processor, add the ricotta, lemon juice, lemon zest, salt, and pepper. Blend until smooth.
Spread the whipped ricotta on top of the toasted bread. Arrange the cherries on top and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Blueberry Vanilla Protein Oats
ingredients:
1 cup
Oats
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1 1/4 cups
Oat Milk
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tbsp
Ground Flax Seed
1 cup
Blueberries
1 tbsp
All Natural Peanut Butter
2 tbsps
Pecans (chopped)
recipe:
In a large bowl or container combine the oats, chia seeds, and milk. Stir to combine. Place in the fridge for eight hours, or overnight.
After the oats have set, remove from the fridge and stir in the protein powder and ground flax until well combined. Add extra oat milk one tablespoon at a time if the oats are too thick.
Divide the oats evenly between bowls or containers and top with blueberries, peanut butter, and chopped pecans. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Mint Slushie
ingredients:
3 cups
Strawberries (stems removed)
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
16
Ice Cubes
1/4 cup
Water
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until well combined. Pour into glasses and enjoy!

name: Oil & Herb Potato Salad
ingredients:
3 cups
Mini Potatoes
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
White Wine Vinegar
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
3 tbsps
Fresh Dill (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Parsley (finely chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
In a large pot, add the potatoes and enough water to cover them. Bring the pot to a boil and cook for 12 to 15 minutes or until fork-tender. Drain and let them cool before cutting them in half.
Place the halved potatoes in a bowl and add the oil, vinegar, onion, dill, parsley, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine. Serve warm or refrigerate for at least an hour before serving. Enjoy!

name: Labneh with Marinated Olives
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Green Olives (pitted)
1/2 tsp
Dried Thyme
1/4
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
2/3 cup
Labneh
recipe:
In a bowl, mix together all the ingredients except for the labneh.
Add the labneh to a serving bowl or spread onto a serving plate. Top with the olive mixture and enjoy!

name: Beet & Broccoli Salad
ingredients:
3 cups
Broccoli (including the stalk)
2
Beet (small, peeled)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cut the florets off of the broccoli and use a vegetable peeler to peel the stalks into ribbons. Add both the florets and ribboned stalks to the bowl.
Peel the beets into ribbons and add them to the bowl.
Add the oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Tomato & Feta Toast
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 3/4 ozs
Sourdough Bread (toasted)
1/4
Tomato (medium, sliced)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe: Drizzle the oil on top of the toasted bread and top with sliced tomatoes and feta cheese. Drizzle the honey on top and season with chili flakes. Enjoy!

name: Sun Dried Tomato & Feta Potato Salad
ingredients:
4 cups
Mini Potatoes
1/4 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives (chopped)
1/4 cup
Shallot (chopped)
1/4 cup
Sun Dried Tomatoes (drained, chopped)
2 tsps
Capers (drained)
1/4 cup
Fresh Dill (chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Red Wine Vinegar
2 tsps
Greek Seasoning
2 tbsps
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Boil the potatoes in water until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and cool slightly.
Cut the potatoes in half or into bite-sized chunks.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl combine the olives, shallots, sun dried tomatoes, capers, dill, oil, vinegar, and Greek seasoning. Add the potatoes and toss gently. Top with feta cheese.
Serve at room temperature or refrigerate for at least an hour before serving. Enjoy!

name: Cherry & Dark Chocolate Overnight Oats
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
2/3 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1 tbsp
Ground Flax Seed
1/2 cup
Oats (rolled)
1/16 tsp
Sea Salt
2/3 cup
Cherries (pitted, chopped)
1 oz
Dark Chocolate (chopped)
recipe:
Whisk the Greek yogurt, milk, maple syrup, and vanilla together in a bowl.
Add in the remaining ingredients, with the option of keeping 1/4 of each the cherries and dark chocolate for garnish. Stir together until combined.
Divide the mixture evenly between jars. Top with the remaining cherries and chocolate (if reserved for garnish). Cover and place in the fridge overnight, or for at least eight hours. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Corn & Okra Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Okra (trimmed, halved lengthwise)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 ears
Corn On The Cob (husk removed)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1/4
Cucumber (large, sliced)
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1
Lime (medium, juiced)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a bowl, add the okra, half of the oil, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine and set aside.
Place the corn on the grill and grill for 15 to 20 minutes, or until lightly charred, turning occasionally. Remove from the heat and let it cool for five to ten minutes before cutting.
While the corn is cooling, place the okra on the grill. Grill for two to three minutes per side or until lightly charred.
Cut the kernels off the cobs and add them to a large bowl. Add the okra, onion, cucumber, tomatoes, remaining oil, lime juice, parsley, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine.
Divide evenly between bowls or plates. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea, Beet & Kale Grain Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Farro (uncooked, rinsed)
2 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped)
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1
Beet (small, peeled, chopped)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
White Wine Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the farro according to the package directions.
To assemble the bowls, divide the farro, kale, chickpeas, onion, beet, feta, oil, and vinegar evenly between bowls. Season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Strawberries & Feta on Toast
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Strawberries (chopped)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Raw Honey
3 1/2 ozs
Sourdough Bread (sliced, toasted)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Place the strawberries on a rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and honey and toss to combine.
Cook the strawberries in the oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until slightly soft.
Top the toasted bread with roasted strawberries and feta cheese. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean & Quinoa Greek Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry)
1/2
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1
Tomato (medium, chopped)
2 tbsps
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
1
Orange Bell Pepper (medium, chopped)
1/4 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1 tsp
Greek Seasoning
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Red Wine Vinegar
1 1/2 cups
Black Beans (cooked)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions. Set aside to cool.
In a large bowl combine the cucumber, tomato, red onion, bell pepper, olives, and feta cheese together.
In a separate bowl, mix together the Greek seasoning, oil, and vinegar. Pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss to coat.
Divide the quinoa, salad, and black beans evenly between bowls, and enjoy!

name: Lentil & Cucumber Balsamic Chopped Salad
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Lentils (cooked)
1
Cucumber (medium, diced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (large, diced)
3 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves (chopped)
1/3 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
3 tbsps
Balsamic Vinaigrette

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Combine all of the ingredients in a large bowl. Mix well to combine. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Whipped Ricotta & Pesto Toast
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Ricotta Cheese
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced, zested)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 1/2 ozs
Sourdough Bread (sliced, toasted)
2 tbsps
Pesto
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
In a food processor, add the ricotta, lemon juice, lemon zest, salt, and pepper. Blend until smooth.
Spread the whipped ricotta on top of the toasted bread. Spoon the pesto on top and sprinkle with chili flakes. Enjoy!

name: Garlic Scape Pesto with Crackers
ingredients:
2 1/2 cups
Garlic Scapes (chopped)
2/3 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 cups
Basil Leaves (packed)
1/2 cup
Sunflower Seeds
1/2 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (freshly grated)
1/4 cup
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Sea Salt
9 ozs
Rice Crackers
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Add the garlic scapes to a baking sheet and drizzle with a little bit of the oil. Toss until well coated. Bake for 15 minutes or until fork-tender and starting to brown.
Combine the roasted garlic scapes with the remaining ingredients, except for the crackers, in a food processor and blend until desired consistency.
Serve with crackers and enjoy!

name: Tomato & Mozzarella Pesto Sandwich
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Pesto
2 slices
Whole Grain Bread
1/4
Tomato (sliced)
1 1/16 ozs
Mozzarella Ball (sliced)
recipe: Spread the pesto onto each piece of bread. Add the tomato and mozzarella to one piece of bread and close the sandwich. Cut in half and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Balsamic Red Peppers & Garlic Scapes
ingredients:
1
Red Bell Pepper (large, sliced)
2 cups
Garlic Scapes (chopped)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (chopped)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Balsamic Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 380°F (195°C).
Toss the vegetables with oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper. Add to the air fryer basket and cook for 15 minutes, tossing a few times, until starting to brown and crisp. Enjoy!

name: Apricot Chia Jam
ingredients:
4
Apricot (medium, pit removed, chopped)
1/3 cup
Water
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
recipe:
Add the apricots, water, maple syrup, vanilla, and cinnamon to a saucepan over medium heat. Cook the apricots until they start to soften, about five to six minutes.
Use a potato masher or a fork to mash the apricots. Stir in the chia seeds and cook for another three to five minutes or until the mixture has thickened.
Remove from the heat and let it cool before pouring into a jar. Once cooled, refrigerate and enjoy!

name: Mango Chia Coconut Pudding
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Plain Coconut Milk
1/4
Mango (plus extra for garnish)
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1 tsp
Ground Flax Seed
1 tsp
Sunflower Seeds
recipe:
Add the coconut milk, mango, and vanilla to a small blender or food processor and blend well until combined.
Pour the mango mixture into a medium-sized bowl and add the chia seeds. Stir well to combine. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight to thicken.
Divide evenly between bowls or add into to-go containers. Top with extra mango (if using), flax, and sunflower seeds. Enjoy!

name: One Pot Chipotle Tomato Lentils with Sausage
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 cup
Red Onion (diced)
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
16 ozs
Venison Sausage
1
Zucchini (medium, chopped)
1 1/2 cups
Crushed Tomatoes
2 cups
Lentils (cooked)
1 tsp
Chipotle Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the red onion and cook for one minute. Add the garlic and cook for another minute, then add the sausages and continue to cook for five minutes.
Add the zucchini, crushed tomatoes, lentils, chipotle powder, salt, and pepper. Cover, reduce the heat, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the sausages are cooked through and the zucchini is fork-tender. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Chia Coconut Pudding
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Plain Coconut Milk
1/2 cup
Strawberries (plus extra for garnish)
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1 tbsp
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
recipe:
Add the coconut milk, strawberries, and vanilla to a small blender or food processor and blend well until combined.
Add the strawberry mixture to a medium-sized bowl and add the chia seeds. Stir well to combine. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight to thicken.
Divide the mixture evenly between bowls or in to-go containers. Top with extra strawberries (if using) and shredded coconut. Enjoy!

name: Peach & Tomato Salad
ingredients:
3
Peach (pits removed, sliced)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes
1/3 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves (chopped)
recipe: In a bowl, combine the peaches, tomatoes, and onions. Top with crumbled feta then drizzle the oil and honey over top. Season with salt and top with basil. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Cauliflower, Chickpea & Turmeric Puree
ingredients:
1 head
Cauliflower (small, cut into small florets)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Turmeric
1/2 tsp
Cumin
1/4 tsp
Coriander
1/4 tsp
Paprika
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1/2 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Steam the cauliflower florets for five to seven minutes, or until tender, and then let them cool slightly.
In a pan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the turmeric, cumin, coriander, and paprika. Cook for one minute to bloom the spices, or until fragrant.
In a blender or food processor, combine the steamed cauliflower, bloomed spices, lemon juice, and chickpeas. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Blend until smooth and creamy. Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Raspberry Chia Jam
ingredients:
1 cup
Raspberries
1 tsp
Lemon Juice
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
1 1/2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
recipe:
Add the raspberries, lemon juice, and honey to a blender and pulse blend for a few seconds, until desired consistency. Alternatively, you can mash with a fork.
Add to a sealable container and mix in the chia seeds. Transfer to the fridge and allow to sit for at least two hours. Enjoy!

name: Raspberry Chia Coconut Pudding
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Plain Coconut Milk
1/2 cup
Raspberries (plus extra for garnish)
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1 tbsp
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
recipe:
Add the coconut milk, raspberries, and vanilla to a small blender or food processor and blend well until combined.
Pour the raspberry mixture into a medium-sized bowl and add the chia seeds. Stir well to combine. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight to thicken.
Divide evenly between bowls or in to-go containers. Top with extra raspberries (if using) and shredded coconut. Enjoy!

name: Pureed Turnip & Potatoes with Sausages
ingredients:
2
Turnip (medium, chopped)
4
Yellow Potato (medium, chopped)
5
Garlic (cloves, leave skin on)
1 lb
Lamb Sausage
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Butter
2 tbsps
Cow's Milk, Whole

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Toss the turnips, potatoes, and garlic cloves in oil and place on a baking sheet with the sausages. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Squeeze the garlic cloves out of their peel and add them along with the turnips, potatoes, butter, milk, salt, and pepper to a food processor. Blend until desired consistency. Alternatively, you can also mash until your desired consistency.
Serve the turnip and potato mash with the sausages and enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato & White Bean Puree
ingredients:
2
Sweet Potato (medium, peeled, cubed)
1/2 cup
Plain Coconut Milk
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon
1/8 tsp
Nutmeg
1/16 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
White Navy Beans (cooked)
recipe:
Steam the sweet potato until tender, for 10 to 12 minutes. Let them cool slightly.
In a blender or food processor, combine the steamed sweet potatoes, coconut milk, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt, and beans.
Blend until smooth and creamy. Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Strawberry Basil Smoothie Bowl
ingredients:
1/2
Banana (frozen)
1 cup
Strawberries (frozen plus additional for garnish)
1/2
Zucchini (medium, chopped, frozen)
1/4
Avocado
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves (plus additional for garnish)
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1/2 cup
Coconut Water
1 tbsp
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut (for garnish)
1 tbsp
Pumpkin Seeds (for garnish)
recipe:
