Add the banana, strawberries, zucchini, avocado, basil, protein powder, and coconut water in a blender or food processor. Start to blend on low, working your way up to high, and tampering as necessary until a thick, ice cream-like consistency is achieved.
Scoop into a bowl and top with the shredded coconut and pumpkin seeds. Add strawberries and basil if desired. Enjoy!

name: Cherry & Strawberry Flaxseed Pudding
ingredients:
1 cup
Ground Flax Seed
1 1/2 cups
Plain Coconut Milk
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
1 1/2 tsps
Cinnamon
1 cup
Strawberries (sliced)
1 cup
Cherries (pitted)
recipe:
Combine all of the ingredients except for the strawberries and cherries in a large container and mix well. Refrigerate for at least one hour or until the ground flax has set.
Stir well, and divide into cups or containers if on-the-go. Top with the strawberries and cherries. Enjoy!

name: Pureed Turnip & Potatoes
ingredients:
2
Turnip (medium, chopped)
4
Yellow Potato (medium, chopped)
5
Garlic (cloves, with peel)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Butter
2 tbsps
Cow's Milk, Whole

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Toss the turnips, potatoes, and garlic cloves in the oil and place on a baking sheet. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Squeeze the garlic cloves out of their peel and add them along with the turnip, potato, butter, milk, salt, and pepper to a food processor. Blend until desired consistency. Alternatively, you can mash to your desired consistency.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Sun Dried Tomato Dressing
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Sun Dried Tomatoes (drained)
1
Garlic (clove)
2 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)
1 tbsp
White Wine Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
Water
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Add more water to thin it out, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Portobello Mushrooms & Kale
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Lemon Juice
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
4
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 lb
Portobello Mushroom Caps
1/2 cup
Red Onion (finely chopped)
1/8 tsp
Red Pepper Flakes
4 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC).
In a large baking dish, combine the lemon juice, honey, garlic, and half of the oil. Season with salt and pepper. Place the mushrooms into the dish and coat with the sauce.
Add the onion, red pepper flakes, and kale to the dish around the mushrooms. Drizzle with the remaining oil and season with salt and pepper. Cook in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.
To serve, place the roasted mushrooms on a plate and top with the kale mixture. Enjoy!

name: Heirloom Tomato Salad
ingredients:
3
Tomato (heirloom, large, sliced)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Red Wine Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves (chopped)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe: Arrange the tomatoes onto a platter or bowl. Top with oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, basil, and parsley. Serve and enjoy!

name: Kale, Chickpea & Farro Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Farro (uncooked, rinsed)
4 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped, massaged)
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
2/3 cup
Artichoke Hearts (from the can, drained, chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Red Wine Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the farro according to the package directions.
In a large bowl, add the farro, kale, chickpeas, artichoke hearts, oil, vinegar, salt and pepper. Toss to combine.
Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Covered Raspberries
ingredients:
2 tsps
Coconut Oil
1/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
1 1/2 cups
Raspberries
recipe:
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a small saucepan over low heat, melt the coconut oil and chocolate chips. Continuously stir so the chocolate doesn't burn. Remove from the heat and pour into a bowl. Let cool for five minutes.
Add the raspberries to the bowl and coat each of them in chocolate. Work in batches if needed.
Spread the chocolate covered raspberries out in an even layer on the baking sheet. Freeze for 25 to 30 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Cantaloupe Sorbet
ingredients:
1/3
Cantaloupe (chopped, frozen)
1/4 cup
Water (warm)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
recipe:
Thaw the frozen cantaloupe for five minutes before blending.
Place all the ingredients in a blender. Blend until smooth.
Scoop into bowls and serve immediately, or store in a resealable container in the freezer for 30 minutes for a firmer texture. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Watermelon & Cilantro Salad
ingredients:
1/2
Seedless Watermelon (medium, cubed)
1
Jalapeno Pepper (thinly sliced)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (cubed)
1/2 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
1
Lime (juiced, zested)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Combine all ingredients together in a large bowl. Toss, serve, and enjoy!

name: Cherry & Sage Iced Tea
ingredients:
1 cup
Cherries (pitted)
1 1/2 tsps
Honey
2 tbsps
Fresh Sage (plus extra for garnish)
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1 1/2 cups
Earl Grey Tea (brewed, cold)
10
Ice Cubes
recipe: Muddle the cherries, honey, and sage in a pitcher. Add the lemon juice and brewed tea, cover the pitcher with lid and let sit in the fridge for at least an hour. Strain the tea into the glasses, top with ice, and enjoy!

name: Shredded Potato, Avocado & Sardine Bowl
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3
Yellow Potato (medium, shredded)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 ozs
Sardines (drained)
1/2
Avocado (medium, sliced)
1/4 cup
Fresh Dill (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan and add the shredded potato. Cook for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring frequently, until browned. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Divide the potatoes, sardines, avocado, and fresh dill evenly between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Frozen Watermelon Popsicles
ingredients:
1/2
Seedless Watermelon (medium)
12
Popsicle Sticks
recipe: Slice the watermelon into one-inch thick triangles and insert a popsicle stick into the middle of the rind on each one. Place on a parchment-lined baking sheet and freeze for at least three hours or until completely frozen. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Squash & Fennel Soup
ingredients:
2 1/2 cups
Butternut Squash (peeled, seeded, and cubed)
1 bulb
Fennel (medium, trimmed and sliced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Plain Coconut Milk
2 cups
Vegetable Broth
2 tsps
Cumin
1/2 tsp
Turmeric
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Spread the squash and fennel on the baking sheet in a single layer. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss until the vegetables are evenly coated. Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized.
Transfer to a blender or food processor. Add the coconut milk, broth, cumin, turmeric, and season with salt and pepper. Blend the mixture until smooth and creamy, venting as needed for heat to escape.
Transfer the blended soup to a large pot and heat over medium heat until warmed through, for about four to five minutes. Enjoy!

name: Tomato & Nectarine Salad
ingredients:
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Red Wine Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Tomato (heirloom, large, sliced)
2
Nectarine (pit removed, sliced)
3 tbsps
Goat Cheese (crumbled)
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves (finely chopped)
recipe:
In a small bowl, combine the oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Arrange the tomato and nectarine slices on a platter. Drizzle with dressing and top with goat cheese and basil. Serve and enjoy!

name: Cucumber, Celery & Orange Juice
ingredients:
1 stalk
Celery (chopped)
1/2 cup
Orange Juice (freshly squeezed)
1/4
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
5
Ice Cubes
recipe:
Add the celery stalk, orange juice, and cucumber to a blender. Blend until smooth.
Strain through a fine mesh sieve into a glass. Serve with ice and enjoy!

name: Raspberry Beet Smoothie Bowl
ingredients:
1 cup
Frozen Raspberries (plus more for garnish)
1/2
Beet (medium, chopped, frozen)
2 tbsps
Pitted Dates
1/4 cup
Hemp Seeds
1/2 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1 tbsp
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
1 tbsp
Slivered Almonds
recipe:
Combine all ingredients except the shredded coconut and slivered almonds in a blender. Start by blending on low and working your way up to high, tampering as needed, until a thick consistency is achieved.
Scoop into bowls and top with shredded coconut, slivered almonds, and more raspberries if desired. Enjoy!

name: Mixed Greens & Cherry Salad
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Dijon Mustard
2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 cups
Mixed Greens
1
Cucumber (medium, sliced)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
1 cup
Cherries (pitted, halved)
1/2 cup
Pecans (roughly chopped)
1/2 cup
Goat Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
In a small jar or bowl, whisk together the oil, mustard, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
In a large salad bowl, combine the greens, cucumber, red onion, and cherries.
Drizzle the dressing over top and toss to combine. Garnish with pecans and goat cheese and toss gently to combine. Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Tofu Pad Kee Mao
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Tamari (divided)
1/4 cup
Avocado Oil (divided)
1 1/3 tbsps
Rice Vinegar (divided)
15 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, pressed, crumbled)
3 tbsps
Fish Sauce
12 ozs
Udon Noodles (dried)
1
Yellow Onion (medium, sliced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (large, sliced)
5
Garlic (clove, roughly chopped)
1
Thai Chili (chopped)
1 cup
Thai Basil
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and lightly grease a sheet pan with oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together half of the tamari, half of the oil, and half of the rice vinegar. Add the crumbled tofu and toss well. Transfer to the sheet pan and bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until crispy.
In a small bowl, mix together the remaining tamari, oil, rice vinegar, and fish sauce. Set aside.
Cook the noodles according to package directions and set aside.
In a large wok or pan, heat the remaining oil over medium-high heat. Once hot, add the onion and cook for about five minutes, tossing often. Add the bell pepper and cook for one minute and then add the garlic and Thai chili and cook for 30 seconds, tossing often.
Add the tofu, cooked noodles, and sauce to the wok and toss using tongs until everything is well coated, about one minute. Remove from the heat and stir in the Thai basil.
Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Lightened Up Blackberry Fool
ingredients:
1 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/4 cup
Whipping Cream
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup (divided)
1 1/2 cups
Blackberries (plus more for garnish)
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves
recipe:
In a bowl, combine the Greek yogurt, whipping cream, vanilla extract, and half of the maple syrup. Using a hand mixer, whip the mixture on medium speed for two to three minutes or until light and smooth.
Crush the blackberries using a fork or a potato masher. Stir in the remaining maple syrup and mix well.
Layer the crushed blackberries and whipped yogurt in a small dessert bowl or a glass. Swirl the layers gently with a knife to create a marbled effect.
Garnish each bowl with blackberries and fresh mint. Enjoy!

name: Tomato Avocado Salad
ingredients:
2
Tomato (medium, chopped)
1
Avocado (medium, chopped)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (cubed)
1
Lime (juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Arrange the tomato, avocado, and red onion on a serving plate.
Top with feta cheese, drizzle with lime juice on top, and season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Lemon & Cilantro Baked Pickerel
ingredients:
10 ozs
Pickerel Fillet
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (sliced)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (coarsely chopped)
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the pickerel fillet(s) on the baking sheet. Coat the fish in oil using a brush or your hand. Squeeze the juice from the lemon over the top of the fish, and then place the lemon slices on top. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until the fish is white and flakes with a fork.
Garnish the fish with the cilantro and salt. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Crispy Mini Potatoes
ingredients:
4 cups
Mini Potatoes (halved)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 400ºF (205ºC).
Add the potatoes, oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper to a large bowl. Toss to coat and combine.
Transfer to the air fryer and cook for 10 minutes. Shake the basket and cook for eight to ten minutes longer, until the potatoes are crispy and cooked through. Divide the potatoes onto plates and enjoy!

name: Fruity Hibiscus Tea Lemonade
ingredients:
4 cups
Water
1 1/3 tbsps
Hibiscus Tea (loose leaf or in tea bags)
1
Lemon (juiced)
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
1/2
Peach (sliced)
1/2
Nectarine (sliced)
1 cup
Frozen Raspberries
recipe:
Bring the water to a boil and steep the tea for seven to ten minutes. Remove the tea bags and stir in the lemon and honey. Refrigerate for at least two hours.
When ready to serve, divide into cups with ice and add sliced peach, nectarine, and raspberries to each cup. Enjoy!

name: Spinach & Feta Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
2 cups
Baby Spinach (finely chopped)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
8 ozs
Portobello Mushroom Caps
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking dish with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix together the feta, spinach, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper. Top the mushroom caps with the feta mixture. Bake in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until tender. Enjoy!

name: Frozen Fruit Kabobs
ingredients:
1/4
Seedless Watermelon (medium, cubed)
2 cups
Strawberries (halved)
2 cups
Grapes
3
Peach (pits removed, chopped)
12
Barbecue Skewers
recipe: Add the fruit pieces to the skewers and place on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Freeze for at least three hours. Enjoy!

name: Homemade Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients:
2 tsps
Arrowroot Powder
1/4 cup
Water
1 cup
Soy Sauce, Low Sodium
2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
2 tsps
Rice Vinegar
1 tsp
Sesame Oil
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
recipe:
Mix the arrowroot powder with the water to make a slurry.
Add the soy sauce, coconut sugar, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and garlic to a small pot over high heat. Once boiling, add the slurry, whisk well, and remove the pot from the heat to cool and thicken. Enjoy!

name: Peach & Cherry Crisp
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Cherries (pitted)
3
Peach (pitted, sliced)
1/2 cup
Coconut Sugar (divided)
1 tsp
Arrowroot Powder
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1 cup
Quick Oats
1/2 cup
Almond Flour
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
3 tbsps
Butter (cold, cubed)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC). Grease a pie dish or baking dish.
In a medium bowl, add the cherries, peaches, half the sugar, arrowroot powder, and lemon juice. Mix well to coat the fruit. Put the fruit mixture into the pie dish.
In a separate bowl, mix the remaining sugar, oats, flour, salt, and butter. Pinch the butter into the mixture until you get a coarse crumble. Pour this mixture onto the fruit and spread evenly. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until the fruit is bubbling and the crisp is lightly browned.
Rest the crisp for five minutes before scooping and serving. Enjoy!

name: Raspberry Banana Smoothie Bowl
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Plain Coconut Milk
1 cup
Frozen Raspberries
1/2
Banana (frozen, plus more for garnish)
1/4
Zucchini (frozen, chopped)
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tsp
Unsweetened Coconut Flakes
1 tsp
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
In a blender, add the coconut milk, raspberries, banana, zucchini, and protein powder. Blend until smooth.
Pour the smoothie into a bowl and garnish with banana, coconut flakes, and hemp seeds. Enjoy!

name: Wild Rice Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Wild Rice (dry)
1 cup
Mixed Greens
1/3 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
White Wine Vinegar
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Let the rice cool for 10 minutes before adding it to a large bowl. Add the remaining ingredients and toss to combine. Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Mackerel & Rice Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry, rinsed)
5 2/3 ozs
Canned Mackerel (skinless, boneless)
1/4
Cucumber (medium, sliced)
1/2
Avocado (medium, sliced)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
To assemble, evenly divide the rice, mackerel, cucumber and avocado into bowls. Drizzle each with oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Top with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Watermelon Sorbet
ingredients:
1/2
Seedless Watermelon (medium, cubed, frozen)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Raw Honey
recipe: Combine all ingredients in a food processor and blend until a smooth consistency is achieved. Enjoy immediately, or scoop into a sealable dish and set in the freezer for an additional hour. Enjoy!

name: Cherry Banana Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from a carton)
1 cup
Cherries (frozen)
1/2
Banana (frozen)
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
2 tbsps
Sunflower Seed Butter
recipe: Add all of the ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Celery, Carrot & Grape Salad
ingredients:
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 stalks
Celery (sliced)
1
Carrot (medium, julienned)
2/3 cup
Grapes
recipe:
In a bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, oil, salt and pepper.
Add the celery, carrot, and grapes and toss to combine. Divide between plates and enjoy!

name: Zucchini Banana Smoothie Bowl
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
3/4 cup
Water
1
Banana (divided)
1/2
Zucchini (large, frozen)
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tbsp
Pumpkin Seeds
1 tbsp
Sunflower Seeds
recipe:
Add the yogurt, water, half of the banana, zucchini, and protein powder to a blender and blend on high until smooth.
Pour the smoothie into a large bowl and top with the remaining banana, pumpkin seeds, and sunflower seeds. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Jalapeno Poppers
ingredients:
1/2 cup
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
1/2 cup
Water
1 cup
Almond Flour
6
Jalapeno Pepper (sliced in half lengthwise, seeds removed)
3 ozs
Mozzarella Cheese (shredded)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2/3 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
2 tbsps
Chives (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 370°F (190°C).
In a bowl, combine the gluten-free flour with half of the salt and water and whisk until a thick pancake-like batter has formed. Add more water if necessary, one tablespoon at a time. Add the almond flour to a separate bowl. Stuff each of the jalapeño halves with the mozzarella. One at a time, dip them into the batter to completely coat and then dip into the almond flour until completely coated. Set on a plate and repeat this process with each jalapeño half.
Brush both sides of the coated jalapeños with the oil and carefully transfer to the air fryer. Cook for 15 minutes, flipping halfway through, until browned and crispy.
Meanwhile, combine the yogurt, remaining salt, garlic powder, and chives in a bowl and mix well.
Serve the jalapeño poppers with the yogurt dip and enjoy!

name: Tomato & Anchovy Salad
ingredients:
1
Tomato (heirloom, large, sliced)
3
Anchovy (fillets, whole)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves (finely chopped)
recipe: Place the tomato on a large plate or platter and top with anchovies. Drizzle the oil on top and season with salt and pepper. Garnish with basil. Serve and enjoy!

name: Smoked Oysters & Mushroom Rice
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry)
1 tbsp
Butter
3 ozs
Smoked Oysters (from the can, drained)
4 cups
Mushrooms (chopped)
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika
2 tsps
Dried Parsley

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to package directions.
Meanwhile, warm the butter in a pan over medium heat. Add the smoked oysters and the mushrooms. Cook for two to three minutes, then add the lemon juice and cook for another two minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, dried parsley, salt, and pepper.
When the rice is done, combine it with the oyster mixture and stir until combined. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Grain-Free Waffles
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Tapioca Flour
3 tbsps
Coconut Flour
1/4 tsp
Baking Soda
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
3/4 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup (plus more for serving)
1/4 cup
Coconut Oil (melted)
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
recipe:
In a medium-sized bowl, add the tapicoa flour, coconut flour, baking soda, and salt. Whisk to combine. Add the milk, maple syrup, oil, and vanilla and stir with a spatula until combined.
Grease the waffle maker. Add the batter to cover the bottom of your maker, about 1/2 cup at a time.
Cook the waffles for about six to seven minutes or until golden brown and crispy. Repeat the process until all of the batter is cooked. Serve with maple syrup, if using, and enjoy!

name: Nectarine Strawberry Smoothie
ingredients:
1
Nectarine (pitted, chopped)
1/2 cup
Strawberries
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
recipe: Add all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Divide into glasses and enjoy!

name: Dates & Apple
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Pitted Dates
1
Green Apple (chopped)
recipe: Add ingredients to a plate or snack box. Enjoy!

name: Apricot Crisp
ingredients:
8
Apricot (pitted, sliced)
1/3 cup
Coconut Sugar (divided)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1 tsp
Arrowroot Powder
1/2 cup
Almond Flour
2/3 cup
Walnuts (chopped)
2 tsps
Coconut Oil (chilled)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC). Grease a baking dish.
In a medium bowl, toss the apricots with half of the sugar, lemon juice, and arrowroot powder until the fruit is coated. Add the apricot mixture to the dish.
In a separate bowl, mix the almond flour, walnuts, and coconut oil until you get a coarse crumble. Add this evenly overtop of the apricots. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the apricots are bubbling and the crisp is lightly browned.
Let it rest for five to ten minutes to set before serving. Enjoy!

name: Date, Chia & Tahini Energy Balls
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Pitted Dates
2 tbsps
Tahini
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
2 tbsps
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
recipe:
In a blender or food processor, add the dates, tahini, and chia seeds. Blend until smooth paste forms.
Use a one-inch cookie scoop to scoop out the paste and roll it in your hands to create a ball. Continue until you have used up all of the paste.
Roll each ball in shredded coconut until evenly coated. Chill in the fridge for about 30 minutes and enjoy!

name: Braised Maple Dandelion Greens
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
1/2 cup
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
6 cups
Dandelion Greens (chopped)
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-low heat. Add the red onion and cook for two minutes. Add the garlic and continue to cook for another two minutes or until fragrant.
Add the dandelion greens, lemon juice, and maple syrup. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thoroughly wilted and cooked. Season with salt. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Strawberry Nut-Free Trail Mix
ingredients:
1/3 oz
Freeze Dried Strawberries
1/4 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
1/4 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Flakes
recipe: Combine all of the ingredients into a bowl or sealable jar. Serve and enjoy!

name: Sambal Oelek
ingredients:
30
Thai Chili (stems removed, chopped)
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
1 tsp
Sea Salt
1
Garlic (clove, optional)
1 tsp
Lime Juice (optional)
recipe: Add the chilis, vinegar, salt, garlic, and lime juice to a food processor or blender. Pulse or blend until a course paste forms. Enjoy!

name: Bell Pepper & Mushroom Stir Fry with Rice
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry, rinsed)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 cups
Portobello Mushroom (sliced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (medium, sliced)
1 stalk
Celery (sliced)
1 cup
Matchstick Carrots
1 1/2 tsps
Ginger (minced)
1 tsp
Chinese Five Spice
2 tbsps
Soy Sauce
2 tsps
Dried Parsley (optional)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms, bell pepper, celery, and carrots to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, for six to eight minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Add the ginger, Chinese five spice, and soy sauce and stir to combine. If the pan seems too dry, add a splash of water. Cook for one more minute.
To serve, divide the rice evenly between bowls. Top with the vegetable mixture and season with parsley, if using. Enjoy!

name: No Cook Chocolate Chip Granola Bars
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Tahini
1/4 cup
Raw Honey
1/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips (mini)
2/3 cup
Quick Oats
recipe:
Line a small baking dish with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, mix the tahini and honey together. Add the chocolate chips and quick oats and mix well. Press the mixture into all corners of the baking dish with a spatula or another piece of parchment paper to create a smooth, even surface. Chill for 30 minutes before cutting into bars. Enjoy!

name: Lentil & Bocconcini Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
Lentils (cooked)
4 ozs
Small Bocconcini (mini, or torn into small pieces)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
2 stalks
Celery (chopped)
2 tsps
Mint Leaves (chopped)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
1/4 cup
Balsamic Vinaigrette

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Combine all of the ingredients in a large bowl. Mix well to combine. Divide evenly between serving bowls and enjoy!

name: Peach & Raspberry Baked Oats
ingredients:
2 cups
Oats (rolled)
2 cups
Cow's Milk, Whole
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
2 tsps
Vanilla Extract
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1 tsp
Baking Powder
1 cup
Raspberries
1
Peach (sliced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a baking pan or line it with parchment paper.
Add the oats, milk, maple syrup, vanilla, chia seeds, and baking powder to the pan. Mix to combine. Fold in the raspberries and add peach slices on top.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until cooked through and the oats are set. Remove from the oven and let it cool for ten minutes. Cut into even pieces and enjoy!

name: Loaded Greek Hummus with Crackers
ingredients:
1 cup
Hummus
1/2
Cucumber (medium, finely chopped)
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (finely chopped)
1/2 cup
Black Olives (pitted, chopped)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (finely chopped)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1/3 cup
Parsley (chopped)
2 1/2 ozs
Rice Crackers
recipe: Add the hummus to a serving platter. Add the cucumber, tomatoes, olives, onion, feta, and parsley on top. Serve with crackers. Enjoy!

name: Orange & Carrot Juice
ingredients:
2
Navel Orange (medium, peeled)
2
Carrot (medium, peeled, chopped)
3 cups
Water
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth.
Place a nut-milk bag or a fine strainer over a large bowl and pour in the juice. Using clean hands, squeeze out all the liquid. Pour the strained juice into a glass pitcher and serve. Enjoy!

name: Blueberry Coconut Rice Porridge
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry, rinsed)
3/4 cup
Water
1/2 cup
Canned Coconut Milk (full fat)
1/3 cup
Blueberries (fresh or frozen)
1 tsp
Raw Honey
recipe:
Add the rice and water to a small pot over high heat. Once boiling, turn the heat down to a low simmer, add the coconut milk and cover. Cook covered for 12 minutes or until the rice is a creamy porridge texture.
Add the blueberries and serve. Drizzle the honey over top of the porridge. Enjoy!

name: Peach & Granola Quinoa Porridge
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (tricolor, rinsed and drained)
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk (plus more for garnish)
1/2 cup
Water
1 1/2 tsps
Maple Syrup (plus more for garnish)
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1
Peach (pitted, sliced)
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
1/4 cup
Granola
1 1/2 tsps
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
In a small pot, bring the quinoa, milk, water, maple syrup, and salt to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer covered until the liquid has been absorbed and the quinoa is tender but still chewy, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand for five minutes. Fluff with a fork.
Divide into bowls and serve topped with peach slices, yogurt, granola, and hemp seeds. Add more milk and maple syrup, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato & Mixed Bean Stew
ingredients:
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3
Sweet Potato (large, peeled, halved lengthwise)
2 tsps
Cumin
2 tsps
Chili Powder
3 cups
Frozen Vegetable Mix
1/2 cup
Cilantro (stalks and leaves divided, chopped)
3 cups
Water (divided)
3 cups
Mixed Beans (cooked)
2 cups
Canned Whole Tomatoes (with juices)
1/3 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Heat the oil in an oven-safe pot or large dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the potatoes and cook for three to five minutes, or until golden, on both sides.
Turn off the heat then add the cumin, chili powder, mixed vegetables, cilantro stalks, and 2/3 of the water. Bake in the oven for 30 mins.
Remove from the oven. Add the beans, tomatoes, and remaining water. Stir well. Bake for 30 minutes more, until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Divide evenly between bowls. Top with feta cheese and chopped cilantro leaves. Enjoy!

name: Cranberry & Tahini Granola Bars
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Tahini
1/4 cup
Raw Honey
2/3 cup
Quick Oats
3 tbsps
Ground Flax Seed
1/3 cup
Dried Unsweetened Cranberries
recipe:
Line a small baking dish with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix the tahini and honey together. Add the oats, ground flax seed, and dried cranberries and mix well.
Press the mixture into all corners of the baking dish with a spatula or another piece of parchment paper to create a smooth, even surface. Chill for 30 minutes before cutting into bars. Enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Oatmeal
ingredients:
1 cup
Water
1/2 cup
Quick Oats
1/2 cup
Pureed Pumpkin
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1/4 tsp
Pumpkin Pie Spice
1 tbsp
Pumpkin Seeds
recipe:
In a small pot, bring the water and oats to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer, stir in the pumpkin and maple syrup, and cover. Cook for three to five minutes or until the oats have absorbed the water and the oatmeal thickens.
Top the oatmeal with pumpkin spice and pumpkin seeds. Enjoy!

name: Sardines & Tomato Sauce with Zoodles
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3
Zucchini (medium, spiralized)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
Tomato Sauce
1 tsp
Oregano
3 ozs
Sardines (drained)
1/4 cup
Parsley (torn into pieces)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-low heat. Add the zucchini noodles and stir to coat with the oil. Season with salt and pepper. Cook for two to three minutes. Remove from the heat.
In a small saucepan, add the tomato sauce and stir in the oregano. Add a splash of water if the sauce is too thick. Heat for three to four minutes or until heated through.
Divide the cooked zucchini noodles, tomato sauce, and sardines evenly between bowls and top with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Shallot & Ginger Dressing
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Shallot (minced)
1 tsp
Ginger (minced)
2 tbsps
Sesame Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Water
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Whisk all of the ingredients together in a small bowl. Serve with your favorite salad and enjoy!

name: Broccoli, Cauliflower & Quinoa Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 cup
Broccoli (cut into florets)
1/4 head
Cauliflower (cut into florets)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Chickpeas (drained, rinsed)
1/3 cup
Vegan Caesar Dressing
1/2 cup
Parsley (torn into pieces)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions and set aside.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the broccoli and cauliflower and season with salt and pepper. Sauté for three to four minutes or until cooked to your liking.
Divide the quinoa, broccoli, cauliflower, chickpeas, and dressing into bowls. Top with parsley and enjoy!

name: Cilantro & Sesame Dressing
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Cilantro (minced)
2 tbsps
Sesame Oil
2 tbsps
Water
1/2
Garlic (clove, large, minced)
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Whisk all of the ingredients together in a small bowl. Serve with your favorite salad and enjoy!

name: Cinnamon & Apple Coconut Porridge
ingredients:
1 tsp
Coconut Oil
1
Apple (small, sliced)
2 tsps
Cinnamon (divided)
1/4 cup
Coconut Flour
1 cup
Water (boiling)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-low heat. Add the sliced apples and half of the cinnamon. Stir to combine. Cook for three to four minutes or until the apples have softened. Remove from the heat.
In a bowl, mix the coconut flour and the remaining cinnamon together. Slowly pour in the boiling water while mixing until desired thickness is reached. Add more water if needed.
Stir in the maple syrup then top with the cinnamon apples and enjoy!

name: Chickpea, Tomato & Feta Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, rinsed)
1 1/2 cups
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/2
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
3/4 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 1/2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1/2 tsp
Greek Seasoning

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a large bowl and mix to combine. Divide evenly between bowls or onto plates and enjoy!

name: One Pan Quinoa, Peanut & Banana Skillet Bake
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
2 tsps
Butter
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2/3 cup
Water
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 cup
Pitted Dates (chopped)
1
Banana (sliced lengthwise)
1 tbsp
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
1/4 cup
Raw Peanuts
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Add the quinoa, butter, salt, and water to an oven-safe pan. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cover with a lid and reduce the heat to low. Cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until all of the water is absorbed.
Add the maple syrup, cinnamon, and chopped dates to the quinoa and mix well. Top with the banana halves, shredded coconut, and peanuts. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes, or until browned. Enjoy!

name: Shawarma Spice Blend
ingredients:
2 1/2 tbsps
Turmeric
2 1/2 tbsps
Cumin (ground)
2 tsps
Paprika
1 1/2 tsps
Ground Sumac
1 1/2 tsps
Oregano
1 tsp
Cardamom
1 tsp
Fennel Seed (ground)
1 tsp
Ground Fenugreek
3/4 tsp
Coriander
3/4 tsp
Cinnamon
1/2 tsp
Nutmeg
1/2 tsp
Ground Cloves
recipe: Combine all ingredients in a jar and shake to combine. Enjoy!

name: Carrot & Cauliflower Porridge
ingredients:
1 cup
Cauliflower Rice
1
Carrot (finely shredded)
1/2 cup
Canned Coconut Milk (full fat)
1/2 cup
Water
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
2 tbsps
Pitted Dates (chopped)
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients except for the yogurt to a small pot and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for seven minutes or until the liquid starts to cook off.
Remove the pot from the heat and let sit for three minutes to set.
Add the porridge to a bowl and top with the yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Wild Rice, Broccoli & Mixed Greens Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Wild Rice (dry)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
2 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 cups
Mixed Greens
1/2 cup
Hummus
1/4
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Heat half of the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the broccoli and season with salt and pepper. Sauté for three to four minutes or until tender-crisp.
Divide the cooked rice, broccoli, mixed greens, hummus, cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion into bowls. Top with the remaining oil and lemon juice. Season with more salt and pepper, if desired. Enjoy!

name: PB & J Energy Balls
ingredients:
1/3 cup
All Natural Peanut Butter
1 cup
Pitted Dates
3/4 cup
Oats (rolled)
2 1/2 tbsps
Strawberry Jam
recipe: Add all ingredients to a food processor and pulse until the mixture has a coarse crumb and sticks together. Use a teaspoon or one-inch cookie scoop to scoop out the mixture and roll it into balls. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Parmesan Snap Peas
ingredients:
3 cups
Snap Peas
1 tbsp
Butter (melted)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 380°F (195°C). Toss the snap peas with the melted butter and cook in the air fryer for 15 minutes, tossing halfway through, until starting to brown.
Season with salt and top with parmesan cheese. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato, Pineapple & Cilantro Salad
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (medium, chopped)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
2 cups
Pineapple (chopped)
1/4 cup
Chives (chopped)
1/2 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
1 tbsp
Coconut Aminos
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
1 tbsp
Ginger (freshly grated)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the sweet potato in half of the oil and season with half of the salt. Add to the prepared baking sheet and cook in the oven for 25 minutes, or until fork-tender and starting to brown.
Meanwhile, add the pineapple, chives, and cilantro to a large bowl. In a small bowl, whisk together the remaining oil, salt, coconut aminos, lime juice, and ginger.
Add the cooked sweet potato to the pineapple mixture and stir to combine. Drizzle on the dressing, then toss to coat. Enjoy!

name: Quick Pickled Cabbage
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Apple Cider Vinegar
3/4 cup
Water
2 tsps
Cane Sugar (optional)
1 1/2 tsps
Sea Salt
1 tsp
Black Peppercorns
1 tsp
Coriander Seed
1
Garlic (clove, sliced)
2 cups
Coleslaw Mix
recipe:
In a small saucepan over medium heat, bring the vinegar, water, sugar, and salt to a boil. Stir the mixture until the sugar and salt are fully dissolved, for about three minutes. Remove from the heat.
Meanwhile, place the peppercorns, coriander seeds, and garlic in a glass jar. Pack the slaw tightly into the jar.
Carefully pour the vinegar mixture over the slaw, ensuring that it is completely submerged in the liquid.
Allow the jar to cool uncovered at room temperature for approximately one hour. Then cover, give it a shake and place it in the refrigerator, leaving it for at least 24 hours. Enjoy!

name: Pinto Beans, Broccoli & Brown Rice
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Rice (dry)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2
Garlic (clove, finely chopped)
1 1/2 tsps
Cumin
1 cup
Pinto Beans (cooked, rinsed, and drained)
2 cups
Broccoli (finely chopped)
1 cup
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and cumin and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the pinto beans, broccoli, and broth. Season with salt and pepper. Cook for two to four minutes, stirring, until the broccoli is tender.
Add the cooked rice and stir until well combined. Divide between plates and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Parmesan Green Beans
ingredients:
3 cups
Green Beans (chopped)
1 tbsp
Butter (melted)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 380°F (195°C).
Toss the green beans in the melted butter and cook in the air fryer for 15 minutes, tossing halfway through, or until starting to brown and fork-tender.
Season with salt and pepper and top with parmesan cheese. Enjoy!

name: One Pot Spicy Tofu Green Curry
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
11 ozs
Tofu (firm, diced)
2
Zucchini (medium, chopped)
1 3/4 cups
Canned Coconut Milk (full fat)
3 tbsps
Lime Juice
1/4 cup
Green Curry Paste
2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
2
Jalapeno Pepper (thinly sliced)
1/2 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot or deep pan over medium heat. Add the tofu and cook, stirring sometimes, for three to five minutes or until it starts to brown and get crispy. Add the zucchini and continue to cook for three to four minutes or until slightly softened.
Add the coconut milk, lime juice, curry paste, coconut sugar, and salt. Stir and simmer for two to three minutes. Add the jalapeño and continue to cook, stirring frequently for another three minutes or until the zucchini is fork tender.
Divide between bowls and top with cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Parmesan Green Beans with Scallops & Potatoes
ingredients:
2 cups
Mini Potatoes
1 1/2 tbsps
Butter (melted, divided)
3 cups
Green Beans (chopped)
12 ozs
Scallops (defrosted)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 380°F (195°C).
Toss the potatoes in half of the butter and cook in the air fryer for five minutes. Meanwhile, toss the green beans in the remaining butter. Add them to the basket with the potatoes and cook for another seven minutes. Add the scallops and cook for seven more minutes or until the potatoes and beans are browned and fork-tender. Some overlap in the basket is ok.
Season everything with salt and pepper and top with parmesan cheese. Enjoy!

name: Blackberry Kefir Chia Pudding
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Chia Seeds
2/3 cup
Plain Kefir
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/3 cup
Blackberries
recipe: In a small bowl, add all of the ingredients except for the blackberries. Mix well and transfer to a small container. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Garnish with the blackberries. Enjoy!

name: Lemony Rapini & Mozzarella
ingredients:
5 ozs
Rapini (large, trimmed)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (juiced, zested)
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes (optional)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 1/2 ozs
Mozzarella Ball (torn into pieces)
1 tbsp
Parmigiano Reggiano
recipe:
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Blanche the rapini for two to three minutes or until tender. Drain and set aside.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the rapini, lemon zest, and chili flakes if using. Season with salt and pepper and sauté for two to three minutes. Turn off the heat and squeeze the lemon juice on top.
Arrange the rapini and mozzarella on a serving plate. Top with parmesan and enjoy!

name: Squash & Pinto Bean Soup
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (small, diced)
1 1/2 cups
Butternut Squash (peeled, seeds removed, cubed)
1
Carrot (medium, peeled, chopped)
1 tsp
Turmeric

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1 cup
Water
1 cup
Pinto Beans (cooked)
2 cups
Baby Spinach
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for two to three minutes.
Add the squash and carrot. Cook for about five minutes and stir occasionally. Add the turmeric, salt, and pepper. Cook for another minute, then add the broth and water.
Stir and bring the mixture to a simmer. Cover the pot with a lid and simmer for about 20 minutes or until the vegetables are soft.
Add the beans to the pot. Simmer for another five minutes uncovered. Add the spinach, stir, and cook for two minutes or until wilted. Adjust the seasoning to your taste and enjoy!

name: Matcha Mint Kefir Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Plain Kefir
1
Banana
1 cup
Kale Leaves
1 tsp
Ginger (fresh, minced)
2 tsps
Mint Leaves
1 tsp
Green Tea Powder
3
Ice Cubes (optional)
recipe: Add all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Divide into glasses and enjoy!

name: Cinnamon Mint Tea
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Water
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves
1 serving
Cinnamon Stick
recipe: Bring water to a boil and pour into a glass. Add the mint leaves and cinnamon. Steep for four to five minutes before drinking. Remove the mint and cinnamon stick if preferred. Enjoy!

name: Lemon Basil Blueberry Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Blueberries (frozen)
1/4
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1/4
Avocado (medium)
2 tbsps
Pitted Dates
1/4 cup
Hemp Seeds
2 tsps
Chia Seeds
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves (packed)
1/2
Lemon (juiced, zested)
1 cup
Plain Kefir
recipe: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass, and enjoy!

name: Roasted Red Pepper & Cauliflower Penne
ingredients:
1 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
1
Red Bell Pepper (large, coarsely chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 cups
Whole Wheat Penne (dry)
1/3 cup
Sunflower Seeds (toasted)
3 cups
Tomato Sauce
1 tbsp
Italian Seasoning
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped, plus more for garnish)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the cauliflower and red peppers to a baking sheet. Toss everything to coat in oil and season with salt and pepper. Cook for 25 to 30 minutes or until tender.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta to al dente, according to package directions. Add the red peppers, sunflower seeds, tomato sauce, and Italian seasoning to a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth.
Drain the pasta and return it to the pot over low heat. Add the sauce, roasted cauliflower, and basil. Stir until warm, about one to two minutes.
Divide the pasta evenly between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Cucumber, Grape, Avocado & Mint Salad
ingredients:
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1 cup
Grapes (halved)
1
Avocado (medium, diced)
1/3 cup
Mint Leaves (chopped)
recipe: In a large bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, oil, and salt. In the same bowl, add the cucumber, grapes, avocado, and mint leaves. Toss to combine with the dressing. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Carrot & Cauliflower Salad
ingredients:
2
Carrot (large, peeled, chopped)
1/2 head
Cauliflower (small, cut into florets)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the carrots, cauliflower, half of the oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper to the baking sheet. Toss to combine. Spread out into an even layer. Cook for 25 to 30 minutes or until browned and tender, turning halfway through.
Add the roasted vegetables to a bowl and mix in the onion and parsley. Add the remaining oil and season with salt and pepper. Divide into bowls or onto plates and enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Pumpkin Oatmeal
ingredients:
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
1 1/3 cups
Water
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
3/4 cup
Pureed Pumpkin
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
3/4 tsp
Pumpkin Pie Spice
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
2 tbsps
Pumpkin Seeds
recipe:
Combine the oats, water, milk, pumpkin, maple syrup, and pumpkin pie spice in the pressure cooker. Close the lid and set to "sealing". Press manual/pressure cooker and cook for two minutes on high pressure.
Once the cooking time is complete, allow the pressure to naturally release for 10 minutes, then carefully quick release any remaining pressure.
Divide the oatmeal into bowls and top with yogurt and seeds. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Harissa Cauliflower & Squash with Lentils
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil
1 1/2 tbsps
Harissa
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
4 cups
Butternut Squash (cut into wedges)
1/2 head
Cauliflower (large, cut into florets)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Tahini
1/4 cup
Water
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1 cup
Green Lentils (cooked)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet(s) with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine the oil, harissa, and maple syrup. Working in batches, toss in the squash and cauliflower to coat all over. Spread out on the baking sheet(s). Season with salt and pepper.
Transfer the baking sheet(s) to the oven and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until cooked through and browned on the edges.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tahini, water, and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper.
Combine the veggies and lentils on a plate and drizzle the dressing on top. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Kefir Smoothie
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Plain Kefir
1 cup
Strawberries (frozen)
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Oat Energy Balls
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Pureed Pumpkin
2/3 cup
Cashews (raw)
1/4 cup
Pitted Dates
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/3 cup
Oats (rolled)
2 tsps
Water
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients except for the water to a food processor. Process until you get a smooth texture with a few chunks of dates and nuts. Add the water if necessary to help the mixture stick together.
Use a one inch cookie scoop or a teaspoon to scoop out the mixture and roll it into balls. Continue until all of the mixture is used.
Store in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes to set. Enjoy!

name: One Pot Mushroom Stroganoff
ingredients:
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 cup
Shallot (sliced)
10
Cremini Mushrooms (sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
10 ozs
Whole Wheat Rotini Pasta
3 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
1/3 cup
Cashews (raw, soaked for at least six hours, rinsed)
1/2 cup
Water
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
2 tbsps
Parsley (finely chopped)
recipe:
Add the oil to a large pot over medium heat. Once hot, add the shallot and sauté for one to two minutes, until just starting to soften. Add the mushrooms and cook for ten minutes, until cooked through. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the pasta, broth, and nutritional yeast. Bring to a boil and then reduce the heat to medium-low. Stir often and simmer for ten to 13 minutes or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, in a blender combine the drained cashews and water. Blend until completely smooth.
Remove the pasta from the heat and add the cashew cream and lemon juice. Stir to combine. Season with salt and pepper and top with parsley. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Spicy Tofu Green Curry with Rice
ingredients:
1 cup
Basmati Rice (dry, rinsed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
11 ozs
Tofu (firm)
2
Zucchini (medium, chopped)
1 3/4 cups
Canned Coconut Milk (full fat)
3 tbsps
Lime Juice
1/4 cup
Green Curry Paste
2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
2
Jalapeno Pepper (thinly sliced)
1/2 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to package directions.
Heat the oil in a large pot or deep pan over medium heat. Add the tofu and cook, stirring sometimes, for three to five minutes or until it starts to brown and get crispy. Add the zucchini and continue to cook for three to four minutes or until slightly softened.
Add the coconut milk, lime juice, curry paste, coconut sugar, and salt. Stir and simmer for two to three minutes. Add the jalapeño and continue to cook, stirring frequently for another three minutes or until the zucchini is fork-tender.
Serve with rice and garnish with cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Grape & Coconut Protein Chia Pudding
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Chia Seeds
1 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
2/3 cup
Water
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/2 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
2/3 cup
Grapes (halved)
recipe:
In a small bowl, mix together the chia seeds, yogurt, water, cinnamon, and protein powder.
Layer the chia pudding and grapes into small jars, one jar per serving, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Squash Over Labneh
ingredients:
1/2
Acorn Squash (medium, seeds removed, sliced)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2/3 cup
Labneh
2 tbsps
Hazelnuts (toasted, chopped)
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
1 tbsp
Mint Leaves
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Brush the acorn squash slices on both sides with half of the oil and season with salt and pepper. Place on the baking sheet and bake in the oven for 13 to 15 minutes.
Remove from the oven. Flip and cook for another 13 to 15 minutes, until cooked through and slightly golden. Set aside to cool down.
Spread the labneh onto a serving plate. Place the squash slices on top.
Top with hazelnuts, chili flakes, and mint leaves. Drizzle with the remaining oil, and enjoy!

name: Slow Cooker Pumpkin Oatmeal
ingredients:
1 cup
Pureed Pumpkin
7 cups
Water
2 cups
Steel Cut Oats
1 tsp
Pumpkin Pie Spice
1/2 cup
Walnuts (chopped)
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
recipe:
Add the pumpkin, water, oats, and pumpkin spice to a slow cooker and stir well. Set the slow cooker on high for four hours.
Once cooked, divide the oats evenly between bowls and garnish with walnuts and maple syrup. Enjoy!

name: Whole Grain Crackers with Edamame
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Frozen Edamame
2 ozs
Whole Grain Crackers
recipe: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add a steaming basket and steam the edamame for one minute or until bright green. Serve with the crackers and enjoy.

name: Pumpkin Polenta with Maple Roasted Carrots
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil (melted, divided)
1 tbsp
Thyme (fresh, divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3
Carrot (medium, chopped)
1/2 cup
Cornmeal
2 cups
Vegetable Broth
1/4 cup
Pureed Pumpkin
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a bowl, whisk together the maple syrup, half of the coconut oil, half of the thyme, salt, and pepper. Add the carrot and toss to combine.
Transfer the carrots to the baking sheet and bake in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, add the cornmeal, broth, pumpkin purée, and the remaining thyme to a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Stir and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Stir continuously until most of the liquid evaporates. This will take only few minutes. Turn the heat down to a simmer. Let the mixture cook for about 15 minutes, stirring often until the mixture is tender and thick.
Add the remaining coconut oil and stir well. Season the polenta with salt. Serve the roasted carrots over the pumpkin polenta, and enjoy!

name: One Pan Tilapia, Orzo & Peas
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Butter
1 cup
Orzo (dry)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
3 cups
Water
1 cup
Frozen Peas (thawed)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped, plus more for garnish)
2 tbsps
Chives (chopped, plus more for garnish)
3
Tilapia Fillet
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC).
In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add the butter, orzo, salt, lemon juice, and water.
Bring to a simmer and cook for eight to 10 minutes or until the orzo is just al dente. Stir frequently to prevent the orzo from sticking to the skillet.
Stir in the peas, dill, and chives. Nestle the tilapia filets into the orzo mixture. Cover and transfer to the oven. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until the tilapia is cooked through.
Divide the orzo and tilapia between plates and garnish with extra dill and chives. Enjoy!

name: Apple & Brie Crostini
ingredients:
1/2
Green Apple (sliced)
3 ozs
Brie Cheese (sliced)
2 ozs
Sourdough Baguette (sliced, toasted)
2 tsps
Raw Honey
recipe: Arrange the sliced apple and brie cheese on top of the toasted baguette. Drizzle the honey on top and enjoy!

name: Lentil, Kale & Squash Soup
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (diced)
2 stalks
Celery (chopped)
2 tsps
Herbes De Provence

Sea Salt & Black Pepper ( to taste)
3 cups
Butternut Squash (peeled, seeds removed, cubed)
1/2 cup
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
5 cups
Vegetable Broth
3 cups
Kale Leaves (finely chopped)
1 1/2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (shaved)
recipe:
In a large pot, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Add the onion and celery and cook for three to five minutes, or until softened. Add the Herbes de Provence and season with salt and pepper.
Add the squash, lentils, and broth and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until the lentils and squash are cooked through. Stir in the kale during the last five minutes. Add the lemon juice and top with parmesan. Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Arugula & Cantaloupe Salad
ingredients:
1/2
Cantaloupe (medium, chopped, divided)
1 tbsp
Balsamic Vinegar
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Raw Honey
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
4 cups
Arugula
1/3 cup
Goat Cheese (crumbled)
1/4 cup
Slivered Almonds
recipe:
To make the dressing, combine 1/4 of the cantaloupe, balsamic vinegar, oil, honey, and salt in a blender and blend until smooth and creamy.
Divide the arugula, remaining cantaloupe, goat cheese, and slivered almonds evenly between bowls. Add the dressing on top. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Apple Cinnamon Oats
ingredients:
2 tsps
Coconut Oil
1
Apple (large, chopped)
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
1 1/3 cups
Water
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
2 tbsps
Almond Butter
2 tbsps
Pumpkin Seeds
recipe:
Turn the pressure cooker to "sauté" mode. Once hot, add the coconut oil, apple, and cinnamon. Cook until softened, stirring occasionally, about five minutes. Remove the apples and set aside.
Add the oats, water, and milk and stir. Close the lid and set to "sealing". Press manual/pressure cooker and cook for two minutes on high pressure.
Once the cooking time is complete, allow the pressure to naturally release for five minutes, then carefully quick release any remaining pressure.
Divide the oatmeal into bowls and top with maple syrup, almond butter, and seeds. Enjoy!

name: Crackers, Apple & Kefir
ingredients:
1
Apple (sliced)
1 oz
Whole Grain Crackers
1 cup
Plain Kefir
recipe: Add the apple slices and crackers to a plate or sealable container and pour the kefir into a glass. Enjoy!

name: Flaked Tilapia, Cucumber & Couscous
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Couscous (uncooked)
3 tbsps
Butter
2
Tilapia Fillet
2 tbsps
Chives (chopped, plus more for garnish)
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1/16 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2
Cucumber (large, diced)
1/2 cup
Tzatziki
recipe:
Cook the couscous according to the package directions. Once it's finished cooking, fluff the couscous with a fork and set it aside.
Heat the butter in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the tilapia fillets and cook for three minutes per side. Add the chives, lemon juice, and salt and continue cooking for two more minutes, breaking it up as it cooks.
Divide the couscous, tilapia, cucumber, and tzatziki evenly between bowls. Garnish with more chives if desired, and enjoy!

name: Potato & Cheddar Soup
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (large, chopped)
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1/2 tsp
Chili Powder
2
Russet Potato (large, cut into chunks)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth
3 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)
2 stalks
Green Onion (sliced)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Once hot, add the onion and cook until softened, about five to seven minutes, stirring often.
Add the smoked paprika, chili powder, and potatoes. Cook for one minute. Season with salt and pepper. Add the broth and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer for ten to 12 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked through.
Using an immersion blender, blend about half of the soup. Divide the soup into bowls and top with cheese and green onion. Enjoy!

name: Farro, Squash & Apple Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Farro (uncooked, rinsed)
3 cups
Butternut Squash (peeled, seeds removed, cubed)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Dijon Mustard
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
2
Apple (medium, chopped)
3/4 cup
Pecans (chopped)
3 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped, massaged)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cook the farro according to package directions and set aside in a large bowl to let cool slightly.
Place the squash on the baking sheet and drizzle with 1/4 of the oil and season with salt and pepper. Transfer to the oven and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, flipping halfway through, until cooked through and browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together the remaining oil, lemon juice, mustard, and maple syrup. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the apple, pecans, farro, squash, and kale to the bowl. Pour the dressing over top and toss to combine. Serve and enjoy!

name: One Pan Hummus Pasta
ingredients:
4 ozs
Rigatoni (uncooked)
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
1/3 cup
Hummus
1/2 cup
Green Olives
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Reserve pasta water and drain.
Add the cooked pasta back to the same pot, along with the hummus, pasta water, olives, and tomatoes. Toss to combine and simmer for three to four minutes or until the sauce is thick and creamy.
Season the pasta with salt and pepper. Divide between plates and top with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Blackberry Kefir Smoothie
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Plain Kefir
1 cup
Blackberries (fresh or frozen)
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tbsp
Hemp Seeds
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Enjoy!

name: Mackerel & Cauliflower Rice Bowl
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
3 cups
Cauliflower Rice
3/4 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
5 2/3 ozs
Canned Mackerel (skinless, boneless)
1/4
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1 cup
Microgreens
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
recipe:
Heat 1/3 of the oil in a pan over medium heat and add the cauliflower rice. Season with a 1/4 of the salt. Sauté for two to three minutes or until the cauliflower is warmed through.
Evenly divide the cauliflower rice, mackerel, cucumber, and microgreens into bowls. Season each bowl with the remaining oil, lemon juice, and remaining salt. Enjoy!

name: Grape Apple Crisp
ingredients:
3
Apple (cored, sliced)
1 cup
Grapes (small, red, seedless)
1/3 cup
Coconut Sugar (divided)
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 1/4 cups
Oats (rolled)
1/2 cup
Oat Flour
2 tsps
Cinnamon
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Coconut Oil
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a deep baking dish. Add the apples, grapes, 1/4 of the coconut sugar, and vanilla. Toss to combine then spread the fruit out. Set aside.
In a mixing bowl, add the oats, oat flour, remaining coconut sugar, cinnamon, and salt. Mix to combine. Add the coconut oil, one tablespoon at a time. Use your fingers to work it in until coarse crumbs form. Add this topping to the fruit and evenly spread it out, gently pressing down.
Bake for 45 minutes or until the oats turn golden brown. Let it cool for 15 to 20 minutes before serving. Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Protein Pumpkin Oatmeal
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Oats (rolled)
1/4 cup
Pureed Pumpkin
3/4 cup
Water
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
2 tbsps
Vanilla Protein Powder
1/2 tsp
Pumpkin Pie Spice
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
2 tbsps
Pecans (chopped)
recipe:
Heat a small saucepan over medium heat and add the oats, pumpkin, water, milk, protein powder, and pumpkin pie spice. Cook, stirring often until gently boiling. Reduce the heat and simmer until cooked through, about five minutes.
Add the oatmeal to a bowl and top with maple syrup and pecans. Enjoy!

name: Avocado, Feta & Lima Bean Wrap
ingredients:
1/2
Avocado (medium)
1
Whole Wheat Tortilla (large)
1/4
Lime (juiced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 cup
Lima Beans (cooked)
2 tbsps
Feta Cheese (crumbles)
recipe:
Place the avocado on top of the tortilla. Use a fork and smash the avocado. Spread it all over the tortilla. Season with lime juice and salt.
Top the avocado with beans and feta cheese. Roll up the tortilla and enjoy!

name: Lemony Tilapia & Cucumber with Rice
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Basmati Rice (dry, rinsed)
2
Tilapia Fillet
1 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
1 tbsp
Butter (divided)
1
Lemon (juiced, divided)
1/2
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
2 tsps
Mint Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions and set aside.
Season the fish fillets all over with half of the salt. Melt half of the butter in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the fish and half of the lemon juice to the pan.
Cook for three to four minutes. Add the remaining butter to the pan. Flip the fillets and cook for another three to four more minutes. Spoon the lemon butter from the pan over the fillets occasionally.
Meanwhile, in a bowl, mix together the cucumber, mint leaves, remaining lemon juice, and salt. Divide the rice and fish fillets evenly between plates. Top the fish with the cucumber mixture and enjoy!

name: Romaine & Parmesan Salad
ingredients:
2 heads
Romaine Hearts (chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Red Wine Vinegar
1/3 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Mix all of the ingredients together in a large bowl. Serve and enjoy!

name: Cauliflower Shawarma Grain Bowl
ingredients:
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2 head
Cauliflower (small, cut into florets)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Shawarma Spice Blend (divided)
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry)
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/4
Cucumber (large, diced)
2 tbsps
Red Onion (chopped)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
1/4 cup
Hummus
2 tbsps
Water (warm)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the chickpeas and cauliflower with the oil and 2/3 of the spice blend on the baking sheet. Spread out evenly. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the quinoa according to package directions.
Toss the tomatoes, cucumbers, red onion, and parsley in a small bowl. Set aside.
Prepare the dressing by mixing the hummus, water, and remaining spices together.
Divide the quinoa, chickpea, cauliflower, and cucumber salad between bowls. Drizzle with the hummus dressing and enjoy!

name: Roasted Squash & Lima Bean Salad
ingredients:
1/2
Acorn Squash (medium, seeds removed, sliced)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Arugula
1 cup
Lima Beans (cooked)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese
2 tbsps
Balsamic Glaze
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Brush the acorn squash slices on both sides with the oil and season with salt and pepper. Place on the baking sheet and bake in the oven for 13 to 15 minutes.
Remove from the oven. Flip and cook for another 13 to 15 minutes, until cooked through and slightly golden. Set aside to cool down.
Arrange the arugula, beans, squash, and feta cheese on a serving plate. Drizzle with balsamic glaze and enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Polenta
ingredients:
2 cups
Vegetable Broth
1/2 cup
Cornmeal
1/4 cup
Pureed Pumpkin
1/8 oz
Thyme Sprigs
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 tsps
Coconut Oil
recipe:
Add all the ingredients except for the coconut oil to a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Stir and bring the mixture to simmer.
Stir continuously until almost all of the liquid evaporates. This will only take a few minutes.
Turn the heat down to a simmer. Let the mixture cook for about 15 minutes, stirring often until the mixture is tender and thick.
Add the coconut oil and stir well. Remove the thyme springs, adjust the seasoning to your taste, and enjoy!

name: BBQ Ranch Tempeh Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry, rinsed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
9 ozs
Tempeh (diced)
2 tbsps
Barbecue Sauce
3 tbsps
Water
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/2
Avocado (medium, sliced)
2 tbsps
Vegan Ranch Dressing
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
1 stalk
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the tempeh and cook for two to three minutes, stirring frequently. Add the barbecue sauce and the water. Stir and cook until it begins to caramelize for approximately three to five minutes.
Divide the rice, tempeh, tomatoes, and avocado into each bowl. Top with dressing, cilantro, and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Lentil & Zucchini Couscous Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Couscous (uncooked)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, sliced)
1
Zucchini (medium, chopped)
1 1/2 tsps
Cumin
1 cup
Lentils (cooked)
1/4 cup
Vegetable Broth (warm, divided)
1/4 cup
Hummus
2 cups
Baby Spinach
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the couscous according to the package directions. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring, until starting to brown, about four minutes. Add the zucchini and cook for two more minutes or until tender.
Add the cumin, lentils, and half of the broth. Stir to combine and cook for one more minute or until heated through.
In a small bowl, mix the hummus with the remaining broth.
Divide the couscous, lentils, and spinach into each bowl. Top with the hummus dressing and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Parmesan Tomatoes
ingredients:
2 tsps
Italian Seasoning
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano
2
Tomato (large, sliced)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 380°F (195°C).
Add the Italian seasoning, sea salt, and parmesan cheese evenly over all of the tomato slices. Cook in the air fryer for eight minutes, or until the cheese has started to brown.
Remove from the air fryer and top with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Pinto Bean & Cabbage Quesadilla
ingredients:
1/2 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Green Cabbage (sliced)
1/4 cup
Purple Cabbage (sliced)
1/2 cup
Pinto Beans (cooked)
1/2 tsp
Taco Seasoning
2
Whole Wheat Tortilla (medium)
3 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)
1/2
Avocado (medium, sliced)
1/2
Lime (juiced)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add both cabbages and sauté for about five minutes or until soft. Add the pinto beans and taco seasoning. Stir and cook for another minute. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and set aside.
In the same pan, add one tortilla. Cover the tortilla with the cheese and top with the bean mixture. Close the quesadilla with another tortilla on top.
Cover the pan with a lid and cook for about four minutes, flipping halfway through.
Cut the quesadilla into four pieces. Top with avocado and lime juice. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Potato Lentil Soup
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Leeks (medium, trimmed, chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
2
Carrot (medium, peeled, diced)
1 cup
Mini Potatoes (quartered)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth
3 1/3 cups
Crushed Tomatoes (from the can)
1 1/2 cups
Dry Lentils (brown, rinsed, drained)
1 tbsp
Italian Seasoning
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Turn the pressure cooker to "sauté" mode. Once hot, add the oil and leeks. Season with salt and pepper. Sauté for three to four minutes or until the leeks have softened. Add a splash of broth if needed. Add the garlic and sauté for another 30 to 60 seconds.
Add the carrots and cook for three to four minutes, stirring occasionally, until they have softened slightly. Add the potatoes, vegetable broth, crushed tomatoes, lentils, and Italian seasoning. Stir to combine.
Close the lid of the pressure cooker and set to “sealing”. Press manual/pressure cooker and cook for 12 minutes on high pressure. Once it is done, allow the pressure to release naturally for 10 minutes, and then release any remaining pressure manually. Remove the lid carefully.
Stir the soup before dividing into bowls. Season with salt and pepper if desired. Garnish with parsley and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Corn Ribs
ingredients:
4 ears
Corn On The Cob (husk removed)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Apple Cider Vinegar
2 tbsps
Raw Honey
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Onion Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 380°F (195°C).
Meanwhile, carefully chop the corn cobs in half. Slice each in half lengthwise, turn, and cut in half lengthwise again to yield four ribs from each half. Add to a large bowl.
In a small bowl, combine the oil, apple cider vinegar, honey, and spices. Whisk with a fork until well combined. Pour over the corn pieces and mix until well-coated.
Transfer to the air fryer basket and cook for 10 to 12 minutes, tossing halfway through. Enjoy!

name: Quinoa, Brussels Sprouts & Sweet Potato Bowl
ingredients:
2 cups
Brussels Sprouts (trimmed, halved)
1
Sweet Potato (medium, cubed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Harissa
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry)
1 cup
Baby Spinach (finely chopped)
1/4 cup
Hummus
2 tbsps
Water (warm)
1/2
Avocado (medium, sliced)
2 tbsps
Pumpkin Seeds (toasted)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the Brussels sprouts and sweet potato with the oil and harissa. Spread the vegetables evenly onto the baking sheet. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until tender and starting to brown.
Meanwhile, cook the quinoa according to package directions. Once cooked, stir in the spinach.
Prepare the dressing by mixing the hummus and the water.
Divide the quinoa, Brussels sprouts, potatoes, and avocado into each bowl. Top with the hummus dressing and pumpkin seeds. Enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Pie Spiced Pecans
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Pecans
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Pumpkin Pie Spice
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, toss together all the ingredients. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread evenly. Bake for five minutes, remove from the oven and stir, then bake for another five minutes.
Let the pecans cool down before serving and enjoy!

name: Matar Paneer
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2
Tomato (medium, chopped)
1
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
2 tsps
Ginger (minced)
2
Garlic (clove, large, minced)
2 tsps
Garam Masala
1/3 cup
Plain Cow's Yogurt, Whole Milk
1/3 cup
Water
12 ozs
Paneer Cheese (cubed)
1 1/2 cups
Frozen Peas
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Add the oil to a large pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the tomatoes, onion, ginger, and garlic. Sauté for three to five minutes, or until the tomatoes and onions soften.
Add the tomato mixture to a blender or food processor and blend until just smooth. Add the mixture back to the pan. Add the garam masala, yogurt, and water. Stir to mix well.
Add the paneer and peas and stir to coat. Cover and cook for two minutes.
Serve and garnish with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Tofu, Sweet Potato & Kale Rice Bowls
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Rice (dry, rinsed)
1
Sweet Potato (Japanese, medium, chopped)
12 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, cubed)
1/8 oz
Avocado Oil Spray

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Kale Leaves (stems removed, chopped)
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Apple Cider Vinegar
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C).
Add the sweet potato and tofu to a baking sheet. Coat with the avocado oil spray and season with salt and pepper. Bake in the oven for 25 minutes or until the sweet potato is fork-tender.
For the last five minutes of the rice cooking, add the kale leaves into the pot.
In a small bowl, whisk together the avocado oil, garlic, apple cider vinegar, and honey.
Divide the rice, sweet potato, and tofu between bowls. Drizzle with the dressing and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Maple Dijon Brussels Sprouts & Squash
ingredients:
2 cups
Brussels Sprouts
1
Acorn Squash (medium, seeds removed, sliced)
1 tbsp
Balsamic Vinegar
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
1 tbsp
Dijon Mustard
1 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 380°F (195°C).
Add the brussels sprouts and squash to a large bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together the balsamic vinegar, honey, mustard, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Drizzle over the Brussels sprouts and squash and mix until well coated.
Transfer to the air fryer and cook for 12 to 15 minutes, until fork-tender and browned. Enjoy!

name: Amchar Masala Paneer
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Garlic (clove, large, minced)
2 tsps
Ginger (fresh, grated)
1
Yellow Onion (small, chopped)
2
Tomato (medium, diced)
1 1/2 tsps
Amchar Masala
1 tsp
Kashmiri Chili Powder
3 tbsps
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
1/3 cup
Water
12 ozs
Paneer Cheese (cubed)
1 tbsp
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
In a large pan over medium heat, add the oil. Once it is hot, add the garlic, ginger, onion, and tomato. Sauté for three minutes, mixing frequently.
Add the tomato mixture to a blender or food processor and blend until just smooth. Once smooth, add it back to the pan.
Add the amchar masala, chili powder, yogurt, and water to the pan. Mix well and cook for two minutes.
Add the paneer and coat well in the sauce. Cover and cook for two minutes. Garnish with the cilantro and serve. Enjoy!

name: Cinnamon Banana Overnight Steel Cut Oats
ingredients:
1 1/3 cups
Water
1 1/3 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
3/4 cup
Steel Cut Oats
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1
Banana (sliced)
2 tbsps
All Natural Peanut Butter
recipe:
In a medium pot, combine the water and milk over medium-high heat and bring to a low boil, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the oats, salt, and cinnamon and cook for five minutes, stirring occasionally. Transfer to a container and let cool before placing in the fridge overnight or for at least eight hours.
When ready to eat, top with maple syrup, banana, and peanut butter. Enjoy!

name: Mixed Green Salad with Apple & Walnuts
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Walnuts (roughly chopped)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinegar
1 1/2 tsps
Dijon Mustard
1 tbsp
Raw Honey

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 cups
Mixed Greens
1/2 cup
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
1
Apple (thinly sliced)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 325ºF (165ºC).
Place the walnuts on a baking sheet and transfer to the oven. Bake for seven to nine minutes, until toasted and fragrant. Set aside.
In a small jar or bowl, whisk together the oil, vinegar, mustard, honey, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
In a large salad bowl, combine the greens, red onion, and apple.
Drizzle the dressing over top and toss to combine. Garnish with the walnuts and feta cheese and toss gently to combine. Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Roasted Paprika Potatoes
ingredients:
7
Yellow Potato (medium, chopped into bite-sized pieces)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Paprika
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1 tbsp
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC). Place a cast iron pan in the oven while it preheats.
Toss the potatoes with the oil, paprika, salt, and garlic powder. Add the potatoes to the preheated pan.
Bake for 40 minutes, tossing halfway through. The potatoes should be browned with crispy edges and cooked through.
Garnish with the cilantro and serve. Enjoy!

name: Turmeric Oat Latte
ingredients:
2 tsps
Coconut Oil
1/2 tsp
Turmeric (ground)
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 tsp
Ground Ginger
1/4 tsp
Cardamom (ground)
2 cups
Oat Milk (plus more for topping)
1/2 cup
Coffee (espresso, brewed)
2 tsps
Raw Honey
recipe:
In a small saucepan, heat the oil and spices over low heat, stirring to infuse for 30 seconds.
Add the milk, coffee, and honey. Simmer gently for five minutes, stirring constantly, until smooth.
Pour into a cup. Froth a little more milk to top the latte, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Red Lentil Curry
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil
1 cup
Red Onion (chopped)
1 tbsp
Ginger (fresh, minced)
1 tbsp
Curry Powder
1/2 tsp
Garam Masala
1 1/4 cups
Dry Red Lentils (rinsed, drained)
1/2 cup
Canned Coconut Milk (full fat)
1 cup
Crushed Tomatoes
3 cups
Vegetable Broth
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onions and cook for three to five minutes or until translucent.
Add the ginger, curry powder, garam masala, and lentils. Cook, stirring, for 30 seconds or until the flavors are blended.
Add the coconut milk, crushed tomatoes, and broth. Stir well to combine.
Bring to a boil, reduce the heat to low, and cover. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are cooked through.
Divide onto plates, sprinkle with cilantro, and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Maple Dijon Brussels Sprouts, Squash & Sausage
ingredients:
2 cups
Brussels Sprouts
1
Acorn Squash (medium, seeds removed, sliced)
1 tbsp
Balsamic Vinegar
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
1 tbsp
Dijon Mustard
1 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 lb
Lamb Sausage
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 380°F (195°C).
Add the Brussels sprouts and squash to a large bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together the balsamic vinegar, honey, mustard, garlic powder, salt and pepper to taste. Drizzle over the brussels sprouts and squash and mix until well coated.
Cook the sausage in the air fryer for five minutes then add the Brussels sprouts and squash. Cook for another 12 to 15 minutes, until fork-tender and browned. Enjoy!

name: Matcha Cashew Latte
ingredients:
2 cups
Unsweetened Cashew Milk
2 tsps
