Green Tea Powder
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
recipe:
Warm cashew milk in a pot on the stove until hot. Alternatively, steam the cashew milk using a steaming wand. Add the milk to a blender with the green tea powder and maple syrup. Blend on high for 15 seconds. Alternatively, use an immersion blender to combine.
Pour into mugs and enjoy!

name: Chili & Garlic Paneer
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
1
Garlic (clove, large, minced)
1 tsp
Kashmiri Chili Powder
12 ozs
Paneer Cheese (cubed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Water
1 tsp
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Add the oil, garlic, chilli powder, paneer, salt, and pepper to a large bowl and toss well to coat the paneer.
Heat a large pan over medium heat. Add the seasoned paneer. Cook for five to seven minutes, flipping the paneer as it cooks to brown the sides. Add the water to deglaze and release any paneer stuck to the pan.
Serve and garnish with the cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Tahini Dates
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Pitted Dates
1/3 cup
Tahini
1 1/2 tsps
Coconut Oil
3/4 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Arrange the dates onto a lined baking sheet with the cut side up. Add tahini into each date, approximately one teaspoon per date. Place in the fridge.
Add the coconut oil and chocolate chips to a small saucepan over low heat. Continuously stir until the chocolate has melted. Pour it into a shallow bowl and let it cool for five minutes.
Once the chocolate has slightly cooled, remove the dates from the fridge. Dip each date into the chocolate, making sure it is well coated. Let any excess chocolate drip back into the bowl and then transfer back to the baking sheet.
Place the baking sheet back into the fridge for 15 to 20 minutes to let the chocolate harden. Remove from the fridge and sprinkle flaky salt all over the dates. Enjoy!

name: Chai Latte
ingredients:
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 cup
Chai Tea (steeped)
1/4 cup
Cow's Milk, Whole
1/8 tsp
Cinnamon
recipe: Add the maple syrup, vanilla, and steeped tea to a mug and stir. Warm the milk in a small pot over low heat. Once warm, use a frother to create some foam. Alternatively, blend the warmed milk in a blender until frothy. Pour into the same mug as the tea and top with cinnamon. Enjoy!

name: Vanilla Maple Nut Granola
ingredients:
2 cups
Quick Oats
1 cup
Walnuts (chopped)
1/2 cup
Cashews (raw)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add oats, walnuts, cashews, and sea salt to a large bowl and mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the vanilla extract, maple syrup, and oil. Pour this mixture over the oat mixture and stir well to coat.
Put the oat mixture onto the baking sheet and spread it out evenly. Bake for 20 minutes, stirring halfway through.
Let the granola cool on the baking sheet for 10 minutes before serving. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Tofu Burrito Bowl
ingredients:
1 cup
Brown Rice (dry, rinsed)
16 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, pressed, crumbled)
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Taco Seasoning
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
1/3 cup
Tahini
1/4 cup
Water
2 tbsps
Hot Sauce
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
10 leaves
Romaine (chopped)
2
Avocado (medium, sliced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Add the tofu, oil, taco seasoning, and half the salt to a large bowl. Toss well to combine. Transfer to the baking sheet and bake for 20 to 24 minutes, until crispy.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the tahini, water, hot sauce, lime juice, and remaining salt. Whisk well until incorporated, adding more water if needed to thin.
Divide the rice, romaine, tofu, and avocado between bowls. Drizzle the tahini over the top. Enjoy!

name: Turmeric Chocolate Chia Pudding
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Chia Seeds
1 1/2 cups
Canned Coconut Milk (full fat)
2 tsps
Turmeric (ground)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup (divided)
1 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
2 tbsps
Cacao Powder
recipe:
Mix the chia seeds, coconut milk, turmeric, and 2/3 of the maple syrup together. Place in the fridge for 30 minutes to set.
Meanwhile, mix the yogurt, cacao powder and remaining maple syrup together.
Layer the chia pudding and yogurt into jars or serving bowls until all ingredients are used up. Enjoy!

name: Lavender & Chamomile Tea Latte
ingredients:
1/16 oz
Dried Chamomile Flowers
1/16 oz
Dried Lavender Flowers
1/2 cup
Water (hot)
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Cashew Milk
1 tsp
Raw Honey
recipe:
Combine the dried chamomile and lavender in a tea infuser or tea bag in a mug. Steep in hot water for at least five minutes or until your desired strength.
Heat the milk in a pot on the stove until hot. Alternatively, steam the milk with a steaming wand. Pour the milk into the mug and add the honey. Enjoy!

name: Sun Dried Tomato Pesto
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Sun Dried Tomatoes (drained)
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Capers (drained)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
recipe:
In a food processor, pulse the sun dried tomatoes, basil, oil, capers, and garlic until desired consistency.
Transfer to a jar and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Cauliflower Bites with Mint Sauce
ingredients:
1 head
Cauliflower (small, cut into florets)
1/2 tsp
Cumin
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika
2
Garlic (clove, minced, divided)
1
Lemon (juiced, divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
1/3 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 380°F (195°C).
In a bowl, toss together the cauliflower florets, cumin, paprika, half of the garlic, half of the lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Transfer the cauliflower to the air fryer basket. Spray with avocado oil and bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until cooked through, shaking halfway through.
Meanwhile, use a blender or immersion blender to make the sauce. Blend the yogurt, mint, remaining lemon juice, remaining garlic, salt, and pepper together until smooth. Adjust the seasoning to your taste.
Serve the cauliflower with mint sauce and enjoy!

name: Mushroom Tacos
ingredients:
1/2
Lime (juiced)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Cilantro (Chopped)
2 cups
Oyster Mushrooms (king oyster, halved)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
4
Corn Tortilla (small)
1/4 head
Green Lettuce (shredded)
1 oz
Pickled Red Onions
1/2
Jalapeno Pepper (thinly sliced)
recipe:
In a bowl, mix together the lime juice, garlic, cilantro, and mushrooms. Season the mixture with salt and pepper and let the mushrooms marinate for about 10 minutes.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms and sauté for three to four minutes or until browned.
Top each tortilla with mushrooms, lettuce, pickled onion, and jalapeño. Enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Ricotta Dip
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Ricotta Cheese
1/3 cup
Pureed Pumpkin
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1 1/2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1
Garlic (clove)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Pumpkin Seeds
recipe:
Add the ricotta, puréed pumpkin, lemon juice, maple syrup, garlic, salt, and pepper to a blender. Blend until smooth and adjust the seasoning to your taste.
Transfer the mixture to a serving bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and garnish with pumpkin seeds. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Brussels Sprouts & Radishes
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Brussels Sprouts (trimmed, halved)
1 cup
Radishes (halved)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Shallot (chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, large, minced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Parsley (coarsely chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Lined a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the Brussels sprouts, radishes, oil, shallots, garlic, and salt together in a bowl. Spread out on the baking sheet and roast for 25 minutes.
Serve and garnish with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Cayenne, Lemon & Honey Hot Drink
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1/2 tsp
Cayenne Pepper
1 cup
Water (boiled)
recipe:
Add the lemon juice, honey, and cayenne to a cup or mug.
Add the hot water into the cup and stir. Once it is cool enough to drink, enjoy!

name: Roasted Broccoli Chickpea Pasta
ingredients:
6 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (uncooked)
2 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Basil Leaves
1/2
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1 1/2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
1/3 cup
Sun Dried Tomatoes (drained, chopped)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Drain, rinse well, and set aside to cool.
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the broccoli on the baking sheet and toss with 1/3 of the oil. Season with salt and pepper. Roast for 15 minutes or until lightly golden. Set aside to cool.
Blend the basil, garlic, hemp seeds, lemon juice, nutritional yeast, and the remaining oil in a blender or food processor. Season with salt and pepper.
Combine the roasted broccoli, cooked pasta, sun dried tomatoes, and pesto in a large bowl. Toss to combine. Enjoy!

name: Fennel Tea
ingredients:
2 tsps
Fennel Seed (crushed)
1 cup
Water (boiled)
1 tsp
Raw Honey (optional)
recipe:
Fill a tea bag or tea steeper with the fennel seeds.
Pour the hot water into the cup with the fennel seeds. Cover and let it steep for two to five minutes or until desired strength.
Remove the tea bag and sweeten with honey, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Baked Apples with Oatmeal
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup (divided)
1 1/2 tsps
Coconut Oil
1/2 tsp
Pumpkin Pie Spice
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2/3 cup
Oats (rolled)
1/4 cup
Hazelnuts (chopped)
2
Apple (halved, cored)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, whisk together half of the maple syrup, coconut oil, pumpkin pie spice, and salt. Add the oats and hazelnuts and stir well.
Place the apples on the baking sheet, skin side down. Spoon the oat mixture on top of the apples. Bake in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until the apples are soft.
Drizzle the remaining maple syrup on top and enjoy!

name: Cinnamon Roll Latte
ingredients:
1 tsp
Coconut Sugar
1/4 cup
Coffee (espresso, brewed)
1/2 cup
Cow's Milk, Whole
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon (plus more for garnish)
2 tbsps
Whipped Cream (optional)
recipe: Stir the coconut sugar into the brewed coffee. Warm the milk, vanilla extract, and cinnamon in a small pot over the stove. Use a frother to create some foam. Alternatively, blend the warmed milk in a blender until frothy. Add the milk to the brewed coffee and top with whipped cream and cinnamon. Enjoy!

name: One Pot Vegan Sun Dried Tomato Alfredo
ingredients:
2 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
2 cups
Vegetable Broth
8 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (dry)
1/2 cup
Sun Dried Tomato Pesto
2 cups
Baby Spinach (finely chopped)
1 tbsp
Nutritional Yeast
recipe:
In a pot over medium-high heat, bring the milk and broth to a boil. Add the pasta and stir. Cook over medium heat for four to six minutes, stirring frequently, until the pasta is just cooked to al dente. The pasta will continue to cook in the next steps.
Stir in the sun dried tomato pesto, spinach, and nutritional yeast. Cook for one to two more minutes, allowing the spinach to wilt and the sauce to thicken.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Blueberry & Banana Bread N'Oatmeal
ingredients:
1
Banana (medium, ripe)
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
1 tbsp
Ground Flax Seed
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 cup
Pecans (chopped)
1/2 cup
Blueberries
2 tbsps
Tahini
recipe:
In a bowl, mash the banana then add the milk, chia seeds, hemp seeds, ground flax, maple syrup, vanilla, and cinnamon. Whisk to combine. Let it sit out on the counter for five minutes, then whisk again before covering it and putting it in the fridge.
Refrigerate overnight for best results. When ready to eat, divide into bowls or jars and top with pecans, blueberries, and tahini. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Chana Masala
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Jasmine Rice (dry, rinsed)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2
Garlic (clove, large, minced)
1/3 cup
Shallot (finely chopped)
2 cups
Cherry Tomatoes (chopped)
3 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 1/2 tsps
Garam Masala
1 tsp
Turmeric (ground)
2 tsps
Cumin
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 cups
Water
2 tbsps
Parsley (coarsely chopped)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to package directions.
Set the pressure cooker to "sauté" mode. Add the oil, garlic, shallots, and tomatoes. Cook for four to five minutes or until everything has softened. Gently mash the tomatoes with a wooden spoon to break them up.
Add the chickpeas, garam masala, turmeric, cumin, and sea salt. Mix well and cook for two minutes to allow the spices to bloom. Add the water and mix well again. Set the pressure cooker to "sealing" and cook on high for ten minutes.
Manually and carefully release the pressure. Serve the chana masala with the rice and garnish with the parsley. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Cauliflower, Squash & Apple Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Farro (uncooked, rinsed)
2
Honeynut Squash (small, seeds removed, chopped)
1/2 head
Cauliflower (small, cut into small florets)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
3 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
1 tbsp
Fresh Dill (chopped)
1
Apple (medium, chopped)
recipe:
Cook the farro according to the package directions and set aside.
While the farro is cooking, preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the squash and cauliflower to the baking sheet. Drizzle half of the oil all over and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat the veggies, then spread them out into an even layer. Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, turning halfway through, or until they are golden brown and fork tender.
Add the remaining oil, lemon juice, garlic, parsley, dill, salt, and pepper to a jar. Close the lid and shake until emulsified. Set aside.
Add the cooked farro, roasted veggies, and apple to a large bowl. Shake the jar of dressing again before pouring it over the salad. Toss to combine. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Chocolate Chip Banana Bread Oatmeal
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Steel Cut Oats
3/4 cup
Water
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon
1/2
Banana (medium, sliced)
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
2 tbsps
Walnuts (chopped)
1 tbsp
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Add the steel cut oats, water, milk, cinnamon, banana, and sea salt to your pressure cooker and close the lid. Set to “sealing,” then press manual/pressure cooker. Cook for five minutes on high pressure. Once it is done, press cancel, and let the pressure release naturally for ten minutes. Do a quick release for any remaining pressure. Remove the lid carefully, and stir in the chia seeds and let it sit for a few minutes until thickened.
Pour the oatmeal into a bowl and top with maple syrup, walnuts, and chocolate chips. Enjoy!

name: Green Beans Almondine
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Butter
1/4 cup
Slivered Almonds
2
Garlic (cloves, thinly sliced)
1/3 cup
Shallot (thinly sliced)
4 cups
Green Beans (trimmed)
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Fill a large pot with salted water and bring to a boil over high heat. Cover with a lid.
Heat a large skillet over medium-low heat. Melt the butter and add the almonds, stirring frequently, until toasted, about three to four minutes. Add the garlic and shallot and sauté for one minute, until fragrant. Remove from the heat and set aside.
Add the beans to the large pot of boiling water and cook for three minutes.
Once the beans are done, return the skillet to medium-low heat. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the beans to the skillet and cook, stirring often for two to three minutes or until tender-crisp.
Add the lemon juice and season with salt and pepper. Toss often until the sauce is glossy. Transfer to a serving dish and enjoy!

name: Sausage & Apple Pizza Rolls
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
8 ozs
Turkey Sausage (casing removed)
1/2 cup
Shallot (finely chopped)
1
Apple (large, chopped small)
1/2 oz
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
11 ozs
Pizza Dough (store bought)
1/4 cup
Pesto
3 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)
recipe:
With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 450ºF (230ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the sausage and shallots. Cook for five to seven minutes, breaking the meat up as it cooks. Let it cool, then mix in the apple.
Meanwhile, lightly dust a clean surface with flour. Roll the dough out to approximately a 1/4-inch (1/2 cm) thick rectangle.
Spread the pesto onto the dough. Add the sausage and apple mixture and sprinkle with cheese.
Roll the dough into a large roll and gently cut it into 1 1/4-inch (3 cm) thick slices.
Lay the slices on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden and cheese is melted and browned. Enjoy!

name: Green Tea Latte
ingredients:
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 cup
Green Tea (brewed)
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
recipe:
Add the honey, vanilla, and steeped tea to a mug and stir.
Warm the milk in a small pot over low heat. Once warm, use a frother to create some foam. Alternatively, blend the warmed milk in a blender until frothy. Pour into the same mug as the tea and enjoy!

name: Meal Prep Quinoa, Tomato & Guacamole Bowl
ingredients:
1 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
4 cups
Arugula
2 cups
Cherry Tomatoes (chopped)
1/2 cup
Guacamole
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions.
To assemble, divide the quinoa, arugula, tomatoes, and guacamole into bowls. Enjoy!

name: Whole Wheat Focaccia
ingredients:
1 cup
Water (warm)
2 tsps
Instant Yeast
1 1/2 tsps
Maple Syrup
2 1/2 cups
Whole Wheat Flour (plus extra for dusting)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
2 tsps
Sea Salt (plus flakey salt for garnish)
1/8 oz
Avocado Oil Spray (divided)
1 tbsp
Rosemary (fresh, chopped)
recipe:
In a large bowl, add the warm water, yeast, and maple syrup. Stir, cover the bowl with a towel, and let it sit for about five minutes.
Add flour, half of the oil, and salt to the bowl. Stir the ingredients together with a wooden spoon, and once the dough starts to come together, knead the dough for five to six minutes on a clean surface, dusted with flour.
Spray a clean bowl with half of the oil spray, cover the bowl with a damp towel, and let the dough rise in a warm place for about an hour and a half or until doubled in size.
Once the dough has risen, spray a baking dish with oil spray and transfer the dough into the dish. Gently press the dough into the pan evenly, dimpling the dough with your fingertips and pressing all the way to the bottom of the pan. Drizzle the top of the dough with the remaining olive oil.
Cover the dish with a damp towel, and let the dough rise again for another 30 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC).
Top the dough with rosemary and flakey salt. Bake in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Slice the focaccia and enjoy!

name: Crispy Air Fryer Cauliflower Bites with Sweet Chili Sauce
ingredients:
1/3 cup
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/4 tsp
Ground Ginger
1/2 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into small florets)
1/2 cup
Bread Crumbs
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
1/4 cup
Sweet Chili Sauce
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 370°F (190°C).
In a large bowl add the flour, milk, salt, garlic powder, and ginger. Whisk until well combined. Add the cauliflower and toss until well coated. Add the breadcrumbs and toss until all florets are coated.
Transfer the cauliflower to the air fryer basket. Spray with avocado oil and bake for 10 to 13 minutes or until cooked through, shaking halfway through.
Serve the cauliflower with the sauce and enjoy!

name: Cherry & Walnut Buckwheat Porridge
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Buckwheat Groats (dry)
2 cups
Water
3/4 cup
Frozen Cherries
2 tbsps
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
2 tbsps
Walnuts (chopped)
recipe:
Add the buckwheat groats and water to a medium pot and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cover, cooking for 15 to 20 minutes or until the water has absorbed and the buckwheat is soft and porridge-like.
Meanwhile, heat the cherries in a small saucepan for about five to seven minutes over medium heat. Mash them with a wooden spoon as they begin to soften.
Divide the buckwheat porridge between bowls and top with the cherries, yogurt, and walnuts. Enjoy!

name: Parmesan Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Bread Crumbs
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
1 tbsp
Italian Seasoning
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Parsley (finely chopped)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 cups
Mushrooms (large, stems removed)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix the breadcrumbs, parmesan, Italian seasoning, garlic, parsley, oil, salt, and pepper.
Fill the mushroom cavities with the mixture, placing them on the prepared baking sheet, cavity side up.
Bake for about 20 to 25 minutes or until the mushrooms are tender and the filling is golden. Enjoy!

name: Lemon Blueberry Steel Cut Oats
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Steel Cut Oats
2 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2
Lemon (juiced, zested)
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 cup
Blueberries (divided)
recipe:
Add the oats, almond milk, and salt to a saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 13 to 15 minutes, depending on how crunchy you like your oats. When everything starts to thicken, stir in the lemon juice, lemon zest, and maple syrup.
Once cooked, stir in half of the blueberries. Divide into bowls and top with the remaining blueberries. Enjoy!

name: Leek & White Bean Soup
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Red Onion (diced)
3
Garlic (clove, chopped)
1
Leeks (medium, sliced)
2 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
White Navy Beans
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1 tbsp
Fresh Dill (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for two to three minutes or until soft. Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the leeks and cook for another five minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the vegetable both, stir, and season with salt and pepper. Cover the pot with a lid and simmer for about 15 minutes.
Add the beans, cover, and simmer for another 10 minutes. Remove the pot from the heat. Add the lemon juice and adjust the seasoning to your taste.
Divide the soup between bowls, top with dill, and enjoy!

name: Mushroom & Lentil Shepherd's Pie
ingredients:
3
Yellow Potato (medium, peeled and cubed)
1/3 cup
Cow's Milk, Whole (plus more if needed)
2 tbsps
Butter (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
15
Cremini Mushrooms (medium, sliced)
2
Carrot (medium, diced)
4
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 cups
Lentils (cooked)
1 1/2 cups
Tomato Sauce
1 stalk
Green Onion (sliced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). In a large pot of boiling water, cook the potatoes until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and bring back to the same pot. Add the milk and half of the butter to the potatoes. Use a masher and mash or purée until the potatoes are smooth. Add more milk if needed to reach your desired consistency. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside.
Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the remaining butter and mushrooms. Sauté until browned. Add the carrot and garlic and sauté for another minute. Add the lentils and tomato sauce and season with salt and pepper. Stir well, cover the pot with a lid, and simmer on low heat for about 10 minutes.
Pour the lentil mixture into a baking dish. Cover the top with mashed potato and bake in the oven for 30 minutes or until browned on top.
Let cool for about five minutes before serving. Top with green onion and enjoy!

name: Vanilla Chamomile Tea Latte
ingredients:
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 cup
Chamomile Tea (brewed)
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
recipe:
Add the honey, vanilla, and steeped tea to a mug and stir.
Warm the milk in a small pot over low heat. Once warm, use a frother to create some foam. Alternatively, blend the warmed milk in a blender until frothy. Pour into the same mug as the tea and enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Steel Cut Oats
3/4 cup
Water
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon (divided)
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1
Apple (medium, chopped)
2 tbsps
Walnuts (chopped)
recipe:
Add the steel cut oats, water, milk, half of the cinnamon, and salt to your pressure cooker and close the lid. Set to “sealing,” then press manual/pressure cooker. Cook for five minutes on high pressure. Once it is done, press cancel and let the pressure release naturally for ten minutes. Do a quick release for any remaining pressure.
Remove the lid carefully and add the maple syrup.
Add the oatmeal to a bowl and top with the chopped apple, walnuts, and remaining cinnamon. Enjoy!

name: Chipotle Squash, Quinoa & Chickpea Salad
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Quinoa (dry)
1 1/2 cups
Butternut Squash (peeled, seeded and cubed)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Chipotle Powder
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 cups
Mixed Greens
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped, optional)
1/4 cup
Cilantro Lime Dressing
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cook the quinoa according to package directions.
Toss the squash with the oil, chipotle powder, garlic, salt, and pepper. Cook for 20 minutes in the oven, flipping halfway through, or until just browned.
Add the mixed greens, tomatoes, chickpeas, squash, quinoa, and parsley to a large serving dish. Serve with the dressing and enjoy!

name: Cauliflower & Blueberry Porridge
ingredients:
1 cup
Canned Coconut Milk (full fat)
1 1/2 cups
Cauliflower Rice
2 tbsps
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
1/3 cup
Frozen Blueberries
recipe:
Add the coconut milk, cauliflower rice, coconut, and blueberries to a small pot over medium heat. Bring to a simmer and cook for four to five minutes or until some of the liquid has evaporated and the cauliflower rice has softened.
Add to a bowl, serve, and enjoy!

name: Twice Baked Potato Casserole
ingredients:
4
Russet Potato (large)
6 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
1/3 cup
Parsley (chopped, plus more for garnish)
6 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (grated)
1 1/2 cups
Plain Greek Yogurt

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Butter (melted)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC). Pierce each potato multiple times with a sharp knife or fork.
Place the potatoes on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until cooked through and very tender. Cool completely. Keep the oven on.
Remove the skin of the potatoes and shred them. Place them into a large mixing bowl.
Add the green onions, parsley, cheddar, and yogurt, to the same bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Mix gently to combine without over-mixing.
Transfer the potato mixture to a casserole dish. Brush the top with butter and bake in the oven for about 30 minutes or until starting to brown on top.
Garnish with fresh herbs if desired, and enjoy!

name: Savory Mushroom, Broccoli & Nori Oatmeal
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4
Yellow Onion (large, chopped)
1/2 cup
Mushrooms (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Broccoli (cut into small florets)
1/4
Sweet Potato (Japanese, large, peeled, diced)
1/2 cup
Steel Cut Oats (uncooked)
3 cups
Vegetable Broth (plus more as needed)
1 1/2 tsps
Coconut Aminos
2
Nori Sheets (snack size, chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onions and mushrooms and cook for three to five minutes or until softened. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the broccoli, sweet potatoes, and oats. Stir and cook for one minute.
Add the broth and bring the mixture to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low, cover, and continue to cook for an additional 25 to 30 minutes, stirring frequently. Add broth as needed.
Stir in the coconut aminos and serve the oatmeal garnished with nori. Enjoy!

name: Celery Root & Parsnip Parmesan Casserole
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Celery Root (peeled, chopped)
4
Parsnip (large, peeled and chopped)
2 tbsps
Butter
1
Garlic (clove, large, minced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Grease a baking dish.
Add the celery root and parsnips to a large pot and cover in water. Bring to a boil and cook for ten minutes or until fork-tender. Drain and mash with the butter, garlic, and salt.
Add the mash to the baking dish and sprinkle the cheese on top. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until the cheese starts turning golden brown. Serve and enjoy!

name: Maple Hazelnut Carrots
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Garlic (clove, small, minced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
4
Carrot (large, chopped)
1/3 cup
Hazelnuts
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, mix the oil, garlic, salt, and maple syrup together. Toss with the carrots. Spread the carrots out on the baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes or until soft and browned.
In the final two minutes of cooking, add the hazelnuts to a baking sheet and toast. Remove, coarsely chop, and serve over the carrots. Enjoy!

name: Apple Cinnamon Cookies
ingredients:
1/2
Apple (large, grated)
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Applesauce
1/3 cup
Maple Syrup
3 tbsps
Coconut Oil (melted)
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 1/2 cups
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1 1/2 tsps
Cinnamon (plus more for on top)
1 tsp
Baking Powder
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Add the grated apple, applesauce, maple syrup, coconut oil, and vanilla extract to a mixing bowl. Mix to combine.
Using a spatula, mix in the flour, cinnamon, baking powder, and sea salt until well combined and a batter starts to form. Cover and chill in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Scoop about two tablespoons of dough per cookie and form into a ball. Place on the baking sheet and slightly flatten, leaving space between cookies.
Bake for eight to ten minutes. Let the cookies cool for five minutes before transferring them to a cooling rack for another five minutes. Sprinkle some cinnamon onto each cookie and enjoy!

name: Parmesan & Parsley Whole Roasted Cauliflower
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tbsps
Dijon Mustard (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 head
Cauliflower (large, leaves removed)
2 tbsps
Parsley (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
2 tbsps
Pumpkin Seeds (toasted, chopped)
recipe:
Place the rack at the bottom of the oven. Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, whisk together the oil, garlic, and 3/4 of the mustard. Season with salt and pepper. Rub the cauliflower with the mixture.
Roast the cauliflower until charred and tender, about 45 to 50 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine the parsley, parmesan, and pumpkin seeds in a small bowl.
Brush the cauliflower with the remaining mustard and sprinkle with the parmesan mixture. Slice into pieces, serve, and enjoy!

name: Roasted Maple Mustard Carrots & Parsnips
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Dijon Mustard
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1
Garlic (clove, large, minced)
4
Carrot (chopped)
4
Parsnip (chopped)
1 tsp
Rosemary (fresh)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix the oil, mustard, maple syrup, salt, and garlic together in a large bowl. Add the carrots and parsnips and toss to coat. Spread the vegetables onto the prepared baking sheet and cook for 25 minutes in the oven, tossing halfway through. The veggies should be browned and caramelized.
Garnish with the rosemary and enjoy!

name: Cucumber & Labneh Bites
ingredients:
1
Cucumber (large, thickly sliced on the bias)
1/2 cup
Labneh
1/3 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives (halved)
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves
1 tbsp
Za'atar Spice
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
recipe:
Lay the cucumber slices on a serving platter. Spread each slice with labneh and top with an olive half and a mint leave.
Season with zaatar, drizzle with oil, and enjoy!

name: Raspberry Jam & Brie Pastry Bites
ingredients:
1/8 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
1/4 oz
Unbleached All Purpose Flour (for dusting)
8 ozs
Puff Pastry (thawed)
1/4 cup
Raspberry Jam
12 ozs
Brie Cheese (chopped into bite-sized pieces)
2 tbsps
Rosemary (fresh)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and lightly spray a muffin tray with oil.
Use the flour to lightly dust a flat surface. Roll out the puff pastry into a rectangle about 1/2 inch (13 mm) thick. Use a sharp knife or a pizza cutter and cut the puff pastry into 2 1/2 inch (6 cm) squares.
Press each square into a muffin tin. Then top with raspberry jam, brie, and rosemary.
Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato, Black Bean & Ranch Rice Bowl
ingredients:
1 cup
Basmati Rice (dry, rinsed)
2
Sweet Potato (medium, peeled, chopped)
2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, sliced)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
1
Lime (juiced, plus more for garnish)
2 cups
Corn
2 cups
Black Beans (cooked)
1/2 cup
Vegan Ranch Dressing
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cook the rice according to the package directions. While the rice cooks, add the sweet potato and bell peppers to the baking sheet. Drizzle with the oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat. Spread out into an even layer. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the vegetables are fork-tender.
Mix the cilantro and lime juice into the cooked rice.
To assemble, evenly divide the sweet potatoes, bell peppers, rice, corn, and black beans into bowls. Top each with ranch dressing. Enjoy!

name: Orange & Pomegranate Steel Cut Oats
ingredients:
1 cup
Steel Cut Oats
2 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk (plus more when serving)
1 cup
Water
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2
Navel Orange (juiced, zested)
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/2 cup
Pomegranate Seeds
recipe:
Add the oats, milk, water, and salt to a saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, depending on how crunchy you like your oats. When everything starts to thicken, stir in the orange juice, orange zest, and maple syrup.
Remove from the heat and stir in the pomegranate seeds. Divide into bowls and add a splash of milk to each bowl. Enjoy!

name: Edamame & Tahini on Toast
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Frozen Edamame
1 1/2 tbsps
Tahini
2 tbsps
Water
1/2
Lemon (juiced, zested)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 slices
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
2 tbsps
Cilantro
1/2 oz
Pickled Red Onions
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
Add the edamame, tahini, water, lemon juice, lemon zest, salt, and pepper to a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth, adding more water if the mixture seems too dry. Adjust the seasoning to your taste.
Spread the edamame mixture over the toasted bread. Top with cilantro and pickled red onion. Sprinkle some chili flakes on top and enjoy!

name: Raspberry Leaf Tea
ingredients:
1 cup
Raspberry Leaf Tea (steeped)
recipe: Add the steeped tea to a mug and enjoy!

name: Blueberry & Dark Chocolate Overnight Oats
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
2/3 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1/2 cup
Oats (rolled)
1/16 tsp
Sea Salt
2/3 cup
Blueberries (chopped)
1 oz
Dark Chocolate (chopped)
recipe:
Whisk the yogurt, maple syrup, and milk together in a bowl.
Add the remaining ingredients with the option of keeping 1/4 of each the blueberries and dark chocolate for garnish. Stir together until combined.
Divide the mixture evenly between jars. Top with the remaining blueberries and chocolate (if reserved). Cover and place in the fridge overnight, or for at least eight hours. Enjoy!

name: Quinoa, Lentil & Kale Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1 cup
Broccoli (chopped into small florets)
2 cups
Kale Leaves (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1/2 tsp
Dijon Mustard

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Lentils (cooked)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)
2 tbsps
Pumpkin Seeds (toasted)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Set aside.
Meanwhile, set the broccoli and the kale in a steamer basket over boiling water and cover. Steam for about five minutes or until tender. Set aside.
Whisk together the oil, lemon juice, and mustard. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside.
Place the quinoa, lentils, broccoli, kale, dill, and pumpkin seeds in a large bowl. Add the dressing and mix to coat.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Dark Chocolate, Blueberry & Walnut Cups
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil
8 ozs
Dark Chocolate (coarsely chopped)
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1/2 cup
Blueberries
2 tbsps
Walnuts (finely chopped)
recipe:
Line a muffin tray with liners or use a silicone muffin tray.
In a saucepan over low heat, melt the coconut oil and chocolate, continuously stirring. Remove from the heat and stir in the chia seeds.
Divide the chocolate mixture between the muffin cups. Top each with equal amounts of blueberries and walnuts, gently pressing them into the chocolate.
Chill in the fridge for at least 30 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Curried Kale & Chickpeas with Rice
ingredients:
1 cup
Basmati Rice (dry, rinsed)
1
Yellow Onion (large, chopped)
4
Garlic (clove, chopped)
4 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped)
2 tbsps
Curry Powder
3 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
2 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/3 cup
Canned Coconut Milk (full fat)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Lime (juiced, optional for serving)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to package directions.
Meanwhile, in a pot, add the onion with a splash of water. Cook and stir over medium heat for about three minutes or until soft. Add the garlic, kale, curry powder, and 1/3 of the broth. Stir and cook for another five minutes.
Transfer the kale mixture to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour the mixture back to the same pot, along with the remaining broth, chickpeas, and coconut milk. Simmer on low heat for about 15 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Divide the chickpea curry and rice between bowls. Serve with lime juice if using and enjoy!

name: Overnight Oats with Berries & Walnuts
ingredients:
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1 1/4 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
3/4 cup
Blueberries
3/4 cup
Strawberries (quartered)
1/3 cup
Walnuts (roughly chopped)
recipe:
In a large bowl or container combine the oats, chia seeds, and milk. Stir to combine. Place in the fridge for eight hours, or overnight.
Divide the oats evenly between bowls or containers and top with blueberries, strawberries, and chopped walnuts. Enjoy!

name: Orange Cranberry Sauce
ingredients:
2 cups
Frozen Cranberries
1
Navel Orange (large, juiced, zested)
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 cups
Water
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a small pot over high heat. Bring to a boil and then reduce the heat to a simmer and cover. Cook for 12 minutes.
Gently mash the cranberries with a wooden spoon. Put the cranberry sauce into a jar and let it cool on the counter before storing. Enjoy!

name: Lemony Arugula & White Bean Farfalle
ingredients:
6 ozs
Farfalle (dry)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
3 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated, plus extra shaved for garnish)
1 tbsp
Capers
1 cup
Cannellini Beans (cooked)
3/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
2 cups
Arugula
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to package directions.
Add the drained pasta back to the pot it was cooking in. Add the remaining ingredients and stir well to combine.
Serve, add more garnish if desired, and enjoy!

name: Broccoli & Mozzarella Quesadilla
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 cup
Broccoli (chopped into small florets)
1/4 tsp
Onion Powder
1/2 tsp
Paprika
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
2
Corn Tortilla (small)
2 ozs
Mozzarella Cheese (shredded)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a small cast iron pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the broccoli, onion powder, paprika, and salt. Sauté for three to five minutes or until the broccoli is bright green and starting to get crispy edges. Remove from the pan and set aside.
Wipe out the pan and return to medium heat. Add one tortilla to the pan and sprinkle the cheese on it. Add the broccoli and top it with the other tortilla. Press down on the quesadilla to flatten it. Cook for three to five minutes, flipping halfway, or until the quesadilla is browned on both sides and the cheese has melted. Slice, serve, and enjoy!

name: Spicy Tomato & Lentil Soup
ingredients:
4
Tomato (medium, chopped)
1/2
White Onion (large, chopped)
4
Garlic (clove)
1 tbsp
Tomato Paste
1 1/2 tsps
Smoked Paprika
1 1/2 tsps
Chili Flakes
1 cup
Dry Red Lentils (rinsed)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped, plus more for garnish)
1
Lime (juiced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 440ºF (225ºC) and line a baking sheet with foil. Add the tomatoes, onion, and garlic to the baking sheet. Bake in the oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until the vegetables are soft and lightly charred. Meanwhile, in a pot over medium heat, add the tomato paste, paprika, and chili flakes with a splash of water. Stir and cook for about two to three minutes. Add the lentils, stir, and cook for another two to three minutes.
Add the broth and bring to a simmer. Turn the heat to low, cover the pot with a lid, and simmer for about 20 minutes or until softened and cooked through. Add more broth if necessary.
Add the cooked tomatoes, onion, and garlic to the pot. Remove from the heat and blend with an immersion blender until smooth. Stir in the lime juice and adjust the seasoning to your taste. Divide into the serving bowls, top with parsley, and enjoy!

name: Sardines, Couscous & Red Pepper Sauce
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Couscous (uncooked)
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, chopped)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, large, chopped)
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 ozs
Sardines (drained)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the couscous according to the package directions.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the bell peppers and the onions and sauté for three to four minutes or until tender.
Add the garlic and paprika. Season with salt and pepper. Sauté for two more minutes. Let it cool slightly, and add the pan's contents to a blender or food processor to make the red pepper sauce. Blend until smooth.
Divide the red pepper sauce and the couscous onto plates. Top with the sardines and garnish with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Harissa Broccoli & Chickpea Farfalle
ingredients:
6 ozs
Farfalle (dry)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Leeks (medium, sliced)
1 1/2 cups
Broccoli (chopped into florets)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 1/2 tsps
Harissa
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to package directions.
Add the oil to a large pan over medium heat. Once heated, add the leek, broccoli, chickpeas, and harissa. Sauté until the leek has softened, about five minutes.
Add the cooked pasta to the pan and mix well. Serve and garnish with the cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Bell Pepper Couscous
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Couscous (uncooked)
1/2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (diced)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Cook the couscous according to the package directions.
Fluff the couscous using a fork. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well.
Adjust the seasoning to your taste and enjoy!

name: Cannellini Bean & Mozzarella Quesadilla
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Shallot (chopped)
1/2 cup
Cannellini Beans (cooked)
1/2 tsp
Chili Powder
2
Corn Tortilla (small)
2 ozs
Mozzarella Cheese (shredded)
1 tbsp
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a small pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the shallots, beans, and chili powder. Sauté for three minutes or until the shallots have softened. Remove from the pan.
Wipe out the pan and return to medium heat. Add one tortilla to the pan and sprinkle with cheese. Add the bean mixture and top it with the other tortilla. Press down on the quesadilla to flatten it.
Cook for three to five minutes, flipping halfway, or until the quesadilla is browned on both sides and the cheese has melted. Cut into quarters and garnish with cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Mackerel Salad with Peppers, Snap Peas & Blueberries
ingredients:
4 ozs
Canned Mackerel (plus some oil from the can)
1 stalk
Green Onion (chopped)
1/2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, sliced)
1/2 cup
Blueberries
1/2 cup
Snap Peas
recipe: In a bowl, mash the mackerel with the oil from the can, adding one teaspoon at a time to your desired consistency. Mix in the green onion. Add it to a plate with the bell pepper, blueberries, and snap peas. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Vegetables with Hummus
ingredients:
1
Carrot (large, sliced)
1 cup
Red Onion (thickly sliced)
1/4 head
Cauliflower (small, chopped into florets)
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
1 cup
Hummus
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Arrange the carrots, onions, and cauliflower on the prepared baking sheet.
Season with smoked paprika, salt, and drizzle with oil. Toss to coat.
Cook in the oven for 30 minutes, stirring halfway, until tender and browned. Drizzle the lime juice over the vegetables.
Place the vegetables on a bed of hummus and enjoy!

name: Chili Lime & Rosemary Roasted Nuts
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Lime (small, juiced)
2 tsps
Chili Powder
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
2 tbsps
Rosemary (fresh)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 cups
Almonds (raw, unsalted)
1 1/2 cups
Cashews (raw, unsalted)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 325°F (165°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, combine the oil, lime juice, chili powder, garlic powder, rosemary, and salt.
Add the nuts to the baking sheet and pour the chili lime mix on top. Toss to combine. Spread the nuts out into an even layer.
Cook in the oven for 13 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent burning. Remove from the oven and let the nuts cool for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve and enjoy!

name: Roasted Tomato & Ricotta Toast
ingredients:
2 cups
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Fennel Seed (crushed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Ricotta Cheese
3 1/2 ozs
Sourdough Bread (sliced, toasted)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC).
In a bowl, gently mix together the tomatoes, oil, and fennel seeds. Season with salt and pepper.
Place the tomatoes cut side down into a baking dish. Cook in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until wilted and starting to brown.
Spread the ricotta onto a slice of bread and season with salt and pepper. Top with the tomatoes. Enjoy!

name: Mackerel, Quinoa & Kale Salad
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1 tsp
Dijon Mustard
2 tsps
Apple Cider Vinegar
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper
1 1/2 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped)
4 ozs
Canned Mackerel (drained)
2 tsps
Fresh Dill (fresh, chopped)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to package directions.
Mix the mustard, vinegar, and oil together. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the quinoa, kale, and mackerel to a bowl. Garnish with the dill and serve the dressing on the side. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Roasted Lentils
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
3 cups
Water
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
recipe:
In a pot, add the lentils and water. Bring to a boil then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 20 to 22 minutes or until they are tender.
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Once the lentils are cooked, drain any excess water and rinse under cold water. Transfer them to a cutting board lined with paper towel. Carefully pat the lentils dry until most of the water is absorbed.
Transfer the lentils to the baking sheet and toss with oil, salt, and garlic powder.
Bake for 12 minutes. Remove, shake the pan, and return to the oven for nine to 11 minutes more or until crispy. Enjoy!

name: Nori Mackerel & Carrot Wraps
ingredients:
1
Carrot (small, julienned)
4 ozs
Canned Mackerel (drained)
1
Nori Sheets (quartered)
recipe: Divide the carrot and mackerel between the nori sheets. Fold and roll each nori sheet into a hand roll, cone shape. Enjoy!

name: Mashed Potatoes & Cauliflower
ingredients:
3
Yellow Potato (large, halved, peeled)
1 head
Cauliflower (medium, chopped into florets)
1/2 cup
Cow's Milk, Reduced Fat (divided)
3 tbsps
Butter (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tsps
Rosemary (fresh, chopped)
recipe:
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Carefully add the potatoes and cook for 20 to 25 minutes or until cooked through. With ten minutes remaining, add the cauliflower. Drain and let cool slightly. Empty the water from the pot. Transfer the steamed cauliflower to a food processor or blender. Add 1/4 of the milk and 1/3 of the butter and blend until desired texture.
Use a ricer or a potato masher to mash the potatoes into the empty pot. Turn the heat on to low and pour in the remaining milk and butter. Stir to incorporate and add the cauliflower to the potatoes. Season with salt and pepper and add the rosemary.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Guacamole & Banana Pepper Toast
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Guacamole
1 3/4 ozs
Sourdough Bread (toasted)
1 oz
Pickled Banana Peppers (hot)
recipe: Spread the guacamole onto the toasted bread and top with pickled banana peppers. Enjoy!

name: Saffron Cauliflower Soup
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
1 head
Cauliflower (medium, sliced into florets)
2
Garlic (clove, sliced)
3 cups
Vegetable Broth
1/4 tsp
Saffron (ground)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Plain Greek Yogurt
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cauliflower. Sauté for about five minutes or until browned. Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the broth, saffron, salt, and pepper to the pot. Bring to a simmer and cover the pot with a lid. Turn the heat down to low and simmer for about 20 minutes or until the cauliflower is soft.
Remove the pot from heat. Use a hand blender and blend the soup until smooth. Adjust the seasoning to your taste. Divide the soup evenly between bowls. Top each soup bowl with a tablespoon of Greek yogurt. Garnish with parsley and enjoy!

name: Thai Curry Carrot Soup
ingredients:
4 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium (divided, plus more as needed)
4
Carrot (large, chopped)
1
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
1 tbsp
Thai Red Curry Paste
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (optional)
1
Lime (juiced)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Add a splash of broth to a large pot over medium heat. Add the carrots and the onions and cook for five to seven minutes, stirring regularly.
Add the remaining broth and the curry paste to the pot, stirring constantly. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until the carrots are tender.
Blend until smooth. Adjust the consistency with more broth as needed. Add salt, if desired.
Divide into bowls. Top with lime juice and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Seared Scallops with Spicy Caper Sauce
ingredients:
8 ozs
Scallops

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tsps
Avocado Oil
1 tbsp
Butter
1 tbsp
Capers
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
1 tsp
Lemon Juice
1 tbsp
Parsley (finely chopped)
recipe:
Place the scallops on a plate lined with paper towel and pat them very dry. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat a pan over medium heat and add the oil. Once hot, place the scallops in the pan and cook for about two to three minutes or until seared on one side and browned. Flip and cook for one minute longer and then transfer to a plate.
Remove the pan from the heat and reduce the heat to medium-low. Allow the pan to cool for a minute or so. Return the pan to the heat and add the butter, capers, and chili flakes. Stir often until the butter has browned lightly and smells nutty, about three to four minutes.
Add the lemon juice to the pan and stir. Pour over the scallops and garnish with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Tulsi Tea
ingredients:
1/8 oz
Tulsi Tea (in a tea bag)
1 cup
Water (hot)
recipe: Steep the tea for five minutes. Enjoy!

name: Twice Baked Potatoes
ingredients:
2
Russet Potato (medium)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded, divided)
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
3 tbsps
Cow's Milk, Whole
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Onion Powder
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Pierce the potatoes with a fork in a few spots then rub the oil all over them. Season with salt and pepper. Place them on the baking sheet. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until cooked through and fork tender.
Let the potatoes cool for about 10 minutes before cutting them in half lengthwise. Scoop out the center of the potatoes, leaving some inside to keep the potato intact. This will create a shell.
To the bowl, add half of the cheese, yogurt, milk, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Mix to combine and mash with a fork until smooth. Add another splash of milk if needed.
Evenly divide the mashed potato mixture into each shell and top each with the remaining cheese. Place back into the oven for 10 to 15 minutes or until the cheese has melted and browned on top.
Divide onto plates and top with onions. Enjoy!

name: Whipped Feta Sweet Potato Rounds
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Feta Cheese
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
2
Sweet Potato (large)
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1 cup
Walnuts (chopped)
1 cup
Pomegranate Seeds
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a food processor, add the feta, yogurt, lemon juice, and honey. Pulse until smooth. Refrigerate until the potatoes are ready.
Cut the sweet potatoes into 1/2-inch (1 cm) rounds and place in a bowl. Add the oil, cinnamon, and salt. Toss to combine. Spread the rounds out on the baking sheet into an even layer. Bake for about 25 to 30 minutes, flipping halfway through, or until fork tender.
Evenly divide the whipped feta, chopped nuts, and pomegranate seeds onto the rounds. Enjoy!

name: Cranberry Tahini Coleslaw
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Tahini
2 tbsps
Water
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1 1/2 tsps
Maple Syrup

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Coleslaw Mix
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
1/3 cup
Dried Unsweetened Cranberries
recipe:
In a large bowl, whisk together the tahini, water, lemon juice, and maple syrup. Season the dressing with salt and pepper.
Add the coleslaw mix, parsley, and cranberries to the bowl. Toss everything together and enjoy!

name: Kale & Potato Soup
ingredients:
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
2
Garlic (clove, chopped)
1 1/2 tsps
Turmeric (ground)
2 cups
Mini Potatoes (halved)
2 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped)
1/3 cup
Canned Coconut Milk (full fat)
recipe:
Heat a large pot over medium heat. Once hot, add the onion with a splash of water. Cook and stir occasionally for about two minutes. Add the garlic, turmeric, and potatoes. Stir and cook for another two to three minutes.
Add the broth, salt, and pepper. Cover the pot with a lid and simmer over low heat for about 20 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked.
Uncover the pot. Add the kale leaves and coconut milk and simmer for another five minutes. Adjust the seasoning to your taste and enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Freezer Fudge
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Cashew Butter (runny, drippy)
1/3 cup
Coconut Oil (melted)
1/2 cup
Pureed Pumpkin
1/3 cup
Raw Honey
1 tsp
Pumpkin Pie Spice
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Line a loaf pan with parchment paper going in both directions.
In a large bowl, combine the cashew butter, coconut oil, pumpkin, honey, pumpkin pie spice, and salt. Mix very well with a spatula until smooth.
Stir in the chocolate chips and then pour into the prepared loaf pan. Transfer to the freezer for four hours (or overnight).
Remove the fudge and slice into squares. Enjoy!

name: Herb Crusted Haddock
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)
2 tbsps
Bread Crumbs
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced, zested)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2
Haddock Fillet
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix together parsley, dill, bread crumbs, garlic, lemon juice, and lemon zest. Season the mixture with salt and pepper.
Place the haddock fillets on the baking sheet and spoon the herb mixture on top of the haddock. Gently press it down. Bake the haddock for 10 to 12 minutes or until cooked through. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato Rosemary Gratin
ingredients:
1 cup
Whipping Cream
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1 tbsp
Rosemary (fresh, chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 1/2 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)
2
Sweet Potato (medium, thinly sliced)
1 tbsp
Parmigiano Reggiano
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC) and lightly grease a casserole dish.
In a large bowl, stir together the cream, garlic powder, rosemary, salt, pepper, and cheddar cheese. Add the sweet potato slices and toss to coat well.
Arrange the potato slices into the casserole dish and pour the cream mixture over top. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and bake in the oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until cooked through.
Remove from the oven, let cool for 10 minutes before serving and enjoy!

name: Everything Bagel Seasoned Green Beans
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
4 cups
Green Beans (trimmed)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tbsps
Everything Bagel Seasoning
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the beans and sauté for three to five minutes. Add the minced garlic and sauté for another one to two minutes.
Sprinkle the everything bagel seasoning all over and use tongs to coat the beans. Sauté for another two minutes or until the beans are tender-crisp or cooked to your liking.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Hazelnut & Pomegranate White Chocolate Bark
ingredients:
1 cup
White Chocolate Chips
1/4 cup
Pomegranate Seeds
2 tbsps
Hazelnuts (chopped)
recipe:
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set it aside.
Fill a pot with water and place a heat safe bowl on top. Bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer. Make sure no water is able to get into the bowl.
Add the chocolate to the bowl. Use a spatula and stir continuously until chocolate has melted. Pour the melted chocolate onto the baking sheet. Smooth the chocolate with a spatula into an even layer, about 1/4-inch (6 mm) thick.
Sprinkle the pomegranate and hazelnuts on top. Transfer to freezer for 30 minutes or until firm.
Break the chocolate before serving and enjoy!

name: Miso Cabbage, Collards & Lentil Soup
ingredients:
4 cups
Water
1 1/2 tbsps
Miso Paste
1 tbsp
Coconut Aminos
2
Garlic (clove, small, chopped)
1/2 cup
Dry Red Lentils (rinsed, drained)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1 1/2 cups
Collard Greens (sliced)
2 cups
Purple Cabbage (shredded)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Add the water to a large pot and bring to a boil. Add the miso paste and whisk well to incorporate. Reduce to a simmer.
Add the coconut aminos, garlic, and lentils. Cover and cook for 20 minutes.
Add the lemon juice, collard greens, cabbage, salt, and pepper. Continue to cook for longer if you'd prefer softer vegetables. Serve and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Almond Truffles
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Canned Coconut Milk (full fat)
7 ozs
Dark Chocolate (chopped)
1 tbsp
Butter
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Almonds (finely chopped)
recipe:
Heat the coconut milk in a small pot over medium-low until just simmering, stirring often.
Add the chocolate, butter, and salt and turn the heat off. Stir with a spatula until the chocolate has melted and the mixture is completely smooth.
Pour into a bowl and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Transfer to the fridge to harden overnight or for at least four hours.
Place the almonds on a plate.
Remove the truffle mixture and scoop about two tablespoons and form into balls, working quickly before they soften. Roll into the almonds. Place them in a container and store them in the fridge.
Leave them out for a few minutes prior to serving. Enjoy!

name: Mixed Berry Quinoa Porridge
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1 1/2 cups
Water
2 tbsps
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
1 cup
Frozen Raspberries
1/2 cup
Frozen Strawberries
recipe:
In a small pot, add the quinoa and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cover. Cook for 20 minutes. Remove the pot from the burner and add the coconut yogurt. Stir to combine. Add the fruit on top, cover, and let it rest for five minutes.
Divide the quinoa porridge between bowls and enjoy!

name: One Pan Curried Chickpeas, Broccoli & Cabbage
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Vegetable Broth
1/4 cup
Shallot (chopped)
2 cups
Broccoli (chopped in florets)
2 cups
Green Cabbage (sliced)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Crushed Tomatoes (from the can)
2 tsps
Garam Masala
1 tsp
Curry Powder
1 tsp
Nigella Seeds
recipe:
Add the broth to a large pan over medium heat. Bring to a simmer and add the shallots, broccoli, and cabbage. Cook for two minutes.
Add the chickpeas, salt, tomatoes, garam masala, and curry powder. Mix well and cook for about five minutes or until the broccoli is bright green and the cabbage has softened.
Garnish with the nigella seeds and serve. Enjoy!

name: Sea Salt Dark Chocolate Cashews
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
3/4 cup
Cashews (raw, unsalted)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Line a small baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add water to a double boiler. Alternatively, fill a small pot halfway with water and place a heat-safe bowl on top. Bring the water to a boil and add the chocolate chips to the bowl. Melt the chocolate, stirring often.
Remove the pot from the burner and keep the bowl on the pot to keep the chocolate warm. Dip the cashews in the chocolate and use two forks to take each cashew out, being sure to tap them a few times before placing on the parchment paper.
Sprinkle the flaky salt on top and freeze for 10 minutes to set. Enjoy!

name: Tahini Cookie Dough Freezer Fudge
ingredients:
1 cup
Tahini
3 tbsps
Coconut Oil (melted)
1/4 cup
Raw Honey
2 tsps
Vanilla Extract
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Line a loaf pan with parchment paper going in both directions.
In a large bowl combine the tahini, coconut oil, honey, vanilla, and salt. Mix until very smooth.
Stir in the chocolate chips and then pour into the prepared loaf pan. Transfer to the freezer for four hours (or overnight).
Remove the fudge and slice into squares. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Chickpeas, Cabbage & Parsnips
ingredients:
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
3 cups
Purple Cabbage (sliced)
2
Parsnip (sliced)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Shawarma Spice Blend
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, toss the chickpeas, cabbage, and parsnips with oil and the shawarma spice blend. Spread out on the baking sheet and cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until the chickpeas are crispy and the vegetables start to brown on the edges.
Season with the salt and garnish with the parsley. Enjoy!

name: Shaved Brussels Sprouts & Kale Salad
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Orange Juice (freshly squeezed)
2 tsps
White Wine Vinegar
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1/2 tsp
Dijon Mustard

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 cups
Brussels Sprouts (shaved)
2 cups
Kale Leaves (finely chopped)
2
Navel Orange (small, segmented)
3/4 cup
Pomegranate Seeds
1/2 cup
Pecans (chopped)
recipe:
In a jar with a lid, add the oil, orange juice, vinegar, honey, dijon, salt, and pepper. Close the lid tightly and shake well until combined and emulsified.
In a large bowl, add the Brussels spouts and kale. Add a splash of the dressing and massage with your hands to soften the Brussels sprouts and kale. Add the orange pieces, pomegranate seeds, and pecans.
Add the remaining dressing all over and toss to combine. Enjoy!

name: Mushroom Miso Gravy
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Shallot (minced)
1
Garlic (clove, small, minced)
4
Cremini Mushrooms (finely chopped)
1 tsp
Balsamic Vinegar
1 tbsp
Miso Paste
1 cup
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 tsp
Tapioca Flour
1/4 cup
Water
recipe:
In a pan over medium heat, add the oil, shallots, garlic, and mushrooms. Sauté for three to five minutes or until everything is fragrant and has softened.
Deglaze the pan with the vinegar. Add the miso paste and broth and increase the heat to a simmer. Mix well, being sure to break up and dissolve the miso paste. Season with salt and pepper.
Make a slurry with the tapioca flour and water. Add this to the mushroom mixture, stirring well until it thickens. Enjoy!

name: Tofu with Green Lentils
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
3 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth (plus more as needed)
2 tsps
Herbes De Provence
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1
Yellow Onion (large, sliced)
16 ozs
Tofu (cut into cubes)
1 tbsp
Tamari
recipe:
Place the lentils in a large pot and cover completely with the broth. Add more broth as needed. Add the Herbes de Provence and cook over low heat for 35 to 40 minutes or until tender.
Meanwhile, add half of the oil to a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for six to eight minutes or until softened and starting to brown. Set aside.
Add the remaining oil to the pan and cook the tofu over medium-high heat for two to three minutes or until browned. Add the tamari and scrape the bottom with a spatula.
Once the lentils are cooked, stir in the onions. Divide the lentils onto plates and arrange the tofu on top. Enjoy!

name: Cabbage, Edamame & Halloumi Salad
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Rice Vinegar
3 tbsps
Sesame Oil (divided)
1 tsp
Raw Honey

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Purple Cabbage (finely sliced)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
1 stalk
Green Onion (chopped)
1 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
4 ozs
Halloumi (sliced)
1 tsp
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
recipe:
In a large bowl, mix together the vinegar, 2/3 of the oil, and honey. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the cabbage, cilantro, green onions, and edamame. Toss to coat and let it sit for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Meanwhile, pat dry the cheese slices with paper towels. Heat the remaining oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the cheese and cook for one to two minutes on each side or until browned.
Divide the cabbage mixture onto plates and top with cheese slices. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Lemony Chickpeas & Fennel
ingredients:
2 bulbs
Fennel (small, sliced, fronds set aside for garnish)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/4 cup
Shallot (sliced)
1
Lemon (small, half juiced, half sliced)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the fennel, chickpeas, and shallots on the baking sheet. Add the lemon juice to a small bowl with the oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and pour it over the ingredients. Use your hands to gently mix the oil mixture with the fennel, chickpeas, and shallots. Add the remaining lemon slices to the baking sheet. Place the baking sheet in the oven and cook for 25 minutes or until the fennel is lightly browned and the chickpeas are crispy.
Garnish with the fennel fronds and enjoy!

name: Balsamic Mushroom & Avocado Toast
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2
Cremini Mushrooms (sliced)
1
Garlic (clove, small, sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 tsps
Balsamic Vinegar
1/2
Avocado (small, sliced)
1 3/4 ozs
Sourdough Bread (toasted)
recipe:
Heat a pan over medium heat. Add the oil, mushrooms, garlic, salt, and pepper. Sauté for three to five minutes, or until the mushrooms have softened and started to brown.
Add the balsamic vinegar to the pan and toss well to coat the mushrooms. Set aside.
Add the avocado to the sourdough and put the mushrooms on top. Enjoy!

name: Blueberries & Walnuts
ingredients:
1 cup
Blueberries
1/4 cup
Walnuts
recipe: Add the blueberries and walnuts to a plate or bowl and enjoy!

name: Chia & Hemp Seed Banana
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1 tbsp
Hemp Seeds
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
1
Banana (large, peeled)
recipe:
In a small bowl, mix together the chia seeds and hemp seeds. Pour onto a plate.
Spread the honey onto one side of the banana then put the honey side down on top of the seed mix. Gently roll side to side until the banana is coated.
Slice, plate and enjoy!

name: Slow Cooker Spiced Carrot & Lentil Soup
ingredients:
8
Carrot (medium, diced)
2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
2 stalks
Celery (diced)
1 cup
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
1 1/2 tsps
Ginger (fresh, minced)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tsps
Curry Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
8 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1/3 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Add the carrots, onions, celery, lentils, ginger, garlic, and curry powder to the slow cooker. Season with salt and pepper, and add the broth.
Cover and cook for six hours on high or eight hours on low.
Before serving, take 1/3 of the soup and blend it until smooth. Pour the blended back into the slow cooker. Alternatively, blend some of the soup right in the slow cooker with an immersion blender. Stir in the cilantro before serving. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Sesame Edamame
ingredients:
3 cups
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1 tbsp
Sesame Oil (divided)
1 tbsp
Sesame Seeds
1 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, combine the edamame, oil, sesame seeds, and salt. Spread the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Carrot & Feta Salad
ingredients:
2
Carrot (large, peeled and roughly chopped)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 tbsps
Tahini
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
3 cups
Mixed Greens
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (cubed)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the carrots on the baking sheet. Toss with oil and season with salt and pepper. Bake in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until cooked through and browned, shaking halfway through.
Meanwhile, in a bowl whisk together the tahini, honey, and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper. Whisk and add a splash of water if the dressing seems too thick.
Place the mixed greens into the serving plate. Top with roasted carrots and feta cheese. Drizzle with tahini dressing and enjoy!

name: Strawberries & Almonds
ingredients:
1 cup
Strawberries
1/4 cup
Almonds
recipe: Add the strawberries and almonds to a plate or bowl and enjoy!

name: Moroccan Spiced Quinoa Carrot Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1/3 cup
Shallot (finely chopped)
1/2 tsp
Moroccan Spice Blend
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1
Carrot (large, grated)
2 tbsps
Pitted Dates (finely chopped)
1 cup
Baby Spinach (chopped)
2 tbsps
Sunflower Seeds (toasted)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the oil, lemon juice, shallots, and Moroccan spice blend.
Add the remaining ingredients and the cooked quinoa to the same bowl. Mix to coat.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Chickpea & Edamame Millet Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Millet (dry, rinsed)
1 cup
Frozen Edamame
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1
Garlic (clove, large, minced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (drained)
1/2 cup
Pickled Turnip (chopped)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe: Cook the millet according to the package directions. Place a steamer basket inside a large pot and fill just to the basket with water. Bring to a boil. Once boiling, add the edamame and steam for three minutes. In a large bowl, mix the oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, pepper, and maple syrup together. Add the chickpeas, pickled turnips, and parsley to the same large bowl and mix to combine. Add the millet and edamame and toss until well combined. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Protein Mug Cake
ingredients:
3 1/2 tbsps
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
2 tbsps
Chocolate Protein Powder
1 1/2 tbsps
Cocoa Powder
1 1/2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
1/2 tsp
Baking Powder
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 tbsp
Tahini
1 tbsp
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
In a mug whisk the flour, protein powder, cocoa powder, coconut sugar, baking powder, and salt. Add the milk and tahini. Stir well to combine until no flour remains. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Microwave for 90 seconds until the cake is spongy to the touch. Allow the cake to cool slightly and enjoy!

name: Feta, Cucumber & Haddock Quinoa Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1 tbsp
Tahini
1
Lemon (medium, juiced, divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2
Haddock Fillet
2 cups
Mixed Greens
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/4
Cucumber (medium, sliced)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk together the tahini, half of the lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Add a splash of water to the sauce if it seems too thick. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Season the haddock with salt and pepper and drizzle with the remaining lemon juice. Add the fish to the pan and cook for two to three minutes on each side or until cooked through.
Divide the quinoa, mixed greens, tomato, cucumber, and haddock evenly between plates or bowls. Top with feta cheese and tahini dressing. Enjoy!

name: Lebanese Lentils & Rice
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 cup
Red Onion (sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Basmati Rice (dry, rinsed)
1 1/2 tsps
Cumin
1 cup
Green Lentils (cooked)
1/2 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
recipe:
Heat half of the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and season with salt. Cook the onion for 20 to 25 minutes or until caramelized, stirring frequently.
Meanwhile, cook the rice according to the package directions.
Heat the remaining oil in a pot. Add the cumin and lentils. Stir and cook for about five minutes. Add the cooked rice, stir, and cook until warmed up. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide the lentil rice between plates. Top with caramelized onions and yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Tofu & Black Bean Tacos
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 1/2 tsps
Tamari
2 tsps
Taco Seasoning
6 ozs
Tofu (crumbled)
1 cup
Black Beans (cooked)
1/2 cup
Salsa
1 tbsp
Nutritional Yeast
1/4 cup
Guacamole
4
Corn Tortilla (warmed)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (finely chopped)
recipe:
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together half of the oil, tamari, and taco seasoning.
Add the tofu into the bowl, mix to coat.
Heat the remaining oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the tofu mixture and cook for five to seven minutes or until dry and the moisture has evaporated.
Add the beans, salsa, and nutritional yeast. Cook for about two minutes or until warmed through, and the salsa liquid has cooked off.
Spread the guacamole over warm tortillas. Top with the tofu mixture and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Quinoa & Black Bean Zucchini Boats
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
4
Zucchini (medium)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 cups
Black Beans (cooked)
1 cup
Salsa (plus more for topping)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions.
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut the zucchini down the middle lengthwise and scoop out the middle flesh from the center of each zucchini half. Discard the inner flesh. Brush oil on the bottom of each half and place them on the baking sheet, cut side up.
In a bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, black beans, and salsa.
Spoon the filling into each zucchini boat and top each with some extra salsa (optional). Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until the filling is browned and the zucchini is cooked to your liking. Divide onto plates and season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Tofu & Broccoli with Almond Sriracha Sauce
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Rice (dry, rinsed)
3 tbsps
Almond Butter
1/2 tsp
Ginger (fresh, minced)
2 tbsps
Tamari
1 tbsp
Sriracha
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
1 1/2 tbsps
Sesame Oil (divided)
3 cups
Broccoli (chopped into florets)
8 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, pressed, cubed)
1 stalk
Green Onion (sliced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cook the rice according to package directions.
In a bowl, whisk together the almond butter, ginger, tamari, sriracha, vinegar, and 1/3 of the oil.
Spread the broccoli and the tofu onto the prepared baking sheet. Drizzle with the remaining oil and toss gently. Arrange in a single layer.
Place the baking sheet in the oven and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the tofu and broccoli are crispy. Rotate the baking sheet halfway through.
Divide the rice, tofu, broccoli, and sauce evenly between bowls. Garnish with green onions. Enjoy!

name: Cabbage & Bean Soup
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (small, sliced)
2
Garlic (clove, chopped)
2 cups
Green Cabbage (sliced)
2 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
Lima Beans (cooked)
3 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add onion and sauté for about five minutes until soft. Add the garlic and cabbage and sauté for another five to seven minutes.
Add the broth, salt, and pepper. Cover the pot with a lid and simmer over low heat for about 20 minutes.
Add the beans and simmer covered for another 10 minutes. Just before serving, stir in the dill. Adjust the seasoning to your taste and enjoy!

name: Everything Bagel Crackers
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Brown Rice Flour
1/4 cup
Whole Flax Seeds
1/4 cup
Sunflower Seeds
1 tbsp
Everything Bagel Seasoning
1 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tsp
Black Pepper
1/3 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 cup
Water (warm)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, combine the flour, flax seeds, sunflower seeds, everything bagel seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Add the oil and water and mix until just combined.
Spread the mixture onto the parchment paper. Cover with a second piece of parchment paper. Using your hands, press and spread into as thin and even a layer as possible, covering all the bottom parchment paper. Remove the top piece of parchment paper.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden brown. Let cool. Crackers will crisp as they cool. Break into pieces and enjoy!

name: Roasted Carrot & Couscous Bowls
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Couscous (dry)
2
Carrot (medium, peeled, sliced on the bias)
1 cup
Radishes (chopped)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Paprika
2 cups
Mixed Greens
2 tsps
Balsamic Vinegar
recipe:
Cook the couscous according to the package directions. Set aside.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the carrots and radishes to the baking sheet and toss them with half of the oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Spread out into an even layer and cook for 20 to 25 minutes or until browned and fork tender, flipping halfway through.
