To assemble, divide the mixed greens, couscous, and roasted veggies into bowls. Drizzle the remaining oil and balsamic vinegar onto each bowl. Enjoy!

name: Lentil Souvlaki Flatbread with Tzatziki
ingredients:
4 pieces
Naan
1 1/2 cups
Lentils (cooked)
1 1/2 tsps
Greek Seasoning
1/4 cup
Fresh Dill (chopped)
1
Red Bell Pepper (large, chopped)
1/4 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives (chopped)
1 cup
Tzatziki
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the naan onto the baking sheet and bake in the oven for eight to 10 minutes or until the bread is crispy.
Meanwhile, place the lentils in a bowl and stir in the Greek seasoning, dill, bell peppers, and olives.
Spread the tzatziki on top of the naan bread. Top with the lentil mixture. Enjoy!

name: Pan Fried Tofu with Beans & Peppers
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Tamari
2 tbsps
Water
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Arrowroot Powder
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
10 ozs
Tofu (cut into slices)
1 tsp
Steak Spice Seasoning
1
Yellow Onion (large, diced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (large, diced)
4 cups
Green Beans (trimmed)
recipe:
In a bowl, whisk together the tamari, water, maple syrup, and arrowroot powder. Set aside.
Working in batches if needed, heat 2/3 of the oil in a large non-stick skillet over high heat. Once hot, add the tofu. Cook for three minutes then flip. Season with steak spice. Cook for another two minutes then set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and wipe the skillet clean. Add the remaining oil. Once hot, add the onions and bell peppers. Cook for three to four minutes or until golden. Add the green beans and continue to cook for two minutes or until tender-crisp. Divide the vegetables and tofu onto plates.
In the same skillet, bring the tamari mixture to a boil, constantly stirring, until thickened for one to two minutes. Pour over the tofu and vegetables. Enjoy!

name: Hashbrown Cups
ingredients:
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
1
Russet Potato (large, grated)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (grated)
1 oz
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC) and lightly spray the muffin tray with avocado oil spray. Transfer the potatoes and onions to a clean kitchen towel or a piece of cheesecloth. Squeeze as much liquid as possible from the grated vegetables.
Add the flour and garlic powder, stir well and season with salt and pepper. Spoon the mixture evenly into each muffin cup. Transfer the muffin tray to the oven and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until cooked and golden brown.
Remove the hashbrowns from the tray and enjoy!

name: One Pot Chickpea Pasta Fagioli
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (small, diced)
3
Garlic (clove, finely chopped)
2
Carrot (medium, diced)
2 cups
Tomato Sauce
1 1/2 tsps
Italian Seasoning
6 cups
Vegetable Broth
8 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (dry)
2 cups
Cannellini Beans (cooked)
1/3 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté the onions, garlic, and carrots for three to five minutes or until the onions are translucent.
Add the tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, and broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and the beans. Bring to a boil and cook uncovered for four to six minutes or until the pasta is just al dente. The pasta will continue cooking in the broth.
Divide evenly between bowls and garnish with parmesan cheese. Enjoy!

name: Beet, Fennel & Carrot Slaw
ingredients:
2 cups
Green Cabbage (thinly sliced)
1/2 bulb
Fennel (medium, thinly sliced)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Beet (medium, peeled, thinly sliced)
1
Carrot (medium, peeled, thinly sliced)
1
Apple (small, thinly sliced)
1/2 cup
Radishes (medium, thinly sliced)
1/2 cup
Parsley (chopped)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
recipe:
Add the cabbage and fennel to a large bowl. Add half of the oil and season with salt. Massage with hands to soften the vegetables.
Add the beets, carrots, apples, radishes, and parsley to the bowl. Add the remaining oil and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Enjoy!

name: Chai & Pomegranate Overnight Oats
ingredients:
1 cup
Cow's Milk, Whole
1/2 cup
Chai Tea (steeped)
1 1/2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1/4 cup
Chia Seeds
1/2 cup
Oats (rolled)
1/2 cup
Pomegranate Seeds
recipe:
In a bowl, whisk together the milk, tea, and maple syrup. Add the chia seeds and oats. Stir to combine. Cover the container with a lid and refrigerate overnight.
Serve with pomegranate seeds and enjoy!

name: Lemon Ricotta Pasta
ingredients:
1 cup
Brown Rice Penne (dry)
1/3 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
2/3 cup
Ricotta Cheese
2 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2
Lemon (juiced, zested)
1 tsp
Chili Flakes

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to package directions. Once done, drain reserving some of the pasta water.
In a pot over medium heat, add the ricotta, parmesan cheese, garlic, lemon juice, and lemon zest. Add the pasta along with the reserved pasta water.
Stir well, add the chili flakes, and season with salt and pepper. Cook for about five minutes. Adjust the seasoning to your taste and enjoy!

name: Zucchini Coconut Soup
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (large, chopped)
2
Zucchini (medium, sliced)
2
Garlic (clove, sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1/2 cup
Canned Coconut Milk (full fat)
1 stalk
Green Onion (sliced)
2 tbsps
Pumpkin Seeds
1/2
Lemon (juiced, for serving)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add in the onion and sauté for about five minutes or until soft. Add the zucchini and sauté for another five minutes.
Add the garlic, salt, and pepper. Stir and add the vegetable broth. Cover the pot with a lid, turn the heat low, and simmer for about 15 minutes.
Use a hand blender and blend the soup until smooth. Alternatively, blend in a blender, making sure to vent for heat. Add the coconut milk and simmer for another five minutes. Taste and adjust the seasoning to your taste.
Divide the soup between serving bowls. Garnish with green onion and pumpkin seeds. Drizzle with lemon juice and enjoy!

name: Feta Strawberry Skewers
ingredients:
1 cup
Arugula
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (cubed)
2/3 cup
Strawberries
recipe: Take a toothpick and thread the arugula, feta cheese and strawberry one at a time. Repeat until each toothpick is full. Serve and enjoy!

name: Beet & Quinoa Salad
ingredients:
3
Beet (medium, peeled)
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
3 tbsps
Balsamic Vinaigrette
3 stalks
Celery (chopped, with leaves)
2 stalks
Green Onion (sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1/4 cup
Pumpkin Seeds (toasted)
recipe:
Add the beets to a large pot. Fill with water and bring to a boil. Cook for 25 minutes or until soft. Rinse in cold water before chopping.
Meanwhile, cook the quinoa according to the package directions.
In a bowl, add the vinaigrette, celery, and green onions. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the beets and quinoa to the bowl and gently mix to coat.
Divide into bowls. Garnish with feta cheese and pumpkin seeds. Enjoy!

name: Dark Chocolate Covered Fig Bites
ingredients:
1/2 oz
Freeze Dried Strawberries (optional)
1 1/2 cups
Dried Fig (chopped)
2 tbsps
Almonds (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Water
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil (melted)
1/2 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Line baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the dried strawberries to a small food processor and blend until the mixture is powdery. Set aside in a small bowl.
Blend the figs, almonds, and water in the food processor until it forms a sticky paste. Roll the mixture into small balls and place on the prepared baking sheet.
In a saucepan over low heat, melt the coconut oil and chocolate, continuously stirring.
Roll the fig balls in the melted chocolate until they are thoroughly coated, using two forks. Allow any excess chocolate to drip off before placing them back on the baking sheet.
Sprinkle all the balls with strawberry dust. Chill in the fridge for at least 30 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Raspberry Swirl Chocolate Fudge
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Raspberries
1 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
1/2 cup
All Natural Peanut Butter
recipe:
Line a loaf pan with parchment paper.
In a saucepan over medium heat, add the raspberries. Use a fork and smash the raspberries. Stir and bring to simmer. Simmer for about five minutes then remove from the heat and set aside.
Place a saucepan over medium heat and add water. Bring to a simmer. Turn the heat to low and place a heat-proof bowl on top. Make sure that the bowl doesn't touch the water.
Add the chocolate to the bowl. Stir frequently until the chocolate has melted. Add the peanut butter and stir until smooth.
Pour the chocolate mixture into the loaf pan. Spoon the mashed raspberries on top. Using a toothpick, gently swirl the raspberries into the chocolate mixture. Refrigerate for at least two hours. Cut into squares and enjoy!

name: One Pot Harissa Red Lentil & Carrot Soup
ingredients:
2 tsps
Coconut Oil
8
Carrot (large, chopped)
1
Yellow Onion (chopped)
4
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2 tsp
Cumin (ground)
1/2 tsp
Coriander (ground)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Harissa
1/2 cup
Dry Red Lentils (rinsed, drained)
4 cups
Water
recipe:
Heat a large Dutch oven or pot over medium heat and melt the oil. Add the carrots and onion and cook for about six minutes, until the onion is just starting to soften.
Add the garlic, cumin, coriander, salt, pepper, and harissa. Cook, stirring constantly until fragrant, about one minute.
Add the lentils and water and stir. Bring to a boil and then reduce the heat. Simmer, covered, for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the lentils are cooked through.
Uncover and use an immersion blender to blend until smooth. Alternatively, add to a blender and blend until smooth, making sure to vent for heat to escape. Serve and enjoy!

name: Cacio e Pepe
ingredients:
4 1/2 ozs
Whole Wheat Spaghetti
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Black Pepper (freshly ground)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2/3 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)
recipe:
Cook the spaghetti according to the package directions. Once done, drain and reserve some of the pasta water.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the pepper and cook for about a minute.
Add the pasta, salt, and reserved water. Stir and add the parmesan cheese slowly while stirring. Cook for a few minutes until a sauce forms, stirring frequently.
Divide the pasta between serving plates and enjoy!

name: Apple & Cranberry Smoothie
ingredients:
1
Apple (small, sweet, chopped)
1 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/2 cup
Frozen Cranberries
1/4 cup
Water
2 tsps
Ground Flax Seed
2 tsps
Raw Honey (optional)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Enjoy!

name: Sticky Tofu & Bell Pepper Stir Fry
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry, rinsed)
2 tbsps
Tamari
2 tsps
Rice Vinegar
1 1/2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
2 tbsps
Water
1 tbsp
Cornstarch (divided)
8 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, pressed, crumbled)
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil
1
Red Bell Pepper (medium, chopped)
1/2
Yellow Onion (large, cut in large chunks)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
In a small bowl, combine the tamari, vinegar, coconut sugar, water, and 1/4 of the cornstarch and whisk well.
In another bowl, toss the tofu with the remaining cornstarch until well coated.
Heat a large pan or wok to medium-high heat and add the oil. Once hot, add the tofu (working in batches if needed) and cook until crispy. Toss halfway through, about four to five minutes total. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add the pepper and onion and cook until just starting to brown around the edges, about two minutes, tossing often.
Pour in the sauce and toss to combine. Cook until thickened, about one minute. Add the tofu back in and gently toss to combine.
Divide the rice onto plates and top with the tofu mixture. Enjoy!

name: Sweet & Spicy Tofu Toast
ingredients:
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Hot Sauce

Sea Salt & Black Pepper
4 1/2 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, pressed, sliced thick)
1 slice
Bread (toasted)
1/4 cup
Baby Spinach
recipe:
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Mix the maple syrup, oil, hot sauce, salt, and pepper together. Brush the mixture on the tofu slices and sear them for two minutes on each side or until sear marks appear.
Brush any remaining hot sauce mixture onto the toast. Add the spinach and top with the tofu slices. Serve and enjoy!

name: Garlic Parmesan Beans & Chickpeas
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
Cannellini Beans (cooked)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2 cup
Vegetable Broth
1/2 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (plus more for garnish)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
3 cups
Baby Spinach
recipe:
In a large pan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the garlic and sauté for 30 seconds, stirring constantly. Add the tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Cook for three to four minutes or until they begin to soften.
Add the cannellini beans, chickpeas, and broth. Cook for three to four minutes, then stir in the cheese and lemon juice. Add more broth or water if needed.
Stir in the spinach and cook until it starts to wilt.
Divide into bowls and top with more cheese if desired. Enjoy!

name: Date & Feta Couscous Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Couscous (dry)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1/4 cup
Pitted Dates (finely chopped)
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
1 1/2 tsps
Lemon Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the couscous according to the package directions.
Once cooked, fluff the couscous using a fork. Add the feta, dates, parsley, and lemon juice.
Stir and season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Bell Pepper & Ricotta Toast
ingredients:
1
Orange Bell Pepper (medium)
1/2 cup
Ricotta Cheese
2 slices
Bread (toasted)
1 1/2 tsps
Lemon Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Parsley (for garnish)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 390ºF (200ºC). Place the bell pepper in the air fryer basket and cook for 15 minutes, or until soft. Flipping halfway through.
Transfer the bell pepper to a bowl and cover the bowl with plastic wrap. Let it sit for about 10 minutes.
Spread the ricotta over the toast and drizzle with lemon juice. Remove the bell pepper skin and thinly slice. Top the ricotta with the bell pepper.
Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with parsley and enjoy!

name: Fennel & Parmesan Bites
ingredients:
1 bulb
Fennel (medium, sliced into wedges, fronds chopped)
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (shaved)
1 1/2 tsps
Chili Flakes
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
1/2
Lemon (zested and juiced)
recipe:
Spread the fennel wedges out onto a plate. Top each with cheese, chili flakes, and sea salt.
Add the lemon zest then squeeze the lemon all over the fennel wedges. Top with fennel fronds. Enjoy!

name: Beans & Spinach Dip
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Cream Cheese, Regular
1/2
Lemon (juiced, zested)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
White Navy Beans (cooked)
1/3 cup
Frozen Spinach (thawed, drained)
2 ozs
Mozzarella Cheese (shredded, divided)
3 ozs
Whole Grain Crackers
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC).
In an oven-safe baking dish, mix together the cream cheese, lemon juice, lemon zest, garlic, salt, and pepper. Stir in the beans, spinach, and half of the mozzarella cheese.
Top the mixture with the remaining mozzarella. Bake in the oven for 17 to 20 minutes or until browned on top and bubbly.
Serve the dip warm with crackers and enjoy!

name: Nori Sesame Chips
ingredients:
4
Nori Sheets
1 1/2 tsps
Tamari
2 tsps
Sesame Oil
1 tbsp
Sesame Seeds
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 300ºF (150ºC) and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Add the sheets of nori to each baking sheet, placing the shiny side up. Leave space between each piece of nori.
In a small bowl, combine the tamari and sesame oil. Brush the mixture onto the nori sheets. Sprinkle the sesame seeds over the nori sheets.
Bake for eight to 12 minutes or until crisp. Once baked, cut each nori sheet into six pieces before serving. Enjoy!

name: Alfredo Stuffed Spaghetti Squash
ingredients:
1 cup
Cow's Milk, Whole
1 1/4 cups
Frozen Spinach (thawed, drained)
1 tbsp
Fresh Sage (chopped)
1 tbsp
Thyme (fresh)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
8 ozs
Mozzarella Cheese (shredded, divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2
Spaghetti Squash (small, halved lengthwise, seeds removed)
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC).
Mix the milk, spinach, sage, thyme, garlic, and 2/3 of the mozzarella in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper.
Season the squash with salt and pepper and place in a baking dish. Fill with the spinach mixture. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan. Cover with foil.
Bake the squash for 30 minutes. Remove the foil then bake for 20 minutes or until the squash is tender and the cheese is golden.
Use a fork to scrape the squash into strands and mix with the cheese. Enjoy!

name: Sun Dried Tomato & Sausage Linguine
ingredients:
4 1/16 ozs
Linguine
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
4 3/4 ozs
Turkey Sausage (chopped)
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
1/3 cup
Sun Dried Tomatoes (chopped)
2 cups
Marinara Sauce
2 cups
Baby Spinach
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to package directions.
Add the oil to a large pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the sausage and sauté until just browned but not cooked through. Remove from the pan.
Add the onion to the pan and sauté until translucent, about three minutes. Add the sun-dried tomatoes, marinara sauce, and sausage to the pan. Mix well, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom. Cook on low until the sausage is cooked through.
Add the baby spinach and pasta to the pan and mix well. Allow the residual heat to wilt the spinach. Serve and enjoy!

name: One Pan Gochujang Tempeh & Sweet Potatoes with Avocado
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Gochujang
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tbsps
Water
1 tbsp
Shallot (chopped)
1/2
Sweet Potato (large, sliced)
4 ozs
Tempeh (sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2
Avocado (medium, sliced)
2 tsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix the gochujang, oil, and water together. Toss with the shallot, sweet potato, tempeh, salt, and pepper. Place everything on the baking sheet and cover with more parchment paper or foil. Cook in the oven for 20 minutes. Remove the cover and continue cooking for 10 minutes or until the potatoes and tempeh are browning on the edges.
Divide the tempeh, sweet potatoes, and avocado between plates. Garnish with cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea Pasta Chili
ingredients:
10 ozs
Chickpea Pasta
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 cup
Red Onion (chopped)
1
Carrot (large, diced small)
1
Red Bell Pepper (large, chopped)
2 tbsps
Tomato Paste
2 cups
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with juices)
1 1/2 tbsps
Taco Seasoning
2 cups
Red Kidney Beans (cooked)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped, plus more for garnish)
recipe:
Cook the chickpea pasta to al dente according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onions, carrots, and peppers and cook for three to five minutes or until softened.
Add the tomato paste and diced tomatoes and stir in the taco seasoning. Bring the mixture to a simmer. Once the mixture is bubbling, add the beans and cilantro. Cook until warmed through.
Add the cooked pasta to the pot. Cook for another minute or until warmed through. Top with cilantro (optional) and enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Palak Tofu with Rice
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (small, chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, small, minced)
1/2 tsp
Ginger (fresh, minced)
1
Tomato (small, ripe, diced)
2 cups
Baby Spinach
1 tsp
Garam Masala
1/2 tsp
Cumin
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Lite Coconut Milk
8 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, pressed, cubed)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Set the pressure cooker to "sauté" mode and add the oil. Once hot, add the onion, garlic, and ginger. Sauté for two minutes or until the onion is fragrant.
Add the tomato and mix well to loosen any browned bits that have stuck to the pot. Then, add the spinach and spices. Mix well and let cook for three minutes, or until the spinach has fully wilted, stirring frequently.
Add the coconut milk and stir well. Use an immersion blender to purée. Alternatively, you can carefully add everything to a blender and blend until just smooth.
Add the tofu to the pressure cooker. Stir well to coat. Close the lid and set to "sealing". Press manual/pressure cooker and cook for one minute on high pressure. Manually release the pressure.
Serve with the rice and enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Feta & Spinach Chickpea Pasta
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 cups
Water
4 cups
Frozen Spinach (thawed, drained)
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes (optional)
8 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (dry)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Feta Cheese
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Add the oil, garlic, water, spinach, chili flakes, and pasta to the pressure cooker. Stir well to combine. Season with salt and pepper.
Break the feta cheese into a few pieces and nestle it into the pasta.
Close the lid and set to "sealing". Press manual/pressure cooker and cook for three minutes on high pressure. Once the cooking time is complete, release the pressure manually and carefully open the lid.
Stir in the basil. Mix well to break-up the cheese, and enjoy!

name: Matcha Black Rice Porridge
ingredients:
1 cup
Black Rice (rinsed)
5 cups
Water
2 tsps
Vanilla Extract
1 tbsp
Coconut Sugar
1/2 cup
Canned Coconut Milk (full fat)
1 tbsp
Green Tea Powder (plus extra for garnish)
recipe:
Add the rice, water, vanilla, and sugar to a large pot and boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cover. Cook for 60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is tender and split.
Remove from the heat and let it sit for five minutes, covered, until it has thickened into a porridge consistency.
Stir in the coconut milk and green tea powder. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Carrot & Fennel Salad
ingredients:
2
Carrot (medium, roughly chopped)
1 bulb
Fennel (medium, sliced into wedges)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Raw Honey
2 cups
Arugula
2 cups
Baby Spinach
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the carrots and fennel on the baking sheet. Season with salt and pepper and spray with avocado oil. Bake in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until browned.
Meanwhile, in a bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, honey, salt, and pepper.
In a serving bowl, toss together the arugula and spinach. Top with roasted carrots, fennel, and feta cheese. Serve with the dressing and enjoy!

name: Lemony Artichoke & Beans Toast
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 cup
White Navy Beans (cooked)
1/2 cup
Artichoke Hearts (marinated, halved)
1/2
Lemon (juiced, zested)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
2 slices
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
2 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the beans and artichokes and sauté for about five minutes.
Add the lemon juice and zest and season with salt and pepper. Cook for another minute, remove from the heat and stir in the parsley.
Top the toast with the beans mixture. Add parmesan cheese on top and enjoy!

name: Roasted Broccolini, Chickpeas & Quinoa Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
8 ozs
Broccolini (chopped)
1/2 head
Cauliflower (small, cut into florets)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Onion Powder
1/4 cup
Green Goddess Salad Dressing
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions. Set aside.
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the broccolini on one side of the baking sheet, the cauliflower in the middle, and the chickpeas on the other side. Use separate baking sheets if there isn't enough space.
Drizzle the oil all over the vegetables and chickpeas. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder. Toss to coat.
Cook for 20 to 25 minutes or until the the vegetables and chickpeas are golden brown, flipping halfway through.
Divide the quinoa, roasted vegetables, and chickpeas into bowls. Add the dressing on top of each bowl. Enjoy!

name: Lemony Whipped Ricotta with Celery
ingredients:
2 cups
Ricotta Cheese
1/2
Lemon (juiced, zested)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Fresh Dill (chopped)
12 stalks
Celery (leaves removed, cut into sticks)
recipe:
In a food processor, whip the ricotta, lemon juice, and lemon zest until it is creamy, fluffy, and smooth, about one to two minutes.
Spoon the ricotta into a serving bowl and drizzle with olive oil. Garnish with dill.
Serve with celery sticks and enjoy!

name: Malaysian Tofu Curry
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
14 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, pressed, cubed)
2 tsps
Tapioca Flour
2 tbsps
Yellow Curry Paste
2 tbsps
Curry Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 cups
Canned Coconut Milk
2/3 cup
Vegetable Broth
3 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add half of the oil.
Toss the tofu cubes in the tapioca flour. Add the coated tofu to the pot and brown so that all sides are crispy. Work in batches as needed. Set aside and wipe out the pot as needed.
Add the remaining oil to the pot. Once hot, add the yellow curry paste, curry powder, and salt. Allow the paste and spices to bloom in the oil for about two minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the coconut milk and broth and stir well to combine. Add the tofu back to the pot and allow the curry to reduce for about five minutes.
Garnish with the green onions and enjoy!

name: Lemon & Dill White Bean Dip
ingredients:
2 cups
Cannellini Beans (cooked)
1/4 cup
Fresh Dill (chopped, plus more for garnish)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Tahini
3 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Sea Salt
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 cups
Radishes (halved)
2 cups
Green Beans (trimmed)
recipe:
In a food processor, combine the beans, dill, oil, tahini, lemon juice, salt, and garlic. Blend until creamy.
Serve with veggies and enjoy!

name: Singapore Noodles
ingredients:
2 cups
Brown Rice Vermicelli Noodles (dry)
1/2 cup
Shallot (chopped)
3 tbsps
Tamari
2 tbsps
Tomato Paste
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Tamarind Paste
1/4 cup
Water (plus more as needed)
1 tsp
Chili Flakes (plus extra for garnish)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1
Carrot (julienned)
2 tsps
Sesame Oil
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the vermicelli according to the package directions until al dente. Set aside. Be sure not to overcook.
In a blender or food processor, add the shallots, tamari, tomato paste, maple syrup, tamarind paste, water, and chili flakes. Blend on high until just smooth. Add more water as needed to create a paste.
Add half of the olive oil to a pan over medium heat. Add the carrots and sauté until soft, about five to seven minutes. Remove from the pan.
Add the remaining olive oil to the pan along with the paste. Cook for two minutes stirring often so it doesn't burn or stick. Add water as needed to keep the paste loose.
Add the vermicelli and sesame oil to the pan. Toss in the paste and add more water or oil if needed. Once coated and warmed through, divide the noodles evenly between plates. Top with the carrots and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Minestrone
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
4
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 cups
Frozen Vegetable Mix
1 tbsp
Italian Seasoning
3 cups
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with juices)
1/2 cup
Lentil Macaroni (dry, uncooked)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth
2 cups
Cannellini Beans (cooked)
2 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Turn the pressure cooker to "sauté" mode. Once hot, add the oil, garlic, and vegetables. Sauté for two to three minutes.
Add the Italian seasoning, tomatoes, macaroni, broth, and beans. Mix well.
Close the lid and set to "sealing". Press manual/pressure cooker and cook for three minutes on high pressure.
Once the cooking time is complete, release the pressure manually. Carefully open the lid. Stir in the kale and let it stand for five minutes or until wilted.
Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Roasted Broccolini & Cauliflower
ingredients:
8 ozs
Broccolini
1/2 head
Cauliflower (small, cut into florets)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/4 tsp
Onion Powder
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the broccolini and cauliflower to the baking sheet. Add the oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder. Toss to coat.
Cook for 20 to 25 minutes or until the the vegetables are golden brown, flipping halfway through. Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Spring Pea & Mint Pesto Pasta
ingredients:
3 cups
Brown Rice Fusilli (dry, uncooked)
1/4 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
1 1/3 cups
Frozen Peas (thawed)
1/4 cup
Pistachios
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves
1/4 cup
Fresh Dill
1/2
Lemon (juiced, zested)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Set aside the cooking water for later.
In a food processor, combine the peas, pistachios, mint, dill, lemon juice, lemon zest, oil, salt, pepper, and nutritional yeast. Pulse for about one to two minutes until everything is combined, but some texture remains. In the same pot used to cook the pasta, over low heat, toss the pasta with the pesto and the water, stirring to combine, until everything is coated. Add more water, one teaspoon at a time, as needed.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Spring Pea & Feta Dip
ingredients:
1 cup
Fresh Peas (or frozen, thawed)
1/4 cup
Fresh Dill
1/2 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
3 tbsps
Lemon Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3
Carrot (small, chopped)
1 1/2 cups
Snap Peas (trimmed)
recipe:
In a food processor, combine the peas, dill, yogurt, oil, feta cheese, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Blend until creamy.
Serve with the carrots and snap peas and enjoy!

name: Slow Cooker Chickpea Coconut Curry
ingredients:
1 3/4 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1
Sweet Potato (large, cubed)
1
Yellow Onion (chopped)
1
Red Bell Pepper (large, chopped)
3 cups
Fire Roasted Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with juices)
1 tbsp
Cumin
2 tsps
Paprika
2 tsps
Turmeric
1 tsp
Ginger (minced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 cups
Broccoli (chopped into florets)
1 3/4 cups
Canned Coconut Milk
1 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry, rinsed)
recipe:
Add the chickpeas, sweet potato, onion, bell peppers, tomatoes, cumin, paprika, turmeric, and ginger to the slow cooker. Season with salt and pepper.
Cover and cook for four hours on high or six hours on low. During the last hour, add the broccoli and coconut milk.
30 minutes before serving, cook the rice according to the package directions.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Spicy Snow Peas
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 cups
Snow Peas (stems removed)
3 tbsps
Water
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Chili Flakes
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the peas and coat them in the oil. Sauté for two to three minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the water and continue to move the peas around until the water has evaporated.
Add the peas to a bowl. Season with lemon juice, chili flakes, and salt. Toss to combine. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Broccoli Bake
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Butter (divided)
1/4 oz
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
1 1/4 cups
Water
6 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 cups
Broccoli (chopped into florets)
1/3 cup
Bread Crumbs
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Grease a baking dish.
Melt 2/3 of the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Once melted, add the flour and whisk well to combine. While whisking vigorously, slowly add the water. Allow the mixture to thicken, whisking occasionally, for about two minutes.
Add the cheese, salt, and pepper and whisk well to combine. Set aside.
Add the broccoli to the baking dish. Pour the cheese sauce all over the broccoli, and mix with a spoon to coat well. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes, until bubbling.
Meanwhile, add the breadcrumbs and remaining butter to a small bowl and mash together with your fingers or a spoon. Sprinkle the breadcrumb mixture over the top of the broccoli. Set the oven to broil and return the broccoli to the oven for one to two minutes or until the breadcrumb topping has browned lightly.
Let the broccoli rest for five to ten minutes before serving. Enjoy!

name: Tarragon & Shallot Labneh Dip
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/3 cup
Shallot (thinly sliced)
1 cup
Labneh
1 tbsp
Fresh Tarragon (chopped, plus extra for garnish)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Carrot (large, cut into sticks)
1/2
Cucumber (large, cut into sticks)
2 stalks
Celery (cut into sticks)
recipe:
Heat the oil a pan over medium heat. Add the shallots and cook for about 15 to 20 minutes or until caramelized, stirring occasionally. Remove from the pan and roughly chop. Set aside to cool down. In a bowl, mix together the labneh, caramelized shallots, and tarragon. Season the dip with salt and pepper.
Serve the dip with carrots, cucumber, and celery. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Palak Tofu
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (small, chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, small, minced)
1/2 tsp
Ginger (fresh, minced)
1
Tomato (small, ripe, diced)
2 cups
Baby Spinach
1 tsp
Garam Masala
1/2 tsp
Cumin
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Lite Coconut Milk
8 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, pressed, cubed)
recipe:
Set the pressure cooker to "sauté" mode and add the oil. Once hot, add the onion, garlic, and ginger. Sauté for two minutes or until the onion is fragrant.
Add the tomato and mix well to loosen any browned bits that have stuck to the pot. Then, add the spinach and spices. Mix well and cook for three minutes, or until the spinach has fully wilted, stirring frequently.
Add the coconut milk and stir well. Use an immersion blender to purée. Alternatively, you can carefully add everything to a blender and blend until just smooth.
Add the tofu to the pressure cooker. Stir well to coat. Close the lid and set to "sealing". Press manual/pressure cooker and cook for one minute on high pressure. Manually and carefully release the steam. Serve and enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker PB & J Steel Cut Oats
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Steel Cut Oats
3/4 cup
Water
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
3 tbsps
All Natural Peanut Butter
2 tbsps
Strawberry Jam
1
Banana (medium, sliced)
recipe:
Add the steel cut oats, water, milk, and salt to your pressure cooker and close the lid. Set to “sealing,” then press manual/pressure cooker. Cook for five minutes on high pressure. Once it is done, press cancel, and let the pressure release naturally for ten minutes. Do a quick release for any remaining pressure.
Remove the lid carefully and stir in the chia seeds. Let it sit for two to four minutes or until thickened.
Divide the oatmeal evenly between bowls. Top with peanut butter, jam, and sliced banana. Enjoy!

name: Ricotta & Green Peas Toast
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Fresh Peas (or frozen and thawed)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4
Lemon (juiced, zested)
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Ricotta Cheese
2 slices
Bread (toasted)
recipe:
Add the peas to a pot and add enough water to cover them. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Cook for three to four minutes or until tender. Rinse under cold water and drain.
Transfer the peas to a bowl. Mix in the oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, and chili flakes. Season with salt and pepper.
Spread the ricotta over each slice of toast and season with salt and pepper.
Spoon the pea mixture on top and enjoy!

name: Avocado & Grapefruit
ingredients:
1
Grapefruit (peeled, cut into sections)
1
Avocado (medium, sliced)
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves (chopped)
1/16 tsp
Sea Salt (or to taste)
recipe: Divide the grapefruit and avocado slices onto plates. Season with basil and salt. Enjoy!

name: Simple Scallion Flatbread
ingredients:
2 cups
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1 2/3 cups
Water
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Sesame Oil
8 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil (divided)
1 1/2 tbsps
Tamari
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
1/4 tsp
Coconut Sugar
recipe:
In a large bowl, combine the flour, water, salt, and sesame oil. Mix until just combined and then fold in the green onion.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add 1/4 of the avocado oil. Once hot, add about 3/4 cup of the batter into the pan. Allow the batter to evenly spread out.
Cook until browned on one side, about four minutes. Flip and cook for another four minutes, until browned on the other side. Continue with the remaining batter, using more oil in between batches. In a small bowl, combine the tamari, vinegar, and sugar and mix well to dissolve the sugar.
Slice each flatbread into quarters and serve with the dipping sauce on the side. Enjoy!

name: Warm Chickpeas in Roasted Red Pepper Sauce
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1 1/2 tsps
Tomato Paste
4 ozs
Roasted Red Peppers (drained and chopped)
1 cup
Canned Coconut Milk

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/4 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2
Lime (juiced)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (for garnish)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the garlic powder and tomato paste, stir, and cook for two minutes. Add the roasted red peppers and cook for another minute.
Add the coconut milk, salt, and pepper. Stir and bring to a simmer. Use an immersion blender and blend the mixture until smooth.
Add the chickpeas to the pan and cover the pan with a lid. Turn the heat to low and simmer for about 10 minutes.
Remove from the heat and stir in the lime juice. Top with cilantro and enjoy!

name: Avocado Green Tea Popsicles
ingredients:
2
Avocado (medium, pitted)
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
3 tbsps
Raw Honey
1 tbsp
Green Tea Powder
recipe:
Add all ingredients to a food processor and blend until smooth.
Spoon the mixture into popsicle molds and freeze for three hours. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Beets with Whipped Dill Feta
ingredients:
6
Beet (medium, peeled, quartered)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped, divided)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC).
Toss the beets with half of the oil, salt, and pepper. Add them to a cast-iron pan, cover, and cook in the oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until the beets are tender.
Meanwhile, add the remaining oil, feta, and half of the dill to a food processor. Blend until smooth.
Spread the feta onto a serving plate and pile the beets on top. Garnish with the remaining dill. Enjoy!

name: Grain-Free Coconut Tahini Granola
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Unsweetened Coconut Flakes
1/2 cup
Almonds (chopped)
1/2 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
1 tbsp
Hemp Seeds
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
1/4 cup
Coconut Oil (melted, slightly cooled)
1/3 cup
Maple Syrup
1/4 cup
Tahini
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine the coconut flakes, almonds, pumpkin seeds, hemp seeds, and salt. Stir in the coconut oil, maple syrup, tahini, and vanilla. Add the granola to the baking sheet and spread it out into an even layer. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until everything is golden brown. Check on it every five minutes and toss it around.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes. It will crisp up as it cools. Enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Frittata
ingredients:
1 cup
Chickpea Flour
1/4 tsp
Baking Powder
3/4 cup
Water
1
Tomato (medium, diced)
1 cup
Baby Spinach (chopped)
1/4 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives (sliced)
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped, plus more for garnish)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Avocado (medium, sliced)
recipe:
In a large bowl, whisk together the chickpea flour, baking powder, and water until smooth. Add the tomatoes, spinach, olives, and basil and mix well.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the mixture, cover, and cook for eight to 10 minutes until the bottom is golden. Cover the pan with a large upside-down plate, place your hand on it, and quickly turn the frittata over on the plate before gently sliding it back onto the pan. Cook for an additional five to eight minutes until fully cooked.
Top with sliced avocado and garnish with basil, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Chili Sauce
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Maple Syrup
1/4 cup
Water (plus more for the slurry)
1 tbsp
Apple Cider Vinegar
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 tsps
Tapioca Flour
recipe:
In a small saucepan, mix the maple syrup, water, vinegar, garlic, chili flakes, and salt until combined.
Bring to a boil then lower the heat to a simmer for seven to eight minutes. Once the heat is reduced, mix the tapioca flour with water to make a slurry. Pour it into the sauce and whisk for a few minutes until the sauce thickens.
Remove from the heat and let it cool before transferring to a sealable jar. Enjoy!

name: Tahini Cardamom Granola
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Tahini
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 1/2 tsps
Cardamom
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
1/3 cup
Walnuts (chopped)
1 1/2 tbsps
Sesame Seeds
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 325ºF (160ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, whisk together the tahini, maple syrup, and cardamom. Add the oats, walnuts, and sesame seeds. Stir to combine.
Spread granola evenly onto the baking sheet and sprinkle with flaky salt. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until light golden brown, stirring once halfway through.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely before breaking into chunks. Enjoy!

name: Sauteed Chickpea & Edamame Bowl
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Brown Rice (dry, rinsed)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 cup
Red Onion (chopped)
1 1/2 cups
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Baby Spinach
1/3 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
1 tbsp
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions and set aside.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onions and sauté for two to three minutes or until they have softened. Add the edamame and chickpeas. Mix in the garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Cook for five to seven minutes or until the chickpeas and edamame are browned, stirring occasionally. Add a splash of water if needed.
Stir in the spinach and cook for another one to two minutes or until the spinach starts to wilt.
To assemble, evenly divide the rice, sauteéd chickpea and edamame mixture, pumpkin seeds, and hemp seeds into bowls. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Dahl Soup
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with the juices)
1/2 cup
Dry Red Lentils (rinsed)
1 cup
Red Onion (finely chopped)
3 cups
Vegetable Broth
2 tsps
Coriander (ground)
1 tsp
Cumin
1/4 tsp
Turmeric
1 tbsp
Ginger (minced)
2/3 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1/2 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Add all ingredients except for the coconut milk and the cilantro to the pot of your pressure cooker. Mix well.
Close the lid of the pressure cooker and set to “sealing”. Press manual/pressure cooker and cook for five minutes on high pressure.
Once it is done, allow the pressure to release naturally for five minutes, and then release any remaining pressure manually. Remove the lid carefully.
Stir in the coconut milk. Divide between bowls and garnish with cilantro. Enjoy!

name: One Pot White Bean Stew
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (small, diced)
2
Carrot (sliced)
1 stalk
Celery (sliced)
1 tbsp
Tomato Paste
2 tsps
Italian Seasoning
4
Garlic (clove, minced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Cannellini Beans (cooked)
2 cups
Vegetable Broth
1/2
Lemon (juiced, zested)
1/4 cup
Parsley (finely chopped)
recipe:
Heat a Dutch oven or large pot over medium heat and add the oil. Once hot, add the onion, carrot, and celery. Cook, stirring often until just starting to soften, about five minutes. Add the tomato paste and Italian seasoning and cook for one minute, stirring often. Add the garlic and cook for one minute. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the beans and vegetable broth and stir to combine. Increase the heat to medium-high and bring to a low boil. Reduce the heat and cover partially. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until everything is cooked through and slightly thickened.
Stir in the lemon juice, lemon zest, and parsley. Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Grain-Free Cranberry Orange Granola
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Unsweetened Coconut Flakes
1/2 cup
Cashews (raw, roughly chopped)
1/4 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
3 tbsps
Orange Zest
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Maple Syrup
2 tbsps
Coconut Oil (melted, slightly cooled)
1/2 cup
Dried Unsweetened Cranberries
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine the coconut flakes, cashews, pumpkin seeds, orange zest, and salt. Stir in the maple syrup and coconut oil.
Add the granola to the baking sheet and spread it out into an even layer. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until everything is golden brown. Check on it every five minutes and toss it around.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before stirring in the cranberries. It will crisp up as it cools. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Parmesan & Garlic Cashews
ingredients:
2 cups
Cashews (raw, soaked for at least one hour, rinsed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, combine the cashews, oil, cheese, garlic powder, and salt.
Spread out into an even layer onto the baking sheet. Cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until the cashews are lightly browned, turning occasionally. Let them cool for about five minutes before serving. Enjoy!

name: One Pot Lentil Saffron Stew
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
2
Carrot (medium, diced)
1 stalk
Celery (diced)
1 tbsp
Tomato Paste
1/2 tsp
Cumin
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/4 tsp
Saffron (ground)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Dry Red Lentils (rinsed, drained)
2 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth
4 cups
Baby Spinach (roughly chopped)
recipe:
Heat a Dutch oven or large pot over medium heat and add the oil. Once hot, add the onion, carrot, and celery and cook, stirring often for five minutes or until just starting to soften.
Add the tomato paste and cumin and cook for one minute, stirring often. Add the garlic and saffron and cook for an additional minute. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the lentils and broth and stir to combine. Increase the heat to medium-high and bring to a simmer. Lower the heat slightly and continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, about 15 to 18 minutes. Add the spinach and stir until wilted. Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Sauerkraut & Hummus Sandwich
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Hummus
1 tbsp
Hemp Seeds
1/4 tsp
Turmeric

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 slices
Whole Grain Bread
1/4 cup
Sauerkraut (drained)
1/2 cup
Baby Spinach
recipe:
Mix together the hummus, hemp seeds, and turmeric, until well combined. Season with salt and pepper.
Scoop the hummus mixture onto one slice of bread. Add the sauerkraut and spinach on top. Close the sandwich and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Coconut Popsicles
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Canned Coconut Milk
2 tbsps
Cacao Powder
2 tsps
Monk Fruit Sweetener
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Taste and add more sweetener if desired.
Pour into popsicle molds and freeze for five to six hours or until completely frozen. Enjoy!

name: Cocoa, Coffee & Almond Granola
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 1/2 tbsps
Coffee (brewed, espresso)
2 tsps
Cocoa Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
1/4 cup
Sliced Almonds
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 325ºF (160ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, whisk together the maple syrup, coffee, cocoa powder, and salt. Add the oats and almonds, and stir to combine.
Spread the mixture evenly onto the baking sheet. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until light golden brown, stirring once halfway through.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely. It will crisp up as it cools. Enjoy!

name: One Pot Lentil & Olive Linguine
ingredients:
2 1/3 cups
Water
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes
1/4 cup
Green Olives (pitted, halved)
1/2 cup
Parsley (chopped)
6 ozs
Linguine (dry)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Lentils (cooked)
recipe:
In a large pot, bring the water to a boil over high heat. Add all the ingredients except for the lentils.
Continue to boil while stirring and turning the pasta for eight to 10 minutes or until the pasta is al dente and most of the liquid has evaporated. Stir in the lentils and remove from the heat.
Divide onto plates and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Protein Crunch Bars
ingredients:
1 cup
All Natural Peanut Butter (runny)
1 cup
Maple Syrup
3 cups
Rice Puffs Cereal
1 1/4 cups
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 1/2 cups
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Line a pan with parchment paper and set aside.
In a large bowl, add the peanut butter and maple syrup and mix well to combine. Add the cereal and protein powder and mix well with a spatula until thoroughly combined.
Transfer the cereal mixture into the prepared pan, pressing down to create an even layer.
Add water to a double boiler or fill a small pot halfway with water and place a heat-safe bowl on top. Bring the water to a boil and add the chocolate chips to the bowl. Melt the chocolate, stirring often. Alternatively, you can melt the chocolate chips in the microwave on 30-second intervals.
Pour the melted chocolate over the cereal, spreading it out to create an even layer. Transfer to the fridge until the chocolate has completely set, about 45 minutes, or overnight.
Remove the cereal bars and slice into rectangular pieces. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Chip Protein Muffins
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1/2 cup
Almond Flour
1 tsp
Baking Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
All Natural Peanut Butter
3
Banana (mashed)
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
3/4 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a muffin tray with liners or use a silicone muffin tray.
In a large bowl, whisk together the protein powder, almond flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the peanut butter, banana, and maple syrup and stir with a spatula until combined. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Divide the batter evenly between muffin cups. Bake for 13 to 15 minutes or until firm to the touch and a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Let the muffins cool in the pan for 10 to 15 minutes before removing and transferring to a cooling rack to cool completely. Enjoy!

name: Broccoli & Chickpea Green Curry
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (small, diced)
2 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
2 tbsps
Green Curry Paste
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the onion and sauté for three to four minutes or until the onions are translucent.
Add the broccoli, chickpeas, coconut milk, and curry paste to the pan and mix well to incorporate the curry paste. Cover, lower the heat to a simmer and cook for three to five minutes or until the broccoli is tender.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Greek Kale & Edamame Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
3/4 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/4
Cucumber (large, chopped)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1/3 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives
1/2 cup
Red Onion (chopped)
2 cups
Baby Kale
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Add all the ingredients to a large bowl and mix to combine. Divide evenly between bowls or onto plates and enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Corn Chowder
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (small, diced)
1
Yellow Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
1
Jalapeno Pepper (seeds removed, diced)
1 1/2 tsps
Smoked Paprika
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
3
Yellow Potato (chopped)
3 1/2 cups
Frozen Corn

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth
3/4 cup
Unsweetened Cashew Milk
recipe:
Turn the pressure cooker to "sauté" mode. Once hot, add the oil. Add the onion, bell pepper, and jalapeno and sauté until softened, stirring often, about four to five minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, nutritional yeast, potato, and corn. Season with salt and pepper and add the broth. Stir to combine.
Set the pressure cooker to "sealing" and cook on high pressure for six minutes. Allow the pressure to release naturally for five minutes, then carefully release the remaining pressure.
Carefully remove the lid and stir in the cashew milk. Season with salt and pepper if needed. Use an immersion blender to purée until slightly thickened, but still slightly chunky. Alternatively, add to a blender and blend to the desired consistency being careful to vent as needed. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Green Curry Edamame & Cabbage Skillet
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Shallot (chopped)
4 cups
Purple Cabbage (thinly sliced)
1 cup
Frozen Edamame
2 tbsps
Green Curry Paste
1 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
Heat a large pan over medium heat. Add the oil and shallot and sauté until translucent, about three minutes.
Add the cabbage, edamame, and curry paste to the pan. Toss well to coat and sauté for three to five minutes or until the cabbage has softened and the edamame is warmed through. Divide evenly between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Coconut Avocado Lime Popsicles
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from a carton)
1/2
Avocado (medium, pitted)
1/4 cup
Cashews (raw, soaked for at least one hour, rinsed)
1
Lime (large, juiced)
1 tsp
Monk Fruit Sweetener
1 cup
Baby Spinach
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Add more milk if too thick.
Pour into popsicle molds and freeze for five to six hours or until completely frozen. Enjoy!

name: Tofu & Quinoa Bowl with Peanut Sauce
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
12 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, and cubed)
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil (divided)
1 tbsp
Tamari (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 tsps
Arrowroot Powder
2 cups
Edamame Pods (frozen)
2 tbsps
Rice Vinegar
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
1/3
Cucumber (large, sliced)
1/4 cup
Peanut Sauce
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cook the quinoa according to package directions.
Add the tofu cubes to a bowl and gently toss with half of the oil and half the tamari. Season with salt and pepper. Add the arrowroot powder and gently toss until the tofu cubes are well coated. Arrange the coated tofu cubes on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes.
In the same bowl, toss the edamame with the remaining oil and tamari and season with salt and pepper. Move the tofu to one side of the baking sheet and add the edamame. Place back in the oven and bake for 12 to 14 minutes or until cooked through and the tofu is crispy.
In a small bowl, mix together the rice vinegar and chili flakes. Add the sliced cucumber and toss to coat.
Divide the quinoa, tofu, and edamame into bowls. Top with the cucumber and drizzle with peanut sauce. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Maple Cinnamon Buckwheat
ingredients:
1 cup
Buckwheat Groats
2 1/2 cups
Water
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
3 1/3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 1/3 tbsps
Cinnamon
recipe:
Add the buckwheat, water, and salt to a pressure cooker. Set to "sealing" and cook on high pressure for 15 minutes.
Allow the pressure to naturally release for eight minutes, then manually release the remaining pressure. Carefully remove the lid and mix in the maple syrup and cinnamon. Enjoy!

name: Keto Lime Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/2 cup
Cottage Cheese
1/2 cup
Sour Cream
1
Lime (zested and juiced)
2 tsps
Monk Fruit Sweetener
recipe: Add all the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Enjoy!

name: Cucumber & Black Bean Salad
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Black Beans (cooked)
1/2
Cucumber (medium, diced)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (diced)
1
Lime (medium, juiced)
1 tsp
Chili Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a bowl and toss to combine. Taste and add more seasoning if desired. Enjoy!

name: One Pan Mushroom & Asparagus Lentils
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 cups
Mushrooms (sliced)
1 cup
Asparagus (trimmed, chopped)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 cup
Lentils (cooked)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Fresh Dill (chopped)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms and sauté for about five minutes.
Add the asparagus and garlic. Cook for another two to three minutes.
Add the lentils, stir, and cook for about five to seven minutes or until warmed up. Season the mixture with salt and pepper.
Remove from the heat. Add the dill and lemon juice and adjust the seasoning to your taste. Enjoy!

name: Moroccan Lentil Salad
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Red Wine Vinegar
1/2 tsp
Moroccan Spice Blend
1/2
Navel Orange (juiced)
1/4 cup
Shallot (finely chopped)
2 1/2 cups
Lentils (cooked)
4 stalks
Celery (chopped)
1/4 cup
Dried Apricots (chopped)
1/4 cup
Almonds (toasted, chopped)
1/2 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe: Add all the ingredients to a large bowl and mix to combine. Divide evenly between bowls or onto plates and enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Cajun Sweet Potato & Chickpeas
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (large, cut into wedges)
3 cups
Purple Cabbage (thinly sliced)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Cajun Seasoning
3 cups
Arugula
1
Lemon (small, juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the sweet potato wedges on the left side of the baking sheet, followed by the cabbage in the middle and the chickpeas on the right side. Use additional baking sheets if additional room is needed.
Drizzle the oil all over the pan, followed by the cajun seasoning. Toss each section to make sure everything is fully coated.
Cook for 30 to 35 minutes or until browned and cooked through, flipping the sweet potatoes halfway through and tossing the cabbage and chickpeas.
Divide the arugula between bowls along with the roasted sweet potatoes, cabbage, and chickpeas. Drizzle lemon juice all over each bowl and season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Shawarma Spiced Chickpeas & Potatoes
ingredients:
1
Russet Potato (large, cut into wedges)
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 1/2 cups
Shallot (halved)
3/4 tsp
Shawarma Spice Blend
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes
3 tbsps
Tahini
3 tbsps
Water
1
Garlic (clove, small, finely grated)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet(s) with parchment paper.
Place the potato wedges on the baking sheet and drizzle with 1/3 of the oil. Season with salt and pepper. Arrange evenly on the baking sheet, spacing the wedges out. Transfer to the oven for 10 minutes.
In a bowl, toss the chickpeas and shallot with half of the remaining oil, shawarma spice, salt, and pepper. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread them out evenly. Bake for 20 minutes, flipping the wedges halfway through.
In the same bowl, toss the tomatoes with the remaining oil, salt, and pepper. Transfer to the baking sheet and bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the tomatoes have burst and the chickpeas and wedges are browned and crispy.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the tahini, water, and garlic and whisk well until smooth and creamy.
Divide the wedges, chickpeas, and veggies between plates and drizzle with the tahini sauce. Enjoy!

name: Curried Cauliflower Rice & Haddock
ingredients:
2 cups
Cauliflower Rice
1/2 cup
Frozen Peas (thawed)
2 tbsps
Curry Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Water
2
Haddock Fillet
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC).
In an oven safe dish, add the cauliflower rice, green peas, curry powder, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Pour the water over the cauliflower and season the haddock all over with salt and pepper.
Place the haddock on top of the cauliflower. Cover the baking dish tightly with foil or a lid. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes.
Remove from the oven and uncover the baking dish. Flake the haddock into big chunks and gently stir. Place the dish back in the oven and bake for another seven to ten minutes or until everything is cooked through.
Garnish with cilantro and drizzle the lemon juice on top. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Chickpea & Avocado Toast
ingredients:
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Cumin
1/4 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/4 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (plus more for garnish)
1
Avocado (medium)
2 slices
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped, optional)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the chickpeas, oil, cumin, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and salt to the prepared baking sheet. Mix well to coat.
Cook in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until crispy.
When ready to serve, mash the avocado evenly between the slices of toast. Top with roasted chickpeas and drizzle with lemon juice. Season with more salt and cilantro, if desired.
Serve immediately and enjoy!

name: One Pot Lentils & Rice with Hummus
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry, rinsed)
1/3 cup
Dry Red Lentils
1 2/3 cups
Water
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Hummus
1/2 cup
Black Olives
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/2 tsp
Za'atar Spice
recipe:
Add the rice, lentils, water, and salt to a small pot and bring to a boil. Once boiling, cover and reduce to a simmer. Cook for 10 minutes or until the rice and lentils are tender. Remove from the heat and keep the lid on. Allow the rice and lentils to sit for five minutes.
Divide the rice and lentils between bowls. Top with hummus, olives, and tomatoes. Garnish with za'atar. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Peach Oat Bran Porridge
ingredients:
1 cup
Oat Bran
2 cups
Water
2 cups
Oat Milk
1/4 cup
Cocoa Powder
1/2 tsp
Stevia Powder
2 tsps
Cinnamon
1
Peach (sliced)
recipe:
Add the oat bran to a large saucepan over medium heat. Toast for one minute, stirring often.
Add the water, oat milk, cocoa powder, stevia, and cinnamon. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for three to four minutes, whisking constantly, until thickened.
Remove from the heat and pour into a bowl. Top with peaches and enjoy!

name: Apple & Brazil Nuts
ingredients:
1
Apple (cored, sliced)
1/4 cup
Brazil Nuts
recipe: Add the apple slices and Brazil nuts to a plate. Enjoy!

name: One Pot Fettucine with Kale & Mushrooms
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 cups
Mushrooms (sliced)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
8 ozs
Brown Rice Fettuccine
3 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
2 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped)
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast (plus extra for garnish)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a deep pan over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms and sauté for about five minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the fettuccine and broth. Stir and bring to a simmer. Lower the heat, cover the pot with a lid, and simmer for about 15 minutes.
Remove the lid and stir in the kale leaves, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper. Stir and cover with a lid again. Simmer for another 12 to 15 minutes or until the fettuccine is cooked through.
Divide the pasta between plates. Top with more nutritional yeast if desired, and enjoy!

name: Cherry & Blueberry Smoothie
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Oat Milk
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/2 cup
Frozen Blueberries
1/2 cup
Frozen Cherries
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tbsp
Pumpkin Seeds
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Add more liquid for a thinner consistency, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Edamame, Nori & Brown Rice Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Rice (dry, rinsed)
1 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1 tbsp
Ginger (fresh, chopped)
2 tbsps
Rice Vinegar
1 tbsp
Tamari
1 tsp
Sesame Oil
2
Nori Sheets (finely chopped)
1 tbsp
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions. Set aside to cool.
In a mixing bowl, add the edamame, ginger, rice vinegar, tamari, and sesame oil. Toss well to coat the edamame evenly.
Add the nori sheets, sesame seeds, and green onions to the bowl. Mix until well combined. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean & Hummus Stuffed Sweet Potato
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (large, halved lengthwise and pricked with a fork)
1 cup
Black Beans (cooked)
2 tbsps
Hummus
2 tbsps
Water
1 stalk
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Place the sweet potato in a steaming basket over boiling water. Steam for 25 minutes or until cooked through. Carefully remove the sweet potatoes and use a fork to create a space for the black beans in the potato's flesh. Spoon the black beans into the sweet potato.
Mix the hummus and water to make a dressing. Drizzle this over the sweet potato. Garnish with the green onion, and enjoy!

name: Cherry Oat Bran Porridge
ingredients:
1 cup
Oat Bran
2 cups
Oat Milk
2 cups
Water
2 tsps
Cinnamon (plus more for ganish, optional)
1/4 tsp
Stevia Powder (to taste)
1 cup
Frozen Cherries
recipe:
In a large saucepan over medium heat, add the oat bran and toast for 30 to 60 seconds, stirring often.
Add the oat milk, water, cinnamon, and stevia, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for three to four minutes, whisking constantly, until thickened.
Remove from the heat and pour into bowls. Top with cherries and cinnamon. Enjoy!

name: Coconut Peach Blueberry Smoothie
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Oat Milk
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
1/2 cup
Frozen Blueberries
1/2 cup
Frozen Peaches
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Add more liquid for a thinner consistency, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Tempeh, Mushroom & Asparagus Stir Fry
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Rice (dry, rinsed)
1 tbsp
Sesame Oil
8 ozs
Tempeh (cut into cubes)
1 cup
Mushrooms (sliced)
1 cup
Asparagus (chopped)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tbsps
Tamari
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
1 stalk
Green Onion (chopped)
1 tsp
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions. Set aside.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the tempeh to the pan and cook for five minutes or until lightly browned.
Add the mushrooms and asparagus to the pan. Cook for another three to four minutes or until tender. Add the garlic and cook for one more minute, stirring.
Stir in the cooked rice, tamari, cilantro, and green onions. Cook for an additional two to three minutes or until the rice is heated through.
Garnish with sesame seeds before serving. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Blueberry Chia & Flax Pudding
ingredients:
1 cup
Oat Milk
2 tbsps
Cocoa Powder
1/4 tsp
Stevia Powder
3 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1 1/2 tbsps
Ground Flax Seed
1/4 cup
Blueberries
recipe:
Add all ingredients except the blueberries to a jar and shake well until combined. Refrigerate overnight or for at least three hours until all liquid is absorbed.
Stir well before serving and top with the blueberries. Enjoy!

name: One Pot Tomato & Basil Penne
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3
Garlic (clove, small, minced)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes
2 1/4 cups
Brown Rice Penne (dry)
4 1/2 cups
Water
1/3 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (shredded, plus extra for garnish)
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves
recipe:
Add the oil, garlic, and tomatoes to a large pot over medium heat. Sauté for three minutes, or until the garlic is fragrant and the tomatoes start to burst.
Add the pasta and water and bring to a boil. Then, reduce the heat to a simmer. Cover and cook for eight to ten minutes, stirring often.
Add the parmesan cheese and stir well. Garnish with the basil leaves and serve. Enjoy!

name: One Pan Leek & Tahini Rigatoni
ingredients:
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Leeks (small, sliced)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
4 ozs
Rigatoni (uncooked)
3 1/3 cups
Vegetable Broth

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Tahini
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the leeks and sauté for about 10 minutes or until soft and slightly browned, stirring frequently.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute. Add the rigatoni, broth, salt, and pepper. Stir and cover the pan with a lid. Turn the heat down to low and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes or until al dente. Stir the pasta a few times as it cooks.
Add the tahini and stir. Simmer for two to three minutes uncovered. Remove from the heat and stir in the lemon juice.
Top the pasta with parsley. Adjust the seasoning to your taste and enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Savory Miso Oatmeal
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Steel Cut Oats
1 1/3 cups
Water
1 tbsp
Miso Paste (white)
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
1 tsp
Tamari
1
Avocado (medium, sliced)
recipe:
Add the steel cut oats and water to your pressure cooker and close the lid.
Set to “sealing,” then press manual/pressure cooker. Cook for five minutes on high pressure. Once it is done, press cancel, and let the pressure release naturally for ten minutes. Do a quick release for any remaining pressure.
Remove the lid carefully and stir in the miso, nutritional yeast, and tamari until well combined.
Divide the oatmeal evenly between bowls. Top with the avocado. Enjoy!

name: Edamame & Broccoli Slaw
ingredients:
4 cups
Broccoli Slaw (bagged)
2 cups
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
1/2 cup
Radishes (medium, thinly sliced)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lime (large, juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients into a large bowl and mix to combine. Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Pesto & Potato Pizza
ingredients:
12 ozs
Pizza Dough (store bought)
3/4 cup
Mini Potatoes (very thinly sliced)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/2 tsp
Rosemary (finely chopped)
1/3 cup
Pesto
4 ozs
Mozzarella Cheese (shredded)
recipe:
Place the dough in a large bowl and cover it with a tea towel. Leave it on counter for at least 30 minutes to rise and come to room temperature.
Preheat the oven to 500°F (260°C).
Place the dough in a cast-iron pan and stretch it slightly to fill the pan.
In a small bowl, combine the sliced potato with half the oil and rosemary. Mix well.
Dollop the pesto on the dough and spread it out evenly. Sprinkle the cheese all over. Top with the potato and rosemary mixture. Drizzle the remaining oil over the crust. Transfer to the oven and bake for 15 to 18 minutes or until the cheese has melted and the dough is browned and cooked through.
Transfer to a cutting board. Slice, serve, and enjoy!

name: Blended Raspberry Protein Chia Pudding
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Cow's Milk, Reduced Fat
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
3 tbsps
Chia Seeds
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 cup
Raspberries (divided)
recipe:
In a blender, combine the milk, yogurt, protein powder, chia seeds, maple syrup, and half of the raspberries. Blend on high until combined and relatively smooth.
Pour into a container and place in the fridge for 30 minutes to thicken.
When ready to serve, top with remaining raspberries and enjoy!

name: Vanilla Tahini Protein Mug Cake
ingredients:
3 1/2 tbsps
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
2 tbsps
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 1/2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
1/2 tsp
Baking Powder
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 tbsp
Tahini
1 tbsp
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
In a mug whisk the flour, protein powder, coconut sugar, baking powder, and salt. Add the milk and tahini. Stir well to combine until no flour remains. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Microwave for 90 seconds until the cake is spongy to the touch. Allow the cake to cool slightly and enjoy!

name: Roasted Red Pepper & Artichoke Pizza
ingredients:
12 ozs
Pizza Dough (store bought)
1/3 cup
Pesto
4 ozs
Mozzarella Cheese (shredded)
5 ozs
Roasted Red Peppers (sliced)
3/4 cup
Artichoke Hearts (from the can, drained, sliced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 cup
Arugula

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano (shaved)
recipe:
Place the dough in a large bowl and cover it with a tea towel. Leave it on the counter for at least 30 minutes to rise and come to room temperature.
Preheat the oven to 500°F (260°C).
Place the dough in a cast-iron pan and stretch it slightly to fill the pan. Dollop the pesto on the dough and spread it out evenly. Sprinkle the mozzarella cheese all over. Top with roasted red peppers and artichokes. Drizzle with 1/3 of the oil.
Drizzle half of the remaining oil over the crust. Transfer to the oven and bake for 15 to 18 minutes or until the cheese has melted and the dough is browned and cooked through.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, toss the arugula with the remaining oil and season with salt and pepper.
Top the pizza with the arugula and parmesan. Transfer to a cutting board. Slice, serve, and enjoy!

name: Blended Chocolate Strawberry Protein Chia Pudding
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Cow's Milk, Reduced Fat
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/4 cup
Chocolate Protein Powder
3 tbsps
Chia Seeds
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Cocoa Powder
1/2 cup
Strawberries (sliced)
recipe:
In a blender, combine the milk, yogurt, protein powder, chia seeds, maple syrup, and cocoa powder. Blend on high until combined and relatively smooth.
Pour into a container and place in the fridge for 30 minutes to thicken.
When ready to serve, top with strawberries and enjoy!

name: Brown Rice Pasta with Basil & Broccoli
ingredients:
1 cup
Brown Rice Penne (dry)
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/16 tsp
Chili Flakes (optional, to taste)
4 cups
Broccoli (finely chopped)
1 cup
Vegetable Broth
1 tsp
Miso Paste

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the pasta to al dente according to the package directions. Reserve pasta water and drain.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Stir in the chili flakes, then add the broccoli, broth, and miso. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook for six to eight minutes, stirring occasionally, until the broccoli softens. Add some of the reserved pasta water, a little at a time, to reach a saucy consistency.
Toss the cooked pasta with the broccoli. Stir in the basil, and continue cooking until warmed through. Enjoy!

name: Apple Cinnamon Oat Bran Porridge
ingredients:
1 cup
Oat Bran
2 cups
Water
2 cups
Oat Milk (unsweetened)
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1/2 tsp
Stevia Powder
1
Apple (sliced)
recipe:
In a large saucepan over medium heat, add the oat bran and toast for 30 to 60 seconds, stirring often.
Add the water, oat milk, cinnamon, and stevia, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for three to four minutes, whisking constantly, until thickened.
Remove from the heat and pour into a bowl. Top with sliced apple and enjoy!

name: One Pan Potatoes, Chickpeas & Asparagus
ingredients:
3 cups
Mini Potatoes (halved)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 tbsp
Italian Seasoning (divided)
3 cups
Asparagus (trimmed, chopped)
1
Sweet Onion (medium, sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the potatoes to one side of the baking sheet and the chickpeas in the middle. Drizzle half of the oil all over the potatoes and chickpeas, followed by half of the Italian seasoning. Toss to combine.
Cook for 20 to 25 minutes then remove the pan from the oven. Flip the potatoes and toss the chickpeas. Add the asparagus and onion to the open side of the pan and drizzle the remaining oil and Italian seasoning on top. Carefully toss.
Place back into the oven for an additional 10 to 15 minutes or until the vegetables are tender. Divide into bowls. Season with salt and pepper, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Blueberry, Quinoa & Oat Bran Muffins
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
2 tsps
Ground Flax Seed
1/2 cup
Water
1 cup
Oat Bran
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
3/4 cup
Oat Milk
1 tsp
Stevia Powder
2 tsps
Baking Powder
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1 cup
Blueberries
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions.
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a muffin pan with muffin liners or use a silicone muffin tray.
Mix the ground flax seed with the water and set aside for five minutes to thicken.
Blend the oat bran in a high-powered blender or food processor to make flour. Set aside.
In a large bowl, mix together the yogurt, oat milk, flax mixture, and stevia.
Add the quinoa, oat bran, baking powder, and cinnamon to the bowl and stir well. Fold in the blueberries. Evenly divide the batter between the muffin cups. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes.
Cool in the muffin pan until completely cool. Once cooled, enjoy!

name: Cucumber & Kimchi Edamame Rice
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Rice (dry, rinsed)
1 cup
Frozen Edamame
1 tbsp
Tamari
1/2 tsp
Miso Paste
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
1/2
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1/4 cup
Kimchi
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
In a separate pot, boil the edamame in water for two to three minutes or until it turns bright green. Drain and set aside.
Mix the tamari, miso paste, and rice vinegar together to make a dressing.
Divide the rice, edamame, cucumber, kimchi, green onion, and cilantro evenly between bowls. Pour the dressing over top and garnish with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Vanilla Ricotta Chia Mousse
ingredients:
1 cup
Ricotta Cheese
1/2 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1 1/2 tsps
Chia Seeds
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/4 tsp
Stevia Powder
recipe: Add all ingredients to a food processor and blend until well combined and creamy. Divide into small bowls or jars, one per serving, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. Enjoy!

name: Apple & Cinnamon Chia Pudding
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1 1/2 tsps
Ground Flax Seed
1 cup
Oat Milk
1/4 tsp
Stevia Powder
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1
Apple (divided)
2 tbsps
Brazil Nuts (chopped)
recipe:
Add the chia seeds, ground flax seed, oat milk, stevia, cinnamon, and half of the apple to a jar and shake well until combined. Refrigerate overnight or for at least three hours until all liquid is absorbed.
Stir well before serving. Top with Brazil nuts and the remaining apple. Enjoy!

name: Vegan Carrot Lox Bagels
ingredients:
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2
Carrot (medium, trimmed, unpeeled, cut in half)
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Rice Vinegar
1 tbsp
Tamari
1 tsp
Miso Paste (white)
1/2 cup
Water
3 ozs
Vegan Cream Cheese
2
Bagel (plain, toasted)
2 tsps
Capers
2 tsps
Fresh Dill
recipe:
Fill a medium-sized pot with water and season with the salt. Add the carrots. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat and boil for six to ten minutes, until the carrots are fork-tender, but not falling apart. Remove the carrots and transfer them to a bowl of cold water.
In a container or shallow bowl, stir the oil, vinegar, tamari, miso paste, and water.
Using a sharp knife, thinly slice the carrots into ribbons. Transfer to the bowl with the marinade and cover. Place in the fridge for 60 minutes, or overnight.
