When ready to eat, remove them and let them sit out for ten minutes. Spread the cream cheese over the bagel. Remove the carrots from the marinade and place on top followed by the capers and dill. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Zucchini Chips
ingredients:
2
Zucchini (large, sliced)
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 365°F (185°C).
In a bowl, toss together zucchini slices with the garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Place the zucchini slices into the air fryer basket in a single layer. Work in batches if necessary. Spray with avocado oil and cook in the air fryer for 13 to 15 minutes or until crispy, flipping halfway through. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Spiced Lentils & Collard Greens with Rice
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry, rinsed)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (small,diced)
1
Garlic (clove, large, minced)
1 tbsp
Ginger (fresh, grated)
2
Yellow Potato (medium, diced)
2 tsps
Berbere Spice
1 cup
Dry Red Lentils (rinsed)
3 cups
Water
1/2
Lime (juiced)
2 cups
Collard Greens (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Set the pressure cooker to "sauté". Add the oil, onion, garlic, and ginger. Sauté for one to two minutes, stirring frequently, until fragrant and starting to brown.
Add the potato, berbere spice, lentils, and water. Close the lid and set to "sealing". Press manual/pressure cooker and cook for ten minutes on high pressure. Once the cooking time is complete, release the pressure manually. Carefully open the lid. Add the lime juice and collard greens and stir thoroughly until wilted. Serve with the rice and enjoy!

name: Grape & Mint Virgin Mojito
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Grapes
1/2
Lemon (plus more for garnish)
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves (plus more for garnish)
1/2 tsp
Monk Fruit Sweetener
6
Ice Cubes (as needed)
1 cup
Sparkling Water (as needed)
recipe:
In a glass add the grapes, lemon, mint, and monk fruit sweetener. Muddle until mashed.
Add the ice cubes and pour in the sparkling water.
Give a quick stir. Garnish with a sprig of fresh mint and sliced lemon and serve chilled. Enjoy!

name: Pea & Mushroom Risotto
ingredients:
2 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Shallot (finely chopped)
2 cups
Oyster Mushrooms
1/2 cup
Arborio Rice (dry, rinsed)
1/2 cup
Frozen Peas (thawed)
2 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated, plus extra for garnish)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
In a saucepan, bring the broth to a gentle simmer, then leave on low heat to keep warm.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the shallot and sauté for two to three minutes. Add the mushrooms and cook for another five minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the rice and cook for two minutes, or until the rice is fragrant.
Pour in the warm broth one cup at a time, stirring frequently and allowing time for the liquid to absorb before adding more. Cook until the risotto is al dente, about 20 to 25 minutes.
Stir in the peas and parmesan cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Divide evenly between bowls and top with more parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Kimchi Peanut Noodles
ingredients:
1 cup
Kimchi (divided)
1/2 cup
All Natural Peanut Butter
2 tbsps
Tamari
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
1/3 cup
Water
7 ozs
Buckwheat Soba Noodles
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
1/2 cup
Raw Peanuts
recipe:
In a blender, combine half the kimchi, peanut butter, tamari, lime juice, and water. Blend until fairly smooth, adding more water if needed to thin. Set aside.
Cook the soba noodles according to the package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water until completely cooled.
Transfer the noodles to a large bowl and add the sauce. Toss to combine. Add in the reserved kimchi.
Divide between bowls and top with green onions and peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Berry Banana Fruit Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Strawberries (chopped)
1 cup
Raspberries
1 cup
Blueberries
1
Banana (medium, sliced)
recipe: Add everything into a bowl and serve. Enjoy!

name: Pomegranate Lime Mimosa Mocktail
ingredients:
1 cup
Pomegranate Juice
1 cup
Sparkling Water
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
1/4 cup
Pomegranate Seeds
recipe: Divide the pomegranate juice, sparkling water, and lime juice into glasses. Stir to combine then top each with pomegranate seeds. Enjoy!

name: Banana Walnut Oatmeal with Kefir
ingredients:
1 cup
Water
1/2 cup
Quick Oats
1/2 cup
Plain Kefir
1/2
Banana (medium, sliced)
2 tbsps
Walnuts (chopped)
recipe:
In a small saucepan, bring the water to a boil. Add the oats. Reduce to a steady simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, for about five minutes or until the oats are tender and most of the water is absorbed.
Add the oats to a bowl. Top with kefir, banana, and walnuts. Enjoy!

name: Balsamic Blueberry & Nectarine Fruit Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Blueberries
2
Nectarine (pitted, chopped)
1 tbsp
Basil Leaves (chopped)
2 tbsps
Balsamic Glaze
recipe: In a bowl, toss together all the ingredients. Divide between bowls and enjoy!

name: Blueberry Lemon Scones
ingredients:
10 1/2 ozs
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
1 1/2 tsps
Baking Powder
1/2 tsp
Baking Soda
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Coconut Sugar (plus more for topping, optional)
2 tsps
Lemon Zest
1/2 cup
Butter (grated, cold)
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 cup
Buttermilk (divided)
1 1/4 cups
Blueberries
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, sugar, and lemon zest. Mix well to combine.
Add the butter to the flour mixture and disperse with your hands. Add the vanilla and 3/4 of the buttermilk. Mix with a spatula until combined. Fold in the blueberries.
On a lightly floured surface, using floured hands, turn the dough out onto the surface. If the dough is too sticky, add more flour, if it's too dry, add a splash more buttermilk. Form the dough into a large disc.
Use a biscuit cutter to cut out circles. Transfer to the baking sheet and brush lightly with the remaining buttermilk. Sprinkle each scone with a small amount of coconut sugar. Place in the oven and bake for 19 to 22 minutes, until browned on top and cooked through.
Cool on the baking sheet for about five minutes and then transfer to a cooling rack. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potatoes with Miso Glaze
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (medium, cubed)
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
1 1/2 tbsps
Miso Paste (white)
1 1/2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
2 tsps
Tamari
1 1/2 tsps
Rice Vinegar
1/8 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC)
Place the sweet potato on a baking sheet and spray with avocado oil. Spread out evenly. Transfer to the oven and bake for 30 minutes, flipping halfway, until cooked through, puffy and lightly browned.
Meanwhile, in a saucepan, combine the miso, maple syrup, tamari, rice vinegar, and chili flakes. Bring to a low simmer over medium-low heat. Stir occasionally until slightly thickened. Place the cooked sweet potato in a serving bowl and drizzle the miso sauce over top. Toss to combine. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Berbere Spiced Lentil & Collard Greens
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (small,diced)
1
Garlic (clove, large, minced)
1 tbsp
Ginger (fresh, grated)
2
Yellow Potato (diced)
2 tsps
Berbere Spice
1 cup
Dry Red Lentils (rinsed)
3 cups
Water
1/2
Lime (juiced)
2 cups
Collard Greens (chopped)
recipe:
Set the pressure cooker to "sauté". Add the oil, onion, garlic, and ginger. Sauté for one to two minutes, stirring frequently, until fragrant and starting to brown.
Add the potato, berbere spice, lentils, and water. Close the lid and set to "sealing". Press manual/pressure cooker and cook for ten minutes on high pressure.
Once the cooking time is complete, release the pressure manually. Carefully open the lid. Add the lime juice and collard greens and stir thoroughly until wilted. Serve and enjoy!

name: Pineapple Basil Mocktail
ingredients:
2 cups
Pineapple (chopped)
4 fl ozs
Pineapple Juice
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves (chopped)
8
Ice Cubes (as needed)
recipe:
Add all the ingredients except for the ice cubes to a blender. Blend until smooth.
Divide the ice cubes between glasses. Pour the drink overtop and enjoy!

name: Granola & Fig with Kefir
ingredients:
2
Fig (sliced)
1 1/2 cups
Plain Kefir
1/2 cup
Granola
recipe: Add all ingredients to a bowl and enjoy!

name: Iced Matcha
ingredients:
1/2 tsp
Green Tea Powder
1/4 cup
Water (hot)
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
6
Ice Cubes
3/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
recipe:
In a small bowl, whisk together the green tea powder and hot water until it becomes frothy. Add the vanilla and maple syrup and whisk again.
Fill a glass with ice and add the almond milk. Pour the green tea powder mix into the glass. Stir, taste, and add more sweetener if desired. Enjoy!

name: Date & Walnut Oatmeal with Kefir
ingredients:
1 cup
Water
1/2 cup
Quick Oats
1/2 cup
Plain Kefir
1/8 tsp
Cinnamon
2 tbsps
Pitted Dates (chopped)
2 tbsps
Walnuts (chopped)
recipe:
In a small saucepan, bring the water to a boil. Add the oats. Reduce to a steady simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, for about five minutes or until the oats are tender and most of the water is absorbed.
Add the oats to a bowl and top with the kefir. Garnish with cinnamon, dates, and walnuts. Enjoy!

name: Spaghetti with Clams
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Rice Spaghetti
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
1 lb
Clams (fresh)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
recipe:
Cook the spaghetti according to the package directions. Reserve the pasta water and drain.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and chili flakes, stir and cook for about a minute. Add the clams and pasta water. Cover the pan with a lid and let the clams steam for six to eight minutes or until they have opened.
Remove the lid and add in the spaghetti, parsley, and salt. Stir and adjust the seasoning to your taste.
Remove the pot from the heat and stir in the lemon juice. Divide between serving and enjoy!

name: Oatmeal with Kefir
ingredients:
1 cup
Water
1/2 cup
Quick Oats
1/2 cup
Plain Kefir
1/8 tsp
Cinnamon
recipe:
In a small saucepan, bring the water to a boil. Add the oats. Reduce to a steady simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, for about five minutes or until the oats are tender and most water is absorbed.
Add the oats to a bowl with the kefir. Garnish with cinnamon. Serve and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Beets with Feta
ingredients:
2
Beet (large, peeled, cut into small pieces)
1 tsp
Balsamic Vinegar
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 390ºF (200ºC).
In a large bowl combine the beets, vinegar, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Toss well to coat.
Arrange the beets in a single layer in the fryer basket and cook for 10 minutes. Carefully flip the beets and cook for six to eight more minutes or until crispy and browned on the edges.
Transfer to a serving dish and top with feta and parsley. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry & Granola Kefir Parfaits
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Frozen Strawberries
1 cup
Granola
1 1/3 cups
Plain Kefir
recipe:
In a small saucepan over medium heat, add the strawberries and cook for three to five minutes, until softened and saucy. Remove from the heat to cool slightly, for about five minutes.
Layer the granola, kefir, and strawberries in glass containers or bowls until all ingredients are used. Serve and enjoy!

name: Granola with Kefir
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Plain Kefir
1/2 cup
Granola
recipe: Add all ingredients to a bowl and serve. Enjoy!

name: Lemony Crab & Potato Salad
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Mini Potatoes
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
1 tbsp
Capers (drained)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
8 ozs
Fresh Lump Crab Meat, Cooked
recipe:
Add the potatoes to a large pot with enough water to cover them. Bring the pot to a boil and cook for 12 to 15 minutes or until fork-tender. Drain and let them cool before cutting them in half.
In a bowl, whisk together the oil, lemon juice, parsley, capers, salt, and pepper. Add in the crab meat and halved potatoes. Season with salt and pepper.
Adjust the seasoning and lemon juice to your taste. Divide between serving bowls and enjoy!

name: Virgin Strawberry Mojito
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Strawberries (chopped)
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves
1
Lime (juiced)
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
2
Ice Cubes (large)
1 1/2 cups
Sparkling Water
recipe:
Divide the strawberries, mint, lime juice, and maple syrup into glasses. Use a muddler to mash and combine the flavors.
Add the ice cubes then top with sparkling water. Enjoy!

name: Lubya Kidney Bean Curry
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
2
Tomato (large, finely diced)
1 tsp
Coriander (ground)
1/2 tsp
Cumin

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (small, diced)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 cup
Vegetable Broth
1 1/2 cups
Red Kidney Beans (cooked)
1/4 tsp
Turmeric
1/4 tsp
Paprika
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Heat half of the oil in a pot over medium-low heat. Once hot, add the tomatoes with their juices to the pot. Cook over medium-low heat, for five minutes, stirring occasionally or until they break down and are saucy. Carefully transfer the tomatoes to a blender. Add the coriander and cumin and blend until smooth. Season with salt and pepper and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and add the remaining oil to the pot. Add the onions and cook for four minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened. Add the garlic, and continue cooking for an additional minute, stirring.
Stir in the broth, tomato mixture, kidney beans, turmeric, paprika, and season with salt and pepper. Simmer uncovered over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until the liquid has slightly reduced.
Garnish with cilantro and enjoy!

name: Avocado Berry Salad with Kombucha Vinaigrette
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 fl ozs
Kombucha (berry flavored)
2 tbsps
Shallot (finely chopped)
1/4 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Raw Honey

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 cups
Mixed Greens
1 cup
Strawberries (chopped)
1/2 cup
Blackberries
1
Avocado (medium, cubed)
recipe:
In a small bowl or jar, whisk together the oil, kombucha, shallot, garlic powder, honey, salt, and pepper.
Add the mixed greens, strawberries, blackberries, and avocado to a large bowl. Add the dressing and mix to combine. Serve and enjoy!

name: Tempeh & Asparagus Shirataki Noodle Bowl
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Sesame Oil
2 tbsps
Tamari
1 tsp
Rice Vinegar
1 tbsp
Nutritional Yeast
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
8 ozs
Tempeh (cubed)
2 cups
Asparagus (trimmed, chopped)
8 ozs
Shirataki Noodles
1 stalk
Green Onion (chopped)
1/2 tsp
Sesame Seeds
recipe:
In a small bowl or jar, whisk together the sesame oil, tamari, rice vinegar, nutritional yeast, and garlic.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Add the tempeh and asparagus to the baking sheet and toss with half of the marinade. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes or the asparagus is cooked through.
Add the noodles to a pot along with the remaining marinade. Warm over medium heat for three to four minutes or until heated through.
Divide the noodles into bowls and top with the tempeh and asparagus. Sprinkle with green onion and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Overnight Blueberry Oat Bran
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Oat Bran
1/2 cup
Oat Milk (unsweetened, plus more to serve)
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/16 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tsp
Stevia Powder
1/3 cup
Blueberries
1 1/2 tsps
Ground Flax Seed
recipe:
Mix the oat bran, milk, yogurt, salt, and stevia together until well combined.
Divide evenly between jars and refrigerate overnight or for at least eight hours.
When ready to eat, stir in the blueberries and flax seeds. Add a small amount of milk, as needed, for desired consistency. Enjoy!

name: Berry Coconut Kefir Popsicles
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Plain Coconut Kefir
1 cup
Frozen Berries
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Add more liquid if needed.
Pour into popsicle molds and freeze for five to six hours or until completely frozen. Enjoy!

name: Lentil & Leek Soup
ingredients:
5 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided, plus more as needed)
2
Leeks (medium, chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 tsp
Turmeric
1/4 tsp
Cumin
1/4 tsp
Coriander (ground)
1 cup
Dry Red Lentils (rinsed)
2 tbsps
Tomato Paste
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
In a large pot, heat a splash of broth over medium heat.
Add the leeks and season with salt and pepper. Cook for five minutes, or until softened, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the turmeric, cumin, and coriander. Cook for one to two minutes until fragrant.
Add the remaining vegetable broth, lentils, and tomato paste. Season with salt and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and simmer for about 15 minutes or until the lentils are tender, stirring occasionally. If the soup becomes too thick, add more broth as needed.
Divide evenly between bowls and garnish with cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Napa Cabbage Slaw with Kimchi Dressing
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Kimchi
2 tsps
Water
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
1 tsp
Fish Sauce
1 tsp
Sesame Oil (toasted)
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil
4 cups
Napa Cabbage (thinly sliced)
1 cup
Daikon (julienned)
2
Carrot (shredded)
recipe:
In a blender combine the kimchi, water, rice vinegar, fish sauce, sesame oil, and avocado oil. Blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the cabbage, daikon, and carrot. Pour the dressing over top and toss until well coated. Serve and enjoy!

name: Lemon Garlic Haddock Spaghetti
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Rice Spaghetti
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2
Haddock Fillet

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Lemon (juiced, divided)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 stalk
Green Onion (sliced)
recipe:
Cook the spaghetti according to the package directions. Once done, drain and reserve some of the pasta water.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Season the haddock with salt and pepper and drizzle with half of the lemon juice. Add the fish to the pan and cook for two to three minutes on each side or until cooked through.
Remove the fish, and in the same pan, add the garlic. Sauté the garlic for about a minute, then add the pasta water and the remaining lemon juice. Bring to a simmer and add the spaghetti.
Season with salt and pepper. Stir frequently and let it simmer for about five minutes or until the sauce has slightly thickened.
Divide the fish and the pasta between plates. Top with green onion. Enjoy!

name: Hibiscus Berry Kombucha Mocktail
ingredients:
1 1/3 tbsps
Hibiscus Tea (loose leaf or in tea bags)
4 cups
Water (cold or room temperature)
4
Ice Cubes (large)
1 pint
Kombucha (berry flavored)
1 cup
Frozen Berries
recipe:
Add the tea to a pitcher or large French press. Add the water and refrigerate for at least two hours. Once steeped, discard the tea. Strain if needed.
Divide the ice into glasses along with the tea, kombucha and berries. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea Soba Noodle Bowl
ingredients:
3 1/2 ozs
Buckwheat Soba Noodles (dry, uncooked)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 cups
Mushrooms (sliced)
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
2 tbsps
Tamari

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1 stalk
Green Onion (sliced)
recipe:
Cook the soba noodles according to the package directions.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add in the mushrooms and sauté for about five minutes. Add the chickpeas and cook for another five minutes.
Add the cooked noodles and tamari. Stir and cook for another two to three minutes or until heated through and the flavors have combined. Season with salt and pepper. Divide the noodles and cucumber evenly between bowls. Top with green onion, and enjoy!

name: Miso Tempeh, Kale & Asparagus with Buckwheat
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Buckwheat Groats
1 1/3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 tbsp
Miso Paste
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
2
Garlic (clove, minced, divided)
8 ozs
Tempeh (sliced)
6
Cremini Mushrooms (sliced)
1 cup
Asparagus (trimmed and chopped)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped, divided)
2 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the buckwheat according to the package directions.
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix half of the oil, miso paste, rice vinegar, and half of the garlic into a paste. Place the tempeh pieces on the baking sheet and brush the paste onto the tempeh. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the tempeh starts to brown. Set aside.
Add the remaining oil to a large pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the remaining garlic, mushrooms, asparagus, and half of the green onion. Sauté for three to five minutes, or until the mushrooms soften and start to brown.
Add the kale to the pan and toss well. Heat for two minutes or until the kale starts to wilt, stirring as it cooks.
Divide the buckwheat, vegetable mixture, and tempeh evenly between plates. Garnish with the remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Almond Oat Bran Porridge
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Oat Milk
1/4 cup
Oat Bran
1/16 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1 tsp
Stevia Powder
1 tbsp
Almond Butter
1 1/2 tsps
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut (toasted)
1 tbsp
Ground Flax Seed
1 tsp
Chia Seeds
recipe:
In a small saucepan bring the milk to a boil.
Stir in the oat bran and salt. Reduce the heat to medium and simmer for two minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cinnamon and stevia powder. Stir well for about two to three minutes or until the liquid is gone and the desired consistency is reached.
Transfer to a bowl. Top with almond butter, coconut, flax, and chia seeds. Enjoy!

name: Tomato, Kale & White Bean Soup
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (small, diced)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tsp
Cumin
2 cups
White Navy Beans (cooked)
1 cup
Tomato Purée
2 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for about five minutes. Add the garlic and cumin and sauté for another minute.
Add the beans, tomato purée, and broth to the pot. Stir and season with salt and pepper. Cover the pot with a lid and simmer on low heat for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid, use a potato masher and mash some of the beans in the pot. Alternatively, blend some of the soup with a hand blender. Stir and add the kale leaves. Simmer uncovered for another five minutes.
Divide the soup evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Blueberry & Granola Chia Seed Parfaits
ingredients:
1 cup
Frozen Blueberries
1 1/3 cups
Plain Kefir
2/3 cup
Chia Seeds
1 cup
Granola
recipe:
In a small saucepan over medium heat, add the blueberries and cook for three to five minutes, until softened and saucy. Remove from the heat to cool slightly, for about five minutes.
Add the blueberries, kefir, and chia seeds to a food processor and process until smooth. Refrigerate for at least 1 1/2 hours or overnight to set.
Layer the chia pudding with the granola into glass container or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Miso Leek & Mushroom Soba Noodles
ingredients:
3 1/2 ozs
Buckwheat Soba Noodles
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Leeks (large, sliced lengthwise, cut in large pieces)
8
Cremini Mushrooms (quartered)
1 1/2 tbsps
Miso Paste
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
1 1/2 tbsps
Tamari
1/3 cup
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1 tbsp
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
1 stalk
Green Onion (sliced)
recipe:
Cook the soba noodles according to the package directions.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the leeks and mushrooms, and sauté for five to seven minutes or until softened. Remove from the pan. In the same pan, add the miso, honey, tamari, and broth. Simmer for about a minute until the sauce has slightly thickened. Add the leeks and mushrooms back to the pan and simmer for two to three more minutes.
Divide the noodles evenly between bowls. Top with leeks, mushrooms, and the sauce. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onion. Enjoy!

name: Smoked Herring & Potato Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Mini Potatoes
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1 tbsp
Shallot (finely chopped plus more for garnish)
1 tbsp
Fresh Dill (chopped, plus more for garnish)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
6 ozs
Smoked Herring Fillet (in oil, drained)
3 cups
Mixed Greens
recipe:
Set the potatoes in a steamer over boiling water and cover. Steam for about 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. Once cooled down, cut the potatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Meanwhile, mix together the yogurt, shallots, and dill. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide the herring, potatoes, mixed greens, and yogurt dressing evenly between plates. Garnish with more shallots, dill, salt, and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Crispy Lima Beans
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Lima Beans (cooked)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 380°F (195°C).
Pat the lima beans dry with paper towel. Transfer to a bowl and toss with oil, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the beans to the air fryer and cook for 15 minutes, shaking half way through. Enjoy!

name: Thai Red Curry Chickpeas, Rice & Broccoli
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry, rinsed)
1 tbsp
Thai Red Curry Paste
1/4 cup
Water
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
4 cups
Frozen Broccoli
1 tbsp
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking dish with parchment paper.

Mix the curry paste with the water and toss with the chickpeas. Put the chickpeas into the baking dish and cook in the oven for 20 minutes or until just starting to brown.

Almonds
1/2 cup
Snow Peas (stems removed)
recipe: Arrange the almonds and snow peas in a plate. Enjoy!

name: Crab Fusilli
ingredients:
3 1/2 cups
Brown Rice Fusilli (dry, uncooked)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 cups
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
3
Garlic (clove, chopped)
1/2 tsp
Red Pepper Flakes
2 tbsps
White Wine Vinegar
1 lb
Fresh Lump Crab Meat, Cooked
1/2 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
1 tsp
Lemon Zest

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the pasta to al dente according to the package directions.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-low heat. Add the tomatoes, garlic, and red pepper flakes and cook for two minutes.
Add the vinegar to the pan and continue cooking for about two minutes, or until slightly reduced.
Add the crab and continue cooking until warmed through. Remove from the heat and stir in the cilantro and lemon zest. Add the warm pasta to the pan and toss to combine. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Spiced Tofu & Avocado Green Salad
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
10 ozs
Tofu (firm, cut into slices)
1 tsp
Steak Spice Seasoning
1/4 cup
Vegan Mayonnaise
1 tbsp
Apple Cider Vinegar
4 leaves
Romaine (chopped)
1
Avocado (medium, sliced)
1/2
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1/4 cup
Pumpkin Seeds (toasted)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan over high heat. Once hot, add the tofu. Cook for two minutes then flip. Season with steak spice. Cook for another two minutes then set aside to cool.
In a small bowl, mix together the mayonnaise and vinegar.
Divide the lettuce, avocado, cucumber, and pumpkin seeds evenly between plates. Top with tofu and green onions. Drizzle with the dressing and enjoy!

name: Walnuts, Tomatoes & Olives
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Cherry Tomatoes
1/4 cup
Walnuts
2 tbsps
Pitted Kalamata Olives
recipe: Add all ingredients to a plate or separate bowls and enjoy!

name: Thai Red Curry Grilled Cauliflower Steaks
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Thai Red Curry Paste
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 head
Cauliflower (large, cut into steaks)
1 stalk
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the grill to medium heat.
Mix the oil, curry paste, and salt together and brush onto the cauliflower steaks.
Cook the cauliflower steaks for five to six minutes per side with the lid closed or until the cauliflower steaks are tender and slightly charred.
Garnish with the green onion. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Sesame Tofu Lettuce Wraps
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Sesame Oil
6 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, pressed, crumbled)
1 1/2 tbsps
Almond Butter
1/4 cup
Tamari (divided)
2 tbsps
Rice Vinegar (divided)
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1 tsp
Ground Ginger
1
Red Bell Pepper (medium, chopped)
1/4 cup
Water (optional)
1 head
Boston Lettuce (leaves separated)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the crumbled tofu and cook, stirring occasionally, for about four to six minutes or until browned.
Meanwhile, In a small bowl, combine the almond butter, half of the tamari, and half of the rice vinegar. Stir until smooth. Set aside.
Add the onions, the remaining tamari, and the remaining rice vinegar to the pan. Cook until the onions are tender, about three to five minutes.
Add the garlic powder, ground ginger, and chopped peppers. Cook for an additional two minutes or until the peppers are slightly tender. Add the almond butter sauce to the pan. Stir to coat everything evenly. Add water as needed for your preferred consistency.
Spoon the tofu and veggie mixture into the center of each lettuce leaf and enjoy!

name: Cucumber, Olive & Feta Salad
ingredients:
1/2
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 cups
Water (enough to submerge the cucumber)
2 tbsps
Feta Cheese
2 tbsps
Pitted Kalamata Olives
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
Add the cucumber to a medium-sized bowl with the salt and just enough water to cover them. Let it sit for 10 minutes to soften and then drain.
Add the cucumber, feta cheese, and olives to a serving plate. Drizzle with oil and top the chili flakes. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Chickpea Tacos
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Taco Seasoning
4
Corn Tortilla (small)
2 tbsps
Sour Cream
4 leaves
Romaine (chopped)
1/2
Avocado (medium, sliced)
2 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
1/2
Lime (cut into wedges)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 375°F (190°C).
In a bowl, toss the chickpeas and onions with oil and taco seasoning. Place the seasoned chickpeas in the air fryer basket.
Cook in the air fryer for 12 to 15 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through. The chickpeas will be finished when they are slightly crispy.
Top each tortilla with sour cream, lettuce, avocado, chickpeas, cheese, and cilantro. Serve with lime wedges and enjoy!

name: Burrata & Tomato Salad
ingredients:
8 ozs
Burrata
4
Tomato (heirloom, cut into wedges)
2
Plum (medium, sliced)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves
recipe:
Add the burrata to a large bowl. Add the tomatoes and plum around the cheese. Drizzle the oil all over and season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with basil. When ready to serve, cut into the burrata and divide it evenly into bowls with the rest of the salad. Enjoy!

name: Celery & Guacamole
ingredients:
2 stalks
Celery (chopped)
1/4 cup
Guacamole
recipe: Add the ingredients to a bowl and enjoy!

name: Cucumber Mint Raita
ingredients:
1 cup
Plain Cow's Yogurt, Whole Milk
1
Cucumber (large, grated)
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves (chopped)
1/2 tsp
Fennel Seed (crushed)
1/2
Green Chili Pepper (finely chopped)
1/2 tsp
Cumin
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tsps
Lemon Juice
recipe: Add all the ingredients to a large serving bowl and mix well. Serve chilled and enjoy!

name: Avocado & Halloumi Salad
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
4 ozs
Halloumi (sliced)
4 cups
Mixed Greens
1/2 cup
Assorted Olives
1
Avocado (medium, sliced)
1/4 cup
Hot Banana Pepper (sliced)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat 1/3 of the oil in a pan. Add the sliced halloumi and cook for two to three minutes per side or until browned.
Divide the mixed greens, olives, avocado, hot banana peppers, and fried halloumi evenly between bowls. Drizzle the remaining olive oil into each bowl, followed by the lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate & Sesame Banana Bites
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
1/3 cup
Sesame Seeds
1
Banana (large, sliced into large pieces)
recipe:
Melt the chocolate in a double boiler or for 30-second increments in the microwave.
Place the sesame seeds in a shallow bowl.
Use a toothpick to pick up a banana chunk. Dip it in the melted chocolate and roll it in the sesame seeds. Repeat until all banana chunks are dipped. Freeze for 10 minutes and enjoy!

name: Red Lentil Kitchari
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Coconut Oil
1 tbsp
Coriander Seed
2 tsps
Fennel Seed
1 tbsp
Ginger (grated)
1 tsp
Turmeric (ground)
1 cup
Dry Red Lentils (rinsed)
1/2 cup
Basmati Rice (dry, rinsed)
6 cups
Vegetable Broth
1/2 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
4 cups
Frozen Vegetable Mix
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped, optional)
recipe:
In a large pot, melt the coconut oil over low heat. Add the coriander and fennel seeds and sauté for about two to three minutes or until they pop.
Add the ginger and turmeric and cook for 30 seconds. Add the lentils, rice, broth, coconut milk, and vegetables and stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on low for 30 to 35 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until the rice and lentils are fully cooked.
Divide evenly between bowls. Serve warm and garnish with fresh cilantro if desired. Enjoy!

name: Cantaloupe, Avocado & Feta Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
Arugula
1/3 cup
Feta Cheese (cubed)
1/4
Cantaloupe (medium, cubed)
1
Avocado (medium, chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Balsamic Glaze
recipe:
Add the arugula to a serving bowl. Arrange the feta cheese, cantaloupe, and avocado on top.
Season with salt and pepper and drizzle with balsamic glaze. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Grilled Tofu & Peach Skewers
ingredients:
12 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, and cubed)
2
Peach (medium, pitted and cubed)
3/4 cup
Red Onion (cut into chunks)
4
Barbecue Skewers
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil
1 tsp
Chili Powder
3/4 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Sweet Chili Sauce
1/2
Lime (juiced and zested)
recipe:
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Evenly divide the tofu, peach, and red onions between skewers. Brush with oil. In a small bowl, mix together the chili powder, garlic powder, and salt. Sprinkle this over the skewers evenly, coating all sides.
In another small bowl, mix together the sweet chili sauce and lime juice.
Grill the skewers for eight to 10 minutes, flipping occasionally until the tofu has grill marks. During the last two minutes, brush the sweet chili glaze over the skewers.
Divide onto plates and garnish with lime zest. Enjoy!

name: Tart Cherry Sorbet
ingredients:
2 cups
Frozen Cherries
3 tbsps
Tart Cherry Juice
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
recipe:
Thaw the cherries for five minutes before blending.
In a food processor, blend the cherries and juice until it resembles shaved ice. Scrape down the sides then add the honey. Blend again. Scoop into bowls and serve immediately, or store in a resealable container in the freezer for one hour for a firmer texture. Enjoy!

name: Cucumber, Celery & Guacamole
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Guacamole
1/4
Cucumber (chopped)
2 stalks
Celery (chopped)
recipe: Add all ingredients to a bowl and enjoy!

name: Vegetable & Barley Soup
ingredients:
3 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (diced)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Crushed Tomatoes
1 tbsp
Italian Seasoning
1/3 cup
Pearl Barley (uncooked)
3 cups
Frozen Vegetable Mix
recipe:
Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add a splash of broth along with the onion and garlic. Cook for three to five minutes or until softened. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the tomatoes, remaining broth, Italian seasoning, and barley. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer covered for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the barley is just cooked.
Add the frozen vegetable mix and cook for another five to seven minutes or until the veggies are tender.
Remove from the heat. Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Oil-Free Caramelized Onion Pasta
ingredients:
1 cup
Vegetable Broth (divided)
2
Yellow Onion (medium, sliced)
8 ozs
Rigatoni (uncooked)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
3 cups
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with the juices)
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
1/2 tsp
Dried Rosemary

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Add 1/4 of the vegetable broth to a large pan over medium heat. Add the onions and cook, stirring occasionally, for 20 to 25 minutes, or until caramelized. Add a splash of broth at a time as needed to prevent burning. Set aside a 1/4 of the caramelized onions for garnish.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to the package directions.
Add the garlic, tomatoes, chili flakes, and rosemary to the pan with the onions. Season with salt and pepper. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes, or until the sauce reaches your preferred consistency.
Toss the pasta with the sauce until evenly coated. Divide evenly between plates or bowls and season with salt and pepper. Garnish with reserved caramelized onions and enjoy!

name: Raspberry Lemon Chia Pudding
ingredients:
1 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
1 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
1/4 cup
Chia Seeds
1/2
Lemon (juiced, zested, plus extra for garnish)
1 cup
Raspberries (plus extra for garnish)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a large bowl and mix very well until combined. Ensure the chia seeds are mixed in, and the berries are lightly mashed. Divide the mixture evenly between jars, making one jar per serving, and refrigerate for at least eight hours or overnight.
Serve with extra raspberries and lemon zest (optional). Enjoy!

name: Leek & Potato Soup
ingredients:
4 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
2
Leeks (medium, chopped)
1 stalk
Celery (chopped)
2
Garlic (clove, chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3
Yellow Potato (peeled and cubed)
1/4 oz
Thyme Sprigs (whole)
1/8 tsp
Cayenne Pepper
2 tbsps
Chives (chopped, optional)
recipe:
Heat a splash of broth in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion, leeks, celery, and garlic and sauté for three to five minutes, or until tender, stirring frequently. Season with salt and pepper.
Add half of the remaining broth and use a wooden spoon to lift off any browned bits stuck to the bottom of the pot. Add the potatoes, thyme, and cayenne pepper. Stir to combine, then add the remaining broth.
Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low. Cover and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
Remove and discard the thyme stems. Using an immersion blender, blend the soup until smooth. Alternatively, add to a blender and blend to the desired consistency being careful to vent as needed.
Divide evenly between bowls and garnish with chives. Enjoy!

name: Hibiscus Rose Spritz
ingredients:
2 cups
Water
1 tbsp
Hibiscus Tea (loose leaf or in tea bags)
1/2 tsp
Monk Fruit Sweetener
1/16 fl oz
Rose Water
6
Ice Cubes (as needed)
1/3
Navel Orange (juiced, plus slices for garnish)
1/2 cup
Sparkling Water (as needed)
recipe:
Bring the water to a boil and steep the hibiscus tea for about 10 minutes. Mix in the sweetener and rose water. Add the tea to a pitcher and refrigerate until cold.
When ready to serve, fill a glass with ice and garnish with a slice of orange. Add the sparkling water, orange juice, and hibiscus tea. Stir gently and enjoy!

name: Tilapia in Spicy Tomato & Roasted Red Pepper Sauce with Cauliflower Mash
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 1/2 cups
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
3 ozs
Roasted Red Peppers (sliced)
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves (chopped, plus extra for garnish)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2
Tilapia Fillet
1/2 head
Cauliflower (large, cut into florets)
recipe:
Heat half of the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the tomatoes, stir, and simmer for about five minutes. Add the chili flakes and smash half of the tomatoes with a fork.
Add the roasted red peppers and basil and season with salt and pepper. Stir and bring to simmer. Season the tilapia all over with salt and pepper.
Place the fish over the tomato sauce and cover the pan with a lid. Simmer for about ten minutes or until the fish has cooked through. Check halfway through and add a splash of water if necessary.
Meanwhile, steam the cauliflower for five to seven minutes or until fork tender. Mash it with the remaining oil and season with salt and pepper.
Divide the mashed cauliflower, tilapia, and sauce evenly between plates. Top with additional basil leaves (optional), and enjoy!

name: Leek & Basil Pasta
ingredients:
1 cup
Brown Rice Spaghetti
1/2 cup
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1
Leeks (large, trimmed, chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2
Garlic (clove)
1/3 cup
Basil Leaves
1/4 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions.
While the pasta is cooking, add half of the vegetable broth, leeks, salt, and pepper to a pan over medium heat.
Sauté for eight to ten minutes or until the leeks become soft and slightly brown. Add the garlic halfway through. Add a splash of broth if needed.
Add the cooked leeks and garlic to a blender along with the basil, remaining vegetable broth, and coconut milk. Blend until smooth and creamy.
Pour the blended sauce into the pot with the cooked pasta and gently mix to combine. Divide into bowls and season with salt and pepper if desired. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Zucchini & Couscous Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Couscous (uncooked)
1 1/4 cups
Vegetable Broth (hot)
1 1/2 tsps
Raw Honey
1/2 tsp
Cumin (ground)
1 tbsp
White Wine Vinegar
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1
Zucchini (large, sliced lengthwise)
1/3 cup
Feta Cheese (diced)
1 tsp
Lemon Zest
1/4 cup
Mint Leaves (finely chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Place the couscous in a bowl and pour the hot broth over top. Cover and let it stand for five minutes or until the broth has been absorbed.
Make the dressing by whisking together the honey, cumin, vinegar, and half of the oil.
Brush the remaining oil onto the zucchini slices. Grill for two to three minutes per side or until tender.
To serve, place the zucchini, feta, and couscous on a serving plate. Season with the lemon zest and mint and top with the dressing. To serve, divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Orange Tofu
ingredients:
12 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, and cubed)
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
3 tbsps
Tamari (divided)
1 tbsp
Arrowroot Powder (divided)
2 tbsps
Water
1
Navel Orange (large, juiced, zested)
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
1/4 tsp
Ground Ginger
1 stalk
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 400ºF (205ºC).
In a medium-sized bowl, add the tofu, oil, 1/3 of the tamari, 2/3 of the arrowroot powder, and gently toss to combine.
Spread the tofu in an even layer in the air fryer and bake for 12 to 14 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl mix together the remaining arrowroot powder and water to make a slurry. Set aside.
In a small saucepan over medium heat, whisk together the orange juice, orange zest, maple syrup, vinegar, ginger, and remaining tamari. Bring to a low boil for one to two minutes. Whisk the slurry again (if needed) and then pour it into the saucepan. Reduce the heat to low and continuously whisk until thickened, about one to two minutes. Remove from the heat and cool slightly.
Toss the tofu in the sauce until well coated. Divide onto plates and top with green onion. Enjoy!

name: Nectarine, Tomato & Mozzarella Salad
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
White Wine Vinegar
1/2 tsp
Raw Honey

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2
Nectarine (pit removed, sliced)
1 1/2 cups
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
2 1/2 ozs
Mozzarella Ball (torn into pieces)
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves (sliced)
recipe:
In a small bowl, whisk together the oil, vinegar, and honey. Season with salt and pepper.
Place the nectarine and tomatoes onto a serving dish and add the mozzarella. Pour the oil mixture over top and garnish with basil. Divide evenly between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Spinach & Green Pea Pasta
ingredients:
6 ozs
Rigatoni (uncooked)
1/3 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
2/3 cup
Fresh Peas (or frozen and thawed)
2 cups
Baby Spinach
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
2
Garlic (clove)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the rigatoni according to the package directions. Drain, reserving some of the pasta water.
Meanwhile, bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the peas and spinach and simmer for two to three minutes. Strain and immediately transfer to an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Remove the peas and spinach from the ice water and transfer to a blender. Add the yogurt, garlic, salt, and pepper. Blend until smooth.
Transfer the sauce and the pasta to the pot. Stir and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Cook for only two to three minutes or until warmed up.
Divide the pasta evenly between plates. Top with parsley, and enjoy!

name: Classic Vegan Blueberry Muffins
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 tsp
Lemon Juice
11 ozs
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
3/4 cup
Coconut Sugar
2 tsps
Baking Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Ground Ginger
1/3 cup
Coconut Oil (melted)
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 1/2 cups
Blueberries
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC) and line a muffin tray with liners.
Mix together the milk and lemon juice in a small bowl and set aside.
In a large bowl mix together the flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and ginger.
Add the milk mixture, coconut oil, and vanilla to the dry ingredients and stir with a spatula until just combined. Do not over mix. Fold in the blueberries.
Divide the batter evenly between muffin cups. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until firm to the touch and a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Let the muffins cool in the pan for 10 to 15 minutes before removing and transferring to a cooling rack to cool completely. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Plum & Blueberry Crumble
ingredients:
2
Plum (pitted, chopped)
1 cup
Blueberries
1 tsp
Lemon Zest
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup (divided)
1/2 cup
Almond Flour
2 tbsps
Quick Oats
3 tbsps
Butter
1/2 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt (optional)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer at 350ºF (175ºC).
Place the plums and blueberries into ramekins.
In a small bowl, mix together the lemon zest, vanilla, and half of the maple syrup and spread evenly over the fruit.
In a small bowl, mix the flour, oats, and the remaining syrup together. Rub in the butter with your fingers until the mixture is crumbly.
Spread the crumbles evenly over the blueberry-plum mixture. Cook in the air fryer for 12 to 15 minutes or until the tops are golden brown and the berries are soft.
Top with yogurt (optional) and enjoy!

name: Za'atar Spice Blend
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Dried Thyme
1 1/2 tsps
Oregano
1 tbsp
Cumin
1 tbsp
Coriander (ground)
1 tbsp
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
1 tbsp
Ground Sumac
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Add all the spices to a bowl and stir to combine. Store in an airtight jar. Enjoy!

name: Iced Pineapple Green Tea
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
4 cups
Green Tea (brewed, cooled)
1 pint
Pineapple Juice (chilled)
1
Lime (juiced plus lime slices for garnish)
12
Ice Cubes (optional)
recipe:
Add the honey to the brewed tea and mix well. Place in a pitcher in the fridge until chilled.
Once chilled, add the pineapple juice and lime juice. Mix to combine. Pour into glasses, garnish with lime slices and add ice (optional). Enjoy!

name: Tomato Rasam
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Coconut Oil
1/2 tsp
Cumin
1/2 tsp
Ground Fenugreek
1 tsp
Black Pepper
1 tsp
Chili Flakes
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
2
Tomato (medium, chopped)
2 tsps
Tamarind Paste
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (or to taste)
2 cups
Water (divided)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (finely chopped)
recipe:
Heat the coconut oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the cumin, fenugreek, black pepper, chili flakes, and garlic. Toast the spices, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, tamarind paste, salt, and water. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer for about 10 minutes to allow the flavors to combine. Stir in the cilantro.
To serve, divide evenly between bowls or cups and enjoy!

name: Rosewater Lemonade
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Water
1 tsp
Monk Fruit Sweetener
1/8 fl oz
Rose Water
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
4
Ice Cubes (or as needed, optional)
recipe: Add all ingredients to a glass. Stir to combine and enjoy!

name: Potato, Carrot & Red Lentil Soup
ingredients:
5 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
3
Carrot (medium, sliced)
5
Yellow Potato (chopped into chunks)
4
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tsp
Ginger (minced)
1 1/2 tsps
Cumin
1 tsp
Turmeric (ground)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Dry Red Lentils (rinsed)
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
recipe:
Heat a splash of broth in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, carrots, and potatoes and sauté for five minutes, stirring frequently. Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, and turmeric. Season with salt and pepper and cook for an additional one minute or until fragrant.
Add the lentils and the remaining broth. Bring to a boil, cover slightly, and reduce the heat. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until everything is cooked through. Add the lemon juice and taste, seasoning with more salt and pepper if needed.
To serve, divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Plum & Nectarine Crisp
ingredients:
4
Nectarine (medium, pitted, sliced)
4
Plum (medium, pitted, sliced)
1/2 cup
Coconut Sugar (divided)
1 1/4 cups
Oats (rolled)
1/2 cup
Coconut Flour
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Coconut Oil
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a deep baking dish. Add the nectarines, plums, and half of the coconut sugar. Toss to combine then spread the fruit out along the bottom. Set aside.
In a mixing bowl, add the oats, coconut flour, salt, and remaining coconut sugar. Mix to combine.
Add the coconut oil, one tablespoon at a time. Use your fingers to work it in until coarse crumbs form. Add this topping to the fruit and evenly spread it out, gently pressing down.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until the oats turn golden brown. Let it cool for 15 to 20 minutes, allowing the topping to crisp up. To serve, divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Frozen Raspberry Lemonade
ingredients:
1
Lemon
1/2 cup
Coconut Water
3/4 cup
Frozen Raspberries
3 tbsps
Raw Honey
16
Ice Cubes
recipe:
Zest the lemon(s) and set the zest aside. Remove the peel, quarter the lemon(s), and discard the seeds.
Add the lemon and lemon zest to a blender along with the coconut water, frozen raspberries, honey, and ice cubes.
Blend until well combined. Divide evenly between glasses and enjoy!

name: Cherry Oatmeal Bars
ingredients:
2 cups
Oats (rolled)
1 cup
Spelt Flour
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Baking Powder
1/2 cup
Butter (melted)
1/3 cup
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
3 cups
Frozen Cherries
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1/3 cup
Strawberry Jam
2 tsps
Arrowroot Powder
recipe:
In a large bowl, stir together the oats, flour, salt, and baking powder. Add the butter, maple syrup, and vanilla. Stir with a spatula until everything is well combined. Set aside.
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC) and line a pan with parchment paper going in both directions.
In a small saucepan over medium-low heat, combine the cherries, lemon juice, and jam. Bring to a low boil, pressing down on the cherries slightly to break them open. Sprinkle in the arrowroot powder and mix to combine. Simmer for five to seven minutes or until thickened. Remove from the heat.
Add 3/4 of the oat mixture to the pan, pressing down firmly to create an even crust layer. Add the cherry mixture over top. Crumble the remaining 1/4 of the oat mixture over top.
Transfer to the oven and bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until light golden brown on top and the mixture is bubbling.
Let it cool in the pan for at least 45 minutes and then remove using the parchment paper. Let it cool before slicing. Enjoy!

name: Tahini Miso Mushroom Pasta
ingredients:
10
Cremini Mushrooms (sliced)
1/2 cup
Brown Rice Spaghetti
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
1 tbsp
Miso Paste
1/4 cup
Tahini
1 tsp
Chili Flakes

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Parsley (for garnish)
recipe:
Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Once hot, add the mushrooms with a splash of water. Cook and stir occasionally for about 10 minutes or until browned.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti according to package directions. Once done, drain the pasta and reserve some of the pasta water.
Add the miso, tahini, and chili flakes to the mushrooms. Turn down the heat to medium and stir well. Add the pasta to the pan along with the pasta water, adding a little at a time as needed. Stir and cook for about five minutes.
Add salt and pepper and adjust the seasoning to your taste.
Divide the pasta evenly between plates. Top with parsley and more chili flakes, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Zucchini, Bell Pepper & Chickpea Yellow Curry
ingredients:
1
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
1/2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, chopped)
1
Zucchini (large, chopped)
2 tsps
Curry Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
3 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1/2
Lime (juiced)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Heat a pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion with a splash of water and cook for about five minutes or until translucent. Add the bell pepper and zucchini, stir, and cook for another five minutes.
Add the curry powder, salt, and pepper. Cook for two to three minutes, then add the chickpeas and vegetable broth. Stir and cover the pot with a lid. Turn down the heat to low and simmer for about 20 minutes.
Remove the lid, add the coconut milk, and simmer for another five minutes.
Remove from the heat and stir in the lime juice. Divide evenly between bowls and top with cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Sparkling Kiwi Limeade
ingredients:
2
Kiwi (peeled, roughly chopped)
1/2
Lime (juiced)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
10

recipe: Add the kiwi, lime juice, and maple syrup to a blender. Blend until smooth. Divide the kiwi mixture between glasses. Top with ice and sparkling water. Stir and enjoy!

name: Fluffy Matcha & White Chocolate Chip Pancakes
ingredients:

1 tbsp
Green Tea Powder
1 tbsp
Cane Sugar
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil (melted, plus more for pan)
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/2 cup
White Chocolate Chips
recipe:
In a small bowl or large measuring cup, combine the milk and apple cider vinegar. Let it sit for about five minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk the flour, baking powder, green tea powder, sugar, and salt.
Add the milk mixture, coconut oil, and vanilla to the dry ingredients. Mix with a spatula until just combined, some lumps are ok. Gently fold in the chocolate chips.
Heat a well-greased pan over medium heat. Scoop 1/4 cup of the batter at a time into the pan, and cook until bubbles start to form. Flip and cook for another one to two minutes. Repeat with the remaining batter.
Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Broccoli & Potato Soup
ingredients:
1
Leeks (large, trimmed, chopped)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
2
Russet Potato (large, peeled, cubed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Broccoli (cut into small florets, divided)
1/2 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
recipe:
Add the leeks to a large pot over medium heat. Add a few splashes of broth and sauté for three to four minutes.
Add the garlic and sauté for another 30 seconds. Add the potatoes, salt, pepper and the remaining broth. Bring to a boil then lower the heat to a simmer with the lid mostly covered for 10 to 14 minutes or until the potatoes are fork tender. Stir in half of the broccoli with just a few minutes left.
Remove from the heat and use an immersion blender to blend the soup until smooth. Stir in the coconut milk and add the remaining broccoli. Warm the soup for two to three minutes or until the broccoli is tender-crisp.
Divide evenly between bowls and season with salt and pepper, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Bursted Tomato & Basil Pasta
ingredients:
9 ozs
Whole Wheat Spaghetti
1/4 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 cups
Cherry Tomatoes
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
3/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
2 tbsps
Butter
1/2 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3/4 cup
Basil Leaves
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Set aside the cooking water for later.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the tomatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they start to burst and soften, about eight minutes. Gently press down on about half of the tomatoes to create a sauce. Add the garlic and chili flakes and cook for one minute or until fragrant.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and add the cooked spaghetti, butter, reserved water, and parmesan. Toss until everything is coated. Season with salt and pepper and gently fold in the basil.
Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Peaches with Granola
ingredients:
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
2
Peach (cut in half, pit removed)
1/8 tsp
Cinnamon
1 tsp
Butter (softened)
1/4 cup
Granola
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 350ºF (175ºC).
Drizzle the maple syrup over the cut side of the peach. Season with cinnamon and place in the air fryer, cut side up. Bake for nine to ten minutes, until softened and just starting to brown around the edges.
Divide the peaches onto plates and top with butter and granola. Enjoy!

name: Blended Pina Colada Mocktail
ingredients:
1/4 cup

1 cup

1 tbsp

1 tsp
Raw Honey

Ice Cubes
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender. Blend well until combined. Serve and enjoy!

name: Frozen Lemonade
ingredients:
1
Lemon
1/2 cup
Coconut Water

Raw Honey
16
Ice Cubes
recipe:
Zest the lemon(s) and set the zest aside. Remove the peel, quarter the lemon(s), and discard the seeds.
Add the lemon and lemon zest to a blender along with the coconut water, honey, and ice cubes.
Blend until well combined. Divide evenly between glasses and enjoy!

name: Vietnamese-Style Iced Coffee
ingredients:
6
Ice Cubes
1 cup
Coffee (brewed, chilled)

Sweetened Condensed Milk, Low Fat
recipe:
Add ice cubes to a tall glass.
Pour the chilled coffee over top of the ice then add the milk. Stir and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Cauliflower & Chickpea Salad
ingredients:
1/2 head
Cauliflower (large, chopped into small florets)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp

recipe:
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the cauliflower and blanch for one minute. Drain and add to a large bowl with the oil and lemon juice. Let it cool to room temperature.
Once it has cooled, add the remaining ingredients to the bowl. Stir to combine. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Pesto & Nectarine Pizza
ingredients:
8 ozs
Pizza Dough (store bought)
1/2 cup
Pesto (plus more for serving)
1/2
Nectarine (medium, sliced)
4 ozs
Burrata
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves
1 tbsp
Balsamic Glaze

recipe:
Place the dough in a large bowl and cover it with a tea towel. Leave it on counter for at least 30 minutes to rise and come to room temperature.
Preheat the oven to 500°F (260°C).
Lightly dust a clean surface on the counter with flour. Roll the dough out to approximately one inch (2.5 cm) in thickness. Transfer it to a lightly greased baking sheet or pizza pan.
Spread the pesto onto the pizza dough and add the nectarine slices. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown on the bottom.
Cut into the burrata and use a spoon to add dollops onto the pizza followed by basil leaves. Drizzle the balsamic glaze all over and top with flaky salt. Cut into slices and enjoy!

name: Matcha Mint Coconut Mocktail
ingredients:

Sparkling Water
recipe:
In a cocktail shaker with a lid, add the green tea powder, water, and honey. Whisk until well combined. Add the mint, orange juice, coconut water, and half the ice.
Place the lid on top and shake until well combined
Place the remaining ice into a glass. Pour the drink into the glass using a sieve. Top with sparkling water and extra mint, if using. Enjoy!

name: Hummus Mushroom & Spinach Wrap
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 cup
Mushrooms (sliced)
1/2 cup
Baby Spinach

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Hummus
1
Whole Wheat Tortilla (large)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms and sauté for about five minutes or until browned. Add the spinach, salt, and pepper. Stir and cook for another two minutes.
Spread the hummus onto the tortilla. Top with the mushroom mixture and roll tightly into a wrap, tucking in the sides.
Toast the wrap in a panini press for two to three minutes, or in a pan on the stovetop. Enjoy!

name: Wasabi Peas
ingredients:
2 ozs
Wasabi Peas
recipe: Place in a bowl or container if on-the-go. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Summer Squash with Labneh & Chimichurri
ingredients:

Zucchini (medium, cut into big chunks)

1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray

Fresh Oregano (chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2 cup
Labneh
recipe:
Preheat the grill over medium heat. Season the zucchini all over with salt and pepper.
Place the zucchini directly on the grill or on a grill mat and spray with avocado oil. Grill for 12 to 15 minutes, or until cooked and browned, flipping occasionally.
Meanwhile, in a bowl, stir together the olive oil, vinegar, parsley, oregano, and garlic. Taste and add salt and pepper or adjust seasoning as needed. Spread the labneh onto a serving plate. Top with the grilled zucchini and spoon the chimichurri on top. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Whipped Coconut Raspberry Fool

Vanilla Extract

Raspberries
recipe:

Use a fork and smash the raspberries in a bowl.
Layer the coconut cream and smashed raspberries into small bowls, jars, or a glass. Use a spoon and gently swirl the layers. Enjoy!

name: Dried Apricots & Sunflower Seeds
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Dried Apricots
1/4 cup
Sunflower Seeds (toasted)
recipe: Combine apricots and seeds in a bowl or container if on-the-go. Enjoy!

name: Herby Quinoa & Chickpea Salad
ingredients:

In a small bowl, combine the lemon juice, nutritional yeast, mustard, honey, water, salt and pepper. Add more water if needed to thin out. Whisk the dressing one more time before pouring over the salad. Mix to combine. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker White Bean & Farro Soup
ingredients:
1
Yellow Onion (small, chopped)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
2
Carrot (medium, chopped)
2 stalks
Celery (chopped)

Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with the juices)
1/2 cup
Farro (uncooked, rinsed)
2 tbsps
Italian Seasoning
1 1/2 cups
Swiss Chard (chopped)
recipe:
Turn the pressure cooker to "sauté" mode. Add the onion and a few splashes of broth. Sauté for three to four minutes or until the onions have softened. Add the garlic and sauté for another 30 to 60 seconds.
Add the carrots, celery, beans, diced tomatoes, farro, broth, and Italian seasoning. Stir to combine and close the lid of the pressure cooker. Set to “sealing” and press manual/pressure cooker. Cook for six minutes on high pressure. Once it is done, allow the pressure to release naturally for five minutes, and then release any remaining pressure manually. Remove the lid carefully.
Stir in the Swiss chard and let it sit for two to three minutes. Divide the soup evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Fluffy Vegan Chocolate Chip Pancakes
ingredients:

Oat Milk

Baking Powder

Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Coconut Oil (melted, plus more for pan)
3/4 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
1/3 cup
Maple Syrup (for serving, optional)
recipe:
In a small bowl or large measuring cup, combine the milk with apple cider vinegar and let it sit for about five minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the milk mixture and coconut oil into the bowl with the dry ingredients. Mix with a spatula until just combined (some lumps are ok). Gently fold in the chocolate chips.
Heat a well-greased pan over medium heat. Scoop 1/4 cup of the batter at a time into the pan, and cook until bubbles start to form. Flip and cook for another one to two minutes. Repeat with the remaining batter.
Divide onto plates and serve with maple syrup (if using). Enjoy!

name: Caramelized Zucchini Pasta
ingredients:
9 ozs
Whole Wheat Linguine

Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Zucchini (large, sliced)

Anchovy (fillets, whole)

Butter

recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Set aside some of the cooking water for later.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the zucchini and sauté for about seven to nine minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and slightly browned in spots. Season with salt and pepper, remove with a slotted spoon, and set aside. Reduce the heat to low and add the garlic and anchovy. Cook for about two minutes, stirring often, until softened and fragrant.
Add the cooked linguine to the pan along with the reserved pasta water, lemon juice, lemon zest, butter, zucchini, and parmesan cheese. Toss until everything is combined and season with salt and pepper.
Divide evenly between plates and top with basil. Enjoy!

name: Kiwi Granola Chia Pudding

Granola

Kiwi (peeled, sliced)

Divide the chia pudding, granola, and kiwi evenly between jars or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Dried Apricots & Pumpkin Seeds

1/4 cup
Dried Apricots
1/4 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
recipe: Combine apricots and seeds in a bowl or container if on-the-go. Enjoy!

Dried Parsley

Dried Thyme

name: Wasabi Peas & Popcorn
ingredients:
4 cups
Popcorn
2 ozs
Wasabi Peas
recipe: Combine popcorn and peas in a bowl or container if on-the-go. Enjoy!

name: Cherry Cobbler
ingredients:
4 cups
Frozen Cherries
1/2 cup
Coconut Sugar (divided)
1 1/2 cups
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
1 1/2 tsps
Baking Powder
1/4 cup
Coconut Oil
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 1/2 cups
Coconut Ice Cream
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC).
Add the cherries and half of the coconut sugar to a well-greased baking dish. Mix to coat the cherries and then spread the cherries out into an even layer.
In a bowl, mix together the flour, remaining coconut sugar, and baking powder. Use a spoon to add dollops of the coconut oil into the bowl then use a pastry cutter, fork, or clean hands to cut the oil into the flour until mostly combined.
Stir in the milk and vanilla until a dough forms that is slightly crumbly but can be formed with your hands. Using a cookie scoop or spoon, scoop the dough into dollops and drop it onto the cherries. Repeat with the remaining dough all over the cherries.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until the top is slightly golden brown. Let it cool for 10 to 15 minutes before dividing evenly between bowls. Top with ice cream and enjoy!

name: Whipped Coconut & Mashed Blueberry Parfait
ingredients:
1 cup
Coconut Cream (chilled in the fridge overnight)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 cup
Blueberries
1/2 cup
Granola
recipe:
Add the chilled coconut cream, maple syrup, and vanilla to a bowl. Using a hand mixer, whip the mixture on medium speed for two to three minutes or until light and fluffy.
Use a fork and smash the blueberries in a bowl. Layer the coconut cream, mashed blueberries, and granola into jars, small bowls, or glasses. Enjoy!

name: Kale Pici Cacio e Pepe
ingredients:
4 cups
Baby Kale
6 ozs
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
2 tsps
Sea Salt (divided)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3/4 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
1 tsp
Black Pepper (freshly ground)
1 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)
recipe:
Add the kale, flour, and 1/4 of the salt to a food processor. Blend until a vibrant green and smooth dough forms, scraping down the sides if needed.
Transfer the dough to a clean flat work surface. Pinch off small amounts of the dough, about a teaspoon each and roll them into long, skinny noodles.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the remaining salt.
Drop the noodles into the boiling water. Boil for about one minute, or until they float to the surface. Set aside some of the pasta water before draining.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the black pepper and toast until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add 1/3 of the pasta water to the toasted pepper.
Transfer the noodles to the pan. Add the parmesan and the remaining pasta water. Raise the heat to medium-high and continue cooking and tossing for two minutes until the cheese melts and the sauce thickens.
Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Raisins & Pistachios
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Pistachios
2 tbsps
Raisins
recipe: Add the pistachios and raisins to a plate or bowl. Enjoy!

name: Dalgona Whipped Coffee

2 tbsps
Instant Coffee
2 tbsps
Monk Fruit Sweetener
2 tbsps
Water (hot)
4
Ice Cubes (or as needed)
1 cup
Cow's Milk, Whole
recipe:
In a small bowl, combine the instant coffee, sweetener, and hot water. Whip the mixture with a hand mixer or milk frother, until it becomes thick and creamy.
Fill a glass with ice and pour in the milk.
Spoon the whipped coffee mixture over the milk and stir well. Enjoy!

name: Dried Apricots & Walnuts
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Walnuts
1/4 cup
Dried Apricots
recipe: Add the walnuts and apricots to a plate or bowl. Enjoy!

name: Cherry Compote

Cherries (fresh or frozen)
2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
2 tbsps
Water
recipe:
In a saucepan, over medium heat, add the cherries, coconut sugar and water. Stir until the sugar dissolves.
Cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until the cherries have released their juices and have softened. Remove from the heat and let it cool completely before transferring to a glass jar. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Enjoy!

name: Tahini & Pistachio Date Bark
ingredients:
2 1/2 cups
Pitted Dates
1/2 cup
Tahini
3 tbsps
Pistachios (chopped)
1/2 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
1/2 tsp
Coconut Oil
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Take a pitted date and place it cut side down onto the parchment paper. Flatten it with your hands. Do the same with the remaining dates, building an even layer resembling a square. Make sure there are no gaps.
Spread the tahini overtop of the dates. Sprinkle the chopped pistachios all over.
Melt the chocolate and coconut oil in a double boiler or in 30-second intervals in the microwave
Carefully spread the melted chocolate on top of the bark. Sprinkle flaky salt all over. Refrigerate for about one hour or until the chocolate has hardened.
When ready, cut the bark into equal size pieces. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea & Sundried Tomato Wrap
ingredients:
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/4 cup
Sun Dried Tomato Pesto
1/2
Tomato (large, diced)
2 tbsps
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
2 cups
Baby Spinach
2
Whole Wheat Tortilla
recipe:
In a bowl, combine the chickpeas, pesto, tomatoes, feta, and spinach.
Distribute the mixture evenly between the tortillas. Fold each tortilla tightly into wraps, and enjoy!

name: Lemon Ginger Salty Mocktail
ingredients:
1 cup
Ginger (fresh, sliced)
6 cups
Water
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Raw Honey
1/2 cup
Lemon Juice
1/2 cup
Apple Cider Vinegar
12
Ice Cubes
1 cup
Sparkling Water (or to taste)
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves (or to taste)
recipe:
In a medium saucepan, bring the sliced ginger and water to a boil. Turn off the heat and let it sit for 20 to 30 minutes.
In a large jar or lidded glass container, combine the salt, honey, lemon juice, and vinegar.
Strain out the ginger and add the liquid to the glass container. Mix well to combine all ingredients.
Pour the ginger mixture into a glass filled with ice. Top with sparkling water.
Stir, top with mint (optional) and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Spaghetti Squash Parmesan
ingredients:
1
Spaghetti Squash (small, halved lengthwise, seeds removed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)

Parmigiano Reggiano (grated, divided)

Bread Crumbs

Marinara Sauce

Mozzarella Cheese (shredded)

Basil Leaves (plus more for garnish)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 400ºF (205ºC).
Brush the squash halves with half of the oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Cook the squash in the air fryer, cut side up, for 20 to 25 minutes, or until tender.
Meanwhile, mix half the parmesan with the breadcrumbs and the remaining oil. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside.
Once cooked, use a fork to carefully shred the squash flesh while keeping it in the shell.
Divide the marinara, mozzarella, remaining parmesan, and basil between squash halves. Stir to combine.
Add the breadcrumb mixture over top and return to the air fryer for five to seven minutes or until the cheese melts and the breadcrumbs have browned.
Garnish with extra basil (optional) and season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Strawberries with Melted Chocolate & Pistachios

1/2 cup
Milk Chocolate Chips

Coconut Oil
2 cups
Strawberries (tops removed, halved)
1 tbsp
Pistachios (finely chopped)

Place the strawberries in a glass or bowl. Drizzle the chocolate over top and top with pistachios. Enjoy!

name: Edamame, Bell Pepper & Orange Snack Box

1/2 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Apple Cider Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Red Bell Pepper (small, sliced)
1/2
Navel Orange (cut into wedges)
1/4 cup
Tzatziki
recipe: Add the edamame to one side of a sectioned storage container. Add the oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper and mix to combine with the edamame. Assemble the remaining ingredients into the storage container and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!

name: Dried Figs & Almonds
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Dried Fig
1/4 cup
Almonds
recipe: Combine figs and nuts in a bowl or container if on-the-go. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Mushroom Barley Stew
ingredients:
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (large, chopped)
18
Cremini Mushrooms (sliced)
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
White Wine Vinegar
3 stalks
Celery (chopped)
2
Carrot (medium, chopped)
3 tbsps
Tomato Paste
1/2 cup
Pearl Barley (uncooked)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
5 cups
Vegetable Broth
recipe:
Turn the pressure cooker to "sauté" mode. Add the oil and once hot, add the onion and mushrooms. Cook for three to five minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms release some water. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds or until fragrant. Stir in the vinegar.
Add the celery, carrot, tomato paste, and barley and stir to combine. Season with salt and pepper. Turn "sauté" off.
Add the broth and cover with the lid. Set the pressure cooker to "sealing" and cook on high pressure for 15 minutes. Allow the pressure to release naturally.
Carefully remove the lid. Divide the stew evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Melon with Mint Lime Vinaigrette
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
1 tbsp
Mint Leaves (or to taste)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Honeydew Melon (small, peeled, seeds removed and sliced)
recipe:
In a small bowl, whisk together oil, lime juice, mint, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Drizzle the vinaigrette on top of the melon and enjoy!

name: Sesame Soy Cucumber Salad
ingredients:
2
Cucumber (medium)
1 tbsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 tsps
Soy Sauce
1/2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
1 tbsp
Sweet Chili Sauce
1 tsp
Sesame Oil
2 tsps
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
3 stalks
Green Onion (sliced)
recipe:
Slice the cucumber using a spiralizer or a knife.
Sprinkle salt over the cucumbers and let it sit for eight to 12 minutes. Rinse and pat dry.
In a small bowl, mix together the soy sauce, garlic, vinegar, chili sauce, sesame oil, sesame seeds, and green onions. Stir until well combined.
Toss the cucumbers in the dressing until evenly coated. Enjoy!

name: Pitted Prunes & Almonds
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Pitted Prunes
1/4 cup
Almonds
recipe: Add the prunes and almonds to a plate or bowl. Enjoy!

name: Dried Figs & Pretzels
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Dried Fig
2 ozs
Pretzels
recipe: Combine figs and pretzels in a bowl or container if on-the-go. Enjoy!

name: Lentil & Bell Pepper Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
1
Orange Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (finely chopped)
3 tbsps
Parsley (finely chopped)

Fresh Oregano (finely chopped)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

White Wine Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the lentils according to the package directions. Once cooked, drain and rinse under cold water then add to a large bowl.
Add the remaining ingredients to the bowl and toss to combine. Refrigerate for 30 to 60 minutes to bring out the flavors. When ready to eat, taste, and add more vinegar if desired.
Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Pitted Prunes & Walnuts
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Pitted Prunes
1/4 cup
Walnuts
recipe: Add the prunes and walnuts to a plate or bowl. Enjoy!

name: Pear & Almonds

Almonds

Pear (sliced)
recipe: Add the almonds and sliced pear to a plate or bowl. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Chips, Dried Cranberries & Walnuts
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Dark Chocolate Chips
3 tbsps
Dried Unsweetened Cranberries
1/4 cup
Walnuts
recipe: Add the chocolate chips, dried cranberries and walnuts to a bowl or container if on-the-go. Enjoy!

name: Brie & Pistachio Stuffed Dates
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Pitted Dates (sliced open)
3 ozs
Brie Cheese (sliced)
1 tbsp
Pistachios (chopped)
recipe: Stuff each date with a piece of brie cheese. Sprinkle the pistachios on top and enjoy!

name: Navel Orange & Almonds
ingredients:
1
Navel Orange (cut into wedges)
1/4 cup
Almonds
recipe: Add the orange wedges and almonds to a plate or bowl. Enjoy!

name: Raspberry Protein Overnight Oats
ingredients:
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk

Oats (rolled)

Chia Seeds
3 tbsps
Vanilla Protein Powder

Cinnamon (plus more for garnish)
1/2 cup

Almonds (chopped)
recipe:
Add the milk, oats, chia seeds, protein powder, and cinnamon to a bowl or container and stir to combine.
Refrigerate overnight then top with raspberries, chopped almonds, and cinnamon (optional) before eating. Enjoy!

name: Raspberry & Apple Flax Smoothie
ingredients:

Almonds

name: Cinnamon Pear Overnight Oats
ingredients:

Oats (rolled)
1 1/2 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
2
Pear (chopped)
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a large bowl or container. Stir to combine. Place in the fridge for eight hours or overnight.
Divide the oats evenly between bowls or containers and enjoy!

name: Tahini Stuffed Dates
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Tahini
1/2 cup
Pitted Dates (sliced open)
1/4 tsp
Sesame Seeds
recipe: Spread the tahini into the dates and add the sesame seeds on top. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Apple Cinnamon Apple Chips
ingredients:
1
Apple (small, cored, thinly sliced and seeds removed)
1 tbsp
Coconut Sugar
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/2 tsp
Coconut Oil (melted)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 325ºF (165ºC).
Place the apple slices in a bowl and add the sugar, cinnamon, and coconut oil. Toss well to combine.
Place the apple slices in an even layer in the air fryer basket, trying not to overlap too much.
Cook for 15 minutes, tossing every five minutes, until lightly browned and crispy. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Peanut Cucumber Salad
ingredients:
1
Cucumber (medium, thinly sliced)
2 tbsps
All Natural Peanut Butter
1 tbsp
Tamari
2 tsps
Rice Vinegar
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1
Garlic (clove, small, grated)
