Chili Flakes
1 tsp
Sesame Oil
1 tsp
Sesame Seeds
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a large container with a lid or mason jar. Shake vigorously until the cucumber is well coated.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Smashed Chickpea Salad
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2
Orange Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (chopped)
1/4 cup
Shallot (finely chopped)
3 tbsps
Cilantro (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1/2 tsp
Oregano

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Add the chickpeas to a large bowl and lightly mash with a fork.
Add the remaining ingredients and stir to combine. Taste and season if needed. Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Pear & Spinach Smoothie
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1
Pear (cored and chopped)

Baby Spinach
1/4 cup

1 tbsp

recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and enjoy!

name: Raspberry & Almond Oatmeal
ingredients:
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2 cup
Oats (rolled)
2 tbsps
Vanilla Protein Powder
1/4 cup
Raspberries
1 tbsp
Unsweetened Coconut Flakes
1 tsp
Cinnamon
recipe:
Bring the almond milk to a boil in a small saucepan. Add the oats and protein powder. Reduce to a steady simmer and cook, stirring occasionally for about five minutes or until the oats are tender and most of the water is absorbed.
Transfer the cooked oats to a bowl. Top with raspberries, coconut flakes, and cinnamon. Enjoy!

name: Edamame, Broccoli & Chickpea Pasta Salad
ingredients:
4 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (dry)
1 cup
Broccoli (cut into florets)
2 tbsps

Apple Cider Vinegar

Italian Seasoning

1 tbsp
Nutritional Yeast
1 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1/2
Cucumber (medium, sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to package directions. Add the broccoli for the two last minutes of cooking.
In a large bowl, combine the remaining ingredients. Add the pasta and broccoli and season with salt and pepper to taste. Toss well to coat.
Serve immediately or chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Thai Cucumber Salad
ingredients:
1
Cucumber (medium, thinly sliced)
1 tbsp
Tamari
2 tsps
Avocado Oil
2 tsps
Lime Juice

Fish Sauce

Coconut Sugar

3 tbsps
Cilantro (roughly chopped)
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a large container with a lid or mason jar. Shake vigorously until the cucumber is well-coated.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Curry Tofu & Spinach Chickpea Pasta
ingredients:
4 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (dry)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
12 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, crumbled)
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1 tsp
Curry Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
Baby Spinach
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/3 cup
Cilantro (chopped, plus more for garnish)
2 tbsps
Almonds (toasted, chopped)
recipe:
Cook the pasta to al dente according to package directions.
In a large pan, heat half of the oil over medium heat. Add the tofu and season with garlic powder, curry powder, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the tofu is golden and slightly crispy, about five to seven minutes. Add spinach and milk and simmer for two more minutes.
Add the cooked pasta and cilantro. Toss to coat with the sauce.
Divide evenly between bowls. Top with almonds and cilantro, and enjoy!

name: Cucumber & Edamame Salad
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Apple Cider Vinegar
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2
Cucumber (large, sliced)
1 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1/4 cup
Almonds (chopped)
recipe:
In a bowl, whisk together the oil, vinegar, cilantro, salt and pepper.
Add the cucumber, edamame, and chopped almonds. Stir well to combine. Divide evenly between bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Tahini & Honey Oat Bites
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Oats (rolled)
2/3 cup
Tahini (runny, drippy)
3 tbsps
Raw Honey
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
recipe:
Add the oats to a food processor and blend until it reaches a flour consistency.
Add the tahini, honey, and vanilla and blend until combined and the mixture holds together.
Use a cookie scoop or a tablespoon to scoop out the mixture and roll them into balls in your hands. Repeat until all of the mixture is used. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea & Spinach Pasta Salad
ingredients:
4 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (dry)
1/2 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 cup
Baby Spinach
1/2
Cucumber (medium, diced)
1/2
Orange Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
1 1/2 tbsps
Shallot (finely chopped)
1/2 cup
Cottage Cheese
1 tbsp
Hemp Seeds
2 tbsps
Italian Dressing

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the chickpea pasta according to the package directions. Drain and let it cool.
In a large bowl, combine the chickpeas, spinach, cucumbers, bell peppers, shallots, cottage cheese, hemp seeds, Italian dressing, and the cooked pasta. Season with salt and pepper to taste and toss well to coat everything evenly.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes to allow the pasta to fully cool and the flavors to combine. Divide evenly between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Strawberry & Orange Protein Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2 cup
Frozen Strawberries
1
Navel Orange (peeled and sectioned)
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tbsp
Ground Flax Seed
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Enjoy!

name: Spaghetti Squash with Mushroom Marinara Sauce
ingredients:
1
Spaghetti Squash (medium)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
8
Cremini Mushrooms (sliced)
1/2 cup
Walnuts (chopped)
1 1/4 cups
Marinara Sauce
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast (divided)
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Slice the spaghetti squash into even rings through its belly. Carve out the seeds and set aside. Place the rings onto the baking sheet and drizzle with half the oil and season with salt and pepper. Cook in the oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Remove the squash from the oven and let it cool. Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the mushrooms and cook for seven to eight minutes, until softened and some water has released. Add the walnuts and cook for another four to five minutes, stirring occasionally, until toasted. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the marinara sauce into the pan and stir to combine. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for five minutes or until warmed. Stir in half the nutritional yeast.
Use a fork to shred the flesh of the squash into noodles and divide evenly between plates. Top with the sauce, remaining nutritional yeast, and basil. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry & Flax Seed Chia Pudding
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
2 tsps
Ground Flax Seed
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2 tbsps
Sunflower Seed Butter
1/3 cup
Strawberries (chopped)
1 tbsp
Almonds (chopped)
recipe:
In a bowl, stir together the chia seeds, flax seeds, milk, vanilla, and sunflower seed butter. Refrigerate for at least two hours or until chilled and the chia seeds have set.
Serve the chia pudding topped with strawberries and almonds. Enjoy!

name: Harissa Lentil Stew
ingredients:
4 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
3
Carrot (medium, chopped)
1
Yellow Onion (chopped)
3 stalks
Celery (chopped)
1 tsp
Cumin

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Harissa
3 cups
Fire Roasted Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with juices)
1 1/4 cups
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
5 cups
Baby Spinach
recipe:
Heat a splash of broth in a large pot over medium heat. Add the carrot, onion, and celery and sauté for five minutes or until tender, stirring frequently. Stir in the cumin and season with salt and pepper.
Add the harissa and cook for one minute, stirring to combine. Add the tomatoes, lentils, and remaining broth. Bring to a boil and then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the spinach and let it sit for two to three minutes until wilted. Divide the soup evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Cinnamon Pear Baked Oatmeal
ingredients:
2 cups
Oats (rolled)
1 tsp
Cinnamon
3/4 tsp
Baking Powder
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
2 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
3
Pear (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC) and grease a baking dish, or line it with parchment paper. Add the oats, cinnamon, baking powder, and salt to a large bowl and mix well. Add the milk, maple syrup, and vanilla and mix to combine. Fold in the pears.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until cooked through. Remove from the oven and let it cool for ten minutes. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: One Pot Cajun Spiced Haddock
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (small, chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1
Tomato (large, chopped)
1/2
Green Bell Pepper (large, diced)
1 1/2 tsps
Cajun Spice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2
Haddock Fillet
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
1/4
Lemon (sliced)
recipe:
Preheat the oil in a deep pan over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and sauté for two to three minutes or until softened.
Add the tomatoes, bell peppers, and Cajun spice. Stir and cook for three to four minutes or until the tomatoes soften. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the fish fillets to the vegetables. Cover and cook on medium-low for eight to 10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Divide evenly between plates. Season with cilantro and serve with lemon slices for squeezing. Enjoy!

name: Tofu Quinoa Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (uncooked)
8 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, cubed)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 tbsp
Nutritional Yeast
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Orange Bell Pepper (large, sliced)
2 cups
Baby Spinach
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions. Set aside.
Add the tofu cubes to a bowl and gently toss with half of the oil, nutritional yeast, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Heat the remaining oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the bell peppers and sauté for three to four minutes. Add the spinach and sauté for another one to two minutes or until slightly wilted.
Make room in the middle of the pan to add the marinated tofu and any remaining marinade from the bowl. Cook the tofu for two to three minutes or until browned on the top and bottom. Add a splash of water if needed.
Divide the quinoa, tofu, and sautéed veggies into bowls. Season with salt and pepper if desired. Enjoy!

name: Spinach & Artichoke Naan Pizza
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
4 cups
Baby Spinach

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3/4 cup
Artichoke Hearts (from the jar, drained and coarsely chopped)
4 ozs
Mozzarella Cheese (grated)
1/4 cup
Cream Cheese, Regular (softened)
2 pieces
Naan
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for one to two minutes. Add the spinach and season with salt and pepper. Cook until wilted and remove from the pan.
Add the spinach and artichokes to a bowl and mix to combine.
In a separate bowl, combine the mozzarella cheese and cream cheese until well combined. Season with salt and pepper.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly onto the naan. Top with the spinach and artichoke mixture. Place the pizzas on the prepared baking sheet. Cook in the oven for 12 to 14 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the naan is golden. Slice once slightly cooled and enjoy!

name: Chocolate, Cauliflower & Hemp Seed Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Cow's Milk, Whole
1 cup
Frozen Cauliflower
1 1/2 tsps
Cacao Powder
1/4 cup
Chocolate Protein Powder
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
1/16 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and enjoy!

name: Haddock with Tomato Caper Sauce
ingredients:
2
Haddock Fillet
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/4 cup
Shallot (chopped, divided)
1
Tomato (large, chopped)
1 1/2 tsps
White Wine Vinegar
1 tbsp
Capers (drained)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped, plus more for garnish)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the fish on the prepared baking sheet and brush with half of the oil. Season with salt and pepper. Cook in the oven for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a pan over medium-low heat. Sauté the garlic and shallots for one to two minutes or until softened.
Add the tomatoes and vinegar and season with salt and pepper. Cook for about four to five minutes or until the tomatoes soften. Stir in the capers and parsley, cooking for one more minute.
Place the fish on a serving platter. Top with the tomato caper sauce and season with fresh parsley. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Vegan Pumpkin Pancakes
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Pureed Pumpkin
1 1/2 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
2 tsps
Apple Cider Vinegar
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil (plus more for pan)
7 ozs
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
1 tbsp
Baking Powder
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tsps
Pumpkin Pie Spice
1/3 cup
Maple Syrup (for serving, optional)
recipe:
In a large bowl, combine the pumpkin, milk, vinegar, vanilla, and oil. Let it sit for about five minutes.
Add the flour, baking powder, salt, and pumpkin pie spice to the wet ingredients in the bowl. Mix with a spatula until just combined (some lumps are ok). Heat a well-greased pan over medium heat. Scoop 1/4 cup of the batter into the pan at a time, and cook until bubbles start to form. Flip and cook for another one to two minutes. Remove from the pan and repeat with the remaining batter.
Divide evenly between plates and serve with maple syrup (if using). Enjoy!

name: Asparagus & Mushroom Pasta
ingredients:
4 ozs
Farfalle (dry)
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
6
Cremini Mushrooms (medium, quartered)
1 cup
Asparagus (trimmed, chopped)
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to package directions. Drain, reserving some of the pasta water.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms, asparagus, and a splash of reserved pasta water. Stir frequently and cook for about 10 minutes or until the vegetables are cooked and browned.
Add the cooked pasta and half of the nutritional yeast to the pan along with the reserved pasta water. Stir and bring to simmer until it reaches a slightly creamy consistency. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide the pasta between serving plates. Top with the remaining nutritional yeast and enjoy!

name: Caramelized Leek Pasta
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Butter (divided)
1
Leeks (large, white and light green parts, chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
10 ozs
Rigatoni (uncooked)
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
4
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced, zested)
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
3 tbsps
Chives (finely chopped)
recipe:
In a large Dutch oven or heavy-bottomed pot, melt half of the butter over medium-low heat. Add the leeks and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are completely softened and starting to brown around the edges, about 25 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Meanwhile, cook the rigatoni according to the package directions. Drain, reserving some of the pasta water.
Add the garlic to the leeks and cook for one to two minutes, until fragrant. Add the rigatoni, reserved pasta water, remaining butter, parmesan cheese, lemon juice, lemon zest, and chili flakes. Toss until everything is well coated. Season with salt and pepper and top with chives.
Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Oil-Free Three Bean Salad
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 1/2 cups
Red Kidney Beans (cooked)
1 1/2 cups
Cannellini Beans (cooked)
1/3 cup
Cilantro (finely chopped)
2 stalks
Celery (chopped)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (finely chopped)
1/4 cup
Apple Cider Vinegar
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1/2 tsp
Dijon Mustard

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
In a large bowl, add the chickpeas, kidney beans, cannellini beans, cilantro, celery, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar, honey, mustard, salt and pepper. Pour the dressing over the salad. Toss to combine. Taste and add more seasoning, if desired.
Divide into bowls and enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Pie Spice Blend
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Cinnamon
2 tsps
Ground Ginger
1 tsp
Nutmeg
1/2 tsp
Ground Allspice
1/2 tsp
Ground Cloves
recipe: Add all of the ingredients into a bowl or a jar and mix well. Seal and store in the pantry. Enjoy!

name: Parsnip, Potato & Ginger Soup
ingredients:
4 1/4 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1
Yellow Onion (small, chopped)
1 stalk
Celery (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tsp
Ginger (fresh, grated)
2
Parsnip (medium, peeled, chopped)
1
Yellow Potato (large, peeled, chopped)
1 1/2 tsps
Dijon Mustard
1/4 cup
Pumpkin Seeds (roasted, optional)
recipe:
Heat a splash of broth in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté the onions and celery until tender. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the garlic and ginger, cooking for one minute while stirring.
Add the parsnips, potatoes, and the remaining broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat. Simmer for 12 to 15 minutes or until the vegetables are soft.
Add the Dijon mustard and blend the soup with a stick blender until smooth. Alternatively, add the soup to a blender and blend in batches as needed.
Divide evenly between bowls. Top with pumpkin seeds (optional) and enjoy!

name: Southwest Sheet Pan Dinner
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (large, cubed)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
2 tbsps
Chili Powder (divided)
1/2 tsp
Chipotle Powder (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, chopped)
1 cup
Frozen Corn
1 1/2 cups
Black Beans (cooked)
1
Lime (juiced)
1/2 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, add the sweet potato, half of the oil, half of the chili powder, half of the chipotle powder, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine.
Add the sweet potato to the baking sheet and spread out into an even layer. Place in the oven and cook for 10 minutes.
In the same bowl, add the bell peppers, corn, remaining oil, remaining chili powder, remaining chipotle powder, salt and pepper. Toss to combine.
Remove the sweet potato from the oven and toss them around before adding the bell peppers and corn. Spread out into an even layer. Place back in the oven and cook for another 10 to 15 minutes.
Lastly, remove the baking sheet from the oven and add the black beans. Place back in the oven for another five to ten minutes or until the vegetables are fork tender and slightly browned.
Divide evenly between bowls and top with lime juice and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Spaghetti Squash & Lentil Soup
ingredients:
1
Spaghetti Squash (small, halved lengthwise, seeds removed)
6 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1
Yellow Onion (small, chopped)
3
Carrot (medium, diced)
2 stalks
Celery (diced)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tsp
Thyme (fresh)
2 tsps
Celery Salt
2 cups
Lentils (cooked)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the squash on the prepared baking sheet, flesh-side down. Cook for 30 to 35 minutes, or until the squash is fork-tender. Once the squash has finished cooking, take a fork, and loosen the squash strands. Scrape them into a bowl and set these aside for later.
Meanwhile, heat a splash of broth in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion, carrots, celery, and garlic and sauté for three to five minutes, or until the veggies are just tender.
Add the remaining broth, thyme, and celery salt. Bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer. Simmer for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the veggies are fully cooked.
Add the lentils and the cooked spaghetti squash noodles to the soup and stir. Cook until warmed through. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Cabbage & White Bean Soup
ingredients:
8 1/4 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1
Leeks (medium, sliced)
6 cups
Coleslaw Mix

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Tomato Paste
1 tbsp
Rosemary (fresh, finely chopped)
2 cups
White Navy Beans (drained, rinsed)
1/2 cup
Parsley (chopped, optional)
recipe:
Heat a splash of broth in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the leeks and coleslaw mix to the pot. Cook for five minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Add the remaining broth and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and add the tomato paste and rosemary. Simmer for seven to 10 minutes.
Stir in the beans and cook for another five minutes or until everything is heated through. Garnish with parsley (optional) and divide evenly between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Oil-Free Pecan Banana Bread
ingredients:
3
Banana (very ripe)
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
1/2 cup
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 1/2 cups
Spelt Flour
2 tsps
Baking Powder
2 tsps
Pumpkin Pie Spice
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 cup
Hemp Seeds
1/2 cup
Pecans (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a loaf pan with parchment paper.
In a mixing bowl, mash the bananas with a fork until smooth. Stir in the coconut yogurt, maple syrup, and vanilla.
Add the flour, baking powder, pumpkin pie spice, and salt. Mix until well combined and smooth. Stir in the hemp seeds and most of the pecans, leaving some for garnish (optional).
Add the batter into the prepared loaf pan and smooth it out into an even layer. Top with the remaining pecans, if desired.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick comes out with a couple of crumbs on it. The top should be firm. Let it cool for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing. Enjoy!

name: Overnight Quick Oats with Stewed Apples
ingredients:
1
Apple (large, cored, chopped)
1/4 cup
Water
1 tsp
Cinnamon
2 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk (divided)
1/2 cup
Quick Oats
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1/4 cup
Chia Seeds
recipe:
Add the chopped apples, water, and cinnamon to a small pot. Mix to combine.
Bring to a boil then reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until the apples are soft and fork tender. Remove from the heat and set aside.
Add half of the milk to a small saucepan over low heat. When tiny bubbles begin to form, add the oats and cook for one to two minutes, stirring often.
Cover and remove from the heat. Let it sit for two to three minutes.
Divide the oats, remaining milk, maple syrup, and chia seeds evenly between jars. Seal the jars and shake to mix. Refrigerate overnight and top with the stewed apples when ready to serve. Enjoy!

name: Balsamic Glaze
ingredients:
2 cups
Balsamic Vinegar
3 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
recipe:
Add the vinegar and coconut sugar to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir until the sugar has dissolved.
Once tiny bubbles start to form, reduce the heat to medium-low. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes, or until the liquid reduces by half and it can coat the back of a spoon. Stir often.
Remove from the heat and allow it to cool before transferring to a glass jar. It will continue to thicken as it cools. Refrigerate until ready to use. Enjoy!

name: Stewed Apples
ingredients:
5
Apple (large, cored, chopped)
1 cup
Water
1 tbsp
Cinnamon
recipe:
Add the chopped apples, water, and cinnamon to a large pot. Mix to combine.
Bring to a boil then reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until the apples are soft and fork tender.
Remove from the heat and let the apples cool before transferring them, along with the liquid, to a glass container. Serve warm or refrigerate until ready to use. Enjoy!

name: Crunchy Chickpea Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/4 cup
Water (divided)
1 tbsp
Za'atar Spice (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Hummus
1/2
Lemon (juiced, to taste)
1/2 head
Iceberg Lettuce (shredded)
2 cups
Coleslaw Mix
1/2 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
4 ozs
Pita Chips
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the chickpeas to the baking sheet. Drizzle with 1/4 of the water and sprinkle with 1/3 of the za’atar. Season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat. Cook in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until crisp and golden. Let cool.
Meanwhile, in a bowl whisk together the hummus, lemon juice, remaining za’atar, and remaining water. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide the lettuce, coleslaw, and cilantro evenly between bowls. Top with roasted chickpeas and pita chips. Drizzle the dressing on top. Season with salt and pepper, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Spiced Plum Overnight Oats
ingredients:
1 cup
Cow's Milk, Whole
2 tbsps
Raw Honey (divided)
1/4 cup
Chia Seeds
1/2 cup
Oats (rolled)
2
Plum (medium, pitted, quartered)
1 1/2 tsps
Butter
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 tsp
Ground Cloves
recipe:
In a bowl, whisk together the milk and half of the honey. Add the chia seeds and oats. Stir to combine. Cover the container with a lid and refrigerate overnight.
Before serving, add the plums, the remaining honey, butter, cinnamon, and cloves to a saucepan. Bring to simmer over medium-low heat and immediately cover with a lid.
Let it simmer for about ten minutes or until the plums are slightly soft. Stir occasionally and add a splash of water if necessary.
Divide the overnight oats and plums evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Avocado with Turmeric & Cumin
ingredients:
1/16 tsp
Turmeric (ground, to taste)
1/16 tsp
Cumin (to taste)
1
Avocado (large, pit removed)
1/2
Lemon (juiced, to taste)
recipe: Add the turmeric and cumin to the avocado, adding as much or as little to your preferred taste. Drizzle with lemon juice, adding more or less as needed. Enjoy!

name: Oatmeal with Stewed Apples
ingredients:
1
Apple (large, chopped)
1/4 cup
Water
1 tsp
Cinnamon
2 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1 cup
Quick Oats
recipe:
Add the chopped apples, water, and cinnamon to a small pot. Mix to combine.
Bring to a boil then reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until the apples are soft and fork tender. Remove from the heat and set aside.
In a small saucepan over low heat, combine the milk and maple syrup. When tiny bubbles begin to form, add the oats and cook for one to two minutes, stirring often.
Cover and remove from the heat. Let it sit for two to three minutes.
Divide the cooked oats and stewed apples into bowls. Enjoy!

name: Nori & Hazelnuts
ingredients:
2
Nori Sheets (quartered)
1/4 cup
Hazelnuts
recipe: Add the nori and hazelnuts to a plate. Enjoy!

name: Garlic Knots
ingredients:
9 ozs
Pizza Dough (store bought)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Parsley (finely chopped)
recipe:
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Portion the pizza dough into 3/4 ounce (20 gram) pieces. Roll each piece into a four inch (10 cm) rope and tie it into a knot. Tuck the ends under to secure.
Place the knots on the prepared baking sheet, leaving some space between each one. Cover the baking sheet and let the dough rise for about 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Bake in the oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the knots are golden brown. Meanwhile, in a large bowl whisk together the olive oil, garlic, salt and parsley.
Once the knots are done baking, transfer them to the olive oil bowl. Toss to combine, serve warm and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Kale Smoothie
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Kale Leaves (finely chopped)
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2
Avocado (medium, pitted)
1/4 cup
Chocolate Protein Powder
1 tsp
Cocoa Powder
4
Ice Cubes (optional)
recipe: Add all the ingredients to a high-speed blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Cinnamon Pear Oatmeal with Walnuts
ingredients:
2
Pear (large, peeled, sliced)
1 1/2 tsps
Coconut Oil
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup (divided)
1 tsp
Cinnamon
2 cups
Water
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
2 tbsps
Walnuts
recipe:
In a saucepan over medium heat, add the pear, coconut oil, half of the maple syrup, and cinnamon. Stir and bring to simmer. Immediately cover the saucepan with a lid and simmer on low heat for about 15 minutes or until the pears are soft. Check occasionally and add a splash of water if necessary.
Meanwhile, bring the water to a boil in a small saucepan. Add the oats and the remaining maple syrup. Reduce to a steady simmer and cook, stirring occasionally for about five minutes or until the oats are tender and most of the water is absorbed.
Serve the oatmeal with cinnamon pears and walnuts. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Walnut & Sunflower Seed Kale Chips
ingredients:
8 cups
Kale Leaves (washed, thoroughly dried, stems removed)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 cup
Walnuts
3 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
2 tbsps
Sunflower Seeds
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Onion Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Tear the kale into large pieces and place them into a large bowl. Add the oil and massage it into the kale. Set aside.
In a food processor, add the walnuts, nutritional yeast, sunflower seeds, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Process until it resembles a breadcrumb-like consistency.
Pour half of the nut and seed mixture into the bowl of kale and toss to coat. Spread the kale out onto the baking sheet, then sprinkle the remaining nut and seed mixture all over the kale.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown. Let them cool for a few minutes before serving. Enjoy!

name: Garlic & Parmesan Puff Pastry Twist
ingredients:
1/2 oz
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
8 ozs
Puff Pastry (thawed)
1/4 cup
Butter (melted)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated, divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Lightly dust your work surface with flour. Roll out the puff pastry into a rectangle, about 1/8-inch (1/2 cm) thick.
In a small bowl, mix the melted butter with the minced garlic. Brush the garlic butter generously over the puff pastry. Sprinkle half of the parmesan evenly on top and season with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Using a sharp knife or a pizza cutter, cut the puff pastry into strips, about 1-inch (2.5 cm) wide. Take each strip, twist it a few times, and place it onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the twists are golden and crispy. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with the remaining parmesan cheese. Enjoy!

name: Skyr with Jam
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Raspberry Jam
6 ozs
Plain Skyr
recipe: In a jar, add a layer of jam. Then, add the skyr on top. Enjoy!

name: Nori Crisps & Almonds
ingredients:
2
Nori Sheets (quartered)
1/4 cup
Almonds
recipe: Add the nori and almonds to a plate. Enjoy!

name: Hummus, Chickpea & Artichoke Orzo Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Orzo (dry)
1/2 cup
Hummus
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1/4 cup
Water
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 cup
Matchstick Carrots
1/2
Tomato (large, diced)
1/4 cup
Artichoke Hearts (from the jar, drained, chopped)
2 tbsps
Red Onion (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Parsley (finely chopped)
recipe:
Cook the orzo according to the package directions. Set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, whisk together the hummus, lemon juice, and water in a large serving bowl. Add the chickpeas, carrots, tomatoes, artichokes, onions, parsley and orzo to the same bowl. Mix well to coat with the hummus dressing.
Divide evenly between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Peppermint Mocha
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Cow's Milk, Whole
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Cacao Powder
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 tsp
Peppermint Extract
1/4 cup
Coffee (espresso, brewed)
2 tbsps
Whipped Cream
1 tsp
Dark Chocolate Chips (optional)
recipe:
In a small saucepan, combine the milk, maple syrup, cacao powder, sea salt and peppermint extract. Continuously whisk until warmed and frothy.
Pour the brewed espresso into a cup, then pour the warmed milk mixture over top. Top with whipped cream and chocolate chips. Enjoy!

name: Smoked Herring & Bulgur Tabbouleh
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Bulgur (dry)
1/2 cup
Matchstick Carrots
1/2
Cucumber (small, sliced)
1/2 cup
Parsley (chopped)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1/2 tsp
Sambal Oelek (optional)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
8 ozs
Smoked Herring Fillet (drained)
recipe:
Cook the bulgur according to package directions and set aside to cool in a mixing bowl.
Once cooled, add the carrots, cucumber, parsley, green onions, olive oil, lemon juice, and sambal oelek (optional). Season with salt and pepper.
Divide the salad evenly between bowls. Top with smoked herring and enjoy!

name: Vegetable Linguine
ingredients:
8 ozs
Linguine (dry)
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
1
Zucchini (medium, chopped)
1 cup
Broccoli (chopped into small florets)
1
Carrot (medium, chopped)
1/2 cup
Mushrooms (chopped)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (chopped)
1 cup
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with the juices)
1 cup
Baby Spinach
1 1/2 tsps
Italian Seasoning
recipe:
Cook the linguine according to the package directions. Drain, reserving some of the pasta water.
Meanwhile, heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the zucchini, broccoli, carrots, mushrooms, and onions. Cook for five to seven minutes, or until just tender. Stir occasionally, adding a splash of reserved pasta water as needed to prevent sticking or burning.
Add the tomatoes, spinach, and Italian seasoning. Stir and cover. Cook for three to four minutes, or until warmed through.
Stir in the cooked pasta and serve warm. Divide evenly between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Roasted Squash & Arugula Salad
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Tahini
2 tsps
Raw Honey
2 tbsps
Balsamic Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Water
1
Delicata Squash (small, cut in half lengthwise, seeds removed, cut into wedges)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
6 cups
Arugula
1/3 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1/4 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tahini, honey, vinegar, salt, pepper, and water until smooth. Add more water if needed. Set aside.
Add the squash to the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine. Spread out into an even layer.
Cook for 20 to 25 minutes or until the squash is fork tender, flipping halfway through.
Divide the arugula, onion, cooked squash, pumpkin seeds, and dressing evenly between bowls. Season with more salt and pepper if desired. Enjoy!

name: Avocado Sushi
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Calrose Rice (rinsed until water runs clear, drained)
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
1 tsp
Cane Sugar
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2
Nori Sheets
1
Avocado (thickly sliced)
3 tbsps
Tamari
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
In a bowl, whisk together the rice vinegar, sugar, and salt. Add the cooked rice and stir well. If the rice is still warm, let it come to room temperature.
Place a nori sheet on a bamboo mat. Spread about three to four tablespoons of rice over the nori sheet then add the avocado slices. Roll the sushi tight.
Using a sharp knife, slice the sushi into six or eight equal pieces. Serve with tamari and enjoy!

name: Pomegranate & Chickpea Spinach Salad
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Walnuts (chopped)
2 cups
Baby Spinach
1/3 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
2 tbsps
Pomegranate Seeds
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Balsamic Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Add the walnuts and cook for three to five minutes or until they become slightly golden brown, stirring frequently. Let them cool for a few minutes before chopping
Add the spinach, chickpeas, pomegranate seeds, chopped walnuts, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper to a bowl. Toss to combine. Enjoy!

name: White Bean Pot Pies
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
4
Carrot (medium, diced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 oz
Unbleached All Purpose Flour (plus extra for dusting)
3 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth
1 tbsp
Apple Cider Vinegar
2 tsps
Thyme (fresh)
1 1/2 cups
White Navy Beans (drained, rinsed)
12 ozs
Puff Pastry (thawed)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Place the small oven-proof soup bowls on a baking sheet.
Add the oil to a pan over medium heat. Add the onions and carrots and sauté for four to five minutes or until tender. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in the flour and cook for one more minute.
Add the broth and apple cider vinegar while whisking. Stir in the thyme and beans. Simmer for two to three minutes, or until thickened then remove from the heat.
Lightly flour a clean, flat work surface. Roll out the puff pastry about 1/2-inch (13 mm) thick. Cut the puff pastry into squares.
Fill the small soup bowls with the bean mixture. Top with a square of dough, and poke small holes into the dough.
Cook in the oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden. Cool for 10 minutes before serving. Enjoy!

name: Oil-Free Crispy Air Fryer Tofu
ingredients:
12 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, cubed)
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 tsp
Black Pepper
1 cup
Sugar Free Ketchup
recipe:
Toss the tofu with the paprika, garlic powder, salt and black pepper in a bowl.
Place in an air fryer basket, leaving space between pieces. Cook at 400ºF (205ºC) for 10 to 12 minutes, shaking halfway.
Serve with ketchup and enjoy!

name: Carrot & Cabbage Sushi
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Calrose Rice (rinsed until water runs clear, drained)
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
1 tsp
Cane Sugar
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2
Nori Sheets
1 cup
Purple Cabbage (thinly sliced)
2
Carrot (shredded)
3 tbsps
Tamari
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
In a bowl, whisk together the rice vinegar, sugar, and salt. Add the cooked rice and stir well. If the rice is still warm, let it come to room temperature.
Place a nori sheet on a bamboo mat. Spread about three to four tablespoons of rice over the nori sheet then add the cabbage and carrot. Roll the sushi tight.
Using a sharp knife, slice the sushi into six or eight equal pieces. Serve with tamari and enjoy!

name: Oil-Free Broccoli & Cashew Stir Fry
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Basmati Rice (dry, rinsed)
1
Yellow Onion (small, diced)
1/2 cup
Vegetable Broth (divided)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 cups
Broccoli (chopped into florets)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2/3 cup
Cashews
1/4 cup
Coconut Aminos
1 tbsp
Arrowroot Powder
2 tbsps
Water
1 stalk
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions. Set aside.
While the rice is cooking, heat a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and half of the broth. Sauté for two to three minutes or until the onion has softened.
Add the garlic, broccoli, salt, pepper, and remaining broth. Cover and steam the broccoli for three to four minutes or until slightly tender. Remove the lid and add the cashews and coconut aminos.
Mix the arrowroot powder with water to make a slurry. Pour it into the pan and stir for one to two minutes until the sauce thickens.
Divide the rice and stir fry into bowls. Top with chopped green onion. Enjoy!

name: Pear & Pecan Crisp
ingredients:
4
Pear (large, ripe, peeled, sliced)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1 tbsp
Arrowroot Powder
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Maple Syrup (divided)
1/2 cup
Oats (rolled)
1/4 cup
Almond Flour
1/4 cup
Pecans (chopped)
1/4 cup
Butter (melted)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Toss the pears, lemon juice, arrowroot powder, vanilla, salt, and half of the maple syrup together in a baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix the oats, almond flour, pecans, butter, and remaining syrup. Spread evenly over the pears.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until the pears are tender and the topping is golden. Enjoy!

name: Miso Lemon & Pecan Asparagus
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 cups
Asparagus (trimmed)
1 tbsp
Miso Paste
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
1
Garlic (clove, minced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Pecans (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the asparagus and cook for about seven to ten minutes or until slightly browned. Stir occasionally.
Meanwhile, in a bowl whisk together the miso, lemon juice, maple syrup, garlic, salt, and pepper until smooth. If the mixture is too thick, add a splash of water.
Pour the miso mixture over the asparagus and cook for another two to three minutes.
Remove from the heat and transfer onto a serving plate. Top with pecans and enjoy!

name: One Pot Curried White Beans, Mushrooms & Swiss Chard
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Mushrooms (sliced)
2 cups
White Navy Beans (cooked)
2 tsps
Curry Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2/3 cup
Vegetable Broth
1/2 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
3 cups
Swiss Chard (chopped)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
recipe:
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms with a splash of water. Cook and stir occasionally for about five minutes or until browned.
Add the beans, curry powder, salt, and pepper. Stir and cook for another minute. Add the broth and coconut milk. Cover the pan with a lid and simmer on low heat for about ten minutes.
Remove the lid and add the Swiss chard. Stir and cook uncovered for another two to four minutes, or until wilted. Taste and adjust the seasoning to your taste.
Remove from the heat. Stir in the lemon juice. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Almond Orange Cookies with Chocolate Drizzle
ingredients:
2 cups
Almond Flour
1/2 tsp
Baking Soda
1/4 cup
Coconut Oil (melted, slightly cooled)
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Almond Extract
1/2 tsp
Orange Extract
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix together the almond flour, baking soda, coconut oil, maple syrup, almond extract, orange extract, and salt.
Portion the batter into balls roughly two tablespoons in size and place onto the baking sheet. Press down to slightly flatten. Leave at least three inches (8 cm) of room between each cookie.
Bake for 11 to 12 minutes or until golden. Let the cookies cool for about ten minutes.
Melt the chocolate in a double boiler or in 30-second intervals in the microwave.
Drizzle the chocolate onto the cookies and refrigerate for approximately 15 minutes or until the chocolate has hardened. Enjoy!

name: Zucchini & Lemon White Bean Skillet
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Walnuts
3 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
2 tbsps
Sunflower Seeds
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Leeks (medium, trimmed, chopped)
1
Zucchini (medium, chopped)
1/3 cup
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1 1/2 cups
Cannellini Beans (cooked)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
recipe:
In a food processor, add the walnuts, nutritional yeast, sunflower seeds, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Process until it resembles a breadcrumb-like consistency. Set aside.
Heat a large oven-safe pan over medium heat. Add the leeks, zucchini, salt, pepper, and a splash of broth. Sauté for seven to nine minutes or until the vegetables have softened.
Stir in the beans, remaining broth, lemon juice, and about 1/4 of the nut and seed mixture. Cook for another few minutes or until most of the liquid has reduced.
Sprinkle the remaining nut and seed mixture all over. Place in the oven under broil for three to four minutes or until slightly browned on top.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Sauteed Vegetables with Arugula & Balsamic Glaze
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 cups
Mushrooms (sliced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (medium, chopped)
1 1/2 cups
Green Cabbage (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Arugula
2 tbsps
Balsamic Glaze
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the mushrooms, bell peppers, and cabbage.
Sauté for about 10 to 15 minutes or until browned and cooked through. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the arugula to a serving plate. Top with sautéed vegetables and drizzle the balsamic glaze on top. Divide evenly between plates. Enjoy!

name: Iced Strawberry Lemon Matcha Latte
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Strawberries (chopped)
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Green Tea Powder
1/4 cup
Water (hot)
2 tsps
Lemon Juice
6
Ice Cubes
3/4 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
recipe:
In a small bowl, add the strawberries and maple syrup. Mash with a fork. Set aside.
In another bowl, whisk together the green tea powder, hot water, and lemon juice until it becomes frothy.
Add the mashed strawberries into a glass. Add the ice and coconut milk on top.
Lastly, pour the green tea powder mix into the glass. Stir, taste, and add more sweetener if desired. Enjoy!

name: Lox Baked Potato
ingredients:
2
Russet Potato (medium)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/3 cup
Cream Cheese, Regular (softened)
3 1/2 ozs
Smoked Salmon (sliced)
1 tbsp
Capers
2 tbsps
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Scrub your potatoes and pierce them all over with a fork. Place on a pan and bake for 45 to 50 minutes, or until it is cooked through.
Remove the potato from the oven. Once it is cool enough to handle, cut the potato down the middle and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Spread the cream cheese all over the potatoes. Top with smoked salmon, capers, red onion, and dill. Enjoy!

name: Spinach & Mushroom Stuffed Baked Potato
ingredients:
2
Russet Potato (medium)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 cups
Mushrooms (sliced)
1 cup
Baby Spinach
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tbsps
Tahini
2 tbsps
Water
1/2
Lemon (juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Scrub your potatoes and pierce them all over with a fork. Place on a pan and bake in the oven for 45 to 50 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms and cook for about five minutes or until browned. Add the spinach and garlic, stir, and cook for another minute.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tahini, water, and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper. Add more water if necessary to reach sauce consistency.
Remove the potato from the oven. Once it is cool enough to handle, cut the potato down the middle and season with sea salt and black pepper to taste.
Top the potatoes with the mushroom mixture and drizzle the tahini sauce on top. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Matcha Chia Pudding Parfait
ingredients:
1 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
1 tsp
Green Tea Powder
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup (divided)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1/4 cup
Chia Seeds
2/3 cup
Strawberries (chopped)
1 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
recipe:
In a bowl, add the milk, green tea powder, half of the maple syrup and lemon juice. Whisk until well combined.
Stir in the chia seeds. Let it sit for five to ten minutes then stir again. Refrigerate for at least one hour or until the chia seeds have set.
Once the pudding is ready, mash the strawberries and the remaining maple syrup in a bowl. Then, layer the mashed strawberries, yogurt, and pudding into jars. Enjoy!

name: Whipped Feta Pumpkin Dip
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1/3 cup
Pureed Pumpkin
1 1/2 tsps
Raw Honey
1/4
Lemon (juiced)
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes (plus extra for topping)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Pistachios (chopped, optional for topping)
6 ozs
Whole Grain Crackers
recipe:
In a blender, add the feta cheese, puréed pumpkin, honey, lemon, and chili flakes. Blend until mostly smooth and creamy or your desired consistency.
Taste and adjust the salt and pepper if needed.
Transfer the dip into a serving bowl. Drizzle the oil on top. Garnish with pistachios and more chili flakes (optional). Serve with crackers and enjoy!

name: Beet Mango Smoothie
ingredients:
1
Beet (large, diced)
1 cup
Frozen Mango
1 cup
Frozen Berries
1
Carrot (small, peeled, chopped)
1 1/2 tsps
Ginger (fresh, grated)
1 cup
Baby Spinach
1
Lime (juiced)
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves
1 cup
Water (or more as needed)
recipe:
Steam the chopped beets for eight to 10 minutes or until almost tender. Let them cool completely.
Add all of the ingredients to a high-speed blender. Blend on high until smooth, scraping down sides as needed. Add more water if too thick.
Divide evenly between glasses and enjoy!

name: Hazelnut Truffles
ingredients:
6 ozs
Dark Chocolate (chopped)
3/4 cup
Canned Coconut Milk (full fat)
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
3/4 cup
Hazelnuts (finely chopped, divided)
recipe:
Add the chopped chocolate to a heatproof bowl.
Heat the coconut milk, vanilla, and salt in a saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a simmer then turn off the heat.
Pour the heated coconut milk into the bowl of chocolate and cover with a tea towel for about five minutes. Remove the towel then stir until well combined and the chocolate has melted. If it hasn't melted completely, microwave for 10 to 15 seconds, in intervals.
Stir in half of the chopped hazelnuts. Tightly cover with plastic wrap and place in the fridge for two to three hours or until hardened.
Add the remaining hazelnuts to a plate. Remove the truffle mixture from the fridge and scoop to form into balls, about 2 tbsp in size. Roll into the hazelnuts then place back into the fridge for 15 to 20 minutes to set. Enjoy!

name: Baked Sun Dried Tomato & Crab Dip
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Cream Cheese, Regular (softened)
1 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
8 ozs
Fresh Lump Crab Meat, Cooked
4 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
1/4 cup
Sun Dried Tomatoes (drained, chopped)
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes (optional)
1/2 tsp
Old Bay Seasoning
3 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded, divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
5 ozs
Whole Grain Crackers
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together the cream cheese and yogurt until smooth. Add the crab, green onions, sun dried tomatoes, chili flakes (optional), old bay seasoning, and 2/3 of the cheddar cheese. Season with salt and pepper and mix well to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish. Smooth the top and sprinkle with the remaining cheddar cheese.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until bubbly and golden on top. Serve warm and enjoy with crackers!

name: Earl Grey Chia Pudding
ingredients:
1 cup
Plain Coconut Milk (from the carton)
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2 tsps
Earl Grey Tea (loose leaf or in tea bags)
1/4 cup
Chia Seeds
1 cup
Frozen Blueberries
recipe:
In a small saucepan, add the coconut milk and stir in the maple syrup and vanilla. Bring to a low simmer.
Add the loose leaf tea or tea bags. Remove from the heat and let the tea steep for three to five minutes. If using tea bags, discard the bags. If using loose leaf, strain the tea.
Let the steeped tea mixture cool for five to ten minutes before pouring into a bowl.
Stir in the chia seeds. Let it sit for five to ten minutes then stir again. Refrigerate for at least one hour or until the chia seeds have set.
Once the pudding is ready to serve, top with frozen blueberries. Enjoy!

name: Pomegranate Molasses Brussels Sprouts
ingredients:
4 cups
Brussels Sprouts (trimmed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
3 tbsps
Pomegranate Molasses
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tbsps
Pecans (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the Brussels sprouts on a baking sheet and drizzle with oil, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out evenly. Transfer to the oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a bowl whisk together the maple syrup, pomegranate molasses, and garlic.
Remove the Brussels sprouts from the oven. Drizzle the molasses mixture on top and stir well. Cook in the oven for another 10 to 15 minutes or until cooked through.
Transfer into a serving plate. Top with pecans and enjoy!

name: Harissa Caramelized Fennel & White Bean Skillet
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 bulb
Fennel (medium, thinly sliced, fronds reserved for garnish)
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, thinly sliced)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Harissa
2/3 cup
Vegetable Broth
2 cups
White Navy Beans (cooked)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the fennel and onion. Sauté for about 15 to 20 minutes or until soft and caramelized, stirring frequently.
Add the garlic and harissa. Stir and cook for another minute. Add the broth and beans. Season with salt and pepper, cover with a lid and let it simmer on low heat for about 10 minutes, allowing the beans to warm up and the flavors to meld together.
Taste and adjust the seasoning to your taste. Top with the fennel fronds and enjoy!

name: Tofu Red Curry Noodles
ingredients:
5 1/2 ozs
Gluten-Free Ramen Noodles (dry)
2 tbsps
Sesame Oil (divided)
8 ozs
Tofu (firm, crumbled)
1
Garlic (clove, chopped)
1 1/2 tbsps
Ginger (fresh, chopped)
1 1/2 tbsps
Thai Red Curry Paste
1 1/2 tsps
Tomato Paste
1 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1/2
Lime (juiced)
2 tsps
Tamari
2 stalks
Green Onion (sliced)
recipe:
Cook the noodles to al dente, according to package directions.
Meanwhile, heat half of the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the tofu for six to eight minutes, or until browned. Set aside.
Add the remaining oil to the same pan and sauté the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds. Add the curry paste and the tomato paste and cook for one minute more, stirring.
Add the coconut milk and bring to a boil. Once boiling, turn the heat down and simmer for two to three minutes to allow the flavors to combine. Stir in the lime juice and tamari.
Add the cooked noodles, tofu, and green onions to the sauce. Stir to coat. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Prune, Gingersnap & Almond Chocolate Bites
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Whipping Cream
14 ozs
Dark Chocolate (at least 70% cacao, chopped)
1/2 cup
Butter (unsalted)
8 ozs
Gingersnap Cookies (roughly crushed)
1 cup
Pitted Prunes (roughly chopped)
3/4 cup
Almonds (roasted, chopped)
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon (optional)
recipe:
Line small loaf pans with parchment paper or use silicones pans. In a saucepan over low heat or in a double boiler, gently melt the whipping cream and chocolate. Stir in the butter until smooth.
Mix in the cookies, prunes, almonds, and cinnamon (if using).
Divide the mixture evenly between the pans. Smooth the top, and tap the pan on the counter to settle it. Let cool completely at room temperature, then refrigerate for two to four hours or until set.
Once set, remove from the pan and slice into bite-sized pieces. Serve chilled and enjoy!

name: Lentil & Fennel Coconut Curry
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, thinly sliced)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 bulb
Fennel (medium, thinly sliced)
2 tsps
Curry Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
Lentils (cooked)
1 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth
1/2 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1/4 cup
Cilantro (for garnish)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about five minutes. Add the garlic and fennel. Sauté for another five minutes until the fennel begins to soften.
Stir in the curry powder, salt, and pepper. Cook for two to three minutes, then add the lentils and broth. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the lid and add the coconut milk. Taste and adjust the seasoning to your taste. Simmer for another five minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the curry thickens.
Divide the curry evenly between bowls. Garnish with cilantro and enjoy!

name: Roasted Carrot, Hummus & White Bean Salad
ingredients:
2
Carrot (medium, peeled, chopped)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
Lima Beans (cooked)
1/2
Lemon (large, juiced)
1
Garlic (clove, large, minced)
1/4 cup
Parsley (finely chopped)
1 head
Romaine Hearts (chopped)
1/4 cup
Hummus
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the carrots to the baking sheet. Drizzle with half of the oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine. Spread out into an even layer. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until fork tender, flipping halfway through.
While the carrots are cooking, in a bowl, combine the lima beans, the remaining oil, lemon juice, garlic, parsley, salt and pepper. Mix to combine. Set aside.
To assemble the bowls, divide the lettuce, marinated lima beans, cooked carrots, and hummus evenly between bowls. Use the remaining marinade as a dressing. Enjoy!

name: Parmesan Roasted Squash
ingredients:
1
Acorn Squash (large, seeds removed, sliced into wedges)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the squash wedges to a mixing bowl with the oil, cheese, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Spread the squash out in an even layer on the baking sheet. Add any of the remaining cheese from the bowl onto each piece of squash.
Cook for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown and fork tender. Serve and enjoy!

name: Coconut Couscous with Sumac Roasted Cauliflower & Mushrooms
ingredients:
1/2 head
Cauliflower (medium, chopped into bite-size pieces)
8
Cremini Mushrooms (small)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Ground Sumac (plus extra for toppings)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3/4 cup
Israeli Couscous (dry)
1 tsp
Turmeric
1/3 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
2/3 cup
Vegetable Broth
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the cauliflower and mushrooms with oil, sumac, salt, and pepper. Spread evenly onto the baking sheet and cook in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until cooked and golden brown, flipping halfway through.
Meanwhile, in a saucepan, add the couscous, turmeric, coconut milk, and broth. Bring to a boil then reduce the heat to a simmer. Cover the pan with a lid and simmer for about ten minutes or until cooked through. Fluff with a fork and season with salt.
Divide the couscous evenly between plates and top with roasted vegetables. Sprinkle extra sumac on top, garnish with dill, and enjoy!

name: Fennel & Mushroom Gratin
ingredients:
1 bulb
Fennel (large, cut in big pieces)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 cups
Mushrooms (halved)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 tsp
Nutmeg
2/3 cup
Whipping Cream
2 ozs
Mozzarella Cheese (shredded)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC).
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add in the fennel and boil for about five minutes or until slightly soft.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in an oven-safe pan over high heat. Add the mushrooms and sauté for about five minutes. Season with salt to taste.
Remove from the heat and transfer the fennel into the same pan as the mushrooms. Season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Add the cream and top with mozzarella.
Place in the oven and cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until everything is cooked and golden brown on top. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Lemon Garlic Lima Beans
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Lima Beans (cooked)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (large, juiced)
1
Garlic (clove, large, minced)
1/4 cup
Parsley (finely chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl. Serve and enjoy!

name: Smashed Parmesan Sweet Potato Rounds
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (large, sliced into thick rounds)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
1/2
Lime (for serving)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add the sliced sweet potatoes and boil for 20 to 25 minutes or until fork tender.
Drain and place the sweet potatoes on the baking sheet. Flatten gently with the bottom of a glass or measuring cup. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Bake in the oven for about 20 minutes or until golden brown and crispy on the edges. Top with cilantro and serve with lime. Enjoy!

name: Slow Cooker Split Pea Soup
ingredients:
7 cups
Vegetable Broth
2 cups
Yellow Split Peas (uncooked, rinsed)
1
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
2
Carrot (medium, diced)
1 bulb
Fennel (medium, diced)
2 stalks
Celery (diced)
1/4 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
1 tbsp
Red Wine Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
In a slow cooker, combine the broth, split peas, onion, carrots, fennel, celery, smoked paprika, and chili flakes, stir well.
Cover and cook on high heat for four to six hours, or low heat for eight to ten hours.
Stir in the red wine vinegar and season with salt and pepper to taste. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: One Pot Spinach, Artichoke & Lima Bean Orzo
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
2 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1
Garlic (clove, finely chopped)
1 1/2 cups
Artichoke Hearts (from the jar, chopped)
1 1/2 cups
Lima Beans (cooked)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Chili Flakes
1 cup
Orzo (dry)
2 cups
Baby Spinach
recipe:
In a large pan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for three to five minutes or until softened. Add a splash of broth if needed.
Add the garlic and sauté for another 30 seconds. Stir in the artichoke hearts, lima beans, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chili flakes. Add another splash of broth if needed.
Mix in the orzo and remaining vegetable broth. Lower the heat and simmer for eight to ten minutes or until the orzo is al dente and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Continuously stir to prevent the orzo from sticking. If needed, add some water or more broth.
Turn off the heat and stir in the spinach until it has wilted down. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Mushroom & Lentil Arayes
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1
White Onion (medium, chopped)
2 cups
Mushrooms (chopped)
3 cups
Green Lentils (cooked)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Tomato Paste
1 1/2 tsps
Lebanese Seven Spice Blend

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
4 ozs
Mini Whole Wheat Pita
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Heat half of the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the onion and sauté for about five minutes or until soft and translucent.
Add the mushrooms and cook for about five minutes. Add the lentils, garlic, tomato paste, Lebanese spice, salt, and pepper. Stir well.
Add a splash of water to the pan. Cover the pan with a lid and cook on low heat for about five minutes. Remove the lid and slightly smash the mixture. Remove from the heat, stir in the cilantro and let it cool for about five minutes.
Cut the mini pitas in half. Place roughly two tablespoons of the mixture inside each pita and gently press the mixture down with a spoon. Repeat with the remaining mixture and pitas.
Brush the stuffed pitas with the remaining oil and place them on the baking sheet. Bake for seven to 10 minutes or until golden brown, flipping halfway. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Crumbled Tofu Tacos
ingredients:
8 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, patted dry, crumbled)
2 tbsps
Tamari
2 tsps
Taco Seasoning
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
4
Corn Tortilla (small, warmed)
2 tbsps
Guacamole
2 tbsps
Salsa
1/2 cup
Microgreens
1 oz
Pickled Red Onions (optional)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped, optional)
recipe:
Add the tofu, tamari, and taco seasoning to a bowl. Mix until well combined.
Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the tofu mixture and cook for six to eight minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and crispy.
Divide the tofu evenly between the tortillas. Top with guacamole, salsa, and microgreens. Garnish with pickled onions and cilantro, if desired. Enjoy!

name: One Pot Spicy Leek & Mushroom Pasta
ingredients:
1
Leeks (medium, trimmed, chopped)
1 cup
Shiitake Mushrooms (sliced)
2 1/2 cups
Quinoa Penne (dry)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tsps
Dried Parsley
1 tsp
Chili Flakes
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
recipe:
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the leeks, mushrooms, pasta, and salt. Cook for seven to nine minutes or until the pasta is al dente. Drain the pasta and vegetables and reserve some of the pasta water.
Add the pasta and vegetables back to the pot. Add the oil, garlic, dried parsley, chili flakes, salt, and pepper and sauté on medium-low heat for one to two minutes.
Add the nutritional yeast and about 1/4 of the reserved water. Stir for two to three minutes or until most of the water has absorbed.
Divide into plates and top with nutritional yeast and more chili flakes (optional). Enjoy!

name: Mason Jar Vermicelli Tofu Soup
ingredients:
4 ozs
Tofu (diced)
1/2
Carrot (medium, finely chopped or cut into ribbons)
1/4
Red Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
1/4 cup
Broccoli (chopped into florets)
1 stalk
Green Onion (chopped)
1 tbsp
Soy Sauce, Low Sodium
2 tsps
Miso Paste
1/2 tsp
Everything Bagel Seasoning
1 oz
Rice Vermicelli Noodles (dry)
1 1/2 cups
Water (boiling)
recipe:
In a mason jar, layer the tofu, carrots, bell peppers, broccoli, green onions, soy sauce, miso paste, everything bagel seasoning, and noodles. Secure the lid and store in the fridge until ready to eat.
To serve, pour boiling water into the jar, covering the ingredients. Secure lid and shake carefully or use a spoon to gently push the noodles into the water.
Let it sit for six to eight minutes or until the noodles are tender. Enjoy!

name: Avocado & Radish Sweet Potato Toast
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (medium)
1
Avocado (medium)
1/2
Lime (juiced)
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Onion Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (plus more for garnish)
1/2 cup
Watermelon Radish (sliced)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Trim the pointy ends off the sweet potato then lay on its side on a cutting board. Slice it lengthwise into 1/4 inch (1/2 cm) slices.
Pop the sweet potato slices into the toaster and toast two to three times, depending on your toaster setting. If you do not have a toaster, set your oven to broil and cook in the oven on a lined baking sheet for three to six minutes per side.
While the sweet potatoes are cooking, mash the avocado, lime juice, garlic powder, onion powder, and salt together in a bowl.
Place the toasted sweet potato on a plate and divide the mashed avocado, watermelon radish, and green onion evenly between each piece. Top with a sprinkle of salt. Enjoy!

name: Homemade Pickled Jalapenos
ingredients:
3/4 cup
White Wine Vinegar
3/4 cup
Water
2
Garlic (clove, quartered)
2 tbsps
Cane Sugar
1 tbsp
Sea Salt
6
Jalapeno Pepper (sliced)
recipe:
In a pot, combine the vinegar, water, garlic, sugar, and salt. Bring to a boil.
Add the jalapeño slices, stir, and remove from the heat. Set aside for ten minutes.
Transfer the jalapeños to a jar and pour in the brining liquid to cover.
Allow the jar to cool uncovered at room temperature for approximately one hour. Then cover the jar and place it in the refrigerator, leaving it for at least 24 hours before opening. Enjoy!

name: Bulgur, Chickpea & Cucumber Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Bulgur (dry)
1/2
Cucumber (diced)
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
3 tbsps
Red Onion (diced)
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves (chopped)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the bulgur according to package directions. Once it's done cooking, transfer to a baking sheet to cool completely (approximately 10 minutes) then place in a large bowl.
Add the remaining ingredients to the bowl and mix well to combine. Divide evenly between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Shawarma Spiced Cauliflower Wraps
ingredients:
1/2 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
1
Yellow Onion (medium, sliced)
1 tbsp
Shawarma Spice Blend

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Tomato (medium, chopped)
1/4
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
3 tbsps
Tzatziki
2 ozs
Pickled Red Onions (optional)
4 1/2 ozs
White Pita Bread
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the cauliflower and the onion on the prepared baking sheet and toss with the spice blend, salt, pepper, and oil, until evenly coated.
Cook in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until tender and caramelized.
Divide the roasted cauliflower, tomato, cucumber, tzatziki, and pickled onions (if using) evenly between the pitas. Roll into a wrap and enjoy!

name: Hummus & Avocado Portobello Mushroom Burger
ingredients:
3 ozs
Portobello Mushroom Caps
1/2 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 tsp
Steak Spice Seasoning (to taste)
1 tbsp
Vegan Mayonnaise
1 tsp
Sriracha
1 tbsp
Hummus
2 ozs
Whole Wheat Bun (toasted)
1/4
Tomato (small, sliced)
1/4
Avocado (medium, sliced)
1/4 cup
Microgreens
recipe:
Brush the portobello mushroom caps with oil and season with steak spice.
Heat a grill pan to medium-high. Grill the mushroom cap for three to four minutes per side, until tender.
In a small bowl, mix the mayonnaise and sriracha together.
Spread the hummus on the bottom half of the bun. Layer the tomato slices, grilled portobello cap, avocado slices, microgreens, and sriracha mayo. Top with the other half of the bun and enjoy!

name: Spicy Black Bean Burrito Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Rice (dry, rinsed)
2 cups
Black Beans (cooked, undrained)
1/4 tsp
Cumin
1/4 tsp
Onion Powder
1/4 cup
Salsa
2 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (grated)
2 stalks
Green Onion (sliced)
1 tbsp
Pickled Jalapeno Pepper (sliced)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
In a pot, add the black beans with its liquid, cumin, and onion powder. Stir to combine. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for about three to four minutes or until everything is heated through.
To assemble, divide the rice, black beans, salsa, and shredded cheese evenly between bowls. Top with green onions and jalapeños. Enjoy!

name: Lentil & Purple Cabbage Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
1 1/2 cups
Purple Cabbage (thinly sliced)
1/4 cup
Shallot (finely chopped)
1
Carrot (medium, finely diced)
1 stalk
Celery (medium, finely diced)
1/3 cup
Almonds (roasted, chopped)
1/2 cup
Parsley (chopped)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
recipe:
Cook the lentils according to the package directions. Once cooked, drain and rinse under cold water then add to a large serving bowl.
Add the remaining ingredients to the bowl and toss to coat. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Dipped Dates with Pistachios
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Milk Chocolate Chips
1 cup
Pitted Dates
3 tbsps
Pistachios (finely chopped)
recipe:
Melt the chocolate in a double boiler or in 30-second intervals in the microwave.
Dip each date into the melted chocolate. Place on a plate and sprinkle the chopped pistachios onto each date.
Serve right away or refrigerate for 10 to 15 minutes or until the chocolate has hardened. Enjoy!

name: Garlic Naan
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Water (warm)
1 tsp
Instant Yeast
1 tsp
Cane Sugar
8 1/2 ozs
Unbleached All Purpose Flour (plus more for dusting)
1 tsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 tsps
Garlic Powder
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (plus more for greasing)
2 tbsps
Plain Cow's Yogurt, Whole Milk
2 tbsps
Butter (melted, optional)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped, optional)
recipe:
In a small bowl, mix the warm water, yeast, and sugar. Let it sit for 10 minutes until foamy.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, and garlic powder.
Add the oil, yogurt, and yeast mixture. Knead until the dough is smooth and pulls away from the bowl. Transfer to a floured surface and knead for five minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let it rise in a warm place for two hours or until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and divide into equal pieces, one piece per serving. Roll each piece to 1/4-inch (1/2 cm) thickness.
Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium heat. Once hot, add one piece of flatbread and cook for two to three minutes until golden brown and bubbles form. Flip and cook the other side until golden. Repeat until all pieces have cooked.
Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with parsley, if desired. Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Salted Chocolate Popcorn
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
4 cups
Popcorn
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Melt the chocolate in a double boiler or in 30-second intervals in the microwave.
Add the popcorn to a large bowl. Pour the melted chocolate all over the popcorn. Use a spatula to mix and evenly coat the popcorn.
Sprinkle the salt all over and mix again. Spread the popcorn out onto a parchment paper lined baking sheet.
Leave at room temperature for about 60 to 70 minutes to allow the chocolate to harden. Serve and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Dipped Dates with Flaky Salt
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Milk Chocolate Chips
1 cup
Pitted Dates
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Melt the chocolate in a double boiler or in 30-second intervals in the microwave.
Dip each date into the melted chocolate. Place on a plate and sprinkle the flaky salt onto each.
Serve right away or refrigerate for 10 to 15 minutes or until the chocolate has hardened. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Labneh & Cucumbers
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Labneh
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
1/4
Cucumber (large, sliced)
recipe: In a bowl, mix together the labneh with chili flakes. Serve with cucumber and enjoy!

name: One Pan Beans & Ricotta
ingredients:
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1 cup
Tomato Sauce
1 1/2 cups
White Navy Beans (drained, rinsed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Ricotta Cheese
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Heat a pan over medium heat. Add the onion with a splash of water and cook for about five minutes or until soft. Stir occasionally.
Add the garlic and paprika, stir and cook for another minute. Add the tomato sauce and beans. Stir and season with salt and pepper.
Cover the pan with a lid, and simmer on low heat for 10 to 12 minutes.
Remove the lid and spoon the ricotta cheese on top. Cover with a lid again and cook for another five minutes or until everything is heated through and flavors have combined.
Top with parsley and divide evenly between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Broccoli & Cauliflower Soup
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tsp
Ginger (fresh, minced)
2 cups
Broccoli (chopped)
1/2 head
Cauliflower (medium, chopped into bite-size pieces)
2 cups
Vegetable Broth

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1/2
Lemon (juiced, for serving)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion and sauté for five to six minutes, or until translucent.
Add the garlic and ginger, and sauté for another minute. Then, add the broccoli, cauliflower, broth, salt, and pepper. Cover the pot with a lid and let it simmer on low heat for about 15 minutes, or until everything is cooked.
Use an immersion blender to blend the soup until smooth. Add the coconut milk, stir, and simmer uncovered for another five minutes so the flavors blend together.
Divide evenly between bowls. Drizzle with lemon juice and enjoy!

name: Labneh & Pita Chips
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Labneh
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3/4 oz
Pita Chips
recipe: Spread the labneh into a serving plate. Drizzle the oil on top. Serve with pita chips and enjoy!

name: Hazelnut & Coconut Energy Balls
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Pitted Dates
1 tbsp
Cocoa Powder
1/2 cup
Hazelnuts (finely chopped, divided)
2 tbsps
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
recipe:
Add the dates, cocoa powder and hazelnuts to a food processor and process on high for two to three minutes, scraping down the sides as needed. Blend until the mixture is sticky and holds together.
Use a one-inch cookie scoop to scoop out the paste and roll it in your hands to create a ball. Continue until you have used up all of the paste.
Roll each ball in coconut until evenly coated. Chill in the fridge for about 15 minutes and enjoy!

name: Tuscan White Bean Soup
ingredients:
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
2
Carrot (small, finely diced)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tsps
Thyme (fresh)
2 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
White Navy Beans (cooked)
1 1/2 cups
Swiss Chard (chopped)
recipe:
Heat a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and carrot with a splash of water. Sauté for five minutes or until slightly browned.
Add the garlic and thyme and sauté for another minute. Add the broth, cover the pot with a lid and simmer on low heat for ten minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the beans and cook covered for another ten minutes. Remove the lid and stir in the Swiss chard. Simmer for two to three minutes, or until the chard is wilted and tender.
Divide evenly between serving bowls and enjoy!

name: Old Bay Seasoning
ingredients:
6
Bay Leaf
2 tbsps
Celery Salt
2 tsps
Ground Mustard
1 tbsp
Paprika
2 tsps
Black Pepper
1/4 tsp
Ground Ginger
1/8 tsp
Cayenne Pepper
1/8 tsp
Ground Cloves
1/8 tsp
Nutmeg
1/8 tsp
Cinnamon
recipe: Use a coffee grinder or mortar and pestle to finely grind the bay leaves. Combine all ingredients in a jar and shake to mix well. Enjoy!

name: Kale, Apple & Cabbage Salad
ingredients:
4 cups
Kale Leaves (stems removed, chopped)
1
Apple (medium, grated)
1 cup
Purple Cabbage (grated)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 tbsps
Apple Cider Vinegar
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a bowl and use your hands to massage the oil and vinegar into the salad. Serve and enjoy!

name: Berry & Mango Coconut Kefir Smoothie
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Plain Coconut Kefir Yogurt
1/4 cup
Water
1/2 cup
Frozen Berries
1/3 cup
Frozen Mango
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1 tsp
Hemp Seeds
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Enjoy!

name: Burrata Crostinis
ingredients:
8 ozs
Burrata
4 ozs
Sourdough Baguette (sliced, toasted)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Spoon the burrata evenly on top of the baguette slices. Season with salt and pepper and enjoy!

name: Crunchy Cabbage Slaw with Nutty Roasted Chickpeas
ingredients:
3 tbsps
All Natural Peanut Butter
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
2 tbsps
Coconut Aminos
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 cup
Cashews
3 cups
Purple Cabbage (thinly sliced)
2 tbsps
Apple Cider Vinegar
1
Navel Orange (peeled, chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the peanut butter, 1/3 of the oil, coconut aminos, garlic powder, and salt. Add the chickpeas and cashews and toss to evenly coat.
Spread the mixture evenly onto the baking sheet. Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, tossing occasionally, until browned and slightly crunchy. Let cool for 10 to 15 minutes.
Add the cabbage to a bowl with the remaining oil and vinegar and toss well. Mix in the chopped orange, cooled cashews, chickpeas, salt, and pepper. Divide evenly onto plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Hazelnut & Date Bars
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Pitted Dates
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2/3 cup
Oats (rolled)
1/3 cup
Hazelnuts (chopped, divided)
recipe:
Add the dates to a blender or food processor and blend until a paste forms. Transfer the paste into a bowl and stir in the salt, oats, and half of the hazelnuts.
Line a baking pan with parchment paper. Add the mixture to the pan, pressing down firmly with a spatula or your hands until even. Sprinkle the remainder of the hazelnuts on top and lightly press them down.
Transfer to the fridge for one hour or until it sets. Cut it into rectangular or square pieces and enjoy!

name: Slow Cooker Curried Red Lentil Soup
ingredients:
2
Carrot (large, thinly chopped)
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 1/2 cups
