Dry Red Lentils (rinsed)
5 cups
Vegetable Broth
2 tbsps
Tomato Paste
2 tsps
Curry Powder
2 tsps
Ginger (fresh, minced)
1 1/2 cups
Baby Kale
1/2 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1 tbsp
Lime Juice (optional)
recipe:
Add the carrot, garlic, lentils, broth, tomato paste, curry powder, and ginger to a slow cooker and stir to combine.
Cover and cook on low for six hours or on high for four hours.
Stir in the kale, coconut milk, and lime juice. Let it stand for five minutes, or until the kale has wilted. Divide evenly into bowls and enjoy!

name: Hummus & Sauteed Mushrooms on Toast
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 cup
Mushrooms (thinly sliced)
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Hummus
1 tsp
Lemon Juice
1 3/4 ozs
Sourdough Bread (sliced, toasted)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for three to five minutes or until soft and lightly browned. Stir in the parsley and season with salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, mix the hummus and lemon juice. Stir until smooth.
Spread the hummus mixture onto the toast. Top with sautéed mushrooms and enjoy!

name: Adobo Seasoning
ingredients:
6
Bay Leaf
1 tbsp
Sea Salt
3 tbsps
Garlic Powder
1 tbsp
Onion Powder
2 tsps
Black Pepper
2 tsps
Oregano
1/2 tsp
Turmeric
recipe:
Use a coffee grinder or mortar and pestle to finely grind the bay leaves.
Combine all ingredients in a jar and shake to mix well. Enjoy!

name: Musabaha
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
2 tbsps
Tahini

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Za'atar Spice
1 tbsp
Walnuts (chopped)
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
In a pan, combine the chickpeas, tahini, salt, and pepper. Mash with a fork until creamy with some chunks remaining.
Place the pan over medium heat and cook for one to two minutes until just warmed.
Remove from the heat, drizzle with oil, and top with za'atar and walnuts. Garnish with parsley and enjoy!

name: Hummus Toast with Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Hummus
1 3/4 ozs
Sourdough Bread (sliced, toasted)
1/2 cup
Arugula
1/3 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe: Spread the hummus evenly onto the toasted bread. Top with arugula, tomatoes, oil, and salt. Enjoy!

name: Za'atar Roasted Chickpeas with Labneh
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4
Lemon (juiced)
2 tsps
Za'atar Spice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2 cup
Labneh
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
3 1/2 ozs
Sourdough Bread (sliced, toasted)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, whisk together the oil, lemon juice, za'atar, salt, and pepper. Add the chickpeas and stir well.
Transfer the chickpeas onto the baking sheet. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, tossing halfway.
Divide the chickpeas and labneh evenly between bowls. Top with cilantro and serve with toasted bread. Enjoy!

name: Tempeh & Tahini Roasted Vegetables
ingredients:
2 cups
Mini Potatoes (halved)
1 1/2 tbsps
Tahini
1/2
Lemon (juiced, plus more for garnish)
1 tbsp
Coconut Aminos
1 tsp
Raw Honey

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Water (optional)
8 3/4 ozs
Tempeh (cubed)
3 cups
Asparagus (trimmed, chopped)
1/2
Zucchini (large, chopped)
1
Red Bell Pepper (large, sliced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the potatoes to a large pot with enough water to cover them. Bring the pot to a boil and cook for 12 to 15 minutes or until fork-tender. Drain and set aside.
In a large bowl, mix together the tahini, lemon juice, coconut aminos, honey, salt, and pepper. Add a splash of water to thin out if needed. Add the tempeh, asparagus, zucchini, and bell pepper to the bowl. Toss to coat in the tahini sauce.
Spread the vegetables and tempeh out evenly on the baking sheet. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the vegetables are browned and fork-tender.
Divide the potatoes, tempeh, and vegetables evenly into bowls. Drizzle with additional lemon juice. Enjoy!

name: Bread Upma
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 tsp
Cumin Seed
1
Green Chili Pepper (seeds removed, chopped)
1/4 tsp
Ginger (fresh, minced)
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, finely chopped)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (stems and leaves divided, chopped)
1/2
Tomato (medium, finely chopped)
1/4 tsp
Turmeric (ground)
1/2 tsp
Kashmiri Chili Powder
2 tbsps
Water

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 slices
Bread (cubed)
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds and sauté until they darken slightly, about 30 seconds.
Stir in the green chili and the ginger. Sauté for 15 seconds. Add the onion and sauté for two to three minutes or until the onion is translucent.
Add the cilantro stems and tomato. Stir, cover, and cook for two to three minutes until the tomatoes soften. Add the turmeric, chili powder, water, salt, and pepper. Cook for one to two minutes until the liquid has almost fully evaporated.
Add the bread pieces and toss to coat evenly with the mixture. Cover and cook for two minutes to let the flavors absorb.
Add the lemon juice and cilantro leaves. Mix well and divide evenly onto plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Labneh Balls
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Za'atar Spice
2 tbsps
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
1 cup
Labneh
recipe:
Place the za’atar in a small bowl and the sesame seeds in another. Roll the labneh into smooth, tablespoon-sized balls.
Roll half of the labneh balls in za’atar and the other half in sesame seeds until evenly coated. Serve and enjoy!

name: Baba Ganoush on Toast
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Baba Ganoush
1 3/4 ozs
Sourdough Bread (sliced, toasted)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
1 tsp
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
1 1/2 tsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Spread the baba ganoush on top of the toast.
Drizzle with olive oil. Top with chili flakes, toasted sesame seeds, and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Plantain Chips & Salsa
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Plantain Chips (store-bought or homemade)
1/3 cup
Salsa
recipe: Serve the plantain chips with the salsa as a dip. Enjoy!

name: Herby Lima Bean & Cucumber Salad
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Lima Beans (cooked)
1/3
Cucumber (medium, sliced)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1/4 cup
Fresh Dill (chopped)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Enjoy!

name: Lentil & Cauliflower Salad with Orange Tahini Dressing
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
1 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
1 tbsp
Moroccan Spice Blend

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Tahini
1/2
Navel Orange (large, zested, juiced)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
8 cups
Arugula
1/2 cup
Pitted Dates (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the lentils according to the package directions. Once cooked, drain and rinse under cold water and set aside.
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the cauliflower with the Moroccan spice blend, salt, and pepper until well coated. Arrange the cauliflower on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 25 to 30 minutes until cooked and browned slightly, tossing halfway.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tahini, orange juice and zest, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Place the arugula on a platter and top with the cooked lentils, cauliflower, and dates. Drizzle the tahini dressing over the top. Divide evenly into bowls or plates, and enjoy!

name: Chili Lime Plantain Chips
ingredients:
2
Plantain (large, slightly ripened, peeled)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Lime (juiced)
1 tbsp
Chili Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Thinly slice the plantains with a knife or mandoline. Place the slices in a bowl with the oil, lime juice, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Gently toss to coat the plantains evenly in seasoning.
Arrange the plantain slices in an even layer on the baking sheet without overlapping. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, flipping at the halfway point. (Note: Chips are done when they start to brown around the edges.)
Let the chips cool completely before serving and enjoy!

name: Hummus & Artichoke Toast
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Hummus
1 3/4 ozs
Sourdough Bread (sliced, toasted)
2 tbsps
Artichoke Hearts (from the jar, drained, coarsely chopped)
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe: Spread the hummus on the toast. Top with artichokes, parsley, and chili flakes. Enjoy!

name: Turmeric Ginger Miso Soup
ingredients:
4 cups
Vegetable Broth
1/4 cup
Miso Paste
14 ozs
Tofu (diced)
1
Carrot (medium, grated)
4 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
1 tsp
Ginger (finely grated)
1/2 tsp
Turmeric
1
Nori Sheets (thinly sliced)
1 tsp
Rice Vinegar
recipe:
Place the broth in a pot and bring to a low simmer.
Add the miso to a small bowl. Add a small amount of warm broth from the pot and whisk until smooth. Set aside.
Add the tofu, grated carrot, green onion, ginger, and turmeric to the pot. Simmer for three to four minutes until the carrots are tender. Add the nori and vinegar and stir to combine.
Remove from the heat, add the miso mixture, and stir to combine. Divide evenly into bowls and enjoy!

name: Farro Ratatouille
ingredients:
1 cup
Farro (uncooked, rinsed)
1/2 cup
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1/2
Yellow Onion (small, finely chopped)
1/2
Eggplant (medium, peeled, diced)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 1/2 tsps
Thyme (fresh)
1
Zucchini (medium, diced)
1
Orange Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
2
Tomato (large, diced)
1/2 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the farro according to the package directions and set aside.
Meanwhile, heat half of the broth in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion, eggplant, and garlic, and cook for three to four minutes until softened.
Add the remaining broth, thyme, zucchini, bell pepper, and tomatoes. Cook for eight to 10 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Remove from the heat, add the cooked farro and basil, and stir to combine. Divide evenly onto plates and enjoy!

name: Olive & Feta Farro Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Farro (uncooked, rinsed)
2 tbsps
Red Onion (finely chopped)
1/4 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives (chopped)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1
Cucumber (medium, sliced)
1/2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, chopped)
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the farro according to the package directions and set aside to cool completely.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine the red onion, olives, feta, cucumber, bell pepper, lemon juice, and basil. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the farro to the bowl and toss well to combine. Divide evenly onto plates and enjoy!

name: Sardines & Crackers
ingredients:
3 ozs
Sardines (drained)
1 tsp
Lemon Juice (optional)
1/16 tsp
Black Pepper (optional)
1 oz
Seed Crackers
recipe: Mash the sardines, lemon juice, and pepper together with a fork. Spread the sardine mixture evenly on each cracker. Enjoy!

name: Blender Beet Juice
ingredients:
1
Beet (medium, peeled, chopped)
1
Carrot (medium, peeled, chopped)
1
Green Apple (medium, chopped)
2 tsps
Ginger (peeled, chopped)
1 cup
Water
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Place a nut-milk bag or a fine mesh sieve over a large bowl and pour in the juice. Using clean hands, squeeze out all the liquid. Pour the strained juice into a glass pitcher and serve. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Parmesan Roasted Green Beans
ingredients:
4 cups
Green Beans (trimmed)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2/3 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
1 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the beans on the baking sheet and drizzle with oil. Season with salt and pepper, and toss to combine.
Arrange the beans in an even layer, leaving no gaps between each bean. Top with parmesan. Roast for 10 to 15 minutes or until the beans are cooked and the cheese is slightly crispy.
Top with chili flakes, divide evenly onto plates, and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Falafel Salad
ingredients:
5 1/2 ozs
Frozen Falafel
4 cups
Mixed Greens
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1/4
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (juiced, plus more for garnish)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Hummus
recipe:
Cook the falafel according to the package directions.
In a bowl, toss the mixed greens, tomatoes, cucumber, and onion in the oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Divide evenly into bowls.
Top each salad with falafel and hummus. Garnish with lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Mixed Herb & Sesame Beet Salad
ingredients:
3
Beet (medium)
2 tsps
Sesame Oil
1 tsp
Cumin

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Red Onion (thinly chopped)
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves (chopped)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Bring a pot of water to a boil and add the beets. Simmer for 35 to 40 minutes until fork-tender. Remove from the pot, let cool, then peel with your hands under running water. Cut the beets into chunks.
In a large bowl, whisk together the oil, cumin, salt, and pepper. Add the beets and onions and toss well.
Top with mint and cilantro. Divide evenly onto plates and enjoy!

name: Blueberry Pomegranate Dressing
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Blueberries
1/3 cup
Pomegranate Juice (unsweetened)
1 1/2 tsps
Maple Syrup

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
recipe:
Add the blueberries, pomegranate juice, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to a blender and blend for 30 seconds.
While the blender is running, gradually add the olive oil and blend until smooth. Pour the dressing into a jar and enjoy!

name: Dill Pickle Dip
ingredients:
1 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
2 tbsps
Pickle Brine
2 1/2 ozs
Baby Pickles (chopped)
3 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)
1 stalk
Green Onion (chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a bowl and mix well. Enjoy!

name: Simple Garlic-Free Peanut Sauce
ingredients:
1/4 cup
All Natural Peanut Butter (runny)
3 tbsps
Water
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
2 tbsps
Tamari
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a small bowl or jar. Whisk or shake the jar until well combined. Enjoy!

name: Mason Jar Thai Peanut Salad
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (medium, cubed)
2 tsps
Avocado Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1/4 cup
All Natural Peanut Butter
3 tbsps
Water
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
2 tbsps
Tamari
1 cup
Purple Cabbage (thinly sliced)
1/4
Cucumber (medium, diced)
1/3 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1/2 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1
Carrot (medium, peeled, grated)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the sweet potato to the baking sheet, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes or until fork tender.
Meanwhile, cook the quinoa according to the package directions.
Add the peanut butter, water, lime juice, and tamari to a small bowl or jar. Whisk or shake the jar until well combined.
Layer the ingredients in a mason jar in the following order: peanut dressing, cabbage, quinoa, sweet potato, cucumber, edamame, chickpeas, and carrot. When ready to eat, shake well and dump into a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Mint Chocolate Shake
ingredients:
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1
Banana (frozen)
1 1/2 cups
Baby Spinach
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1/2 cup
Mint Leaves
1 tbsp
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe: Add all the ingredients except the chocolate chips to a blender and blend until smooth. Serve in a glass and top with the chocolate chips. Enjoy!

name: Carrot Cake Oat & Tahini Bites
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Oats (rolled)
2/3 cup
Tahini (runny)
1/4 cup
Raw Honey
1
Carrot (medium, peeled, grated)
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/2 tsp
Ground Ginger
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
recipe:
Add the oats to a food processor and blend until it reaches a flour-like consistency.
Add the tahini, honey, carrot, vanilla, ginger, and salt and blend until combined and the mixture holds together.
Use a cookie scoop or a tablespoon to scoop out the mixture and roll it into balls in your hands. Repeat until all of the mixture is used.
Roll each ball in coconut until evenly coated. Chill in the fridge for 15 minutes, and enjoy!

name: Ground Bison Tacos with Avocado & Jalapeno Sauce
ingredients:
8 ozs
Ground Bison
1 1/2 tsps
Taco Seasoning
1/4 cup
Water
1/2
Avocado (medium)
2 tbsps
Pickled Jalapeno Pepper
1 cup
Cilantro
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
4
Corn Tortilla (small, warmed)
2 tbsps
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Add the bison. Cook for five to seven minutes until the meat is browned and cooked through, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add the taco seasoning and the water. Stir and cook for four to six minutes until the sauce thickens.
Meanwhile, blend the avocado, pickled jalapeños, cilantro, and lime juice in a food processor until smooth.
Divide the bison mixture evenly between the tortillas. Top with avocado sauce and feta cheese. Enjoy!

name: Dill Pickled Cauliflower
ingredients:
1 cup
White Wine Vinegar
1 1/2 cups
Water
1 tbsp
Sea Salt
2 tsps
Black Peppercorns
1/3 cup
Fresh Dill
4
Garlic (clove, quartered)
1/2 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
recipe:
In a small saucepan over medium heat, bring the vinegar, water, and salt to a boil. Stir for three minutes or until the salt is fully dissolved. Remove from the heat.
Meanwhile, place the peppercorns, dill, and garlic in a glass jar. Pack the cauliflower tightly into the jar.
Carefully pour the vinegar mixture over the cauliflower, ensuring it is completely submerged in the liquid.
Allow the jar to cool uncovered at room temperature for approximately 30 minutes. Then, cover the jar and place it in the refrigerator, leaving it for at least 24 hours. Enjoy!

name: Tahini, Oat & Coconut Energy Balls
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Oats (rolled)
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Tahini
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
recipe:
Add the oats, shredded coconut, hemp seeds, and salt to a food processor. Blend until it starts to combine and form small, crumbly pieces.
Add the tahini, maple syrup, and vanilla and blend again until the mixture is combined.
Use a 1-inch (2.5 cm) cookie scoop or a teaspoon to scoop out the mixture and roll it into balls. Continue until all of the mixture has been used.
Chill in the fridge for 15 minutes to allow them to set. Enjoy!

name: Coconut Chia Pudding with Cooked Apples
ingredients:
1 3/4 cups
Canned Coconut Milk
1/4 cup
Chia Seeds
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup (divided)
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 tsp
Coconut Oil
1
Apple (medium, chopped)
recipe:
Add the coconut milk, chia seeds, 3/4 of the maple syrup, and vanilla to a large container. Stir well to combine.
Melt the coconut oil in a small pot over medium-low heat. Once hot, add the apple and remaining maple syrup. Cook for seven to eight minutes until softened, stirring occasionally.
Add the cooked apple to the chia mixture and mix well. Refrigerate for two hours or overnight.
Divide evenly between bowls or containers. Enjoy!

name: Smoky Roasted Cauliflower Dip
ingredients:
1/2 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Cottage Cheese
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
4 ozs
Seed Crackers
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the cauliflower with half the oil, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes until golden and tender.
Blend the warm roasted cauliflower, cottage cheese, lemon juice, and the remaining oil in a food processor until smooth.
Transfer to a bowl. Divide evenly between plates along with the crackers. Enjoy!

name: Easy Sea Salt Hot Chocolate
ingredients:
1 cup
Chocolate Milk, Low Fat
1 tsp
Butter (optional)
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Heat the milk in a pot over low heat. Add the butter and salt, whisking continuously. Remove from the heat when it starts to bubble.
Use a handheld frother to froth. Divide evenly into mugs and enjoy!

name: Grilled Carrots with Fresh Herbs
ingredients:
12
Carrot (medium, washed)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
1/3 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
3 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)
1/2
Lime (juiced)
recipe:
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat. Coat the carrots in oil, salt, and pepper.
Place the carrots on the grill. Cook for 12 to 14 minutes until slightly charred and fork tender, rotating every few minutes.
Plate the grilled carrots and top with green onion, cilantro, dill, and lime juice. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Beet, Burrata & Arugula Salad
ingredients:
4
Beet (medium, washed)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
White Wine Vinegar
1 tsp
Raw Honey

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
8 cups
Arugula
8 ozs
Burrata
1/2 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Place the beets in a pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer. Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes or until the beets are fork-tender.
Remove from the pot, let them cool slightly, then peel the skins and tops off with your hands under running water. Cut the beets into quarters or wedges.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk together the oil, white wine vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Divide the arugula, cooked beets, burrata, pumpkin seeds, and dressing evenly into bowls or plates. Top with flaky salt. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Falafel, Snow Peas & Bell Peppers
ingredients:
5 1/2 ozs
Frozen Falafel
1
Yellow Onion (medium, roughly chopped)
1
Red Bell Pepper (medium, chopped)
1 cup
Snow Peas (stems removed)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the falafel, onion, bell pepper, and snow peas on the baking sheet. Drizzle the vegetables with oil and season with salt and pepper.
Cook in the oven for 12 to 15 minutes until the vegetables are tender and the falafel is cooked. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Artichoke & Sun Dried Tomato Focaccia
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Water (warm)
2 tsps
Instant Yeast
1 1/2 tsps
Maple Syrup
12 1/2 ozs
Unbleached All Purpose Flour (plus more for dusting)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
2 tsps
Sea Salt (plus flaky salt for garnish)
1/8 oz
Avocado Oil Spray (divided)
1/4 cup
Sun Dried Tomatoes (chopped)
1/4 cup
Artichoke Hearts (from the jar, drained, coarsely chopped)
recipe:
In a large bowl, combine the warm water, yeast, and maple syrup. Stir, cover with a towel, and let sit for five minutes.
Add the flour, half of the olive oil, and salt to the bowl. Mix the ingredients together with a wooden spoon. Once the dough starts to come together, transfer it to a clean surface dusted with flour. Knead the dough for five to six minutes.
Spray a clean bowl with half of the avocado oil spray. Place the dough in the bowl, cover it with a damp towel, and let it rise in a warm place for one hour or until it doubles in size.
Spray a baking dish with avocado oil spray. Transfer the dough to the dish, gently pressing it into an even layer. Dimple the dough with your fingertips.
Drizzle the dough with the remaining olive oil. Let it rise for another 30 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Top the dough with sun dried tomatoes, artichokes, and a sprinkle of flaky salt. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Slice into even pieces and enjoy.

name: Roasted Hasselback Beets
ingredients:
4
Beet (large, peeled)
2 tbsps
Butter (melted, divided)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)
1 tsp
Everything Bagel Seasoning
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Trim a thin slice off the stem end of the beet to create a flat base.
Cut the beet into thin slices, stopping about 1/4 inch (6 mm) from the bottom.
Place the beets in a baking dish and drizzle each with half of the butter. Cover the dish with foil and place it in the oven.
Cook in the oven for 50 to 55 minutes. At the halfway mark, remove the foil, brush the beets with the remaining butter, and return them to the oven.
Top the cooked beets with dill and seasoning. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Simple Mustard Greens Salad
ingredients:
4 cups
Mustard Greens (chopped)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a bowl and toss to combine. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Focaccia with Peaches & Thyme
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Water (warm)
2 tsps
Instant Yeast
1 1/2 tsps
Maple Syrup
12 1/2 ozs
Unbleached All Purpose Flour (plus more for dusting)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
2 tsps
Sea Salt (plus flaky salt for garnish)
1/8 oz
Avocado Oil Spray (divided)
2 tbsps
Thyme (fresh)
1
Peach (medium, sliced)
recipe:
In a large bowl, combine the warm water, yeast, and maple syrup. Stir, cover with a towel and let it sit for five minutes.
Add the flour, half of the olive oil, and salt to the bowl. Mix the ingredients together with a wooden spoon. Once the dough starts to come together, transfer to a clean surface dusted with flour. Knead the dough for five to six minutes.
Spray a clean bowl with half of the avocado oil spray. Place the dough in the bowl, cover it with a damp towel, and let it rise in a warm place for one hour or until it doubles in size.
Spray a baking dish with avocado oil spray. Transfer the dough to the dish, gently pressing it into an even layer. Dimple the dough with your fingertips.
Drizzle the dough with the remaining olive oil. Let it rise for another 30 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Top the dough with fresh thyme, peach slices, and a sprinkle of flaky salt. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Slice into even pieces and enjoy!

name: Mustard Green, Arugula & Tomato Salad
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Mustard Greens (chopped)
2 cups
Arugula
1/3 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
recipe:
In a small bowl or jar, combine the oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Whisk or shake the jar until well combined.
Add the remaining ingredients to a bowl, add the dressing, and toss to combine. Divide evenly between plates or bowls, and enjoy!

name: Beet & Orange Salad with Honey Mustard Dressing
ingredients:
3
Beet (large, peeled, quartered)
1/3 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 tsps
Dijon Mustard
1 1/2 tsps
Raw Honey
2 tbsps
Red Wine Vinegar
8 cups
Arugula
1
Navel Orange (peeled, chopped)
1/2 cup
Pecans (toasted, chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the beets on the baking sheet. Toss them with 1/3 of the oil and season with salt and pepper. Cook for 35 to 40 minutes or until tender. Set aside when finished.
Meanwhile, combine the remaining oil, mustard, honey, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a small bowl or jar. Whisk or shake the jar until well combined.
In a large salad bowl, add the arugula, cooked beets, orange, and toasted pecans. Add the dressing and toss to combine. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Sauteed Lemony Mustard Greens
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/3 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
4 cups
Mustard Greens (roughly chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for two to three minutes. Add the mustard greens and cook for another two to three minutes or until they start to wilt.
Add the garlic, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Cook for another two to three minutes or until the stems of the greens are fork tender.
Divide evenly onto plates and enjoy!

name: Tomato, Peach & Burrata Salad
ingredients:
4
Tomato (medium, cut into wedges)
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
2
Peach (small, sliced)
8 ozs
Burrata
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Raw Honey
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
Spread the tomatoes and peach slices evenly on a serving dish. Top with dollops of burrata.
Whisk the oil and honey together in a small bowl and drizzle it over the salad. Sprinkle the salad with salt and chili flakes. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Tofu & Cauliflower Crumble with Spinach
ingredients:
16 ozs
Tofu (firm, pressed)
1/2 tsp
Fennel Seed
1 tsp
Thyme (fresh)
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 cups
Baby Spinach
1 cup
Cauliflower Rice
1 tbsp
Tamari
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
recipe:
In a food processor, add the tofu, fennel seeds, thyme, paprika, and garlic powder. Pulse for 10 to 15 seconds to create a chunky crumble.
Heat a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the oil, then the crumbled tofu. Cook undisturbed until brown on the underside for three minutes, then stir and cook for two more minutes.
Add the spinach and cauliflower rice and cook for one to two minutes, until the spinach is wilted. Turn off the heat, add the tamari and maple syrup, and mix well. Divide evenly between bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Spicy Shredded Tofu Taco Filling
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4
Yellow Onion (finely diced)
1/2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, finely diced)
1/2
Jalapeno Pepper (small, finely diced)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tsps
Taco Seasoning
2 tbsps
Water (plus more as needed)
8 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, pressed, grated)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the onion, bell pepper, and jalapeño and cook for three to five minutes until soft. Add the garlic.
Add the taco seasoning and water and toss to combine.
Add the tofu and gently toss to coat it in seasoning. Cook for two to three minutes, stirring occasionally. If needed, add additional water for moisture and season with salt and pepper. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Cilantro Lime Roasted Cauliflower
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lime (medium, juiced)
1 tsp
Cumin Seed

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, whisk together the oil, lime juice, cumin, salt, and pepper. Add the cauliflower and toss to combine. Transfer the cauliflower to the baking sheet. Cook in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until tender.
Toss with cilantro before serving. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Tahini Banana Bites
ingredients:
2
Banana (large)
1/3 cup
Tahini
1/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
1/2 tsp
Coconut Oil
1 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Slice the bananas into about 1/4 to 1/2 inch (5 to 10 mm) rounds. Place half of the sliced bananas on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Spread the tahini evenly onto each piece of banana, then place the remaining pieces on top to make a sandwich. Place in the freezer for 45 to 60 minutes or until frozen.
Melt the chocolate and coconut oil in a saucepan on low or in the microwave for 30-second intervals. Dip each frozen banana bite into the chocolate and sprinkle it with salt.
Place the chocolate-dipped bananas back in the freezer until the chocolate has hardened, approximately 10 to 15 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Lemony Couscous & Halloumi Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Couscous (dry)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
4 ozs
Halloumi (cut into cubes)
1
Lemon (medium, juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2/3 cup
Corn
1 1/3 cups
Purple Cabbage (finely shredded)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the couscous according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, heat half of the oil in a pan. Add the cubed halloumi and cook for two to three minutes per side or until browned.
In a bowl, whisk together the remaining oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Add the cooked couscous, corn, cabbage, parsley, and halloumi. Toss to combine.
Divide evenly between bowls or plates, and enjoy!

name: Thai Red Curry Tempeh & Vegetables
ingredients:
7 ozs
Tempeh (crumbled)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 tbsp
Soy Sauce (divided)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (chopped)
1/4 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
1/2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, chopped)
1 tbsp
Thai Red Curry Paste
1/2 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1 tbsp
Almond Butter
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
1/2 cup
Water
recipe:
Place the crumbled tempeh in a pot with just enough water to cover it. Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Cook for five to seven minutes or until the water evaporates completely. Add half of the oil and cook for an additional five minutes until browned, stirring occasionally. Add half of the soy sauce and stir to coat. Set aside.
In the same pot, add the remaining oil, onion, cauliflower, and bell pepper. Cook for three to four minutes. Add the curry paste and sauté for one minute.
Add the coconut milk, almond butter, lime juice, remaining soy sauce, and water. Cover, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for five minutes until the cauliflower is tender.
Add the cooked tempeh, and simmer for another two to three minutes to combine. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Crumbled Tofu & Coleslaw Stir Fry
ingredients:
1 1/2 tbsps
Soy Sauce
1 tbsp
Cane Sugar
1 tbsp
Water
1 1/2 tbsps
Sesame Oil (divided)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2 tsp
Ginger (fresh, grated)
12 ozs
Tofu (firm, pressed, crumbled)
2 1/2 cups
Coleslaw Mix
2 tbsps
Almonds (toasted, chopped)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped, plus more for garnish)
recipe:
In a bowl, combine the soy sauce, sugar, water, 1/3 of the sesame oil, garlic, and ginger. Set aside.
Heat the remaining oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the tofu and sauté for five minutes or until the pan is completely dry.
Add the coleslaw mix and prepared sauce and cook for two to three more minutes, until the cabbage wilts.
Add the chopped almonds and green onions. Sauté for one to two minutes, until well combined. Divide evenly between plates, top with additional green onion, and enjoy!

name: Asparagus & Feta Orzo Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Orzo (dry)
2 cups
Asparagus (trimmed, chopped)
1/3 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced, zested)
1 tsp
Dijon Mustard
1 tsp
Raw Honey

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1/3 cup
Sun Dried Tomatoes (sliced)
recipe:
Cook the orzo to al dente, according to the package directions. Add the chopped asparagus during the last minute.
Drain the orzo and asparagus and set aside in a large bowl.
Whisk together the oil, lemon juice and zest, mustard, honey, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Pour the dressing over the orzo and asparagus. Add the feta and sun-dried tomatoes and gently toss to combine. Divide evenly between bowls or plates, and enjoy!

name: Cold Noodle & Edamame Salad with Honey Miso Dressing
ingredients:
3 ozs
Chow Mein Noodles
1 tbsp
Miso Paste
1/2
Lime (juiced)
1 tbsp
Soy Sauce, Low Sodium
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
1
Garlic (minced)
1
Carrot (medium, peeled, shredded)
1 1/2 cups
Purple Cabbage (thinly sliced)
1/2 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1 tsp
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
recipe:
Cook the noodles according to the package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water.
Meanwhile, in a bowl, whisk together the miso paste, lime juice, soy sauce, honey, and garlic. If needed, add a splash of water to thin the dressing.
Divide the cooked noodles, carrots, cabbage, and edamame evenly between bowls. Top with sesame seeds, dressing, and enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato & Tofu Tacos
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Tamari
3 tbsps
Avocado Oil (divided)
2 tbsps
Taco Seasoning (divided)
3 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 lbs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, crumbled)
1
Sweet Potato (large, chopped into small cubes)
1/2 cup
Guacamole
8
Corn Tortilla (small, warmed)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and lightly grease a baking sheet. Line a second baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the tamari, 2/3 of the oil, half of the taco seasoning, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper. Add the crumbled tofu and toss well. Transfer to the greased baking sheet and toss well.
In the same bowl, toss the sweet potato with the remaining oil and the remaining taco seasoning. Transfer to the parchment-lined baking sheet.
Place both baking sheets in the oven. Cook for 22 to 25 minutes until the tofu is browned and crispy and the sweet potatoes are fork-tender. Toss at the halfway mark.
Divide the guacamole evenly between the warmed tortillas. Top with tofu and sweet potato. Enjoy!

name: Maple Teriyaki Roasted Nuts & Seeds
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Walnuts
1/2 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
1/4 cup
Teriyaki Sauce
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add all of the ingredients to a bowl and mix well to ensure the nuts and seeds are evenly coated in sauce.
Spread the mixture out into an even layer on the baking sheet. Bake for 13 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool before serving. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate & Berry Kefir Smoothie
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Plain Kefir
1/2
Avocado (small)
3/4 cup
Frozen Berries
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1 1/2 tbsps
Cocoa Powder
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Enjoy!

name: Blueberry & Peach Salsa with Tortilla Chips
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Blueberries
1
Peach (large, diced)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (finely chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (finely chopped)
1
Lime (medium, juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 1/2 cups
Corn Tortilla Chips
recipe: Add the blueberries, peach, cilantro, garlic, onion, lime juice, and salt to a bowl and gently toss to combine. Serve with tortilla chips. Enjoy!

name: Artichoke & Pumpkin Seed Salad
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 cups
Mixed Greens
1 cup
Artichoke Hearts (from the jar, chopped)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1/4 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
In a small bowl or jar, combine the oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Whisk or shake the jar until well combined.
Add the remaining ingredients to a bowl, add the dressing, and toss to combine. Divide evenly between plates or bowls, and enjoy!

name: Wild Rice Pudding with Fresh Berries
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Wild Rice (dry)
3 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1/2 cup
Water
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup (divided)
1 cup
Raspberries
1 cup
Blueberries
2 tbsps
Sunflower Seeds (toasted)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions. Set aside to cool for 10 to 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine the chia seeds, water, and 1/4 of the maple syrup in a bowl. Stir well and let sit for eight to 10 minutes until thickened.
Transfer the rice to a blender or food processor with the remaining maple syrup. Pulse until smooth or to your preferred consistency.
Add the chia mixture and pulse briefly until just combined. Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes to set.
Divide the pudding evenly between bowls and top with fresh berries and sunflower seeds. Enjoy!

name: Tofu & Chickpea Bowl with Peanut Sauce
ingredients:
1 1/3 cups
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1/3 cup
All Natural Peanut Butter (runny)
3 tbsps
Tamari
1 tbsp
Sriracha
1/3 cup
Water
2 tbsps
Lime Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 lbs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, cubed)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 tsp
Chili Powder
2 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a jar, combine the peanut butter, tamari, sriracha, water, and lime juice. Shake to combine and season with salt and pepper. Set aside.
In a large bowl, add the tofu and gently toss with 1/4 of the peanut sauce. Spread the tofu out evenly on the baking sheet.
In the same bowl, add the chickpeas and drizzle with half the oil, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Place on the prepared baking sheet. Add the broccoli to the same bowl and toss with the remaining oil, salt, and pepper. Place on the prepared baking sheet.
Transfer the baking sheet to the oven and bake for 25 minutes, flipping the tofu and tossing the chickpeas and broccoli halfway. Divide the cooked quinoa, tofu, chickpeas, and broccoli evenly into bowls and serve with the remaining peanut sauce. Enjoy!

name: Three Sisters Salad
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Butternut Squash (peeled, seeds removed, cubed)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 1/2 tsps
White Wine Vinegar
1 tsp
Raw Honey
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
2 tbsps
Chives (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Corn (cooked)
1 cup
Black Beans (cooked)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Spread the squash in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet and coat with half of the oil. Cook in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until tender. Let cool.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk together the remaining oil, vinegar, honey, parsley, chives, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked squash, corn, and black beans. Toss well to combine. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Blueberry & Peach Salsa
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Blueberries
1
Peach (large, diced)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (finely chopped)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (finely chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1
Lime (juiced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a bowl and gently toss to combine. Divide evenly between bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Roasted Red Pepper & Tahini Beans with Air Fryer Asparagus
ingredients:
2 cups
Asparagus (trimmed)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Tahini
4 ozs
Roasted Red Peppers
1 tbsp
Tomato Paste
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced, plus extra for garnish)
1
Garlic (clove)
2 1/2 cups
Cannellini Beans (cooked)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 400ºF (205ºC). Place the asparagus in the basket, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Cook for five to six minutes, or until tender.
Meanwhile, add the tahini, roasted red pepper, tomato paste, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper to a blender. Blend until smooth, adding a splash of water to thin if needed.
Transfer the mixture to a pot with the beans and bring to a simmer. Simmer for five minutes or until heated through, stirring occasionally.
Divide the beans and asparagus evenly between plates. Top with parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Sesame Soy Sauteed TVP, Carrot & Cabbage
ingredients:
1 cup
Textured Vegetable Protein (crumbs)
1 tbsp
Sesame Oil
1
Yellow Onion (medium, sliced)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1
Carrot (medium, peeled, shredded)
1 1/2 cups
Purple Cabbage (thinly sliced)
1 1/2 tbsps
Soy Sauce (Low Sodium)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Place the textured vegetable protein in a bowl and cover it with boiling water. Cover the bowl and let it sit for 10 minutes to rehydrate.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for four to five minutes, until softened. Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the rehydrated textured vegetable protein, carrot, and cabbage. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk the soy sauce, maple syrup, and chili flakes. Add the mixture to the pan and stir to combine. Cook for another five minutes until the flavors are well combined.
Divide evenly between bowls, top with green onion, and enjoy!

name: Fry Bread
ingredients:
8 1/2 ozs
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
1 tbsp
Baking Powder
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
3/4 cup
Water (warm)
1/3 cup
Vegetable Oil
recipe:
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Gradually stir in warm water using a spatula until mostly combined, then switch to your hands and knead until a soft dough forms. Cover with a towel and let rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough evenly into pieces and flatten each piece so it's approximately 1/4 inch thick.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat until it reaches 350ºF (175ºC). Fry one piece at a time for one to two minutes per side, or until golden and puffed.
Transfer to a plate with a paper towel to drain any excess oil. Enjoy!

name: Three Sisters Soup
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tsps
Dried Thyme
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 tsp
Black Pepper
4 cups
Vegetable Broth
1/2 cup
Frozen Corn (thawed)
2 cups
Butternut Squash (peeled, seeds removed, cubed)
1 cup
White Navy Beans (cooked, rinsed)
recipe:
Heat a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Add the oil, then the onion and garlic. Sauté for two to three minutes until softened.
Add the thyme, salt, and pepper. Add the broth, corn, squash, and beans, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until the squash is tender. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Chip Cookie Granola
ingredients:
3 cups
Oats (rolled)
1/4 cup
Oat Flour
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 tsp
Baking Soda
2 tbsps
Almond Butter (runny)
1/3 cup
Coconut Oil (melted)
1/3 cup
Coconut Sugar
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/2 cup
Milk Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 325°F (165°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, mix the oats, oat flour, chia seeds, salt, and baking soda.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond butter, melted coconut oil, coconut sugar, and maple syrup until smooth. Add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients and stir until the oats are evenly coated.
Spread the granola onto the baking sheet and gently press down with the back of a spoon. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.
Let cool for five minutes, then sprinkle the chocolate over the warm granola. Allow to cool completely before serving or transferring to a storage container. Enjoy!

name: Cabbage Slaw with Fresh Herbs, Almonds & Lime
ingredients:
3 cups
Purple Cabbage (thinly sliced)
1
Carrot (large, grated)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Red Onion
1/2 cup
Parsley (chopped)
1/4 cup
Fresh Dill (chopped)
1/4 cup
Sliced Almonds
1 1/2
Lime (medium, juiced)
recipe:
Add the cabbage, carrot, half the oil, salt, and pepper to a bowl. Lightly massage to soften the cabbage.
Add the onion, parsley, dill, almonds, the remaining oil, and lime juice and toss to combine. Season with additional salt and pepper, if needed. Divide evenly onto plates and enjoy!

name: Cold Peanut Noodle Salad with Crispy Air Fryer Tofu
ingredients:
7 ozs
Buckwheat Soba Noodles (dry)
16 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, cubed)
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Tamari
1 tbsp
Cornstarch

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 cups
Green Cabbage (finely shredded)
2
Carrot (medium, peeled, grated)
1 cup
Peanut Sauce
recipe:
Cook the noodles according to the package directions. Drain, rinse under cold water, and set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat the air fryer to 400ºF (205ºC). In a medium-sized bowl, add the tofu, oil, tamari, cornstarch, salt, and pepper and gently toss to combine.
Add the tofu to the air fryer basket in an even layer. Cook for 12 to 14 minutes until crispy, flipping halfway.
Divide the cooked noodles, cabbage, and carrot evenly into bowls and top with tofu. Drizzle with peanut sauce and toss to combine. Enjoy!

name: One Pan Harissa Bulgur & Chickpeas
ingredients:
2 cups
Cherry Tomatoes
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
2 tsps
Moroccan Spice Blend
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2/3 cup
Bulgur (dry)
1 tbsp
Harissa
1 1/3 cups
Vegetable Broth (warm)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
1/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt (optional)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). In a small baking dish, combine the cherry tomatoes, chickpeas, spice blend, salt, and oil.
Cook in the oven for 20 minutes. Remove the dish from the oven and add the bulgur, harissa, and warm broth. Stir to combine. Cover tightly with foil and return to the oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the bulgur is fully cooked.
Remove from the oven, fluff with a fork, and let it rest for a few minutes before serving. Serve warm, topped with cilantro and a spoonful of yogurt (optional). Enjoy!

name: Spiced Roasted Carrots & Bulgur
ingredients:
1 cup
Bulgur (dry)
1 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
2
Carrot (medium, peeled, sliced)
1 tsp
Moroccan Spice Blend
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1
Lemon (medium, juiced, zested)
3/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1/3 cup
Pitted Dates (chopped)
1/4 cup
Parsley (finely chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). In a large baking dish, combine the bulgur, broth, and chickpeas.
In a bowl, toss the carrots with the spice blend and 1/3 of the oil. Spread the carrots out over the bulgur mixture. Cook in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes, or until the bulgur is cooked and the carrots are tender.
Meanwhile, whisk the lemon juice, zest, and the remaining oil to make the dressing.
Fluff the bulgur with a fork and add the dressing. Top with crumbled feta, dates, and parsley. Enjoy!

name: Tofu Quinoa Bowl with Lemon Herb Tahini Sauce
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
16 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, cubed)
2 tsps
Avocado Oil (divided)
1 1/2 tsps
Tamari

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Cornstarch
3 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
2 tbsps
Tahini
1/2 cup
Parsley (chopped)
1/4 cup
Fresh Dill (chopped)
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
3 tbsps
Water
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the tofu cubes to a bowl and gently toss with half the oil, tamari, salt, and pepper. Add the cornstarch and gently toss until the tofu cubes are well coated. Arrange the tofu on one side of the prepared baking sheet.
In the same bowl, toss the broccoli with the remaining oil and season with salt and pepper. Add the broccoli to the other side of the baking sheet. Cook in the oven for 20 minutes or until the broccoli is tender and the tofu is crispy.
To make the sauce, add the tahini, parsley, dill, lemon juice, and water to a blender and blend until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide the quinoa, tofu, and broccoli evenly into bowls. Drizzle with the sauce and enjoy!

name: Raisins & Walnuts
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Walnuts
2 tbsps
Raisins
recipe: Add all ingredients to a bowl or plate. Enjoy!

name: Coconut Water Lemonade
ingredients:
4 cups
Coconut Water
1/4 cup
Lemon Juice
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/2
Lemon (small, sliced)
recipe: Add the coconut water, lemon juice, and maple syrup to a pitcher and stir well to combine. Pour into glasses and garnish each one with a lemon slice. Enjoy!

name: Raisins & Almonds
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Almonds
2 tbsps
Raisins
recipe: Add all ingredients to a bowl or plate. Enjoy!

name: Avocado Toast with Hemp Seeds
ingredients:
1/2
Avocado (medium)
1 slice
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
1 tsp
Hemp Seeds
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe: Mash the avocado onto the toast. Top with hemp seeds and salt. Enjoy!

name: PB & J Sandwich Skewers
ingredients:
1/4 cup
All Natural Peanut Butter
4 slices
Whole Grain Bread
1/4 cup
Strawberry Jam
1/2 cup
Grapes
1/4 cup
Blueberries
6
Barbecue Skewers
recipe:
Spread the peanut butter on half the bread slices and the jam on the remaining slices. Close the sandwiches and cut each one into six equal-sized pieces.
Take a barbecue skewer and thread a piece of sandwich, a grape, a blueberry, and then repeat one more time. Repeat with each skewer until all of the ingredients are used up. Enjoy!

name: Hazelnut & Pistachio Dark Chocolate Bark
ingredients:
7 ozs
Dark Chocolate
1/3 cup
Pistachios (divided)
1/3 cup
Hazelnuts (divided)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Line a plate or baking sheet with parchment paper.
Melt the chocolate using a double boiler or in 30-second increments in the microwave. Once melted, add half the pistachios and hazelnuts. Mix well until everything is evenly covered in chocolate.
Transfer the chocolate to the prepared parchment paper and spread into an even layer. Garnish with the remaining pistachios and hazelnuts. Place the bark in the fridge for one hour or until solid. Sprinkle with salt just before the chocolate sets.
When solid, break into pieces and store in an airtight container in the freezer or fridge until ready to eat. Enjoy!

name: Greek Orzo Pasta Salad
ingredients:
1 1/3 cups
Orzo (dry)
1/2 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Lemon (medium, juiced, zested)
1 tsp
Oregano

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
3/4 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives
1/3
Cucumber (large, diced)
1 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1/2 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the orzo according to the package directions. Drain and transfer to a large bowl.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix together the oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Add the tomatoes, olives, cucumber, and dressing to the orzo and mix well. Add the feta and basil and gently toss to combine. Divide evenly between bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Radish & Cucumber Mini Potato Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
Mini Potatoes (halved)
1 1/2 tsps
Yellow Mustard
1 1/2 tsps
White Wine Vinegar
1/8 tsp
Cane Sugar
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Shallot (finely chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Radishes (thinly sliced)
1/4
Cucumber (large, sliced)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (finely chopped)
recipe:
Add the potatoes to a large pot with enough water to cover them. Bring the water to a boil and cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until just tender. Drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk together the mustard, vinegar, and sugar. Gradually add the oil in a thin stream while whisking continuously. Add the shallot and season with salt and pepper.
Toss the warm potatoes in the dressing. Let them marinate for five minutes.
Add the radishes, cucumber, and dill and toss to coat. Divide evenly between bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Tomato Chickpeas & Olives on Toast
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Tomato Purée
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/4 cup
Green Olives (halved)
1 tsp
Greek Seasoning

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Nutritional Yeast
3 1/2 ozs
Sourdough Bread (sliced, toasted)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (for garnish)
recipe:
Heat the tomato purée in a pan over medium heat. Add the chickpeas, olives, and Greek seasoning and stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer and season with salt and pepper. Cook for five minutes until the flavors are well combined. Remove from the heat and add the nutritional yeast.
Top the toast evenly with the chickpea mixture. Garnish with cilantro and enjoy!

name: Fruit Salad with Mint & Honey
ingredients:
1
Navel Orange (medium, peeled, chopped)
1 cup
Raspberries
1 cup
Blueberries
2 tbsps
Raw Honey
1/3 cup
Mint Leaves
recipe: Add the orange, raspberries, blueberries, and honey to a bowl and gently toss to combine. Garnish with mint leaves. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Protein Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Strawberries (fresh or frozen)
1
Banana (small, frozen)
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tbsp
Almond Butter
1 tbsp
Ground Flax Seed
1 1/4 cups
Cow's Milk, Whole
recipe: Place all ingredients in your blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Sesame Ginger Dressing
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Tahini
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 tbsps
Rice Vinegar
2 tbsps
Tamari
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Ginger (minced)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
3 tbsps
Water (plus more as needed)
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Alternatively, use an immersion blender.
If needed, add an additional tablespoon of water at a time until you reach your desired consistency. Enjoy!

name: No Bake Mini Cookie Dough Cups
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Almond Butter
1/3 cup
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 cup
Oat Flour
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (plus flaky salt for garnish)
3/4 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil
recipe:
Line a mini muffin tray with liners. In a large bowl, combine the almond butter, maple syrup, and vanilla. Add the oat flour and salt, and use a spatula to mix well until a dough forms.
Press about one tablespoon of mixture into the bottom of each lined muffin cup, pressing down lightly to make a smooth, flat top.
Melt the chocolate and coconut oil in a saucepan on low or in the microwave for 30-second intervals.
Spoon the chocolate over the cookie dough and sprinkle with flaky salt. Transfer the muffin tray to the fridge for one hour, or until the chocolate has hardened. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Chip & Raisin Popcorn
ingredients:
4 cups
Popcorn
1/2 cup
Raisins
1/4 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe: Place the popcorn in a bowl and add the raisins and chocolate chips. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry, Almond & Pumpkin Seed Trail Mix
ingredients:
4 ozs
Freeze Dried Strawberries
1/2 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
1/2 cup
Sliced Almonds
recipe: Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl or container. Serve and enjoy!

name: TVP & Quinoa Bowl with Miso Dressing
ingredients:
1 cup
Textured Vegetable Protein (crumbs)
2/3 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1 1/2 tsps
Sesame Oil
1/2 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1 tbsp
Miso Paste (dark)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2
Lime (medium, juiced)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
2 tsps
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Place the textured vegetable protein in a bowl and cover it with boiling water. Cover the bowl and let it sit for 10 minutes to rehydrate.
Meanwhile, cook the quinoa according to the package directions, then set it aside.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the rehydrated textured vegetable protein and sauté for five minutes, or until slightly browned. Add the edamame and sauté for another two minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together the miso, garlic, lime juice, and maple syrup. If needed, add a splash of water to thin.
Divide the quinoa and TVP mixture evenly between bowls. Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Drizzle the dressing on top and enjoy!

name: Cold Noodles with Crunchy Tahini Corn Slaw
ingredients:
4 ozs
Rice Vermicelli Noodles (dry)
2 tbsps
Tahini
1 1/2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1/2
Lime (medium, juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Purple Cabbage (thinly sliced)
1
Carrot (medium, julienned)
1/2 cup
Corn (cooked)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the noodles according to the package directions. Drain, rinse under cold water, and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the tahini, maple syrup, lime juice, salt, and pepper. Add a splash of water to thin the sauce if needed.
Add the cabbage, carrot, corn, and cilantro to the bowl and toss to combine. Divide the slaw and noodles evenly between bowls or plates. Enjoy!

name: Mango & Jalapeno Salsa
ingredients:
1
Mango (large, peeled, cubed)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (finely chopped)
1
Jalapeno Pepper (small, seeds removed, finely chopped)
3 tbsps
Cilantro (finely chopped)
1
Lime (medium, juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe: Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Serve and enjoy!

name: Avocado & Edamame Dip
ingredients:
1
Avocado (medium)
1 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1
Lime (medium, juiced)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes (plus extra for garnish)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender or food processor. Blend until you reach your desired consistency, smooth or chunky. If the mixture is too thick, add a splash of water to thin. Serve and enjoy!

name: Mixed Herb & Anchovy Pasta Salad
ingredients:
13 ozs
Whole Wheat Rotini Pasta (dry)
1 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 tsp
Red Pepper Flakes
6 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
3
Anchovy (fillets, chopped)
1 cup
Parsley (finely chopped)
1/2 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped)
1
Lemon (medium, juiced, zested)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Reserve some pasta water.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the red pepper flakes, green onion, and anchovy. Cook for 30 seconds, stirring frequently. Transfer to a large bowl.
Add the parsley, basil, lemon juice, lemon zest, cooked pasta, and pasta water to the bowl. Stir well to coat the pasta. Season with salt and pepper and mix well to coat.
Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes before serving. Divide evenly onto plates and enjoy!

name: Meal Prep TVP & Refried Bean Burrito
ingredients:
3 cups
Textured Vegetable Protein (crumbs)
1 1/2 tbsps
Taco Seasoning
1 can
Refried Beans
6
Whole Wheat Tortilla (large)
1/2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, finely diced)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
1/2 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
1/2 cup
Black Olives (sliced)
4 ozs
Vegan Cheese Shreds
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, mix the textured vegetable protein with the taco seasoning.
Spread the refried beans evenly on each tortilla. Top evenly with the seasoned textured vegetable protein, bell pepper, green onion, cilantro, olives, and cheese.
Tightly roll each tortilla into a burrito. Place seam-side down on the baking sheet. Repeat with the remaining tortillas.
If eating immediately, cook in the oven for eight to 10 minutes or pan fry each side until lightly golden. Wrap the remaining burritos in foil and freeze in a freezer-safe bag. See notes section for instructions on how to reheat. Enjoy!

name: Coconut Kefir Overnight Oats with Mango & Berries
ingredients:
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
2 1/2 cups
Plain Coconut Kefir
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1/4 tsp
Cinnamon
1/2 cup
Raspberries
1
Mango (small, diced)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
recipe:
In a bowl, combine the oats, kefir, chia seeds, and cinnamon. Stir well to combine. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Divide evenly into bowls or containers. Top with raspberries, mango, and a drizzle of maple syrup. Enjoy!

name: Pink Watermelon Lemonade
ingredients:
1/4
Seedless Watermelon (medium, chopped)
1/3 cup
Monk Fruit Sweetener
4 cups
Water (warm)
3/4 cup
Lemon Juice
16
Ice Cubes
recipe:
In a blender, purée the watermelon until smooth. Strain through a fine mesh sieve into a bowl or pitcher. Discard the pulp.
In a large pitcher, combine the monk fruit sweetener and warm water. Stir until the sweetener is completely dissolved. Add the lemon juice and stir well.
Add the watermelon juice and stir to combine. Serve immediately over ice or refrigerate until chilled. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Cauliflower with Olives & Raisins
ingredients:
1/2 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 1/2 tsps
Za'atar Spice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Green Olives (chopped)
2 tbsps
Raisins
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the cauliflower to the pan and toss with half the oil, za'atar, salt, and pepper. Cook in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until tender.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix together the olives, raisins, and remaining oil.
Place the cauliflower on a serving plate and top with the olive and raisin mixture. Divide evenly onto plates and enjoy!

name: Zucchini Ricotta Pasta
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Brown Rice Spaghetti
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
2
Zucchini (medium, grated)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/3 cup
Ricotta Cheese
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Reserve some of the pasta water.
Meanwhile, heat a pan over medium-high heat and add the zucchini. Cook for 10 minutes until tender, stirring occasionally. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the ricotta and a splash of the reserved pasta water to the pan. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Add the cooked pasta and toss to coat. Cook for another one to two minutes, adding more pasta water as needed to loosen the sauce.
Divide the pasta evenly between bowls or plates. Top with chili flakes and parsley. Enjoy!

name: Nutty Cookie Dough Energy Balls
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Pitted Dates
1 cup
Walnuts
1/2 cup
Pecans
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
2 tbsps
Cashew Butter (runny)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Add the dates, walnuts, pecans, and hemp seeds to a food processor. Blend to form small, crumbly pieces.
Add the cashew butter and salt and blend again until combined. Pour the mixture into a bowl and add the chocolate chips.
Use a one-inch (2.5 cm) cookie scoop or a teaspoon to scoop out the mixture and roll it into balls. Continue until all of the mixture is used.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set. Enjoy!

name: Simple Blueberry Protein Shake
ingredients:
1 cup
Cow's Milk, Reduced Fat
1 cup
Frozen Blueberries
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: One Pot Cheesy Vegan TVP Pasta
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
2 1/2 cups
Textured Vegetable Protein (crumbs)
1 tbsp
Arrowroot Powder
1 tbsp
Chili Powder
2 tsps
Oregano

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 1/2 cups
Tomato Sauce
1/2 cup
Water (plus more as needed)
8 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (dry)
4 ozs
Vegan Cheese Shreds
recipe:
Heat a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the oil and onion and sauté for three to four minutes, until the onion softens. Add the textured vegetable protein. Cook for five minutes until warmed through, stirring often.
Add the arrowroot, chili powder, oregano, salt, and pepper and stir to evenly combine.
Add the almond milk, tomato sauce, and water. Add the pasta and stir well to combine.
Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook for six to eight minutes or until the pasta is al dente. Add additional water as needed.
Remove from the heat. Add the vegan cheese shreds and stir until melted and well combined. Divide evenly onto plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Honey Lemon Whipped Feta Bagel
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
1/4
Lemon (juiced)
2
Bagel (everything, toasted)
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
Add the feta, honey, and lemon juice to a food processor. Process for 30 seconds or until smooth. Add a splash of water to thin if needed.
Spread the feta onto each toasted bagel slice. Sprinkle chili flakes on top and enjoy!

name: Coconut Kefir Chia Pudding with Fruit & Granola
ingredients:
3 cups
Plain Coconut Kefir
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1/2 cup
Chia Seeds
1/2 cup
Raspberries
1/2 cup
Grapes (halved)
1/3 cup
Granola
recipe:
Mix the kefir and maple syrup together in a bowl or container. Add the chia seeds and stir well to combine.
Refrigerate, covered, for at least one hour or until the chia seeds have set.
Divide evenly into bowls or jars. Top with raspberries, grapes, and granola. Enjoy!

name: Avocado Key Lime Pie Jars
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Pitted Dates
1/2 cup
Pecans
1 1/2 tsps
Coconut Oil
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
1
Avocado (large, pitted)
1
Lime (medium, juiced, zested)
2 tbsps
Raw Honey
1/2 tsp
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
recipe:
Add the dates, pecans, oil, vanilla, and half the salt to a food processor. Process on high until the mixture is fully combined, sticky, and holds together.
Divide the crust into small jars or cups and press the mixture down. Set aside.
Wipe out the food processor and add the avocado, lime juice, lime zest, honey, and remaining salt. Process on high until smooth and creamy.
Divide the avocado mixture into each jar or cup. Sprinkle with shredded coconut. Enjoy!

name: Savory Nori & Seed Granola Bars
ingredients:
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
3/4 cup
Rice Puffs Cereal
3/4 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
1/2 cup
Hemp Seeds
1/4 cup
Sesame Seeds
2
Nori Sheets (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Raw Honey
1/2 cup
Tahini
recipe:
Line a baking dish with parchment paper, ensuring it covers all sides. In a large bowl, combine the oats, cereal, pumpkin seeds, hemp seeds, sesame seeds, nori, nutritional yeast, and salt.
In a small bowl, mix the honey and tahini together. Add it to the bowl with the dry ingredients. Mix very well with a spatula until everything is thoroughly combined.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish, pressing it firmly into an even layer. Refrigerate for one hour or until it sets.
Cut it evenly into rectangular pieces and enjoy!

name: Pan Seared Salted Dates
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil
1 cup
Pitted Dates (sliced open)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Place the dates in the pan, cut-side down, and press down to flatten. Sear for two to three minutes or until slightly golden. Flip and cook for another one to two minutes.
Add them to a plate and sprinkle with salt. Enjoy!

name: Raisin & Feta Quinoa
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/3 cup
Raisins
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions. Once cooked, fluff with a fork and let it cool for 10 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together the oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked quinoa, raisins, feta, and cilantro to the bowl. Stir to combine. Divide evenly onto plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Black Bean & Rice Burrito
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Brown Rice (dry, rinsed)
1/2 cup
Black Beans (cooked)
3 tbsps
Salsa
1/2 tsp
Taco Seasoning
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
1
Whole Wheat Tortilla (large)
2 1/2 ozs
Vegan Cheese Shreds
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
In a medium bowl, add the cooked rice, beans, salsa, seasoning, and cilantro and stir to combine.
Lay the tortilla on a flat surface and top with the rice and bean mixture, then the cheese shreds. Roll tightly into a burrito, tucking in all the sides.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium-low heat. Add the burrito seam-side down and heat for three to four minutes, until lightly browned on all sides. Remove from the pan, slice in half, and enjoy!

name: Burst Tomato & Burrata Crostini
ingredients:
14 ozs
Sourdough Baguette (sliced)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 1/2 cups
Cherry Tomatoes
1/2 tsp
Oregano
8 ozs
Burrata
1/3 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped)
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tsp
White Wine Vinegar
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and arrange the baguette slices on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with half of the oil and rub it into both sides of the baguette. Rub the garlic onto each piece. Cook in the oven for 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly golden.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the tomatoes and cook for 15 minutes or until they start to burst.
Spread the burrata evenly on the toasted baguette slices. Top each piece with cooked tomatoes, basil, chili flakes, salt, and pepper. Drizzle with vinegar. Serve and enjoy!

name: Chili Lime Mango
ingredients:
1
Mango (small)
1/2
Lime (juiced)
1/4 tsp
Chili Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Stand the mango up and use a sharp knife to cut along the sides of the pit to make large slices of mango. Make cuts into the slices to resemble cubes.
Drizzle the lime juice over each piece, followed by the chili powder and salt. Enjoy!

name: Lebanese Moussaka with Chickpeas
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (small, diced)
1
Eggplant (medium, peeled, cubed)
1 tsp
Tomato Paste
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1 cup
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with the juices)
1 cup
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
2/3 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion and sauté for five minutes until softened. Add the eggplant and cook for another 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned.
Add the tomato paste and paprika, and cook for another minute. Add the diced tomatoes and broth, stir well, and bring to a simmer. Cover the pot with a lid and simmer on low heat for approximately 10 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and season with salt and pepper. Stir, cover, and simmer for another 15 minutes or until everything is cooked and the flavors combine. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Divide the moussaka evenly between bowls. Top with chopped green onion, and enjoy!

name: Black Bean Hummus Dip with Carrot Sticks
ingredients:
1 cup
Black Beans (cooked)
2 tbsps
Tahini
1 1/2 tsps
Lemon Juice
1
Garlic (small clove)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Water
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
2
Carrot (medium, cut into sticks)
recipe:
Add the beans, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and water to a food processor. Blend for one minute or until smooth. Add more water to thin slightly, if needed.
Transfer the dip to a bowl. Top with chili flakes and serve with carrot sticks. Enjoy!

name: Sauteed Spiced Bell Peppers
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2
Red Bell Pepper (large, sliced)
2
Yellow Bell Pepper (large, sliced)
1 tsp
Chili Powder
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the bell peppers and season with chili powder and salt.
Sauté for 10 to 15 minutes or until the peppers are tender and lightly browned. Enjoy!

name: Cuban-Style Black Beans & Rice
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Brown Rice (dry, rinsed)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, finely chopped)
1 stalk
Green Onion (chopped)
1/2
Orange Bell Pepper (medium, finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
3/4 cup
Black Beans (from the can with the liquid)
1/2 cup
Water
1/4 tsp
Oregano
1/4 tsp
Cumin
1/2 tsp
Apple Cider Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the yellow onion, green onion, bell pepper, and cilantro. Sauté for three to five minutes, until softened.
Add the black beans, water, oregano, cumin, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add more water if needed to prevent it from drying out.
Divide the cooked rice and black beans evenly between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Blended Quinoa Porridge with Strawberries & Tahini
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup (divided)
3/4 cup
Strawberries (chopped)
1 tbsp
Tahini
recipe:
Add the almond milk to a medium-sized pot and bring to a low boil over medium heat. Add the quinoa and reduce the heat to low. Cover with a lid slightly ajar and cook for 13 to 15 minutes, until the quinoa is cooked through.
Add the vanilla extract and half of the maple syrup, and use an immersion blender to blend approximately half of the quinoa.
Meanwhile, combine the strawberries and remaining maple syrup in a saucepan. Heat over medium-low to bring to a low simmer. Cook for nine to 10 minutes, gently pressing on the strawberries with the back of a fork, until they have softened.
Divide the quinoa evenly into bowls and stir in the strawberries and tahini. Enjoy!

name: Sauteed Lemon Garlic Rapini
ingredients:
12 ozs
Rapini (trimmed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2
Garlic (clove, minced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
recipe:
Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add the rapini and blanch for one minute.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over medium-low heat. Add the garlic and sauté for 30 to 60 seconds.
Remove the rapini from the pot and drain well. Add it to the pan.
Sauté for four to five minutes or until cooked to your liking. Season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice. Serve and enjoy!

name: Halloumi, Corn & Hummus Flatbread
ingredients:
2 pieces
Naan
1/2 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
4 ozs
Halloumi (sliced)
1/4 cup
Hummus
1/2 cup
Corn (cooked)
1/4
Cucumber (large, chopped)
2 tbsps
Parsley
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Add the naan to the baking sheet and cook in the oven for eight minutes or until crispy.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the halloumi slices and cook for one to two minutes per side or until golden brown.
Spread the hummus on the naan. Top evenly with halloumi, corn, and cucumber. Garnish with parsley and enjoy!

name: Spicy Sesame Steamed Broccoli
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
1 tbsp
Sesame Oil
1 tbsp
Coconut Aminos
2 tsps
Sriracha
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
1/2 tsp
Sesame Seeds
recipe:
In a large bowl, combine the vinegar, oil, coconut aminos, sriracha, chili flakes, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Put the broccoli in a steamer basket over boiling water and cover. Steam for five minutes or until tender.
Add the broccoli to the bowl with the sauce. Toss to combine. Sprinkle sesame seeds on top and enjoy!

name: Tofu Scramble with Spinach & Feta
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
12 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, crumbled)
2 tbsps
Chives (thinly sliced)
2 tsps
Nutritional Yeast
1/2 tsp
Cumin
1/2 tsp
Turmeric
1/2 tsp
Dried Thyme

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 cups
Baby Spinach (chopped)
1/3 cup
Water
1/3 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the crumbled tofu, chives, nutritional yeast, cumin, turmeric, thyme, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Cook for four to five minutes until the tofu is lightly browned, stirring occasionally.
Add the spinach and water. Stir frequently for one to two minutes until the spinach is wilted and most of the water evaporates.
Remove from the heat and stir in the feta. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Simple Grilled Zucchini
ingredients:
2
Zucchini (large, sliced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the grill to medium heat. Toss the zucchini in oil, salt, and pepper.
Grill the zucchini for three to four minutes per side or until fork tender. Serve and enjoy!

name: Zucchini Pesto Cavatappi
ingredients:
2 1/2 cups
Cavatappi Pasta (dry)
1/2 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2
Zucchini (large, grated)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3/4 cup
Cottage Cheese
1 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped)
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
recipe:
Cook the pasta to al dente according to the package directions. Once done, reserve some of the pasta water and drain.
Meanwhile, heat a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the oil and zucchini and sauté for eight to ten minutes, stirring often until the zucchini reaches an almost puréed consistency. Season with salt and pepper and remove from the heat.
Using a blender, food processor, or immersion blender, blend the cottage cheese, basil, and lemon juice until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.
Return the pan to the stove over low heat. Add the pasta, cheese mixture, and reserved pasta water. Stir until creamy and well combined. Divide evenly into bowls and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Bark
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Oat Flour
1/4 cup
Raw Honey
1/4 cup
Coconut Oil (melted)
2 tsps
Vanilla Extract
1 1/2 cups
Dark Chocolate Chips
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set it aside.
In a bowl, mix the flour, honey, oil, and vanilla with a spatula until well combined. Fold in 1/4 of the chocolate chips.
Pour the cookie dough mixture onto the baking sheet, and use your hands or a spoon to flatten and spread it to approximately 1/4 inch (0.5 cm) thickness.
Melt the remaining chocolate in a double boiler or in 30-second intervals in the microwave.
