Pour the melted chocolate onto the dough and use the back of a spoon to spread it out. Transfer to the freezer for 30 minutes or until solid. Sprinkle with salt just before the chocolate sets.
When solid, break it into pieces and store it in an airtight container in the refrigerator until ready to eat. Enjoy!

name: Mango & Bell Pepper Salad
ingredients:
1
Mango (large, peeled, sliced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (large, sliced)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Lime (medium, juiced)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1 tsp
Chili Flakes
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Add the mango, bell pepper, onion, oil, lime, and salt to a bowl. Toss to combine.
Top with chili flakes and cilantro. Serve and enjoy!

name: Grilled Chili & Parmesan Leeks
ingredients:
2
Leeks (large, trimmed)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
1 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
Heat the grill to medium-high heat. Cut the leeks in half, then cut them in half lengthwise. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the leeks for three to four minutes per side or until slightly charred.
Plate the leeks, then top them with parmesan and chili flakes. Enjoy!

name: Sesame Ginger TVP & Broccoli Stir Fry
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Coconut Aminos
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
2 tsps
Ginger (grated)
1 tbsp
Arrowroot Powder
1/2 cup
Water (divided)
1 tbsp
Sesame Oil
4 cups
Textured Vegetable Protein (crumbs)
3 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
3 cups
Green Cabbage (finely shredded)
1 tbsp
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
recipe:
In a bowl, whisk together the coconut aminos, maple syrup, ginger, arrowroot powder, and half of the water. Set it aside.
Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-low heat. Add the TVP and cook for three to four minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the remaining water, broccoli, and cabbage. Cover and cook for three minutes or until the vegetables start to soften.
Add the sauce and stir well to combine. Cook for one to two minutes until heated through and the sauce thickens. Divide evenly into bowls or plates. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and enjoy!

name: Lima Bean Puree with Roasted Fennel
ingredients:
1 bulb
Fennel (medium, sliced into wedges, fronds reserved for garnish)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 tsp
Ground Sumac

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Shallot (diced)
1 tsp
Cumin Seed
1 cup
Lima Beans (cooked)
1/2 cup
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
1 1/2 tbsps
Pomegranate Molasses
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the fennel wedges on the baking sheet, drizzle with half of the olive oil, and season with sumac, salt, and pepper. Cook in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes until tender and cooked through, flipping halfway.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the shallot and sauté for one to two minutes or until softened. Add the cumin seeds and cook for another minute.
Add the beans and broth, stir, and bring to a simmer. Use a fork to mash the beans to your desired texture. Season with salt and pepper, stir, and simmer for four to five minutes.
Top the mashed beans with roasted fennel. Drizzle with pomegranate molasses and garnish with fennel fronds. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Zucchini Parmesan & Basil Rigatoni
ingredients:
8 ozs
Rigatoni (uncooked)
1 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Zucchini (large, chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, finely chopped)
1 tsp
Dried Thyme

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Cream, Half & Half
1/2 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (finely grated)
1/2 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Reserve some pasta water.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the zucchini, garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring often, for three to five minutes, until the zucchini is tender. Add the cream and stir to combine.
Using a fork, mash the zucchini into a chunky sauce.
Add half of the reserved pasta water and bring to a simmer. Add the cooked pasta and the parmesan. Toss until the cheese is melted and the pasta is coated in sauce. Add more pasta water to thin the sauce if needed.
Remove from the heat and stir in the basil. Divide evenly into bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Chopped White Bean Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
White Navy Beans (cooked)
1/4 head
Green Lettuce (chopped)
1
Red Bell Pepper (medium, finely chopped)
1
Cucumber (small, finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Red Onion (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Basil Leaves (chopped)
2 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped)
3 tbsps
Sun Dried Tomatoes (packed dry, not in oil, finely chopped)
1/3 cup
Green Olives (chopped)
2 tbsps
Pine Nuts (optional)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a large bowl and toss well to combine. Divide evenly into bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Spicy Melon & Cucumber Ribbon Salad
ingredients:
1/2
Cucumber (medium, thinly sliced into ribbons)
1/4
Honeydew Melon (medium, peeled, seeds removed and thinly sliced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Lime (small, juiced)
1/2
Jalapeno Pepper (small, seeds removed, diced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves
recipe:
Arrange the cucumber and melon on a plate, alternating between pieces.
In a small bowl, whisk together the oil, lime juice, jalapeno, salt, and pepper. Pour it over the salad.
Garnish with mint leaves and enjoy!

name: Charred Corn, Zucchini & Feta Salad
ingredients:
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 ears
Corn On The Cob (husk removed)
1
Zucchini (large, cut into big chunks)
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
1/2
Lime (juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a cast-iron pan over medium heat. Add the corn and cook corn for two to three minutes per side until lightly charred on all sides. Remove the corn from the pan and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, add the zucchini to the pan and cook for five to seven minutes or until tender and browned.
Slice the kernels off the cob and add them to a large bowl. Add the cooked zucchini, feta, cilantro, lime juice, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine.
Divide evenly between bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Honey Mustard Dressing
ingredients:
3 tbsps
Dijon Mustard
2 tbsps
Raw Honey
2 tbsps
Apple Cider Vinegar
3 tbsps
Avocado Oil
1 tbsp
Water
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/8 tsp
Turmeric

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
In a small bowl or jar, whisk the mustard, honey, and vinegar until smooth.
Slowly whisk in the oil to form a creamy emulsion. Alternatively, use an immersion blender. Gradually add water until you reach your desired consistency.
Stir in the garlic, turmeric, salt, and pepper. Transfer to a sealable jar. Enjoy!

name: Mung Bean Falafel
ingredients:
2 cups
Mung Beans (dry)
1
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2 cup
Parsley
1 tbsp
Curry Powder
1/3 cup
Oat Flour

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 oz
Avocado Oil Spray (divided)
recipe:
Soak the mung beans in water for at least three hours. Drain and thoroughly rinse.
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the soaked mung beans and simmer over medium heat for 20 to 25 minutes, or until cooked and tender.
Drain and transfer the beans to a food processor. Add the onion, garlic, parsley, curry powder, and oat flour. Season with salt and pepper. Blend for 30 seconds or until a slightly chunky paste forms.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 430ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Lightly spray the parchment paper with half the oil. Using your hands, shape the mixture into balls approximately 1.5 inches (4 cm) in diameter.
Place the patties on the baking sheet, flatten them slightly, then spray the tops with the remaining oil. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown, flipping halfway.
Let the falafels cool for five minutes before serving. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Grilled Corn & Peach Salad with Basil
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tsps
Raw Honey

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 ears
Corn On The Cob (husk removed)
2
Peach (small, sliced)
2 tbsps
Red Onion (finely chopped)
1/2
Jalapeno Pepper (medium, diced)
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
In a large bowl, mix together the lime juice, oil, honey, salt, and pepper.
Heat a grill or cast-iron pan over medium-high heat. Add the corn and cook for one to two minutes per side or until lightly charred on all sides. Let the corn cool before slicing the kernels off the cob and transferring them to the bowl.
Add the peach, red onion, jalapeno, additional salt, and pepper, and toss to combine. Gently fold in the basil. Divide evenly into bowls or plates, and enjoy!

name: Chickpea & Tahini Sesame Chopped Salad
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Coconut Aminos
1 tbsp
Tahini
2 tsps
Apple Cider Vinegar
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
2 tbsps
Water (as needed to thin)
1/2
Cucumber (large, chopped)
1
Carrot (medium, peeled, chopped)
2 cups
Mixed Greens (chopped)
1 cup
Cauliflower Rice (thawed)
1/2 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 tbsp
Everything Bagel Seasoning
recipe:
In a large bowl, whisk together the coconut aminos, tahini, vinegar, and nutritional yeast. Add the water a little at a time until the dressing reaches your desired consistency.
Add the cucumber, carrot, mixed greens, cauliflower rice, chickpeas, and everything bagel seasoning. Toss well to coat all the ingredients evenly.
Divide evenly between bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Smoky Tomato & White Bean Toast
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Tomato Sauce
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Cannellini Beans (cooked)
1/3 cup
Baby Spinach
1 3/4 ozs
Sourdough Bread (sliced, toasted)
1 stalk
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Heat a pan over medium heat. Add the tomato sauce and paprika, then stir and season with salt and pepper. Simmer for five minutes until heated through, stirring occasionally.
Add the beans and spinach, then stir and simmer for another five minutes until the spinach is wilted and the beans have heated through. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Top the toast with the tomato bean mixture. Garnish with green onions and enjoy!

name: Vegan Cinnamon Roll Mug Cake
ingredients:
3 1/2 tbsps
All Purpose Gluten-Free Flour
2 tbsps
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tbsp
Coconut Sugar
1/2 tsp
Baking Powder
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
2 tbsps
Unsweetened Applesauce
1/4 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2 tbsps
Icing Sugar
1 tsp
Water
recipe:
In a mug, whisk the flour, protein powder, sugar, baking powder, and cinnamon. Add the milk, applesauce, and vanilla. Stir thoroughly until well combined.
Microwave for 90 seconds until the cake is spongy to the touch.
In a small bowl, whisk together the icing sugar and water until fully combined to form a glaze. Pour the glaze over the cake and enjoy!

name: Spicy Peach Salsa
ingredients:
1
Peach (large, diced)
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (chopped)
2 tbsps
Red Onion (finely chopped)
1/2
Serrano Pepper (medium, seeds removed, finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
1
Lime (medium, juiced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe: Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Watermelon & Halloumi Skewers
ingredients:
4 1/2 ozs
Halloumi (cubed)
1/4
Seedless Watermelon (medium, cubed)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
6
Barbecue Skewers
1 tbsp
Raw Honey
2 tbsps
Mint Leaves
recipe:
Preheat the grill to medium heat. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the halloumi, watermelon, and oil.
Thread a piece of watermelon, halloumi, and another piece of watermelon onto each barbecue skewer.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for two to three minutes per side or until the halloumi is golden brown with grill marks. Plate and top with honey and mint leaves. Enjoy!

name: Oil-Free Hemp Seed & Coconut Granola
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Oats (rolled)
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
2 tbsps
Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
2 tbsps
Unsweetened Applesauce
1/3 cup
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine all of the ingredients in a large bowl. Spread the granola onto the baking sheet in an even layer.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes or until crisp and golden brown, tossing halfway through. Let completely cool before serving. Enjoy!

name: Tempeh & Bell Pepper Lettuce Wraps
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (diced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (large, diced)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
8 ozs
Tempeh (crumbled)
3 tbsps
Coconut Aminos

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 head
Iceberg Lettuce (medium, leaves pulled apart)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and bell pepper. Sauté for three to five minutes or until the vegetables have softened. Add the garlic and sauté for another 30 to 60 seconds to soften.
Add the crumbled tempeh, coconut aminos, salt, and pepper. Cook for another six to eight minutes or until the tempeh is slightly browned.
Top each lettuce wrap evenly with the tempeh mixture and green onion. Divide between plates and enjoy!

name: Roasted Sweet Potato with Lentils & Cabbage
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (large)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1 1/2 tsps
Tomato Paste
1/2 cup
Dry Red Lentils (rinsed)
1 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth (plus more if needed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Savoy Cabbage (shredded)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped, plus extra for garnish)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Pierce the sweet potato a few times with a fork, brush it with half of the oil, and place it on the baking sheet. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the garlic, paprika, and tomato paste, stir, and cook for one minute until fragrant. Add the lentils and broth and season with salt and pepper. Stir and bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until the lentils are cooked. Check occasionally and add more broth if necessary.
In a bowl, mix together the cabbage, lemon juice, cilantro, salt, and pepper.
Slice the sweet potato down the middle and divide evenly between plates. Use a fork to lightly mash the flesh and sprinkle with salt. Top the sweet potato evenly with cooked lentils, cabbage, cilantro, and enjoy!

name: Peach & Avocado Salsa
ingredients:
1/2
Avocado (medium, diced)
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (chopped)
1
Peach (medium, chopped)
3 tbsps
Red Onion (finely chopped)
1
Lime (medium, juiced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Cilantro (finely chopped)
recipe: Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl. Serve and enjoy!

name: Blended Lentil & Sweet Potato Soup
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
1
Sweet Potato (large, cubed)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1 cup
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with the juices)
1 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Lentils (cooked)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for five minutes or until softened. Add the sweet potato and cook for another four to five minutes until slightly browned, stirring occasionally.
Add the garlic and smoked paprika, stir, and cook for another minute. Add the tomatoes and broth, stir, and bring to a simmer. Cover the pot with a lid and simmer on low for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the sweet potato is cooked through.
Using an immersion blender, blend the soup until smooth. Alternatively, add the soup to a blender, blend in batches as needed, and then add it back to the pot. Season with salt and pepper. Add the lentils, cover, and cook for another 10 minutes until the flavors have combined.
Remove the soup from the heat and add the cilantro. Divide evenly into bowls and enjoy!

name: Couscous
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Water
1 cup
Couscous (dry)
recipe:
Bring the water to a boil, then add the couscous. Stir, cover, and remove from the heat.
Let it sit covered for five minutes. Fluff with a fork and serve. Enjoy!

name: Hummus Stuffed Mini Peppers
ingredients:
10 ozs
Mini Peppers (halved lengthwise, seeds removed)
1/2 cup
Hummus
1/4 tsp
Smoked Paprika
recipe: Fill each pepper half evenly with hummus and top with paprika. Enjoy!

name: Cinnamon & Ginger Pear Muffins
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
2 tsps
Lemon Juice
11 ozs
Unbleached All Purpose Flour
1/2 cup
Brown Sugar
2 tsps
Baking Powder
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1/2 tsp
Ground Ginger
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Avocado Oil
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2
Pear (medium, finely diced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC) and line a muffin tray with liners.
Combine the milk and lemon juice in a small bowl and set aside.
In a large bowl mix together the flour, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, and salt.
Add the milk mixture, oil, and vanilla to the dry ingredients and stir with a spatula until just combined. Do not over mix. Fold in the pears.
Divide the batter evenly between muffin cups. Bake for 22 to 25 minutes or until firm to the touch and a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Let the muffins cool in the pan for 10 to 15 minutes before removing and transferring to a cooling rack to cool completely. Enjoy!

name: Tempeh & Brussels Sprouts Stir Fry
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
8 ozs
Tempeh (crumbled)
1/4 cup
Water
1 1/2 tsps
Fajita Seasoning

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
3 cups
Brussels Sprouts (shredded)
4 stalks
Green Onion (small, chopped)
1 tbsp
Red Wine Vinegar
recipe:
Heat half of the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the tempeh, water, fajita seasoning, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine. Cook for two to three minutes, until the water has completely evaporated.
Add the garlic to the pan and sauté for one more minute. Remove the ingredients from the pan and set them aside.
In the same pan over medium-high heat, add the remaining oil, Brussels sprouts, and green onion. Sautée for five to seven minutes or until the Brussels sprouts are browned and tender-crisp. Add the red wine vinegar and stir well to coat the vegetables.
Return the cooked tempeh to the pan and stir to combine. Cook for one more minute to heat through. Divide evenly onto plates and enjoy!

name: Farro & Chickpea Tomato Soup with Dill Pesto
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Farro (uncooked, rinsed)
1/2 cup
Fresh Dill (chopped)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
2
Garlic (clove, finely chopped, divided)
3 1/4 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Yellow Onion (small, finely chopped)
1 stalk
Celery (finely chopped)
1 1/2 cups
Tomato Sauce
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
recipe:
Cook the farro according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, using a small food processor or an immersion blender, pulse the dill, half of the oil, half of the garlic, and a splash of broth until smooth. Add additional broth as needed to thin. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside.
Heat a pot over medium heat. Add the remaining oil, onion, celery, salt, and pepper. Cook for three to four minutes until softened. Add the remaining garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the tomato sauce, chickpeas, and the remaining broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for six to eight minutes, until the soup has thickened. Add the farro, stir, and cook until warmed through.
Divide the soup evenly into bowls, drizzle with dill pesto, and enjoy!

name: Blended Matcha Overnight Oats
ingredients:
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 tsp
Green Tea Powder
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
2/3 cup
Blueberries
recipe:
In a blender, add the oats, chia seeds, milk, yogurt, vanilla, green tea powder, and maple syrup. Blend until smooth.
Pour into a container, seal, and place in the fridge overnight or for at least eight hours.
Once set, divide the oats evenly between bowls or containers and top with blueberries. Enjoy!

name: Steamed Cauliflower
ingredients:
1/2 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
recipe: Add the cauliflower to a steamer basket over boiling water and cover. Steam for five minutes or until fork-tender. Enjoy!

name: Farro
ingredients:
8 cups
Water
1 cup
Farro (uncooked, rinsed)
recipe: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the farro, reduce the heat to medium-high, and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes or until tender but al dente. Drain and serve. Enjoy!

name: TVP & Rice Stuffed Bell Peppers with Guacamole
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Basmati Rice (dry, rinsed)
1 cup
Textured Vegetable Protein (crumbs)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Red Onion (diced)
1 tsp
Tomato Paste
1/4 cup
Corn
1 tbsp
Fajita Seasoning

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped, plus extra for garnish)
2
Red Bell Pepper (medium, halved, seeds removed)
1/3 cup
Water
1/2 cup
Guacamole
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, place the textured vegetable protein (TVP) in a bowl and cover it with boiling water. Cover the bowl and let it sit for ten minutes to rehydrate.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the onion and sauté for five minutes or until softened. Add the rehydrated TVP and cook for another ten minutes until crispy and golden brown.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Add the tomato paste, corn, fajita seasoning, and cooked rice to the pan. Season with salt and pepper, stir, then cook for another five minutes. Remove from the heat and add the cilantro.
Place the bell peppers in a deep baking dish and stuff them evenly with the TVP and rice mixture. Pour the water into the baking dish and cover the dish with aluminum foil.
Cook in the oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until the bell peppers are cooked through. Garnish with additional cilantro, serve with guacamole, and enjoy!

name: TVP & Corn Quesadilla
ingredients:
1 cup
Textured Vegetable Protein (crumbs)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Red Onion (diced)
1 tsp
Tomato Paste
1/4 cup
Corn
1 tbsp
Fajita Seasoning

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
4
Brown Rice Tortilla
recipe:
Place the textured vegetable protein (TVP) in a bowl and cover it with boiling water. Cover the bowl and let it sit for 10 minutes to rehydrate.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the onion and sauté for five minutes until softened. Add the rehydrated TVP and cook for another 10 minutes, until crispy and golden brown.
Add the tomato paste, corn, and fajita seasoning. Season with salt and pepper and cook for another five minutes. Remove from the heat, add the cilantro and stir to combine.
Lay half of the tortillas on a flat surface. Divide the TVP and corn mixture evenly among them, then top with the remaining tortillas.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Cook each quesadilla for two to three minutes per side, or until crispy and golden. Cut before serving and enjoy!

name: Roasted Vegetables & Couscous
ingredients:
1 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
2
Zucchini (medium, chopped)
2 cups
Cherry Tomatoes
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 tsp
Oregano

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2/3 cup
Couscous (dry)
1/2 cup
Vegan Caesar Dressing
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the cauliflower, zucchini, and cherry tomatoes to the baking sheet. Drizzle with half of the oil, oregano, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine.
Spread out into an even layer. Cook for 25 to 30 minutes or until browned, tossing halfway.
Meanwhile, cook the couscous according to the package directions. Fluff and set aside when done.
Divide the couscous and vegetables evenly into bowls or plates. Top with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Blended Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Overnight Oats
ingredients:
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1 1/4 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
2 tbsps
Almond Butter
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
In a blender, add the oats, chia seeds, milk, yogurt, protein powder, almond butter, and salt. Blend until smooth.
Pour into a container and stir in the chocolate chips. Seal the container and place it the fridge overnight or for at least eight hours.
Divide the oats evenly between bowls or containers. Enjoy!

name: Baked Haddock, Zucchini & Broccoli
ingredients:
2
Zucchini (small, sliced)
2 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/3 cup
Corn
2
Haddock Fillet
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC).
In a deep baking dish, add the zucchini and broccoli. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper. Cook in the oven for 20 minutes.
Remove from the oven, add the corn, and stir well. Season the fish all over with salt and pepper, then place it on top of the vegetables.
Cook for another 12 to 15 minutes or until everything is cooked through.
Divide the fish and vegetables evenly between plates, drizzle with lemon juice, and enjoy!

name: Baked Feta & Spinach Mini Quesadilla
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1/4 cup
Frozen Spinach (thawed, drained, chopped)
3/4 oz
Mozzarella Cheese (shredded)
1/4
Lemon (medium, juiced, zested)
4
Corn Tortilla (small)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix together the feta, spinach, mozzarella, lemon juice, and zest.
Place half of the tortillas on the prepared baking sheet. Spread the spinach mixture evenly onto each one, then cover with the remaining tortillas.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, flipping once halfway through, until the tortillas are golden and slightly crisp. Cut the quesadillas in half and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Sweet & Spicy Nuts
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Pecans
1/2 cup
Walnuts
1/4 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
1/2 tsp
Chili Powder
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 325ºF (165ºC).
Add all ingredients to a bowl and mix well to combine.
Line the air fryer with a perforated air fryer parchment sheet and add the mixed nuts. Cook in the air fryer for nine to 11 minutes, tossing halfway through, until bubbling and toasted.
Transfer to a plate and let cool. Once cool, break apart into clusters and enjoy!

name: Honey Mustard Fall Harvest Salad with Crunchy Chickpeas
ingredients:
1 3/4 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, patted dry)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1 1/2 tsps
Smoked Paprika
1 tsp
Chili Powder
8 cups
Kale Leaves (finely chopped)
1/3 cup
Honey Mustard Dressing
1/3 cup
Red Onion (small, sliced)
1
Pear (large, sliced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, toss the chickpeas with the oil and season with salt and pepper. Transfer to the prepared baking sheet and bake for 20 to 25 minutes until crispy, shaking halfway through.
Meanwhile, in the same bowl, whisk together the maple syrup, smoked paprika, and chili powder. Add the chickpeas to the bowl and toss well to combine. Transfer back to the baking sheet and let cool for approximately five minutes so the spices can set.
Add the kale and dressing to a large bowl. Toss to coat very well. Add the onion, pear, and cooked chickpeas and toss gently to combine.
Divide the salad evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Herby Roasted Delicata Squash
ingredients:
1
Delicata Squash (medium)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Poultry Seasoning
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Trim the ends of the squash and cut into 1/2-inch rings. Use a spoon to scoop out the seeds.
Add the squash rings to the baking sheet with the oil, poultry seasoning, and salt. Mix to combine. Ensure the squash is spread out in an even layer.
Cook for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown and fork-tender. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Black Eyed Pea Fritters
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Black Eyed Peas (cooked, drained and rinsed)
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2 tsp
Cumin
1 tsp
Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Cornmeal (divided)
1/8 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
1
Lime (medium, juice, for serving)
recipe:
In a food processor, combine the black-eyed peas, onion, and garlic. Blend until a paste forms. Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Blend for another 30 seconds. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl, add 1/4 of the cornmeal, and stir to combine. Cover and let it sit for 15 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (205°C). Place the remaining cornmeal in a shallow bowl.
Divide the mixture evenly into small portions and shape them into logs. Dredge each log in cornmeal, then place them in the air fryer basket. Spray with oil. Depending on the size of your air fryer you may have to work in batches.
Cook for 13 to 15 minutes, flipping halfway through, until browned and crispy. Serve with lime and enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Potato, Kale & White Bean Soup
ingredients:
4 cups
Vegetable Broth
1
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
3
Carrot (medium, sliced)
3 stalks
Celery (sliced)
4
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tsp
Oregano
1/2 tsp
Dried Thyme
4 cups
Mini Potatoes (quartered)
1 3/4 cups
Cannellini Beans (cooked)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped)
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
recipe:
Turn the pressure cooker to "sauté" mode. Add a splash of broth and once hot, add the onion, carrot, and celery. Sauté for three to four minutes until slightly softened. Add the garlic, oregano, and thyme and sauté for another 30 to 60 seconds. Cancel "sauté" mode.
Add the potatoes, beans, and remaining broth, and season with salt and pepper. Close the lid of the pressure cooker.
Set the pressure cooker to "sealing" and cook on high pressure for 10 minutes. Once finished, carefully release the pressure manually.
Carefully open the lid and add the kale and lemon juice. Let it sit until the kale is wilted. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Fudgy Chocolate Protein Bites
ingredients:
2 cups
Pitted Dates
1/4 cup
Chocolate Protein Powder
1/4 cup
Cocoa Powder
2 tsps
Vanilla Extract
1/3 cup
Almond Butter (runny)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
3/4 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
1/2 tsp
Coconut Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Sprinkles (optional)
recipe:
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the dates, protein powder, cocoa powder, vanilla, almond butter, and salt to a food processor. Pulse until a coarse crumb forms and the mixture starts to stick together.
Use a teaspoon or one-inch cookie scoop to scoop out the mixture and roll it into balls.
Melt the chocolate and coconut oil in a saucepan on low or in the microwave for 30-second intervals.
Dip each ball in the melted chocolate and transfer to the prepared baking sheet. Top with sprinkles, if using. Place in the fridge or freezer for 10 to 15 minutes or until the chocolate has set. Enjoy!

name: Sticky Teriyaki & Sesame Chickpeas
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Tapioca Flour
1/2 cup
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
3 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/4 cup
Teriyaki Sauce
1 tsp
Sriracha

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Sesame Seeds (divided)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Mix the tapioca flour with 1/4 of the broth to make a slurry. Set it aside.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for four to five minutes or until softened.
Add the chickpeas, the remaining broth, teriyaki sauce, sriracha, salt, and pepper. Add the slurry and stir until the sauce thickens.
Divide evenly into bowls and top with sesame seeds and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Vegetable Pakoras
ingredients:
1
Sweet Potato (small, peeled, finely sliced)
1
Zucchini (medium, grated)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (thinly sliced)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
2 tbsps
Chickpea Flour
1 tsp
Curry Powder
1/4 tsp
Ground Ginger
1/4 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/8 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
recipe:
Add the sweet potato to a steamer basket over boiling water and cover. Steam for five to seven minutes or until fork-tender. Place the steamed potato in a large bowl and mash it.
Place the zucchini and onion in a colander, sprinkle with half of the salt, and set aside for five minutes. Squeeze out the excess water, then add the mixture to the bowl with the sweet potato.
Add the chickpea flour, curry powder, ground ginger, garlic powder, and remaining salt to the bowl.
Preheat the air fryer to 370ºF (190ºC). Divide the batter evenly into patties approximately three inches (8 cm) in diameter. Lightly spray the basket and add the patties.
Cook for eight minutes, flip, and cook on the other side for another eight minutes until crisp. Enjoy!

name: Edamame & Quinoa Salad with Maple Sesame Dressing
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
2 tbsps
Tamari
2 tbsps
Rice Vinegar
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Sesame Oil
1/2
Cucumber (small, chopped)
1 stalk
Celery (chopped)
2 cups
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1/2 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions. Set aside to cool for five minutes.
Meanwhile, mix the remaining ingredients together in a large salad bowl.
Add the quinoa and toss until well combined. Divide evenly onto plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Mini Pear Crisps
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Butter (divided)
1 cup
Oats
1/3 cup
Maple Syrup (divided)
2 tsps
Vanilla Extract (divided)
2 tsps
Pumpkin Pie Spice (divided)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (divided)
3
Pear (medium, chopped)
recipe:
Heat half of the butter in a pan over medium-low heat. Add the oats, half of each of the maple syrup, vanilla, pumpkin pie spice, and salt. Mix to combine.
Cook for five to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the oats are golden brown. Remove from the pan and set aside.
To the same pan, add the pears along with the remaining butter, maple syrup, vanilla, pumpkin pie spice, and salt. Mix to combine.
Cook for five to 10 minutes or until the pears are softened or cooked to your liking.
Divide the cooked pears evenly into small bowls and top each one with the oats. Let cool for at least 10 minutes before serving. Enjoy!

name: Curried Black Eyed Pea & Spinach Stew
ingredients:
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tsp
Curry Powder
1 1/3 cups
Black Eyed Peas (cooked, drained and rinsed)
2 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth
2/3 cup
Frozen Peas (thawed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Baby Spinach (finely chopped)
1/2
Lime (medium, juiced)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for five minutes until soft and translucent.
Add the garlic and curry powder and cook for another minute. Add the black eyed peas and the broth. Stir, cover the pot with a lid, and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.
Remove the lid and lightly mash some of the black eyed peas in the pot. Add the frozen peas and season with salt and pepper. Stir well.
Simmer for another five minutes, then add the spinach. Cook for another two to three minutes or until everything is tender and the flavors have combined.
Remove from the heat and add the lime juice. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Roasted Squash, Fennel & Apple Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
Butternut Squash (peeled, seeds removed, sliced)
1/2 bulb
Fennel (large, sliced thick)
1 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 fl oz
Apple Cider
1 1/2 tsps
Apple Cider Vinegar
1/2 tsp
Maple Syrup
1/4
Apple (thinly sliced, seeds removed)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the squash, fennel, and onion on the baking sheet. Drizzle with half of the oil and season with salt and pepper. Cook in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until just tender. Let cool.
Meanwhile, whisk together the apple cider, vinegar, maple syrup, and the remaining oil in a large bowl. Add salt and pepper.
Add the roasted vegetables, apple slices, and parsley to the bowl. Toss gently to coat. Serve and enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Sesame Ginger Ramen
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Sesame Oil
3
Garlic (clove, finely chopped)
1 tbsp
Ginger (fresh, finely chopped)
4 stalks
Green Onion (thinly sliced, divided)
1 cup
Mushrooms (sliced)
3 cups
Vegetable Broth
3 tbsps
Soy Sauce
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
2 tbsps
Rice Vinegar
12 ozs
Gluten-Free Ramen Noodles (dry)
2 cups
Bok Choy (baby, sliced)
recipe:
Turn the pressure cooker to "sauté" mode. Add the oil and once heated, add the garlic, ginger, and half of the green onions. Cook for one to two minutes until tender. Add the mushrooms and sauté for two to three minutes until tender.
Cancel "sauté" mode. Add the broth, soy sauce, maple syrup, and vinegar. Stir to combine.
Add the noodles and press down slightly to submerge. Close the lid and set to “sealing,” then press manual/pressure cook. Cook for three minutes on high pressure. Quick release the pressure and carefully open the lid.
Add the bok choy, cover with the lid, and let sit for five minutes to steam.
Remove the lid and divide the ramen evenly between bowls. Top with the remaining the green onions and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Chickpea Patties
ingredients:
1
Yellow Onion (small, chopped)
2
Garlic (clove)
1/4 cup
Cilantro
1 tsp
Cumin Seed
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, divided)
1/4 cup
Chickpea Flour

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
recipe:
Add the onion, garlic, cilantro, cumin, and half of the chickpeas to a food processor. Blend for 30 seconds until well combined. Transfer the mixture to a bowl.
Add the remaining chickpeas to the food processor and pulse a few times, just until roughly chopped. Transfer to the bowl with the mixture. Add the chickpea flour, salt, and pepper.
Mix well, cover the bowl, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 400ºF (205ºC). Using your hands, shape the mixture into balls using about two tablespoons of batter each, then flatten them slightly.
Arrange the patties in the air fryer basket and spray lightly with oil. Cook for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown and crispy, flipping halfway through and spraying the tops again.
Let them cool for a couple of minutes before serving to allow them to firm up. Enjoy!

name: Sticky Teriyaki & Sesame Chickpeas with Broccoli
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Tapioca Flour
1/2 cup
Vegetable Broth (divided)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
3 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/4 cup
Teriyaki Sauce
1 tsp
Sriracha

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
1 tbsp
Sesame Seeds (divided)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
recipe:
Mix the tapioca flour with 1/4 of the broth to make a slurry. Set it aside.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for four to five minutes until softened.
Add the chickpeas, the remaining broth, teriyaki sauce, sriracha, salt, and pepper. Add the slurry and stir until the sauce thickens.
Meanwhile, place the broccoli in a steamer basket over boiling water and cover. Steam for five minutes or until tender.
Divide the chickpeas and broccoli evenly into bowls or plates. Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Soy-Ginger Noodles with Vegetables
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Soy Sauce
2 tbsps
Oyster Sauce
2 tbsps
Rice Vinegar
2 tbsps
Coconut Sugar
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil
1 tsp
Ginger (fresh, finely sliced)
3 stalks
Green Onion (sliced thick)
1
Red Bell Pepper (large, sliced)
1
Carrot (large, sliced)
2 cups
Vegetable Broth
8 ozs
Pho Noodles
1 cup
Broccoli (small florets)
recipe:
Whisk together the soy sauce, oyster sauce, vinegar, and sugar. Set it aside.
Turn the pressure cooker to "sauté" mode. Heat the oil, then add the ginger and green onion. Sauté for two to three minutes until softened.
Add the pepper and carrot, then add the broth and prepared sauce. Cancel "sauté" mode.
Add the noodles without stirring. Press slightly to partially submerge them.
Close the lid and set to “sealing,” then press manual/pressure cook. Cook for three minutes on high pressure. Quick release the pressure and carefully open the lid.
Stir everything together. Add the broccoli, cover with the lid, and let sit for five minutes to steam. Toss well, divide evenly between bowls, and enjoy!

name: Tofu, Bok Choy & Mushroom Rigatoni
ingredients:
8 ozs
Rigatoni (uncooked)
1/4 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
2 cups
Bok Choy (thinly sliced)
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 1/2 cups
Mushrooms (chopped)
12 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, crumbled)
1
Garlic (clove, chopped)
1 1/2 tbsps
Tomato Paste
3/4 cup
Vegetable Broth
2 tbsps
Soy Sauce, Low Sodium
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Reserve some pasta water. Add the bok choy to the pot and continue to cook for one minute. Drain and return the pasta and bok choy to the pot.
Meanwhile, heat 2/3 of the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the mushrooms for five minutes. Add the tofu and the remaining oil. Cook for another eight minutes until golden, stirring often.
Add the garlic and the tomato paste. Cook for one minute until fragrant. Add the broth and the soy sauce. Cook for five minutes until slightly thickened.
Add the tofu sauce to the pasta. Toss to coat, adding the reserved pasta water to thin as needed.
Divide evenly into bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Jackfruit Curry
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Ginger (fresh, grated)
1 cup
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with the juices)
2 cups
Canned Jackfruit (young, drained and rinsed, shredded)
2 tsps
Curry Powder
1/2 tsp
Dried Thyme
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
2 cups
Canned Coconut Milk
3/4 cup
Vegetable Broth
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the garlic, ginger, and tomatoes. Cook for four to six minutes until the liquid has evaporated.
Add the jackfruit, curry powder, thyme, and salt. Cook for four to six minutes, stirring occasionally, until the jackfruit browns slightly.
Add the coconut milk and broth. Simmer gently for eight to 10 minutes until thick and creamy.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Chunky Zucchini & Cauliflower Soup
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Leeks (large, sliced)
1
Zucchini (large, diced)
1/2 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
1 1/2 tbsps
Ginger (fresh, minced)
2 tsps
Turmeric (ground)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1 cup
Vegetable Broth
1 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
recipe:
Heat the oil in a medium pot over medium heat. Add the leeks and sauté for four to six minutes until softened.
Add the zucchini, cauliflower, ginger, turmeric, and salt. Cook for one minute.
Add the broth and coconut milk. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the lime juice, divide evenly between bowls, and enjoy!

name: Roasted Delicata Squash with Crumbled Feta
ingredients:
1
Delicata Squash (medium)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Oregano
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Trim the ends of the squash and cut it in half lengthwise. Use a spoon to scoop out the seeds. Slice the squash into 1/2-inch (1.25 cm) pieces.
Add the squash to the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and season with oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Mix to combine.
Place the squash on the baking sheet in an even layer. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown and fork-tender. Top with feta and serve. Enjoy!

name: Mango Golden Chia Pudding
ingredients:
1/2
Mango (small)
1/4 cup
Chia Seeds
1/2 tsp
Turmeric
1/2 tsp
Ground Ginger
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1/4 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/16 tsp
Black Pepper
1 cup
Oat Milk
recipe:
Use a food processor or immersion blender to puree the mango. Alternatively, mash it well with a fork.
In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients and stir thoroughly to mix.
Divide the mixture evenly into individual containers. Refrigerate for at least one hour to allow the chia pudding to set. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Aloo Matar
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Cumin Seed
2
Yellow Onion (small, finely chopped)
2
Tomato (medium, finely chopped)
2 tsps
Ginger (fresh, minced)
1/2 tsp
Turmeric (ground)
1 tsp
Paprika
1 tsp
Garam Masala
3
Yellow Potato (medium, peeled, cubed)
1 cup
Frozen Peas
1 cup
Vegetable Broth
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Turn the pressure cooker to "sauté" mode. Add the oil and cumin seeds. Sauté for one minute or until toasted. Add the onion and sauté for two to three minutes until tender.
Add the tomato, ginger, turmeric, paprika, and garam masala. Cook for two more minutes, then cancel "sauté" mode.
Add the potatoes, peas, broth, and salt. Stir well. Set the pressure cooker to "sealing" and cook on high pressure for four minutes.
Quick release the pressure and carefully open the lid. Divide evenly into bowls and enjoy!

name: Parmesan Carrots
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Oregano
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4
Carrot (large, peeled)
1 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (freshly grated, divided)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, combine the oil, oregano, garlic, paprika, salt, and pepper. Cut the carrots in half, then cut each half lengthwise. Add the carrots to the bowl and toss to coat.
Spread 3/4 of the cheese on the baking sheet in an even layer. Arrange the carrots on the baking sheet over the cheese, flat-side down. Sprinkle the remaining cheese all over.
Cook for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Top with parsley, divide evenly onto plates, and enjoy!

name: Roasted Squash, Lentil & Kale Pot Pie
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
6 cups
Butternut Squash (cubed)
1/3 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Yellow Onion (small, chopped)
2 stalks
Celery (chopped)
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Fresh Sage (chopped)
1 oz
Unbleached All Purpose Flour (plus more for dusting)
2 cups
Vegetable Broth
3/4 cup
Oat Milk
2 cups
Kale Leaves (finely chopped)
12 ozs
Puff Pastry (thawed)
recipe:
Cook the lentils according to the package directions. Once cooked, drain and rinse under cold water and set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Place the squash on a baking sheet and drizzle it with a bit of oil, and season it with salt and pepper. Toss to coat. Transfer to the oven and cook for 20 to 24 minutes until cooked through. Set aside.
Heat a large cast-iron pan over medium heat and add enough oil to coat the bottom. Once hot, add the onion and celery and cook for three to four minutes, or just until they start to soften. Add the garlic and sage and cook until fragrant.
Add the flour and cook for two minutes, stirring often. Add the broth and milk and stir to incorporate. Bring to a low simmer and cook for two to three minutes, reducing the heat as needed. Add the lentils, squash, and kale, and season with salt and pepper. Stir to incorporate and set aside.
Lightly dust a flat surface with flour. Roll out the puff pastry to be slightly larger than the cast-iron pan. Place the puff pastry over top of the pan, folding the edges up as needed. Brush with the remaining oil and cut a few slits on top.
Transfer to the oven and bake for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Let cool slightly, divide evenly between plates, and enjoy!

name: Date Caramel Apple Rings
ingredients:
1 cup
Pitted Dates (soaked until softened)
1/3 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
2
Apple (medium)
1/4 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
2 tbsps
Walnuts (chopped)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Add the dates and coconut milk to a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth, scraping down the sides as needed.
Slice the apples into approximately 1/2-inch (1.25 cm) rounds and cut a hole in the centre of each slice to resemble a donut. Alternatively, core the apples and then cut into rounds.
Spread the date caramel onto each apple ring and top with chocolate chips, walnuts, and flaky salt. Enjoy!

name: Whipped Feta Dip with Roasted Olives
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Assorted Olives
4
Garlic (clove, peeled, smashed)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Oregano
1 cup
Feta Cheese (room temperature)
1/3 cup
Ricotta Cheese (room temperature)
1 tsp
Lemon Juice
1/4 tsp
Chili Flakes
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC).
In a small baking dish, toss together the olives, garlic, oil, and oregano. Transfer to the oven and bake for 20 minutes until bubbling and the garlic is softened and browned slightly.
Meanwhile, add the feta, ricotta, and lemon juice to a food processor and blend on high until smooth and creamy.
Add the whipped feta to a serving bowl. Top with olives and garlic. Add a drizzle of the cooking oil and chili flakes. Enjoy!

name: Maple Cashew Chocolate Fudge
ingredients:
1 cup
Cashew Butter (runny)
3/4 cup
Maple Syrup
1/4 cup
Coconut Oil (melted)
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Line a loaf pan with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix together the cashew butter, maple syrup, coconut oil, and vanilla until smooth. Pour the mixture into the prepared loaf pan.
Melt the chocolate chips in a double boiler or in 30-second intervals in the microwave. Pour the melted chocolate over the cashew mixture, smoothing it out with a spatula. Transfer to the freezer for approximately two hours until set, or leave it overnight.
Slice the fudge into equal-sized pieces and enjoy!

name: Mung Bean & Avocado Dip
ingredients:
1 cup
Mung Beans (dry, rinsed)
1
Avocado (medium)
1
Lime (medium, juiced)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (plus extra for garnish)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tsps
Sesame Seeds
recipe:
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the mung beans and simmer over medium heat for 20 to 25 minutes or until cooked and tender.
Drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Transfer the beans to a food processor. Add the avocado, lime juice, cilantro, salt, and pepper, and blend until smooth.
Add the dip to a serving bowl. Top with oil, sesame seeds, and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Steel Cut Oats with Caramelized Figs
ingredients:
1 1/2 tbsps
Butter
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
6
Fig (halved)
3/4 cup
Steel Cut Oats
1 3/4 cups
Lite Coconut Milk
1/2 cup
Water
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Turn the pressure cooker to sauté mode. Once hot, add the butter and maple syrup. Once the butter is melted, add the figs, cut-side down. Cook until softened, stirring occasionally, for five to six minutes. Remove the figs and any accumulated juices and set aside.
Add the oats, coconut milk, water, vanilla, and salt. Stir, close the lid, and set to "sealing." Press "manual/pressure cooker" and cook for five minutes on high.
Allow the pressure to naturally release for 10 minutes, then carefully quick-release any remaining pressure.
Divide the oatmeal evenly into bowls. Top with the figs and enjoy!

name: Spicy Brussels Sprouts with Kimchi
ingredients:
2 cups
Brussels Sprouts (trimmed, halved)
1/2 cup
Shallot (thinly sliced)
2 tbsps
Avocado Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Kimchi (chopped)
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1 tsp
Rice Vinegar
1 tsp
Fish Sauce
1 tsp
Gochujang
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC).
Place the Brussels sprouts and shallot on a baking sheet and drizzle with oil, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out evenly. Transfer to the oven and cook for 23 to 25 minutes, or until cooked through and crispy, tossing halfway.
In a large bowl, combine the kimchi, honey, vinegar, fish sauce, and gochujang.
Add the Brussels sprouts to the bowl and toss to combine. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Cacio e Pepe Lima Beans with Spinach
ingredients:
1 tsp
Black Pepper (coarsely grounded)
2 cups
Lima Beans (canned, with liquid)
2 tbsps
Butter (unsalted, melted)
1 cup
Frozen Spinach (thawed, drained, chopped)
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (freshly grated, divided)
recipe:
Heat a pan over medium heat. Add the black pepper and toast for one minute, or until fragrant.
Add the beans with their liquid. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until thickened. If the beans begin to stick, loosen with water, one tablespoon at a time.
Add the butter and spinach and gently stir to combine. Remove from the heat. Add the grated parmesan and stir until melted and creamy.
Divide evenly between bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Tomato, Zucchini & Rice Soup with Mozzarella
ingredients:
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 1/2 cups
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with the juices)
3 cups
Water
1/4 tsp
Coconut Sugar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Arborio Rice (dry, rinsed)
1
Zucchini (large, diced)
1/4 cup
Basil Leaves (chopped, plus more for garnish)
4 ozs
Mozzarella Ball (cut into small cubes)
recipe:
In a large pot over low heat, sauté the garlic in oil for one to two minutes, stirring often to avoid browning.
Add the tomatoes, water, sugar, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then add the rice. Reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook for 12 to 15 minutes or until the rice is almost cooked, stirring occasionally.
Add the zucchini to the soup two minutes before the rice is done. Add the basil and season with salt and pepper.
Divide the soup evenly into bowls. Top with mozzarella, garnish with basil, and enjoy!

name: Sunflower & Sesame Seed Bars with Dark Chocolate
ingredients:
1 cup
Spelt Flour
1/3 cup
Quick Oats
1/2 cup
Sunflower Seeds (toasted)
2 tbsps
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
1/4 cup
Brown Sugar
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Butter (softened)
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/2 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
In a large bowl, combine the flour, oats, sunflower seeds, sesame seeds, sugar, and salt.
Add the butter, maple syrup, and vanilla. Stir until the mixture is well combined and the butter is fully incorporated. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Place the dough between two sheets of parchment paper and roll it out into a rectangle about 9 x 10 inches (23 x 25 cm) and 1/4 inch (3/4 cm) thick.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Remove the dough from the refrigerator and cut it into rectangles approximately 1 1/2 x 2 1/2 inches (4 x 6 cm). Place the pieces on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 16 to 18 minutes or until the bottoms and edges are golden. Let cool completely on a wire rack before storing. Enjoy!

name: Pecan & Cranberry Quinoa
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/3 cup
Dried Unsweetened Cranberries
1/4 cup
Pecans (chopped)
2 stalks
Green Onion (sliced)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions. Rinse under cold water, then let it cool for five minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, oil, salt, and pepper. Add the quinoa, cranberries, pecans, and green onions. Stir well to combine.
Adjust the seasoning as needed. Divide evenly between bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Parmesan Fennel Gratin
ingredients:
1/2 bulb
Fennel (large)
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Vegetable Broth
1 1/2 tsps
Lemon Zest
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (freshly grated)
recipe:
Keeping the base intact, cut the fennel into wedges. Each piece should be approximately one to 1 1/4 inches (3 cm) thick.
Heat the oil in a large ovenproof pan over medium heat. Add salt and sear the fennel wedges for six minutes until lightly golden, flipping halfway.
Add the broth and lemon zest, then bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and cover, leaving a small opening. Simmer for eight to 10 minutes or until the fennel is tender.
Remove the lid and cook for one to two more minutes until most liquid evaporates.
Remove from the heat and sprinkle with parmesan. Place under the oven’s broiler for one to two minutes until the cheese is melted and lightly golden.
Divide evenly onto plates and enjoy!

name: Apple Cider Roasted Carrots & Beets
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Apple Cider Vinegar
1/3 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tbsps
Brown Sugar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
6
Heirloom Carrots (sliced lengthwise)
3
Golden Beet (large, peeled, sliced into thick wedges)
1 tsp
Thyme (fresh)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl whisk together the vinegar, oil, sugar, salt, and pepper. Add the carrots and beets and toss well to combine.
Spread the veggies onto the prepared baking sheet being sure to spread everything out in a single layer. Pour any of the leftover dressing over the veggies. Transfer to the oven and cook for 40 to 45 minutes, until tender, flipping halfway through.
Plate the veggies and sprinkle with thyme. Serve and enjoy!

name: Acai & Blueberry Overnight Oats
ingredients:
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
3 tbsps
Vanilla Protein Powder
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1/2 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1 1/4 cups
Cow's Milk, Whole
3 1/2 ozs
Frozen Acai (thawed)
1 cup
Blueberries
recipe:
Add the oats, protein powder, chia seeds, yogurt, milk, and acai to a large container and stir to combine. Stir in the blueberries.
Seal the container and place it in the fridge overnight, or for at least eight hours.
Divide the oats evenly between bowls or containers and enjoy!

name: Kimchi
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Kimchi
recipe: Scoop the kimchi out of the jar and add it to your meal. Enjoy!

name: Crunchy Tahini & Miso Chickpea Slaw
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Tahini
2 tsps
Miso Paste
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1 1/2 tsps
Raw Honey

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 cups
Coleslaw Mix
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/4 cup
Parsley
recipe:
In a bowl, whisk together the tahini, miso paste, lemon juice, honey, salt, and pepper until smooth. Add a splash of water if the mixture seems too thick.
Add the coleslaw mix, chickpeas, and parsley to the bowl and toss to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Sun Dried Tomato Parmesan Dip
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Sun Dried Tomatoes (finely chopped)
1/2 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 cup
Shallot (finely chopped)
2 tsps
Italian Seasoning
1 tsp
Chili Flakes (optional)
1/2 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (freshly grated)
3 tbsps
Basil Leaves (chopped)
10 ozs
Sourdough Baguette (sliced)
recipe:
Add the sun dried tomatoes, oil, shallot, Italian seasoning, and chili flakes (if using) to a small pot.
Heat over low heat and simmer gently for five minutes, until fragrant and warm.
Add the parmesan and basil to a small serving bowl. Add the hot oil mixture and gently stir.
Serve warm with bread and enjoy!

name: Spiced Pomegranate Mocktail
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Orange Juice
1/3 cup
Pomegranate Juice
1 1/2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1/4 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/8 tsp
Ground Ginger
1/16 tsp
Cayenne Pepper
8
Ice Cubes (divided)
1 tbsp
Rosemary (sprig, optional)
recipe:
Add the orange juice, pomegranate juice, maple syrup, vanilla, ginger, and cayenne to a shaker with 1/4 of the ice. Shake for 10 to 15 seconds to combine. Fill a glass with the remaining ice and strain the mixture in. Stir gently.
Garnish with a sprig of rosemary, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Blueberry & Banana Coconut Kefir Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Plain Coconut Kefir
1 cup
Frozen Blueberries
1/2
Banana
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender. Blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and serve chilled. Enjoy!

name: Kale & Squash Pesto Pizza
ingredients:
8 ozs
Pizza Dough (store bought)
2 tbsps
Pesto
2 ozs
Mozzarella Cheese (shredded, divided)
1/4
Acorn Squash (small, seeds removed, thinly sliced)
1/2 cup
Kale Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Place the dough in a large bowl and cover it with a tea towel. Let it rest on the counter for at least 30 minutes to rise and come to room temperature.
Preheat the oven to 460°F (235°C). Transfer the dough to a cast-iron pan and gently stretch it to fill the pan.
Spread the pesto evenly over the dough. Sprinkle with half of the mozzarella, then arrange the squash slices and kale on top. Top with the remaining mozzarella.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the crust is golden and cooked through.
Slice the pizza evenly and enjoy!

name: Apple Cider Kombucha Mocktail
ingredients:
1/8 fl oz
Apple Cider
1 tbsp
Orange Juice
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1/2 tsp
Maple Syrup
1/4 tsp
Apple Cider Vinegar
8
Ice Cubes (divided)
3 fl ozs
Kombucha (ginger flavored)
recipe: Add the apple cider, orange juice, lemon juice, maple syrup, and apple cider vinegar to a shaker with 1/4 of the ice. Shake for 10 to 15 seconds to combine. Fill a glass with the remaining ice and strain the mixture in. Top with kombucha and stir gently. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Chickpea, Tempeh & Cauliflower Bowl
ingredients:
8 ozs
Tempeh
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, patted dry)
1/2 head
Cauliflower (cut into florets)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Paprika
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Couscous (dry)
1 head
Romaine Hearts (chopped)
1/3 cup
Balsamic Vinaigrette
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Crumble the tempeh onto one side of the baking sheet. Add the chickpeas to the middle and the cauliflower to the other side.
Drizzle the oil all over and season with paprika, garlic, salt, and pepper. Gently toss to combine, keeping the ingredients separate.
Cook in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until the cauliflower has browned and the chickpeas and tempeh are crispy.
Meanwhile, cook the couscous according to the package directions.
Divide the lettuce, couscous, cauliflower, tempeh, and chickpeas evenly into bowls. Add the dressing and enjoy!

name: Mango & Ginger Coconut Kefir Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Plain Coconut Kefir
1 cup
Frozen Mango
1/4 cup
Orange Juice
1 tsp
Ginger (grated)
1 tbsp
Hemp Seeds
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender. Blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and serve chilled. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea & Parsley Quinoa
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
2/3 cup
Cherry Tomatoes (chopped)
1/3 cup
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Option to set aside to cool for 10 minutes if you prefer a cool side dish.
In a bowl, add the lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Add the quinoa, chickpeas, tomatoes, and parsley. Stir well.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed. Divide evenly into bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Cranberry Kombucha Mocktail
ingredients:
6
Ice Cubes
1 tbsp
Frozen Cranberries (optional)
2 fl ozs
Kombucha (ginger flavored)
1/2 tsp
Maple Syrup
2 fl ozs
Cranberry Juice
1/4 cup
Sparkling Water
1 tbsp
Rosemary (sprig)
recipe:
Fill a glass with ice and cranberries (if using). Add the kombucha, maple syrup, and cranberry juice.
Top with sparkling water and stir gently to combine.
Garnish with a sprig of rosemary and enjoy!

name: Hearty Bean & Feta Chopped Salad
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Lima Beans (cooked)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (diced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (medium, diced)
1/2
Cucumber (large, chopped)
1/3 cup
Pitted Kalamata Olives
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Dijon Mustard

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
In a large bowl, combine the lima beans, chickpeas, onion, bell pepper, cucumber, and olives.
In a small bowl, whisk together the oil, lemon juice, mustard, and season with salt and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine. Add the feta and toss again. Divide evenly onto plates and enjoy!

name: Parchment Baked Halibut, Zucchini & Tomato
ingredients:
1
Zucchini (small, cut into big chunks)
1/2 cup
Cherry Tomatoes
5 ozs
Halibut Fillet

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 tsps
Thyme (fresh)
1/4
Lemon (medium, juiced, plus extra for serving)
1 1/2 tsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut the parchment paper into an 18-inch (45 cm) long piece. Fold it in half, then unfold it.
Place the zucchini and cherry tomatoes on the parchment. Season the fish and veggies all over with salt and pepper, then place the fish on top of the vegetables. Sprinkle with thyme and drizzle with lemon juice.
Fold the parchment paper over the fish. Starting at one end, crimp and fold the edges tightly to seal the packet. You want this sealed tight to steam the fish and veggies.
Carefully transfer the parchment packet to a baking sheet. Bake for 16 to 20 minutes or until the fish and vegetables are cooked through.
Open the parchment and top with parsley. Serve with extra lemon juice and enjoy!

name: Buffalo Tempeh Wrap
ingredients:
8 ozs
Tempeh (sliced)
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3 tbsps
Hot Sauce
2
Whole Wheat Tortilla (large)
3 tbsps
Vegan Ranch Dressing
4 leaves
Romaine (chopped)
1/2
Avocado (medium, sliced)
recipe:
Place the tempeh in a large baking dish or bowl. Add the oil, then add the garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Toss gently to combine.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add the tempeh. Cook for eight to 10 minutes, flipping halfway through. Remove, brush with hot sauce, and set aside.
To assemble, top each tortilla with ranch, romaine, tempeh, and avocado. Roll tightly into a wrap and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Roasted Tomato & Chickpea Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1 cup
Cherry Tomatoes

Sea Salt & Black Pepper
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1/2 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
2 cups
Baby Kale
1/2 cup
Hummus
1 tbsp
Mint Leaves (chopped)
1 tbsp
Parsley
1 tsp
Everything Bagel Seasoning
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, place the tomatoes on one side of the baking sheet and toss with salt, pepper, and half of the oil. On the other side, toss the chickpeas with the remaining oil, salt, and pepper. Cook in the oven for 30 to 40 minutes, until the tomatoes burst and caramelize and the chickpeas are crispy. Let cool slightly.
To assemble, divide the quinoa and kale evenly between bowls. Top with hummus, cooked tomatoes, chickpeas, mint, and parsley. Sprinkle with everything bagel seasoning and enjoy!

name: Cinnamon & Walnut Red Lentil Porridge
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Dry Red Lentils
1 1/2 cups
Oat Milk (plus more for serving)
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/8 tsp
Nutmeg
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/16 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
2 tbsps
Walnuts (toasted, chopped)
recipe:
In a pot over high heat, combine the lentils and milk. Add the cinnamon, nutmeg, vanilla, salt, and maple syrup. Once it reaches a boil, reduce the heat to medium. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 12 to 15 minutes or until creamy and the lentils are tender.
Divide evenly into bowls. Top with a splash of milk and walnuts and enjoy!

name: Sauteed Lentil & Tomato Bowl
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
1/2 cup
Dry Red Lentils (rinsed)
1 cup
Vegetable Broth (plus more as needed)
1 1/2 cups
Fire Roasted Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with juices)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for four to six minutes until softened.
Add the lentils, broth, and diced tomatoes and stir to combine. Cover and reduce the heat to low. Simmer for 12 to 15 minutes or until the lentils are tender. Add more broth as needed to prevent it from drying. Season with salt and pepper.
Remove from the heat and add the parsley. Divide evenly between bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Sriracha Baked Tofu
ingredients:
12 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, finely sliced)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 1/2 tbsps
Sriracha
2 tbsps
Soy Sauce, Low Sodium
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, gently toss the tofu with oil, sriracha, and soy sauce until evenly coated. Spread the tofu in a single layer on the baking sheet. Brush with half of the remaining marinade. Cook in the oven for 10 minutes.
Remove from the oven, flip the tofu, and brush with the remaining marinade. Cook for another 10 to 12 minutes or until the tofu is crispy on the outside. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Moroccan Crumbled Tofu
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
12 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, crumbled)
1 tbsp
Moroccan Spice Blend

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the tofu, Moroccan spice blend, salt, and pepper. Stir and cook for five to seven minutes, until golden brown.
Divide evenly onto plates and enjoy!

name: Salted Caramel Protein Latte
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Coffee (brewed)
3/4 cup
Cow's Milk, Whole
1 tsp
Coconut Sugar
1/4 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Vanilla Protein Powder
recipe:
Add the brewed coffee to a mug.
Heat the milk, vanilla, sugar, and salt in a pot over medium-low heat and stir to combine. When the sugar has dissolved and tiny bubbles start to form on the outside, remove from the heat.
Add the protein powder to the pot and use a hand-held frother to froth. Add to the mug with the coffee and enjoy!

name: Pressure Cooker Lentil, Mushroom & Farro Soup
ingredients:
4 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium (divided)
1
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
2 stalks
Celery (diced)
10
Cremini Mushrooms (medium, quartered)
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tsps
Italian Seasoning

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Dry Green Lentils (rinsed)
3 cups
Fire Roasted Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with juices)
1/3 cup
Farro
3 tbsps
Parsley (finely chopped)
recipe:
Turn the pressure cooker to "sauté" mode. Add a splash of broth, then add the onion, celery, and mushrooms. Sauté for five minutes or until tender, stirring frequently. Add the garlic, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper and cook for an additional minute. Cancel "sauté" mode.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, farro, and the remaining broth. Set the pressure cooker to "sealing" and cook on high pressure for 12 minutes. Allow the pressure to naturally release for five minutes, then carefully quick-release any remaining pressure.
Carefully open the lid and divide evenly between bowls. Garnish with parsley and enjoy!

name: High Protein Avocado Toast with Tofu Scramble
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
10 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, crumbled)
1 tbsp
Nutritional Yeast
1/4 tsp
Cumin
1/4 tsp
Turmeric

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1
Avocado (large)
4 slices
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the crumbled tofu, nutritional yeast, cumin, turmeric, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Cook for six to eight minutes until the tofu is lightly browned, stirring occasionally.
Mash the avocado evenly onto the toast and season with salt and pepper. Top with tofu and enjoy!

name: Pomegranate & Orange Kombucha Mocktail
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Pomegranate Juice
2 tbsps
Orange Juice
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
8
Ice Cubes (divided)
1/8
Navel Orange (thinly sliced, for garnish)
1 tbsp
Pomegranate Seeds
3 fl ozs
Kombucha (ginger flavored)
recipe: Add the pomegranate juice, orange juice, lemon juice, and maple syrup to a shaker with 1/4 of the ice cubes. Shake well until chilled and combined. Fill a glass with the remaining ice, orange slice, and pomegranate seeds. Strain the mixture into the glass. Top with kombucha. Stir gently and enjoy!

name: Lima Bean & Artichoke Hummus Toast
ingredients:
1 cup
Lima Beans (cooked)
1/2 cup
Artichoke Hearts (marinated, chopped)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1/2 tsp
Oregano

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Hummus
2 slices
Whole Grain Bread (toasted)
1/2
Tomato (large, sliced)
recipe:
In a bowl, combine the beans, artichoke hearts, onion, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Spread the hummus evenly over the toast. Add the sliced tomatoes.
Top the toast with the bean mixture. Enjoy!

name: Teriyaki Lentil Stir Fry with Rice Noodles
ingredients:
4 ozs
Rice Vermicelli Noodles
1
Yellow Onion (small, chopped)
1 cup
Purple Cabbage (thinly sliced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (large, chopped)
1 cup
Frozen Edamame
1 cup
Lentils (cooked, rinsed)
1/2 cup
Teriyaki Sauce
1 tsp
Arrowroot Powder
2 tsps
Water
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the rice noodles according to the package directions. Set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for three to four minutes. Add a splash of water as needed.
Add the cabbage, bell pepper, and edamame. Cook for three to four minutes or until the vegetables have softened. Add the lentils and teriyaki sauce. Cook for another two minutes to warm the lentils.
In a bowl, mix the arrowroot powder and water to make a slurry. Add it to the pan and stir for one to two minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Divide the rice noodles and lentil stir-fry evenly into bowls. Top with chopped green onions. Season with salt and pepper if needed. Enjoy!

name: Peppermint Hot Chocolate
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Water
1/2 cup
Canned Coconut Milk
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1 tbsp
Cacao Powder
1/4 tsp
Peppermint Extract
1/4 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Add the water and coconut milk to a pot over medium-low heat. As it starts to heat up, add the maple syrup, cacao powder, peppermint extract, vanilla extract, and salt. Stir to combine.
Once bubbles start to form around the edges, whisk continuously until frothy. Pour into a mug and enjoy!

name: Vegetarian Cabbage Roll Soup
ingredients:
4 cups
Green Cabbage (chopped)
1
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
2
Zucchini (medium, sliced)
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Mediterranean Spice Blend
1 1/2 cups
Tomato Purée
4 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium
3/4 cup
Basmati Rice (dry, rinsed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped, for garnish)
recipe:
Heat a nonstick pot over medium heat. Add the cabbage and onion with a splash of water. Cook for five to seven minutes until golden and soft, stirring occasionally.
Add the zucchini, garlic, and Mediterranean spice blend. Cook for another two to three minutes.
Add the tomato purée and broth. Bring to a simmer, then cover with a lid. Simmer on low for 15 minutes.
Add the rice and season with salt and pepper. Cover again and cook for an additional 15 to 20 minutes, or until everything is cooked through. Stir occasionally and add more broth if needed.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed. Divide evenly between bowls and top with cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea, Cranberry & Feta Quinoa Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1 1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
2/3 cup
Dried Unsweetened Cranberries
1/2
Cucumber (medium, chopped)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (chopped)
1/3 cup
Parsley (chopped)
1/3 cup
Pistachios (chopped)
2/3 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions. Set aside to cool.
In a small bowl or jar, whisk together the lemon juice, oil, salt, and pepper.
Add the chickpeas, cranberries, cucumber, onion, parsley, pistachios, and feta to a bowl.
Add the cooled quinoa, then add the dressing. Toss to combine. Divide evenly into bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Peach & Mango Green Smoothie
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Cow's Milk, Whole
3/4 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1/2 cup
Frozen Peaches
1/2 cup
Frozen Mango
1 cup
Baby Spinach
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Apple & Orange Earl Grey Tea
ingredients:
1
Apple (medium, seeds removed, chopped)
1
Navel Orange (small, juiced)
1/8 tsp
Cinnamon
1 cup
Earl Grey Tea (brewed, hot)
recipe:
Add the apple, orange juice, and cinnamon to a blender. Blend for one minute until smooth.
Strain the mixture through a fine mesh sieve into the hot tea. Stir and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Tofu Nuggets
ingredients:
13 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, sliced)
2 tbsps
Tamari
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
3 tbsps
Cornstarch
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Panko Bread Crumbs
3 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
1 tbsp
Onion Powder
1 tbsp
Garlic Powder
1 tbsp
Smoked Paprika
recipe:
Place the tofu in a shallow baking dish. Add the tamari and toss to coat all the pieces. Set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the milk, cornstarch, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the bread crumbs, nutritional yeast, onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 400ºF (205ºC). Dip the tofu in the milk, then in the bread crumbs, pressing to adhere the crumbs. Repeat until all remaining tofu slices are done.
Place the tofu in the air fryer basket and cook for 13 to 15 minutes until browned and crispy, flipping halfway through. Serve and enjoy!

name: Mushroom Noodle Soup with Fresh Dill
ingredients:
1
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
2 cups
Mushrooms (sliced)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth (divided, plus more for cooking)
1 1/2 tsps
Tamari

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 ozs
Rice Vermicelli Noodles (thick, dry)
3 tbsps
Fresh Dill (chopped, plus more for garnish)
1 tbsp
Paprika
recipe:
In a large non-stick pot, add the onions, mushrooms, and a splash of broth. Cook over medium heat for five to seven minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened. Add more broth as needed to prevent sticking. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the remaining broth and tamari and bring to a boil. Add the noodles, dill, and paprika. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for five to eight minutes, or until noodles are cooked to your desired tenderness.
Divide evenly into bowls. Garnish with additional dill and enjoy!

name: Cashews
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Cashews
recipe: Add cashews to a bowl and enjoy!

name: Southwest Tofu & Black Bean Bowl
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
8 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, crumbled)
1 tbsp
Nutritional Yeast
1/4 tsp
Turmeric

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Black Beans (cooked)
1 tsp
Taco Seasoning
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
1
Avocado (medium, sliced)
3 tbsps
Salsa Verde
recipe:
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the crumbled tofu, nutritional yeast, turmeric, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine. Cook for six to eight minutes until the tofu is lightly browned, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, place the beans in a bowl and toss with taco seasoning and lime juice.
Divide the tofu, beans, avocado, and salsa evenly between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Smoky Tofu & Tomato Bagel Sandwich
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Tamari
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Liquid Smoke (optional)
1/2 tsp
Onion Powder
1/4 tsp
Turmeric
6 ozs
Tofu (extra firm, pressed)
2 ozs
Vegan Cheese Shreds
1
Tomato (medium, sliced)
2
Bagel (sliced, toasted)
recipe:
In a shallow dish, combine the tamari, oil, liquid smoke (if using), onion powder, and turmeric. Mix well.
Cut the tofu into large pieces to create patties. Place the tofu in the marinade and let it sit for at least five minutes per side.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the tofu and cook for three to five minutes per side until browned. Remove from the heat and top with cheese.
Place the tofu on the bottom half of each bagel. Top with a slice of tomato and close each bagel. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer General Tso Tofu & Broccoli with Rice
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry, rinsed)
8 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, cubed)
1/4 cup
Cornstarch
1 tsp
Garlic Powder
3 cups
Broccoli (cut into florets)
3 tbsps
Tamari
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
2 tbsps
Hoisin Sauce
