1/4 cup
Water
1 tsp
Arrowroot Powder
2 tbsps
Brown Sugar
1/4 tsp
Red Pepper Flakes
1 stalk
Green Onion (sliced)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, preheat the air fryer to 400ºF (205ºC). In a large bowl, toss the tofu with the cornstarch and garlic powder. Transfer the tofu to the air fryer basket and cook for 12 to 15 minutes or until crispy, flipping halfway through.
While the tofu cooks, place the broccoli in a steamer basket over boiling water and cover. Steam for five minutes or until tender.
In a small pot, over low heat, whisk together the tamari, vinegar, hoisin sauce, water, arrowroot powder, sugar, and red pepper flakes. Bring to a simmer and cook until thickened, about three to five minutes.
Toss the cooked tofu in the sauce until coated. Divide the rice, tofu, and broccoli evenly between plates. Top with green onion and enjoy!

name: Sparkling Cranberry Ginger Mocktail
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Ginger (peeled, sliced)
1 tsp
Raw Honey
2 2/3 fl ozs
Cranberry Juice
1/2
Lime (medium, juiced)
8
Ice Cubes (plus more for serving)
1/3 cup
Frozen Cranberries
1 cup
Sparkling Water
recipe:
Add the ginger to a cocktail shaker or a jar. Muddle the ginger, then add the honey, cranberry juice, and lime juice.
Add the ice and close the shaker or jar. Shake vigorously until combined and chilled.
Fill each glass with additional ice, then strain the mixture into the glass. Divide the cranberries evenly between the glasses and top each with sparkling water. Enjoy!

name: Cashews & Blueberries
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Blueberries
1/4 cup
Cashews
recipe: Place the blueberries and cashews on a plate or in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Homemade Hashbrowns
ingredients:
4
Russet Potato (large, peeled, grated)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/4 tsp
Black Pepper
1 tbsp
Oregano
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the grated potatoes in a fine sieve and rinse until the water is mostly clear. Grabbing a handful at a time, squeeze as much water out of the potatoes, then place them in a clean bowl.
Add the oil, salt, pepper, and oregano. Mix to combine.
To shape the hashbrowns, firmly pack a mason jar lid with approximately 1/3 cup of shredded potato. Flip it over and gently remove the hashbrowns from the lid. Repeat with the remaining mixture.
Cook in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until crispy and golden brown, flipping halfway through. Serve and enjoy!

name: Dark Chocolate & Raspberry Chia Jam Bites
ingredients:
2 cups
Raspberries
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1 1/3 cups
Dark Chocolate Chips
1 tsp
Coconut Oil
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the raspberries in a medium-sized bowl and mash with a fork. Add the chia seeds and mix well.
Using a tablespoon, scoop the raspberry mixture into balls and place them on the prepared baking sheet. Transfer to the freezer. Freeze for eight hours or overnight, until completely frozen.
Once frozen, melt the chocolate and oil in a saucepan on low or in the microwave for 30-second intervals.
Use a large spoon or two forks to coat the frozen raspberry bites in melted chocolate and transfer them back to the baking sheet. Garnish with flaky salt and place in the freezer for 10 to 15 minutes just until the chocolate has set. Enjoy!

name: Cashews & Apple Slices
ingredients:
1
Apple (small, sliced)
1/4 cup
Cashews
recipe: Place the apple slices and cashews on a plate or in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Nut-Free Apple Oat Muffins
ingredients:
2 cups
Oat Flour
1 tbsp
Ground Flax Seed
2 tsps
Cinnamon
1/2 tsp
Baking Soda
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Oat Milk
1/2 cup
Maple Syrup
1/3 cup
Avocado Oil
2 tsps
Vanilla Extract
1 tsp
Apple Cider Vinegar
2
Apple (small, peeled and diced)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a muffin tray with liners or use a silicone muffin tray.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, flax seed, cinnamon, baking soda, and salt.
Add the milk, maple syrup, oil, vanilla, and vinegar. Mix until just combined, then fold in the apple.
Divide the batter evenly into the prepared muffin cups. Bake for 20 to 24 minutes or until firm to the touch and a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Let the muffins cool in the tray for 10 to 15 minutes before removing and transferring them to a cooling rack to cool completely. Enjoy!

name: Avocado & Pomegranate Tostada
ingredients:
1
Corn Tortilla (toasted)
1/2
Avocado (medium, sliced)
1/4
Lime (medium, juiced)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Pomegranate Seeds
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Lay the tortilla on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes or until crispy.
Top the toasted tortilla with avocado slices. Add lime juice, salt, and pomegranate seeds. Enjoy!

name: Cashews & Orange Slices
ingredients:
1
Navel Orange (sliced)
1/4 cup
Cashews
recipe: Place the orange slices and cashews on a plate or in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Dark Chocolate Hazelnut Clusters
ingredients:
1 cup
Hazelnuts (lightly roasted)
7 ozs
Dark Chocolate (chopped)
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Line a muffin tray with paper or silicone liners. Divide the hazelnuts evenly among the cups.
Melt the chocolate in a saucepan on low or in the microwave for 30-second intervals. Stir after each interval.
Spoon the melted chocolate over each portion of nuts. Sprinkle with sea salt. Refrigerate for 30 minutes, until set. Enjoy!

name: Macadamia Nuts & Apple Slices
ingredients:
1
Apple (medium, sliced)
1/4 cup
Macadamia Nuts
recipe: Place the apple slices and macadamia nuts on a plate or in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Raspberry Crisp
ingredients:
2 1/2 cups
Frozen Raspberries
1/2 cup
Coconut Sugar (divided)
1 tsp
Arrowroot Powder
1/2 cup
Quick Oats
1/4 cup
Almond Flour
1/4 cup
Coconut Oil (melted)
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 350°F (175°C).
In a bowl, combine the raspberries, half of the sugar, and the arrowroot powder. Divide the mixture evenly among ramekins. Place the ramekins in the air fryer basket and cook for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a separate bowl, combine the oats, almond flour, remaining sugar, and melted coconut oil. Mix until the dry ingredients are moistened.
Remove the basket from the air fryer. Top each ramekin with the oat mixture.
Return to the air fryer and cook for another 10 minutes. Remove and let sit for five minutes before serving. Enjoy!

name: Pistachio Walnut Clusters
ingredients:
1 cup
Pistachios
1 1/4 cups
Walnuts
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1 tsp
Cardamom
1/2 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
1/2 tsp
Coconut Oil
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (180ºC) and line a loaf pan with parchment paper.
In a medium-sized bowl, combine the pistachios, walnuts, maple syrup, vanilla, and cardamom. Mix well.
Add the nut mixture to the prepared loaf pan, pressing down with a spatula. Transfer to the oven and bake for 25 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Let the mixture cool completely in the pan, ideally one hour, before removing. Break into clusters.
Line a small baking sheet (or large plate) with parchment paper.
Melt the chocolate and coconut oil in a saucepan on low or in the microwave for 30-second intervals.
Dip each cluster into the melted chocolate, garnish with salt, and place on the prepared baking sheet. Transfer to the fridge for 10 to 15 minutes or until the chocolate has set. Enjoy!

name: Orange Spice Protein Balls
ingredients:
1 cup
Almond Flour
1/2 cup
Protein Powder (unflavored)
2 tbsps
Pumpkin Pie Spice
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1/3 cup
Almond Butter (runny)
1/3 cup
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Orange Extract
2 tbsps
Orange Zest (plus more for garnish)
recipe:
In a bowl, combine the almond flour, protein powder, pumpkin pie spice, hemp seeds, and salt.
Add the almond butter, maple syrup, orange extract, and orange zest and mix until smooth.
Use a one-inch (2.5 cm) cookie scoop or a teaspoon to scoop out the mixture and roll it into balls. Continue until all of the mixture is used. Refrigerate for 15 to 20 minutes to firm up. Enjoy!

name: Halloumi, Lima Bean & Hummus Bowl
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Basmati Rice (dry, rinsed)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 1/2 cups
Lima Beans (cooked, patted dry)
1/2 tsp
Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
8 3/4 ozs
Halloumi (cubed)
1/3 cup
Hummus
1
Red Bell Pepper (large, chopped)
1/2 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions. Set aside.
Meanwhile, heat half of the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the beans, paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until browned and crispy, stirring occasionally. Remove from the pan and set aside, covered.
In the same pan, add the remaining oil. Add the halloumi and cook for two to three minutes per side or until browned.
Divide the rice, hummus, beans, halloumi, bell pepper, and onion evenly between bowls. Top each with parsley and enjoy!

name: Macadamia Nuts & Raspberries
ingredients:
1 cup
Raspberries
1/4 cup
Macadamia Nuts
recipe: Place the raspberries and macadamia nuts on a plate or in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Kefir Overnight Oats with Raspberries
ingredients:
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
2 tbsps
Chia Seeds
1 1/4 cups
Plain Kefir
2 tsps
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1 cup
Raspberries
recipe:
In a bowl, mix together the oats, hemp seeds, chia seeds, kefir, maple syrup, cinnamon, and salt.
Divide evenly into jars or containers. Refrigerate for at least two hours or overnight for best results.
Top with the raspberries when ready to eat. Enjoy!

name: Savory Chickpea, Flax & Hemp Crackers
ingredients:
1 cup
Chickpea Flour
2 tbsps
Ground Flax Seed
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp
Onion Powder
1 tsp
Oregano (dried)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 tbsps
Water
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 325ºF (165ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a food processor, add the flour, ground flax, hemp seeds, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, and oil. Blend and slowly add the water. Process until combined and a dough forms.
Form the dough into a ball. Place it on top of a piece of parchment paper. Use a rolling pin to roll out the dough to about 1/4-inch (6 mm) thickness.
Use a sharp knife, pizza cutter, or desired shapes to cut into crackers.
Cook in the oven for five minutes. Rotate the baking sheet and cook for another five minutes. Increase the heat to 350ºF (175ºC) and cook for another five to six minutes or until golden brown on top.
Let the crackers cool for 10 minutes before serving. Enjoy!

name: Mango Almond Lime Smoothie
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Unsweetened Almond Milk
2 cups
Frozen Mango
3 tbsps
Almond Butter
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
2 tbsps
Pitted Dates
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Cashews & Raspberries
ingredients:
1 cup
Raspberries
1/4 cup
Cashews
recipe: Place the raspberries and cashews on a plate or in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Banana Tofu Smoothie Bowls
ingredients:
10 ozs
Silken Tofu
2/3 cup
Frozen Banana (chopped)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
2 tbsps
Cocoa Powder
1/4 cup
Almonds (toasted, chopped)
1/2
Banana (medium, sliced)
1/4 cup
Blueberries
recipe: In a blender, add the tofu, frozen banana, maple syrup, and cocoa powder. Blend until smooth. Divide evenly between bowls. Top with the almonds, banana slices, and blueberries. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Spiced Potato Patties with Green Sauce
ingredients:
3
Russet Potato (medium, peeled, quartered)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 tbsp
Chives (finely chopped)
2 tsps
Garam Masala
1/3 cup
Oat Flour (plus more if needed)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Cilantro
1 cup
Mint Leaves (chopped)
2 tbsps
Lime Juice
2
Green Chili Pepper (seeded, roughly chopped)
1 tbsp
Ginger (fresh, grated)
1/4 cup
Water (or as needed)
recipe:
Add the potatoes to a large pot of salted water and bring to a boil. Boil for 15 minutes or until the potatoes are fork-tender. Drain well and return to the pot. Add half of the oil. Mash until smooth. Transfer to a large mixing bowl.
Add the chives, garam masala, and flour to the bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Mix until fully combined. The mixture should be slightly firm and not sticky. If it feels too moist, add more flour, a teaspoon at a time.
Divide the mixture and shape into patties about 3 1/2 inches (9 cm) wide. Place on a tray and refrigerate for 15 minutes until firm.
Meanwhile, add the cilantro, mint, remaining oil, lime juice, green chilies, ginger, and water to a small food processor or blender. Season with salt and pepper. Blend until smooth adding more water if needed to reach your desired consistency.
Preheat the air fryer to 400ºF (205ºC). Arrange the patties in the basket in a single layer. Cook for 15 to 18 minutes until golden brown and cripy, flipping halfway through.
Let the patties rest for two to three minutes before serving to help them set. Serve with the green sauce and enjoy!

name: Loaded Tofu & Black Bean Breakfast Burrito
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Russet Potato (large, peeled, diced)
1/4 tsp
Smoked Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper
1 1/3 cups
Black Beans (cooked)
13 ozs
Tofu (crumbled)
1/4 tsp
Turmeric (ground)
4
Whole Wheat Tortilla (warmed)
2 ozs
Vegan Cheese Shreds
1/2 cup
Salsa
1 tbsp
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the potato and cook for eight to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until golden and tender. Season with smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to coat evenly.
Add the black beans to the pan and cook for one to two minutes until warmed through. Push the potato and bean mixture to one side of the pan.
Add the tofu to the empty side of the pan. Season with turmeric, salt, and pepper. Cook for three to four minutes, stirring gently until heated through and lightly golden. Remove the pan from the heat. Gently combine the tofu with the potato and bean mixture.
Divide the tofu mixture evenly between the tortillas. Top with cheese, salsa, and hemp seeds. Roll each tortilla tightly into a burrito. Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Orange Chickpea Bark
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, patted dry)
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt (flaky, divided)
1 1/4 cups
Dark Chocolate Chips
1 tsp
Coconut Oil
1 tsp
Orange Extract
2 tbsps
Orange Zest
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the chickpeas to the baking sheet and drizzle the olive oil over them. Season with half of the salt. Toss to coat and spread into an even layer on the baking sheet.
Cook in the oven for 17 to 20 minutes until browned and crunchy. Let them cool for five to 10 minutes.
Melt the chocolate chips and the coconut oil in a double boiler or in 30-second intervals in the microwave. Stir in the orange extract.
Add the roasted chickpeas to the melted chocolate and stir to coat. Pour onto a newly lined baking sheet and spread into an even layer. Sprinkle the orange zest and the remaining salt evenly over the top.
Freeze for at least one hour or until set. Break into pieces and enjoy!

name: Bagel with Smashed Chickpea & Tofu Salad
ingredients:
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
10 ozs
Tofu (soft, drained)
2 tbsps
Vegan Mayonnaise
1 tsp
Dijon Mustard
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1/4 tsp
Turmeric

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
2
Bagel (toasted)
recipe:
Roughly mash the chickpeas in a bowl, leaving some texture. Crumble the tofu into the bowl and gently combine.
Add the mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, turmeric, salt, and pepper. Stir until smooth and creamy. Fold in the green onion and hemp seeds.
Divide the smashed chickpea mixture evenly between bowls and serve with a toasted bagel. Enjoy!

name: Radicchio, Arugula & Sweet Potato Salad with Tahini Dressing
ingredients:
2
Sweet Potato (medium, cubed)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 1/2 tsps
Cinnamon
1 1/2 tsps
Ground Ginger
1 1/2 tsps
Cumin

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
2 tbsps
Tahini
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
2 cups
Radicchio (chopped)
3 cups
Arugula
1/3 cup
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, add the sweet potato, 1/4 of the oil, cinnamon, ginger, cumin, salt, and pepper. Toss well to coat and spread everything out on the baking sheet. Transfer to the oven and cook for 30 minutes until cooked through and browned.
In a small bowl, combine the remaining oil, maple syrup, tahini, and lemon juice. Whisk well, and season with salt and pepper.
In the large bowl, add the radicchio, arugula, parsley, and cooked sweet potato. Add the dressing and toss to combine. Divide evenly between bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Mushroom & Lentil Wrap
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 cups
Mushrooms (sliced)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 cup
Lentils (cooked)
1/2 tsp
Smoked Paprika
1 cup
Baby Spinach

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Hummus
2
Whole Wheat Tortilla (warmed)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-low heat. Add the mushrooms and garlic. Cook for three to four minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened.
Add the lentils, smoked paprika, and spinach. Cook for one to two minutes until heated through. Season with salt and pepper.
Spread the hummus evenly over each tortilla. Top with the lentil mixture and roll each tortilla tightly into a wrap. Enjoy!

name: Tofu & Broccoli Stir Fry
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Sesame Oil (divided)
12 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, cubed)
2 cups
Frozen Broccoli (tops only, thawed)
1/4 cup
Vegetable Broth
1 tbsp
Soy Sauce, Low Sodium
1 1/2 tsps
Oyster Sauce
1/16 tsp
Black Pepper
1 1/2 tsps
Rice Vinegar
1 1/2 tsps
Arrowroot Powder
recipe:
Heat half of the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the tofu in a single layer and cook, turning occasionally, for six to eight minutes until golden on all sides.
Add the broccoli to the pan and cook for two to three minutes until heated through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the broth, soy sauce, oyster sauce, pepper, vinegar, the remaining oil, and arrowroot powder until smooth.
Add the sauce to the pan. Cook, stirring gently, for one to two minutes until the sauce thickens and coats the tofu and broccoli.
Divide evenly between bowls or plates and enjoy!

name: Spinach & Ginger Soup with Crispy Baked Tofu
ingredients:
8 ozs
Tofu (cubed)
1 tbsp
Tamari
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil (divided)
4 stalks
Green Onion (chopped, divided)
1/2
Serrano Pepper (medium, diced)
1 1/2 tsps
Ginger (fresh, minced)
1/4 tsp
Turmeric (ground)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth
1/3 cup
Israeli Couscous (dry)
2 cups
Baby Spinach (chopped)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped, plus more for garnish)
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Toss the tofu with tamari and half of the oil in a bowl. Let sit for 10 minutes.
Spread the tofu on the baking sheet. Cook in the oven for 10 minutes, then flip. Place it back in the oven and cook for another five minutes until golden and crispy.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a pot over medium-low heat. Add two-thirds of the green onions, the serrano pepper, ginger, and turmeric. Cook for one minute until fragrant.
Add the broth and couscous. Bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer, cover loosely, and cook for 12 to 14 minutes until the couscous is tender.
Add the spinach and cilantro. Cook for three minutes until wilted. Remove from the heat and add the lime juice.
Divide the soup evenly between bowls. Top with baked tofu, the remaining green onions, and extra cilantro if desired. Enjoy!

name: Turmeric & Ginger Cauliflower Quinoa Soup
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Coconut Oil
1
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
1 1/2 tsps
Ginger (finely chopped)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1 tsp
Turmeric

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth
1 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
1
Lime (medium, zested, juiced)
1 3/4 cups
Canned Coconut Milk
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a medium pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for four to five minutes until softened. Add the ginger and garlic. Cook for one more minute until fragrant.
Add the quinoa and turmeric. Season with salt and pepper, then stir well to incorporate. Add the broth, increase the heat to medium-high, and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook for five minutes.
Add the cauliflower and cook for 13 to 15 minutes until tender and cooked through.
Add the lime zest and juice. Add the coconut milk, and season with salt and pepper. Heat until warmed through.
Divide the soup evenly between bowls and top with cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Chocolate Fudge Oat Bars
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Coconut Oil (melted)
2/3 cup
Sunflower Seed Butter (divided)
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2 cups
Oats (rolled)
1 cup
Oat Flour
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 cups
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Line a baking dish with parchment paper. Set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the oil, half of the sunflower seed butter, maple syrup, and vanilla. Add the oats, oat flour, and salt. Use a spatula to mix until thoroughly combined and the oats hold together when pressed.
Add 3/4 of the oat mixture to the prepared baking dish. Press down to create an even layer. Transfer to the freezer for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt the chocolate chips using a double boiler or in 30-second intervals in the microwave. Once melted, add the remaining sunflower seed butter and mix well.
Remove the baking dish from the freezer. Pour the chocolate mixture over top and spread into an even layer. Scatter the remaining oat mixture over top using your hands. Transfer back to the freezer for two hours until set.
Once set, slice evenly into bars. Enjoy!

name: Dill, Beet & Farro Salad
ingredients:
1 cup
Farro (dry)
1 cup
Pickled Beets (chopped)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
3 tbsps
Fresh Dill (finely chopped)
2 tbsps
Apple Cider Vinegar

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Cook the farro according to the package directions. Set it aside to cool.
Combine the cooled farro, pickled beets, onion, dill, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Toss to combine.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Coconut & Pumpkin Chickpea Curry
ingredients:
1 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry, rinsed)
1 1/2 tbsps
Coconut Oil
1
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
1 1/2 tsps
Ginger (fresh, minced)
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tsps
Garam Masala
1 tsp
Cumin
1/2 tsp
Turmeric

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 1/2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked)
1 cup
Pureed Pumpkin
1 3/4 cups
Canned Coconut Milk
1/2 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a Dutch oven or heavy-bottomed pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion and sauté for seven to eight minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened.
Add the ginger, garlic, garam masala, cumin, turmeric, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring often, for one to two minutes until fragrant.
Add the chickpeas, pumpkin, and coconut milk. Stir to scrape up any browned bits from the bottom. Bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low. Cover partially and cook for 12 to 15 minutes until thickened slightly.
Divide the rice evenly between bowls. Top with the chickpea curry and garnish with cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Carrot Cake Chickpea Pancakes
ingredients:
2/3 cup
Chickpea Flour
2 tbsps
Tapioca Flour
1 tsp
Baking Powder
1/4 tsp
Baking Soda
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
3/4 cup
Oat Milk (plus more if needed)
1 1/2 tbsps
Maple Syrup (plus extra for serving)
1 1/2 tsps
Vegetable Oil
1 tsp
Apple Cider Vinegar
1
Carrot (medium, shredded)
recipe:
In a bowl, whisk together the chickpea flour, tapioca flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt until fully combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the oat milk, maple syrup, oil, and vinegar.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and whisk until smooth. Fold in the grated carrot. Let the batter rest for 10 minutes.
After resting, the batter should be thick but pourable. If it feels too thick or sticky, add one to two teaspoons of extra milk and gently stir.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low heat. Spoon approximately 1/4 cup of batter per pancake. Cook for two to three minutes until bubbles form and the edges set. Flip and cook for one to two minutes until golden and cooked through.
Divide the pancakes evenly between plates. Drizzle with additional maple syrup if desired. Enjoy!

name: Pomegranate Poached Pear
ingredients:
1 cup
Water
1/4 cup
Pomegranate Juice
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1 tsp
Cardamom Seeds
1
Pear (medium, peeled, sliced in half lengthwise, cored)
1 tbsp
Pistachios (chopped)
recipe:
In a small pot over medium heat, combine the water, pomegranate juice, maple syrup, and cardamom. Stir well.
Add the pears, ensuring they are fully submerged in the liquid. Bring to a gentle simmer. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 40 to 50 minutes until the pears are tender, stirring occasionally.
Once the pears are cooked, remove them from the pot. Increase the heat to medium-high. Simmer the remaining liquid until reduced and slightly thickened.
Transfer the pears to a plate. Spoon the sauce over the top, sprinkle with pistachios, and enjoy!

name: Falafel & Quinoa Fatteh
ingredients:
2
Whole Wheat Pita (cut into large pieces)
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
2 tbsps
Sesame Seeds

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
8 ozs
Frozen Falafel
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1/2 tsp
Chili Powder
1 tbsp
Butter (melted)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the pita pieces on the baking sheet. Spray with oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds, salt, and pepper. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until crispy and golden, flipping halfway through.
Place the falafel on a separate parchment-lined baking sheet. Cook in the oven for 12 to 15 minutes until cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the quinoa according to the package directions.
In a bowl, mix together the yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. In a separate small bowl, combine the chili powder and melted butter.
To assemble, place the cooked quinoa on a plate. Top with the crispy pita, falafel, and yogurt. Drizzle with the chili butter and sprinkle with the cilantro. Divide evenly onto plates and enjoy!

name: Peanut Tempeh & Edamame Stir Fry with Quinoa
ingredients:
2 tbsps
All Natural Peanut Butter (runny)
1 tsp
Apple Cider Vinegar
1 tsp
Coconut Aminos
1 tbsp
Water

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
8 ozs
Tempeh (crumbled)
1 cup
Frozen Edamame
2 cups
Coleslaw Mix
1 tbsp
Sesame Seeds
recipe:
Mix together the peanut butter, vinegar, coconut aminos, water, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Cook the quinoa according to the package directions. Set it aside.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the tempeh and season with salt and pepper. Cook for seven to eight minutes until browned.
Add the edamame and cook for two to three minutes until heated through. Add the coleslaw mix and cook for one to two minutes until slightly wilted.
Combine the cooked quinoa, tempeh mixture, and peanut butter sauce in a bowl. Mix until well combined. Divide evenly between bowls and top with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Corn, Quinoa & Black Bean Enchiladas
ingredients:
2
Sweet Potato (medium, peeled, cubed)
2 tsps
Avocado Oil
1 tbsp
Taco Seasoning (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3/4 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
2 cups
Black Beans (cooked)
1 cup
Frozen Corn (thawed)
2 cups
Enchilada Sauce (divided)
4
Whole Wheat Tortilla (large)
5 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)
1
Avocado (medium, sliced)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Add the sweet potato, oil, and 1/3 of the taco seasoning to a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and toss well to coat. Spread evenly on a baking sheet. Cook in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes until cooked through and browned.
Meanwhile, cook the quinoa according to the package directions.
Add the sweet potato to a large bowl along with the beans, corn, cooked quinoa, the remaining taco seasoning, salt, pepper, and 1/4 of the enchilada sauce. Toss well.
Pour 1/3 of the remaining enchilada sauce into the bottom of a baking dish.
Place the tortillas on a flat surface. Divide the sweet potato mixture evenly between the tortillas, placing the mixture in a line down the center. Roll each tortilla tightly and transfer them to the prepared baking dish with the seam-side down.
Pour the remaining enchilada sauce over the tortillas. Top with cheese. Place in the oven and cook for 15 minutes, covered. Remove the cover and cook for an additional five minutes. Let cool slightly. Divide evenly between plates and top with avocado and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Cheezy Popcorn
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Nutritional Yeast
1 tsp
Sea Salt
2 tbsps
Coconut Oil
1/2 cup
Popcorn Kernels
recipe:
Combine the nutritional yeast and salt in a large food storage container with a lid. It should be big enough to fit the popcorn once popped. Set aside.
Heat a large pot over medium heat and add the oil. Once melted, add the popcorn kernels and cover the pot.
Continuously move the pot to coat the kernels in the oil and to prevent them from burning.
Continue until all of the kernels have popped. Immediately transfer the popcorn to the prepared container.
Close the lid and shake to coat the popcorn evenly with the nutritional yeast and salt. Serve warm or at room temperature. Enjoy!

name: Homemade Hummus & Seed Loaf
ingredients:
3 cups
Whole Wheat Flour
1 tbsp
Baking Powder
1/2 tsp
Baking Soda
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 cups
Water
1 tsp
Apple Cider Vinegar
3/4 cup
Hummus
1/2 cup
Pumpkin Seeds (toasted)
1/4 cup
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Line a loaf pan with parchment paper, ensuring the ends extend higher than the sides of the pan.
Combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl.
Add the water, vinegar, and hummus to the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined. Gently fold in the pumpkin seeds and sesame seeds.
Transfer the dough to the prepared pan. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes until the loaf is cooked through and lightly golden.
Let cool completely before slicing into even pieces. Enjoy!

name: Leek & Potato Gratin
ingredients:
1/2 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Leeks (large, chopped)
1/2 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 cup
Whipping Cream
2
Russet Potato (medium, peeled, sliced)
2 ozs
Cheddar Cheese (shredded)
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC).
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the leeks and cook for five to seven minutes until soft and lightly browned.
Add the garlic powder, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine. Add the cream, stir to combine, then remove the pan from the heat.
Arrange the potato slices in a baking dish. Pour the cream mixture over the potatoes and top with the shredded cheese. Cover the dish with aluminum foil and cook in the oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
Remove the foil. Bake for another 10 to 15 minutes until fully cooked and browned on top.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then top with parsley. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Coconut Chia Pudding with Banana
ingredients:
1 3/4 cups
Canned Coconut Milk
1/3 cup
Chia Seeds
3 tbsps
Maple Syrup
2 tbsps
Cocoa Powder
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2
Banana (medium, sliced)
recipe:
In a resealable container, whisk together the coconut milk, chia seeds, maple syrup, cocoa powder, and vanilla.
Cover with an airtight lid and refrigerate for two hours or overnight until set.
When it's ready, divide the chia pudding evenly between bowls or containers. Top with banana slices and enjoy!

name: Hummus & Chopped Olive Salad Snack Box
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Assorted Olives (finely chopped)
1/2
Cucumber (medium, finely chopped)
1/2
Red Bell Pepper (large, finely chopped)
1 tbsp
Shallot (finely chopped)
1 cup
Hummus
1 oz
Seed Crackers
recipe:
In a bowl, combine the chopped olives, cucumber, bell pepper, and shallot. Mix gently.
Divide the chopped salad, hummus, and crackers evenly between plates or in containers with separate compartments. Enjoy!

name: Vegan Pate
ingredients:
1
Carrot (medium, peeled, grated)
1/2
Russet Potato (medium, peeled, grated)
1/2 cup
Sunflower Seeds
1/2 cup
Almond Butter
1
Yellow Onion (sliced)
1/4 cup
Water
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tbsps
Lemon Juice
1 tsp
Sesame Oil
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC). Generously grease an oven-proof glass or aluminum baking dish.
Combine all of the ingredients in a food processor. Blend until very smooth.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared pan. Spread it into an even layer. Cook in the oven for 45 to 50 minutes until the pâté begins to brown lightly on top.
Let cool completely. Cover and refrigerate for one hour before slicing into even pieces. Enjoy!

name: Apple Juice
ingredients:
8 ozs
Apple Juice
recipe: Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Roasted Parmesan Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients:
2 cups
Cherry Tomatoes (halved)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 tbsps
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
2 tsps
Italian Seasoning
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC) with the rack in the middle position. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the cherry tomatoes on the baking sheet, cut side up. Drizzle with the oil. Sprinkle evenly with the parmesan cheese and seasoning.
Cook in the oven for seven to 10 minutes until the cheese has melted and the tomatoes are tender. Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Raspberry Chocolate Oatmeal with Seeds
ingredients:
2 cups
Soy Milk
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1 cup
Raspberries
2 tbsps
Pumpkin Seeds
2 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
1 oz
Dark Chocolate (chopped)
recipe:
Bring the milk to a boil in a small saucepan. Add the oats and cinnamon. Reduce to a steady simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, for five minutes until the oats are tender and most of the liquid is absorbed.
Transfer the cooked oats to a bowl. Top with the raspberries, pumpkin seeds, hemp seeds, and chocolate. Enjoy!

name: Oatmeal Raisin Cookie Smoothie
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups
Cow's Milk, Reduced Fat
1
Banana (frozen)
1/3 cup
Oats (rolled)
1/4 cup
Raisins
1 tbsp
Cashew Butter
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/2 tsp
Vanilla Extract
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Enjoy!

name: Homemade Feta Hummus with Cucumber
ingredients:
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
2 tbsps
Tahini
2 tbsps
Water
1/4 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
1
Garlic (clove)
1 tsp
Lemon Juice
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2
Cucumber (large, sliced)
recipe:
Add all of the ingredients except the cucumber to a food processor. Blend until a creamy consistency forms. Add more water to thin if needed.
Divide the feta hummus evenly between plates or containers. Serve with cucumber slices and enjoy!

name: Garlic Parmesan Crusted Halibut
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Oat Flour

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 tbsps
Butter (cold, cut into small pieces)
1/2 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
10 ozs
Halibut Fillet
1 tbsp
Parsley (chopped)
1/2
Lemon (medium, for serving)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, combine the flour, salt, pepper, and butter. Use your hands to massage the butter into the flour for two to three minutes, until well combined and a sandy texture forms. Add the Parmesan and mix to combine.
Place the fish fillets on the prepared baking sheet. Spoon the Parmesan mixture over the top and gently press to form a crust. Bake for 13 to 15 minutes until the fish is cooked through and the top is crispy.
Top the fish with parsley and serve with lemon. Enjoy!

name: Blackberry Oat Cookies
ingredients:
2
Banana (medium, ripe)
1/3 cup
Almond Butter (smooth)
1 tbsp
Maple Syrup
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt
2 cups
Oats (rolled)
1/2 cup
Blackberries
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mash the bananas until smooth. Add the almond butter, maple syrup, and salt. Stir until smooth.
Add the oats and stir until well combined. Add the blackberries, and lightly mash as you mix them into the batter.
Scoop about two heaping tablespoons of dough for each cookie and form into a ball. Place on the baking sheet and flatten to a 1/2-inch (1 cm) thickness.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes until browned and cooked through. Let cool for 10 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Orange Juice
ingredients:
1 cup
Orange Juice
recipe: Pour into a glass. Enjoy!

name: Harissa Chickpeas with Quinoa, Kale & Halloumi
ingredients:
2 cups
Chickpeas (cooked, patted dry)
2 cups
Shallot (cut into wedges)
3 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 tbsp
Harissa

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3/4 cup
Quinoa (dry, rinsed)
8 ozs
Halloumi (sliced)
4 cups
Kale Leaves (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, toss the chickpeas and shallots with 1/3 of the oil and harissa. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer to the prepared baking sheet and cook for 18 to 22 minutes until crispy, shaking the pan halfway through.
Meanwhile, cook the quinoa according to the package directions.
Heat a pan and add half of the remaining oil. Add the halloumi and cook for two to three minutes per side until browned. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add the remaining oil and cook the kale for two minutes until just softened. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide the quinoa, chickpeas, halloumi, and kale evenly between bowls or plates. Enjoy!

name: Greek Fava Dip & Cucumber
ingredients:
1 1/3 cups
Yellow Split Peas (uncooked, rinsed)
1/3 cup
Red Onion (medium, chopped)
2
Garlic (clove)
1/2
Lemon (juiced)
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1 1/2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)
1 stalk
Green Onion (sliced)
1
Cucumber (large, sliced)
recipe:
Add the split peas to a pot and cover with water. Place the pot on the stove and bring to a simmer over medium-low heat. Simmer for 30 minutes until tender.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes until the split peas are soft and cooked through. Strain and rinse under cold water.
Add to a food processor with the lemon juice, salt, and 2/3 of the oil. Blend until smooth. Taste and adjust the salt and lemon juice as needed.
Transfer the dip to a bowl. Drizzle with the remaining oil and top with green onion. Serve with cucumber. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Green Smoothie
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/2 cup
Frozen Strawberries
1 cup
Baby Spinach
1 tsp
Ginger (fresh, grated)
1 tbsp
Hemp Seeds
1 tbsp
Chia Seeds (optional)
1/4 tsp
Lemon Juice (optional)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Vegan Cauliflower Fried Rice
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Sesame Oil
12 ozs
Tofu (pressed, cubed)
1 1/2 tsps
Ginger (fresh, grated)
2 cups
Frozen Vegetable Mix (thawed)
2 cups
Cauliflower Rice (thawed)
1/2 tsp
Rice Vinegar
2 tsps
Soy Sauce, Low Sodium
2 stalks
Green Onion (sliced)
1/2 cup
Almonds (toasted, finely chopped)
recipe:
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the oil and the tofu. Cook for five to seven minutes, stirring occasionally until lightly golden on all sides.
Add the ginger and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the frozen vegetable mix and cook for three to four minutes until heated through. Add the cauliflower rice. Cook for three to four minutes until tender, stirring occasionally.
Add the vinegar and soy sauce. Stir well to combine. Cook for one to two minutes until heated through.
Remove from the heat. Add the green onion and almonds. Divide evenly between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Hummus, Edamame & Seed Cracker Snack Plate
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
1/4
Avocado (medium, sliced)
1
Carrot (medium, cut into sticks)
1 oz
Seed Crackers
2 tbsps
Hummus

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Arrange all of the ingredients on a plate or in a container with separate compartments.
Season the avocado and edamame with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Spinach Halloumi Stew
ingredients:
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
1 1/3 cups
Frozen Spinach (thawed, drained)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tsp
Garam Masala
1 1/3 cups
Vegetable Broth, Low Sodium

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
4 ozs
Halloumi (sliced)
1/2
Lemon (medium, juiced)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for five minutes until soft.
Add the spinach and cook for five minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the garlic and garam masala. Stir and cook for two minutes until fragrant.
Add the broth. Season with salt and pepper, and bring to a simmer. Lower the heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes until cooked through and the flavors have combined.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Cook the halloumi for one to two minutes per side until golden brown.
Remove the stew from the heat. Add the lemon juice and fold in the halloumi. Divide evenly into bowls and enjoy!

name: Strawberry Protein Oatmeal with Seeds
ingredients:
1 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk (plus more if needed)
1/2 cup
Oats (rolled)
1/2 cup
Frozen Strawberries (thawed, chopped)
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tsp
Chia Seeds
2 tbsps
Pumpkin Seeds
1/2 oz
Dark Chocolate (chopped)
recipe:
In a saucepan, bring the milk to a boil. Add the oats and reduce the heat to a steady simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, for six to eight minutes until the oats are tender and most of the milk is absorbed. Add the thawed strawberries halfway through.
Add the protein powder and chia seeds and mix until well combined. Add a splash of water or additional milk if needed to reach the desired consistency.
Transfer the cooked oats to a bowl. Top with the pumpkin seeds and dark chocolate. Enjoy!

name: Classic TVP Hard Shell Tacos
ingredients:
2 cups
Textured Vegetable Protein (crumbs)
1 tbsp
Taco Seasoning
1/4 cup
Water
4 ozs
Hard Taco Shell
1 head
Iceberg Lettuce (small, finely shredded)
4 ozs
Vegan Cheese Shreds
1/3 cup
Guacamole
1/3 cup
Salsa
4 stalks
Green Onion (thinly sliced, optional)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped, optional)
recipe:
Heat a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the TVP and cook for three to four minutes, stirring often until heated through.
Add the taco seasoning and the water. Cook until all the liquid has evaporated.
Spoon the TVP evenly into the taco shells. Top with lettuce, cheese, guacamole, salsa, green onions, and cilantro, if desired. Enjoy!

name: Pan Seared Haddock with Green Beans
ingredients:
2 cups
Green Beans (trimmed)
2
Haddock Fillet (patted dry)
1 tsp
Oregano (dried)
1/2 tsp
Thyme (fresh)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
recipe:
Put the beans in a steamer basket over boiling water and cover. Steam for five to six minutes or until tender.
Meanwhile, season the fish with oregano, thyme, salt, and pepper. Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Pan-fry the fish for three to four minutes per side or until it flakes with a fork.
Divide the cooked fish and green beans evenly between plates. Enjoy!

name: Blueberry Banana Oat Bars
ingredients:
2 cups
Frozen Blueberries
1/4 cup
Raw Honey (divided)
3 tbsps
Chia Seeds
2
Banana (medium, ripe)
1/2 cup
Cashew Butter (smooth)
2 1/2 cups
Oats (rolled, divided)
1 tsp
Coconut Oil
recipe:
In a saucepan over low heat, combine the frozen berries and half of the honey. Simmer for eight to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until it starts to thicken. Stir in the chia seeds and simmer for another four to five minutes. Remove from the heat and let cool for five minutes. It will thicken more as it cools.
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC). Line a baking dish with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, mash the banana until smooth. Add the remaining honey and the cashew butter. Add 4/5 of the oats and mix until well combined. Reserve the remaining oats for topping later.
Pour the oat and banana mixture into the baking dish and press it into an even layer. Spread the mixed berry compote over the top.
Add the oil to the reserved oat mixture. Use your hands to crumble it, then sprinkle it on top of the berry compote.
Bake for 17 to 18 minutes until the top is slightly golden. Let cool for five minutes before cutting evenly into bars. Enjoy!

name: Seasoned Sweet Potato Wedges
ingredients:
4
Sweet Potato (small, cut into wedges)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
1 tbsp
Poultry Seasoning
1/4 tsp
Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add all of the ingredients to a bowl. Toss to thoroughly combine.
Spread into an even layer on the baking sheet. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until browned and cooked through, flipping halfway. Enjoy!

name: Pan Seared Haddock with Mashed Potatoes & Green Beans
ingredients:
2
Russet Potato (large, peeled, chopped)
1/4 cup
Cow's Milk, Whole
1 tsp
Butter

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Green Beans (trimmed)
2
Haddock Fillet (patted dry)
1 tsp
Oregano (dried)
1/2 tsp
Thyme (fresh)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
recipe:
Add the potatoes to a pot of salted water. Bring to a boil and cook for 15 minutes until fork-tender. Drain the water and return the potatoes to the pot. Add the milk, butter, and salt. Mash with a potato masher until smooth and creamy. Set aside.
Once the potatoes are almost done, place the beans in a steamer basket over boiling water and cover. Steam for five to six minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, season the fish with oregano, thyme, salt, and pepper. Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the fish for three to four minutes per side until it flakes with a fork.
Divide the mashed potatoes, green beans, and cooked fish evenly between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pita Pockets with Roasted Vegetables & Hummus
ingredients:
1
Red Bell Pepper (medium, sliced)
1 cup
Mushrooms (sliced)
1
Zucchini (medium, sliced)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 tsp
Oregano (dried)
1/4 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/8 tsp
Sea Salt (or to taste)
1/2 cup
Hummus
1
Whole Wheat Pita (sliced in half)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the bell pepper, mushrooms, zucchini, and red onion to the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and season with oregano, garlic powder, and salt. Toss to coat evenly, then spread the vegetables in an even layer.
Cook in the oven for 35 to 40 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Spread the hummus evenly on each pita half. Fill each pita with the roasted vegetables. Enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Chocolate Oat Balls
ingredients:
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
1/2 cup
Pitted Dates (chopped)
1/2 cup
Pureed Pumpkin
1/2 cup
Cashew Butter
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
1/4 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
recipe:
Add the oats to a food processor. Blend until it reaches a flour-like consistency.
Add the dates, pureed pumpkin, cashew butter, vanilla, and salt. Blend until combined and the mixture holds together.
Use a cookie scoop or tablespoon to scoop the mixture. Roll it into balls with your hands and repeat until all the mixture is used. Transfer to the freezer for one hour.
Melt the chocolate in a saucepan over low heat or in the microwave in 30-second intervals. Dip each ball into the chocolate and return to the freezer for 10 to 15 minutes until the chocolate has hardened. Enjoy!

name: Pan Seared Haddock
ingredients:
2
Haddock Fillet (patted dry)
1 tsp
Oregano (dried)
1/2 tsp
Thyme (fresh)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
recipe:
Season the fish with oregano, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the fish for three to four minutes per side until it flakes with a fork.
Divide evenly between plates and enjoy!

name: Shredded Tofu & Coleslaw Wrap
ingredients:
5 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, patted dry)
1/4 tsp
Garlic Powder
1/4 tsp
Smoked Paprika

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
2 tbsps
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
1 tbsp
Hot Sauce
1 cup
Coleslaw Mix
1
Brown Rice Tortilla
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Shred the tofu using the large holes of a box grater and place it on the baking sheet. Toss the tofu with garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spray with oil, spread out evenly, and cook in the oven for 10 to 15 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the yogurt and hot sauce. Add the coleslaw and toss to combine. Season with salt and pepper.
Lay the tortillas flat. Divide the coleslaw and tofu evenly among them. Roll each wrap tightly, tucking in the sides to form a burrito. Enjoy!

name: Zucchini Stuffed Portobello Mushroom Caps
ingredients:
1 tsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2
Zucchini (medium, sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tsp
Italian Seasoning
1 cup
Tomato Sauce
12 ozs
Portobello Mushroom Caps
2 tbsps
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC).
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the zucchini, stir, and season with salt and pepper. Sauté for five to seven minutes until soft and slightly browned. Remove from the heat and stir in the Italian seasoning.
Add the tomato sauce to a deep baking dish and spread it evenly. Place the mushrooms in the dish top-side down, then season with salt and pepper. Fill the mushrooms evenly with zucchini.
Cook in the oven for 15 to 17 minutes or until the mushrooms are cooked through. Top with parsley, and enjoy!

name: Mushroom Bolognese
ingredients:
12 ozs
Rigatoni (uncooked)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
1 stalk
Celery (chopped)
16
Cremini Mushrooms (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Tomato Paste
1 tbsp
Tamari
3 cups
Crushed Tomatoes
3 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
1/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion and celery. Cook for two minutes just until they start to soften. Add the mushrooms, and season with salt and pepper. Cook for six to eight minutes until softened, reducing the heat to medium-low if needed.
Add the tomato paste and tamari. Cook for two to three minutes until the tomato paste deepens in color slightly. Add the crushed tomatoes and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 10 to 12 minutes. Add the nutritional yeast and milk. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the pasta to the pan and toss with the sauce. Divide evenly between plates, garnish with parsley, and enjoy!

name: Strawberry Shortcake Baked Oats
ingredients:
1 cup
Oats (rolled)
3/4 cup
Unsweetened Almond Milk
1/3 cup
Unsweetened Applesauce
2 tbsps
Maple Syrup
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 tsp
Ground Flax Seed
1/2 tsp
Baking Powder
3/4 cup
Strawberries (chopped)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 350ºF (175ºC) and grease the ramekins.
Combine the oats, milk, applesauce, maple syrup, protein powder, flaxseed, and baking powder in a blender. Blend on high for one minute until very smooth.
Stir in the strawberries. Divide the oat mixture evenly between ramekins. Bake for 25 to 27 minutes until cooked through and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Let cool slightly. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato & Cauliflower Chili
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2 cup
Red Onion (chopped)
1/2
Sweet Potato (large, cubed)
3/4 cup
Mushrooms (chopped)
1/2 head
Cauliflower (large, cut into florets)
2 tbsps
Taco Seasoning
3 cups
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with the juices)
1 1/2 cups
Vegetable Broth
2 cups
Mixed Beans (cooked)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and sweet potato. Cook for five to seven minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to brown.
Add the mushrooms and cauliflower. Cook for three to four minutes until slightly softened.
Add the taco seasoning, tomatoes, and broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium. Stir in the beans. Cover and cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until the chili has slightly thickened and the vegetables are tender.
Divide evenly between bowls. Top with the cilantro and enjoy!

name: Chili Oil
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Avocado Oil
4
Garlic (cloves, finely chopped)
2 servings
Cinnamon Stick
1 tbsp
Star Anise (whole)
1 tbsp
Ginger (fresh, cut into pieces)
2 tbsps
Red Pepper Flakes
1 tbsp
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
1 tbsp
Paprika
1 tsp
Cane Sugar
1 tsp
Sea Salt
recipe:
In a small pot, combine the oil, garlic, cinnamon sticks, star anise, and ginger. Cook over medium-low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the garlic is browned and fragrant.
Remove from the heat and let infuse for five minutes. Use a slotted spoon to remove and discard the cinnamon sticks, star anise, and ginger.
Meanwhile, combine the red pepper flakes, sesame seeds, paprika, sugar, and salt in a heatproof bowl. Carefully pour the hot oil over the spice mixture. Stir well to combine.
Transfer to a glass jar. Let cool completely, then seal and refrigerate. Enjoy!

name: Hearty Mixed Bean Chili with Avocado
ingredients:
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
2 stalks
Celery (large, chopped)
1
Green Bell Pepper (large, chopped)
1 1/2 tbsps
Taco Seasoning
4 cups
Mixed Beans (cooked)
1 cup
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with the juices)
1/2 cup
Vegetable Broth
1
Avocado (medium, sliced)
2 tbsps
Cilantro (chopped)
3 tbsps
Hemp Seeds
recipe:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, celery, and bell pepper. Cook for four to six minutes until softened and lightly golden.
Stir in the taco seasoning. Cook for one more minute.
Add the beans, tomatoes, and broth. Stir well to combine. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly and the liquid reduces.
Divide the chili evenly between bowls. Top with the sliced avocado, cilantro, and hemp seeds. Enjoy!

name: Rustic Cabbage & White Bean Soup
ingredients:
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
4 cups
Green Cabbage (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 tsp
Fennel Seed (ground)
1
Carrot (large, chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
4 cups
Vegetable Broth
2 cups
Diced Tomatoes (from the can, with the juices)
2 cups
White Navy Beans (drained, rinsed)
recipe:
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion, cabbage, salt, pepper, and fennel seeds. Cook for six to eight minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened.
Add the carrot and garlic. Stir frequently and cook for two minutes until fragrant.
Add the broth and tomatoes. Bring to a simmer, then cover and cook for 20 to 25 minutes until the cabbage is tender.
Stir in the beans and simmer uncovered for two minutes until warmed through.
Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Canned Sardines
ingredients:
4 ozs
Sardines (canned)
recipe: Eat directly from the can or plate them. Enjoy!

name: Vegan Spinach & Tofu Breakfast Bites
ingredients:
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
2 cups
Baby Spinach (chopped)
14 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed)
2 tbsps
Nutritional Yeast
1 tbsp
Miso Paste
3/4 tsp
Garlic Powder
3/4 tsp
Onion Powder
1/4 tsp
Turmeric

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line a muffin tin with liners and spray with oil, or use a silicone muffin tray.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium-low heat. Add the spinach and cook for three to four minutes until wilted. Set aside.
Break the tofu into pieces with your hands and add to a food processor. Add the nutritional yeast, miso paste, garlic powder, onion powder, turmeric, salt, and pepper. Process until smooth and creamy.
Stir the spinach into the tofu mixture. Divide the tofu mixture evenly between the prepared muffin tin. Cook in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes until cooked through and lightly browned on top.
Let cool for ten minutes and then remove and place on a cooling rack. Serve and enjoy!

name: Dill Pickle Tofu Bites with Ranch Dip
ingredients:
16 ozs
Tofu (extra-firm, pressed, torn)
3 tbsps
Pickle Brine (divided)
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil
3 tbsps
Arrowroot Powder
2 tsps
Onion Powder (divided)
2 tsps
Garlic Powder (divided)
2 tsps
Dried Dill (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Unsweetened Coconut Yogurt
recipe:
Preheat the air fryer to 400ºF (205ºC).
Place the tofu into a large bowl. Toss with 2/3 of the pickle brine and oil. Add the arrowroot, half of the onion powder, half of the garlic powder, half of the dried dill, salt, and pepper. Gently toss until the tofu is coated.
Transfer the tofu to the air fryer basket. Cook for 13 to 15 minutes until crispy, flipping halfway through.
Meanwhile, combine the yogurt, remaining pickle brine, onion powder, garlic powder, and dried dill. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide the tofu evenly between plates. Serve with the yogurt dip, and enjoy!

name: Crispy Black Bean Tacos with Avocado Cilantro Sauce
ingredients:
2 tsps
Avocado Oil (divided)
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, diced)
3
Garlic (clove, minced)
2 tbsps
Tomato Paste
1 tbsp
Taco Seasoning
2 cups
Black Beans (cooked)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup
Lime Juice (divided)
12
Corn Tortilla (small)
4 ozs
Vegan Cheese Shreds
1
Avocado (medium)
1/2 cup
Cilantro
1/3 cup
Water
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 450ºF (230ºC).
Heat a pan over medium heat. Add half of the oil, then add the onion. Cook for four to five minutes until softened.
Reduce the heat to medium-low. Add the garlic, tomato paste, and taco seasoning. Cook for two to three minutes, stirring often, until fragrant and the tomato paste has deepened in color.
Add the black beans and mash into a thick paste, leaving some chunks for texture. Season with salt and pepper, and stir in half of the lime juice.
On one side of each tortilla, add some cheese and some of the bean mixture. Fold the other side of the tortilla over the filling, and press down with a spatula. Rub the remaining oil over both sides of the taco, and repeat with the remaining tortillas. Place on a baking sheet, and cook for five minutes per side until crispy and lightly browned.
Meanwhile, add the avocado, cilantro, remaining lime juice, and water to a blender. Blend until smooth, and season with salt and pepper.
Divide the tacos evenly between plates. Serve with the avocado sauce, and enjoy!

name: Cinnamon Roll Protein Bars
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
1 cup
Oat Flour
1 tsp
Cinnamon
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Almond Butter (runny)
3/4 cup
Raw Honey
1 tsp
Vanilla Extract
2 tbsps
Coconut Oil (melted)
recipe:
Line a loaf pan with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine the protein powder, oat flour, cinnamon, and salt.
Pour in the almond butter, honey, vanilla, and melted coconut oil. Mix well with a spatula until fully combined.
Transfer the protein mixture to the prepared loaf pan. Press down to smooth the top, and sprinkle with flaky salt if using. Refrigerate for two hours until firm.
Slice into bars and enjoy!

name: Chickpea Pasta with Mushrooms & Kale
ingredients:
8 ozs
Chickpea Pasta (dry)
1/4 cup
Water (reserved from cooking pasta)
1/4 cup
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 cups
Mushrooms (chopped)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
1/2 tsp
Chili Flakes
4 cups
Baby Kale
1/2 tsp
Dried Thyme

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 1/2 cups
Black Beans
recipe:
Cook the pasta according to package directions. Reserve some of the cooking water, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the mushrooms, garlic, and chili flakes. Cook, stirring, for two to three minutes until the mushrooms start to release their moisture.
Add the kale, thyme, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, for five minutes or until the vegetables are softened. Add the black beans. Cook for one minute until heated through.
Add the drained pasta to the pan. Pour in enough reserved pasta water to lightly coat everything. Toss well and cook for one minute until combined and hot.
Divide evenly between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Chili Cucumber & Edamame Salad
ingredients:
1
Cucumber (medium, sliced)
1 1/4 cups
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
2 stalks
Green Onion (sliced)
1/2 tsp
Ginger (fresh, minced)
1 tbsp
Rice Vinegar
1 1/2 tsps
Tamari
1 tsp
Sesame Oil
1 tbsp
Sweet Chili Sauce
2 tsps
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a large bowl or container. Toss well to combine. Enjoy!

name: Taco Lime Pepitas
ingredients:
1 cup
Pumpkin Seeds
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
1 tsp
Maple Syrup
2 tsps
Taco Seasoning
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 300ºF (150ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Add the seeds, lime juice, maple syrup, and taco seasoning to the prepared baking sheet. Stir until evenly coated.
Spread the seeds evenly across the pan. Cook in the oven for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring halfway through, until lightly browned. Let cool before serving. Enjoy!

name: No Bake Brownie Bars
ingredients:
3/4 cup
Almond Butter (runny)
1/4 cup
Maple Syrup
1 1/2 tsps
Vanilla Extract
1/2 cup
Chocolate Protein Powder
3 tbsps
Cocoa Powder
1/2 tsp
Sea Salt
1/2 cup
Dark Chocolate Chips
1 tsp
Coconut Oil
recipe:
Line the loaf pan with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine the almond butter, maple syrup, vanilla, protein powder, cocoa powder, and salt. Mix thoroughly until fully combined.
Transfer the mixture to the loaf pan. Press down to create a smooth top.
Melt the chocolate and coconut oil in a pan over low heat, or microwave in 30-second intervals.
Pour the chocolate over the protein mixture. Transfer to the freezer and freeze for 30 minutes until set. Slice into bars. Enjoy!

name: Loaded Black Bean Burgers with Avocado
ingredients:
1/4 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry, rinsed)
1 tbsp
Avocado Oil (divided)
1/2
Yellow Onion (medium, chopped)
2
Garlic (clove, minced)
1 tbsp
Taco Seasoning
1 3/4 cups
Black Beans (drained, rinsed)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
3/4 cup
Arugula
8 ozs
Whole Wheat Bun (toasted)
1
Avocado (sliced)
recipe:
Cook the rice according to the package directions. Set it aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat. Add half of the oil and let it warm. Once hot, add the onion and cook for four to five minutes until softened, stirring often. Stir in the garlic and taco seasoning, then reduce the heat to medium-low. Cook for one to two minutes until fragrant, stirring often. Remove from the heat.
Place the beans in a large bowl and mash half of them with a fork. Add the cooked rice, onion mixture, cilantro, salt, and pepper. Mix well. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Form the black bean mixture into equal patties. Rub the remaining oil on both sides of each patty. Transfer to the oven and cook for 25 minutes, flipping halfway through until they're browned and firm to the touch.
Place the arugula on the bottom bun and top with the patty and avocado. Repeat with the remaining buns and burgers. Enjoy!

name: Portobello Mushrooms, Vegetables & Rice
ingredients:
1/2 cup
Jasmine Rice (dry, rinsed)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 cups
Portobello Mushroom (sliced)
1
Red Bell Pepper (medium, sliced)
1
Zucchini (medium, sliced)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 tsp
Oregano (dried)
1/2 tsp
Dried Thyme
1 tsp
Lemon Juice
recipe:
Cook the rice according to package directions.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the mushrooms, bell pepper, and zucchini. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme. Sauté for five to seven minutes until the vegetables are tender but still slightly crisp.
Remove from the heat. Stir in the lemon juice.
Divide the sautéed vegetables evenly over the jasmine rice, and enjoy!

name: Edamame, Cabbage & Herb Tostadas
ingredients:
1/3 cup
Plain Greek Yogurt
1 tbsp
Lime Juice
2 tbsps
Cilantro (finely chopped)
1/4 tsp
Garlic Powder

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 cups
Green Cabbage (chopped)
2 cups
Frozen Edamame (thawed)
2 stalks
Green Onion (chopped)
1/8 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
8
Corn Tortilla (small)
recipe:
Combine the yogurt, lime juice, cilantro, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
In another bowl, combine the cabbage, edamame, and green onion. Stir in the yogurt sauce, and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat and spray with oil. Add the tortillas in batches and cook for two to three minutes per side until browned and slightly crispy.
Divide the tortillas evenly between plates and top each with the cabbage salad. Enjoy!

name: Sesame & TVP Cabbage Rolls
ingredients:
4 cups
Green Cabbage (medium, pulled apart into leaves)
1 cup
Textured Vegetable Protein (crumbs)
1/4 cup
Red Onion (sliced)
1
Carrot (medium, grated)
1/4 cup
Cilantro (chopped)
1 tbsp
Sesame Seeds (toasted)
1
Garlic (clove, minced)
3 tbsps
Coconut Aminos (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/16 oz
Avocado Oil Spray
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Fill a large pot with water and bring it to a boil. Add the cabbage leaves and simmer over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes until softened. Drain the leaves and set them aside to cool.
Meanwhile, place the textured vegetable protein in a bowl. Pour boiling water over it, cover, and let sit for 10 minutes until rehydrated.
Add the onion, carrot, TVP, cilantro, sesame seeds, garlic, and 1/3 of the coconut aminos. Stir well to combine. Season with salt and pepper.
Lay the cabbage leaf flat on a clean work surface. Place about two tablespoons of the filling along one edge. Roll tightly, folding in the sides as you go. Repeat with the remaining leaves and filling.
Place the cabbage rolls on a baking sheet and spray with oil. Cook in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown, flipping halfway through. Serve with the remaining coconut aminos. Enjoy!

name: Cauliflower, Couscous & Sweet Potato Salad with Green Tahini Sauce
ingredients:
2
Sweet Potato (medium, cubed)
1 head
Cauliflower (medium, cut into florets)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1/2 cup
Couscous (dry)
1/4 cup
Tahini
1/4 cup
Water
1
Lemon (medium, juiced)
1/2 cup
Parsley (chopped, divided)
2/3 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the sweet potato and cauliflower on the baking sheet. Drizzle with the oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat. Cook in the oven for 30 to 35 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, cook the couscous as per the package directions.
In a blender, combine the tahini, water, lemon juice, half of the parsley, salt, and pepper. Blend until smooth. Adjust the seasoning to taste.
In a large bowl, combine the roasted sweet potato, cauliflower, couscous, chickpeas, and remaining parsley. Toss gently. Season with salt and pepper if needed.
Drizzle the green tahini sauce over the salad. Divide evenly between bowls and enjoy!

name: Banana & Avocado Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup
Water
1/2
Avocado (medium)
1
Banana (medium, frozen)
1 tbsp
Macadamia Nuts
1 tsp
Raw Honey
1/2 tsp
Cinnamon
1/4 cup
Vanilla Protein Powder
recipe: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass, and enjoy!

name: Vegan Cajun Chickpea Pot Pie
ingredients:
1 1/2 tsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1
Yellow Onion (small, diced)
2
Sweet Potato (medium, cubed)
2
Zucchini (medium, chopped)
1 tbsp
Cajun Spice
1 cup
Vegetable Broth
1 cup
Chickpeas (cooked)
1/2 cup
Frozen Peas (thawed)
1 cup
Canned Coconut Milk (full fat)
1/4 cup
Parsley (chopped)
1 oz
Unbleached All Purpose Flour (plus more for dusting)
12 ozs
Vegan Puff Pastry (thawed)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 375ºF (190ºC).
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for two minutes until softened. Add the sweet potato and cook for five minutes or until slightly browned. Add the zucchini and cook for two minutes until tender.
Add the Cajun spice and stir. Pour in the broth, bring to a simmer, cover with a lid, and cook on low heat for 15 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and peas. Stir, then pour in the coconut milk and bring back to a simmer. Remove from the heat, stir in the parsley, and transfer the mixture to a deep baking dish.
Lightly dust a flat surface with flour. Roll out the puff pastry until it is slightly larger than the baking dish. Place the pastry over the top, fold the edges in as needed, and cut a few slits on top.
Cook in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Let cool slightly, divide evenly between plates, and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Roasted Artichoke Hearts
ingredients:
1 2/3 cups
Artichoke Hearts (from the jar, drained, halved)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp
Italian Seasoning

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
1 tbsp
Lemon Juice
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 400ºF (205ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, toss the artichoke hearts with the oil, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet. Cook in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes until golden and crisp on the edges.
Remove from the oven and drizzle with lemon juice. Toss gently and enjoy!

name: Tortilla Chips & Guacamole
ingredients:
1 cup
Corn Tortilla Chips
1/2 cup
Guacamole
recipe: Place the tortilla chips evenly in a bowl or on a plate. Serve with the guacamole on the side. Enjoy!

name: Rhubarb Lemonade
ingredients:
6 1/2 cups
Water
1/2 cup
Cane Sugar
4 1/2 cups
Rhubarb (coarsely chopped)
1
Lemon (medium, juiced)
12
Ice Cubes (or as needed)
recipe:
In a large pot, bring the water and sugar to a boil, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Add the rhubarb and return to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for five minutes until softened.
Remove from the heat and strain into a bowl. Let the mixture sit for 10 minutes without pressing the pulp. Transfer to a pitcher. Stir in the lemon juice and refrigerate for two hours or until well chilled. Alternatively, pour over a lot of ice to immediately chill. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Sweet Potato with Feta & Honey
ingredients:
3
Sweet Potato (medium, sliced into rounds)
1 tbsp
Extra Virgin Olive Oil

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
2 tsps
Honey
1/3 cup
Feta Cheese (crumbled)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the sweet potatoes on a large baking sheet. Toss with the oil, and season with salt and pepper. Cook in the oven for 22 to 25 minutes until cooked through, flipping halfway.
Transfer the sweet potatoes to a serving dish. Drizzle with honey and scatter the feta over top. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Roasted Potatoes & Broccolini
ingredients:
4 cups
Mini Potatoes (halved)
2 tbsps
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided)

Sea Salt & Black Pepper (to taste)
12 ozs
Broccolini
1/4 cup
Parmigiano Reggiano (grated)
recipe:
Preheat the oven to 425ºF (220ºC). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the potatoes on the baking sheet. Toss with half of the oil, salt, and pepper. Transfer to the oven and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the broccolini to the baking sheet and toss with the remaining oil, salt, and pepper. Use your hands to mix well. Return the baking sheet to the oven and cook for 15 minutes until tender.
Sprinkle the parmesan over the potatoes and broccolini. Place back in the oven and cook for five minutes until melted. Enjoy!

name: "BLT" Sandwich (Balanced)
ingredients: 1 leaf inner Lettuce green leaf raw; 1/2 tomato Tomatoes orange raw; 1 1/2 serving Bacon style rashers by veggie delights; 2 slice, large White bread; 1 tbsp Organic vegan mayo by 365
recipe: 1) Toast bread, and cook veggie bacon according to package instructions. 2) Assemble sandwich by spreading vegan mayo on bread, topping with thinly sliced tomato, lettuce and veggie bacon.

name: "BLT" Sandwich (Low Carb)
ingredients: 2 slice Low-carb bread; 1 leaf inner Lettuce green leaf raw; 2 serving Bacon style rashers by veggie delights; 1 tbsp Organic vegan mayo by 365; 1/2 tomato Tomatoes orange raw
recipe: 1) Toast bread, and cook veggie bacon according to package instructions. 2) Assemble sandwich by spreading vegan mayo on bread, topping with thinly sliced tomato, lettuce and veggie bacon.

name: "BLT" Sandwich (Low Fat)
ingredients: 2 slice Low-carb bread; 1 tsp Light canola mayo eggless vegan by spectrum; 1/2 tomato Tomatoes orange raw; 1 leaf inner Lettuce green leaf raw; 3 serving Bacon style rashers by veggie delights
recipe: 1) Toast the bread and cook veggie bacon according to package instructions. 2) Assemble the sandwich by spreading vegan mayo on bread and topping it with thinly sliced tomato, lettuce and veggie bacon.

name: "Green-A-Colada" Smoothie (High Protein)
ingredients: 1/3 cup Coconut milk canned light; 3 tbsp, ground Flaxseeds; 2/3 cup Water; 1 cup Pineapple chunks frozen; 1 1/2 scoop Generic Pea Protein Powder; 2 cup Spinach all varieties raw; 2 oz Frozen banana
recipe: 1) Blend all ingredients in a blender until smooth. Serve immediately.

name: "Green-A-Colada" Smoothie (Low Carb)
ingredients: Flaxseeds whole; Water; Coconut milk canned light; Spinach; Pineapple chunks frozen; Frozen banana; Coconut milk beverage unsweetened; Generic Pea Protein Powder
recipe: 1) Blend all ingredients in a blender until smooth. Serve immediately.

name: "Green-A-Colada" Smoothie (Low Fat)
ingredients: Ground Flaxseeds; Water; Coconut milk canned light; Pineapple chunks frozen; Frozen banana; Spinach all varieties raw; Generic Pea Protein Powder; Coconut milk beverage unsweetened
recipe: 1) Blend all ingredients in a blender until smooth. Serve immediately.

name: Air Popped Popcorn
ingredients: 0.1 tsp Salt; 55 g (1.94 oz) Snacks popcorn unpopped kernels
recipe: 1) Add kernels to a preheated deep pot with a lid over medium heat. Shake pot for about 2 minutes, or until all kernels are popped

name: Almond Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 cup (310 g) Brussels sprouts frozen boiled with salt; 2 tbsp Liquid aminos natural soy sauce alternative by bragg; 15 g (0.53 oz) Blanched almonds
recipe: 1) Halve the Brussels sprouts, place them in a bowl, and add the liquid aminos. Toss to combine well. 2) Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the Brussels sprouts and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender, and remove from the fire. 3) Serve on a plate, sprinkle with almonds, and enjoy warm!

name: Almond Mousse With Cherries
ingredients: 2 tsp Blanched almonds; 100 g (3.53 oz) Cherries sweet raw; 150 g (5.29 oz) Tofu soft made with nigari; 2 tsp Honey; 1 tsp Almond extract
recipe: 1) Halve the cherries and remove the pit. 2) In a food processor, add the tofu, almond extract, and honey. Blend until smooth. 3) Pour the almond mousse into a glass or container, add the cherries, blanched almonds, and cover with a lid. 4) Place it in the fridge overnight, and enjoy the next morning!

name: Apple - Cinnamon Mousse
ingredients: 1/4 cup (22 g) Apples dried; 1 tsp Cinnamon ground; 1/4 cup (61 g) Almond milk; 12 oz (340 g) Tofu soft silken; 3 tbsp Maple syrup sugar free
recipe: 1) Blend all the ingredients. Add cinnamon to taste. 2) Transfer into a small container, and place the lid. 3) Fridge for at least 3 hours or overnight for the consistency of the mousse.

name: Apple and Peanut Butter
ingredients: 4 tsp Peanut butter smooth without salt; 1 medium, about 2.5" diameter Apples with skin raw
recipe: 1) Slice apple, and serve with peanut butter on the side

name: Apple Kiwi Smoothie
ingredients: 200 g (7.05 oz) Kiwi fruit raw; 15 g (0.53 oz) Spinach all varieties raw; 40 g (1.41 oz) Generic Pea Protein Powder; 2 1/2 tbsp Hemp seeds shelled or hulled; 1/2 large, about 3" diameter Apples with skin raw; 300 ml Almond milk
recipe: 1) Peel and chop the kiwi and the apple. 2) In a blender, add all the ingredients and blend until smooth. 3) Pour into a glass, and enjoy!

name: Apple Pie Chia Pudding
ingredients: 1 scoop Protein powder, soy based; 1 tsp Cinnamon ground; 1 cup (243 g) Soy milk unsweetened fortified; 1/3 cup (84 g) Applesauce canned sweetened with salt; 3 1/2 tbsp Chia seeds
recipe: 1) In a blender, add the applesauce, soy milk, protein powder, and cinnamon. Blend until smooth. 2) Pour the mixture into a glass, then stir in the chia seeds. 3) Place in the fridge overnight and enjoy the next day!

name: Apple Smoothie
ingredients: 400 ml Organic unsweetened cashew milk by plenish; 1/2 tsp Cinnamon; 1 medium Apple; 2 1/2 serving Vanilla protein by pure paleo
recipe: 1) Chop the apple, place it in a bowl, and sprinkle with cinnamon. Microwave for 2 -4 minutes until blended. 2) Blend all the ingredients and add ice. 3) Enjoy!

name: Apricot Coconut Smoothie
ingredients: 2 1/2 tbsp Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked; 1 tsp Cinnamon ground; 1 scoop Generic Pea Protein Powder; 3/4 cup (182 g) Coconut milk beverage unsweetened; 1/4 cup (60 g) Coconut milk raw; 13 oz (369 g) Apricots raw
recipe: 1) Blend all the ingredients with ice and enjoy! 2) Option: add zero-calorie maple syrup or non-caloric sweetener.

name: Asian Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup (93 g) Rice white cooked without salt; 1/3 cup (50 g) Vegetables cabbage kimchi; 5 piece whole Mushrooms shiitake fresh; 1/2 cup slices (52 g) Cucumber with peel raw; 1/3 cup, grated Carrots raw; 1 tsp Sesame seed kernels (shelled) dried; 60 g (2.12 oz) Textured vegetable protein by bob's red mill; 1 tbsp Sriracha or hot chile sauce; 15 ml Vegan mayonnaise; 1 sheet Seaweed Nori dried
recipe: 1) Prepare the textured vegetable protein according to the package instructions. 2) Slice the cucumber into half-moon slices. Slice the shiitake mushrooms, and cook them in a non-stick pan over medium heat until soft. recipe: 1) Peel and chop the potato into bite-sized pieces, slice the green onion, chop the red pepper into medium cubes and chop the carrot into smaller pieces. 2) Place the potatoes, tofu, carrots, and just half of the green onions in a bowl, and add the cajun seasoning, garlic powder, and salt. 3) Place the steamer rack inside the IP, and add all the ingredients you used in the previous bowl. 4) Set pressure and cook on high pressure for 3 minutes; after cooking, allow 1-3 minutes of natural pressure release before opening the lid. 5) Transfer into a bowl and add the red bell pepper, mustard vinaigrette, and vegan cream cheese and toss to combine, taste to adjust salt and cajun seasoning. Complete by decorating with the rest of the green onion.

recipe: 1) Soak the dates in hot water for a few minutes, then drain them. 2) In a food processor, add the tofu, dates, tahini, turmeric, ginger, and pepper. Blend until smooth and add water if needed. 3) Pour the mixture into a container, cover it with a lid, and refrigerate overnight. Enjoy the next morning!

name: Golden Milk Overnight Oats (Balanced)
ingredients: 3/4 cup (61 g) Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked; 1 cup (8 fl oz) (237 g) Water; 1 1/2 cup (148 g) Pure vanilla almond milk unsweetened; 1 tsp Organic golden milk super blend by sunfood super foods; 1/8 cup, chopped (14 g) Pecans raw; 1 scoop Generic Pea Protein Powder; 1 packet Sweetener
recipe: 1) Blend the protein with the almond milk and sweetener. 2) Place the rolled oats in a jar or container, add the water and almond milk, and mix. Allow it to cool down a bit. 3) Place the pecans on top. Close the container and fridge overnight.

name: Golden Milk Overnight Oats (Low Carb)
