recipe: 1) Blend the protein with the almond milk and sweetener. 2) Place the rolled oats in a jar or container, add the water and almond milk, and mix. Allow it to cool down a bit. 3) Place the pecans on top. Close the container and fridge overnight.

name: Golden Milk Parfait
ingredients: 1/3 cup (34 g) Granola; 2 tsp Hemp seeds shelled or hulled; 2 tsp Golden milk by gaia; 1 cup (254 g) Greek style yogurt dairy free vanilla unsweetened by kite hill
recipe: 1) Mix the yogurt with the golden milk. 2) Place half of the blueberries in the glass or container, then add half of the granola and the yogurt mixture. 3) Finish by adding the remaining blueberries, granola, and hemp seeds.

name: Greek Meatballs Bowl
ingredients: 2 cup (60 g) Spinach; 1/2 cup (93 g) Rice white cooked without salt; 100 g (3.53 oz) Feta cheese; 1 tbsp Olive oil; 200 g (7.05 oz) Meatballs made from soy
recipe: 1) Heat a non-stick pan and add the olive oil. 2) Place the meatballs in the pan and cook, stirring occasionally until golden. 3) Cook the rice according to the package instructions. 4) Prepare the bowl with the rice and spinach and the cooked meatballs. 5) Top with the feta cheese and enjoy!

name: Green Beans With Mushrooms
ingredients: 150 g (5.29 oz) Green beans frozen microwaved; 1 1/2 tsp Sesame oil; 1 clove Garlic raw; 1 tsp Sesame seeds; 300 g (10.58 oz) Mushrooms brown raw; 3 tbsp Liquid aminos natural soy sauce alternative by bragg
recipe: 1) Mince the garlic. 2) Heat the sesame oil over medium heat and add the minced garlic. Stir well. 3) Add the green beans, mushrooms, and a pinch of salt. Cook until the mushrooms are soft. 4) Add the liquid aminos and mix well. 5) Serve on a plate, sprinkle sesame seeds on top, and enjoy!

name: Green Chia Pudding (Low Carb)
ingredients: 4 tbsp Chia seeds; 1 1/2 tbsp Cashews raw; 1 cup (245 g) Cashew milk unsweetened; 35 g (1.23 oz) Vanilla protein by pure paleo; 1 cup (30 g) Spinach
recipe: 1) Blend the spinach, milk and protein. 2) Transfer into a cup or container and mix with chia seeds. Fridge overnight. 3) Use your favorite plant-based milk.

name: Green Collagen Smoothie
ingredients: 2 1/2 scoop Collagen; 1 1/2 cup (365 g) Coconut milk beverage unsweetened; 1 1/2 cup (45 g) Spinach; 3/4 cup, diced (116 g) Pineapple
recipe: 1) Blend all the ingredients with ice and enjoy!

name: Green Goddess Smoothie
ingredients: 1/2 cup, pared, chopped Cucumber peeled raw; 3/4 cup, cubes (113 g) Avocados raw; 1 scoop Generic Pea Protein Powder; 1 cup (243 g) Soy milk unsweetened fortified; 1 cup, chopped (67 g) Kale raw; 1/2 cup, sliced (83 g) Mango raw
recipe: 1) Blend all the ingredients with ice and enjoy! 2) Option: add zero-calorie maple syrup or non-caloric sweetener.

name: Green Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup (30 g) Spinach; 1 cup (243 g) Coconut milk beverage unsweetened; 1 cup, pared, chopped Cucumber peeled raw; 2 scoop Collagen; 1/3 cup, cubes (50 g) Avocado
recipe: 1) Blend all the ingredients with ice and enjoy!

name: Green-A-Colada Smoothie (Balanced)
ingredients: ground Flaxseeds; Water; Generic Pea Protein Powder; Frozen banana; Spinach all varieties raw; Pineapple chunks frozen; Coconut milk canned light
recipe: 1) Blend all ingredients in a blender until smooth. Serve immediately.

name: Grilled Pesto Sandwich
ingredients: 100 g (3.53 oz) French vienna or sourdough bread; 80 g (2.82 oz) Peppers sweet bell red raw; 10 g (0.35 oz) Spinach all varieties raw; 120 g (4.23 oz) Tofu extra firm made with nigari; 4 tsp Basil pesto; 60 g (2.12 oz) Eggplant raw
recipe: 1) Halve the bread and toast the slices. 2) Prepare the ingredients: slice the eggplant and red bell pepper. Slice the tofu lengthwise. 3) Preheat a grill pan on medium heat. Spray with vegetable oil, then grill the tofu, eggplant, and bell pepper for 2–3 minutes per side, until lightly golden. 4) Spread the pesto on the toasted bread. Layer with spinach, grilled tofu, eggplant, and bell pepper. 5) Close the sandwich, serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Havana Style Bowl
ingredients: 1/3 cup (79 g) Black beans canned; 3/4 cup (140 g) Cooked white rice; 1 tablespoon Nutritional yeast seasoning; 1 tablespoon Vegetable oil; 6 oz (170 g) Tofu firm made with nigari; 1/3 tsp Paprika
recipe: 1) Chop the tofu and transfer it to a bowl; add oil, salt and paprika to taste. Mix well 2) Heat a nonstick pan and cook the tofu for 3 to 5 minutes or until golden. 3) Drain the beans. Next, assemble the bowl, serve the rice, beans, and tofu and top with nutritional yeast.

name: High Protein Bowl
ingredients: 2 scoop Generic Pea Protein Powder; 1 tbsp Vanilla extract; 1 1/2 cup, sliced Mango; 2 cup Vanilla almond milk; 1 cup Ice cubes; 2 tbsp Organic spirulina blue-green algae by organika
recipe: 1) Blend the protein with spirulina, vanilla-almond milk, vanilla extract, and two cups of ice cubes. 2) Serve in a medium bowl, place the mango slices on top.

name: Holiday Stew (Balanced)
ingredients: Salt and Pepper, to taste; Liquid aminos by bragg; Sweet potato; Walnuts; Portobello mushroom caps; Onions raw
recipe: 1) Peel and cut the sweet potato into cubes, chop the portobello mushroom, and prepare the other ingredients. 2) Boil the sweet potato cubes until they are fork-tender. 3) Heat a pan, spray the oil, add the onions, and cook for a few minutes. Next, add the portobello, plant-based beef, walnuts, salt and pepper to taste and complete by adding the liquid amino. Combine. 4) Once the sweet potato is ready, incorporate it with the stew and mix.

ingredients: 1/3 cup (61 g) Cooked quinoa without salt; 3 cup, chopped (201 g) Kale raw; 1/3 cup, chopped (49 g) Red bell pepper; 1 tablespoon Nutritional yeast seasoning; 4 oz (113 g) Avocados raw; 3/4 cup (180 g) Black beans canned
recipe: 1) Drain the beans. Next, mix all the ingredients in a bowl, except for the avocado, and season it with salt and pepper to taste. 2) Transfer to a serving plate and finish by adding the avocado slices 3) Option: squeeze lemon juice

name: Kale Chips
ingredients: 1 tsp Salt; 1 1/2 tablespoon Olive oil; 1 cup, chopped (67 g) Kale raw
recipe: 1) Preheat oven to 350F. 2) Cut kale leaves off of stems, and cut into bite-sized pieces. 3) Toss kale with olive oil and salt, then arrange on a baking tray, with space between each leaf. 4) Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, until lightly browned and crisp, but not burnt.

name: Kale Salad With Tofu
ingredients: 1 tsp Minced garlic; 220 g (7.76 oz) Tofu firm made with nigari; 1/2 cup, grated Carrots raw; 1/2 cup, sliced (44 g) Fennel bulb raw; 1 cup, chopped (89 g) Cabbage red raw; 2 cup, chopped (134 g) Kale raw; 1 tsp Olive oil; 1/2 cup (82 g) Chickpeas or garbanzo beans boiled with salt
recipe: 1) In a bowl, combine the kale, red cabbage, fennel, carrot, and chickpeas. 2) For the dressing, blend the tofu, olive oil, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt. Blend until smooth. 3) Drizzle the tofu dressing over the salad, toss to combine, and enjoy!

name: Kale Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup (30 g) Kale raw; 1 1/2 cup (243 g) Soy milk unsweetened fortified; 1 scoop Generic Pea Protein Powder; 3 tbsp Hemp seeds shelled or hulled; 1 medium Banana
recipe: 1) In a blender, add all the ingredients and blend until smooth. 2) Pour into a glass, and enjoy!

name: Kale Tomato Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 cup (164 g) Corn sweet yellow canned; 2 1/2 tsp Olive oil; 2 tablespoon Nutritional yeast seasoning; 1/3 cup drained, rinsed Chickpeas or garbanzo beans canned; 1 1/2 cup, chopped or sliced Tomatoes red raw; 3 cup, chopped (201 g) Kale raw
recipe: 1) Prepare the ingredients according to their description, and drain the corn. 2) Mix all the ingredients in a bowl, add salt to taste and enjoy!

name: Kimchi Noodles
ingredients: 1 tsp Sesame seed kernels (shelled) dried; 1 tbsp chopped Onions green spring or scallions raw; 90 g (3.17 oz) Ground beef baked 85% lean 15% fat; 2 tbsp Soy sauce; 1/4 cup (38 g) Vegetables cabbage kimchi; 70 g (2.47 oz) Noodles rice dry uncooked
recipe: 1) Cook the noodles according to the package instructions. Once ready, drain the excess water and set aside. 2) Meanwhile, chop the kimchi. 3) Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, then add the ground beef and soy sauce. Season with a pinch of salt and cook, stirring occasionally. Before the beef is fully browned, add the kimchi, mix, and continue cooking until the beef is fully done 4) Turn off the heat, add the noodles to the pan, and mix well. 5) Serve on a plate, top with green onions, sprinkle the sesame seeds, and enjoy!

name: Kimchi Scramble Tofu With Rice
ingredients: 2/3 cup (125 g) Rice white cooked without salt; 1 tsp Seeds sesame whole dried; 1/2 tsp Turmeric ground; 1 tbsp Soy sauce; 1 clove Garlic raw; 1 cup (150 g) Vegetables cabbage kimchi; 1 tsp Olive oil; 1 tbsp chopped Onions green spring or scallions raw; 250 g (8.82 oz) Tofu firm made with nigari
recipe: 1) Heat a non-stick pan and cook the scrambled eggs on medium heat. Next, add the kimchi after 2 minutes and combine well. 2) In a non-stick pan, add the cooked rice noodles and soy sauce. Mix well and set aside. 3) In the same pan or another, heat the oil over medium heat, and add the minced garlic. 4) Add the tofu into the pan and crumble it into small pieces using a spatula. Sprinkle salt and turmeric evenly over the scramble. Next, add the kimchi and stir well. 5) Prepare the plate, serve the rice noodles, and top with the scrambled eggs. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Kimchi Tofu Noodles
ingredients: 3 tbsp Soy sauce; 180 g (6.35 oz) Cooked rice noodles; 40 g (1.41 oz) Vegan cheese; 1 tbsp chopped Onions green spring or scallions raw; 1 clove Garlic raw; 1 tsp Sesame seed kernels (shelled) dried; 1/2 cup (75 g) Vegetables cabbage kimchi; 1 tsp Paprika; 200 g (7.05 oz) Tofu firm made with nigari
recipe: 1) Mince the garlic, tofu, and green onion. 2) Heat a pan over medium heat, and add the onion, garlic, and tofu. Cook for a few minutes until the onion is soft. Add the paprika and soy sauce, and combine well. 3) Add the cooked rice noodles and kimchi to the pan. Let them heat through and stir to combine. 4) Serve on a plate, top with vegan cheese. 5) Garnish with green onions, sesame seeds, and enjoy warm!

name: Kiwi Chia Pudding Plant-Based
ingredients: 1 cup (243 g) Soy milk unsweetened fortified; 3 1/2 tbsp Chia seeds; 160 g (5.64 oz) Kiwi fruit raw; 1/4 cup (36 g) Blueberries raw; 1 tsp Honey; 1 scoop Generic Pea Protein Powder
recipe: 1) In a blender, combine the soy milk, protein powder, and honey. Blend until smooth. 2) Pour into a glass or container. 3) Peel and chop the kiwi into cubes, then place it in the blender and puree until smooth. 4) Add the kiwi puree into the container, close with a lid, and refrigerate overnight. 5) Next morning, add the blueberries on top and enjoy!

name: Lentil Spread Wrap
ingredients: 1/4 cup (50 g) Boiled lentils with salt; 1/2 medium Red bell pepper; 1/4 cup, pureed (58 g) Avocados raw; 1 tortilla (approx 10" dia) Tortillas white flour; 2 tablespoon Nutritional yeast seasoning; 1 cup (30 g) Spinach all varieties raw
recipe: 1) Drain the lentils to remove any excess liquid. Finely chop the bell pepper. Place the drained lentils and chopped bell pepper in a blender. Add the nutritional yeast and paprika. Blend for a few seconds until a creamy consistency is reached. 2) Prepare the wrap: Spread the avocado on the tortilla, then place the spinach leaves and lentils on top. Wrap and enjoy

name: Lime Pie Smoothie (High Protein)
ingredients: 4 fruit Limes; 2 tbsp Hemp seeds; 1 packet Sweetener; 1 1/2 cup Almond milk; 2 scoop Generic Pea Protein Powder
recipe: 1) Add in a blender, almond milk, protein, and sweetener. Squeeze in the limes and add ice cubes 2) Blend until smooth and taste to adjust the lime flavor. Serve and place the hemp seeds on top.

name: Liquid Carrot Cake (Low Carb)

name: Mac and Cheese Silken Tofu
ingredients: 6 oz (170 g) Cooked spaghetti or pasta, white, with salt; 2/3 block Tofu soft silken; 1 tablespoon Nutritional yeast seasoning; 1 tsp Mustard dijon; 2 tsp Vegan butter spread; 1/2 tsp Sugar
recipe: 1) Blend the tofu, mustard, nutritional yeast, and sugar until the sauce looks silky and smooth. Taste and then adjust salt, sugar, or dijon as desired. Option: Add some paprika to give it a special flavour. 2) Add the vegan butter to the hot pasta, toss to coat and then pour over the cheese sauce and toss again. Enjoy!

name: Mango Blueberry Smoothie (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1/2 cup, sliced (83 g) Mango; 1 1/2 cup (368 g) Almond milk; 3 oz (85 g) Blueberries frozen; 1 tbsp Chia seeds; 3 serving Vanilla protein by pure paleo
recipe: 1) Blend the Mango with two servings of protein, one cup of milk, and chia. Serve in a glass. 2) Next, blend the frozen blueberries with the remaining milk and protein. 3) Add the blueberry mix on top of the mango smoothie, and enjoy! 4) Use your favorite plant-based milk.

name: Mango Chia Pudding
ingredients: 1 scoop Protein powder, soy based; 1 tsp Vanilla extract; 1 cup, sliced (165 g) Mango raw; 1 cup (245 g) Almond milk; 4 tbsp Chia seeds
recipe: 1) Peel and chop the mango. 2) In a blender, add the chopped mango, almond milk, protein powder, and vanilla extract. Blend until smooth. 3) Pour the mixture into a glass, then stir in the chia seeds. 4) Place in the fridge overnight and enjoy the next day!

name: Matcha Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup (243 g) Coconut milk beverage unsweetened; 1 1/2 tsp Matcha green tea powder by sprouts; 1 scoop Vanilla raw vegan protein by sunwarrior; 6 tbsp Maple syrup sugar free; 6.5 oz (184 g) Raspberries raw; 2.1 oz (60 g) Chia seeds
recipe: 1) Blend the coconut milk with matcha and protein powder until smooth. Refrigerate overnight or until the mixture reaches a pudding-like consistency. 3) Place the raspberries and maple syrup in a bowl. Mash and combine them with a fork until you achieve a smooth puree. 4) Transfer half of the matcha pudding into a cup. Place the raspberry puree on top, and then add the remaining pudding to complete

recipe: 1) Chop the tofu into small cubes. 2) In a bowl, add the kale, quinoa, tomatoes, tofu, and olives. 3) Drizzle the lemon juice and olive oil. Toss to combine, and enjoy!

name: Mexican Cauliflower Rice with Sausage (Balanced)
ingredients: 2 small whole (2-2/5" dia) Tomatoes red raw; 2 cloves Garlic raw; 1/2 medium (2-1/2" dia) Onions raw; 1 tsp Olive oil; 2 1/2 tbsp Tomato paste canned; 2 cup (218 g) Cauliflower riced frozen unprepared; 1 serving Italian sausage vegan by tofurky; 1 pepper Peppers jalapeno raw; 1/2 tsp Paprika; 1/2 tbsp Cumin seed ground or whole; 2 oz (57 g) Corn sweet yellow canned
recipe: 1) Warm oil in a pan over medium-high heat, and toss in diced tomatoes, minced jalapeno, and diced onion. Sauté the mixture for about 3 minutes 2) Add minced garlic, cauliflower, and corn, cooking until tender, about three more minutes. 3) Add tomato paste and spices, stirring to coat. Top with freshly chopped cilantro. 4) Cook sausage according to package instructions and serve with cauliflower rice.

Transfer to a bowl and add 1/2 scoop of the protein, baking powder, and 1/2 tsp of cinnamon, and mix thoroughly. 3) Next, add 2 tbsp. of chopped walnuts, the grated carrot, half of the almond milk, and stir gently to combine. 4) Take a cup and spray the inside with a non-stick spray. name: Miso Soup
ingredients: 4 cup (884 g) Vegetable broth; 3 tbsp Miso paste white; 40 g (1.41 oz) Carrots raw; 500 g (17.64 oz) Mori-nu tofu silken soft; 30 ml Soy sauce; 20 g (0.71 oz) Seaweed wakame raw; 2 medium (4-1/8" long) Onions green spring or scallions raw
recipe: 1) Slice the green onions and carrots. Chop the tofu. 2) Pour the vegetable broth into a pot, and bring to a boil. 3) Add the miso paste to the pot, and stir well until it dissolves into the broth. 4) Next, stir in the carrots, green onions, and wakame seaweed. recipe: 1) Place the peanut butter in a small bowl and mix in the pumpkin puree, pumpkin pie spice until well combined. 2) Roll into balls, top with pumpkin seeds, and enjoy

name: Quinoa Breakfast Bowl
ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp Peanut butter; 1/2 tsp Cinnamon; 1/3 cup Quinoa uncooked; 1/2 cup Pure vanilla almond milk unsweetened; 2 scoop Generic Pea Protein Powder
recipe: 1) Place the quinoa into a small saucepan, add one cup of water and bring to a boil. 2) Once it's thoroughly cooked add the cinnamon, almond milk, and protein. Mix well. 3) Transfer into a small bowl and complete by adding the peanut butter on top.

name: Raspberry - Avocado Smoothie
ingredients: 3 oz (85 g) Avocados raw; 1 3/4 cup (215 g) Raspberries raw; 12 g (0.42 oz) Dates medjool; 1 cup (245 g) Cashew milk unsweetened; 1 scoop Protein powder, soy based
recipe: 1) Blend all the ingredients with ice and enjoy! 2) Option: add zero-calorie maple syrup or non-caloric sweetener.

name: Raspberry Banana Smoothie (Balanced)
ingredients: 1 cup (123 g) Raspberries raw; 30 g (1.06 oz) Generic Pea Protein Powder; 1 1/2 tbsp Peanut butter; 1 cup (245 g) Almond milk unsweetened fortified; 1 medium Banana
recipe: 1) Blend all ingredients until smooth.

name: Raspberry Protein Yogurt Bowl (High Protein)
ingredients: Peanut butter smooth reduced fat; Protein powder soy based; Raspberries; Chocolate chips vegan; Simply plain dairy free yogurt by silk
recipe: 1) Add the yogurt and protein to a bowl and whip until smooth. 2) Next, top with raspberries and chocolate chips. Garnish with peanut butter on top. (Microwave the peanut butter until melted to spread easily).

name: Rice Cakes with Almond Butter
ingredients: 4 tsp Almond butter without salt; 3 cake Rice cake
recipe: 1) Spread rice cakes with almond butter, serve.

name: Roasted Veggies Bowl With Tofu Dressing
ingredients: 180 g (6.35 oz) Zucchini raw; 180 g (6.35 oz) Carrots raw; 1/2 cup (93 g) Cooked quinoa without salt; 1 tsp Ghee clarified butter; 1 tbsp Curry powder; 1/3 cup (54 g) Chickpeas or garbanzo beans boiled with salt; 250 g (8.82 oz) Tofu soft made with nigari
recipe: 1) Preheat the air fryer to 180°C for 5 minutes. 2) Melt the ghee, then add the chickpeas to a bowl and drizzle with the ghee. 3) Add the zucchini, carrots, and chickpeas to the air fryer. Cook until the veggies are tender. 4) Meanwhile, in a food processor, add the tofu, curry powder, and salt. Blend until smooth. 5) Assemble the bowl: add the cooked quinoa, chickpeas, and roasted veggies. Pour the tofu dressing in the center, and enjoy!

name: Salted Caramel Pudding
ingredients: 1/4 cup (48 g) Chia seeds; 1 tbsp Meenut butter by paleo; 1 1/2 scoop Paleo protein salted caramel by amy myers md; 1/2 cup (119 g) Black Coffee; 1 cup (245 g) Cashew milk unsweetened
recipe: 1) Blend black coffee with cashew milk, butter, and protein. 2) Transfer into a container. Next, mix with chia seeds, place the lid, and fridge overnight. 3) Use your favorite plant-based milk.

name: Salted Dark Chocolate Dipped Oranges
ingredients: 1/3 cup (58 g) Dark chocolate chunks or chips 60 - 69% cacao; 1/4 tsp Sea salt non-iodized; 3 large (3-1/16" dia) Oranges raw
recipe: 1) Line a tray with parchment paper. Peel and divide the oranges into segments. 2) Slowly melt the chocolate chips over a double boiler, or in the microwave (in 10 second increments). 3) Dip each orange segment halfway up into the dark chocolate, then place on the baking tray to cool. 4) While the chocolate is still melted, lightly sprinkle each segment with a pinch of sea salt or coarse salt. 5) Store in the fridge. [Note: macros are per 3 servings]

name: Sausages with Cinnamon Sweet Potato Mash and Mixed Veggies (Balanced)
ingredients: 1 sausage Mexican chipotle vegan sausages by field roast; 250 g (8.82 oz) Frozen mixed vegetables by parade; 1 tsp Olive oil; 2 tsp Cinnamon ground; ½ cup, cubes (67 g) Sweet potato raw
recipe: 1) Start by bringing a large pot of water to a bowl. 2) Add chopped, peeled, sweet potato, and boil for 15 minutes, or until completely soft. 3) Then, add frozen mixed vegetables, or fresh chopped vegetables to boiling water and cook until heated through. 4) Meanwhile, sear a vegan sausage in a frying pan according to package directions. 5) Mash sweet potato in a bowl with olive oil, cinnamon, and salt to taste.

name: Sausages with Cinnamon Sweet Potato Mash and Mixed Veggies (Low Carb)
ingredients: 2 tsp Cinnamon ground; 1½ tablespoon Olive oil; 1 sausage Mexican chipotle vegetarian grain meat sausages by field roast; 75 g (2.65 oz) Frozen mixed vegetables by parade; ⅓ sweetpotato, 5" long Sweet potato raw
recipe: 1) Start by bringing a large pot of water to a bowl. 2) Add chopped, peeled, sweet potato, and boil for 15 minutes, or until completely soft. 3) Then, add frozen mixed vegetables, or fresh chopped vegetables to boiling water and cook until heated through. 4) Meanwhile, sear a vegan sausage in a frying pan according to package directions. 5) Mash sweet potato in a bowl with olive oil, cinnamon, and salt to taste.

name: Sausages with Cinnamon Sweet Potato Mash and Mixed Veggies (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1½ sausage Mexican chipotle vegetarian grain meat sausages by field roast; 100 g (3.53 oz) Frozen mixed vegetables by parade; 1 tsp Olive oil; 2 tsp Cinnamon ground; ½ sweetpotato, 5" long Sweet potato raw
recipe: 1) Start by bringing a large pot of water to a bowl. 2) Add chopped, peeled, sweet potato, and boil for 15 minutes, or until completely soft. 3) Then, add frozen mixed vegetables, or fresh chopped vegetables to boiling water and cook until heated through. 4) Meanwhile, sear a vegan sausage in a frying pan according to package directions. 5) Mash sweet potato in a bowl with olive oil, cinnamon, and salt to taste.

name: Sauteed Bok Choy
ingredients: 1 tbsp Rice vinegar; 1 1/2 cup, chopped (224 g) Peppers sweet bell red raw; 4 tbsp Liquid aminos natural soy sauce alternative by bragg; 14 oz (397 g) Bok choy or pak choi or Chinese cabbage raw; 1 1/2 tsp Sesame oil; 3 tsp, minced Garlic raw
recipe: 1) In a bowl, combine the red bell pepper, rice vinegar, and liquid aminos, and mix until well combined. 2) Heat a pan and add the sesame oil. Stir in the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 3) Add the seasoned red bell peppers and cook until softened. Once ready, add the bok choy and mix well. 4) Serve on a plate and enjoy warm!

name: Scramble Sweet Potato Pancakes (High Protein)
ingredients: 1 1/2 scoop Generic Pea Protein Powder; 1/2 cup (123 g) Almond milk; 1 tsp Pumpkin spice; 2 sprays, about 1/3 second each spray Vegetable cooking spray oil; 2 tsp Vanilla extract; 1 tbsp Peanut butter; 1 tbsp Chia seeds; 2 tsp Cinnamon; 2 tsp Baking powder; 1/2 cup, mashed Baked sweet potato
recipe: 1) Blend all the ingredients except for the peanut butter. 2) Spray vegetable oil into a hot skillet, place the pancake mix, and cook. 3) Crumble the pancake with the spatula and mix until it's done, for about 2-3 min on medium heat. 4) Transfer the scramble pancake into a bowl, and place the peanut butter on top. 5) Garnish with extra pumpkin spice on top.

name: Scrambled Eggs with Seitan Chorizo (High Protein)
ingredients: 1 cup (30 g) Spinach; ¼ cup, chopped (25 g) Green onion; 4 oz (113 g) Chorizo seitan by upton's naturals; ½ cup, chopped (75 g) Red bell pepper; ⅓ cup (176 g) Just egg; 1 serving Salt and Pepper, to taste; 1 slice Sourdough bread; 1 tsp Coconut oil
recipe: 1) Chop the red pepper into small cubes, chop the green onion, and cut the spinach into strips. 2) Heat a pan, and add the coconut oil, red pepper, and chorizo. Cook until the red pepper softens. Add 'just egg,' green onion, and spinach. Next, sprinkle salt and pepper to taste. Stir and cook for around 3 minutes. 3) Toast the bread. 4) Transfer the scrambled egg to a serving plate and add the bread.

name: Scrambled Pancakes (Balanced)
ingredients: 1/3 cup (41 g) Raspberries raw; 1 tsp Vegan butter spread; 1 1/2 cup (340 g) Protein vanilla plant-based yogurt by kite hill; 3/4 cup (184 g) Almond milk; 1 tbsp Chia seeds; 1 tsp Honey; 1/3 cup (31 g) Oat bran dry uncooked; 1/2 tsp Baking powder
recipe: 1) *Option: Use your favorite brand of: Plant-based protein powder; Plant-based milk sugar-free; Raw Honey/for low calories change for zero-calorie sweetener. 2) Blend the oats and transfer them into a small bowl. Add the chia seeds and baking powder and mix 3) Stir in the almond milk. (Optional: Add cinnamon and/or vanilla to make it tasty) 4) Add vegan butter to a hot pan, and add the batter. Scramble the pancake until it's done, for about 2-3 min on medium heat. 5) Transfer into a bowl, add the yogurt on the side and the raspberries. Drizzle the honey on top.

name: Seitan Bacon
ingredients: 4 slices Hickory and sage smoked seitan bacon by sweet earth
recipe: 1) Cook bacon style seitan until crispy, and enjoy as a snack!

name: Seitan Chorizo Quesadilla (High Protein)
ingredients: 1/4 cup Vegan mozzarella cheese shredded; 1 cup Spinach all varieties raw; 1/2 tsp Oregano leaves; 1/4 tsp Onion powder; 1 tsp Cumin; 1 tsp Paprika; 1 tsp Olive oil; 1/4 cup Bell Peppers chopped; 1/4 cup Onions chopped; 1 tortilla medium Tortilla; 125 g Chorizo seitan by upton's naturals
recipe: 1) Heat a pan over medium heat, and add olive oil. Cook chopped onions and peppers until tender, about 3-5 minutes. Add chopped spinach and stir, cooking until wilted. 2) Add crumbled seitan 'sausage' and mix. Season with salt and spices and stir, cooking until hot. Remove the mixture from the pan. 3) Wipe out the pan, and add the flour tortilla. Add the filling back into the tortilla, covering just half of the wrap. 4) Top with vegan cheese, and fold the other half of the tortilla over the filling. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the tortilla is hot and crispy.

name: Seitan Chorizo Wrap (High Protein)
ingredients: Red cabbage; Flour tortilla; Nutritional yeast seasoning; Avocado; Chorizo seitan
recipe: 1) Heat nonstick pan, add vegan chorizo, sprinkle nutritional yeast. 2) Microwave tortilla 15 seconds, spread avocado, top with cabbage and chorizo. 3) Roll wrap tightly.

name: Seitan Fajitas (Low Carb)
ingredients: Olive oil; Montreal steak seasoning; Liquid aminos natural soy sauce alternative by bragg; Red onion; Seitan strips wheat protein by west soy; Limes raw; Red bell pepper; Corn tortilla; Salt and Pepper; Avocados raw California; Peppers sweet bell green raw
recipe: 1) In a bowl, add liquid aminos, lemon juice, Montreal steak spice and stir until well combined. Then add the Seitan and coat well. 2) Cover and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes. 3) Drain the seitan, but don't discard the marinade. Cook the seitan with the veggies in a skillet over medium-high heat for 5-10 minutes or until golden brown. 4) Wrap the tortillas in a towel and microwave for 10 seconds to soften them. 5) Use three corn tortilla taco sizes. Place the tortillas on a plate, and serve the seitan fajitas, topped with avocado puree, in each tortilla.

name: Seitan Fajitas (Low Fat)
ingredients: Red onion; Liquid aminos natural soy sauce alternative by bragg; Corn tortilla; Olive oil; Limes raw; Montreal steak seasoning; Salt and Pepper; Peppers sweet bell green raw; Red bell pepper; Seitan strips wheat protein by west soy
recipe: 1) In a bowl, add liquid aminos, lemon juice, Montreal steak spice and stir until well combined. Then add the Seitan and coat well. 2) Cover and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes. 3) Drain the seitan, but don't discard the marinade. Cook the seitan with the veggies in a skillet over medium-high heat for 5-10 minutes or until golden brown. 4) Wrap the tortillas in a towel and microwave for 10 seconds to soften them. 5) Next, transfer the tortillas to a plate and serve the seitan fajitas in each tortilla.

name: Seitan Kebabs (Balanced)
ingredients: Mushrooms; Brown sugar; Red bell pepper; Vegan margarine; Garlic; Ginger root; Lime; Green bell pepper; Red onion; Liquid aminos; Seitan cubed wheat protein
recipe: 1) Mix vegan margarine, liquid aminos, sugar, ginger, lime, and garlic. 2) Place seitan pieces with marinade in bag and let sit 30 minutes. 3) Assemble kebab by skewering seitan, peppers, mushroom, and onion. 4) Bake in oven at 450F for 15-20 minutes.

name: Seitan Kebabs (High Protein)
ingredients: Vegan margarine; Garlic; Mushrooms; Brown sugar; Ginger root; Lime; Green bell pepper; Red onion; Red bell pepper; Seitan cubed wheat protein
recipe: 1) Mix vegan margarine, sugar, ginger, lemon, and garlic in saucepan. 2) Place seitan in marinade and let sit. 3) Assemble by skewering seitan, red peppers, mushroom, and onion. 4) Grill until veggies are soft and seitan is hot, brush with excess marinade.

name: Seitan Kebabs (Low Carb)
ingredients: Red onion; Garlic; Liquid aminos; Mushrooms; Seitan cubed wheat protein; Ginger root; Limes; Green bell pepper; Red bell pepper; Vegan margarine
recipe: 1) Place margarine, liquid aminos, ginger, lemon, brown sugar, garlic, and seitan in pan and cook. 2) In another pan, cook vegetables. 3) Assemble kebab by skewering seitan, peppers, mushroom, onion, and bell pepper.

name: Seitan Kebabs (Low Fat)
ingredients: Seitan cubed wheat protein; Brown sugar; Lime; Red onion; Red bell pepper; Vegan margarine; Garlic; Mushrooms; Liquid aminos; Green bell pepper
recipe: 1) Place margarine, liquid aminos, lemon, brown sugar, garlic, and seitan in pan and cook. 2) In another pan, cook vegetables. 3) Assemble kebab by skewering seitan, peppers, mushroom, onion, and green pepper.

name: Seitan Wrap (High Protein)
ingredients: Spinach; Carrots; Tortilla whole wheat flour; Avocado; Vegan mayonnaise; Seitan cubed wheat protein
recipe: 1) Cut seitan lengthwise and cook in nonstick pan. 2) Microwave tortilla 5-10 seconds to soften. 3) Mash avocado, spread on tortilla, add spinach and carrot, add seitan. 4) Wrap carefully and enjoy.

name: Sheet Pan Miso Ginger Tofu (Balanced)
ingredients: 2 tsp Ginger ground dry; 1 tsp Garlic powder; 3/4 block Extra firm organic tofu by trader joe's; 2 cup, cubes (266 g) Sweet potato; 2 tbsp Organic miso paste by yutaka; 2 tbsp Soy sauce; 1 tablespoon Sesame oil; 1 tbsp Rice vinegar; 1 tbsp Maple syrup; 1 cup (110 g) Green beans
recipe: 1) Heat oven to 425F. Add Sesame Oil, soy Sauce, Miso Paste, Rice Vinegar, Maple Syrup, Ginger, and Garlic to a large mixing bowl and whisk to incorporate. 2) Dice tofu into cubes and add both it and the sweet potato into the sauce. Mix carefully to coat. Spread the tofu and sweet potatoes over the baking sheet, reserving any extra sauce in the bowl, and bake for 15 minutes. 3) While baking, add the green beans to the bowl and coat with any residual sauce. After 15 minutes, stir the tofu and sweet potato before adding the green beans to the baking sheet. Cook on additional 15 minutes, or to your desired texture. [Note: macros are per 1 serving (456 cal)]

name: Sheet Pan Tofu Bowl (Balanced)
ingredients: 1 cup (145 g) Green peas; 1 block Tofu firm made with nigari; 4 tsp Chili paste or sambal oelek; 4 tsp Tahini; 1 serving Salt and Pepper; 3 tablespoon Nutritional yeast seasoning; 2 tsp Olive oil; 1 1/2 medium Red onion; 2 1/2 cup chopped Cabbage red raw; 2 cup grated Carrots
recipe: 1) Preheat the oven to 375 F and line a baking tray with parchment paper, set aside. 2) Open the tofu and drain the water. Using your hands, tear the tofu into similar size chunks and add to a mixing bowl. 3) Peel and chop the carrots and red onion into 1/2-inch pieces, chop the cabbage and add to a mixing bowl. 4) Add the green peas, olive oil, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper into the mixing bowl and toss everything to combine. 5) Spread evenly across the baking tray and bake for 20 minutes or until browned and crispy. 6) Plate into two bowls and drizzle each with 2 tahini teaspoons and 2 teaspoons of sambal sauce or chilli sauce. [Note: macros are per 2 servings]

name: Sheet Pan Tofu Bowl (Low Carb)
ingredients: 1 cup grated Carrots; 2 tbsp Tahini; 1 serving Salt and Pepper; 3 tablespoon Nutritional yeast seasoning; 4 tsp Olive oil; 3/4 medium Red onion; 2 tsp Chili paste or sambal oelek; 1 cup chopped Cabbage red raw; 2 block Tofu firm made with nigari
recipe: 1) Preheat the oven to 375 F and line a baking tray with parchment paper, set aside. 2) Open the tofu and drain the water. Using your hands, tear the tofu into similar size chunks and add to a mixing bowl. 3) Peel and chop the carrots and red onion into 1/2-inch pieces, chop the cabbage and add to a mixing bowl. 4) Add the olive oil, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper into the mixing bowl and toss everything to combine. 5) Spread evenly across the baking tray and bake for 20 minutes or until browned and crispy. 6) Plate into two bowls and drizzle each with tahini and sambal sauce. [Note: macros are per 2 servings]

name: Shredded Wheat Cereal with Soy Milk and Flax (Balanced)
ingredients: 2 biscuits Shredded wheat biscuits by uncle tobys; 5 tsp. ground Flaxseeds; 2 2/3 cup (649 g) Soy milk unsweetened fortified; 1/2 large Banana
recipe: 1) Add shredded wheat to a bowl, top with soy milk, flax seeds, and fruit.

name: Shrimp Skewers (Low Fat)
ingredients: 3 cup, chopped Bell Peppers; 9 oz Cooked shrimp; 1 cup, chopped Red onion; 1/2 tbsp Coconut oil
recipe: 1) Preheat oven to 325F. 2) Place the shrimps in a bowl, add coconut oil, salt, and pepper to taste, and mix. 3) Assemble kebabs by alternating skewering pieces of red bell pepper, onion, green bell pepper, and shrimp. 4) Bake in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes, flipping halfway.

name: Silken Tofu Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 110 g (3.88 oz) Dark chocolate 70 - 85% cacao; 450 g (15.87 oz) Tofu soft silken; 2 1/2 tbsp Maple syrup
recipe: 1) Melt the chocolate in the microwave in 30 second intervals, stirring each time, until the chocolate is melted. Set aside. 2) Meanwhile, place the silken tofu and maple syrup in a food processor and blend until very smooth. Add the melted chocolate and blend until well combined. 3) Scoop the mixture into ramekins or glasses, and refrigerate for about 30 minutes, or until chilled. 4) To serve, garnish with chocolate shavings, raspberries, blackberries, or cocoa. [Note: macros are per 5 servings]

name: Silken Tofu Matcha
ingredients: 1 cup (123 g) Raspberries raw; 1 packet Sweetener; 1 teaspoon Matcha tea powder; 1/2 tsp Vanilla extract; 11.99 oz (340 g) Tofu soft silken
recipe: 1) Combine all the ingredients (except for the raspberries) into a food processor and pulse until pudding-like texture is achieved. Add more sweetener if needed. 2) Set aside 1/4 of the raspberries and mash the rest with a fork. 3) Next, serve half of the tofu matcha in a glass, add the mashed raspberries, fill the glass with the remaining tofu, and garnish with raspberries. 4) To give a smoother consistency, cover and place in the fridge for at least 10 minutes.

name: Simple Protein Shake

name: Smoothie Bowl (Balanced)
ingredients: 1 scoop Generic Pea Protein Powder; 2/3 cup (94 g) Berries mixed frozen unsweetened; 1 small, about 6" long Bananas raw; 1/3 tbsp Coconut shredded unsweetened packaged; 1/2 tbsp Chia seeds; 1 tbsp Hemp seeds shelled or hulled; 2 cup (486 g) Soy milk unsweetened fortified; 1/3 cup, halves (50 g) Strawberries raw
recipe: 1) Blend together protein powder, berries, frozen banana, and soy milk (adding more soy milk as necessary to desired texture). 2) Transfer to a bowl, and top with chia seeds, coconut, hemp hearts, and strawberry slices.

recipe: 1) Blend together protein powder, berries, frozen banana, and soy milk (adding more soy milk as necessary to desired texture). 2) Transfer to a bowl, and top with chia seeds, coconut, hemp hearts, and sliced strawberry.

name: Smoothie Bowl (Low Carb)

recipe: 1) Blend together protein powder, berries, and soy milk (adding more soy milk as necessary to desired texture). 2) Transfer to a bowl, and top with chia seeds, coconut, hemp hearts, and sliced strawberry.

name: Snicker Smoothie
ingredients: 2 tsp Peanut butter; 1/2 medium Banana; 1/2 cup (1/2" cubes) Tofu soft made with nigari; 2 tsp Cocoa powder; 1 cup (243 g) Soy milk; 2 date Dates; 1 1/2 scoop Generic Pea Protein Powder

recipe: 1) In a blender, place the tofu cubes and soy milk and blend. 2) Add the banana, protein, peanut butter, cocoa powder, and pitted dates. Blend it again. 3) Option: blend it with a cup of ice and Splenda for a frosty and sweeter consistency.

ingredients: 125 g (4.41 oz) Tofu soft made with nigari; 1 tsp Cocoa powder; 2 scoop Generic Pea Protein Powder; 1 cup (243 g) Soy milk unsweetened fortified; 15 g (0.53 oz) Dates medjool; 1/2 large Banana; 1 tsp Peanut butter
recipe: 1) In a blender, place the tofu cubes and soy milk and blend. 2) Add the banana, protein, peanut butter, cocoa powder, and pitted dates. Blend it again. 3) Option: blend it with a cup of ice for a frosty consistency.

name: Soba Noodle Salad (Balanced)

recipe: 1) Prepare the vegetables first. Slice the peas in half lengthwise, (or just roughly chop them). Slice the carrots into long, thin strips. 2) To make the sauce: whisk together the soy sauce, lime juice, sesame oil, peanut oil, maple syrup, miso, grated ginger, and chile sauce. 3) Bring two big pots of water to a boil. 4) Once the pots of water are boiling: In one pot, cook the soba noodles just until al dente, according to package directions (about 5 minutes), then drain and briefly rinse under cool water. 5) Cook the frozen edamame in the other pot until warmed through (about 4 minutes) but before draining, toss the halved peas into the boiling edamame water and cook for an additional 20 seconds. Drain. 6) [Note: macros are per 3 servings]

name: Soy Ceviche (Balanced)
ingredients: 3 tbsp Liquid aminos natural soy sauce alternative by bragg; 1 tbsp Parsley fresh or raw herb; 1/4 cup, chopped (40 g) Red onion; 1/2 cup, pared, chopped Cucumber peeled raw; 1 cup (60 g) Natural foods textured soy protein chunks by Now; 1 1/2 fruit (2" dia) Limes raw; 20 oz (567 g) Roma tomatoes; 1 cup (221 g) Vegetable broth; 1 clove Garlic raw; 3/4 cup, cubes (113 g) Avocados raw; 1 serving Salt and Pepper, to taste
recipe: 1) Add the vegetable broth, crushed garlic cloves, and salt to a pot, and bring it all to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes (if you cook more than one portion, it will take more time). 2) Turn it off after simmering and add the textured soy chunks. Let it absorb for about 10 minutes while moving it around so most of the broth gets absorbed. 3) Once the soy is ready, drain the excess liquid and discard the garlic cloves. 4) Meanwhile, chop the cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, avocado, and parsley. 5) Transfer the soy into a bowl, and add the cucumber, tomato, red onion, and parsley. Next, stir in the liquid aminos, squeeze the limes, add some pepper, and mix. 6) Taste it to adjust salt and pepper and completely by adding the avocado cubes.

name: Soy Milk
ingredients: 2 1/2 cup (608 g) Soy milk unsweetened fortified
recipe: 1) Pour a large glass of soy milk. Serve.

name: Soy Tacos
ingredients: 60 g (2.12 oz) Soya chunks; 4 enchilada Tortillas corn; 1 tbsp Paprika; 2 1/2 tablespoon, chopped Walnuts; 1 tsp Oil; 2 tbsp chopped Onions raw
recipe: 1) Prepare the soy chunks according to the package. 2) Preheat a pan over medium heat and add the oil.  Cook the onion until translucent. 3) Drain the soy and transfer it into the pan. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until they begin to brown. 4) Next, transfer the soy and onions to a food processor. Add walnuts, salt, paprika, and pepper to taste. Pulse to combine. 5) Prepare the tacos, add coriander leaves or chopped tomato and enjoy!

name: Spanish Scrambled Tofu (Balanced)
ingredients: Almond milk; Salt and Pepper, to taste; Turmeric ground; Spinach; Potato medium Potatoes; Vegan seitan chorizo by be-hive; Tofu firm; Vegan butter spread
recipe: 1) Microwave the potato for 3 to 5 minutes until it's fork-tender. Cut it into slices, and spread the butter on it. 2) With your fingers, break the tofu into medium-sized pieces, directly over the pan. The tofu will break down further during the cooking process. 3) Add turmeric, salt, and pepper to taste, and cook the crumbled tofu. Carefully add the almond milk and cook until it's heated. 4) Next, add in the vegan chorizo, spinach, and potato slices. Stir well and serve.

name: Spanish Scrambled Tofu (High Protein)
ingredients: Almond milk; Salt and Pepper, to taste; Turmeric ground; Spinach; Vegan butter spread; Potato small Potatoes; Vegan seitan chorizo by be-hive; Tofu firm
recipe: 1) Microwave the potato for 3 to 5 minutes until it's fork tender and cut into slices. 2) With your fingers, break the tofu into medium-sized pieces, directly over the pan. The tofu will break down further during the cooking process. 3) Add turmeric, salt, and pepper to taste, and cook the crumbled tofu. Carefully add the almond milk and cook until it's heated and some of the pieces turn slightly golden. 4) Next, add in the vegan chorizo, spinach, and potato slices. Stir well and serve.

name: Spanish Scrambled Tofu (Low Fat )
ingredients: Turmeric ground; Almond milk; Potatoes; Salt and Pepper, to taste; Spinach; Vegan seitan chorizo by be-hive; Tofu firm; Vegan butter spread
recipe: 1) Microwave the potato for 3 to 5 minutes until it's fork-tender. Cut it into slices, and spread the butter on it. 2) With your fingers, break the tofu into medium-sized pieces, directly over the pan. Slice the sausage into rounds. 2) Place the potato and broccoli in a bowl, add oil, salt and pepper to taste, and mix well. 3) Transfer the seasoned potato and broccoli to a large pan. Cover the pan with a lid and cook on medium heat until the vegetables are soft. 4) Next, add the remaining ingredients and cook until the bell pepper is soft and mixed. Transfer into a serving bowl.

name: Veggie Soup (Balanced)
ingredients: 1/4 cup (28 g) Plant-based mozzarella cheese alternative by 365; 1/2 cup, chopped (64 g) Carrots raw; 2/3 cup (74 g) Beef-free crumble by beyond meat; 1 serving Salt and Pepper, to taste; 1 tsp Onion powder; 1 cup (221 g) Vegetable broth; 20 oz (567 g) Roma tomatoes; 1/2 cup, chopped (62 g) Zucchini raw; 1 cup chopped (91 g) Broccoli raw; 1/2 tsp Garlic powder; 1 cup (8 fl oz) (237 g) Water; 1/2 cup (126 g) Tofu firm
recipe: 1) Chop the tomatoes and tofu into small pieces, cut the broccoli into small florets, and continue with carrots. 2) In a large pot, place the beef-free crumble and cook, breaking up the meat with a wooden spoon. Add onion and garlic powder, salt, and pepper to taste. 3) Add in the tomatoes, zucchini, broccoli and carrots. Next, add the vegetable broth and the cup of water. 4) Bring the soup to a simmer and cook covered until the vegetables are tender. Complete by adding the tofu and half of the cheese. 5) Serve and garnish with the remaining cheese on top.

name: Veggie Soup (High Protein)
ingredients: Carrots; Water; Garlic powder; Tofu firm; Nutritional yeast seasoning; Onion powder; Salt and Pepper; Vegetable broth; Zucchini; Broccoli; Roma tomatoes; Beef-free crumble
recipe: 1) Chop tomatoes and tofu into pieces, cut broccoli into florets. 2) Place beef-free crumble in pot and cook, break up meat. Add onion and garlic powder, salt, pepper. 3) Add tomatoes, zucchini, broccoli, carrots, broth, and water. 4) Bring to simmer until vegetables tender. 5) Add tofu and serve.

name: Veggie Soup (Low Fat)
ingredients: Carrots; Tofu firm; Onion powder; Nutritional yeast seasoning; Salt and Pepper; Garlic powder; Vegetable broth; Zucchini; Broccoli; Roma tomatoes; Beef-free crumble
recipe: 1) Chop tomatoes and tofu into pieces, cut broccoli into florets. 2) Place beef-free crumble in pot and cook, break up meat. Add onion and garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3) Add tomatoes, zucchini, broccoli, carrots, and broth with water. 4) Bring to simmer until vegetables tender. 5) Add tofu and serve.

name: Veggies and Hummus
ingredients: 1/2 medium Cucumber peeled raw; 2 small (5-1/2" long) Carrots raw; 5 tbsp Homemade hummus; 2 stalk, medium (7-1/2" - 8" long) Celery raw
recipe: 1) Slice cucumber, carrots, and celery into long strips, and serve with hummus on the side

name: Veggies with Red Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 9 oz (255 g) Carrots baby raw; 9 oz (255 g) Cauliflower boiled with salt; 1/2 tsp Paprika; 2 tsp, minced Garlic raw; 1 large Red bell pepper; 19 oz (539 g) Tofu soft silken; 2 tbsp Chipotle in adobo
recipe: 1) Halve the red bell pepper and remove the seeds. Hold the slices over an open flame or cook in a non-stick pan. 2) Place the next ingredients in a food processor: tofu, roasted pepper, minced garlic, paprika and salt. Blend until smooth. 3) To give a smoother consistency, refrigerate for at least 10 minutes. 4) Serve the vegetables on a plate and add the sauce in a small container. Enjoy! [Note: macros are per 1 serving]

name: Watermelon Coconut Water
ingredients: 1 cup, balls Watermelon; 1 scoop Collagen; 1 cup (240 g) Coconut water raw; 2 tbsp Coconut shredded unsweetened packaged; 1 cup (8 fl oz) (237 g) Water
recipe: 1) In a food processor, add all the ingredients, ice cubes, and a pinch of salt. Blend until smooth. 2) Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Wild Rice Soup - Instant Pot (Low Carb)
ingredients: 1/2 small Onions; 1 tsp Spices poultry seasoning; 4 oz (113 g) Turkey ground 99% lean 1% fat raw; 1 cup (240 g) Chicken broth; 2 tbsp Egg white protein powder unflavored; 4 oz (113 g) Cauliflower Rice; 1 cup (245 g) Almond milk; 1 1/2 tbsp Butter; 2 cup, whole Mushrooms; 1/2 stalk, medium Celery; 1 1/2 clove Garlic; 1 1/2 medium Carrots
recipe: 1) Prepare the ingredients: chop the carrots, celery, and onion, mince the garlic, and slice the mushrooms. 2) Add the carrots, celery, onion, garlic, wild rice, fresh mushrooms, chicken broth, cauliflower, and spice poultry seasoning to the IP. 3) Cook for 5 minutes manually with high pressure. After cooking, release the pressure and allow the steam to empty before opening. 4) Preheat a saucepan and melt the butter, whisk in the almond milk, mix to combine, and add the protein powder. Add a little salt and cook until you have a good measure. 5) Add the cream sauce to the soup in the Instant Pot and mix.

name: Wild Rice Soup - Instant Pot (Low fat)
ingredients: Wild rice; Turkey ground 99% lean 1% fat raw; Cauliflower Rice; Spices poultry seasoning; Chicken broth; Mushrooms whole; Celery; Garlic; Egg white protein powder unflavored; Almond milk; Onions; Carrots
recipe: 1) Prepare the ingredients: chop the carrots, celery, and onion, mince the garlic, and slice the mushrooms. 2) Add the carrots, celery, onion, garlic, wild rice, fresh mushrooms, chicken broth, cauliflower, and spice poultry seasoning to the IP. 3) Cook for 5 minutes manually with high pressure. After cooking, release the pressure and allow the steam to empty before opening. 4) Preheat a saucepan and melt the butter, whisk in the almond milk, mix to combine, and add the protein powder. Add a little salt and cook until you have a good measure. 5) Add the cream sauce to the soup in the Instant Pot and mix.

name: Zen Bowl
ingredients: 2 tsp Red chili flakes spice; 1/2 cup (93 g) Rice white cooked without salt; 1/2 tsp Sesame seed kernels (shelled) dried; 1 tsp Sesame oil; 2 sprays, about 1/3 second each spray Vegetable cooking spray oil; 3 tbsp Soy sauce; 6 piece whole Mushrooms shiitake raw; 250 g (8.82 oz) Tofu firm made with nigari; 2 cup, chopped (300 g) Mustard spinach tendergreen raw
recipe: 1) Slice the mushrooms and cut the tofu into evenly sized cubes. 2) Heat a large pan over medium heat, add the sesame oil, and cook the mushrooms until they are soft. Then, add the spinach combine well, and serve on a plate. 3) Use the same pan, spray it with vegetable oil, add the tofu cubes, and cook over medium heat until golden halfway through. 4) Prepare the bowl, heat the rice, and serve in a bowl. Add the spinach, mushrooms, and tofu pieces. 5) Drizzle soy sauce over the top, sprinkle the chili flakes, and garnish with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Zucchini Cream (High Protein)
ingredients: 1 cup Water; 1/4 cup Chickpeas or garbanzo beans boiled without salt; 2 tsp Olive oil; 1 tsp Garlic; 2 1/2 cup Zucchini chopped; 1 cup Vegetable broth; 1 scoop Generic Pea Protein Powder; 1/2 cup Onions chopped; 1/3 cup Seitan cubed wheat protein by west soy
recipe: 1) Chop the zucchini, mince the garlic, and cut the seitan into smaller cubes. 2) Heat a pot over medium heat and add the oil, garlic, and onion. Stir for 1-2 minutes. Continue adding the zucchini, vegetable broth, and salt and pepper to taste. Pop the lid on and cook over medium heat. 3) Once the zucchini is fork tender, turn it off. Wait a few minutes to cool off and transfer it to a blender. Next, add water, chickpeas, and plant-based protein. Blend until smooth. 4) Heat a pan and cook the seitan until hot. 5) Transfer the seitan into a bowl, add the soup, and mix.

name: Zucchini Cream (Low Carb)
ingredients: 1 cup (8 fl oz) (237 g) Water; ½ cup, chopped (80 g) Onions; 1 tablespoon Olive oil; ¾ cup (189 g) Tofu firm; 1 tsp Garlic; 2½ cup, chopped (310 g) Zucchini; 1 cup (221 g) Vegetable broth; ⅓ cup (85 g) Seitan cubed wheat protein by west soy
recipe: 1) Chop the zucchini, mince the garlic, and cut the seitan into smaller cubes. 2) Heat a pot over medium heat and add the oil, garlic, and onion. Stir for 1-2 minutes. Continue adding the zucchini, vegetable broth, and salt and pepper to taste. Pop the lid on and cook over medium heat. 3) Once the zucchini is fork tender, turn it off. Wait a few minutes to cool off and transfer it to a blender. Next, add in the water, and tofu. Blend until smooth. 4) Heat a pan and add the seitan. Let it cook for a few minutes. 5) Transfer the seitan into a bowl, serve the soup, and mix.

name: Zucchini Overnight Oats (Balanced)
ingredients: Vanilla almond milk; Zucchini raw; Chia seeds; Generic Pea Protein Powder; Dark chocolate; whole Flaxseeds; Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked
recipe: 1) In a jar or bowl, combine and mix the dry ingredients. Grate the zucchini and chop to roughly the size of oats. Grate the dark chocolate or chop it into small pieces. 2) Mix the zucchini into the dry ingredients, then place half of the chocolate and the non-dairy milk. Mix everything until combined and seal the lid. Store the mixture in the fridge overnight, allowing it to thicken. 3) In the morning, place the rest of the chocolate on top. 4) Option use your favorite product of: Plant-based milk sugar-free, Plant-based protein powder, Zero-Calorie Sweetener

name: Zucchini Smoothie (Low Carb)
ingredients: 1 cup, chopped (124 g) Zucchini; 2 1/2 tbsp Meenut butter by paleo; 1 cup (30 g) Spinach; 1 cup (100 g) Organic unsweetened plain cashew milk by forager; 1/2 large Banana; 30 g (1.06 oz) Vanilla protein by pure paleo
recipe: 1) Chop the zucchini and cook the chunks in boiled water for a few minutes. 2) Once ready, transfer into a blender, and add all the remaining ingredients. 3) Use your favorite plant- based milk.

name: Zucchini Stew (Balanced)
ingredients: Salt and Pepper, to taste; 1 tsp ground Oregano dried; 1 cup Tomatoes diced canned; 1 cup Beef-free crumble by Beyond Meat; 3 clove Garlic; 3 tbsp Vegan mozzarella cheese shredded; 1 tsp ground Basil dried; 1 cup Spinach; 3 cup Zucchini; 1 cup Chickpea puree; 2 tsp Olive oil
recipe: 1) Preheat the oven to 365 F. Heat a large skillet over medium heat, heat the oil, add the onion and garlic, and cook until soft. 2) Add the Beyond Meat mixture to the bottom of the baking dish. Arrange the zucchini rounds on the Beyond Meat. Mix together the chickpea puree, spinach, basil, salt, pepper, and seasoning. Cook until vegetables are cooked and cheese melts on top of the zucchini. Spread the remaining meat mixture on top of the zucchini. Sprinkle the remaining meat mozzarella cheese on top of the meat. 3) Cover the baking dish with foil and bake for 20 minutes. 4) Remove the foil and bake for 10 minutes, until the cheese melts and the zucchini is tender.

name: Zucchini Stew (High Protein)
ingredients: 1½ clove Garlic; ¼ cup (28 g) Vegan mozzarella cheese shredded; 2 sprays, about 1/3 second each spray Vegetable cooking spray oil; 1 cup (30 g) Spinach; 2 tablespoon Nutritional yeast seasoning; ½ cup pieces or slices (15 g) Madrooms; ⅛ cup (79 g) Tomatoes diced canned; 1½ cup (165 g) Beef-free crumble by Beyond Meat; 1½ small Onions
recipe: 1) Preheat the oven to 365 F. Cut the zucchini lengthwise. Heat a large skillet over medium heat, spray the vegetable oil, add the onion and garlic, and cook until soft. 2) Add the crumbled Beyond Meat to the skillet and cook for a few minutes. Add the diced tomatoes, sliced mushrooms, spinach, and Italian seasoning. Cook until vegetables are tender. Add salt and pepper to taste. 3) Arrange some zucchini on the baking dish, spread half of the Beyond Meat mixture, place another zucchini layer, and spread the remaining mixture. Sprinkle the cheese on top. 4) Bake for 15 minutes until the zucchini is tender.

name: Farro Salad
ingredients:
3/4 cup (146g) Farro cooked
8.85 oz (251 g) Tofu firm made with nigari
2 clove Garlic raw
1 tablespoon Olive oil
1 cup, chopped or sliced Tomatoes red raw
1 cup (30 g) Spinach all varieties raw
recipe:
1) Mince the garlic, dice the tofu, and chiffonade the spinach.
2) Next, transfer the tofu to a bowl and add olive oil, garlic, and salt.
Option: Season it with fresh rosemary or dried herbs.
3) Combine all the ingredients in a bowl. Enjoy!
